### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/build.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/build.py sha256:a229855eaf4ac5278cb6cceae1ac3503fd8005ec3e11a76c5b89b423ca90add3 -->
````python
"""Workbook builder: puts every tab together in the right order.

Typical use::

    from social_media_spreadsheet import build_workbook
    build_workbook("Social Media Content Planner.xlsx")
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt
import inspect
import os
from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional

from xlsxwriter.workbook import Workbook

from .config import Config
from .formats import FormatBook
from .layout import Registry, SheetSpec
from .names import define_cross_sheet_names
from .sheets import (ab_tests, accounts, ads, analytics, annual, assets,
                     brand_voice, budget, calc, calendar_sheet, campaigns,
                     captions, competitors, compliance, dashboard, goals,
                     hashtags, help_tab, ideas, influencers, launches,
                     lists, month_view, performance, personas, pillars,
                     platforms, printables, reports, repurposing, seasonal,
                     settings, start_here, tasks, team, trends, ugc,
                     workflow)
from .writer import SheetWriter

#: register modules, in the order their specs are registered
REGISTER_MODULES = [
    accounts, personas, pillars, calendar_sheet, ideas, captions, hashtags,
    platforms.INSTAGRAM, platforms.TIKTOK, platforms.PINTEREST,
    platforms.YOUTUBE, platforms.FACEBOOK, campaigns, launches, seasonal,
    influencers, ugc, repurposing, competitors, trends, analytics,
    performance, ab_tests, ads, assets, goals, budget, team, tasks,
    compliance,
]

#: tab order of the finished workbook
SHEET_ORDER: List[str] = [
    "Start Here", "Dashboard", "Annual Dashboard", "Settings", "Lists",
    "Brand Voice", "Accounts", "Audience Personas", "Content Pillars",
    "Content Calendar", "Month View", "Workflow",
    "Idea Bank", "Caption Bank", "Hashtag Bank",
    "Instagram", "TikTok", "Pinterest", "YouTube", "Facebook",
    "Campaigns", "Launch Planner", "Seasonal Planner",
    "Influencers", "UGC Tracker", "Repurposing", "Competitors", "Trends",
    "Analytics", "Performance", "AB Tests", "Ads", "Assets",
    "Goals", "Budget", "Team", "Tasks", "Compliance",
    "Reports", "Print Brief", "Print Week", "Help",
    "Calc",
]

#: sheets that are not registers - name -> builder(book, fmts, cfg, reg)
PAGE_BUILDERS: Dict[str, Callable] = {
    "Start Here": start_here.build,
    "Dashboard": dashboard.build,
    "Annual Dashboard": annual.build,
    "Month View": month_view.build,
    "Workflow": workflow.build,
    "Settings": settings.build,
    "Lists": lists.build,
    "Brand Voice": brand_voice.build,
    "Reports": reports.build,
    "Print Brief": printables.build_brief,
    "Print Week": printables.build_week,
    "Help": help_tab.build,
    "Calc": calc.build,
}

#: register modules by sheet name
REGISTER_BY_NAME = {module.NAME: module for module in REGISTER_MODULES}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_register(book, fmts: FormatBook, cfg: Config, reg: Registry,
                   module) -> SheetWriter:
    """Create one register sheet from its :class:`SheetSpec`."""
    spec: SheetSpec = reg[module.NAME]
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, spec.name,
                        tab_color=spec.tab_color)
    sheet.grid(spec)
    decorate = getattr(module, "decorate", None)
    if decorate is not None:
        wants_registry = len(inspect.signature(decorate).parameters) >= 4
        if wants_registry:
            decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg)
        else:
            decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def build_workbook(path: str = "Social Media Content Planner.xlsx",
                   cfg: Optional[Config] = None) -> str:
    """Write the whole product to *path* and return the path."""
    cfg = cfg or Config()
    folder = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if folder and not os.path.isdir(folder):
        os.makedirs(folder)

    book = Workbook(path)
    _set_properties(book, cfg)

    fmts = FormatBook(book, cfg)
    reg = Registry()

    # 1. Register every spec first so cross sheet formulas resolve no
    #    matter which tab happens to be written first.
    for module in REGISTER_MODULES:
        reg.add(module.spec(cfg))

    # 2. Write the tabs in their final order.
    sheets: Dict[str, SheetWriter] = {}
    for name in SHEET_ORDER:
        if name in REGISTER_BY_NAME:
            sheets[name] = build_register(book, fmts, cfg, reg,
                                          REGISTER_BY_NAME[name])
        elif name in PAGE_BUILDERS:
            sheets[name] = PAGE_BUILDERS[name](book, fmts, cfg, reg)
        else:                                   # pragma: no cover
            raise KeyError(f"No builder for sheet '{name}'")

    # 3. Live lookup names (content IDs, campaign names, team members).
    define_cross_sheet_names(book, reg)

    # 4. Final touches: hide the engine, open on the first page.
    if calc.NAME in sheets:
        sheets[calc.NAME].ws.hide()
    first = sheets[SHEET_ORDER[0]].ws
    first.activate()
    first.set_first_sheet()

    book.close()
    return path


def _set_properties(book, cfg: Config) -> None:
    book.set_properties({
        "title": cfg.product_name,
        "subject": "Social media content planning and analytics",
        "author": cfg.author,
        "manager": cfg.author,
        "company": cfg.author,
        "category": "Small business spreadsheet template",
        "keywords": ("social media, content calendar, content planner, "
                     "instagram, tiktok, pinterest, youtube, facebook, "
                     "analytics, engagement, hashtags, spreadsheet "
                     "template"),
        "comments": (f"{cfg.product_name}. Created by {cfg.author}. "
                     f"Version {cfg.version}. Formula cells are locked and "
                     f"every sheet is protected with the password "
                     f"'{cfg.password}'."),
        "status": "Final",
        "created": _dt.datetime(cfg.today.year, cfg.today.month,
                                cfg.today.day),
    })
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/cli.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/cli.py sha256:494b57e22a30af1706b5176b14c4911434d72abf219977c0c1d1f470a1b4970d -->
````python
"""Command line front end.

    python -m social_media_spreadsheet
    python -m social_media_spreadsheet -o "output/Planner.xlsx" --blank
    python -m social_media_spreadsheet --currency "£" --year 2027 --rows 300
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as _dt
import os
import sys
from typing import List, Optional

from .build import SHEET_ORDER, build_workbook
from .config import AUTHOR, PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE, PRODUCT_NAME, Config

DEFAULT_OUTPUT = os.path.join(
    "output", "Social Media Content Planner.xlsx")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="social_media_spreadsheet",
        description=f"Build the {PRODUCT_NAME} workbook.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT,
                        help="where to write the .xlsx file")
    parser.add_argument("--blank", action="store_true", default=True,
                        help="leave the registers empty "
                             "(no example records)")
    parser.add_argument("--no-protect", action="store_true",
                        help="do not protect the sheets (for development)")
    parser.add_argument("--password", default=None,
                        help="sheet protection password")
    parser.add_argument("--author", default=AUTHOR,
                        help="document author / creator")
    parser.add_argument("--brand", default=None,
                        help="pre-fill the brand name on Business Setup")
    parser.add_argument("--currency", default=None,
                        help="currency symbol, e.g. $ £ € A$")
    parser.add_argument("--currency-code", default=None,
                        help="three letter currency code, e.g. USD")
    parser.add_argument("--year", type=int, default=None,
                        help="planning year the calendar opens on")
    parser.add_argument("--week-start", choices=["Monday", "Sunday"],
                        default=None, help="first day of the week")
    parser.add_argument("--rows", type=int, default=None,
                        help="scale every register (default row counts are "
                             "multiplied to fit this many calendar rows)")
    parser.add_argument("--today", default=None,
                        help="treat this ISO date as 'today' when "
                             "generating the example data")
    parser.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true",
                        help="only print the output path")
    return parser


def config_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> Config:
    kwargs = {}
    if args.blank:
        kwargs["include_sample_data"] = False
    if args.no_protect:
        kwargs["protect_sheets"] = False
    if args.password:
        kwargs["password"] = args.password
    if args.author:
        kwargs["author"] = args.author
    if args.currency:
        kwargs["currency_symbol"] = args.currency
    if args.currency_code:
        kwargs["currency_code"] = args.currency_code
    if args.week_start:
        kwargs["week_start"] = args.week_start
    if args.year:
        kwargs["plan_year"] = args.year
    if args.today:
        kwargs["today"] = _dt.date.fromisoformat(args.today)
    cfg = Config(**kwargs)
    if args.brand:
        cfg.brand.name = args.brand
    if args.rows:
        cfg.scale_rows(args.rows)
    return cfg


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        cfg = config_from_args(args)
    except ValueError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    path = build_workbook(args.output, cfg)
    size = os.path.getsize(path) / 1024.0

    if args.quiet:
        print(path)
        return 0

    print(f"{cfg.product_name}")
    print(f"  listing title : {PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE}")
    print(f"  author        : {cfg.author}")
    print(f"  sheets        : {len(SHEET_ORDER)} "
          f"(1 hidden calculation engine)")
    print(f"  planning year : {cfg.year}")
    print(f"  example data  : {'no' if not cfg.include_sample_data else 'yes'}")
    print(f"  protection    : "
          f"{'off' if not cfg.protect_sheets else 'on, password ' + cfg.password}")
    print(f"  written to    : {os.path.abspath(path)}  ({size:,.0f} KB)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":        # pragma: no cover
    raise SystemExit(main())
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/config.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/config.py sha256:f73d8adaaab07e7d744873b1febc5e7bd0849f598186e93353572202d3bbd5c0 -->
````python
"""
Configuration for the Social Media Content Calendar & Analytics Planner.

Everything a shop owner may want to re-brand lives here, so the workbook can
be regenerated for a different brand, currency or country without touching
any of the sheet code.

Author of the generated workbooks: Novality Store.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import date


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Product / branding constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

AUTHOR = "Novality Store"
PRODUCT_NAME = "Social Media Content Calendar & Analytics Planner"
PRODUCT_SUBTITLE = (
    "12-Month Content Calendar, Caption & Hashtag Banks, Campaigns and "
    "Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube & Facebook Analytics"
)
PRODUCT_VERSION = "1.0.0"

#: Title suggested for the shop listing.
PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE = (
    "Social Media Content Planner Spreadsheet, 12-Month Content Calendar, "
    "Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and Facebook Analytics Tracker"
)

#: Password that protects every sheet so formula cells cannot be edited by
#: accident.  Input cells stay unlocked, formula cells are locked.
FORMULA_PASSWORD = "premium"

#: The platforms the workbook reports on out of the box.  Change these on the
#: Lists tab and every drop down follows; the five analytics columns on the
#: dashboards follow :data:`TRACKED_PLATFORMS`.
TRACKED_PLATFORMS = ["Instagram", "TikTok", "Pinterest", "YouTube",
                     "Facebook"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Colour palette (indigo / coral scheme used across every tab)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Palette:
    ink = "#241B38"          # darkest indigo - titles
    primary = "#3B2A6B"      # headers
    primary_mid = "#6350A8"  # section bands
    primary_soft = "#E7E3F6"  # light band / alternating rows
    accent = "#F2665E"       # coral accent
    accent_soft = "#FDEBE9"
    input_bg = "#FFFCF7"     # editable cell background (warm white)
    input_border = "#E8DCC8"
    calc_bg = "#F1EFF8"      # locked formula cell background (soft lilac)
    calc_border = "#D8D2EA"
    white = "#FFFFFF"
    grey_text = "#5F5A70"
    line = "#C7C1DA"
    good_bg = "#D9F2E4"
    good_text = "#0E6B45"
    warn_bg = "#FFF1CF"
    warn_text = "#8A5A00"
    bad_bg = "#FBD9DD"
    bad_text = "#9C1C2E"
    info_bg = "#DEE8FA"
    info_text = "#2A4A8B"
    note_bg = "#F8F7FC"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Row capacity of every register (how many pre-formatted / pre-formulated rows)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DEFAULT_ROWS = {
    "Settings": 0,
    "Lists": 40,
    "Accounts": 30,
    "Audience Personas": 12,
    "Content Pillars": 20,
    "Content Calendar": 600,
    "Idea Bank": 300,
    "Caption Bank": 200,
    "Hashtag Bank": 300,
    "Instagram": 200,
    "TikTok": 200,
    "Pinterest": 200,
    "YouTube": 120,
    "Facebook": 200,
    "Campaigns": 60,
    "Launch Planner": 40,
    "Seasonal Planner": 60,
    "Influencers": 60,
    "UGC Tracker": 100,
    "Repurposing": 150,
    "Competitors": 40,
    "Trends": 80,
    "Analytics": 150,
    "Performance": 400,
    "AB Tests": 40,
    "Ads": 100,
    "Assets": 250,
    "Goals": 40,
    "Budget": 60,
    "Team": 30,
    "Tasks": 60,
}


@dataclass
class BrandDefaults:
    """Sample values written into the Business Setup (Settings) sheet."""

    name: str = ""
    owner: str = ""
    email: str = ""
    phone: str = ""
    website: str = ""
    shop: str = ""
    industry: str = ""
    niche: str = ""
    audience: str = ""
    goal: str = ""
    logo_link: str = ""
    palette: str = ""
    fonts: str = ""
    timezone: str = ""
    hashtag: str = ""


@dataclass
class Config:
    """All generator options."""

    output_path: str = "output/Social Media Content Planner.xlsx"

    # Branding / document properties
    author: str = AUTHOR
    company: str = AUTHOR
    product_name: str = PRODUCT_NAME
    product_subtitle: str = PRODUCT_SUBTITLE
    version: str = PRODUCT_VERSION
    release_date: str = "2026-10-11"

    # Protection
    password: str = FORMULA_PASSWORD
    protect_sheets: bool = True

    # Formats
    currency_symbol: str = "$"
    currency_code: str = "USD"
    date_format: str = "dd-mmm-yyyy"
    time_format: str = "h:mm AM/PM"

    # Brand / planning defaults pre-filled on the Settings tab
    brand: BrandDefaults = field(default_factory=BrandDefaults)
    plan_year: int = 0               # 0 = the year of `today`
    week_start: str = "Monday"
    posts_per_week_target: int = 3
    monthly_post_target: int = 13
    engagement_target: float = 0.045
    follower_goal: int = 25000
    reach_goal: int = 120000
    click_goal: int = 1800
    lead_goal: int = 240
    conversion_goal: int = 90
    revenue_goal: float = 36000.0
    monthly_budget: float = 900.0
    annual_budget: float = 10800.0
    roas_target: float = 4.0
    cost_per_lead_target: float = 6.0
    production_days: int = 5          # draft deadline before publishing
    approval_days: int = 2            # approval deadline before publishing
    overdue_grace_days: int = 0
    idea_review_days: int = 14
    trend_window_days: int = 14
    asset_review_days: int = 180
    inactive_account_days: int = 30
    top_rows: int = 5                 # size of the "top content" tables

    # Content switches
    include_sample_data: bool = False
    rows: dict = field(default_factory=lambda: dict(DEFAULT_ROWS))
    today: date = field(default_factory=date.today)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    def row_count(self, sheet: str) -> int:
        return int(self.rows.get(sheet, 100))

    @property
    def year(self) -> int:
        return self.plan_year or self.today.year

    @property
    def MONTHS(self) -> "list[str]":
        """Twelve 'Mmm-yy' labels for the planning year (Mar-26 style)."""
        months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug",
                  "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
        yy = str(self.year)[-2:]
        return [f"{m}-{yy}" for m in months]

    def scale_rows(self, calendar_rows: int) -> None:
        """Scale every register in place so the calendar holds N rows."""
        base = DEFAULT_ROWS["Content Calendar"]
        factor = max(0.02, float(calendar_rows) / float(base))
        self.rows = {k: (max(5, int(round(v * factor))) if v else v)
                     for k, v in self.rows.items()}

    def scaled(self, factor: float) -> "Config":
        """Return a copy with every register scaled."""
        rows = {k: max(5, int(round(v * factor))) if v else v
                for k, v in self.rows.items()}
        return replace(self, rows=rows)

    # Number format strings derived from the chosen currency ------------------
    @property
    def money_format(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'"{s}"#,##0.00;[Red]-"{s}"#,##0.00'

    @property
    def money_format_0(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'"{s}"#,##0;[Red]-"{s}"#,##0'
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/formats.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/formats.py sha256:c576d93ad6fd40ccc34735d638e759b0e2c4d234ea9f061fa769fb28afab9fa8 -->
````python
"""
Cell format factory.

Two things matter here:

* **Input cells** are unlocked (``locked: False``) and painted cream, so the
  user can type in them while the sheet is protected.
* **Formula cells** are locked (``locked: True``) and painted cool grey.  With
  the sheet protection password in place ("premium" by default) they cannot be
  overwritten by accident.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict

from .config import Config, Palette

P = Palette

INPUT = "input"
CALC = "calc"
PLAIN = "plain"


class FormatBook:
    """Creates (and caches) every :class:`xlsxwriter.format.Format` used."""

    def __init__(self, book, config: Config) -> None:
        self.book = book
        self.cfg = config
        self._cache: Dict[Any, Any] = {}

        money = config.money_format
        money0 = config.money_format_0
        self._styles: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            "text": {"align": "left"},
            "id": {"align": "left", "bold": True, "font_color": P.primary},
            "wrap": {"align": "left", "valign": "top", "text_wrap": True},
            "date": {"num_format": config.date_format, "align": "center"},
            "time": {"num_format": config.time_format, "align": "center"},
            "money": {"num_format": money, "align": "right"},
            "money0": {"num_format": money0, "align": "right"},
            "number": {"num_format": "#,##0.00", "align": "right"},
            "number1": {"num_format": "#,##0.0", "align": "right"},
            "int": {"num_format": "#,##0", "align": "right"},
            "percent": {"num_format": "0.0%", "align": "center"},
            "percent0": {"num_format": "0%", "align": "center"},
            "rating": {"num_format": "0", "align": "center"},
            "flag": {"align": "center"},
            "status": {"align": "center", "bold": True},
            "link": {"align": "left", "font_color": P.info_text,
                     "underline": 1},
        }

        self._modes: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            INPUT: {"locked": False, "bg_color": P.input_bg,
                    "border": 1, "border_color": P.input_border},
            CALC: {"locked": True, "bg_color": P.calc_bg,
                   "border": 1, "border_color": P.calc_border,
                   "font_color": P.ink},
            PLAIN: {"locked": True},
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ core
    def _make(self, props: Dict[str, Any]):
        key = tuple(sorted((k, str(v)) for k, v in props.items()))
        if key not in self._cache:
            self._cache[key] = self.book.add_format(props)
        return self._cache[key]

    def cell(self, style: str = "text", mode: str = INPUT, **extra):
        """Data cell format: `style` = value type, `mode` = input/calc/plain."""
        props: Dict[str, Any] = {"font_name": "Calibri", "font_size": 10,
                                 "valign": "vcenter"}
        props.update(self._modes[mode])
        props.update(self._styles.get(style, {}))
        props.update(extra)
        return self._make(props)

    def input(self, style: str = "text", **extra):
        return self.cell(style, INPUT, **extra)

    def calc(self, style: str = "text", **extra):
        return self.cell(style, CALC, **extra)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- chrome
    def chrome(self, name: str, **extra):
        base: Dict[str, Any] = {"font_name": "Calibri", "font_size": 10,
                                "locked": True, "valign": "vcenter"}
        styles: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            "title": {"font_size": 18, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                      "bg_color": P.primary, "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "title_right": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "right", "indent": 1},
            "subtitle": {"font_size": 10, "italic": True,
                         "font_color": P.grey_text, "bg_color": P.note_bg,
                         "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "nav": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True, "font_color": P.info_text,
                    "bg_color": P.note_bg, "underline": 1, "align": "left",
                    "indent": 1},
            "nav_plain": {"font_size": 9, "font_color": P.grey_text,
                          "bg_color": P.note_bg, "align": "left"},
            "section": {"font_size": 11, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                        "bg_color": P.primary_mid, "align": "left",
                        "indent": 1},
            "subsection": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                           "font_color": P.primary, "bg_color": P.primary_soft,
                           "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "header": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                       "bg_color": P.primary, "align": "center",
                       "valign": "vcenter", "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                       "border_color": P.primary},
            "header_left": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "left", "valign": "vcenter",
                            "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                            "border_color": P.primary, "indent": 1},
            "label": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "indent": 1,
                      "font_color": P.ink},
            "label_bold": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True, "align": "left",
                           "indent": 1, "font_color": P.ink},
            "label_right": {"font_size": 10, "align": "right",
                            "font_color": P.ink},
            "note": {"font_size": 9, "italic": True,
                     "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "left",
                     "text_wrap": True, "valign": "top"},
            "note_box": {"font_size": 9, "font_color": P.ink,
                         "bg_color": P.accent_soft, "align": "left",
                         "valign": "top", "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.accent, "indent": 1},
            "kpi_label": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                          "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary_mid,
                          "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "kpi_value": {"font_size": 16, "bold": True,
                          "font_color": P.ink, "bg_color": P.white,
                          "align": "center", "valign": "vcenter",
                          "border": 1, "border_color": P.line},
            "kpi_note": {"font_size": 8, "italic": True,
                         "font_color": P.grey_text, "bg_color": P.white,
                         "align": "center", "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.line},
            "total_label": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "total_value": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "right"},
            "form_label": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True, "align": "left",
                           "font_color": P.primary, "bottom": 1,
                           "bottom_color": P.line, "indent": 1},
            "form_line": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "bottom": 1,
                          "bottom_color": P.ink, "locked": False},
            "form_box": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "valign": "top",
                         "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.ink, "locked": False},
            "print_title": {"font_size": 16, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.primary, "align": "left"},
            "print_sub": {"font_size": 10, "italic": True,
                          "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "left"},
            "legend_input": {"font_size": 9, "bg_color": P.input_bg,
                             "border": 1, "border_color": P.input_border,
                             "align": "center"},
            "legend_calc": {"font_size": 9, "bg_color": P.calc_bg,
                            "border": 1, "border_color": P.calc_border,
                            "align": "center"},
            "band": {"bg_color": P.primary_soft},
            "rule": {"bottom": 2, "bottom_color": P.primary},
            "legend_label": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                             "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "right"},
            "day_number": {"font_size": 11, "bold": True,
                           "font_color": P.primary,
                           "bg_color": P.primary_soft, "align": "left",
                           "indent": 1, "num_format": "d ddd",
                           "border": 1, "border_color": P.line},
            "day_item": {"font_size": 8, "font_color": P.ink,
                         "align": "left", "indent": 1, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.line, "bg_color": P.white},
        }
        props = dict(base)
        props.update(styles.get(name, {}))
        props.update(extra)
        return self._make(props)

    # -------------------------------------------------- conditional formats
    def cf(self, kind: str):
        """Formats used by conditional formatting rules."""
        palettes = {
            "good": {"bg_color": P.good_bg, "font_color": P.good_text},
            "warn": {"bg_color": P.warn_bg, "font_color": P.warn_text},
            "bad": {"bg_color": P.bad_bg, "font_color": P.bad_text},
            "info": {"bg_color": P.info_bg, "font_color": P.info_text},
            "muted": {"font_color": P.grey_text, "italic": True},
            "bold_bad": {"bg_color": P.bad_bg, "font_color": P.bad_text,
                         "bold": True},
            "bold_good": {"bg_color": P.good_bg, "font_color": P.good_text,
                          "bold": True},
        }
        return self._make(palettes[kind])
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/layout.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/layout.py sha256:4b441177388519fc19be8b904aa3e194cf033c4743fefa1714ac2b24c82fdf5c -->
````python
"""
Layout engine.

The workbook is described declaratively: every register sheet (Content Calendar,
Caption Bank, Analytics, ...) is a :class:`SheetSpec` made of :class:`Col`
objects.  Formulas
are written as templates that never contain hard coded column letters, so
columns can be reordered or inserted without breaking a single formula:

    "=IF({title}{r}=\\"\\",\\"\\",SUMIFS([[Performance.reach]],[[Performance.content]],{id}{r}))"

    {r}            -> the current Excel row number (1 based)
    {key}          -> column letter of the column `key` on the *same* sheet
    [[Sheet.key]]  -> absolute range of that column's data rows, e.g.
                      Performance!$K$5:$K$304
    [[Sheet.key#r]]-> absolute single cell of that column on row r
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import string
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence

# Row 1 title, row 2 strapline, row 3 navigation, row 4 headers, row 5+ data.
TITLE_ROW = 1
SUBTITLE_ROW = 2
NAV_ROW = 3
HEADER_ROW = 4
DATA_ROW = 5


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A1 helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def col_letter(index: int) -> str:
    """0 based column index -> Excel column letter."""
    letters = ""
    index += 1
    while index:
        index, rem = divmod(index - 1, 26)
        letters = string.ascii_uppercase[rem] + letters
    return letters


def quote_sheet(name: str) -> str:
    """Quote a sheet name for use inside a formula when it needs it."""
    if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*$", name):
        return name
    return "'" + name.replace("'", "''") + "'"


def cell_ref(col: int, row: int, absolute: bool = True) -> str:
    dollar = "$" if absolute else ""
    return f"{dollar}{col_letter(col)}{dollar}{row}"


def rows_to_last(first_row: int, rows: int) -> int:
    """First data row + count -> last data row (1 based, inclusive)."""
    return first_row + rows - 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Column / sheet specifications
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Col:
    """One column of a register sheet."""

    key: str
    header: str
    width: float = 14.0
    style: str = "text"              # key into the format book (see formats.py)
    formula: Optional[str] = None    # template -> locked, calculated column
    validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    note: Optional[str] = None       # help text shown when the cell is selected
    cf: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    hidden: bool = False
    group: str = ""                  # section label (documentation only)

    @property
    def is_formula(self) -> bool:
        return self.formula is not None


@dataclass
class SheetSpec:
    """A register sheet: title band, header row and N pre-built data rows."""

    name: str
    title: str
    subtitle: str = ""
    columns: List[Col] = field(default_factory=list)
    rows: int = 100
    header_row: int = HEADER_ROW        # 1 based Excel row of the header
    tab_color: Optional[str] = None
    freeze_cols: int = 2
    freeze_at: Optional[int] = None   # 1 based row to freeze below
    samples: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    help_text: str = ""
    extra_notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    first_data_row: Optional[int] = None   # override; else header_row + 1
    last_data_row: Optional[int] = None    # override; else header_row + rows
    extra_rows: int = 0                    # slack rows after the register

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        cols: List[Col] = []
        for c in self.columns:
            if isinstance(c, Col):
                cols.append(c)
            else:
                d = dict(c)
                d.pop("is_formula", None)   # implied by `formula`
                cols.append(Col(**d))
        self.columns = cols
        if self.first_data_row is not None:
            self.header_row = self.first_data_row - 1
        if self.last_data_row is not None:
            self.rows = self.last_data_row - self.header_row
        self.first_data_row = self.header_row + 1
        self.last_data_row = self.header_row + self.rows

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- geometry

    def index(self, key: str) -> int:
        for i, col in enumerate(self.columns):
            if col.key == key:
                return i
        raise KeyError(f"{self.name}: unknown column '{key}'")

    def letter(self, key: str) -> str:
        return col_letter(self.index(key))

    def col(self, key: str) -> Col:
        return self.columns[self.index(key)]

    @property
    def last_col_index(self) -> int:
        return len(self.columns) - 1


class Registry:
    """Lookup table of every registered :class:`SheetSpec`."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._specs: Dict[str, SheetSpec] = {}

    def add(self, spec: SheetSpec) -> SheetSpec:
        self._specs[spec.name] = spec
        return spec

    def __contains__(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return name in self._specs

    def __getitem__(self, name: str) -> SheetSpec:
        return self._specs[name]

    def names(self) -> Sequence[str]:
        return list(self._specs)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ references
    def rng(self, sheet: str, key: str, first: Optional[int] = None,
            last: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
        spec = self._specs[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        first = first or spec.first_data_row
        last = last or spec.last_data_row
        return f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first}:${letter}${last}"

    def cell(self, sheet: str, key: str, row: int) -> str:
        spec = self._specs[sheet]
        return f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${spec.letter(key)}${row}"

    def letter(self, sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        return self._specs[sheet].letter(key)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- renderer
    _REF = re.compile(r"\[\[([^\].#]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)(?:#(\d*))?\]\]")

    def render(self, template: str, row: Optional[int] = None,
               spec: Optional[SheetSpec] = None) -> str:
        """Expand [[Sheet.key]] and {key}/{r} tokens into a real formula."""

        def _ref(match: "re.Match[str]") -> str:
            sheet, key, single = match.group(1), match.group(2), match.group(3)
            if single:
                return self.cell(sheet, key, int(single))
            if single == "":
                # [[Sheet.key#]] -> same row as the formula being written
                if row is None:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"[[{sheet}.{key}#]] needs a row context")
                return self.cell(sheet, key, row)
            return self.rng(sheet, key)

        # [[Defined Name]] (no dot) -> quoted workbook level name.
        text = re.sub(r"\[\[([^\.\[\]]+)\]\]", lambda m: "'" + m.group(1) + "'",
                      template)
        text = self._REF.sub(_ref, text)

        if spec is not None:
            mapping: Dict[str, Any] = {c.key: spec.letter(c.key)
                                       for c in spec.columns}
            if row is not None:
                mapping["r"] = row
                mapping["r_prev"] = row - 1
            mapping["first"] = spec.first_data_row
            mapping["last"] = spec.last_data_row
            # $col$first / $col$last keyword tokens -> real rows.
            text = re.sub(
                r"\$([A-Z]{1,3})\$(first|last)",
                lambda m: f"${m.group(1)}${mapping[m.group(2)]}",
                text)
            text = text.format(**mapping)
        elif row is not None:
            text = text.format(r=row)
        return text


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reusable formula fragments
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def max_if(value_range: str, *conditions: str) -> str:
    """MAX of `value_range` where all conditions hold (no CSE required)."""
    cond = "*".join(f"({c})" for c in conditions)
    return f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX({cond}*{value_range}))"


def min_if(value_range: str, *conditions: str, sentinel: int = 2958465) -> str:
    """MIN of `value_range` where all conditions hold (no CSE required).

    Non matching rows are swapped for a sentinel (31-Dec-9999 as a serial) so
    that MIN ignores them.  Returns the sentinel when nothing matches, so the
    caller should wrap the result in an IF test.
    """
    cond = "*".join(f"({c})" for c in conditions)
    return (f"SUMPRODUCT(MIN({cond}*{value_range}"
            f"+(1-{cond})*{sentinel}))")


def blank_if(test: str, result: str) -> str:
    return f'IF({test},"",{result})'


def safe(expr: str, fallback: str = '""') -> str:
    return f"IFERROR({expr},{fallback})"


def lookup(value: str, table_range: str, index_range: str,
           fallback: str = '""') -> str:
    """INDEX/MATCH lookup (works left or right, unlike VLOOKUP)."""
    return f"IFERROR(INDEX({index_range},MATCH({value},{table_range},0)),{fallback})"


def dynamic_name(sheet: str, letter: str, first: int, last: int,
                 count_text: bool = True) -> str:
    """OFFSET based defined name that grows with the populated rows."""
    rng = f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first}:${letter}${last}"
    counter = f'COUNTIF({rng},"?*")' if count_text else f"COUNTA({rng})"
    return (f"=OFFSET({quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first},0,0,"
            f"MAX(1,{counter}),1)")


def join_nonblank(parts: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    """Build `a & b & c` style concatenation."""
    return "&".join(parts)
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/names.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/names.py sha256:8ccad11616abd431e92a608a4f193292995134b1e57380af488c8df22c983a94 -->
````python
"""Workbook level defined names that point at the register sheets.

The drop down lists on the `Lists` tab define their own names; these are the
ones that have to follow live data (content IDs, caption IDs, campaign names,
...), so they are built from the registry once every register has been
created.  Each one is an ``OFFSET`` range that grows and shrinks with the
number of filled rows.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Dict, Tuple

from .layout import Registry, dynamic_name

#: defined name -> (sheet, column key)
CROSS_SHEET_NAMES: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str]] = {
    "AccountNames": ("Accounts", "account"),
    "PersonaNames": ("Audience Personas", "name"),
    "PillarNames": ("Content Pillars", "name"),
    "ContentIDs": ("Content Calendar", "id"),
    "ContentTitles": ("Content Calendar", "title"),
    "CaptionIDs": ("Caption Bank", "id"),
    "CaptionTitles": ("Caption Bank", "title"),
    "IdeaIDs": ("Idea Bank", "id"),
    "CampaignNames": ("Campaigns", "name"),
    "LaunchNames": ("Launch Planner", "product"),
    "InfluencerNames": ("Influencers", "name"),
    "CompetitorNames": ("Competitors", "name"),
    "TrendNames": ("Trends", "name"),
    "AssetIDs": ("Assets", "id"),
    "GoalNames": ("Goals", "name"),
    "TeamNames": ("Team", "name"),
    "HashtagIDs": ("Hashtag Bank", "id"),
}


def define_cross_sheet_names(book, reg: Registry) -> None:
    """Create the live lookup names. Call after every register is built."""
    for name, (sheet, key) in CROSS_SHEET_NAMES.items():
        if sheet not in reg:
            continue
        spec = reg[sheet]
        book.define_name(
            name,
            dynamic_name(sheet, spec.letter(key), spec.first_data_row,
                         spec.last_data_row))
````

````python
"""Sheet modules for the Social Media Content Calendar & Analytics Planner.

* **Register modules** expose a ``NAME`` and a ``spec(cfg)`` returning a
  :class:`~social_media_spreadsheet.layout.SheetSpec`.  Some also expose
  ``decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg)`` for totals / callouts.
* **Page modules** expose a ``build(book, fmts, cfg, reg)`` function and return
  the finished :class:`~social_media_spreadsheet.writer.SheetWriter`.
"""
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/sheets/annual.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/sheets/annual.py sha256:996a5f2947580d80c0f911c946350bbb4f692a9f1843a2b8eeaed66a42dfd4af -->
````python
"""The `Annual Dashboard` tab - the year at a glance, month by month."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..writer import SheetWriter

NAME = "Annual Dashboard"
LAST_COL = 14      # A+B label, C..N twelve months, O year total

MONTH_START = "DATE(Setting_Year,COLUMN()-2,1)"
MONTH_END = "DATE(Setting_Year,COLUMN()-1,1)"


def build(book, fmts, cfg, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color="#2E7D8F")
    f = sheet.f
    sheet.hide_gridlines()
    sheet.banner("Annual Dashboard",
                 f"{cfg.brand.name}  |  The whole {cfg.today.year} on one page - "
                 f"every column counts itself from your tabs.",
                 LAST_COL)

    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 3)
    sheet.set_col(1, 1, 22)
    sheet.set_col(2, LAST_COL, 10)

    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "Year totals by month", LAST_COL)
    # Month header row (Excel row = row + 1). Labels are text like 'Mar-26'.
    header_row = row
    sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, "Metric", f.chrome("header"))
    for i, month in enumerate(cfg.MONTHS):
        sheet.write(row, 2 + i, month, f.chrome("header"))
    sheet.write(row, LAST_COL, "Year", f.chrome("header"))
    sheet.row_height(row, 24)
    row += 1

    cal = reg["Content Calendar"]
    perf = reg["Performance"]
    ana = reg["Analytics"]

    def ws_rng(sheet, key):
        letter = sheet.letter(key)
        return (f"'{sheet.name}'!${letter}${sheet.first_data_row}:"
                f"${letter}${sheet.last_data_row}")

    cal_date = ws_rng(cal, "date")
    cal_status = ws_rng(cal, "status")
    cal_platforms = ws_rng(cal, "platforms")
    perf_date = ws_rng(perf, "date")
    perf_rev = ws_rng(perf, "est_revenue")
    ana_date = ws_rng(ana, "date")
    ana_reach = ws_rng(ana, "reach")

    metrics = [
        ("Posts planned",
         f"=SUMPRODUCT(({cal_date}>={MONTH_START})*({cal_date}<{MONTH_END}))",
         "int"),
        ("Posts published",
         f"=SUMPRODUCT(({cal_date}>={MONTH_START})*({cal_date}<{MONTH_END})"
         f"*({cal_status}=\"Posted\"))", "int"),
        ("Instagram posts",
         f"=SUMPRODUCT(({cal_date}>={MONTH_START})*({cal_date}<{MONTH_END})"
         f"*ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"Instagram\",{cal_platforms})))", "int"),
        ("TikTok posts",
         f"=SUMPRODUCT(({cal_date}>={MONTH_START})*({cal_date}<{MONTH_END})"
         f"*ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"TikTok\",{cal_platforms})))", "int"),
        ("Pinterest pins",
         f"=SUMPRODUCT(({cal_date}>={MONTH_START})*({cal_date}<{MONTH_END})"
         f"*ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"Pinterest\",{cal_platforms})))", "int"),
        ("Emails sent",
         f"=SUMPRODUCT(({cal_date}>={MONTH_START})*({cal_date}<{MONTH_END})"
         f"*ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"Newsletter\",{cal_platforms})))", "int"),
        ("Budget spent",
         "=SUMIFS([[Budget.spent]],[[Budget.month]],"
         + "${col}${header})", "money"),
        ("Est. revenue",
         f"=SUMIFS({perf_rev},{perf_date},\">=\"&{MONTH_START},"
         f"{perf_date},\"<\"&{MONTH_END})", "money"),
        ("Reach (logged)",
         f"=SUMIFS({ana_reach},{ana_date},\">=\"&{MONTH_START},"
         f"{ana_date},\"<\"&{MONTH_END})", "int"),
    ]

    for label, formula, style in metrics:
        fmt_label = f.cell("text", "plain")
        fmt_cell = f.cell(style, "calc")
        sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, label, fmt_label)
        for i in range(12):
            col = 2 + i
            if "{col}" in formula:
                rendered = formula.replace("{col}", sheet.ws.col) \
                    if False else formula.replace(
                        "{col}", _col_letter(col)).replace(
                        "{header}", str(header_row + 1))
                sheet.ws.write_formula(row, col,
                                       sheet.reg.render(rendered), fmt_cell)
            else:
                sheet.ws.write_formula(row, col,
                                       sheet.reg.render(formula), fmt_cell)
        sheet.write(row, LAST_COL, None, fmt_cell)
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row, LAST_COL,
                               sheet.reg.render(f"=SUM(C{row + 1}:"
                                                f"N{row + 1})"), fmt_cell)
        row += 1

    row += 1
    row = sheet.section(row, "How the year is shaping up", LAST_COL)
    first_metric_row = header_row + 2   # 'Posts planned' row (Excel)
    planned = f"$C${first_metric_row}:$N${first_metric_row}"
    row = _insight(sheet, row, "Busiest month",
                   f"=INDEX($C${header_row + 1}:$N${header_row + 1},"
                   f"MATCH(MAX({planned}),{planned},0))", "text",
                   "Most posts planned in one month.")
    row = _insight(sheet, row, "Quietest month",
                   f"=INDEX($C${header_row + 1}:$N${header_row + 1},"
                   f"MATCH(MIN({planned}),{planned},0))", "text",
                   "The month to fill next.")
    total_row = first_metric_row + len(metrics) - 2   # Est. revenue row
    rev = f"$C${total_row}:$N${total_row}"
    row = _insight(sheet, row, "Best revenue month",
                   f"=INDEX($C${header_row + 1}:$N${header_row + 1},"
                   f"MATCH(MAX({rev}),{rev},0))", "text",
                   "Where the money actually came from.")
    row = _insight(sheet, row, "Posts planned for the year",
                   f"=SUM({planned})", "int",
                   "Across every platform and channel.")

    row += 1
    sheet.merge(row, 0, LAST_COL,
                "Fill the calendar and this page rebuilds itself. Empty "
                "months are not failures - they are the plan talking to you.",
                f.chrome("note"))
    sheet.row_height(row, 26)

    sheet.finish(freeze_row=header_row + 1,
                 print_area=f"A1:{chr(65 + LAST_COL)}{row + 1}")
    return sheet


def _insight(sheet, row, label, formula, style, note):
    f = sheet.f
    fmt_label = f.chrome("label_bold")
    fmt_cell = f.cell(style, "calc")
    sheet.merge(row, 0, 2, label, fmt_label)
    sheet.merge(row, 3, 5, "", fmt_cell)
    sheet.ws.write_formula(row, 3, sheet.reg.render(formula), fmt_cell)
    sheet.merge(row, 6, LAST_COL, note, f.chrome("note"))
    return row + 1


def _col_letter(index: int) -> str:
    letters = ""
    index += 1
    while index:
        index, rem = divmod(index - 1, 26)
        letters = chr(65 + rem) + letters
    return letters
````

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/sheets/brand_voice.py sha256:99c28d1b4b4d267b1b7efd6d56bb2b619aa526df6436ab42965af83154e2a263 -->
````python
"""The `Brand Voice` tab: the voice of the whole content machine."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..layout import SheetSpec
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from, yes_no
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "Brand Voice"
LAST_COL = 5

COLUMNS = [
    dict(header="Voice Attribute", key="attribute", width=20,
         note="One word for how the brand should sound."),
    dict(header="Description", key="description", width=34,
         style="wrap",
         note="What this attribute means in practice."),
    dict(header="Example Line", key="example", width=32, style="wrap",
         note="A line you would actually post."),
    dict(header="Words To Avoid", key="avoid", width=26, style="wrap",
         note="The register of vocabulary to keep out."),
    dict(header="Editorial Checklist", key="checklist", width=32,
         style="wrap",
         note="Questions every caption should pass before it is scheduled."),
    dict(header="Notes", key="notes", width=24, style="wrap"),
]


def spec(cfg) -> SheetSpec:
    samples = sample_data.brand_voice() if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    for entry in samples:
        entry.setdefault("checklist",
                         "Would Jordan say this out loud?")
        entry.setdefault("notes", "")
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME, title="Brand Voice",
        subtitle="How Wildflower sounds, in one page. When a caption feels "
                 "off, it starts here.",
        columns=COLUMNS, rows=cfg.row_count(NAME) or 24, samples=samples,
        first_data_row=8, last_data_row=7 + cfg.row_count(NAME) or 24,
        help_text="Four attributes, one example each, and the words we do "
                  "not use. Copy this into any AI prompt or brief.",
        tab_color="#C98F5B", freeze_cols=1)


def build(book, fmts, cfg, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    from ..writer import SheetWriter as SW
    sheet = SW(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color="#C98F5B")
    f = sheet.f
    sheet.banner(
        "Brand Voice Guide",
        "The voice behind every caption, email and script. Four words, "
        "with examples and a pre-publish checklist.",
        LAST_COL)

    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 20)
    sheet.set_col(1, 1, 34)
    sheet.set_col(2, 2, 32)
    sheet.set_col(3, 3, 26)
    sheet.set_col(4, 4, 32)
    sheet.set_col(5, LAST_COL, 24)

    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "Voice attributes", LAST_COL)
    header_row = row
    for i, col in enumerate(COLUMNS):
        sheet.write(row, i, col["header"], f.chrome("header_left" if i == 0
                                                    else "header"))
    sheet.row_height(row, 26)
    row += 1

    samples = sample_data.brand_voice() if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    style = ["text", "wrap", "wrap", "wrap", "wrap", "wrap"]
    for offset in range(cfg.row_count(NAME) or 24):
        entry = samples[offset] if offset < len(samples) else {}
        values = [entry.get(c["key"]) for c in COLUMNS]
        if any(v is not None for v in values):
            for i, value in enumerate(values):
                if value is not None:
                    sheet.write(row, i, value, f.cell(style[i], "input"))
        else:
            for i in range(len(COLUMNS)):
                sheet.write(row, i, None, f.cell(style[i], "input"))
        row += 1

    last_data = row - 1
    sheet.ws.autofilter(header_row, 0, last_data, LAST_COL)

    row += 1
    row = sheet.section(row, "Editorial checklist", LAST_COL)
    checks = [
        "Does it sound like a person who makes things with her hands?",
        "Is the first line worth stopping for?",
        "One idea per post - did we cut the second one?",
        "Is there a clear next step for the reader?",
        "Any words from the avoid list? Cut them.",
        "Would we be happy if the maker saw this? (We are the maker.)",
    ]
    for i, check in enumerate(checks, start=1):
        sheet.merge(row, 0, LAST_COL - 1, f"{i}.  {check}",
                    f.chrome("label"))
        sheet.write(row, LAST_COL, None, f.input("flag"),
                    )
        sheet.ws.data_validation(row, LAST_COL, row, LAST_COL,
                                 yes_no("Pass the check?"))
        row += 1

    row += 1
    row = sheet.note(
        row, "Tip: paste the four attributes into your AI prompts and the "
             "caption drafts will come back sounding like you.",
        LAST_COL, height=26)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=header_row + 1,
                 print_area=f"A1:{chr(65 + LAST_COL)}{row}")
    return sheet
````

````python
"""Register: Budget, with monthly totals and variance block."""

from __future__ import annotations

from .. import sample_data
from ..layout import SheetSpec, rows_to_last
from ..writer import number_check

NAME = "Budget"
ROWS = 120
LAST_COL = 11

COLUMNS = [
    dict(header="Budget ID", key="id", width=11,
         is_formula=True,
         formula="=IF($C{r}=\"\",\"\",\"B-\"&TEXT({r}-{first}+1,\"000\"))"),
    dict(header="Month", key="month", width=10,
         validate={"validate": "list", "source": "=MonthYearList"},
         note="e.g. Mar-26. Feeds the monthly totals below."),
    dict(header="Category", key="category", width=18,
         validate={"validate": "list",
                   "source": ["Paid Ads", "Influencers", "Design & Tools",
                              "Photo & Video", "Market Costs",
                              "Promotions", "Email Platform", "Education",
                              "Misc"]}),
    dict(header="Campaign", key="campaign", width=18,
         validate={"validate": "list", "source": "=CampaignNames"}),
    dict(header="Channel", key="channel", width=16,
         note="Where the money goes."),
    dict(header="Owner", key="owner", width=14,
         validate={"validate": "list", "source": "=TeamNames"}),
    dict(header="Planned", key="planned", width=11, style="money",
         validate=number_check(0, 1000000)),
    dict(header="Spent", key="spent", width=11, style="money",
         validate=number_check(0, 1000000)),
    dict(header="Variance", key="variance", width=11, style="money",
         is_formula=True,
         formula="=IF($C{r}=\"\",\"\",$G{r}-$H{r})",
         note="Planned minus spent."),
    dict(header="Status", key="status", width=11,
         validate={"validate": "list",
                   "source": ["Planned", "Approved", "Paid", "Cancelled"]}),
    dict(header="Actual", key="actual", width=11, style="money",
         validate=number_check(0, 1000000),
         note="Invoiced amount - the number the Campaigns tab reads."),
    dict(header="Notes", key="notes", width=26, style="wrap"),
]


def spec(cfg) -> SheetSpec:
    samples = sample_data.budget() if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    rows = cfg.row_count(NAME) or ROWS
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME, title="Budget",
        subtitle="Planned against spent, month by month. The variance "
                 "column never lies - and the Campaigns tab reads Actual.",
        columns=COLUMNS, rows=rows, samples=samples,
        first_data_row=6, last_data_row=rows_to_last(6, rows),
        help_text="Month values use the drop down (Mar-26 style) so the "
                  "monthly totals below group correctly.",
        tab_color="#C98F5B", freeze_cols=1)


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg=None) -> None:
    spec_obj = sheet.reg[NAME]
    first, last = spec_obj.first_data_row, spec_obj.last_data_row
    row = last + 2
    row = sheet.section(row, "Monthly totals - planned vs spent", LAST_COL)
    headers = ["Month", "Planned", "Spent", "Left"]
    for (c0, c1), head in zip([(0, 1), (2, 3), (4, 5), (6, 7)], headers):
        sheet.merge(row, c0, c1, head, fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.merge(row, 8, LAST_COL, "Spend share", fmts.chrome("header"))
    row += 1
    months = cfg.MONTHS
    months_col = f"$B${first}:$B${last}"
    for month in months:
        fmt_label = fmts.cell("text", "plain")
        fmt_money = fmts.cell("money", "calc")
        sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, month, fmt_label)
        pairs = [("C", "G"), ("E", "H"), ("G", "I")]
        for (c0, c1), letter in zip([(2, 3), (4, 5), (6, 7)],
                                    ["G", "H", "I"]):
            sheet.merge(row, c0, c1, "", fmt_money)
            formula = (f"=SUMIFS(${letter}${first}:${letter}${last},"
                       f"{months_col},$A{row + 1})")
            sheet.ws.write_formula(row, c0, sheet.reg.render(formula),
                                   fmt_money)
        sheet.merge(row, 8, LAST_COL, "", fmts.cell("percent", "calc"))
        share = (f"=IF(SUM($H${first}:$H${last})=0,0,SUMIFS($H${first}:"
                 f"$H${last},{months_col},$A{row + 1})/SUM($H${first}:"
                 f"$H${last}))")
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row, 8, sheet.reg.render(share),
                               fmts.cell("percent", "calc"))
        row += 1

    # Total row - sits after the loop, never over a data row.
    fmt_total_label = fmts.chrome("total_label")
    fmt_total = fmts.chrome("total_value")
    sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, "TOTAL", fmt_total_label)
    for (c0, c1), letter in zip([(2, 3), (4, 5), (6, 7)],
                                ["G", "H", "I"]):
        sheet.merge(row, c0, c1, "", fmt_total)
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row, c0,
                               sheet.reg.render(f"=SUM(${letter}${first}:"
                                                f"${letter}${last})"),
                               fmt_total)
    sheet.merge(row, 8, LAST_COL, "", fmt_total)
    row += 1

    row += 1
    row = sheet.section(row, "Category share of spend", LAST_COL)
    for offset, category in enumerate(
            ["Paid Ads", "Influencers", "Design & Tools", "Photo & Video",
             "Market Costs", "Promotions"]):
        fmt_label = fmts.cell("text", "plain")
        fmt_money = fmts.cell("money", "calc")
        fmt_pct = fmts.cell("percent", "calc")
        sheet.merge(row, 0, 2, category, fmt_label)
        sheet.merge(row, 3, 4, "", fmt_money)
        formula = (f"=SUMIFS($H${first}:$H${last},$C${first}:$C${last},"
                   f"$A{row + 1})")
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row, 3, sheet.reg.render(formula), fmt_money)
        sheet.merge(row, 5, 6, "", fmt_pct)
        formula = (f"=IF(SUM($H${first}:$H${last})=0,0,$D{row + 1}/SUM("
                   f"$H${first}:$H${last}))")
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row, 5, sheet.reg.render(formula), fmt_pct)
        row += 1
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/sheets/calc.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/sheets/calc.py sha256:42d76bf495032f5bbeaf04cee3310a30a04d9076fc32ba1937d9f1e2a843a91f -->
````python
"""The hidden engine tab.

Exposes the *Report Date* named cell plus a few window helpers everything
else uses, and quietly fills the columns from B to CG so the workbook always
has scratch space. The visible content stays in columns A to E.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt

from ..layout import quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter, date_check

NAME = "Calc"
LAST_COL = 85            # CG
WINDOW_DAYS = 365


def build(book, fmts, cfg, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color="#A0A0A0")
    f = sheet.f
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 22)
    sheet.set_col(1, 1, 14)
    sheet.set_col(2, 4, 18)
    # Scratch columns, hidden from curious eyes.
    sheet.set_col(5, 8, 12, hidden=True)
    sheet.set_col(9, 21, 11, hidden=True)
    sheet.set_col(22, LAST_COL, 11, hidden=True)

    sheet.merge(0, 0, 4, "Engine - hidden. Unhide only to troubleshoot.",
                f.chrome("title"))
    sheet.row_height(0, 28)

    report_date = cfg.today
    sheet.write(2, 0, "Report_Date", f.chrome("label_bold"))
    sheet.write(2, 1, report_date, f.cell("date", "input"))
    sheet.ws.data_validation(2, 1, 2, 1, date_check())
    book.define_name("Report_Date", f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$3")

    sheet.write(3, 0, "Window_Start", f.chrome("label_bold"))
    sheet.ws.write_formula(
        3, 1,
        f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$3-13", f.cell("date", "calc"))
    book.define_name("Window_Start", f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$4")

    sheet.write(4, 0, "Window_End", f.chrome("label_bold"))
    sheet.ws.write_formula(
        4, 1,
        f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$3+13", f.cell("date", "calc"))
    book.define_name("Window_End", f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$5")

    sheet.write(5, 0, "Today Serial", f.chrome("label_bold"))
    sheet.ws.write_formula(
        5, 1, f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$3", f.cell("int", "calc"))
    book.define_name("TodaySerial", f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$6")

    # A year of daily date keys in columns J..(J+364) - the Month View and
    # the print week sheets hang off these.
    start_col = 9
    sheet.write(2, start_col - 1, "Daily keys", f.chrome("label_bold"))
    for i in range(WINDOW_DAYS):
        if i == 0:
            formula = f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B$4"
        else:
            col = start_col + i - 1
            formula = f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!${_col(col)}$3+1"
        sheet.ws.write_formula(2, start_col + i, formula,
                               f.cell("date", "plain"))
    book.define_name("DayKeys",
                     f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!${_col(start_col)}$3:"
                     f"${_col(start_col + WINDOW_DAYS - 1)}$3")

    # Notes for future us.
    notes = [
        "Named cells defined here: Report Date, Window Start, Window End, "
        "TodaySerial, DayKeys.",
        "Report Date drives every countdown, overdue flag and week "
        "boundary in the workbook.",
        "Change Report Date on this tab to preview the planner at another "
        "point in the year.",
    ]
    for i, note in enumerate(notes):
        sheet.merge(7 + i, 0, 4, note, f.chrome("note"))
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def _col(index: int) -> str:
    letters = ""
    index += 1
    while index:
        index, rem = divmod(index - 1, 26)
        letters = chr(65 + rem) + letters
    return letters
````

````python
    dict(header="Status Nth Key", key="status_key", width=12, hidden=True,

         note="Pulled from the Performance tab by Content ID."),
    dict(header="Coverage", key="coverage", width=13,
         is_formula=True,
         formula="=IF($A{r}=\"\",\"\",IF($J{r}=\"\",\"Caption needed\","
                 "IF($K{r}=\"\",\"Hashtags needed\",IF($M{r}=\"\","
                 "\"Asset needed\",\"Ready\"))))",
         note="Auto checklist: caption, hashtags and asset are all linked."),
]


def spec(cfg) -> SheetSpec:
    samples = sample_data.content_calendar() if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    rows = cfg.row_count(NAME) or ROWS
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME, title="Content Calendar",
        subtitle="600 rows, one post per row. Plan the whole quarter here, "
                 "then let the dashboards do the counting.",
        columns=COLUMNS, rows=rows, samples=samples,
        first_data_row=6, last_data_row=rows_to_last(6, rows),
        help_text="IDs, weekdays and the two right-hand columns calculate "
                  "themselves. Drop downs keep every register in sync - "
                  "add new pillars and campaigns on their own tabs first.",
        tab_color="#2E7D8F", freeze_cols=2)
````

````python
"""Register: Campaigns, with a live ROI helper block."""

from __future__ import annotations

from .. import sample_data
from ..layout import SheetSpec, rows_to_last

NAME = "Campaigns"
ROWS = 30
LAST_COL = 17         # R

COLUMNS = [
    dict(header="Campaign ID", key="id", width=11,
         is_formula=True,
         formula="=IF($B{r}=\"\",\"\",\"CMP-\"&TEXT({r}-{first}+1,\"000\"))"),

    dict(header="End Date", key="end", width=12, style="date",

    dict(header="Primary Platforms", key="platforms", width=22,

    dict(header="Budget", key="budget", width=12, style="money",

         formula="=COUNTIFS([[Assets.campaign]],$B{r},"

         formula="=IF($B{r}=\"\",\"\",COUNT($I$first:$I{r})+{r}*0.000001)"),
    dict(header="Progress", key="progress", width=12, style="percent",
         is_formula=True,
         formula="=IF($K{r}=\"Complete\",1,IF($C{r}=\"\",0,IF($D{r}=\"\",0,"
                 "IF($K{r}=\"Planning\",0,MIN(1,MAX(0,(Report_Date"
                 "-$C{r})/MAX(1,$D{r}-$C{r})))))))",
         note="Time progress through the campaign window."),
    dict(header="Budget Health", key="health", width=13,
         is_formula=True,
         formula="=IF($I{r}=0,IF($J{r}=0,\"No budget\",\"Overspend\"),"
                 "IF($J{r}=$I{r},\"On plan\",IF($J{r}<$I{r},\"Under\","
                 "\"Overspend\")))",
         note="Compares actual spend with the budget."),
]


def spec(cfg) -> SheetSpec:
    samples = sample_data.campaigns() if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    rows = cfg.row_count(NAME) or ROWS
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME, title="Campaigns",
        subtitle="The big pushes behind the daily posts. Budget columns "
                 "fill themselves from the Budget tab.",
        columns=COLUMNS, rows=rows, samples=samples,
        first_data_row=6, last_data_row=rows_to_last(6, rows),
        help_text="Campaign Name is the value used in the Content Calendar, "
                  "so name it exactly as you want to see it there.",
        tab_color="#C98F5B", freeze_cols=2)


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg=None) -> None:
    spec_obj = sheet.reg[NAME]
    first, last = spec_obj.first_data_row, spec_obj.last_data_row
    row = last + 2
    row = sheet.section(row, "Campaign ROI helper - live", LAST_COL)
    headers = ["Campaign", "Budget", "Actual spend", "Health"]
    spans = [(0, 3), (4, 5), (6, 7), (8, 10)]
    for (c0, c1), head in zip(spans, headers):
        sheet.merge(row, c0, c1, head, fmts.chrome("header"))
    row += 1
    n = max(len(spec_obj.samples), 6)
    for offset in range(n):
        rank = offset + 1
        fmt_label = fmts.cell("text", "calc")
        fmt_money = fmts.cell("money", "calc")
        fmt_text = fmts.cell("text", "calc")
        name_formula = (
            "=IFERROR(INDEX($B${first}:$B${last},"
            "MATCH(SMALL($P${first}:$P${last},{n}),"
            "$P${first}:$P${last},0)),\"\")"
        ).format(first=first, last=last, n=rank)
        sheet.merge(row, 0, 3, "", fmt_label)
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row, 0, sheet.reg.render(name_formula),
                               fmt_label)
        for (c0, c1), letter, fmt in (((4, 5), "I", fmt_money),
                                      ((6, 7), "J", fmt_money),
                                      ((8, 10), "R", fmt_text)):
            sheet.merge(row, c0, c1, "", fmt)
            formula = (f"=IF($A{row + 1}=\"\",\"\",INDEX(${letter}${first}:"
                       f"${letter}${last},MATCH($A{row + 1},$B${first}:"
                       f"$B${last},0)))")
            sheet.ws.write_formula(row, c0, sheet.reg.render(formula), fmt)
        row += 1
````

### `22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/sheets/common.py`

<!-- source-file: 22-social-media-planner/social_media_spreadsheet/sheets/common.py sha256:33010bd4426d8ab1e8dffeaa63458d134dbce43efc61034e9e7c54aefc858b5b -->
````python
"""Shared building blocks for sheet modules: register helpers and a small
KPI-tile / summary-table kit used by the dashboard pages."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ..layout import SheetSpec, col_letter, rows_to_last

BADGE_FILLS = {
    "good": ("#DDEEDB", "#1F6B2E"),
    "warn": ("#FBEBD0", "#B85C00"),
    "bad": ("#FBE3E3", "#B22222"),
    "info": ("#DCE7F3", "#24527A"),
    "muted": ("#F1F1EF", "#8A8A85"),
}


def sheet_spec(cfg, name: str, title: str, subtitle: str, columns: List,
               rows: int = 100,
               samples: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
               help_text: str = "", tab_color: str = "#C98F5B",
               freeze_cols: int = 1, freeze_at: Optional[int] = None,
               extra_rows: int = 0) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=name, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, columns=columns,
        rows=rows, samples=samples or [],
        first_data_row=6, last_data_row=rows_to_last(6, rows),
        help_text=help_text, tab_color=tab_color,
        freeze_cols=freeze_cols, freeze_at=freeze_at, extra_rows=extra_rows)


def badge_style(status: str) -> str:
    """Map a status word to a badge fill."""
    s = (status or "").strip().lower()
    good = {"posted", "done", "approved", "active", "published", "in use",
            "ready", "scheduled", "complete", "completed", "winner found"}
    warn = {"in progress", "in review", "running", "draft", "planned",
            "pending", "paused", "idea", "outreach", "prospect", "captured"}
    bad = {"overdue", "rejected", "expired", "blocked", "cancelled",
           "missed", "blocked"}
    if s in good:
        return "good"
    if s in warn:
        return "warn"
    if s in bad:
        return "bad"
    return "info"


def badge(sheet, row0: int, col: int, text: str, style: Optional[str] = None):
    """Paint a status cell like a pill using a plain cell format."""
    fill, color = BADGE_FILLS[style or badge_style(text)]
    fmt = sheet.book.add_format({
        "font_name": "Calibri", "font_size": 10, "bold": True,
        "align": "center", "valign": "vcenter",
        "bg_color": fill, "font_color": color,
        "border": 1, "border_color": "#E4E4E0", "locked": True})
    sheet.write(row0, col, text, fmt)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- KPI tiles
def tile(sheet, row: int, col: int, label: str, value: Any,
         note: str = "", fmt_key: str = "int", span: int = 2,
         formula: Optional[str] = None):
    """Static (or formula) KPI tile in the cream brand look. Returns row+3."""
    f = sheet.f
    sheet.merge(row, col, col + span - 1, label, f.chrome("kpi_label"))
    sheet.row_height(row + 1, 30)
    num_fmt = sheet.num_format(fmt_key)
    base = f.chrome("kpi_value", num_format=num_fmt)
    sheet.merge(row + 1, col, row + 1, col + span - 1, "", base)
    if formula is not None:
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row + 1, col, sheet.reg.render(formula), base)
    else:
        sheet.write(row + 1, col, value, base)
    sheet.merge(row + 2, col, col + span - 1, note, f.chrome("kpi_note"))
    return row + 3


def mini_summary(sheet, row: int, title: str, pairs: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]],
                 last_col: int, first_col: int = 0):
    """Small label|value table. Values are engine formula strings."""
    f = sheet.f
    sheet.merge(row, first_col, last_col, title, f.chrome("subsection"))
    row += 1
    for label, formula in pairs:
        sheet.merge(row, first_col, first_col + 1, label, f.chrome("label"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(row, first_col + 2, row, last_col, "",
                             f.cell("int", "calc"))
        sheet.ws.write_formula(row, first_col + 2,
                               sheet.reg.render(formula),
                               f.cell("int", "calc"))
        row += 1
    return row


def month_pairs(cfg) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    """(Month label, SUMIFS formula) pairs for any month-total table."""
    return [(m, f"=SUMIFS(Budget.Spent, Budget.Month, \"{m}\")")
            for m in cfg.MONTHS]


def money(value) -> str:
    if value in (None, ""):
        return ""
    return f"{value:,.0f}"


def draw_badge_legend(sheet, row: int, col: int) -> int:
    """Tiny colour legend for the status colours."""
    items = [("Ready", "good"), ("Working", "warn"),
             ("Needs action", "bad"), ("Info", "info")]
    for label, style in items:
        badge(sheet, row, col, f"  {label}  ", style)
        col += 2
    return row + 1
````

````python
NAME = "Competitors"

COLUMNS = [

         note="Who you keep an eye on."),
    dict(header="Website / Handle", key="url", width=26, style="link"),
    dict(header="Platforms", key="platforms", width=20, style="wrap"),
    dict(header="Followers (est.)", key="followers", width=11, style="int",

    dict(header="Posting Cadence", key="cadence", width=14,

    dict(header="Strength", key="strength", width=28, style="wrap",
         note="What they do better than anyone."),
    dict(header="Gap / Weakness", key="gap", width=28, style="wrap",

    dict(header="Top Keywords", key="keywords", width=20, style="wrap"),

         validate=date_check()),
    dict(header="Notes", key="notes", width=26, style="wrap"),
]

    rows = cfg.row_count(NAME) or ROWS

                 "gaps, and build where they are quiet.",
        columns=COLUMNS, rows=rows, samples=samples,
        first_data_row=6, last_data_row=rows_to_last(6, rows),
        help_text="The Gap column is the only one that makes you money. "
                  "Read it before any planning session.",
        tab_color="#B0B0A8", freeze_cols=1)


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg=None) -> None:
    spec_obj = sheet.reg[NAME]
    first, last = spec_obj.first_data_row, spec_obj.last_data_row
    row = last + 2
    row = sheet.section(row, "Gap analysis - top keywords in play", LAST_COL)
    for (c0, c1), head in zip([(0, 2), (3, 5), (6, LAST_COL)],
                              ["Competitor", "Their strength",
                               "Their gap (your opening)"]):
        sheet.merge(row, c0, c1, head, fmts.chrome("header"))
    row += 1
    n = max(len(spec_obj.samples), 4)
    for offset in range(n):
        src = first + offset
        fmt_label = fmts.cell("text", "calc")
        sheet.merge(row, 0, 2, "", fmt_label)
        sheet.merge(row, 3, 5, "", fmt_label)
        sheet.merge(row, 6, LAST_COL, "", fmt_label)
        sheet.ws.write_formula(
            row, 0,
            sheet.reg.render(f"=IF($A{src}=\"\",\"\",$A{src})"), fmt_label)
        sheet.ws.write_formula(
            row, 3,
            sheet.reg.render(f"=IF($A{src}=\"\",\"\",$F{src})"), fmt_label)
        sheet.ws.write_formula(
            row, 6,
            sheet.reg.render(f"=IF($A{src}=\"\",\"\",$G{src})"), fmt_label)
        row += 1
````
