````python
"""The Mileage register - travel between jobs."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Mileage")
    samples = sd.MILEAGE if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    dist = cfg.distance_unit
    rate = cfg.travel_rate

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Trip ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({distance}{r}="","",'
                    '"ML-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"0000"))'),
        Col("date", "Date", 13, "date",
            validate={"type": "date", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": "DATE(2020,1,1)",
                      "maximum": "DATE(2100,1,1)"}),
        Col("employee", "Employee", 18, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Employees_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("job_ref", "Job #", 13, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Jobs_Numbers",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("client", "Client", 20, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Clients_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("purpose", "Purpose", 22, "text",
            note="Job travel, supply run, estimate visit..."),
        Col("start_odometer", f"Start ({dist})", 11, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1000000}),
        Col("end_odometer", f"End ({dist})", 11, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1000000}),
        Col("distance", f"Distance ({dist})", 11, "decimal_locked",
            formula='IF(OR({start_odometer}{r}="",{end_odometer}{r}=""),'
                    '"",MAX(0,{end_odometer}{r}-{start_odometer}{r}))'),
        Col("rate", "Rate / Unit", 11, "money_locked",
            formula=f'IF({{distance}}{{r}}="","",{rate})',
            note=f"{cfg.currency_symbol}{rate:.2f} per {dist} - change "
                 "the reimbursement rate on the Settings tab and "
                 "rebuild."),
        Col("claim", "Claim", 12, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({distance}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({distance}{r}*{rate}{r},2))',
            note="Flows into the job's total cost."),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "text"),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(
        name="Mileage",
        title="Mileage Log",
        subtitle="Every business trip, reimbursed at your mileage rate "
                 "and charged to the job where it belongs.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
    )
````

````python
"""The Payments register - money in."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Payments")
    samples = sd.PAYMENTS if cfg.include_sample_data else []

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Payment ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({amount}{r}="","",'
                    '"PAY-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"0000"))'),
        Col("date", "Date", 13, "date",
            validate={"type": "date", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": "DATE(2020,1,1)",
                      "maximum": "DATE(2100,1,1)"}),
        Col("invoice_ref", "Invoice #", 14, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Invoices_Numbers",
                      "ignore_blank": True},
            note="The invoice this payment settles."),
        Col("client", "Client", 24, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Clients_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("amount", "Amount", 13, "money",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 10000000}),
        Col("method", "Method", 13, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "Cash", "Card", "Bank transfer", "Check", "Online",
                "Direct debit", "Other"]}),
        Col("reference", "Reference", 16, "text"),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "text"),
        Col("month", "Month", 13, "date_locked",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",DATE(YEAR({date}{r}),'
                    'MONTH({date}{r}),1))'),
        Col("matched", "Matched?", 11, "text_locked",
            formula='IF({invoice_ref}{r}="","",'
                    'IF(COUNTIF([[Invoices.invoice_number]],'
                    '{invoice_ref}{r})>0,"OK","NOT FOUND"))',
            note="Every payment must reference a real invoice number."),
    ]

    spec = SheetSpec(
        name="Payments",
        title="Payments",
        subtitle="Money in, tied to an invoice number. Invoices update "
                 "their paid and balance columns from these rows.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.primary,
    )
    spec.col("matched").cf = [
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "NOT FOUND",
         "style": "bad"},
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "OK",
         "style": "good"},
    ]
    return spec
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/print_invoice.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/print_invoice.py sha256:05a9aa2994b8ed2633932a097fc7f253ca69b8138e9a062f100a8c92e5b6c6cc -->
````python
"""Print Invoice - a client-ready invoice document."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry, quote_sheet

MAX_LINES = 12


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Print Invoice")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.ink)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 16)
    ws.set_column(2, 2, 30)
    ws.set_column(3, 3, 10)
    ws.set_column(4, 4, 10)
    ws.set_column(5, 5, 14)
    ws.set_column(6, 6, 14)

    def rng(sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        spec = reg[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        return (f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${spec.first_data_row}:"
                f"${letter}${spec.last_data_row}")

    I_num = rng("Invoices", "invoice_number")
    I_client = rng("Invoices", "client")
    I_prop = rng("Invoices", "property")
    I_date = rng("Invoices", "date")
    I_due = rng("Invoices", "due")
    I_sub = rng("Invoices", "subtotal")
    I_tax = rng("Invoices", "tax")
    I_total = rng("Invoices", "total")
    I_paid = rng("Invoices", "paid")
    I_balance = rng("Invoices", "balance")
    I_job = rng("Invoices", "job_ref")

    L_key = rng("Invoice Lines", "match_key")
    L_desc = rng("Invoice Lines", "description")
    L_qty = rng("Invoice Lines", "qty")
    L_price = rng("Invoice Lines", "unit_price")
    L_total = rng("Invoice Lines", "line_total")
    L_date = rng("Invoice Lines", "date")

    ws.merge_range(1, 1, 1, 6, "INVOICE", fmts["print_title"])
    ws.set_row(1, 30)
    ws.write(2, 1, "Business", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(2, 2, 2, 4, '=Settings!$C$6', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(2, 5, 2, 6, '=Settings!$C$9', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(3, 1, "Address", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(3, 2, 3, 4, '=Settings!$C$10', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(3, 5, 3, 6, '=Settings!$C$8', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(4, 1, 4, 6, '=Settings!$C$13', fmts["print_sub"])

    ws.write(6, 1, "Invoice #", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write(6, 2, "I-2410", fmts["input"])
    ws.data_validation(6, 2, 6, 2,
                       {"validate": "list", "source": "=Invoices_Numbers",
                        "ignore_blank": True})
    ws.merge_range(6, 3, 6, 6,
                   "Type or pick the Invoice #. Print area A1:G48.",
                   fmts["note"])
    pick = "$C$7"

    def find(col_range: str, fallback: str = '""') -> str:
        return (f"IFERROR(INDEX({col_range},"
                f"MATCH({pick},{I_num},0)),{fallback})")

    ws.write(8, 1, "Bill to", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(8, 2, 8, 4, f"={find(I_client)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(8, 5, "Invoice date", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(8, 6, f"={find(I_date)}", fmts["print_date"])

    ws.write(9, 1, "Property", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(9, 2, 9, 4, f"={find(I_prop)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(9, 5, "Due date", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(9, 6, f"={find(I_due)}", fmts["print_date"])

    ws.write(10, 1, "Job #", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(10, 2, 10, 4, f"={find(I_job)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(10, 5, "Terms", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(10, 6, '=Settings!$C$46&" days"',
                     fmts["print_value"])

    row = 12
    ws.write(row - 1, 1, "Date", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 2, "Description", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 3, "Qty", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 4, "Unit price", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.merge_range(row - 1, 5, row - 1, 6, "Amount",
                   fmts["print_header"])
    row += 1

    for i in range(1, MAX_LINES + 1):
        m = f"MATCH({pick}&\"-\"&{i},{L_key},0)"
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 1, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_date},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell_date"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 2, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_desc},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 3, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_qty},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 4, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_price},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell_money"])
        ws.merge_range(row - 1, 5, row - 1, 6, "", fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 5, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_total},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell_money"])
        row += 1

    money_text = f"{cfg.currency_symbol}#,##0.00"
    for label, expr in [
        ("Subtotal", find(I_sub, "0")),
        (cfg.tax_label, find(I_tax, "0")),
        ("TOTAL", find(I_total, "0")),
        ("Paid to date", find(I_paid, "0")),
    ]:
        ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 4, label, fmts["print_total"])
        ws.merge_range(row, 5, row, 6, f"={expr}",
                       fmts["print_total_money"])
        row += 1

    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 4, "BALANCE DUE", fmts["print_total"])
    ws.merge_range(row, 5, row, 6, f"={find(I_balance, '0')}",
                   fmts["print_total_money"])
    row += 2

    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6, "Payment details", fmts["print_label"])
    row += 1
    details = [
        '="Please pay by bank transfer to "&Settings!$C$6&", '
        'reference "&' + pick + '&"."',
        '="Payment terms: "&Settings!$C$46&" days from the invoice '
        'date. Late balances may attract a late fee."',
        '="Questions? Email "&Settings!$C$8&" or call "&Settings!$C$9&"."',
        f'="Thank you for your business."',
    ]
    for t in details:
        ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6, t, fmts["print_value"])
        row += 1

    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6,
                   f'="Balance due: "&TEXT({find(I_balance, "0")},'
                   f'"{money_text}")&"  ·  thank you."',
                   fmts["print_label"])

    ws.set_zoom(100)
    ws.set_paper(9)
    ws.fit_to_pages(1, 1)
    ws.print_area(0, 0, row, 6)
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
        })
````

````python
"""Print Job Sheet - what the crew takes to the job."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry, quote_sheet

MAX_TASKS = 16


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Print Job Sheet")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.ink)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 14)
    ws.set_column(2, 2, 14)
    ws.set_column(3, 3, 32)
    ws.set_column(4, 4, 16)
    ws.set_column(5, 5, 12)
    ws.set_column(6, 6, 12)

    def rng(sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        spec = reg[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        return (f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${spec.first_data_row}:"
                f"${letter}${spec.last_data_row}")

    J_num = rng("Jobs", "job_number")
    J_date = rng("Jobs", "date")
    J_start = rng("Jobs", "start")
    J_hours = rng("Jobs", "hours")
    J_client = rng("Jobs", "client")
    J_prop = rng("Jobs", "property")
    J_service = rng("Jobs", "service")
    J_crew = rng("Jobs", "crew_lead")
    J_team = rng("Jobs", "team")
    J_status = rng("Jobs", "status")
    J_access = rng("Jobs", "access")
    J_instr = rng("Jobs", "instructions")
    J_price = rng("Jobs", "price")

    T_key = rng("Job Tasks", "match_key")
    T_step = rng("Job Tasks", "step_no")
    T_room = rng("Job Tasks", "room_area")
    T_task = rng("Job Tasks", "task")
    T_who = rng("Job Tasks", "assigned_to")
    T_min = rng("Job Tasks", "est_min")

    P_prop = rng("Properties", "property_name")
    P_pets = rng("Properties", "pets")
    P_park = rng("Properties", "parking")
    P_alarm = rng("Properties", "alarm")
    P_hazard = rng("Properties", "hazards")

    ws.merge_range(1, 1, 1, 6, "JOB SHEET", fmts["print_title"])
    ws.set_row(1, 30)
    ws.write(2, 1, "Business", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(2, 2, 2, 4, '=Settings!$C$6', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(2, 5, 2, 6, '=Settings!$C$9', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(3, 1, 3, 6, '=Settings!$C$13', fmts["print_sub"])

    ws.write(5, 1, "Job #", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write(5, 2, "J-2411", fmts["input"])
    ws.data_validation(5, 2, 5, 2,
                       {"validate": "list", "source": "=Print_Job_Numbers",
                        "ignore_blank": True})
    ws.merge_range(5, 3, 5, 6,
                   "Type or pick the Job #. Print area A1:G44.",
                   fmts["note"])
    pick = "$C$6"

    def find(col_range: str, fallback: str = '""') -> str:
        return (f"IFERROR(INDEX({col_range},"
                f"MATCH({pick},{J_num},0)),{fallback})")

    ws.write(7, 1, "Date", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(7, 2, f"={find(J_date)}", fmts["print_date"])
    ws.write(7, 3, "Start", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(7, 4, f"={find(J_start)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(7, 5, "Hours", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(7, 6, f"={find(J_hours)}", fmts["print_value"])

    ws.write(8, 1, "Client", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(8, 2, 8, 3, f"={find(J_client)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(8, 4, "Service", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(8, 5, 8, 6, f"={find(J_service)}", fmts["print_value"])

    ws.write(9, 1, "Property", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(9, 2, 9, 3, f"={find(J_prop)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(9, 4, "Status", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(9, 5, 9, 6, f"={find(J_status)}", fmts["print_value"])

    ws.write(10, 1, "Crew lead", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(10, 2, 10, 3, f"={find(J_crew)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(10, 4, "Team", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(10, 5, 10, 6, f"={find(J_team)}", fmts["print_value"])

    # property safety panel
    pm = f"MATCH({find(J_prop)}, {P_prop},0)".replace("=IFERROR", "IFERROR")
    prop_pets = (f'=IFERROR(INDEX({P_pets},MATCH({find(J_prop)},'
                 f'{P_prop},0)),"")')
    prop_park = (f'=IFERROR(INDEX({P_park},MATCH({find(J_prop)},'
                 f'{P_prop},0)),"")')
    prop_alarm = (f'=IFERROR(INDEX({P_alarm},MATCH({find(J_prop)},'
                  f'{P_prop},0)),"")')
    prop_hazard = (f'=IFERROR(INDEX({P_hazard},MATCH({find(J_prop)},'
                   f'{P_prop},0)),"")')
    del pm

    ws.write(12, 1, "Site info", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(12, 2, 12, 6, "", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write_formula(12, 2,
                     f'="Pets: "&{prop_pets[1:]}&"   ·   Parking: "&'
                     f'{prop_park[1:]}&"   ·   Alarm: "&{prop_alarm[1:]}',
                     fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(13, 1, "Hazards", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(13, 2, 13, 6, "", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write_formula(13, 2, prop_hazard, fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(14, 1, "Access", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(14, 2, 14, 6, f"={find(J_access)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(15, 1, "Special instructions", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(15, 2, 15, 6, f"={find(J_instr)}", fmts["print_value"])

    row = 17
    ws.write(row - 1, 1, "Step", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 2, "Area", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 3, "Task", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 4, "Who", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 5, "Est. min", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 6, "Done ✓", fmts["print_header"])
    row += 1

    for i in range(1, MAX_TASKS + 1):
        m = f"MATCH({pick}&\"-\"&{i},{T_key},0)"
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 1, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({T_step},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 2, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({T_room},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 3, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({T_task},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 4, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({T_who},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 5, f'=IFERROR(INDEX({T_min},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_blank(row - 1, 6, None, fmts["print_cell"])
        row += 1

    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 4,
                   "Client sign-off (work completed to standard)",
                   fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(row, 5, row, 6, "Time out: __________",
                   fmts["print_label"])
    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6,
                   "Name: ______________________     "
                   "Signature: ______________________     "
                   "Date: ____________", fmts["print_label"])
    row += 2
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6,
                   f'="Price to client: "&TEXT({find(J_price, "0")},'
                   f'"{cfg.currency_symbol}#,##0.00")&'
                   f'"  ·  office use only."',
                   fmts["print_sub"])

    ws.set_zoom(100)
    ws.set_paper(9)
    ws.fit_to_pages(1, 1)
    ws.print_area(0, 0, row, 6)
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
        })
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/print_quote.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/print_quote.py sha256:4af2d3391f164112581807813489469ad265a90b04eb13abb8180c017f7df07e -->
````python
"""Print Quote - a client-ready quote document."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry, quote_sheet
from .settings import settings_ref

MAX_LINES = 12


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Print Quote")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.ink)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 16)
    ws.set_column(2, 2, 30)
    ws.set_column(3, 3, 10)
    ws.set_column(4, 4, 10)
    ws.set_column(5, 5, 14)
    ws.set_column(6, 6, 14)

    def rng(sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        spec = reg[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        return (f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${spec.first_data_row}:"
                f"${letter}${spec.last_data_row}")

    Q_num = rng("Quotes", "quote_number")
    Q_client = rng("Quotes", "client")
    Q_prop = rng("Quotes", "property")
    Q_date = rng("Quotes", "date")
    Q_valid = rng("Quotes", "valid_until")
    Q_freq = rng("Quotes", "frequency")
    Q_sub = rng("Quotes", "subtotal")
    Q_disc = rng("Quotes", "discount")
    Q_tax = rng("Quotes", "tax")
    Q_total = rng("Quotes", "total")
    Q_dep = rng("Quotes", "deposit")
    Q_hours = rng("Quotes", "est_hours")
    Q_service = rng("Quotes", "service")

    L_key = rng("Quote Lines", "match_key")
    L_desc = rng("Quote Lines", "description")
    L_qty = rng("Quote Lines", "qty")
    L_unit = rng("Quote Lines", "unit")
    L_price = rng("Quote Lines", "unit_price")
    L_total = rng("Quote Lines", "line_total")
    L_room = rng("Quote Lines", "room_area")

    # --------------------------------------------------------- document head
    ws.merge_range(1, 1, 1, 6, "QUOTATION", fmts["print_title"])
    ws.set_row(1, 30)
    ws.write(2, 1, "Business", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(2, 2, 2, 4, '=Settings!$C$6', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(2, 5, 2, 6, '=Settings!$C$9', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(3, 1, "Address", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(3, 2, 3, 4, '=Settings!$C$10', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(3, 5, 3, 6, '=Settings!$C$8', fmts["print_value"])
    ws.merge_range(4, 1, 4, 6, '=Settings!$C$13', fmts["print_sub"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the picker
    ws.write(6, 1, "Quote #", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write(6, 2, "Q-1010", fmts["input"])
    ws.data_validation(6, 2, 6, 2,
                       {"validate": "list", "source": "=Quotes_Numbers",
                        "ignore_blank": True})
    ws.merge_range(6, 3, 6, 6,
                   "Type or pick the Quote # - the document builds "
                   "itself. Set the print area to A1:G45 and print.",
                   fmts["note"])
    pick = "$C$7"

    def find(col_range: str, fallback: str = '""') -> str:
        return f"IFERROR(INDEX({col_range},MATCH({pick},{Q_num},0)),{fallback})"

    # ------------------------------------------------------- client block
    ws.write(8, 1, "Prepared for", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(8, 2, 8, 4,
                   f"={find(Q_client)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(8, 5, "Date", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(8, 6, f"={find(Q_date)}", fmts["print_date"])

    ws.write(9, 1, "Property", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(9, 2, 9, 4,
                   f"={find(Q_prop)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(9, 5, "Valid until", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(9, 6, f"={find(Q_valid)}", fmts["print_date"])

    ws.write(10, 1, "Service", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.merge_range(10, 2, 10, 4,
                   f"={find(Q_service)}", fmts["print_value"])
    ws.write(10, 5, "Frequency", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(10, 6, f"={find(Q_freq)}", fmts["print_value"])

    ws.write(11, 1, "Est. hours", fmts["print_label"])
    ws.write_formula(11, 2, f"={find(Q_hours)}", fmts["print_value"])

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- line table
    row = 13
    ws.write(row - 1, 1, "Area", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 2, "What is included", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 3, "Qty", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 4, "Unit", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 5, "Unit price", fmts["print_header"])
    ws.write(row - 1, 6, "Line total", fmts["print_header"])
    row += 1

    for i in range(1, MAX_LINES + 1):
        key_expr = f'{pick}&"-"&{i}'
        m = f"MATCH({key_expr},{L_key},0)"
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 1,
                         f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_room},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 2,
                         f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_desc},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 3,
                         f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_qty},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 4,
                         f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_unit},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 5,
                         f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_price},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell_money"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 6,
                         f'=IFERROR(INDEX({L_total},{m}),"")',
                         fmts["print_cell_money"])
        row += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ totals
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 5, "Subtotal", fmts["print_total"])
    ws.write_formula(row, 6, f"={find(Q_sub, '0')}",
                     fmts["print_total_money"])
    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 5, "Discount", fmts["print_total"])
    ws.write_formula(row, 6, f"={find(Q_disc, '0')}",
                     fmts["print_total_money"])
    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 5, cfg.tax_label, fmts["print_total"])
    ws.write_formula(row, 6, f"={find(Q_tax, '0')}",
                     fmts["print_total_money"])
    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 5, "TOTAL", fmts["print_total"])
    ws.write_formula(row, 6, f"={find(Q_total, '0')}",
                     fmts["print_total_money"])
    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 5,
                   "Deposit to confirm booking", fmts["print_total"])
    ws.write_formula(row, 6, f"={find(Q_dep, '0')}",
                     fmts["print_total_money"])
    row += 2

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- terms
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6, "Terms & notes", fmts["print_label"])
    row += 1
    money_text = f"{cfg.currency_symbol}#,##0.00"
    terms = [
        f'="1. This quote is valid until "&TEXT({find(Q_valid)},'
        f'"d mmm yyyy")&"."',
        f'="2. A deposit of "&TEXT({find(Q_dep, "0")},"{money_text}")'
        f'&" confirms the booking."',
        f'="3. Payment is due within {cfg.payment_terms_days} days of '
        f'the invoice."',
        '="4. Access to the property must be provided at the agreed '
        'time; no-access visits are chargeable."',
        '="5. Fragile or high-value items should be flagged before work '
        'starts."',
        '="6. Any change to the scope may adjust this price - we will '
        'always confirm first."',
        '="Thank you for considering "&Settings!$C$6&"."',
    ]
    for t in terms:
        ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6, t, fmts["print_value"])
        row += 1

    row += 1
    ws.merge_range(row, 1, row, 6,
                   "Signature: ______________________     "
                   "Date: ______________     "
                   "Accept quote: ☐", fmts["print_label"])

    ws.set_zoom(100)
    ws.set_paper(9)               # A4
    ws.fit_to_pages(1, 1)
    ws.print_area(0, 0, row, 6)
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
        })
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/properties.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/properties.py sha256:77ac9412119df8409352899d789451a8249561422ad593dae66aa42df10e7ede -->
````python
"""The Properties register - the places you actually clean."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Properties")
    samples = sd.PROPERTIES if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    unit = cfg.area_unit
    dist = cfg.distance_unit

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Property ID", 12, "text",
            formula='IF({property_name}{r}="","",' +
                    f'"PR-"&TEXT(ROW()-{4},"0000"))'),
        Col("property_name", "Property Name", 24, "text",
            note="Short label used in drop-downs, e.g. "
                 "'Whitfield - Family Home'."),
        Col("client", "Client", 24, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Clients_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("type", "Type", 14, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "House", "Apartment", "Condo", "Office", "Retail",
                "Restaurant", "Warehouse", "School", "Medical",
                "Airbnb / Rental", "Other"]}),
        Col("address", "Address", 30, "text"),
        Col("city", "City / Area", 14, "text"),
        Col("postcode", "Postcode / ZIP", 11, "text"),
        Col("size", f"Size ({unit})", 12, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 500000},
            note="Floor area - the quote calculator prices from this."),
        Col("bedrooms", "Bedrooms", 10, "int",
            validate={"type": "whole", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 30}),
        Col("bathrooms", "Bathrooms", 10, "int",
            validate={"type": "whole", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 30}),
        Col("rooms", "Other Rooms", 10, "int",
            validate={"type": "whole", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 50}),
        Col("floors", "Floors", 8, "int",
            validate={"type": "whole", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 1, "maximum": 60}),
        Col("travel", f"Travel ({dist})", 11, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 500}),
        Col("access", "Access / Keys", 18, "text",
            note="Key safe code, lockbox, doorman..."),
        Col("parking", "Parking", 12, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "On site", "Street", "Permit", "Paid", "Difficult"]}),
        Col("pets", "Pets", 10, "center",
            validate={"type": "list",
                      "source": ["None", "Dog", "Cat", "Both", "Other"]}),
        Col("alarm", "Alarm / Codes", 14, "text"),
        Col("hazards", "Hazards", 18, "text",
            note="Pets, alarms, fragile items, steep stairs, chemicals."),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 26, "text"),
        Col("job_count", "Jobs", 9, "int_locked",
            formula='IF({property_name}{r}="","",'
                    'COUNTIF([[Jobs.property]],{property_name}{r}))'),
        Col("revenue", "Revenue", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({property_name}{r}="","",'
                    'SUMIFS([[Jobs.price]],[[Jobs.property]],'
                    '{property_name}{r}))'),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(
        name="Properties",
        title="Property Register",
        subtitle="Every address you clean, with the size and layout the "
                 "quote calculator needs and the access details the crew "
                 "needs.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.primary,
    )
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/quote_calculator.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/quote_calculator.py sha256:c4067d7df5a291ad4209f3a1e34d3a8f91d7990894c8d3f78331171e65c16049 -->
````python
"""Quote Calculator - the interactive pricing tool.

White cells are the job. Pale teal cells are the maths. Every rate is
read live from the Settings tab, so changing a price there reprices
every future quote.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ..config import (CONDITION_FACTORS, Config, FREQUENCY_FACTORS,
                      Palette)
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry
from .settings import settings_ref


def _nest_if(key: str, mapping: dict, default: str = "1") -> str:
    """Build IF(C17="x",f1,IF(C17="y",f2,...,default))."""
    expr = default
    for label, factor in reversed(list(mapping.items())):
        expr = f'IF({key}="{label}",{factor},{expr})'
    return expr


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Quote Calculator")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.accent)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 30)
    ws.set_column(2, 2, 18)
    ws.set_column(3, 5, 18)

    ws.merge_range(0, 1, 0, 5,
                   "Quote Calculator  ·  Price a Job in 3 Minutes",
                   fmts["title"])
    ws.set_row(0, 30)
    ws.merge_range(2, 1, 2, 5,
                   "Fill the white cells. The price, the cost and the "
                   "margin build themselves. Rates come from Settings - "
                   "change them there, not here.",
                   fmts["subtitle"])

    def label(row: int, text: str, note: str = "") -> None:
        ws.write(row - 1, 1, text, fmts["label"])
        if note:
            ws.merge_range(row - 1, 3, row - 1, 5, note, fmts["note"])
        else:
            ws.merge_range(row - 1, 3, row - 1, 5, "", fmts["note"])

    def section(row: int, text: str) -> None:
        ws.merge_range(row - 1, 1, row - 1, 5, text, fmts["section"])

    def value(row: int, formula: str, style: str, raw=None) -> None:
        if raw is not None and not str(formula).startswith("="):
            if isinstance(raw, (int, float)):
                ws.write_number(row - 1, 2, raw, fmts[style])
            else:
                ws.write(row - 1, 2, raw, fmts[style])
        else:
            ws.write_formula(row - 1, 2, formula, fmts[style])

    def input_row(row: int, text: str, style: str, raw, note: str,
                  validation: dict = None) -> None:
        label(row, text, note)
        if isinstance(raw, (int, float)) and not isinstance(raw, bool):
            ws.write_number(row - 1, 2, raw, fmts[style])
        else:
            ws.write(row - 1, 2, raw, fmts[style])
        if validation:
            ws.data_validation(row - 1, 2, row - 1, 2, validation)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- the job
    section(5, "1 · The Job")
    input_row(6, "Quote Date", "input_date", cfg.today,
              "When the quote is prepared.")
    input_row(7, "Client", "input", "",
              "Type the client name (see the Clients tab).",
              {"validate": "list", "source": "=Clients_Names",
               "ignore_blank": True})
    input_row(8, "Property", "input", "",
              "The place being cleaned (see the Properties tab).",
              {"validate": "list", "source": "=Properties_Names",
               "ignore_blank": True})
    input_row(9, "Service Type", "input", "Standard clean",
              "Drives the uplift multiplier.",
              {"validate": "list", "source": [
                  "Standard clean", "Deep clean",
                  "Move-in / Move-out", "End of tenancy", "Office clean",
                  "Post-construction"]})

    # -------------------------------------------------------- the property
    section(11, "2 · The Property")
    input_row(12, f"Size ({cfg.area_unit})", "input", 1800,
              "Total floor area to clean.")
    input_row(13, "Bedrooms", "input_int", 3, "")
    input_row(14, "Bathrooms", "input_int", 2, "")
    input_row(15, "Other Rooms", "input_int", 2,
              "Living room, dining, office... (rooms beyond bed/bath).")
    input_row(16, "Floors", "input_int", 1, "")
    input_row(17, "Condition", "input", "Normal",
              "How dirty it is - this changes the hours.",
              {"validate": "list", "source": list(CONDITION_FACTORS)})

    # ------------------------------------------------------- job details
    section(19, "3 · The Job Details")
    input_row(20, "Frequency", "input", "One-off",
              "Regular work is cheaper per visit.",
              {"validate": "list", "source": list(FREQUENCY_FACTORS)})
    input_row(21, "Pets", "input", "No", "Adds the pet surcharge.",
              {"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]})
    input_row(22, "Interior Windows", "input_int", 0,
              "Priced each on top of the clean.")
    input_row(23, "Oven Deep Clean", "input", "No", "",
              {"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]})
    input_row(24, "Fridge Deep Clean", "input", "No", "",
              {"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]})
    input_row(25, "Carpet / Upholstery", "input", "No", "",
              {"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]})
    input_row(26, f"Travel ({cfg.distance_unit})", "input", 8,
              "Round trip distance to the job.")
    input_row(27, "Discount %", "input_pct", 0,
              "Goodwill, package deal, haggling room.")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- the maths
    section(29, "4 · The Maths (live)")
    freq_factor = _nest_if("C20", FREQUENCY_FACTORS)
    cond_factor = _nest_if("C17", CONDITION_FACTORS)
    deep_mult = ('IF(OR(C9="Deep clean",C9="Post-construction",'
                 'C9="End of tenancy",C9="Move-in / Move-out"),'
                 '1+' + settings_ref("deep_uplift") + ',1)')

    rows = [
        (30, "Base clean price",
         f'=C12*{settings_ref("rate_per_area")}'
         f'+C13*{settings_ref("rate_per_bedroom")}'
         f'+C14*{settings_ref("rate_per_bathroom")}'
         f'+C15*{settings_ref("rate_per_room")}',
         "calc_money",
         "Size + bedrooms + bathrooms + rooms, at your Settings rates."),
        (31, "Service adjustment", f'=C30*{deep_mult}', "calc_money",
         "Deep / move / post-construction work is harder - it is priced "
         "higher."),
        (32, "Frequency factor", f'={freq_factor}', "decimal_locked",
         "Regular work gets a better per-visit price."),
        (33, "Condition factor (hours)", f'={cond_factor}',
         "decimal_locked",
         "Changes the hours estimate, not the price."),
        (34, "Extras total",
         f'=IF(C21="Yes",{settings_ref("pet_surcharge")},0)'
         '+C22*8+IF(C23="Yes",35,0)+IF(C24="Yes",30,0)'
         f'+IF(C25="Yes",45,0)+C26*{settings_ref("travel_rate")}',
         "calc_money",
         "Pets, windows, oven, fridge, carpet and travel."),
        (35, "Estimated hours",
         f'=ROUND((C12*0.004+C13*0.35+C14*0.5+C15*0.25)*C33*{deep_mult},1)',
         "decimal_locked",
         "How long the crew will be there."),
        (36, "Labour cost",
         f'=ROUND(C35*{settings_ref("cleaners_per_job")}*'
         f'{settings_ref("cost_per_hour")},2)',
         "calc_money", "Hours x cleaners x your loaded hourly cost."),
        (37, "Supplies cost",
         f'=ROUND(C35*{settings_ref("supplies_per_hour")},2)',
         "calc_money", "Chemicals and materials."),
        (38, "Travel cost",
         f'=ROUND(C26*{settings_ref("travel_rate")},2)',
         "calc_money", "Distance at your travel rate."),
        (39, "Total cost", '=C36+C37+C38', "calc_money",
         "What the job costs you."),
    ]
    for row, text, formula, style, note in rows:
        label(row, text, note)
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 2, formula, fmts[style])

    # --------------------------------------------------------- the price
    section(41, "5 · The Price")
    price_rows = [
        (42, "Price before discount",
         f'=MAX({settings_ref("minimum_charge")},'
         'C31*C32+C34)', "calc_money",
         "Adjusted base x frequency factor + extras, never below the "
         "minimum charge."),
        (43, "Discount", '=ROUND(C42*C27,2)', "calc_money", ""),
        (44, "Quote total (ex tax)", '=C42-C43', "calc_money",
         "What you quote the client."),
        (45, "Tax", f'=ROUND(C44*{settings_ref("tax_rate")},2)',
         "calc_money", "Add only if you charge sales tax / VAT."),
        (46, "Total with tax", '=C44+C45', "calc_money", ""),
        (47, "Deposit due",
         f'=ROUND(C46*{settings_ref("deposit_pct")},2)', "calc_money",
         "Collect before work starts on big jobs."),
        (48, "Margin %", '=IF(C44=0,"",(C44-C39)/C44)', "calc_pct",
         "(Price - cost) / price."),
        (49, "Margin verdict",
         '=IF(C44=0,"-",IF(C48<' + settings_ref("margin_floor") +
         ',"LOW MARGIN - review the price",IF(C48<' +
         settings_ref("target_margin") +
         ',"OK - below target","STRONG")))', "calc",
         "Below the floor means this job does not pay."),
        (50, "Break-even price at target margin",
         '=IF(' + settings_ref("target_margin") + '>=1,"",'
         f'ROUND(C39/(1-{settings_ref("target_margin")}),2))',
         "calc_money",
         "What you would need to charge to hit the target margin."),
        (51, "Price per hour quoted", '=IF(C35=0,"",ROUND(C44/C35,2))',
         "calc_money",
         f"Compare with your hourly rate "
         f"({cfg.currency_symbol}{cfg.hourly_rate:,.2f})."),
    ]
    for row, text, formula, style, note in price_rows:
        label(row, text, note)
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 2, formula, fmts[style])

    # -------------------------------------------------------- next steps
    section(53, "6 · Next steps")
    steps = [
        "Happy with the number? Add one row to the Quotes tab and one "
        "row per line to Quote Lines (same Quote #).",
        "Print the client a copy from the Print Quote tab - type the "
        "Quote # into its yellow cell.",
        "Won the work? Copy the details to the Jobs tab and schedule "
        "the crew.",
        "Margin verdict amber or red? Cut the hours, add the extras, "
        "raise the price - or decline. Unprofitable work is worse than "
        "no work.",
    ]
    rr = 54
    for text in steps:
        ws.merge_range(rr - 1, 1, rr - 1, 5, "•  " + text, fmts["note"])
        ws.set_row(rr - 1, 24)
        rr += 1

    ws.freeze_panes(3, 0)
    ws.set_zoom(100)
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
        })
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/quote_lines.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/quote_lines.py sha256:dd07dd3979a19a50ac9191910300a7d53b86b63cef3de168dc0113f69c8bf8a8 -->
````python
"""Quote Lines - the priced detail behind each quote."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Quote Lines")
    samples = sd.QUOTE_LINES if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    cost_per_hour = cfg.cost_per_hour

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Line ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({quote_ref}{r}="","",'
                    '"QL-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"0000"))'),
        Col("quote_ref", "Quote #", 14, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Quotes_Numbers",
                      "ignore_blank": True},
            note="Must match a Quote # on the Quotes tab."),
        Col("line_no", "Line", 7, "int"),
        Col("room_area", "Room / Area", 16, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "Whole property", "Kitchen", "Bathrooms", "Bedrooms",
                "Living areas", "Hall & stairs", "Windows", "Floors",
                "Oven", "Fridge", "Carpet", "Upholstery", "Exterior",
                "Office area", "Communal areas", "Other"]}),
        Col("service", "Service", 22, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Services_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("description", "Description", 34, "text"),
        Col("qty", "Qty", 8, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("unit", "Unit", 11, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "hour", f"{cfg.area_unit}", "room", "bedroom",
                "bathroom", "visit", "fixed", "item"]}),
        Col("unit_price", "Unit Price", 12, "money",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1000000}),
        Col("hours", "Hours", 9, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 400},
            note="Your labour hours for this line."),
        Col("materials", "Materials", 12, "money",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("line_total", "Line Total", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_ref}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({qty}{r}*{unit_price}{r}+{materials}{r},2))'),
        Col("line_cost", "Line Cost", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_ref}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({hours}{r}*' + str(cost_per_hour) +
                    '+{materials}{r},2))',
            note=f"Hours at {cfg.currency_symbol}{cost_per_hour:,.2f} "
                 "fully loaded plus materials."),
        Col("line_profit", "Line Profit", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_ref}{r}="","",'
                    '{line_total}{r}-{line_cost}{r})'),
        Col("line_margin", "Margin %", 11, "pct_locked",
            formula='IF(OR({quote_ref}{r}="",{line_total}{r}=0),"",'
                    '{line_profit}{r}/{line_total}{r})'),
        Col("match_key", "Match Key", 12, "text_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_ref}{r}="","",'
                    '{quote_ref}{r}&"-"&{line_no}{r})',
            hidden=True,
            note="Helper for the printable quote. Leave hidden."),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(
        name="Quote Lines",
        title="Quote Lines",
        subtitle="One row per line of a quote. The Quotes tab totals these "
                 "by Quote #, so the same quote number can have as many "
                 "lines as you need.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
    )
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/quotes.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/quotes.py sha256:3b0d2ae2c100c1f87615e3bbcb5f4c6d371467a0fb8d2a3ae05035bee9e37bd1 -->
````python
"""The Quotes register - one row per quote sent."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Quotes")
    samples = sd.QUOTES if cfg.include_sample_data else []
    valid = cfg.quote_valid_days
    follow = cfg.quote_followup_days
    tax = cfg.tax_rate
    deposit = cfg.deposit_percent

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Quote ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    '"QT-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"0000"))'),
        Col("quote_number", "Quote #", 14, "text",
            note="Quote number used on the Quote Lines tab and the "
                 "printable quote."),
        Col("date", "Date Sent", 13, "date",
            validate={"type": "date", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": "DATE(2020,1,1)",
                      "maximum": "DATE(2100,1,1)"}),
        Col("client", "Client", 24, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Clients_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("property", "Property", 22, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Properties_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("contact", "Contact", 16, "text"),
        Col("email", "Email", 22, "text"),
        Col("phone", "Phone", 14, "text"),
        Col("service", "Main Service", 18, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Services_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("frequency", "Frequency", 14, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "One-off", "Weekly", "Fortnightly", "Every 3 weeks",
                "Monthly", "Quarterly", "Twice a week"]}),
        Col("valid_until", "Valid Until", 13, "date_locked",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",{date}{r}+' + str(valid) + ')'),
        Col("subtotal", "Subtotal", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    'SUMIFS([[Quote Lines.line_total]],'
                    '[[Quote Lines.quote_ref]],{quote_number}{r}))',
            note="Sum of the Quote Lines for this quote number."),
        Col("discount_pct", "Discount %", 11, "pct",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 0.9}),
        Col("discount", "Discount", 12, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({subtotal}{r}*{discount_pct}{r},2))'),
        Col("tax", cfg.tax_label, 12, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND(({subtotal}{r}-{discount}{r})*' +
                    str(tax) + ',2))'),
        Col("total", "Quote Total", 14, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    '{subtotal}{r}-{discount}{r}+{tax}{r})'),
        Col("deposit", "Deposit Due", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({total}{r}*' + str(deposit) + ',2))',
            note=f"{deposit:.0%} of the total, collected before work "
                 "starts on big jobs."),
        Col("est_hours", "Est. Hours", 11, "decimal_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    'SUMIFS([[Quote Lines.hours]],'
                    '[[Quote Lines.quote_ref]],{quote_number}{r}))'),
        Col("est_cost", "Est. Cost", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({quote_number}{r}="","",'
                    'SUMIFS([[Quote Lines.line_cost]],'
                    '[[Quote Lines.quote_ref]],{quote_number}{r}))',
            note="Labour at your cost per hour plus materials on the "
                 "quote lines."),
        Col("margin", "Est. Margin", 11, "pct_locked",
            formula='IF(OR({quote_number}{r}="",{subtotal}{r}=0),"",'
                    '({subtotal}{r}-{discount}{r}-{est_cost}{r})/'
                    '({subtotal}{r}-{discount}{r}))'),
        Col("status", "Status", 13, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "Draft", "Sent", "Followed up", "Accepted", "Declined",
                "Expired"]}),
        Col("follow_up", "Follow Up", 13, "date_locked",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",{date}{r}+' + str(follow) + ')',
            note="Chase the client on this date."),
        Col("owner", "Salesperson", 14, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Employees_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("job_created", "Job Created", 12, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No", ""]}),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 28, "text"),
    ]

    spec = SheetSpec(
        name="Quotes",
        title="Quotes",
        subtitle="One row per quote. Add the detail lines on Quote Lines "
                 "using the same Quote #, and print the quote from the "
                 "Print Quote tab.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
    )

    spec.col("status").cf = [
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "Accepted",
         "style": "good"},
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "Declined",
         "style": "bad"},
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "Expired",
         "style": "warning"},
    ]
    return spec
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/reports.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/reports.py sha256:5ceb5f81c6592aa2755eeb20028e833b68a1a5c4a353cd01feb0bbaf34d4ed5c -->
````python
"""Reports - KPIs, rankings and the monthly trend."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry, quote_sheet
from .settings import settings_ref


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Reports")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.primary_mid)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 30)
    ws.set_column(2, 6, 14)
    ws.set_column(7, 7, 3)
    ws.set_column(8, 13, 14)

    def rng(sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        spec = reg[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        return (f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${spec.first_data_row}:"
                f"${letter}${spec.last_data_row}")

    J_date, J_price, J_status = (rng("Jobs", "date"),
                                 rng("Jobs", "price"),
                                 rng("Jobs", "status"))
    J_client, J_service = (rng("Jobs", "client"),
                           rng("Jobs", "service"))
    I_date, I_total, I_balance = (rng("Invoices", "date"),
                                  rng("Invoices", "total"),
                                  rng("Invoices", "balance"))
    I_due, I_paid = rng("Invoices", "due"), rng("Invoices", "paid")
    P_date, P_amount = rng("Payments", "date"), rng("Payments", "amount")
    E_date, E_amount, E_cat = (rng("Expenses", "date"),
                               rng("Expenses", "amount"),
                               rng("Expenses", "category"))
    T_date, T_emp, T_hours = (rng("Timesheets", "date"),
                              rng("Timesheets", "employee"),
                              rng("Timesheets", "hours"))
    T_pay, T_ot = rng("Timesheets", "pay"), rng(
        "Timesheets", "overtime_pay")
    M_date, M_claim = rng("Mileage", "date"), rng("Mileage", "claim")
    Q_date, Q_status, Q_total = (rng("Quotes", "date"),
                                 rng("Quotes", "status"),
                                 rng("Quotes", "total"))
    C_rating, C_status = rng("Clients", "rating"), rng(
        "Clients", "status")

    ws.merge_range(0, 1, 0, 6, "Reports  ·  KPIs & Trends", fmts["title"])
    ws.set_row(0, 30)
    ws.merge_range(2, 1, 2, 6,
                   f"Every number is live from the registers for "
                   f"{cfg.year}. The month table below is the shape of "
                   "the year; the panels to the right rank what is "
                   "working.",
                   fmts["subtitle"])

    r = 4

    def section(text: str, width: int = 6) -> None:
        nonlocal r
        ws.merge_range(r - 1, 1, r - 1, width, text, fmts["section"])
        r += 1

    def kpi(label: str, formula: str, style: str, target: str = "") -> int:
        nonlocal r
        row = r
        ws.write(row - 1, 1, label, fmts["label"])
        ws.write_formula(row - 1, 2, formula, fmts[style])
        if target:
            ws.write_formula(row - 1, 3, target, fmts[style])
        else:
            ws.write_blank(row - 1, 3, None, fmts["note"])
        ws.merge_range(row - 1, 4, row - 1, 6, "", fmts["note"])
        r += 1
        return row

    y = cfg.year
    ys = f"DATE({y},1,1)"
    ye = f"DATE({y + 1},1,1)-1"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ KPI panel
    section("Key performance indicators")
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Indicator", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 2, "Value", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 3, "Target", fmts["header"])
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 4, r - 1, 6, "Comment", fmts["header"])
    r += 1

    rev_row = kpi("Revenue this year",
                  f'=SUMIFS({J_price},{J_date},">="&{ys},{J_date},"<="&{ye},'
                  f'{J_status},"Completed")+SUMIFS({J_price},{J_date},'
                  f'">="&{ys},{J_date},"<="&{ye},{J_status},"Invoiced")',
                  "calc_money", '=Settings!$C$68')
    kpi("Costs this year",
        f'=SUMIFS({E_amount},{E_date},">="&{ys},{E_date},"<="&{ye})'
        f'+SUMIFS({T_pay},{T_date},">="&{ys},{T_date},"<="&{ye})'
        f'+SUMIFS({T_ot},{T_date},">="&{ys},{T_date},"<="&{ye})'
        f'+SUMIFS({M_claim},{M_date},">="&{ys},{M_date},"<="&{ye})',
        "calc_money")
    profit_row = kpi("Profit this year",
                     f'=C{r-2}-C{r-1}', "calc_money")
    kpi("Margin this year",
        f'=IF(C{r-3}=0,"",C{profit_row}/C{r-3})', "calc_pct",
        '=Settings!$C$63')
    kpi("Cash collected this year",
        f'=SUMIFS({P_amount},{P_date},">="&{ys},{P_date},"<="&{ye})',
        "calc_money")
    kpi("Outstanding now", f'=SUMIF({I_balance},">0")', "calc_money")
    kpi("Overdue now",
        f'=SUMIFS({I_balance},{I_due},"<"&TODAY(),{I_balance},">0")',
        "calc_money")
    kpi("Quotes sent this year",
        f'=COUNTIFS({Q_date},">="&{ys},{Q_date},"<="&{ye})', "calc_int")
    kpi("Quotes won this year",
        f'=COUNTIFS({Q_date},">="&{ys},{Q_date},"<="&{ye},'
        f'{Q_status},"Accepted")', "calc_int")
    kpi("Quote win rate",
        f'=IF(C{r-2}=0,"",C{r-1}/C{r-2})', "calc_pct",
        '=Settings!$C$73')
    kpi("Active clients", f'=COUNTIF({C_status},"Active")', "calc_int")
    kpi("Average satisfaction",
        f'=IF(COUNT({C_rating})=0,"",AVERAGE({C_rating}))',
        "calc_decimal", '=Settings!$C$72')
    kpi("Total jobs done",
        f'=COUNTIF({J_status},"Completed")+COUNTIF({J_status},'
        '"Invoiced")', "calc_int")
    kpi("Average job value",
        f'=IF((COUNTIF({J_status},"Completed")+COUNTIF({J_status},'
        f'"Invoiced"))=0,"",C{rev_row}/(COUNTIF({J_status},'
        f'"Completed")+COUNTIF({J_status},"Invoiced")))',
        "calc_money")
    r += 1

    # -------------------------------------------------------- month table
    section("Monthly trend")
    headers = ["Month", "Jobs", "Revenue", "Costs", "Profit", "Margin"]
    for c, text in enumerate(headers):
        ws.write(r - 1, 1 + c, text, fmts["header"])
    r += 1
    month_first_row = r
    for m in range(1, 13):
        ms = f"DATE({y},{m},1)"
        me = f"DATE({y},{m + 1},1)-1"
        ws.write_formula(r - 1, 1,
                         f'=DATE({y},{m},1)', fmts["calc_month"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 2,
            f'=COUNTIFS({J_date},">="&{ms},{J_date},"<="&{me},'
            f'{J_status},"Completed")+COUNTIFS({J_date},">="&{ms},'
            f'{J_date},"<="&{me},{J_status},"Invoiced")',
            fmts["calc_int"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 3,
            f'=SUMIFS({J_price},{J_date},">="&{ms},{J_date},"<="&{me},'
            f'{J_status},"Completed")+SUMIFS({J_price},{J_date},'
            f'">="&{ms},{J_date},"<="&{me},{J_status},"Invoiced")',
            fmts["calc_money"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 4,
            f'=SUMIFS({E_amount},{E_date},">="&{ms},{E_date},"<="&{me})'
            f'+SUMIFS({T_pay},{T_date},">="&{ms},{T_date},"<="&{me})'
            f'+SUMIFS({T_ot},{T_date},">="&{ms},{T_date},"<="&{me})'
            f'+SUMIFS({M_claim},{M_date},">="&{ms},{M_date},"<="&{me})',
            fmts["calc_money"])
        ws.write_formula(r - 1, 5, f"=D{r}-E{r}", fmts["calc_money"])
        ws.write_formula(r - 1, 6,
                         f'=IF(D{r}=0,"",F{r}/D{r})', fmts["pct_locked"])
        r += 1
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Year", fmts["total_label"])
    for c, letter in enumerate(["C", "D", "E", "F"]):
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 2 + c,
            f"=SUM({letter}{month_first_row}:{letter}{r-1})",
            fmts["total_int"] if c == 0 else fmts["total_money"])
    ws.write_formula(r - 1, 6,
                     f'=IF(D{r}=0,"",F{r}/D{r})', fmts["total_pct"])
    r += 2

    # --------------------------------------------------- revenue by service
    section("Revenue by service (top of the price list)")
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Service", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 2, "Jobs", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 3, "Revenue", fmts["header"])
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 4, r - 1, 6, "Share of jobs", fmts["header"])
    r += 1
    e_spec = reg["Services"]
    n_services = 8
    for i in range(n_services):
        srow = e_spec.first_data_row + i
        name_ref = f"{quote_sheet('Services')}!" \
                   f"${e_spec.letter('name')}${srow}"
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 1,
            f'=IF({name_ref}="","",{name_ref})', fmts["text_locked"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 2,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",COUNTIFS({J_service},$B{r},'
            f'{J_status},"<>Cancelled"))', fmts["calc_int"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 3,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",SUMIFS({J_price},{J_service},$B{r},'
            f'{J_status},"<>Cancelled"))', fmts["calc_money"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 4,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",IFERROR(C{r}/COUNTIFS({J_status},'
            f'"<>Cancelled"),0))', fmts["calc_pct"])
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------- top clients
    section("Top clients (first 8 on the Clients tab)")
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Client", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 2, "Jobs", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 3, "Revenue", fmts["header"])
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 4, r - 1, 6, "Outstanding", fmts["header"])
    r += 1
    c_spec = reg["Clients"]
    for i in range(8):
        crow = c_spec.first_data_row + i
        name_ref = f"{quote_sheet('Clients')}!" \
                   f"${c_spec.letter('name')}${crow}"
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 1,
            f'=IF({name_ref}="","",{name_ref})', fmts["text_locked"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 2,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",COUNTIFS({J_client},$B{r},'
            f'{J_status},"<>Cancelled"))', fmts["calc_int"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 3,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",SUMIFS({J_price},{J_client},$B{r},'
            f'{J_status},"<>Cancelled"))', fmts["calc_money"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 4,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",SUMIFS({I_balance},{rng("Invoices", "client")},'
            f'$B{r}))', fmts["calc_money"])
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------- expense categories
    section("Expenses by category (this year)")
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Category", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 2, "Total", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 3, "Share", fmts["header"])
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 4, r - 1, 6, "", fmts["header"])
    r += 1
    cats = ["Payroll", "Supplies", "Equipment", "Fuel", "Insurance",
            "Rent", "Utilities", "Marketing", "Training", "Repairs",
            "Software", "Fees", "Taxes", "Other"]
    cat_first = r
    for cat in cats:
        ws.write(r - 1, 1, cat, fmts["input"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 2,
            f'=SUMIFS({E_amount},{E_cat},$B{r},{E_date},">="&{ys},'
            f'{E_date},"<="&{ye})', fmts["calc_money"])
        r += 1
    # payroll as its own line (wages are not on the Expenses tab)
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Wages & payroll", fmts["input"])
    ws.write_formula(
        r - 1, 2,
        f'=SUMIFS({T_pay},{T_date},">="&{ys},{T_date},"<="&{ye})'
        f'+SUMIFS({T_ot},{T_date},">="&{ys},{T_date},"<="&{ye})',
        fmts["calc_money"])
    r += 1
    cat_last = r - 1
    for i, rr in enumerate(range(cat_first, cat_last + 1)):
        ws.write_formula(rr - 1, 3,
                         f'=IF(SUM($C${cat_first}:$C${cat_last})=0,"",'
                         f'C{rr}/SUM($C${cat_first}:$C${cat_last}))',
                         fmts["pct_locked"])
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------- staff leaderboard
    section("Staff leaderboard (first 8 on the Employees tab)")
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Employee", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 2, "Hours", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(r - 1, 3, "Cost", fmts["header"])
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 4, r - 1, 6, "Jobs led", fmts["header"])
    r += 1
    emp_spec = reg["Employees"]
    for i in range(8):
        erow = emp_spec.first_data_row + i
        name_ref = f"{quote_sheet('Employees')}!" \
                   f"${emp_spec.letter('name')}${erow}"
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 1,
            f'=IF({name_ref}="","",{name_ref})', fmts["text_locked"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 2,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",SUMIFS({T_hours},{T_emp},$B{r},'
            f'{T_date},">="&{ys},{T_date},"<="&{ye}))',
            fmts["calc_decimal"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 3,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",SUMIFS({T_pay},{T_emp},$B{r},'
            f'{T_date},">="&{ys},{T_date},"<="&{ye})'
            f'+SUMIFS({T_ot},{T_emp},$B{r},{T_date},">="&{ys},'
            f'{T_date},"<="&{ye}))', fmts["calc_money"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 4,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",COUNTIFS({rng("Jobs", "crew_lead")},$B{r},'
            f'{J_date},">="&{ys},{J_date},"<="&{ye},'
            f'{J_status},"<>Cancelled"))', fmts["calc_int"])
        r += 1

    r += 1
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 1, r - 1, 6,
                   "Rankings show the first rows of each register - "
                   "sort the register itself to decide who those are.",
                   fmts["note"])

    ws.freeze_panes(3, 0)
    ws.set_zoom(90)
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
        })
````
