````python
"""The Safety register - checks, talks and policy."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Safety")
    samples = sd.SAFETY if cfg.include_sample_data else []

    columns = [
        Col("id", "ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",'
                    '"SF-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"0000"))'),
        Col("date", "Date", 13, "date",
            validate={"type": "date", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": "DATE(2020,1,1)",
                      "maximum": "DATE(2100,1,1)"}),
        Col("type", "Type", 15, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "Toolbox talk", "Training", "Inspection", "Policy review",
                "Equipment check", "Risk assessment"]}),
        Col("topic", "Topic", 24, "text"),
        Col("area", "Area / Site", 18, "text"),
        Col("risk_level", "Risk", 10, "center",
            validate={"type": "list",
                      "source": ["Low", "Medium", "High"]}),
        Col("finding", "Finding", 28, "text"),
        Col("action", "Action Required", 26, "text"),
        Col("owner", "Owner", 15, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Employees_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("due_date", "Due", 13, "date"),
        Col("status", "Status", 12, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "Open", "In progress", "Done", "Not required"]}),
        Col("closed_date", "Closed", 13, "date"),
        Col("attendees", "Attendees", 22, "text"),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "text"),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(
        name="Safety",
        title="Safety & Compliance",
        subtitle="Toolbox talks, inspections and risk assessments - "
                 "evidence that the business takes care of its people.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
    )
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/services.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/services.py sha256:4d105ade5c491dd0f5aac508f1f388e613d72324f3778d823d6841a04d4117ab -->
````python
"""The Services register - the price list."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Services")
    samples = sd.SERVICES if cfg.include_sample_data else []

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Service ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",'
                    f'"SV-"&TEXT(ROW()-{4},"000"))'),
        Col("name", "Service", 26, "text",
            note="Used in the quote calculator and job sheets."),
        Col("category", "Category", 15, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "Residential", "Commercial", "Deep clean", "Specialist",
                "Add-on"]}),
        Col("description", "What Is Included", 36, "text"),
        Col("unit", "Priced By", 12, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "hour", f"{cfg.area_unit}", "room", "bedroom",
                "bathroom", "visit", "fixed"]},
            note="Drives the quote calculator's maths."),
        Col("base_price", "Standard Price", 13, "money",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("est_hours", "Est. Hours", 10, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 400}),
        Col("materials", "Materials Cost", 12, "money"),
        Col("frequency", "Default Frequency", 15, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "One-off", "Weekly", "Fortnightly", "Every 3 weeks",
                "Monthly", "Quarterly", "Twice a week"]}),
        Col("active", "Active", 9, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]}),
        Col("times_used", "Times Quoted", 11, "int_locked",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",'
                    'COUNTIF([[Quote Lines.service]],{name}{r}))'),
        Col("quoted_value", "Quoted Value", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",'
                    'SUMIFS([[Quote Lines.line_total]],'
                    '[[Quote Lines.service]],{name}{r}))'),
        Col("price_per_hour", "Price / Hour", 12, "money_locked",
            formula='IF(OR({name}{r}="",{est_hours}{r}<=0),"",'
                    '{base_price}{r}/{est_hours}{r})',
            note="Sanity check: should land above your cost per hour "
                 f"({cfg.currency_symbol}{cfg.cost_per_hour:,.2f})."),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(
        name="Services",
        title="Services & Price List",
        subtitle="What you sell, what it costs, how it is priced. The "
                 "quote calculator reads this list.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
    )
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/settings.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/settings.py sha256:466963c5b91b3577356ddc8eed558990447c893cf940adb57603ed9033aba4de -->
````python
"""The Settings tab - business profile, pricing and working rules.

Row map matters: the defined names (Business_Name, Tax_Rate,
Hourly_Rate, Minimum_Charge, ...) point at fixed cells on this sheet.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry

#: Fixed cells on this sheet other pages reference (keep rows in sync!).
SETTINGS_CELLS = {
    "business_name": "$C$6", "owner": "$C$7", "email": "$C$8",
    "phone": "$C$9", "address": "$C$10",
    "plan_year": "$C$18", "week_start": "$C$19",
    "currency_symbol": "$C$20", "currency_code": "$C$21",
    "area_unit": "$C$22", "distance_unit": "$C$23",
    "cleaners_per_job": "$C$27", "productive_hours": "$C$28",
    "travel_rate": "$C$29", "travel_minutes": "$C$30",
    "job_reminder_days": "$C$31", "quote_followup_days": "$C$32",
    "quote_valid_days": "$C$33", "inactive_client_days": "$C$34",
    "low_stock_days": "$C$35", "maintenance_days": "$C$36",
    "pay_rate": "$C$39", "overtime_multiplier": "$C$40",
    "employer_oncost": "$C$41", "cost_per_hour": "$C$42",
    "tax_rate": "$C$45", "payment_terms": "$C$46", "late_fee": "$C$47",
    "tax_label": "$C$48", "deposit_pct": "$C$49",
    "rate_per_area": "$C$52", "rate_per_bedroom": "$C$53",
    "rate_per_bathroom": "$C$54", "hourly_rate": "$C$55",
    "rate_per_room": "$C$56", "minimum_charge": "$C$57",
    "deep_uplift": "$C$58", "move_uplift": "$C$59",
    "pet_surcharge": "$C$60", "callout_fee": "$C$61",
    "supplies_per_hour": "$C$62", "target_margin": "$C$63",
    "margin_floor": "$C$64",
    "revenue_target_month": "$C$67", "revenue_target_year": "$C$68",
    "expense_budget_month": "$C$69", "utilisation_target": "$C$70",
    "retention_target": "$C$71", "satisfaction_target": "$C$72",
    "quote_win_target": "$C$73",
}


def settings_ref(key: str) -> str:
    """Absolute reference to a Settings cell, e.g. Settings!$C$55."""
    return f"Settings!{SETTINGS_CELLS[key]}"


def _section(ws, fmts, row: int, text: str) -> None:
    ws.merge_range(row - 1, 1, row - 1, 6, text, fmts["section"])


def _note(ws, fmts, row: int, text: str) -> None:
    ws.merge_range(row - 1, 1, row - 1, 6, text, fmts["note"])
    ws.set_row(row - 1, 26)


def _field(ws, fmts, row: int, label: str, value: Any,
           style: str = "input", note: str = "") -> None:
    ws.write(row - 1, 1, label, fmts["label"])
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        ws.write_number(row - 1, 2, value, fmts[style])
    else:
        ws.write(row - 1, 2, value, fmts[style])
    if note:
        ws.merge_range(row - 1, 3, row - 1, 6, note, fmts["note"])
    else:
        ws.merge_range(row - 1, 3, row - 1, 6, "", fmts["note"])


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Settings")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.primary_mid)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 30)
    ws.set_column(2, 2, 24)
    ws.set_column(3, 6, 16)

    ws.merge_range(0, 1, 0, 6,
                   f"{cfg.product_name}  ·  Settings",
                   fmts["title"])
    ws.set_row(0, 30)
    ws.merge_range(2, 1, 2, 6,
                   "Set the business up once, then never touch this tab "
                   "again. Everything downstream - quotes, invoices, "
                   "costs, reports - reads these cells.",
                   fmts["subtitle"])

    b = cfg.business

    # --- rows 4-15: business profile (Business_Name = C6) ---------------
    _section(ws, fmts, 4, "1 · Business Profile")
    _note(ws, fmts, 5,
          "These details print on quotes and invoices.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 6, "Business Name", b.name,
           note="Shown on the printable documents.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 7, "Owner / Manager", b.owner)
    _field(ws, fmts, 8, "Email", b.email)
    _field(ws, fmts, 9, "Phone", b.phone)
    _field(ws, fmts, 10, "Address", b.address)
    _field(ws, fmts, 11, "Service Area", b.area)
    _field(ws, fmts, 12, "Website", b.website)
    _field(ws, fmts, 13, "Tagline", b.tagline)
    _field(ws, fmts, 14, "Registration / License #", b.reg_number)
    _field(ws, fmts, 15, "Insurance Policy", b.insurance)

    # --- rows 16-24: calendar & display ---------------------------------
    _section(ws, fmts, 16, "2 · Calendar & Display")
    _note(ws, fmts, 17,
          "The planner year, the currency and the units you price in.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 18, "Plan Year", cfg.year, "input_int",
           "Reports and the Calendar open on this year.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 19, "Week Starts", cfg.week_start,
           note="Monday suits most; Sunday suits the Middle East and US.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 20, "Currency Symbol", cfg.currency_symbol)
    _field(ws, fmts, 21, "Currency Code", cfg.currency_code)
    _field(ws, fmts, 22, "Area Unit", cfg.area_unit,
           note="sq ft or sq m - the quote calculator prices per unit.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 23, "Distance Unit", cfg.distance_unit)
    _field(ws, fmts, 24, "Time Format", cfg.time_format,
           note="Display preference - Excel uses your system format.")

    # --- rows 25-36: working rules --------------------------------------
    _section(ws, fmts, 25, "3 · Working Rules")
    _note(ws, fmts, 26,
          "How the business runs day to day. Drives the scheduler "
          "reminders and the costings.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 27, "Cleaners per Job", cfg.cleaners_per_job,
           "input_int", "Default crew size when costing a job.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 28, "Billable Hours per Day", cfg.productive_hours,
           "input", "Real productive hours per cleaner, per day.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 29, f"Travel Rate per {cfg.distance_unit}",
           cfg.travel_rate, "input_money",
           "Reimbursed per unit of business travel.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 30, "Travel Minutes Between Jobs",
           cfg.travel_minutes, "input_int")
    _field(ws, fmts, 31, "Job Reminder (days)", cfg.reminder_days,
           "input_int", "How early the Calendar flags a job.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 32, "Quote Follow-up (days)",
           cfg.quote_followup_days, "input_int")
    _field(ws, fmts, 33, "Quote Valid (days)", cfg.quote_valid_days,
           "input_int")
    _field(ws, fmts, 34, "Inactive Client (days)",
           cfg.inactive_client_days, "input_int",
           "Clients with no job this long show on Client Retention.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 35, "Low Stock Warning (days)",
           cfg.low_stock_days, "input_int")
    _field(ws, fmts, 36, "Equipment Service Interval (days)",
           cfg.maintenance_days, "input_int")

    # --- rows 37-42: payroll -------------------------------------------
    _section(ws, fmts, 37, "4 · Payroll")
    _note(ws, fmts, 38,
          "What an hour of cleaning really costs you.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 39, "Default Hourly Pay", cfg.pay_rate,
           "input_money", "Fallback when an employee has no own rate.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 40, "Overtime Multiplier", cfg.overtime_multiplier,
           "input")
    _field(ws, fmts, 41, "Employer On-costs", cfg.employer_oncost,
           "input_pct",
           "Tax, insurance, holiday pay on top of wages.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 42, "Loaded Cost per Hour", cfg.cost_per_hour,
           "calc_money",
           "Pay x (1 + on-costs). This is what jobs are costed at.")

    # --- rows 43-49: billing (Tax_Rate = C45, Invoice_Terms = C46) ------
    _section(ws, fmts, 43, "5 · Billing & Tax")
    _note(ws, fmts, 44,
          "How invoices are calculated and chased.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 45, "Tax Rate", cfg.tax_rate, "input_pct",
           "Sales tax or VAT. Set 0 for none.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 46, "Payment Terms (days)", cfg.payment_terms_days,
           "input_int", "Days from invoice date to due date.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 47, "Late Fee", cfg.late_fee_percent, "input_pct")
    _field(ws, fmts, 48, "Tax Label", cfg.tax_label,
           note="What it says on the invoice.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 49, "Deposit %", cfg.deposit_percent, "input_pct",
           "Collected before work starts on big jobs.")

    # --- rows 50-64: pricing (Hourly_Rate = C55, Minimum_Charge = C57) --
    _section(ws, fmts, 50, "6 · Pricing")
    _note(ws, fmts, 51,
          "The knobs the Quote Calculator turns. Get these right and "
          "every quote is right.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 52, f"Rate per {cfg.area_unit} (standard)",
           cfg.rate_per_area, "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 53, "Rate per Bedroom", cfg.rate_per_bedroom,
           "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 54, "Rate per Bathroom", cfg.rate_per_bathroom,
           "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 55, "Hourly Rate", cfg.hourly_rate, "input_money",
           "What the client pays per hour of cleaning.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 56, "Rate per Room", cfg.rate_per_room,
           "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 57, "Minimum Charge", cfg.minimum_charge,
           "input_money", "No job leaves for less than this.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 58, "Deep Clean Uplift", cfg.deep_clean_uplift,
           "input_pct", "Added to the standard clean price.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 59, "Move Clean Uplift", cfg.move_clean_uplift,
           "input_pct")
    _field(ws, fmts, 60, "Pet Surcharge", cfg.pet_surcharge,
           "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 61, "Callout Fee", cfg.callout_fee,
           "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 62, "Supplies Cost per Hour",
           cfg.supplies_per_hour, "input_money",
           "Chemicals and materials consumed per hour worked.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 63, "Target Margin", cfg.target_margin,
           "input_pct", "The margin a healthy quote should show.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 64, "Margin Floor", cfg.margin_floor, "input_pct",
           "Quotes below this get flagged for review.")

    # --- rows 65-73: targets -------------------------------------------
    _section(ws, fmts, 65, "7 · Targets")
    _note(ws, fmts, 66,
          "What good looks like this year. The Dashboard measures "
          "against these.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 67, "Monthly Revenue Target",
           cfg.revenue_target_month, "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 68, "Annual Revenue Target",
           cfg.revenue_target_year, "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 69, "Monthly Expense Budget",
           cfg.expense_budget_month, "input_money")
    _field(ws, fmts, 70, "Staff Utilisation Target",
           cfg.utilisation_target, "input_pct",
           "Share of paid hours that are billed to jobs.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 71, "Client Retention Target", cfg.retention_target,
           "input_pct")
    _field(ws, fmts, 72, "Satisfaction Target", cfg.satisfaction_target,
           "input", "Out of 5.")
    _field(ws, fmts, 73, "Quote Win Rate Target", cfg.quote_win_target,
           "input_pct")

    ws.merge_range(75, 1, 75, 6,
                   "Input cells are white and unlocked. Pale teal cells "
                   f"calculate themselves. Sheets are protected with the "
                   f"password '{cfg.password}' - use Review > Unprotect "
                   "Sheet to restructure.",
                   fmts["note"])
    ws.set_row(75, 28)
    ws.freeze_panes(3, 0)
    ws.set_zoom(100)
    _protect(ws, cfg)


def _protect(ws: Any, cfg: Config) -> None:
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
            "format_cells": False,
        })
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/staff_schedule.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/staff_schedule.py sha256:97825ffbada079fadbafb59a87c53cc2f97f038d8db82992b47e5ac23c808984 -->
````python
"""Staff Schedule - who works where, this week."""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
from typing import Any

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry, quote_sheet


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Staff Schedule")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.primary_mid)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 22)
    ws.set_column(2, 8, 13)
    ws.set_column(9, 9, 12)
    ws.set_column(10, 11, 16)

    def rng(sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        spec = reg[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        return (f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${spec.first_data_row}:"
                f"${letter}${spec.last_data_row}")

    j_date = rng("Jobs", "date")
    j_status = rng("Jobs", "status")
    j_hours = rng("Jobs", "hours")
    j_crew = rng("Jobs", "crew_lead")
    j_client = rng("Jobs", "client")
    e_name = rng("Employees", "name")

    ws.merge_range(0, 1, 0, 9, "Staff Schedule  ·  Week View",
                   fmts["title"])
    ws.set_row(0, 30)
    ws.merge_range(2, 1, 2, 9,
                   "Hours per employee, per day, read live from the Jobs "
                   "tab (crew lead column). Overwrite the week cell to "
                   "look at another week.",
                   fmts["subtitle"])

    ws.write(4, 1, "Week starting", fmts["label"])
    offset = cfg.today.weekday() if cfg.week_start == "Monday" else (cfg.today.weekday() + 1) % 7
    ws.write_datetime(4, 2, cfg.today - dt.timedelta(days=offset), fmts["input_date"])
    ws.merge_range(4, 3, 4, 9,
                   "Type any date to see that week (Monday-based).",
                   fmts["note"])

    week_cell = "$C$5"
    weekdays = (["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
                if cfg.week_start == "Monday" else
                ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"])

    # header row
    ws.write(6, 1, "Employee", fmts["header"])
    for c, name in enumerate(weekdays):
        day_ref = f"{week_cell}+{c}"
        ws.write_formula(6, 2 + c,
                         f'={day_ref}', fmts["header"])
        ws.write(7, 2 + c, name, fmts["nav"])
    ws.write(6, 9, "Week total", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(6, 10, "Jobs", fmts["header"])
    ws.write(6, 11, "Cost", fmts["header"])
    ws.set_row(6, 22)

    # employee rows (first 14 rows of the Employees register)
    e_spec = reg["Employees"]
    for i in range(14):
        r = 9 + i
        erow = e_spec.first_data_row + i
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 1,
            f"=IF({quote_sheet('Employees')}!${e_spec.letter('name')}"
            f"${erow}=\"\",\"\",{quote_sheet('Employees')}!"
            f"${e_spec.letter('name')}${erow})",
            fmts["text_locked"])
        for c in range(7):
            day_ref = f"{week_cell}+{c}"
            formula = (
                f'=IF($B{r}="","",IF(SUMIFS({j_hours},{j_date},{day_ref},'
                f'{j_crew},$B{r},{j_status},"<>Cancelled")=0,"",'
                f'SUMIFS({j_hours},{j_date},{day_ref},{j_crew},$B{r},'
                f'{j_status},"<>Cancelled")))')
            ws.write_formula(r - 1, 2 + c, formula, fmts["calc_decimal"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 9,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",SUM(C{r}:I{r}))', fmts["calc_decimal"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 10,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",COUNTIFS({j_crew},$B{r},{j_date},'
            f'">="&{week_cell},{j_date},"<="&{week_cell}+6,'
            f'{j_status},"<>Cancelled"))', fmts["calc_int"])
        ws.write_formula(
            r - 1, 11,
            f'=IF($B{r}="","",SUMIFS({j_hours},{j_crew},$B{r},{j_date},'
            f'">="&{week_cell},{j_date},"<="&{week_cell}+6,'
            f'{j_status},"<>Cancelled")*{quote_sheet("Settings")}!'
            f'$C$42)', fmts["calc_money"])

    # totals row
    tr = 23
    ws.write(tr - 1, 1, "Totals", fmts["total_label"])
    for c in range(7):
        col = chr(ord("C") + c)
        ws.write_formula(tr - 1, 2 + c,
                         f'=SUM({col}9:{col}22)', fmts["total_money"])
    ws.write_formula(tr - 1, 9, '=SUM(J9:J22)', fmts["total_money"])
    ws.write_formula(tr - 1, 10, '=SUM(K9:K22)', fmts["total_int"])
    ws.write_formula(tr - 1, 11, '=SUM(L9:L22)', fmts["total_money"])

    # week summary
    r = 25
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 1, r - 1, 9, "This week at a glance",
                   fmts["section"])
    r += 1
    stats = [
        ("Jobs this week",
         f'=COUNTIFS({j_date},">="&{week_cell},{j_date},'
         f'"<="&{week_cell}+6,{j_status},"<>Cancelled")', "calc_int"),
        ("Revenue scheduled",
         f'=SUMIFS({quote_sheet("Jobs")}!$'
         f'{reg.letter("Jobs", "price")}$5:$'
         f'{reg.letter("Jobs", "price")}${reg["Jobs"].last_data_row},'
         f'{j_date},">="&{week_cell},{j_date},"<="&{week_cell}+6,'
         f'{j_status},"<>Cancelled")', "calc_money"),
        ("Hours scheduled",
         f'=SUMIFS({j_hours},{j_date},">="&{week_cell},{j_date},'
         f'"<="&{week_cell}+6,{j_status},"<>Cancelled")', "calc_decimal"),
        ("Unassigned jobs (no crew lead)",
         f'=COUNTIFS({j_date},">="&{week_cell},{j_date},'
         f'"<="&{week_cell}+6,{j_status},"<>Cancelled",{j_crew},"")',
         "calc_int"),
    ]
    for label, formula, style in stats:
        ws.write(r - 1, 1, label, fmts["label"])
        ws.write_formula(r - 1, 2, formula, fmts[style])
        r += 1

    ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 9,
                   "Cells show scheduled hours per crew lead. Add crews "
                   "on the Employees tab - the first 14 appear here.",
                   fmts["note"])
    ws.freeze_panes(8, 2)
    ws.set_zoom(100)
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
        })
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/start_here.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/start_here.py sha256:3972ce97c25e401ade7eef273b71b7bf197080f408961c2f81b4ae4f38b71724 -->
````python
"""Start Here - the welcome page."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Registry


def build_page(workbook: Any, fmts: FormatBook, reg: Registry,
               cfg: Config) -> None:
    ws = workbook.add_worksheet("Start Here")
    ws.set_tab_color(Palette.accent)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    ws.set_column(0, 0, 2)
    ws.set_column(1, 1, 34)
    ws.set_column(2, 6, 17)

    ws.merge_range(0, 1, 0, 6, cfg.product_name, fmts["title"])
    ws.set_row(0, 34)
    ws.merge_range(1, 1, 1, 6, cfg.product_subtitle, fmts["subtitle"])
    ws.merge_range(2, 1, 2, 6,
                   f"Version {cfg.version}  ·  by {cfg.author}  ·  "
                   f"built for {cfg.business.name}",
                   fmts["nav"])

    r = 4

    def section(text: str) -> None:
        nonlocal r
        ws.merge_range(r - 1, 1, r - 1, 6, text, fmts["section"])
        r += 1

    def line(text: str, style: str = "note", height: int = 22) -> None:
        nonlocal r
        ws.merge_range(r - 1, 1, r - 1, 6, text, fmts[style])
        ws.set_row(r - 1, height)
        r += 1

    def gap() -> None:
        nonlocal r
        r += 1

    section("What this workbook is")
    line("A complete back office for a cleaning business: client CRM, "
         "quoting, job scheduling, crews and timesheets, costing, "
         "invoicing, stock, expenses, retention and a profit dashboard. "
         "37 tabs, all wired together.")
    line(f"Everything is Excel-2010 safe: classic formulas only, no "
         f"special functions. Sheets are protected with the password "
         f"'{cfg.password}' so formulas cannot be broken by accident - "
         "input cells are white and unlocked.", "warning", 32)
    gap()

    section("Start in this order")
    line("1 · Settings  -  your business details, rates, tax and targets.")
    line("2 · Services  -  your price list. The quote calculator reads it.")
    line("3 · Clients & Properties  -  who you clean and where.")
    line("4 · Quote Calculator  -  price a job in 3 minutes, print it "
         "from Print Quote.")
    line("5 · Jobs  -  schedule the work; Job Tasks hold the checklists.")
    line("6 · Timesheets, Supplies & Expenses  -  log the real costs.")
    line("7 · Invoices & Payments  -  bill it, get paid, watch balances.")
    line("8 · Dashboard & Reports  -  the numbers that tell you how the "
         "business is really doing.")
    gap()

    section("Colour key")
    line("White cells are yours to fill in. Pale teal cells are "
         "calculated - do not type over them. Amber highlights mean "
         "something needs you today.", "note", 30)
    gap()

    section("The tabs")
    tabs = [
        ("Settings", "Business profile, pricing and targets"),
        ("Dashboard", "Today, this month, this year at a glance"),
        ("Quote Calculator", "Interactive pricing tool"),
        ("Clients / Properties / Leads", "The CRM"),
        ("Services", "The price list"),
        ("Quotes / Quote Lines", "What you quoted"),
        ("Jobs / Job Tasks", "The schedule and the checklists"),
        ("Calendar / Staff Schedule", "Who, where, when"),
        ("Checklists", "What each service includes"),
        ("Employees / Timesheets", "The team and their hours"),
        ("Job Costing", "True cost and profit per job"),
        ("Invoices / Invoice Lines / Payments", "Money in"),
        ("Supplies / Supply Usage / Equipment", "Stock and machines"),
        ("Expenses / Mileage", "Money out"),
        ("Client Retention / Complaints", "Keeping clients"),
        ("Incidents / Safety", "Keeping everyone safe"),
        ("Financial Plan", "Budget vs actuals, monthly plan"),
        ("Reports", "KPIs, rankings, monthly trend"),
        ("Print Quote / Invoice / Job Sheet", "Client-ready documents"),
        ("Lists / Help", "Drop-down sources and how-to"),
    ]
    ws.write(r - 1, 1, "Tab", fmts["label"])
    ws.merge_range(r - 1, 2, r - 1, 6, "What it does", fmts["label"])
    r += 1
    for tab, what in tabs:
        ws.write(r - 1, 1, tab, fmts["input"])
        ws.merge_range(r - 1, 2, r - 1, 6, what, fmts["input"])
        r += 1

    gap()
    section("Printable documents")
    line("Print Quote, Print Invoice and Print Job Sheet are client-ready "
         "one-pagers. Type a Quote #, Invoice # or Job # into the yellow "
         "cell at the top and the document builds itself. Set the print "
         "area to A1:F45 and print.")
    gap()
    line(f"© {cfg.author}  ·  {cfg.listing_title}", "note")

    ws.set_zoom(100)
    if cfg.protect_sheets:
        ws.protect(cfg.password, {
            "select_unlocked_cells": True,
            "select_locked_cells": True,
        })
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/supplies.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/supplies.py sha256:c76ce7c3e107fcbae70f711dce2476801db79955850059522bc733aa0b21541b -->
````python
"""The Supplies register - stock on the shelf."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Supplies")
    samples = sd.SUPPLIES if cfg.include_sample_data else []

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Item ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",'
                    '"SP-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"000"))'),
        Col("name", "Supply", 26, "text"),
        Col("category", "Category", 14, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "Chemicals", "Paper", "Equipment", "PPE", "Laundry",
                "Tools", "Other"]}),
        Col("unit", "Unit", 10, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": [
                "bottle", "liter", "gallon", "box", "pack", "each",
                "roll", "kg"]}),
        Col("supplier", "Supplier", 18, "text"),
        Col("cost_per_unit", "Cost / Unit", 12, "money",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("qty_on_hand", "Qty On Hand", 11, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("reorder_level", "Reorder Level", 11, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("reorder_qty", "Reorder Qty", 11, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("last_purchased", "Last Bought", 13, "date"),
        Col("days_left", "Days Left", 10, "decimal_locked",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",IFERROR(ROUND({qty_on_hand}{r}/'
                    '({used_month}{r}/30),0),""))',
            note="Rough days of stock left at this month's usage rate."),
        Col("used_month", "Used This Month", 12, "decimal_locked",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",'
                    'SUMIFS([[Supply Usage.qty]],[[Supply Usage.supply]],'
                    '{name}{r},[[Supply Usage.date]],">="&'
                    'DATE(YEAR(TODAY()),MONTH(TODAY()),1)))'),
        Col("used_cost", "Used Cost (Month)", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",'
                    'SUMIFS([[Supply Usage.total_cost]],'
                    '[[Supply Usage.supply]],{name}{r},'
                    '[[Supply Usage.date]],">="&'
                    'DATE(YEAR(TODAY()),MONTH(TODAY()),1)))'),
        Col("stock_value", "Stock Value", 13, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({qty_on_hand}{r}*{cost_per_unit}{r},2))'),
        Col("flag", "Reorder?", 11, "text_locked",
            formula='IF({name}{r}="","",IF({qty_on_hand}{r}<='
                    '{reorder_level}{r},"REORDER","OK"))'),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "text"),
    ]

    spec = SheetSpec(
        name="Supplies",
        title="Supplies & Stock",
        subtitle="What is on the shelf, what it cost, when to reorder. "
                 "Usage lands on the Supply Usage tab.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
    )
    spec.col("flag").cf = [
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "REORDER",
         "style": "warning"},
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "OK",
         "style": "good"},
    ]
    return spec
````

````python
"""Supply Usage - what each job used."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Supply Usage")
    samples = sd.SUPPLY_USAGE if cfg.include_sample_data else []

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Usage ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({supply}{r}="","",'
                    '"SU-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"0000"))'),
        Col("date", "Date", 13, "date",
            validate={"type": "date", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": "DATE(2020,1,1)",
                      "maximum": "DATE(2100,1,1)"}),
        Col("job_ref", "Job #", 13, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Jobs_Numbers",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("supply", "Supply", 24, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Supplies_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("qty", "Qty Used", 10, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100000}),
        Col("unit_cost", "Unit Cost", 11, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({supply}{r}="","",'
                    'IFERROR(INDEX([[Supplies.cost_per_unit]],'
                    'MATCH({supply}{r},[[Supplies.name]],0)),0))'),
        Col("total_cost", "Total Cost", 12, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({supply}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({qty}{r}*{unit_cost}{r},2))',
            note="Flows into the job's total cost and the supplies "
                 "expense category."),
        Col("employee", "Logged By", 16, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Employees_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "text"),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(
        name="Supply Usage",
        title="Supply Usage",
        subtitle="Every bottle, box and roll that leaves the store room, "
                 "tagged with the job it was used on.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
    )
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/timesheets.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/sheets/timesheets.py sha256:87c725f14c528798c6f20776ea95d0cbeca4b99904bdce6e4b5ba594f66881d4 -->
````python
"""Timesheets - hours worked, what they cost."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..formats import FormatBook
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec


def build_register(cfg: Config, fmts: FormatBook) -> SheetSpec:
    from .. import sample_data as sd

    rows = cfg.row_count("Timesheets")
    samples = sd.TIMESHEETS if cfg.include_sample_data else []

    columns = [
        Col("id", "Entry ID", 11, "text",
            formula='IF({employee}{r}="","",'
                    '"TS-"&TEXT(ROW()-4,"0000"))'),
        Col("date", "Date", 13, "date",
            validate={"type": "date", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": "DATE(2020,1,1)",
                      "maximum": "DATE(2100,1,1)"}),
        Col("employee", "Employee", 20, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Employees_Names",
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("job_ref", "Job #", 13, "text",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": "=Jobs_Numbers",
                      "ignore_blank": True},
            note="Leave blank for non-job time (training, travel)."),
        Col("start", "Start", 9, "time"),
        Col("end", "End", 9, "time"),
        Col("break_min", "Break (min)", 10, "int",
            validate={"type": "whole", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 240}),
        Col("hours", "Hours", 9, "decimal_locked",
            formula='IF(OR({start}{r}="",{end}{r}=""),"",'
                    'ROUND(({end}{r}-{start}{r})*24-{break_min}{r}/60,2))',
            note="Calculated from start, end and break."),
        Col("pay_rate", "Pay Rate", 11, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({employee}{r}="","",'
                    'IFERROR(INDEX([[Employees.hourly_pay]],'
                    'MATCH({employee}{r},[[Employees.name]],0)),""))'),
        Col("pay", "Pay", 12, "money_locked",
            formula='IF(OR({employee}{r}="",{hours}{r}=""),"",'
                    'ROUND({hours}{r}*{pay_rate}{r},2))'),
        Col("overtime", "Overtime Hrs", 11, "decimal",
            validate={"type": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                      "minimum": 0, "maximum": 16},
            note="Hours paid at the overtime multiplier."),
        Col("overtime_pay", "OT Pay", 11, "money_locked",
            formula='IF({overtime}{r}="","",'
                    'ROUND({overtime}{r}*{pay_rate}{r}*' +
                    str(cfg.overtime_multiplier) + ',2))'),
        Col("approved", "Approved", 10, "center",
            validate={"type": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No", ""]}),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "text"),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(
        name="Timesheets",
        title="Timesheets",
        subtitle="Hours in, pay out. Wages cost flows to Job Costing and "
                 "the Financial Plan through these rows.",
        columns=columns,
        rows=rows,
        samples=samples,
        tab_color=Palette.primary,
    )
````

### `23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/writer.py`

<!-- source-file: 23-cleaning-business-crm/cleaning_business_spreadsheet/writer.py sha256:b0d363cf08ffbf54f17dfef5f48b540f7e6bb961c4d84494cec3f6840e325cde -->
````python
"""Sheet writer.

Turns a :class:`~cleaning_business_spreadsheet.layout.SheetSpec` into a real
XlsxWriter worksheet: title band, header row, data rows (formulas resolved
through the :class:`~cleaning_business_spreadsheet.layout.Registry`),
validations, notes, conditional formats and the hide-away helper columns.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Tuple

from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from .layout import (DATA_ROW, HEADER_ROW, Col, Registry, SheetSpec,
                     cell_ref, quote_sheet)


class SheetWriter:
    """Writes register sheets from their specifications."""

    def __init__(self, workbook: Any, formats: Any, registry: Registry,
                 config: Any) -> None:
        self.wb = workbook
        self.fmts = formats
        self.reg = registry
        self.cfg = config

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ main
    def write_spec(self, spec: SheetSpec, samples: Optional[List[Dict]] = None
                   ) -> Any:
        ws = self.wb.add_worksheet(spec.name)
        if spec.tab_color:
            ws.set_tab_color(spec.tab_color)

        fmts = self.fmts
        ncols = len(spec.columns)
        end_col = max(ncols - 1, 0)

        # column widths / formats
        for i, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            style = fmts.formula_style(col) if col.is_formula else col.style
            ws.set_column(i, i, col.width, fmts[style])
            if col.hidden:
                ws.set_column(i, i, col.width, fmts[style], {"hidden": True})

        # title band + header
        fmts.title_band(ws, spec, end_col)
        fmts.header_row(ws, spec)

        # data rows
        samples = samples if samples is not None else spec.samples
        self._write_rows(ws, spec, samples)

        # data validation, notes, conditional formats
        self._apply_validations(ws, spec)
        self._apply_notes(ws, spec)
        self._apply_conditional_formats(ws, spec)

        # freeze panes + filters + gridlines
        freeze_row = spec.freeze_at or spec.first_data_row
        ws.freeze_panes(freeze_row - 1, spec.freeze_cols)
        ws.autofilter(spec.header_row - 1, 0,
                      spec.last_data_row - 1, end_col)
        ws.hide_gridlines(2)
        ws.set_default_row(16)
        if self.cfg.protect_sheets:
            ws.protect(self.cfg.password, {
                "select_unlocked_cells": True,
                "select_locked_cells": True,
                "autofilter": True,
                "sort": True,
            })
        return ws

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- data rows
    def _write_rows(self, ws: Any, spec: SheetSpec,
                    samples: List[Dict]) -> None:
        fmts, reg = self.fmts, self.reg
        first = spec.first_data_row
        n_cols = len(spec.columns)

        for offset in range(spec.rows):
            r = first + offset                    # 1-based Excel row
            xr = r - 1                            # 0-based xlsxwriter row
            sample = samples[offset] if offset < len(samples) else None
            banded = (offset % 2 == 1)

            for i, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
                if col.is_formula:
                    formula = reg.render(col.formula, row=r, spec=spec)
                    style = fmts.formula_style(col)
                    # cache a numeric 0 - NEVER None: xlsxwriter would write
                    # <v>None</v> into a numeric cell and Excel's recovery
                    # reports "Repaired Records: Cell information".
                    ws.write_formula(xr, i, formula, fmts[style], 0)
                    continue

                style = col.style
                value = None
                if sample:
                    value = sample.get(col.key)
                fmt = fmts[style]
                if value is None:
                    ws.write_blank(xr, i, None, fmt)
                elif isinstance(value, bool):
                    ws.write_boolean(xr, i, value, fmt)
                elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                    ws.write_number(xr, i, value, fmt)
                else:
                    ws.write(xr, i, value, fmt)
            del banded

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ validation
    def _apply_validations(self, ws: Any, spec: SheetSpec) -> None:
        reg = self.reg
        first, last = spec.first_data_row, spec.last_data_row
        for i, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            if col.is_formula or not col.validate:
                continue
            v = dict(col.validate)
            dtype = v.pop("type", None)
            if dtype is None:
                continue
            cell_area = (first - 1, i, last - 1, i)
            params: Dict[str, Any] = {"validate": dtype}
            params.update(v)
            # resolve [[...]] tokens inside criteria ranges
            for key in ("source", "minimum", "maximum", "criteria"):
                val = params.get(key)
                if isinstance(val, str) and "[[" in val:
                    params[key] = reg.render(val, spec=spec)
            ws.data_validation(*cell_area, params)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ notes
    def _apply_notes(self, ws: Any, spec: SheetSpec) -> None:
        header = spec.header_row - 1
        for i, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            if col.note:
                ws.write_comment(header, i, col.note,
                                 {"author": self.cfg.author,
                                  "width": 320, "height": 120})

    # -------------------------------------------------- conditional formats
    def _apply_conditional_formats(self, ws: Any, spec: SheetSpec) -> None:
        fmts, reg = self.fmts, self.reg
        first, last = spec.first_data_row, spec.last_data_row
        for i, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            for rule in col.cf:
                params = dict(rule)
                kind = params.pop("type", "text")
                style = fmts[params.pop("style")]
                area = (first - 1, i, last - 1, i)
                if kind == "text":
                    ws.conditional_format(*area, {
                        "type": "text",
                        "criteria": params.pop("criteria"),
                        "value": params.pop("value"),
                        "format": style})
                elif kind == "cell":
                    value = params.pop("value")
                    if isinstance(value, str) and "[[" in value:
                        value = reg.render(value, spec=spec)
                    ws.conditional_format(*area, {
                        "type": "cell",
                        "criteria": params.pop("criteria"),
                        "value": value,
                        "format": style})
                elif kind == "formula":
                    criteria = params.pop("criteria")
                    ws.conditional_format(*area, {
                        "type": "formula",
                        "criteria": reg.render(criteria, first, spec),
                        "format": style})


def write_title_band(ws: Any, fmts: Any, title: str, subtitle: str,
                     end_col: int, *, subtitle_row: int = 2) -> None:
    """Standalone title band for hand built (non register) sheets."""
    ws.merge_range(0, 0, 0, end_col, title, fmts["title"])
    ws.set_row(0, 30)
    ws.merge_range(subtitle_row, 0, subtitle_row, end_col, subtitle,
                   fmts["subtitle"])
    ws.set_row(subtitle_row, 18)
    ws.hide_gridlines(2)
````
