### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/batches.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/batches.py sha256:1aa80fab3fc8b3322ecd75275d0eb80364fae7453d7a60f63d540b80cfe5941a -->
````python
"""The Batches tab - what a run of making actually cost.

A batch is the honest check on a catalog cost. The Products tab says what one
item *should* cost from the bill of materials and the standard minutes; this
tab says what the run of twelve actually cost, including the jar that cracked,
the board that warped and the extra hour the finishing took.

`material_variance` is the difference between the two, and `cost_check` says
whether the batch came out above or below the catalog figure. A batch that
keeps coming out above is a bill of materials that is wrong, a supplier price
that moved, or a defect rate that is higher than the one on Settings - all
three are worth knowing before the price is set from the wrong number.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, craft_packaging, date_col, fetch, id_col,
                     int_col, money_col, num_col, other, product_col,
                     rank_desc, row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, sumifs,
                     wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Batches"

SUBTITLE = ("Runs of making: what a batch cost, what one item came out at, "
            "and how that compares with the catalog cost.")

HELP = ("One row per run. Type what the materials cost and how long it took; "
        "the labour, overhead and packaging are calculated, and so is the "
        "cost of one sellable item once the defects are taken out.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    bid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{bid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    planned = f"N({row_ref('qty_planned')})"
    done = f"N({row_ref('qty_done')})"
    defect = f"N({row_ref('qty_defect')})"
    sellable = f"({done}-{defect})"
    minutes = f"N({row_ref('labor_minutes')})"
    labor_cost = f"{minutes}/60*LaborCostHour"
    packaging = craft_packaging(product)
    batch_cost = (f'N({row_ref("material_cost")})+{labor_cost}'
                  f'+N({row_ref("overhead")})+N({row_ref("packaging_cost")})')
    sold_since = sumifs(other("Sales", "qty"),
                        [(other("Sales", "product"), product),
                         (other("Sales", "date"),
                          '">="&N(' + row_ref("started") + ')')])

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixBatch", trigger="product", width=11.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        calc_col("craft", "Craft",
                 f'IF({product}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "craft", product)})',
                 13.0, "text"),
        date_col("started", "Started", 13.0),
        date_col("finished", "Finished", 13.0),
        calc_col("days_taken", "Days taken",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("started")}="",'
                 f'{row_ref("finished")}=""),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("finished")})-N({row_ref("started")}))',
                 11.0, "int"),
        int_col("qty_planned", "Planned", 10.0),
        int_col("qty_done", "Made", 10.0),
        int_col("qty_defect", "Defects", 10.0,
                note="Pieces that cannot be sold: cracks, warping, missed "
                     "stitches, failed test burns."),
        calc_col("qty_sellable", "Sellable",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{sellable})', 10.0, "int"),
        calc_col("completion", "Made of planned",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({planned}=0,"",{done}/{planned}))',
                 12.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("defect_rate", "Defect rate",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({done}=0,"",{defect}/{done}))', 11.0,
                 "percent"),
        calc_col("defect_flag", "Defect check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("defect_rate")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("defect_rate")})>DefaultDefect,'
                 f'"ABOVE THE TARGET",IF({defect}=0,"CLEAN","OK")))',
                 17.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ABOVE", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "CLEAN", "fmt": "good"}]),
        money_col("material_cost", "Materials (typed)", 13.0,
                  note="What the materials for this batch really cost."),
        calc_col("expected_material", "Materials (expected)",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{planned}*'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "material_cost", product, "0")})',
                 13.0, "money",
                 note="Planned units times the catalog material cost."),
        calc_col("material_variance", "Variance",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("material_cost")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("expected_material")}))', 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        num_col("labor_minutes", "Minutes (whole batch)", 13.0),
        calc_col("minutes_a_unit", "Minutes an item",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({sellable}<=0,"",{minutes}/{sellable}))',
                 12.0, "number1"),
        calc_col("labor_cost", "Labour cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{labor_cost})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("overhead", "Overhead",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(OverheadMethod="Per hour",'
                 f'{minutes}/60*OverheadPerHour,'
                 f'IF(OverheadMethod="Per unit",'
                 f'IF({sellable}<=0,0,{sellable}*OverheadPerUnit),'
                 f'IF(UnitsPerMonth<=0,0,'
                 f'{sellable}*OverheadMonthly/UnitsPerMonth))))', 12.0,
                 "money", note="Spread the way Settings says."),
        calc_col("packaging_cost", "Packaging",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({sellable}<=0,0,{sellable}*{packaging}))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("batch_cost", "Batch cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{batch_cost})', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("cost_per_unit", "Cost an item",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({sellable}<=0,"",{batch_cost}/{sellable}))',
                 13.0, "money",
                 note="The real cost of one sellable item from this run."),
        calc_col("catalog_cost", "Catalog cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{fetch("Products", "id", "total_cost", product, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money",
                 note="What the Products tab thinks one item costs."),
        calc_col("cost_check", "Cost check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("cost_per_unit")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("cost_per_unit")})>'
                 f'N({row_ref("catalog_cost")})*1.05,'
                 f'"BATCH COSTS MORE THAN CATALOG",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("cost_per_unit")})<'
                 f'N({row_ref("catalog_cost")})*0.95,'
                 f'"CHEAPER THAN CATALOG","MATCHES")))', 26.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "MORE THAN", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "CHEAPER", "fmt": "info"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "MATCHES", "fmt": "good"}]),
        int_col("cure_days", "Cure / rest days", 12.0,
                note="Candles cure, glue and oil dry, dye sets."),
        calc_col("ready_date", "Ready to sell",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("finished")}=""),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("finished")})+N({row_ref("cure_days")}))',
                 13.0, "date"),
        calc_col("sold_since", "Sold since it started", sold_since, 12.0,
                 "int"),
        calc_col("left_from_batch", "Left from this batch",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({sellable}<=0,"",'
                 f'{sellable}-N({row_ref("sold_since")})))', 13.0, "int"),
        calc_col("rank_cost", "rank cost", rank_desc("cost_per_unit"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/break_even.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/break_even.py sha256:0334ce7a3280f11535b4ee6e07ef81c60b29f65b8ee2c4774ef3b50236cf70f8 -->
````python
"""The Profit & Break-Even tab.

How many of a product you have to sell before the month pays for itself. The
arithmetic is the one that matters for a one person shop:

    contribution an item = price - channel fees - unit cost
    break even units     = fixed costs a month / contribution an item

Fixed costs here are the real ones - the overhead total, every subscription on
the Channels tab, the shop time recorded on the Labor tab that is not on one
product, and any marketing you type in. Variable costs are the ones that move
with each sale.

`margin of safety` is how far sales can fall before the month goes under, and
the sensitivity strip at the bottom shows what a 10% price cut or a 10% cost
rise does to the break even number - usually more than people expect.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from ..config import VOLUME_STEPS, Config, Palette
from ..layout import lookup
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from .common import channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, other

P = Palette

NAME = "Profit & Break-Even"

SUBTITLE = ("How many you have to sell to cover the month, and what different "
            "volumes earn.")

HELP = ("Pick a product. Its price, cost and fees arrive from the catalog; "
        "the fixed costs arrive from Overhead, Channels and Labor. Type a "
        "marketing spend if you have one.")


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=True)
    last_col = 13
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col, badge="Break-even")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 2, 30.0)
    sheet.set_col(3, 4, 15.0)
    sheet.set_col(5, last_col, 13.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    def f(row: int, label: str, *, formula: Optional[str] = None,
          value: Any = None, name: Optional[str] = None, style: str = "text",
          input_cell: bool = False, validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
          help_text: str = "") -> int:
        return sheet.field(row, label, value, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                           value_end=4, style=style,
                           mode="input" if input_cell else "calc",
                           name=name, validate=validate,
                           help_text=help_text, help_col=5, formula=formula)

    prod = lambda key: lookup("BeProduct", other("Products", "id"),
                              other("Products", key))
    channel_of = f'IFERROR({prod("channel")},DefaultChannel)'
    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=30)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- the product
    r = sheet.section(r, "1. The product", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Product", name="BeProduct", input_cell=True,
          validate=list_from("ProductIDs"))
    r = f(r, "Product name", formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("name")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Price", name="BePrice", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("retail_price")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Cost of one item", name="BeUnitCost", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("total_cost")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Minutes an item", name="BeMinutes", style="number1",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("minutes_used")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Fee rate", name="BeFeeRate", style="percent",
          formula=f"={channel_fee_rate(channel_of)}")
    r = f(r, "Fixed fees an order", name="BeFixedFees", style="money",
          formula=f"={channel_fixed_fee(channel_of)}")
    r = sheet.field(r, "Contribution an item", None, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                    value_end=4, style="money", name="BeContribution",
                    formula="=IF(N(BePrice)=0,0,N(BePrice)"
                            "-(N(BeFeeRate)*N(BePrice)+N(BeFixedFees))"
                            "-N(BeUnitCost))",
                    help_text="Price less the channel fees less the cost. "
                              "This is what each sale puts towards the fixed "
                              "costs.")
    r = _rule(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    r = f(r, "Contribution margin", style="percent",
          formula='=IF(N(BePrice)=0,"",N(BeContribution)/N(BePrice))')
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ fixed costs
    r = sheet.section(r, "2. What the month costs whatever you sell",
                      last_col)
    r = f(r, "Overhead a month", name="BeOverhead", style="money",
          formula="=OverheadMonthly",
          help_text="The allocated rows of the Overhead tab.")
    r = f(r, "Subscriptions a month", name="BeSubscriptions", style="money",
          formula=f"=IFERROR(SUM({other('Channels', 'subscription')}),0)")
    r = f(r, "Shop time this month", name="BeShopTime", style="money",
          formula=(f"=IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Labor', 'overhead_share')},"
                   f"{other('Labor', 'date')},\">=\"&MonthStart,"
                   f"{other('Labor', 'date')},\"<=\"&MonthEnd),0)"),
          help_text="Hours on the Labor tab with no product against them.")
    r = f(r, "Marketing this month", name="BeMarketing", style="money",
          input_cell=True, value=0,
          help_text="Ads, a photographer, a fair table fee - anything you "
                    "spend to get sales.")
    r = sheet.field(r, "Fixed costs a month", None, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                    value_end=4, style="money", name="BeFixed",
                    formula="=N(BeOverhead)+N(BeSubscriptions)"
                            "+N(BeShopTime)+N(BeMarketing)")
    r = _rule(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- break even
    r = sheet.section(r, "3. Break-even", last_col)
    r = sheet.field(r, "Units to break even", None, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                    value_end=4, style="int", name="BeUnits",
                    formula='=IF(N(BeContribution)<=0,"NEVER - IT DOES NOT '
                            'CONTRIBUTE",ROUNDUP(N(BeFixed)'
                            '/N(BeContribution),0))',
                    help_text="Fixed costs divided by the contribution an item.")
    r = _rule(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    r = f(r, "Revenue at break-even", name="BeRevenue", style="money",
          formula='=IF(N(BeUnits)=0,"",N(BeUnits)*N(BePrice))')
    r = f(r, "Hours at break-even", style="number",
          formula='=IF(N(BeUnits)=0,"",N(BeUnits)*N(BeMinutes)/60)',
          help_text="How much of your month that is, at the productive hours "
                    "on Settings.")
    r = f(r, "Share of your productive hours", style="percent",
          formula='=IF(OR(N(BeUnits)=0,ProductiveHours<=0),"",'
                  'N(BeUnits)*N(BeMinutes)/60/ProductiveHours)')
    r = f(r, "Sold this month", name="BeUnitsNow", style="int",
          formula=(f"=IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'qty')},"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'product')},BeProduct,"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&MonthStart,"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&MonthEnd),0)"))
    r = f(r, "Profit this month", name="BeProfitNow", style="money",
          formula="=N(BeUnitsNow)*N(BeContribution)-N(BeFixed)")
    r = f(r, "Margin of safety", name="BeSafety", style="percent",
          formula='=IF(N(BeUnitsNow)=0,"",(N(BeUnitsNow)-N(BeUnits))'
                  '/N(BeUnitsNow))',
          help_text="How far sales can fall before the month goes under.")
    r = f(r, "Verdict", style="text",
          formula='=IF(N(BeUnitsNow)=0,"NOTHING SOLD YET",'
                  'IF(N(BeProfitNow)>=MonthlyProfitTarget,"ABOVE THE PROFIT '
                  'TARGET",IF(N(BeProfitNow)>=0,"COVERING ITS COSTS",'
                  'IF(N(BeUnitsNow)>=N(BeUnits)*0.75,"CLOSE - PUSH A LITTLE '
                  'MORE","NOT COVERING THE MONTH"))))')
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- volume table
    r = sheet.section(r, "4. What different volumes earn in a month", last_col)
    headers = ["Units", "Revenue", "Fees", "Cost of goods", "Contribution",
               "Profit"]
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    for i, head in enumerate(headers):
        col = 1 + i * 2
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    volumes = list(VOLUME_STEPS) + ["Break-even", "Sold this month"]
    for step in volumes:
        units = (f"N(BeUnits)" if step == "Break-even"
                 else f"N(BeUnitsNow)" if step == "Sold this month"
                 else str(step))
        revenue = f"N(BePrice)*{units}"
        fees = f"N(BeFeeRate)*{revenue}+N(BeFixedFees)*{units}"
        cogs = f"N(BeUnitCost)*{units}"
        contribution = f"N(BeContribution)*{units}"
        profit = f"{contribution}-N(BeFixed)"
        sheet.row_height(r, 18)
        label = str(step)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 2, "", fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f"={units}", fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
        for i, formula in enumerate([revenue, fees, cogs, contribution,
                                     profit]):
            col = 3 + i * 2
            sheet.ws.merge_range(r, col, r, col + 1, "",
                                 fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
            sheet.formula(r, col, "=" + formula,
                                   fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.conditional_format(
            r, 11, r, 12,
            {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
             "format": fmts.cf("bold_bad")})
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- sensitivity
    r = sheet.section(r, "5. What changes the break-even number", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    for i, head in enumerate(["If this happens", "Contribution",
                              "Units to break even", "Change"]):
        col = 1 + i * 3
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 2, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    cases = [
        ("As it stands", "N(BePrice)", "N(BeUnitCost)"),
        ("Price 10% lower", "N(BePrice)*0.9", "N(BeUnitCost)"),
        ("Price 10% higher", "N(BePrice)*1.1", "N(BeUnitCost)"),
        ("Costs 10% higher", "N(BePrice)", "N(BeUnitCost)*1.1"),
        ("Costs 10% lower", "N(BePrice)", "N(BeUnitCost)*0.9"),
        ("Both go against you", "N(BePrice)*0.9", "N(BeUnitCost)*1.1"),
    ]
    for label, price, cost in cases:
        contribution = (f"({price}-(N(BeFeeRate)*{price}+N(BeFixedFees))"
                        f"-{cost})")
        units = (f'IF({contribution}<=0,"NEVER",'
                 f'ROUNDUP(N(BeFixed)/{contribution},0))')
        sheet.row_height(r, 18)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 3, label, fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 4, r, 6, "", fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 4, "=" + contribution,
                               fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 7, r, 9, "", fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 7, "=" + units, fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 10, r, 12, "", fmts.cell("percent", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(
            r, 10, f'=IFERROR(IF(N(BeUnits)=0,"",{units}/N(BeUnits)-1),"")',
            fmts.cell("percent", "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1
    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "Read the last column as 'how many more I would have to sell'. A 10% "
        "price cut on a product with a thin contribution typically asks for "
        "half as many sales again - which is why discounting is a volume "
        "decision before it is a marketing one.",
        last_col, height=44)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(4, 0)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def _rule(sheet, fmts, row: int, first_col: int, last_col: int) -> int:
    """Rule under a total, drawn on the blank row below it. Returns the next
    free row so the total above is never overwritten."""
    sheet.row_height(row, 7)
    for col in range(first_col, last_col + 1):
        sheet.ws.write_blank(row, col, None, fmts.chrome("rule"))
    return row + 1
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/bundle_lines.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/bundle_lines.py sha256:47901741b64869c0c9f0707cec4c9911cbbf0d76abd7677f73eb127c6b34645d -->
````python
"""The Bundle Lines tab - what is actually inside each bundle.

One row per product per bundle. The unit price comes off the Products tab (or
from `price_override` when a part is priced specially inside the set), the unit
cost comes off the same row, and the Bundles tab adds the lines up to get the
list price, the real cost and the profit of the set.

`line_profit` is the column that catches a bad bundle: a part that loses money
on its own loses money inside the set too, and discounting on top of it makes
it worse.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from ..writer import list_from
from .common import (calc_col, fetch, id_col, int_col, money_col, product_col,
                     row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, wrap_col)
from ..layout import Col

P = Palette

NAME = "Bundle Lines"

SUBTITLE = ("What is inside each bundle, at what price and at what cost.")

HELP = ("Pick the bundle, pick a product, type the quantity. The price and the "
        "cost arrive from the Products tab; Bundles adds the lines together.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    lid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{lid}=""'
    bundle = row_ref("bundle")
    product = row_ref("product")
    qty = f"N({row_ref('qty')})"
    unit_price = f"N({row_ref('unit_price')})"
    unit_cost = f"N({row_ref('unit_cost')})"

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixBundleLine", trigger="product", width=11.0),
        Col(key="bundle", header="Bundle ID", width=12.0, style="id",
            validate=list_from("BundleIDs"),
            note="Which bundle this line belongs to."),
        calc_col("bundle_name", "Bundle",
                 f'IF({bundle}="","",{fetch("Bundles", "id", "name", bundle)})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 28.0, "text"),
        calc_col("product_active", "Sellable?",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "active", product)})', 10.0,
                 "flag",
                 note="A bundle cannot sell a product that is not active.",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "No", "fmt": "warn"}]),
        int_col("qty", "Qty in the set", 11.0),
        money_col("price_override", "Special price", 12.0,
                  note="Type a price for this part inside the set and it "
                       "beats the catalog price."),
        calc_col("unit_price", "Unit price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("price_override")})>0,'
                 f'N({row_ref("price_override")}),'
                 f'IFERROR(INDEX([[Products.retail_price]],'
                 f'MATCH({product},[[Products.id]],0)),0)))', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("line_total", "Line total",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{qty}*{unit_price})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("unit_cost", "Unit cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{fetch("Products", "id", "total_cost", product, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("line_cost", "Line cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{qty}*{unit_cost})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("line_profit", "Line profit",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{qty}*({unit_price}-{unit_cost}))', 12.0,
                 "money",
                 note="Before the bundle discount and the channel fees.",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/bundles.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/bundles.py sha256:9623c6c7523bb89a9eb1c7ab1f2ddc735ac915141e8efc13ce0461119dc2f711 -->
````python
"""The Bundles tab - kits, sets and gift boxes.

A bundle is priced here, not guessed: the parts are listed on Bundle Lines, the
list price is what they would cost separately, and the bundle price is what the
customer pays for the set. The tab works out the discount that implies, what
the parts actually cost, the fees the channel takes, and whether the bundle
still clears the target margin.

This is where "a nice little discount" turns out to be a loss. The example shop
has one: a candle and a scarf bundled at 84, where the scarf on its own is
already priced below cost - the flag column says LOSS and the Dashboard lists
it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (FLAG_LOSS, calc_col, channel_fee_rate,
                     channel_fixed_fee, countifs, date_col, id_col, int_col,
                     list_col, money_col, other, pct_col, rank_desc,
                     raw_price_col, review_flag, round_ref, row_ref,
                     round_price, samples, spec_defaults, sumifs, text_col,
                     wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Bundles"

SUBTITLE = ("Kits, sets and gift boxes: what the parts cost, what the bundle "
            "sells for and whether it still makes money.")

HELP = ("Name the bundle, list its parts on the Bundle Lines tab and type the "
        "bundle price. The list price arrives from the parts; the discount, "
        "the fees, the profit and the price your margin asks for are all "
        "calculated here.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    bid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{bid}=""'
    chan = (f'IF({row_ref("channel")}="",DefaultChannel,'
            f'{row_ref("channel")})')
    rate = channel_fee_rate(chan)
    fixed = channel_fixed_fee(chan)
    bundle_price = f"N({row_ref('bundle_price')})"
    cost = (f'N({row_ref("parts_cost")})+N({row_ref("packaging_cost")})'
            f'+N({row_ref("shipping_absorbed")})')
    profit = f'{bundle_price}-({rate}*{bundle_price}+{fixed})-{cost}'
    # rounding repeats its argument eight times, so the unrounded model price
    # gets its own hidden cell rather than being inlined eight times
    suggested = round_ref(row_ref("price_raw"))
    wholesale_base = f"{bundle_price}*(1-WholesaleDiscount)"
    products = row_ref("products")

    line_total = sumifs(other("Bundle Lines", "line_total"),
                        [(other("Bundle Lines", "bundle"), bid)])
    line_cost = sumifs(other("Bundle Lines", "line_cost"),
                       [(other("Bundle Lines", "bundle"), bid)])
    line_count = countifs([(other("Bundle Lines", "bundle"), bid)])

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixBundle", trigger="name", width=11.0),
        text_col("name", "Bundle", 32.0,
                 note="What the set is called. Filling this in starts the row."),
        text_col("products", "Parts (IDs)", 26.0,
                 note="Product IDs separated by commas - a reminder of what "
                      "is in the set. The money comes from Bundle Lines."),
        calc_col("product_count", "Parts listed",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({products}="",0,'
                 f'LEN({products})-LEN(SUBSTITUTE({products},",",""))+1))',
                 11.0, "int"),
        yesno_col("active", "On sale?", 10.0),
        list_col("channel", "Channel", "ChannelList", 15.0),
        calc_col("line_count", "Lines on the tab", line_count, 11.0, "int",
                 note="How many rows the Bundle Lines tab holds for this set."),
        calc_col("list_price", "Parts separately",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{line_total})', 13.0, "money",
                 note="What the parts would cost bought one at a time."),
        money_col("bundle_price", "Bundle price", 13.0,
                  note="What the customer pays for the set."),
        calc_col("savings_for_customer", "Customer saves",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("list_price")})-{bundle_price})',
                 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("discount", "Discount",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("list_price")})=0,"",'
                 f'1-{bundle_price}/N({row_ref("list_price")})))', 11.0,
                 "percent"),
        calc_col("discount_check", "Discount check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("discount")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("discount")})>DefaultDiscount*2,'
                 f'"DEEP DISCOUNT",IF(N({row_ref("discount")})<0,'
                 f'"COSTS MORE THAN THE PARTS","OK")))', 20.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DEEP", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "COSTS MORE", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("parts_cost", "Cost of the parts",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{line_cost})', 13.0, "money",
                 note="What the parts cost you, from the Products tab."),
        money_col("packaging_cost", "Extra packaging", 13.0,
                  note="A gift box or ribbon that only the bundle needs."),
        money_col("shipping_absorbed", "Postage absorbed", 13.0,
                  note="Sets are heavier - type what you pay to send one."),
        calc_col("cost", "Total cost", f'IF({has_id},"",{cost})', 13.0,
                 "money"),
        calc_col("fee_rate", "Channel fee rate",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{rate})', 11.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("fixed_fees", "Fixed fees",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{fixed})', 11.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fees", "Fees",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{rate}*{bundle_price}+{fixed})', 12.0,
                 "money"),
        calc_col("profit", "Profit a bundle",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({bundle_price}=0,"",{profit}))', 13.0,
                 "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("margin", "Margin",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({bundle_price}=0,"",{profit}/{bundle_price}))',
                 10.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("margin_flag", "Flag",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({bundle_price}=0,"",'
                 f'IF({profit}<=0,"{FLAG_LOSS}",'
                 f'IF({profit}/{bundle_price}<MarginWarning,"THIN","OK"))))',
                 9.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": FLAG_LOSS, "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "THIN", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        raw_price_col(cost, fixed, "TargetRetailMargin", rate, guard=has_id),
        calc_col("suggested_price", "Suggested bundle price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{suggested})', 14.0, "money",
                 note="(cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee rate)."),
        calc_col("price_gap", "Gap to suggested",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{bundle_price}=0),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("suggested_price")})-{bundle_price})', 13.0,
                 "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("wholesale_price", "Wholesale price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{round_price(wholesale_base)})', 13.0,
                 "money",
                 note="The bundle price less the trade discount on Settings."),
        date_col("reviewed", "Last review", 13.0),
        calc_col("next_review", "Next review due",
                 f'IF({row_ref("reviewed")}="","",'
                 f'N({row_ref("reviewed")})+PriceReviewDays)', 13.0, "date"),
        calc_col("review_flag", "Review",
                 review_flag("next_review", "reviewed"), 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OVERDUE", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DUE SOON", "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("rank_margin", "rank margin", rank_desc("margin"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    """Shade a bundle row that loses money."""
    spec_obj = reg[NAME]
    flag = spec_obj.letter("margin_flag")
    first = spec_obj.first_data_row
    last = spec_obj.last_data_row
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(
        first - 1, 0, last - 1, spec_obj.last_col_index,
        {"type": "formula", "criteria": f'${flag}{first}="{FLAG_LOSS}"',
         "format": fmts.cf("bad")})
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/candles.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/candles.py sha256:65519c22c5f171c8941ed1975f9cc8d76caf182a547079bfeb26d4da823927c0 -->
````python
"""The Candles calculator.

Candles are costed by the pour, not by the jar: you type the wax in the
melting pot, the fragrance load, the wicks and vessels, and how many jars the
pour made. The tab divides the pour back down to one jar and costs it - wax,
fragrance at the load you actually use, wick, vessel - then adds the minutes a
jar takes.

`fragrance_oz_item` is worked out from the wax weight (pounds to ounces, then
the load percentage). If you weigh in grams, or buy fragrance by the drop,
type the cost straight into `fragrance_override` and it wins.

`cure_days`, the pour and melt temperatures and the burn hours are here because
they are the numbers a candle buyer asks about and a recall needs - they do not
feed the cost.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, craft_tail, date_col, fetch, id_col, int_col,
                     material_col, money_col, num_col, pct_col, product_col,
                     row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Candles"

SUBTITLE = ("Candles: one pour costed down to a single jar, with the cure "
            "times and burn figures you need on the label.")

HELP = ("Type the wax in the pot, the fragrance load, the wicks and vessels, "
        "and how many jars the pour made. The cost of one jar and the price "
        "your margin asks for are worked out to the right.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    cid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{cid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    wax = row_ref("wax")
    fragrance = row_ref("fragrance")
    wick = row_ref("wick")
    vessel = row_ref("vessel")
    batch = f"N({row_ref('batch_qty')})"
    wax_lb = f"N({row_ref('wax_lb')})"
    load = f"N({row_ref('fragrance_pct')})"

    batch_col = calc_col(
        "batch_qty", "Jars in the pour",
        f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("batch_size")})=0,DefaultBatchSize,'
        f'N({row_ref("batch_size")})))', 12.0, "int",
        note="How many jars one pour makes. Blank uses the default on "
             "Settings.")

    material_expr = (f'N({row_ref("wax_cost_item")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("fragrance_cost_item")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("wick_cost")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("vessel_cost")})')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixCandle", trigger="blend", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date poured", 13.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        text_col("blend", "Blend / scent", 26.0,
                 note="What you poured. Filling this in starts the row."),
        material_col("wax", "Wax ID", 12.0,
                     note="The wax as it is listed on the Materials tab."),
        calc_col("wax_name", "Wax",
                 f'IF({wax}="","",{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", wax)})',
                 26.0, "text"),
        calc_col("wax_unit_cost", "Wax cost a unit",
                 f'IF({wax}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", wax, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4"),
        num_col("wax_lb", "Wax in the pot", 12.0,
                note="Total wax melted for this pour, in the unit the "
                     "material is bought in (lb for the example shop)."),
        material_col("fragrance", "Fragrance ID", 12.0),
        calc_col("fragrance_name", "Fragrance",
                 f'IF({fragrance}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", fragrance)})', 26.0,
                 "text"),
        calc_col("fragrance_unit_cost", "Fragrance cost a unit",
                 f'IF({fragrance}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", fragrance, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4"),
        pct_col("fragrance_pct", "Fragrance load", 11.0,
                note="Percentage of the wax weight - 8% is typical for soy."),
        material_col("wick", "Wick ID", 12.0),
        calc_col("wick_cost", "Wick cost a jar",
                 f'IF({wick}="",0,{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", wick, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4"),
        material_col("vessel", "Vessel ID", 12.0),
        calc_col("vessel_name", "Vessel",
                 f'IF({vessel}="","",{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", vessel)})',
                 24.0, "text"),
        money_col("vessel_cost", "Vessel cost a jar", 13.0,
                  note="Jar plus lid for ONE item - a trio gift set costs "
                       "three of them."),
        num_col("batch_size", "Jars poured", 11.0,
                note="How many jars came out of this pour."),
        num_col("minutes_per_pour", "Minutes a jar", 12.0,
                note="Wicking, pouring, labelling and cleaning up, per jar."),
        calc_col("minutes", "Minutes used",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("minutes_per_pour")}))', 11.0,
                 "number1", note="What the cost columns use."),
        calc_col("wax_per_item", "Wax a jar",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({batch}=0,"",{wax_lb}/{batch}))',
                 11.0, "number"),
        calc_col("wax_cost_item", "Wax cost a jar",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("wax_per_item")})'
                 f'*N({row_ref("wax_unit_cost")}))', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fragrance_oz_item", "Fragrance a jar",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("wax_per_item")})*16*{load})',
                 12.0, "number",
                 note="Wax weight in ounces times the load. Assumes the wax "
                      "is weighed in pounds."),
        money_col("fragrance_override", "Fragrance cost (typed)", 13.0,
                  note="Type a cost here and it beats the calculated one."),
        calc_col("fragrance_cost_item", "Fragrance cost a jar",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("fragrance_override")})>0,'
                 f'N({row_ref("fragrance_override")}),'
                 f'N({row_ref("fragrance_oz_item")})'
                 f'*N({row_ref("fragrance_unit_cost")})))', 13.0, "money"),
        int_col("cure_days", "Cure days", 10.0,
                note="How long the jar rests before it burns properly."),
        int_col("pour_temp", "Pour temp (F)", 11.0),
        int_col("melt_temp", "Melt temp (F)", 11.0),
        num_col("burn_hours", "Burn hours", 10.0,
                note="Total burn time - goes on the listing."),
        money_col("price", "Price today", 12.0),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]
    cols += craft_tail(material_expr, has_difficulty=False,
                       batch_col=batch_col)

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/channels.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/channels.py sha256:a02528fcd89c092eb01e97bd9b4bb7899a5927a113bda782db188e9e2c01e18b -->
````python
"""The Channels tab - what each place you sell charges you.

Etsy, your own website, a craft fair, wholesale: every channel has its own fee
structure, and pricing without it is guesswork. Each row carries the listing
fee, the transaction percentage, payment processing, the ad fee and the share
of orders ads actually bring, plus the small regulatory and currency fees.

`total_rate` is the percentage a channel takes, `fee_on_100` shows what that
means on a 100 order, and `ads_effective` is the one the Products tab uses -
the ad percentage times the share of orders that come from ads, which is zero
when ads are switched off. The three trading columns at the right count this
month's orders, revenue and fees straight off the Sales tab, so `effective_rate`
is what the channel really charged rather than what its schedule says.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, int_col, list_col, money_col, other, pct_col,
                     row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, sumifs, text_col,
                     wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Channels"

SUBTITLE = ("Marketplace and channel fees: what each place you sell really "
            "takes, and what it took this month.")

HELP = ("Keep the fee schedule current - these numbers move. 'Fee on a 100 "
        "order' is the quickest way to compare two channels. Check the "
        "schedule against the effective rate the Sales tab reports; if they "
        "differ, one of them is out of date.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    cname = row_ref("name")
    has_name = f'{cname}=""'
    transaction = f"N({row_ref('transaction_pct')})"
    processing = f"N({row_ref('processing_pct')})"
    proc_fixed = f"N({row_ref('processing_fixed')})"
    listing = f"N({row_ref('listing_fee')})"
    regulatory = f"N({row_ref('regulatory_fee')})"
    currency = f"N({row_ref('currency_fee')})"
    ads = f"N({row_ref('ads_effective')})"
    total_rate = f"({transaction}+{processing}+{regulatory}+{currency}+{ads})"
    fee_on_100 = f"(100*{total_rate}+{listing}+{proc_fixed})"

    month_orders = (f'IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other("Sales", "channel")},{cname},'
                    f'{other("Sales", "date")},">="&MonthStart,'
                    f'{other("Sales", "date")},"<="&MonthEnd),0)')
    month_revenue = sumifs(other("Sales", "gross"),
                           [(other("Sales", "channel"), cname),
                            (other("Sales", "date"), '">="&MonthStart'),
                            (other("Sales", "date"), '"<="&MonthEnd')])
    month_fees = sumifs(other("Sales", "fees"),
                        [(other("Sales", "channel"), cname),
                         (other("Sales", "date"), '">="&MonthStart'),
                         (other("Sales", "date"), '"<="&MonthEnd')])

    cols: List[Any] = [
        text_col("name", "Channel", 20.0,
                 note="Must match the channel names used on Products and "
                      "Sales, or the lookups come back empty."),
        list_col("type", "Type", "ChannelTypeList", 15.0),
        money_col("listing_fee", "Listing fee", 11.0,
                  note="Charged once per listing or per order."),
        pct_col("transaction_pct", "Transaction %", 11.0),
        pct_col("processing_pct", "Processing %", 11.0,
                note="Payment processing percentage."),
        money_col("processing_fixed", "Processing fixed", 12.0,
                  note="The flat part of payment processing."),
        pct_col("offsite_ads_pct", "Ad fee %", 11.0,
                note="What the marketplace charges on an order its ads brought."),
        yesno_col("offsite_ads_active", "Ads on?", 9.0),
        calc_col("ads_effective", "Ad fee in use",
                 f'IF({has_name},"",IF(EXACT(TRIM({row_ref("offsite_ads_active")}),'
                 f'"Yes"),N({row_ref("offsite_ads_pct")})*OffsiteAdsShare,0))',
                 11.0, "percent",
                 note="Ad percentage times the share of orders ads bring."),
        pct_col("regulatory_fee", "Regulatory %", 11.0),
        pct_col("currency_fee", "Currency %", 11.0,
                note="Conversion fee on sales in another currency."),
        calc_col("total_rate", "Total rate",
                 f'IF({has_name},"",{total_rate})', 11.0, "percent",
                 note="Every percentage this channel takes."),
        pct_col("shipping_fee_pct", "Fees on postage %", 12.0,
                note="Some marketplaces charge their fee on postage too."),
        yesno_col("fees_on_shipping", "Fees on postage?", 12.0),
        money_col("subscription", "Subscription a month", 13.0),
        int_col("payout_days", "Payout days", 10.0,
                note="How long the money takes to reach the bank."),
        money_col("chargeback_fee", "Chargeback fee", 12.0),
        calc_col("fee_on_100", "Fee on a 100 order",
                 f'IF({has_name},"",{fee_on_100})', 13.0, "money",
                 note="The quickest way to compare two channels."),
        calc_col("net_on_100", "You keep on 100",
                 f'IF({has_name},"",100-{fee_on_100})', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("subscription_per_unit", "Subscription a unit",
                 f'IF({has_name},"",IF(UnitsPerMonth<=0,0,'
                 f'N({row_ref("subscription")})/UnitsPerMonth))', 12.0,
                 "money4"),
        calc_col("orders_this_month", "Orders this month", month_orders,
                 12.0, "int"),
        calc_col("revenue_this_month", "Revenue this month", month_revenue,
                 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fees_this_month", "Fees this month", month_fees, 13.0,
                 "money"),
        calc_col("effective_rate", "Effective rate",
                 f'IF({has_name},"",IF(N({row_ref("revenue_this_month")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("fees_this_month")})'
                 f'/N({row_ref("revenue_this_month")})))', 12.0, "percent",
                 note="What the channel actually charged this month."),
        calc_col("fee_drift", "Fee check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_name},{row_ref("effective_rate")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("effective_rate")})>{total_rate}+0.01,'
                 f'"FEES HIGHER THAN SCHEDULE",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("effective_rate")})<{total_rate}-0.01,'
                 f'"FEES LOWER - CHECK SCHEDULE","MATCHES")))', 22.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "HIGHER", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LOWER", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "MATCHES", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("payout_flag", "Cash lag",
                 f'IF({has_name},"",IF(N({row_ref("payout_days")})>14,'
                 f'"SLOW PAYOUT",IF(N({row_ref("payout_days")})=0,'
                 f'"PAID ON THE DAY","NORMAL")))', 14.0, "status"),
        yesno_col("active", "Selling here?", 11.0),
        text_col("fee_source", "Fee schedule source", 24.0,
                 note="Where you checked these figures, and when."),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=1,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/clothing.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/clothing.py sha256:f513787251df9b8dd997e10e2a9ed0ad30ad230ac717ea893138a8c6f0704b27 -->
````python
"""The Clothing calculator.

One row per garment or accessory: the fabric and how many yards it took, the
interfacing, notions, lining and trim, and the time in three parts - cutting,
sewing, finishing. Splitting the time is deliberate: cutting and finishing are
the steps that get faster in a batch, and seeing them separately is what tells
you whether a garment is slow because of the pattern or because of the binding.

`total_minutes` wins when you type it; otherwise the three parts are added.
The `size_factor` column reads the size table on Lists, so a size L can be
costed from the same row as a size M.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, craft_tail, date_col, fetch, id_col, list_col,
                     material_col, money_col, num_col, product_col, row_ref,
                     samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Clothing"

SUBTITLE = ("Sewn items: fabric, notions and the time in cutting, sewing and "
            "finishing, costed to one garment.")

HELP = ("Pick the fabric, type the yards and the three times. The cost of one "
        "garment and the price your margin asks for are calculated to the "
        "right. Minutes can be typed as one figure or left to the three parts.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    cid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{cid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    fabric = row_ref("fabric")

    material_expr = (f'N({row_ref("fabric_cost")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("interfacing")})+N({row_ref("notions")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("lining")})+N({row_ref("trim")})')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixClothing", trigger="pattern_name", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date made", 13.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        text_col("pattern_name", "Pattern / item", 28.0,
                 note="What you sewed. Filling this in starts the row."),
        text_col("pattern_source", "Pattern by", 20.0,
                 note="Commercial pattern, your own draft, or a licence."),
        material_col("fabric", "Fabric ID", 12.0),
        calc_col("fabric_name", "Fabric",
                 f'IF({fabric}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", fabric)})', 28.0, "text"),
        calc_col("fabric_unit_cost", "Fabric cost a unit",
                 f'IF({fabric}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", fabric, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4"),
        num_col("yards", "Yards / metres", 12.0,
                note="In the unit the fabric is bought in, cutting waste "
                     "included."),
        calc_col("fabric_cost", "Fabric cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("yards")})'
                 f'*N({row_ref("fabric_unit_cost")}))', 12.0, "money"),
        money_col("interfacing", "Interfacing", 12.0),
        money_col("notions", "Notions", 12.0,
                  note="Zips, buttons, elastic, thread, grommets, cord."),
        money_col("lining", "Lining", 11.0),
        money_col("trim", "Trim & labels", 12.0),
        list_col("size", "Size", "SizeList", 11.0),
        calc_col("size_factor", "Size factor",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IFERROR(INDEX(SizeFactors,'
                 f'MATCH({row_ref("size")},SizeNames,0)),1))', 11.0, "number",
                 note="From the size table on Lists - what this size adds to "
                      "the fabric and the time."),
        num_col("cut_minutes", "Cutting min", 11.0),
        num_col("sew_minutes", "Sewing min", 11.0),
        num_col("finish_minutes", "Finishing min", 11.0,
                note="Binding, pressing, labels, quality check."),
        num_col("total_minutes", "Minutes (typed)", 12.0,
                note="Type a total and it beats the three parts."),
        calc_col("minutes", "Minutes used",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("total_minutes")})>0,'
                 f'N({row_ref("total_minutes")}),'
                 f'N({row_ref("cut_minutes")})+N({row_ref("sew_minutes")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("finish_minutes")})))', 11.0, "number1"),
        calc_col("hours", "Hours",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("minutes")})/60)', 9.0, "number"),
        list_col("difficulty", "Difficulty", "DifficultyList", 12.0),
        yesno_col("care_label", "Care label", 10.0),
        money_col("price", "Price today", 12.0),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]
    cols += craft_tail(material_expr)

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/common.py`

````python
"""Shared column factories and formula fragments for the handmade sheets.

Everything in here exists so that the forty tab modules stay short and, more
importantly, so that no sheet ever hard codes a column letter or a range.
Formulas are written with the tokens :mod:`..layout` understands:

    {key}{r}            same sheet, this row
    {key_first}         same sheet, top of the data block
    {key_last}          same sheet, bottom of the data block
    [[Sheet.key]]       the data block of `key` on another sheet
    [[Sheet.key#12]]    one cell of `key` on another sheet

Named ranges that point at the Settings tab (``HourlyRate``, ``ListingFee``,
``RoundingRule`` ...) are workbook scoped, so any sheet can use them.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence

from ..config import (CRAFT_SHEETS, PRICING_SCENARIOS, PRODUCT_CATEGORIES,
                      PRODUCT_STATUSES, ROUNDING_RULES, SALES_CHANNELS,
                      UNIT_CONVERSIONS, VOLUME_STEPS, Config, Palette)
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec, blank_if, lookup, max_if, min_if, safe
from ..writer import (cf_bar, cf_formula, cf_text, date_check, list_from,
                      number_check, time_check, yes_no)

P = Palette

#: Rows are numbered from 5 down (1 title, 2 strapline, 3 nav, 4 headers).
FIRST_ROW = 5
#: Sentinel used wherever a MIN over a filtered set could come back empty.
NO_MATCH = 999999

# List data - written to the Lists tab and used by the drop downs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                ("XL", 1.25), ("XXL", 1.40), ("One size", 1.00),
                ("Custom", 1.00)]

#: defined names that must exist before the workbooks opens cleanly
REQUIRED_NAMES = ["ShopName", "TodayDate", "HourlyRate", "LaborCostHour",
                  "ListingFee", "TransactionFee", "ProcessingPercent",
                  "ProcessingFixed", "TargetRetailMargin", "RoundingRule",
                  "MarginWarning", "WholesaleDiscount", "MinimumWage",
                  "ProductIDs", "ProductNames", "MaterialIDs",
                  "MaterialNames"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Column factories
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def tok(key: str) -> str:
    """`{key}` - a same-sheet column token."""
    return "{" + key + "}"


def row_ref(key: str) -> str:
    """`{key}{r}` - this column on the current row."""
    return "{" + key + "}{r}"


def block(key: str) -> str:
    """`{key_first}:{key_last}` - the whole column on this sheet."""
    return "{" + key + "_first}:{" + key + "_last}"


def other(sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
    """`[[Sheet.key]]` - the whole data block of a column elsewhere."""
    return "[[" + sheet + "." + key + "]]"


def other_cell(sheet: str, key: str, row: Any) -> str:
    return "[[" + sheet + "." + key + "#" + str(row) + "]]"


def same_row(sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
    """`[[Sheet.key#]]` - the cell on the same row of another sheet."""
    return "[[" + sheet + "." + key + "#]]"


def id_col(prefix: str, trigger: str = "name", width: float = 12.0,
           note: Optional[str] = None) -> Col:
    """Auto numbering column: blank until the trigger column is filled."""
    formula = (f'=IF({row_ref(trigger)}="","",'
               f'{prefix}&TEXT(ROW()-{FIRST_ROW - 1},"0000"))')
    return Col(key="id", header="ID", width=width, style="id",
               formula=formula,
               note=note or "Numbered automatically - do not type here.")


def text_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 18.0,
             note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="text",
               note=note, group=group)


def wrap_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 34.0,
             note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="wrap",
               note=note, group=group)


def list_col(key: str, header: str, list_name: str, width: float = 16.0,
             note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="text",
               validate=list_from(list_name), note=note, group=group)


def yesno_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 9.0,
              note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="flag",
               validate=list_from("YesNoList"), note=note, group=group,
               cf=[cf_text("Yes", "good"), cf_text("No", "muted")])


def money_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 12.0,
              note: Optional[str] = None, style: str = "money",
              group: str = "", maximum: float = 10000000) -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style=style,
               validate=number_check(0, maximum), note=note, group=group)


def num_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 11.0,
            note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "",
            maximum: float = 1000000) -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="number",
               validate=number_check(0, maximum), note=note, group=group)


def int_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 10.0,
            note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "",
            maximum: float = 100000) -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="int",
               validate=number_check(0, maximum, decimal=False), note=note,
               group=group)


def pct_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 10.0,
            note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="percent",
               validate=number_check(0, 1), note=note, group=group)


def date_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 13.0,
             note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="date",
               validate=date_check(), note=note, group=group)


def time_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 11.0,
             note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="time",
               validate=time_check(), note=note, group=group)


def link_col(key: str, header: str, width: float = 14.0,
             note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="link",
               note=note, group=group)


def product_col(key: str = "product", header: str = "Product ID",
                width: float = 13.0,
                note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    """Drop down of every product ID in the catalog."""
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="id",
               validate=list_from("ProductIDs"),
               note=note or "Pick a product from the list.", group=group)


def material_col(key: str = "material", header: str = "Material ID",
                 width: float = 13.0,
                 note: Optional[str] = None, group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="id",
               validate=list_from("MaterialIDs"),
               note=note or "Pick a material from the list.", group=group)


def inline_list(items: Sequence[str], note: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """A short drop down that does not need a name on the Lists tab."""
    opts: Dict[str, Any] = {"validate": "list", "source": list(items)}
    if note:
        opts["input_message"] = note[:255]
    return opts


def fetch(sheet: str, match_key: str, fetch_key: str, value: str,
          fallback: str = '""') -> str:
    """INDEX/MATCH one value out of another register."""
    return lookup(value, other(sheet, match_key), other(sheet, fetch_key),
                  fallback)


def list_col_inline(key: str, header: str, items: Sequence[str],
                    width: float = 16.0, note: Optional[str] = None,
                    group: str = "") -> Col:
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style="text",
               validate=inline_list(items, note or ""), note=note,
               group=group)


def lookup_col(key: str, header: str, value: str, sheet: str,
               match_on: str, fetch: str, width: float = 20.0,
               style: str = "text", note: Optional[str] = None,
               group: str = "") -> Col:
    """INDEX/MATCH against another register."""
    formula = "=" + lookup(value, other(sheet, match_on), other(sheet, fetch),
                           '""')
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style=style,
               formula=formula, note=note, group=group)


def calc_col(key: str, header: str, body: str, width: float = 12.0,
             style: str = "money", note: Optional[str] = None,
             cf: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None, group: str = "",
             hidden: bool = False) -> Col:
    """A locked formula column. `body` is the formula without the leading =."""
    return Col(key=key, header=header, width=width, style=style,
               formula="=" + body, note=note, cf=list(cf or []),
               group=group, hidden=hidden)


def sumifs(total_range: str, pairs: Sequence[Sequence[str]],
           fallback: str = "0") -> str:
    """SUMIFS(total_range, crit_range1, crit1, ...) as a formula body."""
    parts = [total_range]
    for crit_range, crit in pairs:
        parts.append(crit_range)
        parts.append(crit)
    return "IFERROR(SUMIFS(" + ",".join(parts) + "),0)" + (
        "" if fallback == "0" else "")


def sumifs_wild(total_range: str, crit_range: str, key: str,
                extra: Sequence[Sequence[str]] = ()) -> str:
    """SUMIFS where the criterion column holds a comma separated list."""
    pairs = [(crit_range, '"*"&' + row_ref(key) + '&"*"')]
    pairs.extend(extra)
    return "IFERROR(SUMIFS(" + ",".join(
        [total_range] + [p for pair in pairs for p in pair]) + "),0)"


def countifs(pairs: Sequence[Sequence[str]]) -> str:
    return "IFERROR(COUNTIFS(" + ",".join(
        [p for pair in pairs for p in pair]) + "),0)"


def rank_desc(value_key: str, id_key: str = "id",
              blank_sink: int = NO_MATCH) -> str:
    """Unique descending rank, ties broken by ID order, blanks last."""
    return (f'IF({row_ref(id_key)}="",{blank_sink},'
            f'COUNTIFS({block(value_key)},">"&N({row_ref(value_key)})'
            f',{block(value_key)},N({row_ref(value_key)}),'
            f'{block(id_key)},"<="&{row_ref(id_key)}))')


def rank_asc(value_key: str, id_key: str = "id",
             blank_sink: int = NO_MATCH) -> str:
    return (f'IF({row_ref(id_key)}="",{blank_sink},'
            f'COUNTIFS({block(value_key)},"<"&N({row_ref(value_key)})'
            f',{block(value_key)},N({row_ref(value_key)}),'
            f'{block(id_key)},"<="&{row_ref(id_key)}))')


def rank_flag(flag_key: str, value: str, id_key: str = "id") -> str:
    """Rank only the rows whose flag says `value`; the rest sink to the bottom.

    Used by the Dashboard to list the products that are losing money, the
    reviews that are overdue and the materials that need ordering, without an
    array formula - a plain MATCH on the hidden rank does the work.
    """
    return (f'IF({row_ref(flag_key)}<>"{value}",{NO_MATCH},'
            f'COUNTIFS({block(flag_key)},"{value}",'
            f'{block(id_key)},"<="&{row_ref(id_key)}))')


def flag_list(sheet: str, rank_key: str, name_key: str, n: int,
              value_key: str = "", value_sheet: str = "") -> str:
    """The nth entry of a flagged list, by its hidden rank column."""
    target = value_sheet or sheet
    if not value_key:
        return (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other(sheet, name_key)},'
                f'MATCH({n},{other(sheet, rank_key)},0)),"")')
    return (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other(target, value_key)},'
            f'MATCH({n},{other(sheet, rank_key)},0)),"")')


def top_by(rank_sheet: str, rank_key: str, fetch_sheet: str,
           fetch_key: str, n: int) -> str:
    """The nth best entry of `fetch_key`, by a hidden rank column."""
    return (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other(fetch_sheet, fetch_key)},'
            f'MATCH({n},{other(rank_sheet, rank_key)},0)),"")')


def top_value(rank_sheet: str, rank_key: str, value_sheet: str,
              value_key: str, n: int) -> str:
    return (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other(value_sheet, value_key)},'
            f'MATCH({n},{other(rank_sheet, rank_key)},0)),"")')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pricing maths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def round_price(expr: str) -> str:
    """Apply the rounding rule chosen on Settings (eight branches)."""
    branches = [
        ("None", expr),
        ("Nearest 0.99", f"ROUND({expr}+0.5,0)-0.01"),
        ("Nearest 0.95", f"ROUND({expr}+0.5,0)-0.05"),
        ("Nearest 0.50", f"ROUND({expr}*2,0)/2"),
        ("Nearest 1", f"ROUND({expr},0)"),
        ("Nearest 5", f"ROUND({expr}/5,0)*5"),
        ("Up to whole 1", f"CEILING({expr},1)"),
        ("Up to whole 5", f"CEILING({expr},5)"),
    ]
    out = branches[-1][1]
    for rule, value in reversed(branches[:-1]):
        out = f'IF(RoundingRule="{rule}",{value},{out})'
    return out


def price_from(cost: str, fixed: str, margin: str, rate: str) -> str:
    """The whole pricing model in one line.

        price = (cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee rate)

    Only use this when `cost`, `fixed` and `rate` are short cell references.
    The rounding rule repeats its argument eight times, so a long cost
    expression multiplied by eight runs past Excel's 8,192 character limit
    for a single formula - and Excel answers that by deleting the formula
    and showing a repair log. For anything long, put :func:`raw_price` in a
    hidden helper column and round the cell with :func:`round_ref`.
    """
    room = f"(1-{margin}-{rate})"
    core = f"({cost}+{fixed})/{room}"
    return f'IFERROR({round_price(f"IF({room}<=0,0,{core})")},"")'


def raw_price(cost: str, fixed: str, margin: str, rate: str) -> str:
    """The unrounded model price, evaluated ONCE.

    This is the half of :func:`price_from` that costs characters: the cost
    expression and the fee-rate lookup appear once here instead of eight
    times inside the rounding branches.
    """
    room = f"(1-{margin}-{rate})"
    core = f"({cost}+{fixed})/{room}"
    return f'IFERROR(IF({room}<=0,0,{core}),"")'


def round_ref(raw_ref: str) -> str:
    """Apply the rounding rule from Settings to a price already calculated.

    `raw_ref` should be a short cell reference (a hidden helper column), so
    the eight rounding branches stay eight short references rather than eight
    copies of the whole cost model.
    """
    return f'IFERROR({round_price(f"N({raw_ref})")},"")'


def raw_price_col(cost: str, fixed: str, margin: str, rate: str,
                  guard: str = "") -> Col:
    """A hidden column holding the unrounded price, for :func:`round_ref`."""
    body = raw_price(cost, fixed, margin, rate)
    formula = f'IF({guard},"",{body})' if guard else body
    return calc_col("price_raw", "raw price", formula, 9.0, "money4",
                    hidden=True,
                    note="Hidden - the price before rounding, kept in its own "
                         "cell so the rounding rule does not have to repeat "
                         "the whole cost model eight times.")


def channel_lookup(channel: str, key: str, fallback: str) -> str:
    """A fee value for one sales channel, from the Channels tab."""
    return (f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Channels', key)},"
            f"MATCH({channel},{other('Channels', 'name')},0)),{fallback})")


def channel_fee_rate(channel: str) -> str:
    """Every percentage a channel takes, including its share of ad fees."""
    return ("(" + channel_lookup(channel, "transaction_pct", "TransactionFee")
            + "+" + channel_lookup(channel, "processing_pct",
                                   "ProcessingPercent")
            + "+" + channel_lookup(channel, "regulatory_fee", "RegulatoryFee")
            + "+" + channel_lookup(channel, "currency_fee", "CurrencyFee")
            + "+" + channel_lookup(channel, "ads_effective", "0") + ")")


def channel_fixed_fee(channel: str) -> str:
    """Fees charged once per order, whatever the price."""
    return ("(" + channel_lookup(channel, "listing_fee", "ListingFee")
            + "+" + channel_lookup(channel, "processing_fixed",
                                   "ProcessingFixed") + ")")


def labor_cost(minutes: str) -> str:
    """What an amount of time costs once payroll on-costs are added."""
    return f'IF(N({minutes})=0,0,N({minutes})/60*LaborCostHour)'


def overhead_per_unit(minutes: str = "0", units: str = "1") -> str:
    """Overhead share, following the method chosen on Settings."""
    per_hour = f'IF(N({minutes})=0,0,N({minutes})/60*OverheadPerHour)'
    per_unit = f'IF(N({units})=0,0,OverheadPerUnit/N({units}))'
    return (f'IF(OverheadMethod="Per hour",{per_hour},'
            f'IF(OverheadMethod="Per unit",{per_unit},'
            f'IF(UnitsPerMonth<=0,0,OverheadMonthly/UnitsPerMonth)))')


def hours_of(minutes: str) -> str:
    return f"(N({minutes})/60)"


def margin_flag(margin: str, profit: str, price: str) -> str:
    return (f'IF(N({price})=0,"",'
            f'IF(N({profit})<=0,"{FLAG_LOSS}",'
            f'IF(N({margin})<MarginWarning,"{FLAG_THIN}","{FLAG_OK}")))')


def margin_cf() -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Conditional formats that make a bad price obvious."""
    return [cf_text(FLAG_LOSS, "bold_bad"), cf_text(FLAG_THIN, "warn"),
            cf_text(FLAG_OK, "good"), cf_text(FLAG_REVIEW, "info")]


def hourly_flag(hourly: str, minutes: str) -> str:
    return (f'IF(N({minutes})=0,"",'
            f'IF(N({hourly})<0,"PAYING TO WORK",'
            f'IF(N({hourly})<MinimumWage,"BELOW MIN WAGE",'
            f'IF(N({hourly})<HourlyRate,"BELOW YOUR RATE","GOOD"))))')


def review_flag(next_review: str, reviewed: str) -> str:
    return (f'IF({row_ref(next_review)}="","",'
            f'IF(N({row_ref(next_review)})<TodayDate,"OVERDUE",'
            f'IF(N({row_ref(next_review)})-TodayDate<=30,"DUE SOON","OK")))')


def craft_minutes_total(product_ref: str) -> str:
    """Minutes recorded for one product across all six craft tabs.

    Every craft tab keeps its labour in a column called `minutes`, so the
    catalog can add the six up without knowing which craft a product is.
    """
    parts = [sumifs(other(sheet, "minutes"),
                    [(other(sheet, "product"), product_ref)])
             for sheet in CRAFT_SHEETS]
    return "+".join(parts)


def craft_material_total(product_ref: str) -> str:
    """Material cost recorded for one product across all six craft tabs."""
    parts = [sumifs(other(sheet, "material_total"),
                    [(other(sheet, "product"), product_ref)])
             for sheet in CRAFT_SHEETS]
    return "+".join(parts)


def craft_price_total(product_ref: str) -> str:
    parts = [sumifs(other(sheet, "unit_cost"),
                    [(other(sheet, "product"), product_ref)])
             for sheet in CRAFT_SHEETS]
    return "+".join(parts)


def spec_defaults(name: str, title: str, subtitle: str, cfg: Config,
                  help_text: str, tab_color: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """The SheetSpec arguments every register shares.

    `freeze_cols` is deliberately not part of this: registers pass it straight
    to :class:`SheetSpec`, and keeping it out of both would mean the keyword
    arriving twice.
    """
    return dict(name=name, title=title, subtitle=subtitle,
                rows=cfg.row_count(name), tab_color=tab_color,
                help_text=help_text)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The six craft calculators
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def craft_channel_rate() -> str:
    """Fee rate of the default channel - the craft tabs price for that."""
    return channel_fee_rate("DefaultChannel")


def craft_channel_fixed() -> str:
    return channel_fixed_fee("DefaultChannel")


def craft_packaging(product_ref: str) -> str:
    """Packaging for one item: matched components, or the default."""
    specific = sumifs_wild(other("Packaging", "cost"),
                           other("Packaging", "products"), "product")
    every_order = sumifs(other("Packaging", "cost"),
                         [(other("Packaging", "products"), '"All"')])
    return (f'IF({product_ref}="",DefaultPackaging,'
            f'IF(N({specific})+N({every_order})>0,'
            f'N({specific})+N({every_order}),DefaultPackaging))')


def craft_check(price: str, profit: str, margin: str, hourly: str,
                suggested: str, id_ref: str) -> str:
    """One line that says what is wrong with this piece, if anything."""
    return (f'IF({id_ref}="","",'
            f'IF(N({price})=0,"NO PRICE YET",'
            f'IF(N({profit})<0,"PRICED BELOW COST",'
            f'IF(N({hourly})<MinimumWage,"BELOW MINIMUM WAGE",'
            f'IF(N({margin})<MarginWarning,"MARGIN BELOW TARGET",'
            f'IF(N({price})<N({suggested})*0.9,"UNDER THE MODEL PRICE",'
            f'"OK"))))))')


def craft_tail(material_expr: str, *, has_difficulty: bool = True,
               minutes_key: str = "minutes", price_key: str = "price",
               id_key: str = "id", batch_col: Optional[Col] = None) -> List[Col]:
    """The costing columns every craft calculator ends with.

    The six craft tabs each collect their own materials and their own time;
    from `material_total` and `minutes` onwards they are identical, so they
    share this tail. `unit_cost` is the cost of ONE finished item, which is
    what the Products tab picks up.
    """
    mins = row_ref(minutes_key)
    price = row_ref(price_key)
    batch = row_ref("batch_qty")
    pid = row_ref("product")
    iid = row_ref(id_key)
    rate = craft_channel_rate()
    fixed = craft_channel_fixed()
    unit_cost = (f"N({row_ref('material_total')})+N({row_ref('labor_cost')})"
                 f"+N({row_ref('packaging_cost')})"
                 f"+N({row_ref('overhead_cost')})")
    profit = f"N({price})-({rate}*N({price})+{fixed})-{unit_cost}"
    margin = f'IF(N({price})=0,"",({profit})/N({price}))'
    hourly = f'IF(N({mins})=0,"",({profit})/(N({mins})/60))'

    cols: List[Col] = [
        batch_col if batch_col is not None else int_col(
            "batch_qty", "Batch qty", 10.0,
            note="How many you make at once. Blank uses the default on "
                 "Settings."),
        calc_col("material_total", "Material cost an item",
                 f'IFERROR(IF({iid}="",0,{material_expr}),0)', 13.0, "money",
                 note="Everything this piece is made of, one item."),
        calc_col("labor_cost", "Labour cost",
                 f'IF({iid}="",0,IF(N({mins})=0,0,N({mins})/60*LaborCostHour))',
                 12.0, "money"),
    ]
    if has_difficulty:
        cols.append(calc_col(
            "difficulty_factor", "Difficulty factor",
            f'IF({iid}="",1,IFERROR(INDEX(DiffFactors,'
            f'MATCH({row_ref("difficulty")},DiffNames,0)),1))', 11.0,
            "number", note="From the factor table on the Lists tab."))
    cols += [
        calc_col("packaging_cost", "Packaging cost",
                 f'IF({iid}="",DefaultPackaging,{craft_packaging(pid)})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("overhead_cost", "Overhead share",
                 f'IF({iid}="",0,{overhead_per_unit(mins, f"N({batch})")})',
                 12.0, "money",
                 note="Spread the way the Overhead method on Settings says."),
        calc_col("unit_cost", "Cost an item",
                 f'IF({iid}="",0,{unit_cost})', 13.0, "money",
                 note="Materials + labour + packaging + overhead for one "
                      "finished item. This is what Products picks up."),
        calc_col("batch_total", "Cost a batch",
                 f'IF({iid}="",0,N({row_ref("unit_cost")})*'
````
