````python
                 f'IF(N({batch})=0,DefaultBatchSize,N({batch})))', 13.0,
                 "money"),
        calc_col("cost_a_minute", "Cost a minute",
                 f'IF(OR({iid}="",N({mins})=0),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("unit_cost")})/N({mins}))', 11.0, "money4"),
        # the unrounded model price lives in its own hidden cell: rounding
        # repeats its argument eight times, and eight copies of the whole
        # cost model would pass Excel's 8,192 character formula limit
        raw_price_col(unit_cost, fixed, "TargetRetailMargin", rate,
                      guard=f'{iid}=""'),
        calc_col("suggested_price", "Suggested price",
                 f'IF({iid}="","",{round_ref(row_ref("price_raw"))})', 13.0,
                 "money",
                 note="(cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee rate), "
                      "rounded the way Settings says."),
        calc_col("wholesale_price", "Wholesale price",
                 f'IF({iid}="","",'
                 f'{round_price("N(" + row_ref("suggested_price") + ")*(1-WholesaleDiscount)")})',
                 13.0, "money",
                 note="The suggested retail price less the trade discount."),
        calc_col("profit", "Profit an item",
                 f'IF({iid}="","",IF(N({price})=0,"",{profit}))', 12.0,
                 "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("margin", "Margin",
                 f'IF({iid}="","",{margin})', 10.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("margin_flag", "Flag",
                 margin_flag(row_ref("margin"), row_ref("profit"), price),
                 9.0, "status", cf=margin_cf()),
        calc_col("effective_hourly", "Effective hourly",
                 f'IF({iid}="","",{hourly})', 12.0, "money",
                 note="What an hour of making this earns, after fees."),
        calc_col("hourly_flag", "Wage check",
                 hourly_flag(row_ref("effective_hourly"), mins), 16.0,
                 "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "PAYING TO WORK", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "BELOW", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "GOOD", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("check", "Check",
                 craft_check(price, row_ref("profit"), row_ref("margin"),
                             row_ref("effective_hourly"),
                             row_ref("suggested_price"), iid), 22.0, "status",
                 cf=margin_cf() + [{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                                    "value": "NO PRICE", "fmt": "info"}]),
    ]
    return cols



def samples(cfg: Config, name: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Sample rows for a register (empty when building a blank workbook)."""
    if not cfg.include_sample_data:
        return []
    from ..sample_data import build_sample_data
    return build_sample_data(cfg).get(name, [])


def banner_legend(sheet, fmts, cfg: Config, reg, row: int, last_col: int):
    """Cream = type here, warm grey = calculated. Written under a page."""
    sheet.merge(row, 0, last_col, "", fmts.chrome("rule"))
    sheet.row_height(row + 1, 16)
    sheet.write(row + 1, 0, "Type here", fmts.chrome("legend_label"))
    sheet.write(row + 1, 1, "", fmts.chrome("legend_input"))
    sheet.write(row + 1, 2, "Calculated - locked",
                fmts.chrome("legend_label"))
    sheet.write(row + 1, 3, "", fmts.chrome("legend_calc"))
    sheet.merge(row + 1, 4, last_col,
                f"Sheets are protected with the password '{cfg.password}'. "
                f"Formula cells cannot be overwritten by accident.",
                fmts.chrome("note"))
    return row + 2
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/competitors.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/competitors.py sha256:525af3ac9becfb9efcedee70cfb4c6eeb3130b93e14d45f5106872a5f9f861ae -->
````python
"""The Competitors tab - what the market already pays.

One row per comparable listing: who sells it, what they charge, what postage
they add, and which of your products it compares with. Your price comes off the
Products tab, so the comparison never goes stale on your side.

`price_gap` is the honest figure - their price plus their postage against
yours. The example shop's chunky scarf is the reason this tab exists: it sells
at 68 while the closest comparable sells at 145 plus postage, which means the
problem is not the market, it is the price.

`check_flag` goes STALE after two months, because a competitor comparison that
has not been looked at for a season is a guess with a date on it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, fetch, id_col, int_col, link_col,
                     list_col, money_col, num_col, product_col, row_ref,
                     samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Competitors"

SUBTITLE = ("Comparable listings: what they charge, what you charge, and how "
            "far apart the two are.")

HELP = ("One row per comparable listing. Pick which of your products it "
        "compares with and your price arrives from the catalog. Add their "
        "postage so the comparison is like for like.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    cid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{cid}=""'
    mine = row_ref("my_product")
    their_price = f"N({row_ref('competitor_price')})"
    their_ship = f"N({row_ref('shipping')})"
    their_all_in = f"({their_price}+{their_ship})"
    my_price = f"N({row_ref('my_price')})"

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixCompetitor", trigger="name", width=11.0),
        text_col("name", "Shop", 28.0,
                 note="Who sells it. Filling this in starts the row."),
        link_col("url", "Listing URL", 30.0),
        text_col("product", "Their product", 28.0),
        list_col("category", "Category", "CategoryList", 20.0),
        product_col("my_product", "Your product", 13.0,
                    note="Which of your products this compares with."),
        calc_col("my_product_name", "Your product name",
                 f'IF({mine}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "name", mine)})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        money_col("competitor_price", "Their price", 12.0),
        money_col("shipping", "Their postage", 12.0,
                  note="What they charge to send it - free postage is 0."),
        calc_col("their_all_in", "Their all-in",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{their_all_in})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("my_price", "Your price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{fetch("Products", "id", "retail_price", mine, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("my_absorbed_postage", "Postage you absorb",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{fetch("Products", "id", "shipping_cost", mine, "0")})',
                 13.0, "money",
                 note="Postage you pay out of the margin - it widens the real "
                      "gap between you and them."),
        calc_col("price_gap", "Gap",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{my_price}-{their_all_in})', 11.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "info"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("gap_pct", "Gap %",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({their_all_in}=0,"",'
                 f'({my_price}-{their_all_in})/{their_all_in}))', 10.0,
                 "percent"),
        calc_col("position", "Position",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{their_all_in}=0),"",'
                 f'IF({my_price}<{their_all_in}*0.98,"Cheaper",'
                 f'IF({my_price}>{their_all_in}*1.02,"Premium","Same")))',
                 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "Cheaper", "fmt": "info"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "Premium", "fmt": "good"}]),
        num_col("rating", "Their rating", 11.0,
                note="Out of 5, as shown on the listing."),
        int_col("reviews", "Their reviews", 11.0),
        text_col("sales", "Their sales", 13.0,
                 note="What the listing claims: 10k+, 500+, a number."),
        calc_col("their_strength", "How established",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("reviews")})>1000,'
                 f'"BIG SELLER",IF(N({row_ref("reviews")})>200,'
                 f'"ESTABLISHED",IF(N({row_ref("reviews")})>0,"NEW",'
                 f'"NO REVIEWS"))))', 15.0, "status"),
        calc_col("my_margin", "Your margin",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{fetch("Products", "id", "margin", mine)})',
                 11.0, "percent",
                 note="From the catalog - handy when a comparable is much "
                      "more expensive than you."),
        date_col("last_checked", "Last checked", 13.0),
        calc_col("check_flag", "Check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("last_checked")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(TodayDate-N({row_ref("last_checked")})>60,"STALE","OK"))',
                 10.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "STALE", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/crochet.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/crochet.py sha256:155f887b1fb4200be9100657bc44b42cf29cf23ea1836cdf732d578bfdb4e558 -->
````python
"""The Crochet calculator.

One row per piece (or per batch of pieces): the yarn, how many skeins it took,
the notions, and the minutes at the hook. From that the shared craft tail works
out the cost of one finished item, the price the model asks for, what the
current price really earns and what an hour of crocheting pays.

The yarn cost comes off the Materials tab through the yarn ID, waste allowance
included, so a change in the price of merino moves every scarf that uses it.
The `difficulty_factor` column reads the factor table on Lists - a Hard pattern
is assumed to take longer than an Easy one, and that assumption is editable.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, craft_tail, date_col, fetch, id_col, list_col,
                     material_col, money_col, num_col, product_col, row_ref,
                     samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Crochet"

SUBTITLE = ("Crochet and knitting: yarn, notions and time at the hook, costed "
            "to one finished item.")

HELP = ("Pick the yarn from the materials list and type the skeins and the "
        "minutes. Everything to the right of 'Price' is calculated: the cost "
        "of one item, the price your target margin asks for, and what an hour "
        "of this work actually pays you.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    cid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{cid}=""'
    yarn = row_ref("yarn")
    product = row_ref("product")
    minutes = row_ref("minutes")

    material_expr = (f'N({row_ref("yarn_cost")})+N({row_ref("hooks")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("notions")})')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixCrochet", trigger="pattern", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date made", 13.0),
        product_col(note="The catalog product this piece belongs to, if it "
                         "has one. Prototypes can leave it blank."),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        text_col("pattern", "Pattern", 28.0,
                 note="What you made. Filling this in starts the row."),
        text_col("pattern_source", "Pattern by", 20.0,
                 note="Designer, book or your own - and whether a licence fee "
                      "applies."),
        material_col("yarn", "Yarn ID", 12.0,
                     note="The yarn as it is listed on the Materials tab."),
        calc_col("yarn_name", "Yarn",
                 f'IF({yarn}="","",{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", yarn)})',
                 30.0, "text"),
        calc_col("yarn_unit", "Unit",
                 f'IF({yarn}="","",{fetch("Materials", "id", "unit", yarn)})',
                 9.0, "text"),
        calc_col("yarn_unit_cost", "Cost a unit",
                 f'IF({yarn}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", yarn, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4",
                 note="From Materials, with the expected waste added."),
        num_col("skeins", "Skeins", 10.0,
                note="In the unit above: skeins, ounces, grams."),
        num_col("yardage", "Yardage / metres", 12.0,
                note="Optional - useful when a pattern gives a length."),
        calc_col("yarn_cost", "Yarn cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("skeins")})'
                 f'*N({row_ref("yarn_unit_cost")}))', 12.0, "money"),
        money_col("hooks", "Hooks & tools", 12.0,
                  note="Share of hooks, stitch markers, scissors - the tools "
                       "this piece wears out."),
        money_col("notions", "Notions", 12.0,
                  note="Buttons, zips, safety eyes, labels, stuffing."),
        text_col("gauge", "Gauge", 14.0, note="e.g. 12 st = 4in"),
        list_col("difficulty", "Difficulty", "DifficultyList", 12.0),
        list_col("size", "Size", "SizeList", 11.0),
        num_col("minutes", "Minutes", 10.0,
                note="Time at the hook for ONE item, not the whole batch."),
        calc_col("hours", "Hours",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({minutes})/60)', 9.0, "number"),
        money_col("price", "Price today", 12.0,
                  note="What this piece actually sells for."),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]
    cols += craft_tail(material_expr)

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/dashboard.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/dashboard.py sha256:3ad4a425d0c3036c9cd1f9a6278069c7ca58e077caf499ed09546f8d854883db -->
````python
"""The Dashboard - the whole shop on one screen.

Three bands of numbers (this month, this year, the workshop), a warnings panel
that counts everything needing a decision, the three top-five tables the hidden
rank columns on Products feed, the two lists nobody wants to look at - products
losing money and prices overdue a review - then trading by channel, by craft
and month by month, and a spotlight that follows whichever product you pick.

Nothing here is typed. Every figure is a SUMIFS, a COUNTIFS or an INDEX/MATCH
against a register, so the page is right the moment the registers are.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec, lookup
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from .common import (FIRST_ROW, fetch, flag_list, other, row_ref, top_by,
                     top_value)

P = Palette

NAME = "Dashboard"

SUBTITLE = ("This month, this year, what is selling, what is losing money and "
            "what needs a decision today.")

HELP = ("Everything on this page is calculated from the registers. Pick a "
        "product in the spotlight at the bottom to see its numbers.")


def _sum(value_key: str, sheet: str, start: str, end: str,
         date_key: str = "date") -> str:
    """SUMIFS over a date window."""
    return (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other(sheet, value_key)},"
            f"{other(sheet, date_key)},\">=\"&{start},"
            f"{other(sheet, date_key)},\"<=\"&{end}),0)")


def _count(sheet: str, start: str, end: str,
           date_key: str = "date") -> str:
    return (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other(sheet, date_key)},\">=\"&{start},"
            f"{other(sheet, date_key)},\"<=\"&{end}),0)")


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=True)
    last_col = 15
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col, badge="Calculated - nothing to type")
    for i in range(last_col + 1):
        sheet.set_col(i, i, 2.5 if i == 0 else 13.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 1, 22.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=26)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- this month
    r = sheet.section(r, "This month", last_col)
    month_revenue = _sum("gross", "Sales", "MonthStart", "MonthEnd")
    month_profit = _sum("profit", "Sales", "MonthStart", "MonthEnd")
    month_units = _sum("qty", "Sales", "MonthStart", "MonthEnd")
    month_minutes = _sum("minutes_total", "Sales", "MonthStart", "MonthEnd")
    month_orders = _count("Sales", "MonthStart", "MonthEnd")
    tiles = [
        ("Revenue", month_revenue, "money0", "Against the target on Settings"),
        ("Profit", month_profit, "money0", "After every fee and the cost of "
                                           "goods"),
        ("Margin", f"IF({month_revenue}=0,0,{month_profit}/{month_revenue})",
         "percent", "Profit as a share of revenue"),
        ("Orders", month_orders, "int", "Lines on the Sales tab"),
        ("Units", month_units, "int", "Items sold"),
        ("Hourly earned",
         f"IF({month_minutes}=0,0,{month_profit}/({month_minutes}/60))",
         "money", "What an hour of making earned"),
    ]
    r = _tile_row(sheet, r, 1, tiles, span=2)
    r = _target_row(
        sheet, fmts, r, 1, last_col,
        [("Revenue target", "MonthlyRevenueTarget", "money0", month_revenue),
         ("Profit target", "MonthlyProfitTarget", "money0", month_profit)])
    r += 1

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- this year
    r = sheet.section(r, "This year", last_col)
    year_revenue = _sum("gross", "Sales", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_profit = _sum("profit", "Sales", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_units = _sum("qty", "Sales", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    tiles = [
        ("Revenue", year_revenue, "money0", "Against the annual target"),
        ("Profit", year_profit, "money0", "After fees and cost of goods"),
        ("Units", year_units, "int", "Items sold this year"),
        ("Waste", _sum("cost", "Waste Log", "YearStart", "YearEnd"), "money0",
         "What got broken, spoiled or mis-cut"),
        ("Overhead", "OverheadMonthly", "money0", "A month, from the Overhead "
                                                  "tab"),
        ("Stock value", f"IFERROR(SUM({other('Materials', 'stock_value')}),0)",
         "money0", "What is on the shelf"),
    ]
    r = _tile_row(sheet, r, 1, tiles, span=2)
    r = _target_row(
        sheet, fmts, r, 1, last_col,
        [("Revenue target", "AnnualRevenueTarget", "money0", year_revenue)])
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------- workshop & trade
    r = sheet.section(r, "The workshop and the trade", last_col)
    labour_hours = _sum("hours", "Labor", "MonthStart", "MonthEnd")
    labour_cost = _sum("loaded_cost", "Labor", "MonthStart", "MonthEnd")
    shop_hours = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Labor', 'hours')},"
                  f"{other('Labor', 'date')},\">=\"&MonthStart,"
                  f"{other('Labor', 'date')},\"<=\"&MonthEnd,"
                  f"{other('Labor', 'product')},\"\"),0)")
    tiles = [
        ("Hours worked", labour_hours, "number", "This month, from the Labor "
                                                 "tab"),
        ("Labour cost", labour_cost, "money0", "With the payroll burden added"),
        ("Shop hours", shop_hours, "number", "Time not on one product"),
        ("Productive hours", "ProductiveHours", "number",
         "What Settings assumes a month"),
        ("Wholesale owed",
         f"IFERROR(SUM({other('Wholesale Orders', 'balance_outstanding')}),0)",
         "money0", "Trade orders not marked Paid"),
        ("Wholesale overdue",
         (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Wholesale Orders', 'balance_outstanding')},"
          f"{other('Wholesale Orders', 'aging_flag')},\"OVERDUE\"),0)"),
         "money0", "Past the due date"),
    ]
    r = _tile_row(sheet, r, 1, tiles, span=2)
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- warnings
    r = sheet.section(r, "What needs a decision", last_col)
    warnings = [
        ("Products losing money",
         f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Products', 'margin_flag')},\"LOSS\"),0)",
         "Products below cost after fees - the Dashboard lists them below."),
        ("Margins below target",
         f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Products', 'margin_flag')},\"THIN\"),0)",
         "Priced under the margin warning on Settings."),
        ("Paying below the minimum wage",
         (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Products', 'hourly_flag')},"
          f"\"BELOW MIN WAGE\"),0)"),
         "An hour of making these earns less than the minimum."),
        ("Paying you to work",
         (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Products', 'hourly_flag')},"
          f"\"PAYING TO WORK\"),0)"),
         "Negative profit per hour - every sale costs you money."),
        ("Prices overdue a review",
         f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Products', 'review_flag')},\"OVERDUE\"),0)",
         "Past the review window on Settings."),
        ("Materials to re-order",
         (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Materials', 'stock_flag')},\"REORDER\")"
          f"+COUNTIFS({other('Materials', 'stock_flag')},\"ORDER NOW\"),0)"),
         "At or below the re-order point."),
        ("Waste above the target",
         f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Materials', 'waste_flag')},\"WASTE HIGH\"),0)",
         "Real losses running ahead of the guess."),
        ("Fee schedule out of date", "IF(FeeStale=\"Yes\",1,0)",
         "The fees on Settings have not been checked recently."),
        ("Wholesale orders overdue",
         (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Wholesale Orders', 'aging_flag')},"
          f"\"OVERDUE\"),0)"),
         "Trade invoices past their due date."),
        ("Batches above the defect target",
         (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Batches', 'defect_flag')},"
          f"\"ABOVE THE TARGET\"),0)"),
         "More seconds than the defect rate on Settings."),
        ("Events that lost money",
         f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Events', 'verdict')},\"LOST MONEY\"),0)",
         "Table fees and hours against what the day took."),
        ("Promotions still live past their end",
         (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Promotions', 'state')},\"ENDED\","
          f"{other('Promotions', 'active')},\"Yes\"),0)"),
         "Switched on but out of date."),
    ]
    for i, (label, formula, note) in enumerate(warnings):
        col = 1 + (i % 2) * 7
        if i % 2 == 0:
            sheet.row_height(r, 30)
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, label, fmts.chrome("kpi_label"))
        fmt = fmts.chrome("kpi_value", num_format="#,##0")
        sheet.ws.write_blank(r, col + 2, None, fmt)
        sheet.formula(r, col + 2, _expand(formula), fmt)
        sheet.merge(r, col + 3, col + 6, note, fmts.chrome("kpi_note"))
        sheet.ws.conditional_format(
            r, col + 2, r, col + 2,
            {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
             "format": fmts.cf("bad")})
        if i % 2 == 1:
            r += 1
    if len(warnings) % 2:
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- top fives
    r = sheet.section(r, "The top five", last_col)
    tables = [
        ("By revenue", "rank_revenue", "revenue", "money0"),
        ("By profit", "rank_profit", "gross_profit", "money0"),
        ("By margin", "rank_margin", "margin", "percent"),
    ]
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    for i, (title, _rank, _value, _style) in enumerate(tables):
        col = 1 + i * 5
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 4, title, fmts.chrome("subsection"))
    r += 1
    sheet.row_height(r, 18)
    for i in range(3):
        col = 1 + i * 5
        sheet.write(r, col, "#", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
        sheet.merge(r, col + 1, col + 3, "Product", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
        sheet.write(r, col + 4, tables[i][2].replace("_", " ").title(),
                    fmts.chrome("header"))
    r += 1
    for n in range(1, 6):
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        for i, (_title, rank_key, value_key, style) in enumerate(tables):
            col = 1 + i * 5
            sheet.write(r, col, n, fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
            name_formula = _expand(top_by("Products", rank_key, "Products",
                                          "name", n))
            value_formula = _expand(top_value("Products", rank_key, "Products",
                                              value_key, n))
            sheet.merge(r, col + 1, col + 3, "", fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
            sheet.formula(r, col + 1, name_formula,
                                   fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
            sheet.formula(r, col + 4, value_formula,
                                   fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------- needs attention
    r = sheet.section(r, "Needs attention", last_col)
    attention = [
        ("Losing money", "rank_loss",
         [("Price", "retail_price", "money"),
          ("Cost", "total_cost", "money"),
          ("Should be", "suggested_price", "money"),
          ("Margin", "margin", "percent")]),
        ("Review overdue", "rank_review",
         [("Price", "retail_price", "money"),
          ("Last review", "reviewed", "date"),
          ("Due", "next_review", "date"),
          ("Units sold", "units_sold", "int")]),
        ("Re-order", "rank_reorder",
         [("On hand", "on_hand", "number"),
          ("Re-order at", "reorder_point", "number"),
          ("Order qty", "reorder_qty", "number"),
          ("Order cost", "order_cost", "money")]),
    ]
    for title, rank_key, extras in attention:
        source = "Materials" if rank_key.startswith("rank_reorder") or \
            rank_key in ("rank_reorder", "rank_out") else "Products"
        r = sheet.subsection(r, title, last_col)
        sheet.row_height(r, 18)
        sheet.write(r, 1, "#", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
        sheet.merge(r, 2, 5, "Item", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
        col = 6
        for label, _key, _style in extras:
            sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, label, fmts.chrome("header"))
            col += 2
        r += 1
        for n in range(1, 6):
            sheet.row_height(r, 17)
            sheet.write(r, 1, n, fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
            sheet.merge(r, 2, 5, "", fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
            sheet.formula(
                r, 2, _expand(flag_list(source, rank_key, "name", n)),
                fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
            col = 6
            for _label, key, style in extras:
                formula = _expand(flag_list(source, rank_key, "name", n,
                                            value_key=key))
                sheet.ws.merge_range(r, col, r, col + 1, "",
                                     fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
                sheet.formula(r, col, formula,
                                       fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
                col += 2
            r += 1
        r += 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- by channel
    r = sheet.section(r, "Trading by channel this month", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    headers = ["Channel", "Orders", "Revenue", "Fees", "Profit", "Margin",
               "Effective fee"]
    for i, head in enumerate(headers):
        col = 1 + i * 2
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    channels = reg["Channels"]
    for n in range(1, 7):
        row_of = channels.first_data_row + n - 1
        name_formula = (f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Channels', 'name')},"
                        f"MATCH({n},{other('Channels', 'rank_channel')},0)),\"\")"
                        if "rank_channel" in [c.key for c in channels.columns]
                        else f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Channels', 'name')},{n}),\"\")")
        chan_cell = f"INDEX({other('Channels', 'name')},{n})"
        orders = (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Sales', 'channel')},{chan_cell},"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&MonthStart,"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&MonthEnd),0)")
        revenue = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'gross')},"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'channel')},{chan_cell},"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&MonthStart,"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&MonthEnd),0)")
        fees = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'fees')},"
                f"{other('Sales', 'channel')},{chan_cell},"
                f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&MonthStart,"
                f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&MonthEnd),0)")
        profit = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'profit')},"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'channel')},{chan_cell},"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&MonthStart,"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&MonthEnd),0)")
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 2, "", fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(
            r, 1, _expand(f"IFERROR({chan_cell},\"\")"),
            fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        for i, (formula, style) in enumerate([
                (orders, "int"), (revenue, "money"), (fees, "money"),
                (profit, "money"),
                (f"IF({revenue}=0,\"\",{profit}/{revenue})", "percent"),
                (f"IF({revenue}=0,\"\",{fees}/{revenue})", "percent")]):
            col = 3 + i * 2
            sheet.ws.merge_range(r, col, r, col + 1, "",
                                 fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
            sheet.formula(r, col, _expand(formula),
                                   fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ by craft
    r = sheet.section(r, "Trading by craft this year", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    for i, head in enumerate(["Craft", "Units", "Revenue", "Profit", "Margin",
                              "Hourly earned"]):
        col = 1 + i * 2
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    for n, craft in enumerate(["Crochet", "Jewelry", "Candles", "Clothing",
                               "Woodworking", "Digital"]):
        units = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'qty')},"
                 f"{other('Sales', 'craft')},\"{craft}\","
                 f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&YearStart,"
                 f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&YearEnd),0)")
        revenue = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'gross')},"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'craft')},\"{craft}\","
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&YearStart,"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&YearEnd),0)")
        profit = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'profit')},"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'craft')},\"{craft}\","
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&YearStart,"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&YearEnd),0)")
        minutes = (f"IFERROR(SUMIFS({other('Sales', 'minutes_total')},"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'craft')},\"{craft}\","
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&YearStart,"
                   f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&YearEnd),0)")
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 2, "", fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.write(r, 1, craft, fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        for i, (formula, style) in enumerate([
                (units, "int"), (revenue, "money"), (profit, "money"),
                (f"IF({revenue}=0,\"\",{profit}/{revenue})", "percent"),
                (f"IF({minutes}=0,\"\",{profit}/({minutes}/60))", "money")]):
            col = 3 + i * 2
            sheet.ws.merge_range(r, col, r, col + 1, "",
                                 fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
            sheet.formula(r, col, _expand(formula),
                                   fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- month by month
    r = sheet.section(r, f"Month by month - {cfg.year}", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    for i, head in enumerate(["Month", "Orders", "Units", "Revenue", "Profit",
                              "Margin", "Against the target"]):
        col = 1 + i * 2
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    for month in range(1, 13):
        start = f"DATE(ReportYear,{month},1)"
        end = f"EOMONTH(DATE(ReportYear,{month},1),0)"
        revenue = _sum("gross", "Sales", start, end)
        profit = _sum("profit", "Sales", start, end)
        units = _sum("qty", "Sales", start, end)
        orders = _count("Sales", start, end)
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 2, "", fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=TEXT({start},"mmm")',
                               fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        for i, (formula, style) in enumerate([
                (orders, "int"), (units, "int"), (revenue, "money"),
                (profit, "money"),
                (f"IF({revenue}=0,\"\",{profit}/{revenue})", "percent"),
                (f"{revenue}-MonthlyRevenueTarget", "money")]):
            col = 3 + i * 2
            sheet.ws.merge_range(r, col, r, col + 1, "",
                                 fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
            sheet.formula(r, col, _expand(formula),
                                   fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- spotlight
    r = sheet.section(r, "Product spotlight", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 24)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 2, "Pick a product", fmts.chrome("form_label"))
    spot_fmt = fmts.cell("id", "input")
    sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 3, r, 5, "", spot_fmt)
    sheet.ws.data_validation(r, 3, r, 5, list_from("ProductIDs"))
    book.define_name("DashProduct", f"='{NAME}'!$D${r + 1}")
    sheet.merge(r, 6, last_col,
                "Every figure below follows the product you pick.",
                fmts.chrome("note"))
    r += 1
    spotlight = [
        ("Product", "name", "text"), ("Craft", "craft", "text"),
        ("Status", "status", "text"), ("Price today", "retail_price", "money"),
        ("Total cost", "total_cost", "money"),
        ("Suggested price", "suggested_price", "money"),
        ("Gap to suggested", "price_gap", "money"),
        ("Profit a unit", "profit", "money"), ("Margin", "margin", "percent"),
        ("Minutes an item", "minutes_used", "number1"),
        ("Effective hourly", "effective_hourly", "money"),
        ("Wage check", "hourly_flag", "text"),
        ("Units sold", "units_sold", "int"), ("Revenue", "revenue", "money"),
        ("Gross profit", "gross_profit", "money"),
        ("Wholesale price", "wholesale_price", "money"),
        ("Wholesale margin", "wholesale_margin", "percent"),
        ("Last sale", "last_sale", "date"),
    ]
    for i, (label, key, style) in enumerate(spotlight):
        col = 1 + (i % 3) * 5
        if i % 3 == 0:
            sheet.row_height(r, 22)
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, label, fmts.chrome("kpi_label"))
        formula = _expand(lookup("DashProduct", other("Products", "id"),
                                 other("Products", key)))
        fmt = fmts.cell(style, "plain")
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, col + 2, r, col + 4, "", fmt)
        sheet.formula(r, col + 2, formula, fmt)
        if i % 3 == 2:
            r += 1
    if len(spotlight) % 3:
        r += 1
    r += 1
    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "A gap to suggested above zero means the listing is priced under what "
        "your own target margin asks for. A wage check that says BELOW MINIMUM "
        "WAGE means an hour of making it earns less than the floor on "
        "Settings - that is a pricing problem, not a productivity one.",
        last_col, height=40)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(FIRST_ROW - 1, 0)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _expand(formula: str) -> str:
    """Make sure a formula body starts with = for write_formula."""
    text = formula.strip()
    if text.startswith("="):
        return text
    return "=" + text


def _tile_row(sheet, row: int, col: int,
              tiles: Sequence[Tuple[str, str, str, str]], span: int = 2) -> int:
    """A row of KPI tiles. Returns the row below them."""
    for i, (label, formula, style, note) in enumerate(tiles):
        sheet.kpi(row, col + i * span, label, _expand(formula), style=style,
                  span=span, note=note)
    return row + 3


def _target_row(sheet, fmts, row: int, col: int, last_col: int,
                targets: Sequence[Tuple[str, str, str, str]]) -> int:
    """Targets next to the actuals, with the gap."""
    for i, (label, name, style, actual) in enumerate(targets):
        start = col + i * 5
        sheet.merge(row, start, start + 1, label, fmts.chrome("label_bold"))
        fmt = fmts.cell(style, "plain")
        sheet.formula(row, start + 2, f"={name}", fmt)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(row, start + 3, row, start + 4, "",
                             fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
        sheet.formula(
            row, start + 3,
            _expand(f"IF({name}=0,\"\",({actual})/{name}-1)"),
            fmts.cell("percent", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.conditional_format(
            row, start + 3, row, start + 4,
            {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
             "format": fmts.cf("warn")})
    return row + 1
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/development.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/development.py sha256:aed866e49f9bbb4c5400416d63b7583bd51d5e4a18499c59ede969d559a8145f -->
````python
"""The Development tab - what it costs to bring something new to market.

A new product is not free before its first sale: pattern drafting, samples,
materials, testing, photography, a photographer, a licence. This tab keeps that
spend in one place, against the hours planned and the hours actually taken, and
sets it next to the target cost and target price the product is aiming at.

`viability` answers the question before the money is spent: at the target price
and the target cost, does the product clear the margin on Settings?
`sales_to_recover` says how many it has to sell before the development spend
comes back - the number that decides whether a new line is worth starting.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, fetch, id_col, list_col, money_col,
                     num_col, product_col, rank_desc, row_ref, samples,
                     spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Development"

SUBTITLE = ("New products, patterns and process work: what it cost, how long "
            "it took, and whether the idea stands up.")

HELP = ("One row per project. Type the hours and the spend as they happen; "
        "the target cost and target price decide whether the idea clears your "
        "margin, and how many sales pay the development back.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    did = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{did}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    planned = f"N({row_ref('hours_planned')})"
    actual = f"N({row_ref('hours_actual')})"
    spend = (f'N({row_ref("labor_cost")})+N({row_ref("material_cost")})'
             f'+N({row_ref("outsourcing")})')
    target_cost = f"N({row_ref('target_cost')})"
    target_price = f"N({row_ref('target_price')})"
    per_unit = f"({target_price}-{target_cost})"

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixDevelopment", trigger="name", width=11.0),
        text_col("name", "Project", 32.0,
                 note="What you are developing. Filling this in starts the row."),
        list_col("type", "Type", "DevTypeList", 15.0),
        product_col(note="The catalog product it belongs to, if it has one "
                         "yet."),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        list_col("stage", "Stage", "DevStageList", 14.0),
        date_col("start", "Started", 13.0),
        date_col("due", "Due", 13.0),
        calc_col("days_left", "Days left",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("due")}=""),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("due")})-TodayDate)', 11.0, "int",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"}]),
        list_col("status", "Status", "DevStatusList", 13.0),
        calc_col("schedule_flag", "Schedule",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("due")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(AND(TodayDate>N({row_ref("due")}),'
                 f'NOT(EXACT(TRIM({row_ref("status")}),"Done"))),"OVERDUE",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("due")})-TodayDate<=7,"DUE SOON","ON TRACK")))',
                 13.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OVERDUE", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DUE SOON", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ON TRACK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        num_col("hours_planned", "Hours planned", 12.0),
        num_col("hours_actual", "Hours actual", 12.0),
        calc_col("hours_variance", "Hours variance",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{actual}-{planned})', 12.0, "number1",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("hours_flag", "Hours check",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({planned}=0,"",'
                 f'IF({actual}>{planned}*1.2,"OVER BUDGET",'
                 f'IF({actual}<{planned}*0.8,"UNDER BUDGET","ON BUDGET"))))',
                 14.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OVER", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ON BUDGET", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("labor_cost", "Labour cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{actual}*LaborCostHour)', 12.0, "money",
                 note="Your hours at the loaded rate on Settings."),
        money_col("material_cost", "Materials & samples", 13.0),
        money_col("outsourcing", "Outside work", 13.0,
                  note="Photographer, tech editor, pattern grader, printing."),
        calc_col("total_spend", "Total spend",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{spend})', 13.0, "money"),
        money_col("target_cost", "Target cost a unit", 13.0,
                  note="What one item should cost once it is in production."),
        money_col("target_price", "Target price", 13.0,
                  note="What it should sell for."),
        calc_col("target_margin", "Target margin",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({target_price}=0,"",'
                 f'{per_unit}/{target_price}))', 12.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("viability", "Viability",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{target_price}=0),"",'
                 f'IF({per_unit}<=0,"LOSES MONEY EVERY SALE",'
                 f'IF({per_unit}/{target_price}<TargetRetailMargin,'
                 f'"WILL NOT MEET THE TARGET","VIABLE")))', 24.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LOSES", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "WILL NOT", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "VIABLE", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("sales_to_recover", "Sales to recover the spend",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{per_unit}<=0),"",'
                 f'ROUNDUP({spend}/{per_unit},0))', 14.0, "int",
                 note="How many it has to sell before the development money "
                      "comes back."),
        calc_col("spend_a_unit", "Spend a unit",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("sales_to_recover")}=""),"",'
                 f'{spend}/N({row_ref("sales_to_recover")}))', 12.0, "money4"),
        calc_col("rank_spend", "rank spend", rank_desc("total_spend"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/digital.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/digital.py sha256:f1743ddd64e5142c75c7a87acec52c74277b617ef0a2c1e4e5fcd09c101412ca -->
````python
"""The Digital calculator.

A download is costed differently from anything else in the shop: it is made
once and sold as many times as it will sell, so the honest unit cost is the
whole investment spread over the units you expect to sell. That is what
`units_forecast` is for, and `cost_a_sale` is the figure the shared craft tail
treats as the material cost.

Minutes a sale are zero, on purpose. The labour went in up front and is inside
`creation_cost`; counting it again on every download would double count it, and
it would make a pattern look like it pays an hourly wage when what it really
does is earn money while you sleep. `break_even_units` is the number that
matters here: how many sales it takes to get the making of the file back.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, craft_tail, date_col, fetch, id_col, int_col,
                     list_col, money_col, num_col, product_col, row_ref,
                     samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Digital"

SUBTITLE = ("Downloads: what a pattern or printable cost to make, spread over "
            "the sales you expect, and when it breaks even.")

HELP = ("Type the hours it took to create the file and how many sales you "
        "expect. The cost a sale, the price your margin asks for and the "
        "number of sales that pays the file back are all calculated.")

#: what a forecast falls back to when nothing is typed
FORECAST_DEFAULT = 100


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    did = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{did}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    units = (f'IF(N({row_ref("units_forecast")})=0,{FORECAST_DEFAULT},'
             f'N({row_ref("units_forecast")}))')

    material_expr = f'N({row_ref("cost_a_sale")})'

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixDigital", trigger="file_name", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date published", 13.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        text_col("file_name", "File / title", 30.0,
                 note="What the download is. Filling this in starts the row."),
        list_col("type", "Type", "DigitalTypeList", 16.0),
        list_col("format", "Format", "DigitalFormatList", 11.0),
        int_col("pages", "Pages / files", 11.0),
        num_col("creation_hours", "Hours to create", 12.0,
                note="Writing, photographing, laying out, testing - the whole "
                     "job, once."),
        int_col("units_forecast", "Sales expected", 12.0,
                note=f"Blank assumes {FORECAST_DEFAULT} sales."),
        calc_col("units_used", "Sales used",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{units})', 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("creation_cost", "Cost to create",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("creation_hours")})'
                 f'*LaborCostHour)', 13.0, "money",
                 note="Your hours at the loaded rate on Settings."),
        money_col("software_cost", "Software & assets", 13.0,
                  note="Fonts, mockups, stock, a plugin licence - the total "
                       "for this file."),
        money_col("hosting_cost", "Hosting & tools", 13.0,
                  note="Share of the store subscription and file hosting."),
        calc_col("total_investment", "Total investment",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("creation_cost")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("software_cost")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("hosting_cost")}))', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("cost_a_sale", "Cost a sale",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("total_investment")})/{units})',
                 12.0, "money4",
                 note="The whole investment spread over the sales you expect."),
        calc_col("minutes", "Minutes a sale",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",0)', 11.0, "number1",
                 note="Zero on purpose: a download takes no time per sale. "
                      "The labour is already inside the cost a sale."),
        calc_col("break_even_units", "Sales to break even",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("price")})=0,"",'
                 f'ROUNDUP(N({row_ref("total_investment")})'
                 f'/N({row_ref("price")}),0)))', 13.0, "int",
                 note="How many sales pay the file back at today's price."),
        money_col("price", "Price today", 12.0),
        list_col("difficulty", "Difficulty", "DifficultyList", 12.0),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]
    cols += craft_tail(material_expr, has_difficulty=False)

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/events.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/events.py sha256:4dd5f4b5ddc074b158057f13c01bf2bd1ed11eadfbc33799ff9489c537b8f67f -->
````python
"""The Events tab - fairs, markets and pop-ups, costed properly.

A craft fair looks profitable at four in the afternoon with an empty table.
This tab costs the whole day: the table fee, the travel, the nights away, the
hours setting up and the hours standing there at your own loaded rate, the card
fees, the packaging, and what the items that sold actually cost you.

`profit_an_hour` is the figure that decides whether to book again - a fair that
takes 600 and pays 400 for fourteen hours on its feet is paying less than the
minimum wage, and the stock left over does not change that. `sell_through`
shows how much of what you loaded in the van came home again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, id_col, int_col, list_col, money_col,
                     num_col, rank_desc, row_ref, samples, spec_defaults,
                     text_col, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Events"

SUBTITLE = ("Fairs, markets and pop-ups: what the day cost, what it took, and "
            "what it paid an hour.")

HELP = ("One row per event. Type the fees, the travel and the hours; the "
        "labour cost, card fees and packaging are calculated, and so is the "
        "profit an hour - the number that decides whether to book it again.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    eid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{eid}=""'
    setup = f"N({row_ref('setup_hours')})"
    staff = f"N({row_ref('staff_hours')})"
    revenue = f"N({row_ref('revenue')})"
    units = f"N({row_ref('units_sold')})"
    hours = f"({setup}+{staff})"
    card_fees = (f'({revenue}*(ProcessingPercent+TransactionFee)'
                 f'+{units}*ProcessingFixed)')
    total_cost = (f'N({row_ref("table_fee")})+N({row_ref("travel")})'
                  f'+N({row_ref("accommodation")})+N({row_ref("labor_cost")})'
                  f'+N({row_ref("card_fees")})'
                  f'+N({row_ref("packaging_cost")})+N({row_ref("cogs")})')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixEvent", trigger="name", width=11.0),
        text_col("name", "Event", 32.0,
                 note="What it is called. Filling this in starts the row."),
        list_col("type", "Type", "EventTypeList", 16.0),
        list_col("status", "Status", "EventStatusList", 13.0),
        date_col("date", "Date", 13.0),
        date_col("end_date", "Ends", 13.0),
        int_col("days", "Days", 8.0),
        text_col("location", "Where", 24.0),
        money_col("table_fee", "Table fee", 12.0),
        money_col("travel", "Travel & fuel", 12.0),
        money_col("accommodation", "Nights away", 13.0),
        num_col("setup_hours", "Setup hours", 11.0,
                note="Your own hours: loading in, setting up, packing down."),
        num_col("staff_hours", "Staff hours", 11.0,
                note="Anyone else on the table, paid or not."),
        calc_col("total_hours", "Total hours",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{hours})', 11.0, "number1"),
        calc_col("labor_cost", "Labour cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{setup}*LaborCostHour+{staff}*EmployeeRate'
                 f'*(1+PayrollBurden))', 12.0, "money",
                 note="Your hours at the loaded rate, staff hours at the "
                      "employee rate on Settings."),
        calc_col("card_fees", "Card fees",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{card_fees})', 12.0, "money",
                 note="The reader's percentage plus the fixed part per sale."),
        int_col("units_sold", "Units sold", 11.0),
        money_col("revenue", "Revenue", 13.0,
                  note="Everything the table took, before fees."),
        money_col("cogs", "Cost of what sold", 14.0,
                  note="What the items that sold cost you to make - not the "
                       "whole van load."),
        calc_col("cogs_check", "Cost check",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(AND({units}>0,N({row_ref("cogs")})=0),'
                 f'"NO COST TYPED FOR WHAT SOLD",""))', 22.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "NO COST", "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("packaging_cost", "Packaging",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{units}*DefaultPackaging)', 12.0, "money"),
        money_col("inventory_cost", "Value of stock taken", 15.0,
                  note="What the van load is worth - information, not a cost."),
        money_col("inventory_left", "Value brought home", 15.0),
        calc_col("sell_through", "Sold of what you took",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("inventory_cost")})=0,"",'
                 f'(N({row_ref("inventory_cost")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("inventory_left")}))'
                 f'/N({row_ref("inventory_cost")})))', 13.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("total_cost", "Total cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{total_cost})', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("profit", "Profit",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{revenue}-{total_cost})', 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("margin", "Margin",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({revenue}=0,"",'
                 f'({revenue}-{total_cost})/{revenue}))', 10.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("revenue_an_hour", "Revenue an hour",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({hours}=0,"",{revenue}/{hours}))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("profit_an_hour", "Profit an hour",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({hours}=0,"",'
                 f'({revenue}-{total_cost})/{hours}))', 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("cost_a_unit", "Cost a unit sold",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({units}=0,"",{total_cost}/{units}))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("verdict", "Book again?",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{revenue}=0),"",'
                 f'IF({revenue}-{total_cost}<0,"LOST MONEY",'
                 f'IF(({revenue}-{total_cost})/{hours}<MinimumWage,'
                 f'"BELOW THE MINIMUM WAGE","WORTH BOOKING")))', 24.0,
                 "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LOST", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "BELOW", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "WORTH", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("rank_profit", "rank profit", rank_desc("profit"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/help_tab.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/help_tab.py sha256:1ccfcac9d5ff5d4758e7e836f63070a48a7eddc084f882945167d3e4e9000466 -->
````python
"""The Help tab - the manual that lives inside the workbook.

Three kinds of question get answered here, in this order: how the pricing maths
works, what the words mean, and what to do when a number looks wrong. The
glossary is deliberately plain - every term is defined the way it is used on the
tabs, not the way a textbook defines it.

Nothing on this page calculates. It is the one sheet where reading is the work.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from .common import CRAFT_LIST

P = Palette

NAME = "Help"

SUBTITLE = ("How the pricing maths works, what the words mean, and what to do "
            f"when a number looks wrong.")

HELP = ("Read top to bottom once. Come back to the glossary and the "
        "troubleshooting table whenever something does not add up.")

LAST_COL = 12

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# the maths, in words
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MATHS: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("The price formula",
     "Price = (cost of one item + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee "
     "rate). The division is the whole trick: it grosses the cost up so that "
     "after the marketplace takes its percentage and you take your margin, "
     "what is left still covers the cost. Adding a percentage on top does "
     "not do that."),
    ("Why the fee rate is in the denominator",
     "A percentage fee is charged on the selling price, not on the cost. If "
     "you added 6.5% to the cost you would be short every time. Dividing by "
     "(1 - fee rate) is what makes the fee pay for itself."),
    ("Cost of one item",
     "Materials from the bill of materials, plus labour (minutes over sixty "
     "times the true cost of your hour), plus packaging, plus any postage you "
     "absorb, plus your share of overhead. Every part is on its own tab and "
     "every part is visible on Products."),
    ("The true cost of your hour",
     "What you pay yourself, loaded: HourlyRate x (1 + PayrollBurden). It "
     "sits on Settings as LaborCostHour. The burden covers the tax, insurance "
     "and admin that come with an hour of work but never show on a payslip."),
    ("Overhead, three ways",
     "Settings asks how you want the rent, the tools and the subscriptions "
     "spread: per hour of making, per unit made, or as a monthly total "
     "divided by the units you expect to make that month. The number that "
     "reaches Products is OverheadPerUnit either way."),
    ("Margin versus markup",
     "Margin is profit as a share of the price; markup is profit as a share "
     "of the cost. A 50% markup is a 33% margin. This workbook thinks in "
     "margin, because that is what a marketplace fee comes off."),
    ("Rounding",
     "The rounding rule on Settings turns $18.41 into $18.99 or $19.00 or "
     "leaves it alone. It is applied to the model's answer, so the price you "
     "see is a price a human would actually charge."),
    ("Wholesale price",
     "Retail price x (1 - WholesaleDiscount), rounded the same way. The "
     "Wholesale Calculator then checks what that leaves you after the trade "
     "fee, because a 40% discount on a thin retail margin can be a loss."),
    ("Effective hourly",
     "Profit an item divided by the hours it takes to make one. It is the "
     "only figure that tells you whether a product is worth your time rather "
     "than merely profitable on paper."),
    ("Break-even",
     "Fixed costs divided by the profit on one item: how many you have to "
     "sell before the month stops losing money. The Profit & Break-Even tab "
     "runs it six ways so you can see how sensitive it is."),
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# glossary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

GLOSSARY: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("Bill of materials (BOM)",
     "The list of materials one product uses, with a quantity for each. It "
     "lives on Material Usage and feeds the cost on Products."),
    ("Batch",
     "A run of the same product made at once. Batches spread setup time and "
     "waste over the units in the run, which lowers the cost of each."),
    ("Bundled product",
     "Two or more products sold together as one listing. Bundles re-price "
     "from their lines, never from a number typed by hand."),
    ("Contribution",
     "Price minus everything that moves with the sale: cost and fees. It is "
     "what each unit contributes to the fixed costs."),
    ("Craft tab",
     f"The six making calculators - {', '.join(CRAFT_LIST[:3])} and "
     f"{', '.join(CRAFT_LIST[3:])}. Each builds a product from the parts "
     "that craft actually uses and writes the result into the catalog."),
    ("Defect rate",
     "The share of a batch that fails quality control. It raises the cost of "
     "the pieces that pass."),
    ("Effective hourly",
     "What an hour of making this product earns you after costs and fees."),
    ("Fixed fees",
     "The fees that do not move with the price: a listing fee, a processing "
     "fee, a flat charge. They sit in the numerator of the price formula."),
    ("Loaded hourly rate",
     "Your hourly rate plus the payroll burden - the real cost of an hour."),
    ("Margin",
     "Profit as a share of the selling price. MarginWarning on Settings is "
     "the level below which a product is flagged THIN."),
    ("Offsite ads fee",
     "The extra percentage a marketplace takes when it brings the sale "
     "itself. It is applied to the share of sales you expect it to bring."),
    ("Overhead",
     "Costs that do not belong to one product: rent, tools, subscriptions, "
     "insurance. Spread by the method chosen on Settings."),
    ("Postage you absorb",
     "The part of the shipping cost you pay rather than charge. If the "
     "listing says free shipping, all of it is absorbed."),
    ("Price gap",
     "The difference between the price you charge and the price the model "
     "asks for. Positive means the listing is under-priced."),
    ("Productive hours",
     "The hours a month you actually spend making, not the hours you work."),
    ("Rank column",
     "A hidden column on a register that numbers its rows by some value. The "
     "Dashboard and Reports use it to find the top five without an array "
     "formula."),
    ("Re-order point",
     "The stock level at which a material should be ordered again, set from "
     "how much you use and how long an order takes."),
    ("Scrap",
     "Material lost in making - offcuts, spilled wax, a dropped bead. The "
     "scrap percentage raises the quantity bought, not the quantity used."),
    ("Scenario",
     "One product priced at several target margins side by side. The "
     "Scenarios tab shows five plus the price you charge today."),
    ("Suggested price",
     "What the formula asks for after rounding. It is a recommendation, not "
     "an override - your retail price stays yours until you change it."),
    ("Trade discount",
     "The percentage off retail a wholesale customer gets. Set per customer, "
     "defaulting to WholesaleDiscount on Settings."),
    ("Units per month",
     "How many items you expect to make in a month. It drives the per-unit "
     "share of overhead, so it matters more than it looks."),
    ("Waste",
     "Material or product that never earns: spoilage, seconds, returns that "
     "cannot be resold. The Waste Log costs each entry and Reports totals it."),
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# how to
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

HOW_TO: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("Price a new product",
     "1. Add it on Products (or on its craft tab, which fills Products for "
     "you). 2. List its materials on Material Usage. 3. Record the time on "
     "Labor, or use the minutes the craft tab calculated. 4. Read the "
     "suggested price and set your retail price."),
    ("Check whether an item is worth making",
     "Open Products, find its Effective hourly and its flag. If the flag says "
     "LOSS, the price does not cover the cost and fees. If the hourly is "
     "below the minimum wage on Settings, it covers them but not your time."),
    ("Prepare for a craft fair",
     "Events tab: enter the stall fee, your hours and what you expect to "
     "sell. It returns profit, profit an hour and a verdict. Compare the "
     "verdicts before you book the same fair twice."),
    ("Quote a shop",
     "Wholesale Customers for the shop and its terms, then Print Quote: pick "
     "the shop, type the lines, print one page. The trade discount, tax and "
     "totals are already worked out."),
    ("Run a promotion without losing money",
     "Promotions tab: it takes the discount off the retail price and shows "
     "the profit and margin left. If the margin goes below MarginWarning it "
     "says so before you commit."),
    ("Find out what is eating the margin",
     "Reports: the by-category table shows where the money is, the worst "
     "margin table shows which products are dragging, and the waste figure "
     "shows what never earned anything at all."),
    ("See a year at a glance",
     "Reports, month by month, and the Dashboard for this month. Both follow "
     "the date on your computer, so neither goes stale."),
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# troubleshooting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

TROUBLE: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("I cannot type in a cell",
     "That cell is calculated. Every sheet is protected so that formulas "
     "cannot be overwritten by accident; the cells you are meant to fill are "
     "shaded. To unprotect a sheet: Review, Unprotect Sheet, password "
     "premium."),
    ("A number looks wrong",
     "Follow it back. Every calculated cell is a formula you can click and "
     "read: Formulas, Trace Precedents shows exactly which cells feed it. "
     "Almost always the answer is a blank input upstream - a missing cost, a "
     "missing minute count, a channel with no fee rate."),
    ("A dropdown is missing or empty",
     "Dropdowns read the Lists tab and the registers. If a product dropdown "
     "is empty there are no products yet; if a list is missing, check the "
     "Lists tab has not been overtyped."),
    ("The top-five tables are blank",
     "They need at least one row with a value on the register they read. "
     "They also need the hidden rank columns - unhide columns on Products if "
     "you hid them and the tables will come back."),
    ("Dates look like numbers",
     "The cell has lost its date format. Select it and apply a date format; "
     "the value underneath is fine."),
    ("My margins changed overnight",
     "The fee schedule is date sensitive: FeesReviewed on Settings counts the "
     "days since you last checked your marketplace's fees, and FeeStale says "
     "when that has gone past FeeReviewDays. Nothing in the workbook changes "
     "your fees by itself."),
    ("Printing cuts columns off",
     "Every sheet is set to fit one page wide with its own print area. If you "
     "added columns past the print area, set a new one: Page Layout, Print "
     "Area, Set Print Area."),
    ("Excel offers to repair the file",
     "It should not. This workbook is written with formulas Excel 2010 "
     "understands and no dynamic arrays. If it ever happens, keep a copy and "
     "tell us which version of Excel you are on."),
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# compatibility and the small print
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

COMPAT: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("Excel versions",
     "Excel 2010 and later, on Windows and on the Mac, plus LibreOffice "
     "Calc, Google Sheets and Numbers. Every formula is written the "
     "old-fashioned way: no XLOOKUP, no LET, no IFS, no dynamic arrays, no "
     "spill."),
    ("Macros and scripts",
     "None. The file is a plain .xlsx, so no security prompt and nothing "
     "that a work computer will refuse to open."),
    ("Cloud",
     "It works on OneDrive, SharePoint, Google Drive and Dropbox. On the "
     "web versions of Excel the formulas calculate the same way; only "
     "printing and protection behave slightly differently."),
    ("Protection",
     "Sheets are protected with the password premium so formulas survive. "
     "Protection is a guard rail, not encryption - it does not hide "
     "anything, and you can remove it in two clicks."),
    ("Your data",
     "Everything lives in this one file on your own machine or your own "
     "cloud folder. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing phones home."),
    ("Currency and units",
     "Settings changes the currency symbol and the units of measure. The "
     "maths does not care which you use, as long as it is the same "
     "throughout."),
]


def _height(text: str, chars: int = 96) -> int:
    """Row height for a wrapped line of text."""
    lines = max(1, -(-len(text) // chars))
    return 13 * lines + 6


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary_mid,
                        landscape=True)
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, LAST_COL, badge="Read me")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 3, 20.0)
    sheet.set_col(4, LAST_COL, 13.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    def pair(row: int, question: str, answer: str,
             q_fmt=None, a_fmt=None) -> int:
        sheet.row_height(row, _height(answer))
        sheet.merge(row, 1, 3, question,
                    q_fmt or fmts.chrome("label_bold"))
        sheet.merge(row, 4, LAST_COL, answer,
                    a_fmt or fmts.chrome("label"))
        return row + 1

    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, LAST_COL, height=28)

    r = sheet.section(r, "The pricing maths, in plain words", LAST_COL)
    for question, answer in MATHS:
        r = pair(r, question, answer)
    r += 1

    r = sheet.section(r, "Glossary", LAST_COL)
    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Every term the tabs use, defined the way it is "
                            "used here", LAST_COL)
    for term, meaning in GLOSSARY:
        r = pair(r, term, meaning)
    r += 1

    r = sheet.section(r, "How to", LAST_COL)
    for task, steps in HOW_TO:
        r = pair(r, task, steps)
    r += 1

    r = sheet.section(r, "When something does not add up", LAST_COL)
    for symptom, fix in TROUBLE:
        r = pair(r, symptom, fix)
    r += 1

    r = sheet.section(r, "Compatibility and the small print", LAST_COL)
    for topic, text in COMPAT:
        r = pair(r, topic, text)
    r += 1

    r = sheet.section(r, "Where each thing lives", LAST_COL)
    groups: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
        ("Set up", "Start Here, Settings, Lists, Help"),
        ("What you sell", "Products, Variations, Bundles, Bundle Lines, "
                          "Development"),
        ("What it costs", "Materials, Material Usage, Labor, Packaging, "
                          "Shipping, Overhead, Waste Log"),
        ("What it should cost", "Retail Calculator, Wholesale Calculator, "
                                "Profit & Break-Even, Scenarios"),
        ("Making it", "Crochet, Jewelry, Candles, Clothing, Woodworking, "
                      "Digital, Batches"),
        ("Selling it", "Sales, Channels, Promotions, Price History, "
                       "Competitors, Events"),
        ("Trade", "Wholesale Customers, Wholesale Orders, Print Quote"),
        ("Reading it back", "Dashboard, Reports, Print Costing, Print Order"),
    ]
    for group, tabs in groups:
        r = pair(r, group, tabs)
    r += 1

    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        f"{cfg.product_name} - version {cfg.version}, created by {cfg.author}. "
        f"Currency {cfg.currency_symbol} ({cfg.currency_code}). Every figure "
        f"in this "
        f"workbook is calculated from your own inputs; nothing is estimated "
        f"behind your back and nothing leaves the file.",
        LAST_COL, height=44)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(4, 0)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, LAST_COL)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/jewelry.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/jewelry.py sha256:a4a1350a94187bd89bf6319ca2f28eb0a5102e585999e6ea560c6011c62f932f -->
````python
"""The Jewelry calculator.

One row per piece: the metal, the stones and what they cost, findings, wire,
chain, any plating, and the minutes at the bench. The shared craft tail turns
that into the cost of one item, the price the target margin asks for, and what
an hour of bench work pays.

Stone costs are typed for the piece (`stone_cost`) because a strand is bought
by the lot and used across several designs; `cost_a_stone` divides it back out
so the next design can be costed from the same strand.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, craft_tail, date_col, fetch, id_col, int_col,
                     list_col, money_col, num_col, product_col, row_ref,
                     samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Jewelry"

SUBTITLE = ("Jewellery: metal, stones, findings and bench time, costed to one "
            "finished piece.")

HELP = ("Type what the piece is made of and what the stones and findings "
        "cost. Minutes are for one piece. The columns to the right of 'Price "
        "today' are calculated - including the hourly wage the piece actually "
        "pays, which is where most jewellery pricing goes wrong.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    jid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{jid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    stones = f"N({row_ref('stones')})"
    minutes = row_ref("minutes")

    material_expr = (f'N({row_ref("stone_cost")})+N({row_ref("findings")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("wire")})+N({row_ref("chain")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("plating")})')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixJewelry", trigger="design", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date made", 13.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        text_col("design", "Design", 30.0,
                 note="What the piece is. Filling this in starts the row."),
        list_col("metal", "Metal", "MetalList", 17.0),
        int_col("stones", "Stones", 9.0),
        money_col("stone_cost", "Stone cost", 12.0,
                  note="What the stones in THIS piece cost - divide a strand "
                       "out if you bought a lot."),
        calc_col("cost_a_stone", "Cost a stone",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({stones}=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("stone_cost")})/{stones}))', 12.0, "money4"),
        money_col("findings", "Findings", 12.0,
                  note="Ear wires, clasps, jump rings, settings."),
        money_col("wire", "Wire", 11.0),
        num_col("chain_inches", "Chain (in)", 11.0,
                note="How much chain the piece takes."),
        money_col("chain", "Chain cost", 12.0),
        money_col("plating", "Plating / finishing", 13.0,
                  note="Outside work: plating, tumbling, engraving."),
        calc_col("findings_total", "Metal & findings total",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("findings")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("wire")})+N({row_ref("chain")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("plating")}))', 14.0, "money"),
        num_col("minutes", "Minutes", 10.0,
                note="Bench time for one piece."),
        calc_col("hours", "Hours",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({minutes})/60)', 9.0, "number"),
        list_col("difficulty", "Difficulty", "DifficultyList", 12.0),
````
