````python
        list_col("size", "Size", "SizeList", 11.0),
        yesno_col("hallmarked", "Hallmarked", 10.0),
        money_col("price", "Price today", 12.0),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]
    cols += craft_tail(material_expr)

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/labor.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/labor.py sha256:bf3641628479da313fc01bdebdc7d261eba2e459fcf191a480c2d3f6aa923ad9 -->
````python
"""The Labor tab - every hour that goes into the shop.

Two kinds of row live here and the tab tells them apart on its own:

* a row with a product against it is **production time** - it belongs to that
  product's cost, and the Products tab already counts it through the craft
  tabs or the minutes typed there;
* a row with no product is **shop time** - photography, listing copy, packing,
  fair setup. That is overhead, and `overhead_share` totals it so the monthly
  overhead figure on Settings can be checked against what was really spent.

`loaded_cost` is the honest number: the rate you pay plus the payroll burden
from Settings. `rate_check` flags anything under the minimum wage, including
your own rate if you have been underpaying yourself.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, fetch, id_col, int_col, list_col,
                     money_col, num_col, product_col, row_ref, samples,
                     spec_defaults, text_col, time_col, wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Labor"

SUBTITLE = ("Time spent making and time spent running the shop, what it cost "
            "and where it belongs.")

HELP = ("Type the date, who worked, the task and the hours. Add a product and "
        "the time counts as production; leave it blank and the time counts as "
        "shop overhead. The rate defaults to nothing - type it, or the "
        "workbook will assume the row is free.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    lid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{lid}=""'
    hours = f"N({row_ref('hours')})"
    rate = f"N({row_ref('rate')})"
    cost = f"{hours}*{rate}"
    product = row_ref("product")

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixLabor", trigger="employee", width=11.0,
               note="Numbers itself once a name is typed."),
        date_col("date", "Date", 13.0),
        time_col("start_time", "Start", 10.0, note="Optional - for the record."),
        time_col("end_time", "Finish", 10.0, note="Optional - for the record."),
        text_col("employee", "Who", 20.0,
                 note="You, a maker you pay, a contractor, a helper."),
        list_col("employment_type", "Type", "EmploymentTypeList", 13.0),
        list_col("task", "Task", "TaskList", 20.0),
        product_col(note="Leave blank for shop time that is not one product."),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        calc_col("craft", "Craft",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "craft", product)})', 13.0, "text"),
        num_col("hours", "Hours", 9.0, note="Decimal hours: 1.5 = 90 minutes."),
        calc_col("minutes", "Minutes", f'IF({has_id},"",{hours}*60)', 10.0,
                 "number1"),
        money_col("rate", "Rate an hour", 11.0,
                  note="What this person is paid, before on-costs."),
        calc_col("cost", "Cost", f'IF({has_id},"",{cost})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("burden", "Payroll on-costs",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{cost}*PayrollBurden)', 12.0, "money",
                 note="Tax, insurance and holiday pay at the rate on Settings."),
        calc_col("loaded_cost", "True cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{cost}*(1+PayrollBurden))', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("rate_check", "Rate check",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({rate}=0,"NO RATE TYPED",'
                 f'IF({rate}<MinimumWage,"BELOW MIN WAGE","OK")))',
                 16.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "BELOW", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "NO RATE", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        text_col("batch", "Batch", 12.0,
                 note="Optional - the Batches tab ID if this was one batch."),
        calc_col("is_production", "Production?",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({product}="","No","Yes"))', 11.0, "flag",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "Yes", "fmt": "good"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "No", "fmt": "info"}]),
        calc_col("overhead_share", "Shop time cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({product}="",N({row_ref("loaded_cost")}),0))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 note="Adds up to the real overhead of running the shop."),
        calc_col("month", "Month",
                 f'IF({row_ref("date")}="","",TEXT(N({row_ref("date")}),"yyyy-mm"))',
                 10.0, "text"),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/lists.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/lists.py sha256:ede9b0c06ee724c1482a8f89151565a1a97aeb3e46ab26deab1aef25111f7c66 -->
````python
"""The Lists tab.

Every drop down in the workbook points at a defined name that lives here, so a
maker can add "Ceramics & pottery" or a new waste reason in one place and it
appears in every list on every tab. Below the lists sit the small factor tables
the calculators read: unit conversions, how much harder a Hard pattern is than
an Easy one, what a size L adds to a pattern, what a 24 hour rush costs, and
the margins the Scenarios tab compares.

The defined names are created by this module because only the workbook can
register them, and only after the values are on the sheet.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import (PRICING_SCENARIOS, ROUNDING_RULES, UNIT_CONVERSIONS,
                      VOLUME_STEPS, Config, Palette)
from ..layout import col_letter, quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from .common import (DIFFICULTY_FACTORS, LISTS, LIST_USED_BY, RUSH_FACTORS,
                     SIZE_FACTORS)

P = Palette

NAME = "Lists"

#: how many lists sit side by side in one band
BLOCK_COLS = 9
#: column the first list starts in (column A is a narrow gutter)
FIRST_COL = 1

SUBTITLE = ("Every drop down in the workbook reads from this tab. Add a value "
            "here and it appears in the list on every other tab.")

HELP = ("Type your own values in the cream cells - the lists grow as you add "
        "rows. Do not rename the tab: the drop downs point at it by name.")


def _chunks(items: Sequence[Any], size: int):
    for i in range(0, len(items), size):
        yield list(items[i:i + size])


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.accent,
                        landscape=True)
    last_col = FIRST_COL + BLOCK_COLS + 1
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col, badge=f"{len(LISTS)} lists")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 3.0)
    for i in range(BLOCK_COLS):
        sheet.set_col(FIRST_COL + i, FIRST_COL + i, 21.0)
    sheet.set_col(FIRST_COL + BLOCK_COLS, last_col, 16.0)

    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=30)

    items = list(LISTS.items())
    for block in _chunks(items, BLOCK_COLS):
        r = sheet.section(r, "Drop down lists", last_col, first_col=0)
        sheet.row_height(r, 26)
        longest = max(len(values) for _n, values in block)
        for offset, (list_name, values) in enumerate(block):
            col = FIRST_COL + offset
            used_by = LIST_USED_BY.get(list_name, "")
            sheet.ws.write_comment(
                r, col,
                f"{list_name}\nUsed on: {used_by or 'several tabs'}\n"
                f"{len(values)} values.",
                {"author": cfg.author, "width": 240, "height": 90})
            sheet.write(r, col, list_name.replace("List", ""),
                        fmts.chrome("header_left"))
            for i, value in enumerate(values):
                sheet.write(r + 1 + i, col, value,
                            fmts.cell("text", "input"))
            for i in range(len(values), longest):
                sheet.write(r + 1 + i, col, None, fmts.cell("text", "input"))
            first_excel = r + 2                     # 1 based
            last_excel = first_excel + max(len(values), 1) + 14
            book.define_name(
                list_name,
                f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!${col_letter(col)}${first_excel}"
                f":${col_letter(col)}${last_excel}")
        r += longest + 18
        r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ factor tables
    r = sheet.section(r, "Factor tables the calculators read", last_col,
                      first_col=0)
    r = sheet.note(r, "Change a factor and every calculator that uses it "
                      "follows - a Hard pattern costs 35% more time than an "
                      "Easy one by default.", last_col, height=28)

    tables: List[Tuple[str, str, List[str], List[Tuple[str, float]], str]] = [
        ("UnitNames", "Unit conversions", ["Unit", "Base unit", "Factor"],
         [(u, 0.0) for u, _b, _f in UNIT_CONVERSIONS], "units"),
        ("DiffNames", "Difficulty factors", ["Difficulty", "Factor"],
         DIFFICULTY_FACTORS, "factors"),
        ("SizeNames", "Size factors", ["Size", "Factor"], SIZE_FACTORS,
         "factors"),
        ("RushNames", "Rush factors", ["Rush", "Factor"], RUSH_FACTORS,
         "factors"),
        ("ScenarioNames", "Pricing scenarios", ["Scenario", "Margin"],
         [(k, float(v)) for k, v in PRICING_SCENARIOS.items()], "factors"),
        ("VolumeSteps", "Forecast volumes", ["Units a month"],
         [(str(v), 0.0) for v in VOLUME_STEPS], "factors"),
        ("RoundingRules", "Rounding rules", ["Rule"],
         [(rule, 0.0) for rule in ROUNDING_RULES], "factors"),
    ]

    for anchor, title, headers, rows, kind in tables:
        r = sheet.subsection(r, title, last_col, first_col=0)
        for i, head in enumerate(headers):
            sheet.write(r, FIRST_COL + i, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
        sheet.row_height(r, 20)
        first_excel = r + 2
        if kind == "units":
            for i, (unit, _base, factor) in enumerate(UNIT_CONVERSIONS):
                base = _base
                sheet.write(r + 1 + i, FIRST_COL, unit,
                            fmts.cell("text", "input"))
                sheet.write(r + 1 + i, FIRST_COL + 1, base,
                            fmts.cell("text", "input"))
                sheet.write(r + 1 + i, FIRST_COL + 2, factor,
                            fmts.cell("number", "input"))
            last_excel = first_excel + len(UNIT_CONVERSIONS) - 1
            _define(book, "UnitNames", FIRST_COL, first_excel, last_excel)
            _define(book, "UnitBase", FIRST_COL + 1, first_excel, last_excel)
            _define(book, "UnitFactor", FIRST_COL + 2, first_excel,
                    last_excel)
            r += len(UNIT_CONVERSIONS) + 2
        else:
            for i, (label, factor) in enumerate(rows):
                sheet.write(r + 1 + i, FIRST_COL, label,
                            fmts.cell("text", "input"))
                if headers[-1] != "Rule":
                    sheet.write(r + 1 + i, FIRST_COL + 1, factor,
                                fmts.cell("number", "input"))
            last_excel = first_excel + max(len(rows) - 1, 0)
            _define(book, anchor, FIRST_COL, first_excel, last_excel)
            if headers[-1] != "Rule":
                _define(book, anchor.replace("Names", "Factors")
                        if anchor.endswith("Names") else anchor + "Factors",
                        FIRST_COL + 1, first_excel, last_excel)
            r += len(rows) + 2

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(4, 0)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def _define(book, name: str, col: int, first_excel: int,
            last_excel: int) -> None:
    letter = col_letter(col)
    book.define_name(
        name,
        f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!${letter}${first_excel}:${letter}${last_excel}")
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/material_usage.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/material_usage.py sha256:1e1335ac858102aa9898a1d248d76aea542dd76ad665baab552113c05ce85cc5 -->
````python
"""The Material Usage tab - bills of materials.

One row per material per product: how much of it one finished item takes and
what that costs once the cutting loss is added. The Products tab adds these
rows up to get `material_cost`, so this is where a price really comes from.

`duplicate_flag` catches the mistake that quietly doubles a cost - the same
material listed twice against the same product.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (NO_MATCH, calc_col, fetch, id_col, list_col_inline,
                     material_col, num_col, pct_col, product_col, rank_desc,
                     row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Material Usage"

SUBTITLE = ("Bills of materials: what each product is made of and what the "
            "materials cost.")

HELP = ("Pick a product, pick a material, type how much one item takes. The "
        "unit cost arrives from the Materials tab and the scrap allowance "
        "lifts it to what the material really costs. Products adds every row "
        "for one product together.")

SOURCES = ["Bill of materials", "Craft tab", "One off", "Estimate",
           "Sample / prototype"]


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    pid = row_ref("product")
    mid = row_ref("material")
    empty = f'OR({pid}="",{mid}="")'
    qty = f"N({row_ref('qty')})"
    scrap = f"N({row_ref('scrap_pct')})"
    unit_cost = f"N({row_ref('unit_cost')})"
    cost = f"{qty}*(1+{scrap})*{unit_cost}"

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixUsage", trigger="material", width=11.0,
               note="Numbers itself once a material is picked."),
        product_col(note="Which product this line belongs to."),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({pid}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "name", pid)})',
                 26.0, "text"),
        calc_col("craft", "Craft",
                 f'IF({pid}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "craft", pid)})',
                 13.0, "text"),
        material_col(note="Which material this line uses."),
        calc_col("material_name", "Material",
                 f'IF({mid}="","",{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", mid)})',
                 30.0, "text"),
        calc_col("unit", "Unit",
                 f'IF({mid}="","",{fetch("Materials", "id", "unit", mid)})',
                 9.0, "text"),
        calc_col("unit_cost", "Cost a unit",
                 f'IF({mid}="",0,{fetch("Materials", "id", "unit_cost", mid, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4",
                 note="Straight from the Materials tab."),
        num_col("qty", "Qty an item", 11.0,
                note="How much one finished item takes, in the unit above."),
        pct_col("scrap_pct", "Scrap %", 10.0,
                note="Cutting loss, spills, ends that cannot be used."),
        calc_col("qty_with_scrap", "Qty with scrap",
                 f'IF({empty},"",{qty}*(1+{scrap}))', 11.0, "number",
                 note="What actually has to come off the shelf."),
        calc_col("cost", "Line cost",
                 f'IF({empty},"",{cost})', 12.0, "money",
                 note="Qty with scrap times the unit cost."),
        calc_col("batch_cost", "Cost a batch",
                 f'IF({empty},"",{cost}*DefaultBatchSize)', 12.0, "money",
                 note="The default batch size on Settings."),
        list_col_inline("source", "Source", SOURCES, 17.0,
                        note="Where this line came from."),
        calc_col("duplicate_flag", "Check",
                 f'IF({empty},"",IF(COUNTIFS({{product_first}}:{{product_last}},'
                 f'{pid},{{material_first}}:{{material_last}},{mid})>1,'
                 f'"DUPLICATE",""))', 12.0, "status",
                 note="The same material twice on one product doubles the cost.",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DUPLICATE", "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("products_sharing", "Products sharing it",
                 f'IF({mid}="","",COUNTIFS({{material_first}}:{{material_last}},{mid}))',
                 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("rank_for_print", "rank for print",
                 f'IF(OR({pid}="",PrintProduct=""),{NO_MATCH},'
                 f'IF({pid}<>PrintProduct,{NO_MATCH},'
                 f'COUNTIFS({{product_first}}:{{product_last}},PrintProduct,'
                 f'{{id_first}}:{{id_last}},"<="&{row_ref("id")})))',
                 9.0, "int", hidden=True,
                 note="Hidden - the Print Costing sheet lists a product's "
                      "bill of materials from this."),
        calc_col("rank_cost", "rank cost", rank_desc("cost"), 9.0, "int",
                 hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary_mid))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/materials.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/materials.py sha256:97a3fd78b1c0df004d4202ceb11fb3191a4b5bd6ae65c0c2a7bac6010fc3a65c -->
````python
"""The Materials tab - everything bought in to make things.

Yarn, wax, stones, fabric, lumber, mailers: one row per material with what a
unit costs, how much of it is normally lost, and how much is on the shelf. The
stock columns are what turn this into a re-ordering tool - `stock_flag` says
REORDER the moment the shelf drops to the re-order point, and `order_by` shows
the date an order has to go in for the stock to arrive in time.

The `used_qty` and `wasted_qty` columns read the Material Usage and Waste Log
tabs, so `actual_waste_rate` is the real loss rate rather than the guess in
`waste_pct`. When the real rate runs well ahead of the guess the row says so -
that is usually where money is quietly leaking.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, countifs, date_col, id_col, int_col, list_col,
                     money_col, num_col, other, pct_col, rank_desc, rank_flag,
                     row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, sumifs, text_col,
                     wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Materials"

SUBTITLE = ("Raw materials and supplies: unit cost, waste, stock on hand and "
            "when to re-order.")

HELP = ("Type the material and what one unit costs. The workbook works out "
        "the cost with waste, the value of the stock you hold, how much has "
        "been used and how much has been thrown away. Everything downstream - "
        "bills of materials, craft tabs, product costs - reads this tab.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    mid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{mid}=""'
    unit_cost = f"N({row_ref('unit_cost')})"
    on_hand = f"N({row_ref('on_hand')})"
    waste = f"N({row_ref('waste_pct')})"
    point = f"N({row_ref('reorder_point')})"

    used_qty = sumifs(other("Material Usage", "qty"),
                      [(other("Material Usage", "material"), mid)])
    used_cost = sumifs(other("Material Usage", "cost"),
                       [(other("Material Usage", "material"), mid)])
    products_using = countifs([(other("Material Usage", "material"), mid)])
    wasted_qty = sumifs(other("Waste Log", "qty"),
                        [(other("Waste Log", "material"), mid)])
    wasted_cost = sumifs(other("Waste Log", "cost"),
                         [(other("Waste Log", "material"), mid)])

    stock_status = (f'IF({has_id},"",'
                    f'IF({on_hand}<=0,"Out of stock",'
                    f'IF({on_hand}<={point},"Low","In stock")))')
    stock_flag = (f'IF({has_id},"",'
                  f'IF({on_hand}<=0,"ORDER NOW",'
                  f'IF({on_hand}<={point},"REORDER",'
                  f'IF({on_hand}<={point}*1.5+0.001,"WATCH","OK"))))')
    waste_flag = (f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("actual_waste_rate")}=""),"",'
                  f'IF(N({row_ref("actual_waste_rate")})>{waste}*1.5+0.005,'
                  f'"WASTE HIGH",'
                  f'IF(N({row_ref("actual_waste_rate")})<{waste}*0.5,'
                  f'"BETTER THAN PLAN","OK")))')
    order_by = (f'IF({has_id},"",IF({on_hand}<={point},'
                f'TodayDate,TodayDate+N({row_ref("lead_days")})+30))')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixMaterial", trigger="name", width=11.0,
               note="Numbers itself from the prefix on Settings."),
        text_col("name", "Material", 34.0,
                 note="What you buy. Filling this in starts the row."),
        text_col("sku", "Supplier code", 15.0),
        list_col("category", "Category", "MaterialCategoryList", 17.0),
        text_col("supplier", "Supplier", 22.0),
        list_col("supplier_terms", "Terms", "SupplierTermList", 13.0),
        list_col("unit", "Unit", "UnitList", 10.0,
                 note="The unit you buy in: g, oz, skein, each, yard..."),
        num_col("pack_size", "Pack size", 10.0,
                note="How many units one purchase pack holds."),
        money_col("unit_cost", "Cost a unit", 12.0, style="money4",
                  note="What one unit costs, to a fraction of a cent - a "
                       "gram of yarn is not a whole cent."),
        calc_col("pack_cost", "Cost a pack",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("pack_size")})*{unit_cost})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        pct_col("waste_pct", "Expected waste", 11.0,
                note="How much of this is normally lost: offcuts, shedding, "
                     "breakage. Blank rows can start from DefaultWaste on "
                     "Settings."),
        calc_col("cost_with_waste", "Cost with waste",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{unit_cost}*(1+{waste}))', 12.0, "money4",
                 note="What a unit really costs once the usual loss is added."),
        num_col("on_hand", "On hand", 11.0),
        calc_col("stock_value", "Stock value",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{on_hand}*{unit_cost})', 12.0, "money"),
        num_col("reorder_point", "Re-order at", 11.0,
                note="Order when the shelf drops to this."),
        num_col("reorder_qty", "Re-order qty", 11.0),
        calc_col("stock_status", "Stock status", stock_status, 13.0, "status"),
        calc_col("stock_flag", "Action", stock_flag, 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ORDER NOW", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "REORDER", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "WATCH", "fmt": "info"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("order_cost", "Order cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("reorder_qty")})*{unit_cost})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        int_col("lead_days", "Lead days", 10.0,
                note="How long the supplier takes."),
        calc_col("order_by", "Order by", order_by, 13.0, "date",
                 note="Today if stock is already at the re-order point, "
                      "otherwise the day an order would land."),
        calc_col("used_qty", "Used (units)", used_qty, 11.0, "number"),
        calc_col("used_cost", "Used (cost)", used_cost, 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("products_using", "Products using it", products_using,
                 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("wasted_qty", "Wasted (units)", wasted_qty, 11.0, "number"),
        calc_col("wasted_cost", "Wasted (cost)", wasted_cost, 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("actual_waste_rate", "Real waste rate",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({used_qty})+N({wasted_qty})=0,"",'
                 f'N({wasted_qty})/(N({used_qty})+N({wasted_qty}))))',
                 11.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("waste_flag", "Waste check", waste_flag, 16.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "WASTE HIGH", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "BETTER", "fmt": "good"}]),
        text_col("location", "Stored where", 15.0),
        date_col("last_purchase", "Last bought", 13.0),
        calc_col("rank_usage", "rank usage", rank_desc("used_cost"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        calc_col("rank_reorder", "rank reorder",
                 rank_flag("stock_flag", "REORDER"), 9.0, "int", hidden=True,
                 note="Hidden - the Dashboard lists what needs ordering."),
        calc_col("rank_out", "rank out of stock",
                 rank_flag("stock_flag", "ORDER NOW"), 9.0, "int",
                 hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary_mid))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/overhead.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/overhead.py sha256:d3d47d16cdd1f0f306f464f08efab7414c99328d084c57e1e716c9cb8b536210 -->
````python
"""The Overhead tab - the cost of having a studio at all.

Rent, power, insurance, subscriptions, the bookkeeper, the depreciation of the
kiln and the saw. Each row says how often it is paid; `per_month` turns every
frequency into a monthly figure so the whole column can be added up.

That total is what Settings calls ``OverheadMonthly``, and the two derived
figures underneath it - ``OverheadPerHour`` and ``OverheadPerUnit`` - are what
the Products tab and the craft tabs spread across the work, following the
method chosen on Settings. Rows marked ``allocated = No`` are real money but
are not pushed into a product cost; `shop_time_check` compares the rest against
the labour hours that were actually recorded.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, id_col, int_col, list_col, money_col,
                     other, row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, sumifs, text_col,
                     wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Overhead"

SUBTITLE = ("Rent, power, insurance, subscriptions and equipment: the monthly "
            "cost of the studio, spread across the work.")

HELP = ("Type each cost and how often it is paid. 'A month' normalises "
        "everything, 'Allocated' says whether it belongs in a product cost, "
        "and the two columns on the right show what it comes to per unit and "
        "per hour at the volumes on Settings.")

TIMES_A_YEAR = ('IF(EXACT({f},"Weekly"),52,'
                'IF(EXACT({f},"Monthly"),12,'
                'IF(EXACT({f},"Quarterly"),4,'
                'IF(EXACT({f},"Semi-annual"),2,'
                'IF(EXACT({f},"Annual"),1,1)))))')


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    oid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{oid}=""'
    amount = f"N({row_ref('amount')})"
    freq = row_ref("frequency")
    times = TIMES_A_YEAR.format(f=freq)
    per_month = f"N({row_ref('per_month')})"
    allocated = f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({row_ref("allocated")}),"Yes"),{per_month},0)'
    block_allocated = f"SUM({{allocated_month_first}}:{{allocated_month_last}})"
    hours_recorded = sumifs(other("Labor", "hours"), [])

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixOverhead", trigger="name", width=11.0),
        text_col("name", "Cost", 34.0,
                 note="Rent, electricity, insurance, a subscription..."),
        list_col("category", "Category", "OverheadCategoryList", 16.0),
        money_col("amount", "Amount", 12.0,
                  note="What one payment is."),
        list_col("frequency", "Paid", "OverheadFrequencyList", 13.0),
        calc_col("times_a_year", "Times a year",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({freq}="",0,{times}))', 11.0, "number1"),
        calc_col("per_month", "A month",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({freq}="",0,{amount}*{times}/12))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("per_year", "A year",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{amount}*{times})', 12.0, "money0"),
        yesno_col("allocated", "In product cost?", 12.0,
                  note="No for costs you would rather keep out of a unit cost."),
        calc_col("allocated_month", "Allocated a month",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{allocated})', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("per_unit", "Per unit",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(UnitsPerMonth<=0,0,'
                 f'{allocated}/UnitsPerMonth))', 11.0, "money4",
                 note="At the units a month on Settings."),
        calc_col("per_hour", "Per hour",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(ProductiveHours<=0,0,'
                 f'{allocated}/ProductiveHours))', 11.0, "money4",
                 note="At the productive hours a month on Settings."),
        calc_col("share_of_total", "Share of overhead",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({block_allocated}=0,"",'
                 f'{allocated}/{block_allocated}))', 12.0, "percent"),
        text_col("provider", "Provider", 20.0),
        date_col("last_paid", "Last paid", 13.0),
        calc_col("next_due", "Next due",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("last_paid")}="",{freq}=""),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("last_paid")})+ROUND(365/{times},0))',
                 13.0, "date"),
        calc_col("due_flag", "Due",
                 f'IF({row_ref("next_due")}="","",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("next_due")})<TodayDate,"OVERDUE",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("next_due")})-TodayDate<=14,"DUE SOON","OK")))',
                 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OVERDUE", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DUE SOON", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    spec_obj = SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                         **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                         tab_color=P.accent))
    spec_obj.extra_notes = [
        f"Hours recorded on the Labor tab (all rows): {hours_recorded}",
    ]
    return spec_obj
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/packaging.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/packaging.py sha256:e9a1c394ab1cc9e20385cfcc75c9decf74bb937f8c407bfa6269c1b8cf07e2fd -->
````python
"""The Packaging tab - what it costs to get one item out of the door.

Each row is one packaging component: a mailer, a box, tissue, a seal sticker, a
care card. `products` says which products it goes with - a comma separated list
of product IDs, or the word ``All`` for the things every order gets. The
Products tab adds the components that match a product plus everything marked
``All``, and falls back to the default packaging cost on Settings when nothing
matches.

`override_cost` is there for the box you buy from a different supplier at a
different price: type a figure and it wins over the material lookup.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, fetch, id_col, list_col, material_col,
                     money_col, num_col, rank_desc, row_ref, samples,
                     spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Packaging"

SUBTITLE = ("Boxes, mailers, tissue and inserts: what one packed order costs "
            "and which products it applies to.")

HELP = ("List every component that goes into a parcel. In 'Applies to' type "
        "product IDs separated by commas, or the word All for components "
        "every order gets. Products picks these up automatically.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    pk = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{pk}=""'
    qty = f"N({row_ref('qty')})"
    unit_cost = f"N({row_ref('unit_cost')})"
    override = f"N({row_ref('override_cost')})"
    cost = (f'IF({override}>0,{override},{qty}*{unit_cost})')
    products = row_ref("products")

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixPackaging", trigger="name", width=11.0),
        text_col("name", "Component", 30.0,
                 note="What it is: kraft mailer, tissue sheet, seal sticker."),
        list_col("type", "Type", "PackTypeList", 14.0),
        material_col(note="The material this component is bought as."),
        calc_col("material_name", "Material",
                 f'IF({row_ref("material")}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", row_ref("material"))})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        calc_col("unit_cost", "Cost a unit",
                 f'IF({row_ref("material")}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "unit_cost", row_ref("material"), "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4"),
        num_col("qty", "Qty an order", 10.0,
                note="How many of these go in one parcel."),
        money_col("override_cost", "Override cost", 12.0,
                  note="Type a cost here and it beats the material lookup."),
        calc_col("cost", "Cost an order", f'IF({has_id},"",{cost})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        num_col("weight_oz", "Weight (oz)", 10.0,
                note="Packaging weight - it is posted too."),
        yesno_col("fragile", "Fragile", 9.0),
        yesno_col("reusable", "Reusable", 9.0),
        yesno_col("branded", "Branded", 9.0),
        text_col("products", "Applies to", 26.0,
                 note="Product IDs separated by commas, or the word All."),
        calc_col("applies_all", "Every order?",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(EXACT(TRIM({products}),"All"),"Yes","No"))',
                 11.0, "flag",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "Yes", "fmt": "info"}]),
        calc_col("product_count", "Products listed",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({products}="",0,'
                 f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({products}),"All"),"All",'
                 f'LEN({products})-LEN(SUBSTITUTE({products},",",""))+1)))',
                 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("per_batch", "Cost a batch",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{cost}*DefaultBatchSize)', 12.0, "money"),
        text_col("supplier", "Supplier", 20.0),
        num_col("on_hand", "On hand", 10.0),
        calc_col("stock_value", "Stock value",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("on_hand")})*{cost})', 12.0,
                 "money"),
        num_col("reorder_point", "Re-order at", 11.0),
        calc_col("stock_flag", "Action",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("on_hand")})=0,"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("on_hand")})<=N({row_ref("reorder_point")}),'
                 f'"REORDER","OK")))', 11.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "REORDER", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        text_col("recycle_note", "Recycling note", 22.0,
                 note="Goes on the care card: recyclable, compostable..."),
        date_col("last_ordered", "Last ordered", 13.0),
        calc_col("rank_cost", "rank cost", rank_desc("cost"), 9.0, "int",
                 hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary_mid))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/price_history.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/price_history.py sha256:a09f7dc9258d2a4a57384e5a2f6162bcbf4a40d8e25084ebc7280efc245340c3 -->
````python
"""The Price History tab - every price change, and what happened next.

One row per change: the old price, the new one, why it moved, what the product
cost at the time, and how many sold afterwards. The margin before and after
are recalculated with the channel's fees, so a rise that looks small on the
listing can be worth a lot on the profit line - and a "sale" that looks
harmless can put the product under water.

This is the tab that settles arguments with yourself. The example shop has the
two useful cases in it: a candle that went up twice with no drop in sales, and
a scarf that was discounted to clear and lost more money for the privilege.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, date_col,
                     fetch, id_col, int_col, list_col, money_col,
                     product_col, raw_price_col, round_ref, row_ref, samples,
                     spec_defaults, wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Price History"

SUBTITLE = ("Every price change: what it was, what it became, why, and what "
            "it did to the margin.")

HELP = ("One row per change. Type the old price, the new one, why it moved "
        "and what the product cost at the time - the margins either side are "
        "calculated with the channel fees, and so is the price the target "
        "margin would have asked for.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    hid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{hid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    old_price = f"N({row_ref('old_price')})"
    new_price = f"N({row_ref('new_price')})"
    cost_then = f"N({row_ref('cost_at_time')})"
    units_after = f"N({row_ref('units_after')})"

    from_product = (f'IFERROR(INDEX([[Products.channel]],'
                    f'MATCH({product},[[Products.id]],0)),"")')
    chan = f'IF({from_product}="",DefaultChannel,{from_product})'
    rate = channel_fee_rate(chan)
    fixed = channel_fixed_fee(chan)
    minutes = fetch("Products", "id", "minutes_used", product, "0")

    profit_after = f'{new_price}-({rate}*{new_price}+{fixed})-{cost_then}'
    profit_before = f'{old_price}-({rate}*{old_price}+{fixed})-{cost_then}'

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixHistory", trigger="product", width=11.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        date_col("date", "Date changed", 13.0),
        money_col("old_price", "Old price", 12.0),
        money_col("new_price", "New price", 12.0),
        calc_col("change", "Change",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{new_price}-{old_price})', 11.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("change_pct", "Change %",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({old_price}=0,"",'
                 f'({new_price}-{old_price})/{old_price}))', 11.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("direction", "Direction",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({new_price}>{old_price},"UP",'
                 f'IF({new_price}<{old_price},"DOWN","UNCHANGED")))',
                 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "UP", "fmt": "good"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DOWN", "fmt": "warn"}]),
        list_col("reason", "Why", "PriceReasonList", 17.0),
        money_col("cost_at_time", "Cost at the time", 13.0,
                  note="What one item cost when the price changed - not what "
                       "it costs now."),
        calc_col("fee_rate", "Fee rate then", f'IF({has_id},"",{rate})',
                 11.0, "percent",
                 note="Today's rate for this channel - fees are not stored "
                      "per change."),
        calc_col("profit_before", "Profit before",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({old_price}=0,"",{profit_before}))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("margin_before", "Margin before",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({old_price}=0,"",'
                 f'{profit_before}/{old_price}))', 12.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("profit_after", "Profit after",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({new_price}=0,"",{profit_after}))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("margin_after", "Margin after",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({new_price}=0,"",'
                 f'{profit_after}/{new_price}))', 12.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("margin_change", "Margin change",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("margin_before")}="",'
                 f'{row_ref("margin_after")}=""),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("margin_after")})-N({row_ref("margin_before")}))',
                 12.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        int_col("units_after", "Units sold since", 12.0,
                note="How many sold at the new price."),
        calc_col("revenue_after", "Revenue since",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{units_after}*{new_price})', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("profit_since", "Profit since",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{units_after}*IF({new_price}=0,0,{profit_after}))',
                 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("hourly_after", "Hourly since",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({minutes})=0,"",{profit_after}'
                 f'/(N({minutes})/60)))', 12.0, "money"),
        # the unrounded model price gets its own hidden cell: the rounding
        # rule repeats its argument eight times, and eight copies of this
        # expression pass Excel's 8,192 character formula limit
        raw_price_col(cost_then, fixed, "TargetRetailMargin", rate,
                      guard=has_id),
        calc_col("suggested_now", "Model price at that cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{round_ref(row_ref("price_raw"))})',
                 14.0, "money",
                 note="(cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee rate) "
                      "at the cost recorded on this row."),
        calc_col("gap_to_suggested", "Gap to model",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{new_price}=0),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("suggested_now")})-{new_price})', 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"}]),
        calc_col("flag", "Flag",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("margin_after")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("profit_after")})<=0,"LOSS",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("margin_after")})<MarginWarning,"THIN","OK")))',
                 9.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LOSS", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "THIN", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/printables.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/printables.py sha256:8d579a49bf4317e0213fd7a2981e77b88cba5b078e0539fad08cb944d0e80edb -->
````python
"""The three printable pages: a cost sheet, a quote and a production docket.

These are the pages that leave the workbook. Each one is laid out for a single
portrait sheet, carries the shop's letterhead from Settings, and pulls its
numbers from the registers - so a cost sheet printed in March says the same
thing the catalog said in March.

* **Print Costing** - one product's full cost build-up, its bill of materials,
  the fees, the price the model asks for and what the current price earns.
* **Print Quote** - a wholesale quote on the shop's letterhead: pick the shop,
  type the lines, and the trade discount, tax and totals arrive.
* **Print Order** - a production docket for the workshop: what to make, how
  many, the materials needed for that quantity, and the steps to sign off.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import lookup, quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from .common import (channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, fetch, other,
                     price_from, round_price)

P = Palette

SUBTITLE = ("Print one page: your letterhead, the product, and every number "
            "that supports the price.")

#: how many bill of materials lines the printables list
BOM_LINES = 12
#: how many lines a quote carries
QUOTE_LINES = 8


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# shared page furniture
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _page(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg, name: str, title: str,
          subtitle: str, last_col: int, badge: str) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, name, tab_color=P.primary_mid,
                        landscape=False)
    sheet.banner(title, subtitle, last_col, nav=False, badge=badge)
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)
    return sheet


def _letterhead(sheet, fmts, cfg: Config, reg, row: int, last_col: int) -> int:
    """The shop's details, read from Settings."""
    sheet.row_height(row, 26)
    sheet.merge(row, 1, last_col - 3, '=IF(ShopName="","",ShopName)',
                fmts.chrome("print_title"))
    sheet.merge(row, last_col - 2, last_col,
                '=IF(TodayDate=0,"",TodayDate)',
                fmts.chrome("print_sub", num_format=cfg.date_format,
                            align="right"))
    row += 1
    sheet.row_height(row, 15)
    sheet.merge(row, 1, last_col, '=IF(Tagline="","",Tagline)',
                fmts.chrome("print_sub"))
    row += 1
    for name in ("ShopAddress", "ShopEmail", "ShopPhone", "ShopWebsite"):
        sheet.row_height(row, 14)
        sheet.merge(row, 1, last_col, f'=IF({name}="","",{name})',
                    fmts.chrome("print_sub"))
        row += 1
    sheet.merge(row, 1, last_col, "", fmts.chrome("rule"))
    return row + 2


def _field(sheet, row: int, label: str, *, formula: Optional[str] = None,
           value: Any = None, name: Optional[str] = None,
           style: str = "money", input_cell: bool = False,
           validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, help_text: str = "",
           label_col: int = 1, value_col: int = 4, value_end: int = 5,
           help_col: int = 6) -> int:
    return sheet.field(row, label, value, label_col=label_col,
                       value_col=value_col, value_end=value_end, style=style,
                       mode="input" if input_cell else "calc", name=name,
                       validate=validate, help_text=help_text,
                       help_col=help_col, formula=formula)


def _bom_row(sheet, fmts, reg, row: int, n: int, qty_multiplier: str = "") -> None:
    """One bill of materials line, taken from the hidden print rank."""
    rank = f"MATCH({n},{other('Material Usage', 'rank_for_print')},0)"
    material = f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Material Usage', 'material_name')},{rank}),\"\")"
    qty = (f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Material Usage', 'qty_with_scrap')},{rank}),"
           f"\"\")")
    unit_cost = f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Material Usage', 'unit_cost')},{rank}),\"\")"
    line_cost = f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Material Usage', 'cost')},{rank}),\"\")"
    if qty_multiplier:
        qty = f"IF({qty}=\"\",\"\",N({qty})*{qty_multiplier})"
        line_cost = f"IF({line_cost}=\"\",\"\",N({line_cost})*{qty_multiplier})"
    sheet.row_height(row, 16)
    fmt_text = fmts.cell("text", "plain")
    fmt_num = fmts.cell("number", "plain")
    fmt_money4 = fmts.cell("money4", "plain")
    fmt_money = fmts.cell("money", "plain")
    # merge first, then put the formula in the top left cell of the merge
    sheet.merge(row, 1, 3, None, fmt_text)
    sheet.formula(row, 1, reg.render("=" + material), fmt_text)
    sheet.formula(row, 4, reg.render("=" + qty), fmt_num)
    sheet.formula(row, 5, reg.render("=" + unit_cost), fmt_money4)
    sheet.merge(row, 6, 7, None, fmt_money)
    sheet.formula(row, 6, reg.render("=" + line_cost), fmt_money)


def _bom_head(sheet, fmts, row: int, qty_header: str = "Qty") -> int:
    sheet.row_height(row, 22)
    sheet.merge(row, 1, 3, "Material", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    sheet.write(row, 4, qty_header, fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.write(row, 5, "Cost a unit", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.merge(row, 6, 7, "Cost", fmts.chrome("header"))
    return row + 1


def _finish(sheet, row: int, last_col: int) -> None:
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, row, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 1)
    sheet.ws.set_margins(0.5, 0.5, 0.6, 0.5)
    sheet.protect()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Print Costing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

COSTING = "Print Costing"


def build_costing(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    last_col = 8
    sheet = _page(book, fmts, cfg, reg, COSTING, COSTING, SUBTITLE, last_col,
                  badge="One page, portrait")
    sheet.set_col(1, 3, 22.0)
    sheet.set_col(4, 5, 15.0)
    sheet.set_col(6, last_col, 16.0)

    r = _letterhead(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg, 3, last_col)
    r = sheet.section(r, "Cost sheet", last_col)

    prod = lambda key: lookup("PrintProduct", other("Products", "id"),
                              other("Products", key))
    channel_of = f'IFERROR({prod("channel")},DefaultChannel)'
    rate = channel_fee_rate(channel_of)
    fixed = channel_fixed_fee(channel_of)

    r = _field(sheet, r, "Product", name="PrintProduct", style="id",
               input_cell=True, validate=list_from("ProductIDs"),
               help_text="Pick a product and the whole sheet follows.")
    for label, key, style in [("Product name", "name", "text"),
                              ("SKU", "sku", "text"),
                              ("Category", "category", "text"),
                              ("Craft", "craft", "text"),
                              ("Status", "status", "text")]:
        r = _field(sheet, r, label, style=style,
                   formula=f'=IFERROR({prod(key)},"")')

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "What one item costs", last_col)
    cost_rows = [
        ("Materials", "material_cost", "money",
         "From the bill of materials below, or from the craft tab."),
        ("Minutes of work", "minutes_used", "number1", ""),
        ("Labour", "labor_cost", "money",
         "Minutes over sixty times the true cost of your hour."),
        ("Packaging", "packaging_cost", "money", ""),
        ("Postage you absorb", "shipping_cost", "money", ""),
        ("Share of overhead", "overhead_cost", "money", ""),
    ]
    for label, key, style, note in cost_rows:
        r = _field(sheet, r, label, style=style,
                   formula=f'=IFERROR({prod(key)},"")', help_text=note)
    total_row = r
    sheet.row_height(r, 22)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 3, "Total cost of one item",
                fmts.chrome("total_label"))
    sheet.merge(r, 4, 5, None, fmts.chrome("total_value"))
    sheet.formula(r, 4,
                           reg.render(f'=IFERROR({prod("total_cost")},"")'),
                           fmts.chrome("total_value"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, last_col,
                "Materials + labour + packaging + postage + overhead.",
                fmts.chrome("note"))
    book.define_name("PrintCost",
                     f"={quote_sheet(COSTING)}!$E${total_row + 1}")
    r += 1

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "What selling it costs", last_col)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Channel", style="text",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("channel")},DefaultChannel)')
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Fee rate", style="percent", formula=f"={rate}")
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Fixed fees an order", style="money",
               formula=f"={fixed}")
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Fees at the current price", style="money",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("total_fees")},"")')

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "The price", last_col)
    for label, key, style, note in [
            ("Price today", "retail_price", "money", ""),
            ("Suggested price", "suggested_price", "money",
             "(cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee rate)."),
            ("Gap to the model price", "price_gap", "money",
             "Positive means the listing is under what your margin asks for."),
            ("Wholesale price", "wholesale_price", "money", ""),
            ("RRP / MSRP", "msrp", "money", ""),
            ("Profit an item", "profit", "money", ""),
            ("Margin", "margin", "percent", ""),
            ("Effective hourly", "effective_hourly", "money",
             "What an hour of making this earns."),
            ("Wage check", "hourly_flag", "text", "")]:
        r = _field(sheet, r, label, style=style,
                   formula=f'=IFERROR({prod(key)},"")', help_text=note)

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Bill of materials", last_col)
    r = _bom_head(sheet, fmts, r)
    for n in range(1, BOM_LINES + 1):
        _bom_row(sheet, fmts, reg, r, n)
        r += 1
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Total from the bill", style="money",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("bom_cost")},"")')

    r += 1
    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Prepared by", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 22)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 3, "", fmts.chrome("form_line"))
    sheet.merge(r, 4, 5, "=TodayDate", fmts.chrome("form_line"))
    sheet.formula(r, 4, "=TodayDate", fmts.cell("date", "plain"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, last_col, "Name and date", fmts.chrome("note"))
    r += 2
    r = sheet.note(r, f"{cfg.product_name} - created by {cfg.author}, "
                      f"version {cfg.version}. Figures are read live from the "
                      f"catalog, so a printed sheet matches the workbook it "
                      f"came from.", last_col, height=28, boxed=False)

    _finish(sheet, r, last_col)
    return sheet


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Print Quote
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

QUOTE = "Print Quote"


def build_quote(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    last_col = 9
    sheet = _page(book, fmts, cfg, reg, QUOTE, "Print Quote", SUBTITLE,
                  last_col, badge="One page, portrait")
    sheet.set_col(1, 1, 6.0)
    sheet.set_col(2, 3, 20.0)
    sheet.set_col(4, 5, 12.0)
    sheet.set_col(6, 7, 13.0)
    sheet.set_col(8, last_col, 14.0)

    r = _letterhead(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg, 3, last_col)
    r = sheet.section(r, "Wholesale quote", last_col)

    cust = lambda key: lookup("QuoteCustomer",
                              other("Wholesale Customers", "id"),
                              other("Wholesale Customers", key))

    r = _field(sheet, r, "Quote number", name="QuoteNumber", style="text",
               input_cell=True, value="Q-0001", label_col=1, value_col=4,
               value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Date", style="date", formula="=TodayDate",
               label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Valid until", style="date", name="QuoteValidUntil",
               formula="=TodayDate+30", label_col=1, value_col=4,
               value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Shop", name="QuoteCustomer", style="id",
               input_cell=True, validate=list_from("CustomerIDs"),
               label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6,
               help_text="From the Wholesale Customers tab.")
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Contact", style="text",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("contact")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Address", style="text",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("address")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Terms", style="text", name="QuoteTerms",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("terms")},"Net 30")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Trade discount", style="percent",
               name="QuoteDiscount",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("discount")},WholesaleDiscount)',
               label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Tax rate", style="percent", name="QuoteTaxRate",
               formula=f'=IF(EXACT(TRIM(IFERROR({cust("tax_exempt")},"No")),'
                       f'"Yes"),0,TaxRate)', label_col=1, value_col=4,
               value_end=5, help_col=6,
               help_text="Zero for a tax exempt shop.")

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Lines", last_col)
    head = r
    sheet.row_height(head, 24)
    sheet.write(head, 1, "#", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.merge(head, 2, 3, "Product", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    sheet.write(head, 4, "Qty", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.write(head, 5, "Retail", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.write(head, 6, "Discount", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.merge(head, 7, 8, "Trade price", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.write(head, last_col, "Line total", fmts.chrome("header"))
    r += 1

    first_line = r
    for n in range(1, QUOTE_LINES + 1):
        sheet.row_height(r, 18)
        sheet.write(r, 1, n, fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
        fmt_id = fmts.cell("id", "input")
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 2, r, 3, "", fmt_id)
        sheet.ws.data_validation(r, 2, r, 3, list_from("ProductIDs"))
        sheet.write(r, 4, None, fmts.cell("int", "input"))
        product_cell = f"$C${r + 1}"
        qty_cell = f"$E${r + 1}"
        retail = (f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Products', 'retail_price')},"
                  f"MATCH({product_cell},{other('Products', 'id')},0)),0)")
        sheet.formula(r, 5, reg.render("=" + retail),
                               fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 6, "=QuoteDiscount",
                               fmts.cell("percent", "plain"))
        trade = f"{round_price(f'{retail}*(1-QuoteDiscount)')}"
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 7, r, 8, "", fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 7, reg.render("=" + trade),
                               fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        total = (f"IF(N({qty_cell})=0,\"\",N({qty_cell})*N($H${r + 1}))")
        sheet.formula(r, last_col, reg.render("=" + total),
                               fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        r += 1
    last_line = r - 1
    book.define_name("QuoteLines",
                     f"={quote_sheet(QUOTE)}!$J${first_line + 1}"
                     f":$J${last_line + 1}")

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Totals", last_col)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Subtotal", style="money",
               formula="=IFERROR(SUM(QuoteLines),0)", label_col=6,
               value_col=8, value_end=8)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Postage", style="money", input_cell=True,
               name="QuotePostage", label_col=6, value_col=8, value_end=8)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Tax", style="money", name="QuoteTax",
               formula="=IFERROR(SUM(QuoteLines)*QuoteTaxRate,0)",
               label_col=6, value_col=8, value_end=8)
    total_row = r
    sheet.row_height(r, 22)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 5, "Trade prices exclude postage unless stated.",
                fmts.chrome("note"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, 7, "Quote total", fmts.chrome("total_label"))
    sheet.merge(r, 8, 8, None, fmts.chrome("total_value"))
    sheet.formula(
        r, 8, reg.render("=IFERROR(SUM(QuoteLines)+QuotePostage+QuoteTax,0)"),
        fmts.chrome("total_value"))
    book.define_name("QuoteTotal", f"={quote_sheet(QUOTE)}!$I${total_row + 1}")
    r += 1

    r += 1
    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Terms", last_col)
    for line in [
        "=QuoteTerms & \" from the date of invoice.\"",
        '="Minimum order " & TEXT(MinOrderValue,"$#,##0") & " or " & '
        'TEXT(MinOrderQty,"0") & " units a product."',
        '="Prices hold until " & TEXT(QuoteValidUntil,"dd mmm yyyy") & "."',
        '="Trade prices exclude postage unless stated. Tax ID " & TaxID & "."',
    ]:
        sheet.row_height(r, 15)
        sheet.merge(r, 1, last_col, "", fmts.chrome("label"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, reg.render(line), fmts.chrome("label"))
        r += 1
    r += 1
    sheet.row_height(r, 24)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 4, "", fmts.chrome("form_line"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, last_col, "", fmts.chrome("form_line"))
    r += 1
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 4, '=IF(ShopName="","",ShopName)',
                fmts.chrome("note"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, last_col, "Accepted by (signature and date)",
                fmts.chrome("note"))
    r += 2

    _finish(sheet, r, last_col)
    return sheet


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Print Order - the production docket
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ORDER = "Print Order"

STEPS = ["Cutting / preparing materials", "Making", "Finishing",
         "Quality check", "Packaging", "Label and care card", "Dispatch"]


def build_order(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    last_col = 9
    sheet = _page(book, fmts, cfg, reg, ORDER, "Print Order", SUBTITLE,
                  last_col, badge="One page, portrait")
    sheet.set_col(1, 1, 6.0)
    sheet.set_col(2, 3, 24.0)
    sheet.set_col(4, 5, 13.0)
    sheet.set_col(6, 7, 13.0)
    sheet.set_col(8, last_col, 16.0)

    r = _letterhead(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg, 3, last_col)
    r = sheet.section(r, "Production docket", last_col)

    prod = lambda key: lookup("OrderProduct", other("Products", "id"),
                              other("Products", key))

    r = _field(sheet, r, "Docket number", name="OrderNumber", style="text",
               input_cell=True, value="DO-0001", label_col=1, value_col=4,
               value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Product", name="OrderProduct", style="id",
               input_cell=True, validate=list_from("ProductIDs"),
               label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Product name", style="text",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("name")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "SKU", style="text",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("sku")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Craft", style="text",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("craft")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Difficulty", style="text",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("difficulty")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Quantity to make", name="OrderQty", style="int",
               input_cell=True, value=cfg.default_batch_size, label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Needed by", name="OrderDue", style="date",
               input_cell=True, label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5,
               help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Made for", name="OrderFor", style="text",
               input_cell=True, label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5,
               help_col=6, help_text="Stock, an order, a fair, a shop.")
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Minutes an item", style="number1",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("minutes_used")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Hours for the whole docket", style="number",
               name="OrderHours",
               formula=f'=IFERROR(N({prod("minutes_used")})*OrderQty/60,"")',
               label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Labour cost of the docket", style="money",
               formula="=N(OrderHours)*LaborCostHour", label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Cost a unit from the catalog", style="money",
               formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("total_cost")},"")', label_col=1,
               value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)
    r = _field(sheet, r, "Cost of the whole docket", style="money",
               formula=f'=IFERROR(N({prod("total_cost")})*OrderQty,"")',
               label_col=1, value_col=4, value_end=5, help_col=6)

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Materials needed", last_col)
    r = _bom_head(sheet, fmts, r, qty_header="Qty for the docket")
    for n in range(1, BOM_LINES + 1):
        _bom_row(sheet, fmts, reg, r, n, qty_multiplier="N(OrderQty)")
        r += 1

    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Steps", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 4, "Step", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    sheet.write(r, 5, "Done", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, 7, "Initials", fmts.chrome("header"))
    sheet.merge(r, 8, last_col, "Date", fmts.chrome("header"))
    r += 1
    for step in STEPS:
        sheet.row_height(r, 20)
        sheet.merge(r, 1, 4, step, fmts.chrome("label"))
        sheet.write(r, 5, None, fmts.cell("flag", "input"))
        sheet.ws.data_validation(r, 5, r, 5, list_from("YesNoList"))
        sheet.merge(r, 6, 7, None, fmts.cell("text", "input"))
        sheet.merge(r, 8, last_col, None, fmts.cell("date", "input"))
        r += 1

    r += 1
    r = sheet.subsection(r, "Notes for the maker", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 60)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, last_col, None, fmts.chrome("form_box"))
    r += 2
    sheet.row_height(r, 24)
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 4, "", fmts.chrome("form_line"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, last_col, "", fmts.chrome("form_line"))
    r += 1
    sheet.merge(r, 1, 4, "Made by", fmts.chrome("note"))
    sheet.merge(r, 6, last_col, "Checked by", fmts.chrome("note"))
    r += 2

    _finish(sheet, r, last_col)
    return sheet
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/products.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/products.py sha256:767e7e1b52055ac5f0772bd5839fd09ca9af43a0bdaa980dedf5c5a7b1f346bb -->
````python
"""The Products tab - the catalog and the heart of the workbook.

One row per product. Everything else feeds into it:

* material cost from the bill of materials, or from the product's craft tab if
  it was costed there (never both - the craft figure wins);
* labour, from the minutes recorded here or on the craft tab, at the rate on
  Settings with payroll on-costs added;
* packaging and the postage the seller absorbs, matched by product ID;
* overhead, spread the way Settings says (per unit, per hour, or per month);
* the marketplace fees for the channel the product sells through.

Out of that comes the price the model asks for::

    price = (cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee rate)

and, next to it, what the current price actually earns - profit, margin, an
effective hourly wage and a flag when that wage falls below the minimum on
Settings. The three hidden columns at the far right rank the catalog so the
Dashboard and the Reports can pull a top five without an array formula.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (FLAG_LOSS, calc_col, channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee,
                     channel_lookup, countifs, craft_material_total,
                     craft_minutes_total, date_col, hourly_flag, id_col,
                     int_col, link_col, list_col, margin_flag, money_col,
                     num_col, other, overhead_per_unit, pct_col, price_from,
                     rank_desc, rank_flag, review_flag, row_ref, round_price,
                     samples,
                     spec_defaults, sumifs, sumifs_wild, text_col, wrap_col,
                     yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Products"

SUBTITLE = ("Every product, what it costs to make and what it should sell "
            "for. Cream cells are yours; the rest is calculated.")

HELP = ("Add a product name and the ID numbers itself. Costs arrive from the "
        "bills of materials, the craft tabs, Packaging, Shipping and "
        "Overhead. Compare 'Suggested price' with 'Retail price' - a gap "
        "means the listing is earning less than the target margin asks for.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    pid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{pid}=""'
    chan = f'IF({row_ref("channel")}="",DefaultChannel,{row_ref("channel")})'
    retail = f"N({row_ref('retail_price')})"
    minutes = f"N({row_ref('minutes_used')})"
    hours = f"({minutes}/60)"

    # where the cost of materials comes from
    bom = sumifs(other("Material Usage", "cost"),
                 [(other("Material Usage", "product"), pid)])
    craft_cost = craft_material_total(pid)
    craft_minutes = craft_minutes_total(pid)
    pack_specific = sumifs_wild(other("Packaging", "cost"),
                                other("Packaging", "products"), "id")
    pack_all = sumifs(other("Packaging", "cost"),
                      [(other("Packaging", "products"), '"All"')])
    ship_absorbed = sumifs_wild(other("Shipping", "absorbed"),
                                other("Shipping", "products"), "id")

    sales_qty = sumifs(other("Sales", "qty"), [(other("Sales", "product"), pid)])
    refunded = sumifs(other("Sales", "qty"),
                      [(other("Sales", "product"), pid),
                       (other("Sales", "status"), '"Refunded"')])
    revenue = sumifs(other("Sales", "gross"),
                     [(other("Sales", "product"), pid)])
    sale_profit = sumifs(other("Sales", "profit"),
                         [(other("Sales", "product"), pid)])
    last_sale = (f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX(({other('Sales', 'product')}={pid})"
                 f"*{other('Sales', 'date')}))")
    made = sumifs(other("Batches", "qty_done"),
                  [(other("Batches", "product"), pid)])
    defects = sumifs(other("Batches", "qty_defect"),
                     [(other("Batches", "product"), pid)])
    wasted = sumifs(other("Waste Log", "cost"),
                    [(other("Waste Log", "product"), pid)])

    # the pricing model, written out once so the column below stays readable
    cost_ref = f"N({row_ref('total_cost')})"
    fixed_ref = f"N({row_ref('fixed_fees')})"
    rate_ref = f"N({row_ref('fee_rate')})"
    margin_ref = (f'IF({row_ref("target_margin")}="",TargetRetailMargin,'
                  f'N({row_ref("target_margin")}))')
    suggested = price_from(cost_ref, fixed_ref, margin_ref, rate_ref)
    data_bar = {"type": "data_bar", "bar_color": P.primary_mid}

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixProduct", trigger="name", width=11.0,
               note="Numbers itself from the prefix on Settings."),
        text_col("name", "Product name", 36.0,
                 note="The name you use for it. Filling this in starts the row."),
        text_col("sku", "SKU", 14.0, note="Your own stock code."),
        list_col("category", "Category", "CategoryList", 20.0,
                 note="Used by the Reports tab to group sales."),
        list_col("craft", "Craft", "CraftList", 13.0,
                 note="Which of the six craft calculators costed this item."),
        list_col("status", "Status", "StatusList", 13.0),
        calc_col("active", "Sellable?",
                 f'IF({row_ref("status")}="","",'
                 f'IF(OR({row_ref("status")}="Active",'
                 f'{row_ref("status")}="Made to order",'
                 f'{row_ref("status")}="Seasonal"),"Yes","No"))',
                 9.0, "flag", note="Active, made to order or seasonal.",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "Yes", "fmt": "good"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "No", "fmt": "muted"}]),
        list_col("channel", "Main channel", "ChannelList", 15.0,
                 note="Fees for this channel come from the Channels tab."),
        yesno_col("featured", "Featured", 9.0),
        list_col("season", "Season", "SeasonList", 14.0),
        list_col("size", "Size", "SizeList", 11.0),
        text_col("dimensions", "Dimensions", 18.0),
        num_col("weight_oz", "Weight (oz)", 10.0,
                note="Packed weight - the Shipping tab prices by weight."),
        list_col("difficulty", "Difficulty", "DifficultyList", 12.0,
                 note="The craft tabs multiply time by the factor on Lists."),
        int_col("lead_days", "Lead days", 9.0,
                note="How long from order to dispatch."),
        date_col("created", "Created", 13.0),
        date_col("reviewed", "Last price review", 13.0,
                 note="The last time this price was looked at."),
        calc_col("next_review", "Next review due",
                 f'IF({row_ref("reviewed")}="","",'
                 f'N({row_ref("reviewed")})+PriceReviewDays)',
                 13.0, "date", note="Last review plus the window on Settings."),
        calc_col("review_flag", "Review",
                 review_flag("next_review", "reviewed"), 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OVERDUE", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DUE SOON", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),

        # ------------------------------------------------------------ costs
        calc_col("bom_cost", "BOM material cost", bom, 12.0, "money",
                 note="Sum of the bill of materials on Material Usage."),
        calc_col("craft_cost", "Craft tab material cost", craft_cost, 12.0,
                 "money", note="Sum of the six craft calculators."),
        calc_col("material_cost", "Material cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("craft_cost")})>0,'
                 f'N({row_ref("craft_cost")}),N({row_ref("bom_cost")})))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 note="The craft figure wins, so nothing is counted twice."),
        calc_col("craft_minutes", "Craft minutes", craft_minutes, 11.0,
                 "number1", note="Minutes recorded on the craft tabs."),
        int_col("labor_minutes", "Minutes (typed)", 11.0,
                note="Only used when the craft tabs say nothing."),
        calc_col("minutes_used", "Minutes used",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("craft_minutes")})>0,'
                 f'N({row_ref("craft_minutes")}),N({row_ref("labor_minutes")})))',
                 11.0, "number1"),
        calc_col("hours_used", "Hours", f'IF({has_id},"",{minutes}/60)',
                 9.0, "number"),
        calc_col("hourly_rate", "Rate an hour",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",LaborCostHour)', 11.0, "money",
                 note="Your rate on Settings plus payroll on-costs."),
        calc_col("labor_cost", "Labour cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{minutes}/60*LaborCostHour)', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("packaging_cost", "Packaging cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({pack_specific})+N({pack_all})>0,'
                 f'N({pack_specific})+N({pack_all}),DefaultPackaging))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 note="Matched from the Packaging tab, or the default."),
        calc_col("shipping_cost", "Postage absorbed",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({ship_absorbed})>0,'
                 f'N({ship_absorbed}),DefaultShipping))', 12.0, "money",
                 note="The part of the postage you pay, not the customer."),
        calc_col("overhead_cost", "Overhead share",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{overhead_per_unit(minutes, "1")})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("total_cost", "Total unit cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("material_cost")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("labor_cost")})+N({row_ref("packaging_cost")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("shipping_cost")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("overhead_cost")}))',
                 13.0, "money",
                 note="Materials + labour + packaging + absorbed postage + "
                      "overhead.",
                 cf=[data_bar]),

        # ------------------------------------------------------------- fees
        pct_col("target_margin", "Target margin", 11.0,
                note="Blank uses the default on Settings."),
        calc_col("fee_rate", "Channel fee rate",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{channel_fee_rate(chan)})', 11.0, "percent",
                 note="Every percentage this channel takes."),
        calc_col("fixed_fees", "Fixed fees",
````
