````python
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{channel_fixed_fee(chan)})', 11.0, "money",
                 note="Listing fee plus the fixed part of processing."),
        calc_col("listing_fee", "Listing fee",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{channel_lookup(chan, "listing_fee", "ListingFee")})',
                 10.0, "money"),
        calc_col("transaction_fee", "Transaction fee",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{retail}*'
                 f'{channel_lookup(chan, "transaction_pct", "TransactionFee")})',
                 11.0, "money"),
        calc_col("processing_fee", "Processing fee",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{retail}*'
                 f'{channel_lookup(chan, "processing_pct", "ProcessingPercent")}'
                 f'+{channel_lookup(chan, "processing_fixed", "ProcessingFixed")})',
                 11.0, "money"),
        calc_col("ads_fee", "Offsite ads",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{retail}*'
                 f'{channel_lookup(chan, "ads_effective", "0")})',
                 11.0, "money",
                 note="Ad fee times the share of orders ads bring."),
        calc_col("total_fees", "Total fees",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("listing_fee")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("transaction_fee")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("processing_fee")})+N({row_ref("ads_fee")}))',
                 11.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fee_pct", "Fees % of price",
                 f'IF({retail}=0,"",N({row_ref("total_fees")})/{retail})',
                 10.0, "percent"),

        # ----------------------------------------------------------- pricing
        money_col("retail_price", "Retail price", 12.0,
                  note="What it sells for today."),
        calc_col("net_revenue", "Net revenue",
                 f'IF({row_ref("retail_price")}="","",'
                 f'{retail}-N({row_ref("total_fees")}))', 12.0, "money",
                 note="Price after every fee."),
        calc_col("suggested_price", "Suggested price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{suggested})',
                 13.0, "money",
                 note="(cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - fee rate), "
                      "rounded the way Settings says."),
        calc_col("price_gap", "Gap to suggested",
                 f'IF(OR({row_ref("retail_price")}="",'
                 f'{row_ref("suggested_price")}=""),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("suggested_price")})-N({row_ref("retail_price")}))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 note="Positive means the price is below what the model asks.",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("profit", "Profit a unit",
                 f'IF({row_ref("retail_price")}="","",'
                 f'N({row_ref("net_revenue")})-N({row_ref("total_cost")}))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("margin", "Margin",
                 f'IF({retail}=0,"",(N({row_ref("net_revenue")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("total_cost")}))/{retail})', 10.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "formula",
                      "criteria": f"AND({row_ref('margin')}<>\"\","
                                  f"{row_ref('margin')}<MarginWarning)",
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("margin_flag", "Flag",
                 margin_flag(row_ref("margin"), row_ref("profit"),
                             row_ref("retail_price")), 9.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": FLAG_LOSS, "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "THIN", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("effective_hourly", "Effective hourly",
                 f'IF({minutes}=0,"",N({row_ref("profit")})/{hours})',
                 12.0, "money", note="What an hour of making this earns."),
        calc_col("hourly_flag", "Wage check",
                 hourly_flag(row_ref("effective_hourly"),
                             row_ref("minutes_used")), 16.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "PAYING TO WORK", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "BELOW", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "GOOD", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("price_per_hour", "Price an hour of work",
                 f'IF({minutes}=0,"",{retail}/{hours})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("wholesale_price", "Wholesale price",
                 f'IF({row_ref("retail_price")}="","",'
                 f'{round_price(f"{retail}*(1-WholesaleDiscount)")})',
                 12.0, "money",
                 note="Retail less the trade discount on Settings."),
        calc_col("wholesale_margin", "Wholesale margin",
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("wholesale_price")})=0,"",'
                 f'(N({row_ref("wholesale_price")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("total_cost")}))'
                 f'/N({row_ref("wholesale_price")}))', 11.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        money_col("msrp", "RRP / MSRP", 12.0),
        calc_col("msrp_check", "RRP check",
                 f'IF(OR({row_ref("msrp")}="",'
                 f'{row_ref("retail_price")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("msrp")})<{retail},'
                 f'"RRP BELOW RETAIL","OK"))', 15.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "BELOW", "fmt": "bad"}]),

        # ------------------------------------------------------------ trading
        calc_col("units_sold", "Units sold", sales_qty, 10.0, "int"),
        calc_col("units_refunded", "Refunded", refunded, 10.0, "int"),
        calc_col("revenue", "Revenue", revenue, 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("gross_profit", "Gross profit", sale_profit, 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("avg_price", "Average selling price",
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("units_sold")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("revenue")})/N({row_ref("units_sold")}))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("units_made", "Units made", made, 10.0, "int"),
        calc_col("units_defect", "Defects", defects, 9.0, "int"),
        calc_col("stock_left", "Stock left",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("units_made")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("units_sold")}))', 10.0, "int",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("last_sale", "Last sale",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({last_sale})=0,"",N({last_sale})))',
                 13.0, "date"),
        calc_col("days_since_sale", "Days since sale",
                 f'IF({row_ref("last_sale")}="","",'
                 f'TodayDate-N({row_ref("last_sale")}))', 11.0, "int",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 90,
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("waste_cost", "Waste cost", wasted, 11.0, "money"),
        text_col("batch_id", "Last batch", 12.0,
                 note="Optional - the Batches tab tracks batches itself."),

        # ------------------------------------------------------------- ranks
        calc_col("rank_margin", "rank margin", rank_desc("margin"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        calc_col("rank_revenue", "rank revenue", rank_desc("revenue"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        calc_col("rank_profit", "rank profit", rank_desc("gross_profit"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        calc_col("rank_loss", "rank loss", rank_flag("margin_flag", FLAG_LOSS),
                 9.0, "int", hidden=True,
                 note="Hidden - the Dashboard lists loss making products "
                      "from this."),
        calc_col("rank_review", "rank review",
                 rank_flag("review_flag", "OVERDUE"), 9.0, "int", hidden=True,
                 note="Hidden - the Dashboard lists overdue price reviews "
                      "from this."),

        # -------------------------------------------------------------- text
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 34.0),
        wrap_col("tags", "Tags / keywords", 28.0,
                 note="Comma separated - used for listing copy."),
        text_col("photo", "Photo file", 18.0),
        link_col("url", "Listing URL", 26.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    """Shade any row that is losing money, from the ID to the URL."""
    spec = reg[NAME]
    flag = spec.letter("margin_flag")
    first = spec.first_data_row
    last = spec.last_data_row
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(
        first - 1, 0, last - 1, spec.last_col_index,
        {"type": "formula", "criteria": f'${flag}{first}="{FLAG_LOSS}"',
         "format": fmts.cf("bad")})
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/promotions.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/promotions.py sha256:2c0f9c6c8071e0fccc1560a34d0a29e9ab40d83d0c7f773e7210355d47a62ef8 -->
````python
"""The Promotions tab - discounts, and what they cost.

A discount is a pricing decision, so it gets costed like one. Each row says
what the offer is, when it runs, what it applies to, and how many times it has
been used. The trading columns read the Sales tab: how many orders quoted the
code, what they brought in, what they earned, and what the margin was with the
discount taken out.

`discount_given` is the money the offer gave away, worked back from the
discounted revenue. `state` says whether the offer is live, still scheduled or
already over, so a code that has ended stops being typed into new orders.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, id_col, int_col, list_col, money_col,
                     other, pct_col, row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, sumifs,
                     text_col, wrap_col, yesno_col, countifs)

P = Palette

NAME = "Promotions"

SUBTITLE = ("Discounts and offers: when they run, what they apply to and what "
            "they did to the margin.")

HELP = ("Type the code, the discount and the dates. The Sales tab records "
        "which code each order used, so the redemptions, the revenue and the "
        "margin with the discount taken out are all counted here.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    pid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{pid}=""'
    code = row_ref("code")
    discount = f"N({row_ref('discount')})"
    start = row_ref("start")
    end = row_ref("end")

    redemptions = countifs([(other("Sales", "promo"), code)])
    revenue = sumifs(other("Sales", "gross"), [(other("Sales", "promo"), code)])
    profit = sumifs(other("Sales", "profit"),
                    [(other("Sales", "promo"), code)])

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixPromo", trigger="code", width=11.0),
        text_col("code", "Code", 16.0,
                 note="What the customer types. Filling this in starts the row."),
        text_col("name", "Offer", 30.0),
        list_col("type", "Type", "PromoTypeList", 15.0),
        pct_col("discount", "Discount", 11.0,
                note="As a decimal: 0.15 for 15%."),
        money_col("fixed_amount", "Or a fixed amount", 13.0,
                  note="For 'take 10 off' offers - the percentage is ignored "
                       "when this is filled in."),
        date_col("start", "Starts", 13.0),
        date_col("end", "Ends", 13.0),
        calc_col("days_running", "Days running",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{start}="",{end}=""),"",'
                 f'N({end})-N({start}))', 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("state", "State",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({start}="","NO DATES",'
                 f'IF(TodayDate<N({start}),"SCHEDULED",'
                 f'IF(N({end})>0,IF(TodayDate>N({end}),"ENDED","LIVE"),'
                 f'"LIVE"))))', 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LIVE", "fmt": "good"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ENDED", "fmt": "muted"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "SCHEDULED", "fmt": "info"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "NO DATES", "fmt": "warn"}]),
        yesno_col("active", "Switched on?", 11.0),
        text_col("applies_to", "Applies to", 26.0,
                 note="Product IDs, bundle IDs, or a word like All, "
                      "Wholesale orders."),
        int_col("min_qty", "Minimum qty", 11.0),
        money_col("min_order", "Minimum order", 12.0),
        int_col("max_uses", "Maximum uses", 12.0,
                note="Zero means no limit."),
        int_col("used", "Used (typed)", 11.0,
                note="Your own count - the Sales tab keeps its own below."),
        calc_col("uses_left", "Uses left",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("max_uses")})=0,"No limit",'
                 f'N({row_ref("max_uses")})-N({row_ref("used")})))', 11.0,
                 "int"),
        calc_col("usage_flag", "Usage check",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("max_uses")})=0,"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("used")})>=N({row_ref("max_uses")}),'
                 f'"USED UP","OK")))', 12.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "USED UP", "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("redemptions", "Orders using it", redemptions, 12.0, "int",
                 note="Counted from the promo code on the Sales tab."),
        calc_col("revenue_with_promo", "Revenue", revenue, 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("profit_with_promo", "Profit", profit, 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("margin_with_promo", "Margin with the discount",
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("revenue_with_promo")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("profit_with_promo")})'
                 f'/N({row_ref("revenue_with_promo")}))', 13.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("discount_given", "Discount given away",
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("revenue_with_promo")})=0,"",'
                 f'IF({discount}>=1,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("revenue_with_promo")})*{discount}'
                 f'/(1-{discount})))', 14.0, "money",
                 note="Worked back from the discounted revenue."),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/reports.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/reports.py sha256:5668773fbd63e6ef7533871996a83f16409c30740870d8060699c1b5ce2ab8a5 -->
````python
"""The Reports tab - the year on one page.

Month by month, then by category, by channel and by craft, then the top ten
products and the ten worst margins, then stock, wholesale, promotions, events
and labour. Everything is a SUMIFS, a COUNTIFS or an INDEX/MATCH against a
register, so the page is a report of what is really in the workbook rather than
a copy somebody typed in.

The worst-margin table is the one worth reading. It is built from the hidden
rank column on Products by counting backwards from the number of products, so
it needs no array formula and it works in Excel 2010.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import (PRODUCT_CATEGORIES, Config, Palette)
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from .common import CRAFT_LIST, other

P = Palette

NAME = "Reports"

SUBTITLE = (f"The year month by month, by category, by channel and by craft, "
            f"with the best and the worst of the catalog.")

HELP = ("Nothing to type here. Change the year by changing the date on your "
        "computer - the reports follow TODAY().")


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=True)
    last_col = 17
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col, badge="Calculated")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 2, 26.0)
    for i in range(3, last_col + 1):
        sheet.set_col(i, i, 13.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    def x(formula: str) -> str:
        text = formula.strip()
        if not text.startswith("="):
            text = "=" + text
        return reg.render(text)

    def put(row: int, col: int, formula: str, style: str = "money",
            span: int = 1) -> None:
        fmt = fmts.cell(style, "plain")
        if span > 1:
            sheet.ws.merge_range(row, col, row, col + span - 1, "", fmt)
        sheet.formula(row, col, x(formula), fmt)

    def put_text(row: int, col: int, text: str, style: str = "text",
                 span: int = 1) -> None:
        fmt = fmts.cell(style, "plain")
        if span > 1:
            sheet.ws.merge_range(row, col, row, col + span - 1, text, fmt)
        else:
            sheet.ws.write(row, col, text, fmt)

    def window(sheet_name: str, value_key: str, start: str, end: str,
               extra: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]] = ()) -> str:
        pairs = [f"{other(sheet_name, 'date')},\">=\"&{start}",
                 f"{other(sheet_name, 'date')},\"<=\"&{end}"]
        pairs += [f"{rng},{crit}" for rng, crit in extra]
        return ("IFERROR(SUMIFS(" + ",".join(
            [other(sheet_name, value_key)] + pairs) + "),0)")

    def count_window(sheet_name: str, start: str, end: str,
                     extra: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]] = ()) -> str:
        pairs = [f"{other(sheet_name, 'date')},\">=\"&{start}",
                 f"{other(sheet_name, 'date')},\"<=\"&{end}"]
        pairs += [f"{rng},{crit}" for rng, crit in extra]
        return ("IFERROR(COUNTIFS(" + ",".join(pairs) + "),0)")

    def table(row: int, headers: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]]) -> int:
        sheet.row_height(row, 24)
        col = 1
        for head, span in headers:
            sheet.merge(row, col, col + span - 1, head,
                        fmts.chrome("header_left"))
            col += span
        return row + 1

    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=26)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ year in brief
    r = sheet.section(r, f"The year in brief - {cfg.year}", last_col)
    year_revenue = window("Sales", "gross", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_profit = window("Sales", "profit", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_units = window("Sales", "qty", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_minutes = window("Sales", "minutes_total", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_cogs = window("Sales", "cost", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_fees = window("Sales", "fees", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_waste = window("Waste Log", "cost", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    year_orders = count_window("Sales", "YearStart", "YearEnd")
    tiles = [
        ("Revenue", year_revenue, "money0"),
        ("Cost of goods", year_cogs, "money0"),
        ("Fees", year_fees, "money0"),
        ("Profit", year_profit, "money0"),
        ("Margin", f"IF({year_revenue}=0,\"\",{year_profit}/{year_revenue})",
         "percent"),
        ("Units", year_units, "int"),
        ("Orders", year_orders, "int"),
        ("Waste", year_waste, "money0"),
        ("Hourly earned",
         f"IF({year_minutes}=0,0,{year_profit}/({year_minutes}/60))",
         "money"),
    ]
    for i, (label, formula, style) in enumerate(tiles):
        if i and i % 5 == 0:
            r += 3
        sheet.kpi(r, 1 + (i % 5) * 3, label, x(formula), style=style,
                  span=3, note="")
    r += 4

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- month by month
    r = sheet.section(r, "Month by month", last_col)
    r = table(r, [("Month", 2), ("Orders", 1), ("Units", 1), ("Revenue", 2),
                  ("Cost of goods", 2), ("Fees", 2), ("Profit", 2),
                  ("Margin", 2), ("Waste", 2), ("Labour hours", 1)])
    for month in range(1, 13):
        start = f"DATE(ReportYear,{month},1)"
        end = f"EOMONTH(DATE(ReportYear,{month},1),0)"
        revenue = window("Sales", "gross", start, end)
        profit = window("Sales", "profit", start, end)
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        put_text(r, 1, "", "text", span=2)
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=TEXT({start},"mmm")',
                               fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        put(r, 3, count_window("Sales", start, end), "int")
        put(r, 4, window("Sales", "qty", start, end), "int")
        put(r, 5, revenue, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 7, window("Sales", "cost", start, end), "money", span=2)
        put(r, 9, window("Sales", "fees", start, end), "money", span=2)
        put(r, 11, profit, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 13, f'IF({revenue}=0,"",{profit}/{revenue})', "percent",
            span=2)
        put(r, 15, window("Waste Log", "cost", start, end), "money", span=2)
        put(r, 17, window("Labor", "hours", start, end), "number")
        r += 1
    sheet.row_height(r, 18)
    put_text(r, 1, "Year", "status", span=2)
    put(r, 3, year_orders, "int")
    put(r, 4, year_units, "int")
    put(r, 5, year_revenue, "money", span=2)
    put(r, 7, year_cogs, "money", span=2)
    put(r, 9, year_fees, "money", span=2)
    put(r, 11, year_profit, "money", span=2)
    put(r, 13, f'IF({year_revenue}=0,"",{year_profit}/{year_revenue})',
        "percent", span=2)
    put(r, 15, year_waste, "money", span=2)
    put(r, 17, window("Labor", "hours", "YearStart", "YearEnd"), "number")
    r += 2

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- by category
    r = sheet.section(r, "By category", last_col)
    r = table(r, [("Category", 4), ("Products", 1), ("Units", 1),
                  ("Revenue", 2), ("Cost of goods", 2), ("Profit", 2),
                  ("Margin", 2), ("Average price", 2)])
    for category in PRODUCT_CATEGORIES:
        # Sales carries a hidden `category` column, so these are plain SUMIFS
        cat = (other("Sales", "category"), f'"{category}"')
        rev = window("Sales", "gross", "YearStart", "YearEnd", [cat])
        prof = window("Sales", "profit", "YearStart", "YearEnd", [cat])
        units = window("Sales", "qty", "YearStart", "YearEnd", [cat])
        cogs = window("Sales", "cost", "YearStart", "YearEnd", [cat])
        products = (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Products', 'category')},"
                    f"\"{category}\"),0)")
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        put_text(r, 1, category, "text", span=4)
        put(r, 5, products, "int")
        put(r, 6, units, "int")
        put(r, 7, rev, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 9, cogs, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 11, prof, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 13, f'IF({rev}=0,"",{prof}/{rev})', "percent", span=2)
        put(r, 15, f'IF({units}=0,"",{rev}/{units})', "money", span=2)
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- by channel/craft
    r = sheet.section(r, "By channel and by craft", last_col)
    r = table(r, [("Channel", 3), ("Orders", 1), ("Revenue", 2), ("Fees", 2),
                  ("Profit", 2), ("Margin", 2), ("Craft", 2), ("Units", 1),
                  ("Revenue", 2)])
    for n in range(1, 7):
        chan = f"IFERROR(INDEX({other('Channels', 'name')},{n}),\"\")"
        orders = (f"IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other('Sales', 'channel')},{chan},"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\">=\"&YearStart,"
                  f"{other('Sales', 'date')},\"<=\"&YearEnd),0)")
        revenue = window("Sales", "gross", "YearStart", "YearEnd",
                         [(other("Sales", "channel"), chan)])
        fees = window("Sales", "fees", "YearStart", "YearEnd",
                      [(other("Sales", "channel"), chan)])
        profit = window("Sales", "profit", "YearStart", "YearEnd",
                        [(other("Sales", "channel"), chan)])
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        put_text(r, 1, "", "text", span=3)
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=IFERROR({chan},"")',
                               fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        put(r, 4, orders, "int")
        put(r, 5, revenue, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 7, fees, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 9, profit, "money", span=2)
        put(r, 11, f'IF({revenue}=0,"",{profit}/{revenue})', "percent",
            span=2)
        if n <= len(CRAFT_LIST):
            craft = CRAFT_LIST[n - 1]
            c_units = window("Sales", "qty", "YearStart", "YearEnd",
                             [(other("Sales", "craft"), f'"{craft}"')])
            c_revenue = window("Sales", "gross", "YearStart", "YearEnd",
                               [(other("Sales", "craft"), f'"{craft}"')])
            put_text(r, 13, craft, "text", span=2)
            put(r, 15, c_units, "int")
            put(r, 16, c_revenue, "money", span=2)
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- top and worst
    r = sheet.section(r, "The catalog ranked", last_col)
    product_count = f'COUNTIF({other("Products", "id")},"?*")'
    book.define_name("RepProductCount", f"={reg.render(product_count)}")
    r = table(r, [("#", 1), ("Most revenue", 4), ("Revenue", 2),
                  ("Most profit", 4), ("Profit", 2),
                  ("Worst margin", 4)])
    for n in range(1, 11):
        by_revenue = (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other("Products", "name")},'
                      f'MATCH({n},{other("Products", "rank_revenue")},0)),"")')
        rev_value = (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other("Products", "revenue")},'
                     f'MATCH({n},{other("Products", "rank_revenue")},0)),"")')
        by_profit = (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other("Products", "name")},'
                     f'MATCH({n},{other("Products", "rank_profit")},0)),"")')
        profit_value = (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other("Products", "gross_profit")},'
                        f'MATCH({n},{other("Products", "rank_profit")},0)),"")')
        worst = (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other("Products", "name")},'
                 f'MATCH(RepProductCount-{n - 1},'
                 f'{other("Products", "rank_margin")},0)),"")')
        worst_margin = (f'IFERROR(INDEX({other("Products", "margin")},'
                        f'MATCH(RepProductCount-{n - 1},'
                        f'{other("Products", "rank_margin")},0)),"")')
        sheet.row_height(r, 17)
        put_text(r, 1, n, "int")
        put_text(r, 2, "", "text", span=4)
        sheet.formula(r, 2, x(by_revenue), fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        put(r, 6, rev_value, "money", span=2)
        put_text(r, 8, "", "text", span=4)
        sheet.formula(r, 8, x(by_profit), fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        put(r, 12, profit_value, "money", span=2)
        put_text(r, 14, "", "text", span=2)
        sheet.formula(r, 14, x(worst), fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        put(r, 16, worst_margin, "percent", span=2)
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------- stock, trade, promotions
    r = sheet.section(r, "Stock, trade, promotions, events and labour",
                      last_col)
    blocks: List[Tuple[str, List[Tuple[str, str, str]]]] = [
        ("Stock and purchasing", [
            ("Materials listed", f'COUNTIF({other("Materials", "id")},"?*")',
             "int"),
            ("Value of the stock",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Materials", "stock_value")}),0)', "money"),
            ("Lines to re-order",
             f'IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other("Materials", "stock_flag")},"REORDER")'
             f'+COUNTIFS({other("Materials", "stock_flag")},"ORDER NOW"),0)',
             "int"),
            ("Cost of an order run",
             f'IFERROR(SUMIF({other("Materials", "stock_flag")},"REORDER",'
             f'{other("Materials", "order_cost")}),0)', "money"),
            ("Waste this year", year_waste, "money"),
            ("Waste against materials used",
             f'IFERROR({year_waste}/'
             f'(SUM({other("Materials", "used_cost")})+{year_waste}),"")',
             "percent"),
        ]),
        ("Wholesale", [
            ("Shops on the books",
             f'COUNTIF({other("Wholesale Customers", "id")},"?*")', "int"),
            ("Orders this year",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Wholesale Orders", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Wholesale Orders", "date")}<=YearEnd)),0)', "int"),
            ("Trade value this year",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Wholesale Orders", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Wholesale Orders", "date")}<=YearEnd)'
             f'*({other("Wholesale Orders", "wholesale_total")})),0)', "money"),
            ("Profit on trade this year",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Wholesale Orders", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Wholesale Orders", "date")}<=YearEnd)'
             f'*({other("Wholesale Orders", "profit")})),0)', "money"),
            ("Outstanding now",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Wholesale Orders", "balance_outstanding")}),0)',
             "money"),
            ("Overdue now",
             f'IFERROR(SUMIFS({other("Wholesale Orders", "balance_outstanding")},'
             f'{other("Wholesale Orders", "aging_flag")},"OVERDUE"),0)',
             "money"),
        ]),
        ("Promotions", [
            ("Offers live now",
             f'IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other("Promotions", "state")},"LIVE"),0)',
             "int"),
            ("Redemptions",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Promotions", "redemptions")}),0)', "int"),
            ("Revenue with a code",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Promotions", "revenue_with_promo")}),0)',
             "money"),
            ("Discount given away",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Promotions", "discount_given")}),0)',
             "money"),
            ("Profit on those orders",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Promotions", "profit_with_promo")}),0)',
             "money"),
        ]),
        ("Events", [
            ("Events this year",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Events", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Events", "date")}<=YearEnd)),0)', "int"),
            ("Revenue at events",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Events", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Events", "date")}<=YearEnd)'
             f'*({other("Events", "revenue")})),0)', "money"),
            ("Cost of events",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Events", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Events", "date")}<=YearEnd)'
             f'*({other("Events", "total_cost")})),0)', "money"),
            ("Profit at events",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Events", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Events", "date")}<=YearEnd)'
             f'*({other("Events", "profit")})),0)', "money"),
            ("Hours on the road",
             f'IFERROR(SUMPRODUCT(({other("Events", "date")}>=YearStart)'
             f'*({other("Events", "date")}<=YearEnd)'
             f'*({other("Events", "total_hours")})),0)', "number"),
        ]),
        ("Labour", [
            ("Hours recorded",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Labor", "hours")}),0)', "number"),
            ("Cost of those hours",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Labor", "loaded_cost")}),0)', "money"),
            ("Hours on products",
             f'IFERROR(SUMIFS({other("Labor", "hours")},'
             f'{other("Labor", "is_production")},"Yes"),0)', "number"),
            ("Shop time cost",
             f'IFERROR(SUM({other("Labor", "overhead_share")}),0)', "money"),
            ("Below the minimum wage",
             f'IFERROR(COUNTIFS({other("Labor", "rate_check")},'
             f'"BELOW MIN WAGE"),0)', "int"),
        ]),
    ]
    for title, items in blocks:
        r = sheet.subsection(r, title, last_col)
        for i, (label, formula, style) in enumerate(items):
            col = 1 + (i % 3) * 6
            if i % 3 == 0:
                sheet.row_height(r, 20)
            sheet.merge(r, col, col + 3, label, fmts.chrome("label"))
            put(r, col + 4, formula, style, span=2)
            if i % 3 == 2:
                r += 1
        if len(items) % 3:
            r += 1
        r += 1

    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "Every figure on this page comes from a register - nothing is typed "
        "here, so nothing can drift out of date. Print it landscape on one "
        "page wide; it is laid out for that.",
        last_col, height=30)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(4, 3)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/retail_calc.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/retail_calc.py sha256:1908e9d06c822271902191f36e3baac0f44d4eddc78d7b83cca52d17a3b406f8 -->
````python
"""The Retail Calculator - one product, priced from scratch, on one screen.

Pick a product and every cost arrives from the registers; or type costs into
the cream cells and cost something that does not exist yet. The page then walks
down the model one step at a time - materials, labour at your real hourly cost,
packaging, the postage you absorb, overhead, the channel's fees - and lands on
the price your target margin asks for, next to the price you charge now.

The strip at the bottom prices the same item at five margins, so the cost of
being the cheap option is visible in money rather than in percentages.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import PRICING_SCENARIOS, Config, Palette
from ..layout import lookup
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from .common import (channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, other, price_from,
                     round_price)

P = Palette

NAME = "Retail Calculator"

SUBTITLE = ("Price one item step by step: costs, fees, the price your margin "
            "asks for, and what it really earns.")

HELP = ("Pick a product and its costs arrive from the catalog. Or type into "
        "the cream cells to cost something that does not exist yet - a "
        "prototype, a custom order, a new design.")

#: names this page defines, in the order they appear
NAMES = ["RcProduct", "RcChannel", "RcChannelUsed", "RcMaterials",
         "RcMinutes", "RcLabour", "RcPackaging", "RcPostage", "RcOverhead",
         "RcCost", "RcFeeRate", "RcFixed", "RcMargin", "RcMarginUsed",
         "RcCatalogPrice", "RcPrice", "RcPriceUsed", "RcSuggested",
         "RcFeesAtPrice", "RcProfit", "RcMarginNow", "RcHourly",
         "RcWholesale"]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=False)
    last_col = 10
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col, badge="Retail pricing")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 2, 26.0)
    sheet.set_col(3, 4, 15.0)
    sheet.set_col(5, last_col, 14.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    def f(row: int, label: str, *, formula: Optional[str] = None,
          value: Any = None, name: Optional[str] = None, style: str = "text",
          input_cell: bool = False, validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
          help_text: str = "") -> int:
        return sheet.field(row, label, value, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                           value_end=4, style=style,
                           mode="input" if input_cell else "calc",
                           name=name, validate=validate,
                           help_text=help_text, help_col=5, formula=formula)

    product_lookup = lambda key: lookup("RcProduct", other("Products", "id"),
                                        other("Products", key))
    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=32)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- the item
    r = sheet.section(r, "1. What are you pricing?", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Product", formula=None, value=None, name="RcProduct",
          input_cell=True, validate=list_from("ProductIDs"),
          help_text="Pick one and its costs arrive below. Leave it blank and "
                    "type your own figures.")
    r = f(r, "Product name", formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("name")},"")',
          style="text")
    r = f(r, "Craft", formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("craft")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Status", formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("status")},"")')
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- the costs
    r = sheet.section(r, "2. What one item costs", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Materials", name="RcMaterials", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("material_cost")},0)',
          help_text="From the bill of materials, or from the craft tab. Type "
                    "over it to cost something new.")
    r = f(r, "Minutes of work", name="RcMinutes", style="number1",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("minutes_used")},0)')
    r = f(r, "True cost of your hour", style="money",
          formula="=LaborCostHour",
          help_text="Your rate plus the payroll burden, from Settings.")
    r = f(r, "Labour", name="RcLabour", style="money",
          formula="=IF(N(RcMinutes)=0,0,N(RcMinutes)/60*LaborCostHour)")
    r = f(r, "Packaging", name="RcPackaging", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("packaging_cost")},DefaultPackaging)')
    r = f(r, "Postage you absorb", name="RcPostage", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("shipping_cost")},DefaultShipping)',
          help_text="The part of the postage you pay, not the customer.")
    r = f(r, "Share of overhead", name="RcOverhead", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("overhead_cost")},0)',
          help_text="Spread the way the Overhead method on Settings says.")
    r = sheet.field(r, "Total cost of one item", None, label_col=1,
                    value_col=3, value_end=4, style="money", name="RcCost",
                    formula="=N(RcMaterials)+N(RcLabour)+N(RcPackaging)"
                            "+N(RcPostage)+N(RcOverhead)",
                    help_text="This is the figure the price is built from.")
    r = _bold_row(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- the fees
    r = sheet.section(r, "3. What selling it costs", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Channel", name="RcChannel", input_cell=True,
          validate=list_from("ChannelList"),
          help_text="Blank uses the channel from the catalog, or the default "
                    "on Settings.")
    r = f(r, "Channel used", name="RcChannelUsed",
          formula=f'=IF(RcChannel<>"",RcChannel,'
                  f'IFERROR({product_lookup("channel")},DefaultChannel))')
    r = f(r, "Fee rate", name="RcFeeRate", style="percent",
          formula=f'={channel_fee_rate("RcChannelUsed")}',
          help_text="Transaction, processing, regulatory, currency and the "
                    "share of ad fees, from the Channels tab.")
    r = f(r, "Fixed fees an order", name="RcFixed", style="money",
          formula=f'={channel_fixed_fee("RcChannelUsed")}',
          help_text="The listing fee plus the fixed part of processing.")
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- the price
    r = sheet.section(r, "4. The price your margin asks for", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Target margin", name="RcMargin", style="percent",
          input_cell=True,
          help_text="Blank uses the target on Settings. Type 0.55 for 55%.")
    r = f(r, "Margin used", name="RcMarginUsed", style="percent",
          formula='=IF(RcMargin="",TargetRetailMargin,N(RcMargin))')
    r = sheet.field(r, "Suggested retail price", None, label_col=1,
                    value_col=3, value_end=4, style="money",
                    name="RcSuggested",
                    formula=f'={price_from("N(RcCost)", "N(RcFixed)", "RcMarginUsed", "N(RcFeeRate)")}',
                    help_text="(cost + fixed fees) / (1 - margin - fee rate), "
                              "rounded the way Settings says.")
    r = _bold_row(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    r = f(r, "Price by markup instead", style="money",
          formula="=N(RcCost)*DefaultMarkup",
          help_text="Cost times the default markup - the quick and usually "
                    "wrong way, shown for comparison.")
    r = f(r, "Catalog price", name="RcCatalogPrice", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({product_lookup("retail_price")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Price you charge", name="RcPrice", style="money",
          input_cell=True,
          help_text="Blank uses the catalog price.")
    r = f(r, "Price used", name="RcPriceUsed", style="money",
          formula='=IF(RcPrice="",N(RcCatalogPrice),N(RcPrice))')
    r = f(r, "Gap to the model price", style="money",
          formula='=IF(OR(RcPriceUsed="",RcSuggested=""),"",'
                  'N(RcSuggested)-N(RcPriceUsed))',
          help_text="Positive means you are charging less than your own "
                    "target margin asks for.")
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- what it earns
    r = sheet.section(r, "5. What it actually earns", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Fees at this price", name="RcFeesAtPrice", style="money",
          formula="=IF(N(RcPriceUsed)=0,0,N(RcFeeRate)*N(RcPriceUsed)"
                  "+N(RcFixed))")
    r = f(r, "Profit an item", name="RcProfit", style="money",
          formula="=IF(N(RcPriceUsed)=0,\"\",N(RcPriceUsed)"
                  "-N(RcFeesAtPrice)-N(RcCost))")
    r = f(r, "Margin", name="RcMarginNow", style="percent",
          formula="=IF(N(RcPriceUsed)=0,\"\",N(RcProfit)/N(RcPriceUsed))")
    r = f(r, "Margin check", style="text",
          formula="=IF(N(RcPriceUsed)=0,\"\",IF(N(RcProfit)<=0,\"LOSS - "
                  "PRICED BELOW COST\",IF(N(RcMarginNow)<MarginWarning,"
                  "\"THIN - BELOW YOUR WARNING\",\"OK\")))")
    r = f(r, "Effective hourly", name="RcHourly", style="money",
          formula="=IF(N(RcMinutes)=0,\"\",N(RcProfit)/(N(RcMinutes)/60))",
          help_text="What an hour of making this earns, after every fee.")
    r = f(r, "Wage check", style="text",
          formula="=IF(N(RcMinutes)=0,\"\",IF(N(RcHourly)<0,\"PAYING TO "
                  "WORK\",IF(N(RcHourly)<MinimumWage,\"BELOW THE MINIMUM "
                  "WAGE\",IF(N(RcHourly)<HourlyRate,\"BELOW YOUR OWN RATE\","
                  "\"GOOD\"))))")
    r = f(r, "Wholesale price", name="RcWholesale", style="money",
          formula=f'={round_price("N(RcSuggested)*(1-WholesaleDiscount)")}',
          help_text="The model price less the trade discount on Settings.")
    r = f(r, "Wholesale margin", style="percent",
          formula="=IF(N(RcWholesale)=0,\"\",(N(RcWholesale)-N(RcCost))"
                  "/N(RcWholesale))")
    r = f(r, "Wholesale check", style="text",
          formula="=IF(N(RcWholesale)=0,\"\",IF(N(RcWholesale)-N(RcCost)<=0,"
                  "\"TRADE LOSES MONEY\",IF((N(RcWholesale)-N(RcCost))"
                  "/N(RcWholesale)<TargetWholesaleMargin,\"BELOW THE TRADE "
                  "TARGET\",\"OK\")))")
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- scenarios
    r = sheet.section(r, "6. The same item at five margins", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    for i, head in enumerate(["Scenario", "Margin", "Price", "Profit",
                              "Hourly"]):
        col = 1 + i * 2
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    for scenario, margin in PRICING_SCENARIOS.items():
        price = price_from("N(RcCost)", "N(RcFixed)", str(margin),
                           "N(RcFeeRate)")
        profit = (f"N({price})-(N(RcFeeRate)*N({price})+N(RcFixed))-N(RcCost)")
        sheet.row_height(r, 18)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 2, scenario, fmts.cell("text", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 3, r, 4, margin, fmts.cell("percent", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 5, r, 6, "", fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 5, "=" + price, fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 7, r, 8, "", fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(r, 7, "=" + profit,
                               fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 9, r, 10, "", fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        sheet.formula(
            r, 9, f"=IF(N(RcMinutes)=0,\"\",({profit})/(N(RcMinutes)/60))",
            fmts.cell("money", "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1

    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "The margin is in the denominator for a reason. A 30% margin is not "
        "cost plus 30%: if the item costs 20 and the channel takes 10%, "
        "charging 26 leaves 6.60 after fees against a cost of 20, which is a "
        "loss. Charging 33.99 leaves the 30% you meant.",
        last_col, height=44)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(4, 0)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def _bold_row(sheet, fmts, row: int, first_col: int, last_col: int) -> int:
    """Draw a rule under a total, on the spacer row below it.

    The total has already been written on `row - 1`, so the rule cannot go on
    that row without wiping the label and the value. It goes on the next row
    instead, which is blank anyway, and the caller carries on below it.
    """
    sheet.row_height(row, 7)
    for col in range(first_col, last_col + 1):
        sheet.ws.write_blank(row, col, None, fmts.chrome("rule"))
    return row + 1
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/sales.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/sales.py sha256:23170c1b5e248f4feafe0931947b8b957f58a169aa57df3ffe44f217181d179b -->
````python
"""The Sales tab - the money that actually came in.

One row per order line: what sold, where, how many, at what price, what the
channel took, what the postage cost and what the goods cost. From that comes
the profit and the margin of the sale, and the effective hourly wage behind it
- which is the number that decides whether a product is worth making again.

Refunds and cancellations are handled by the `counts` column rather than by
deleting rows: a refunded sale keeps its cost (the item is gone) but loses its
revenue, so it shows as a loss instead of disappearing. That is what a refund
really does to a month.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from ..writer import list_from
from ..layout import Col
from .common import (calc_col, channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee,
                     channel_lookup, date_col, fetch, id_col, int_col,
                     list_col, money_col, num_col, pct_col, product_col,
                     rank_desc, row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, text_col,
                     wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Sales"

SUBTITLE = ("Every order: price, fees, postage, cost, profit and what the "
            "hour was worth.")

HELP = ("Pick the product and the date, type the quantity and the price paid. "
        "Everything else is calculated - including the profit and the hourly "
        "wage the order earned. Set the status to Refunded and the row keeps "
        "its cost but loses its revenue, which is what a refund really does.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    sid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{sid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    date = row_ref("date")
    status = row_ref("status")
    qty = f"N({row_ref('qty')})"
    unit_price = f"N({row_ref('unit_price')})"
    discount = f"N({row_ref('discount_pct')})"
    counts = row_ref("counts")

    from_product = (f'IFERROR(INDEX([[Products.channel]],'
                    f'MATCH({product},[[Products.id]],0)),"")')
    chan_raw = (f'IF({row_ref("channel")}="",{from_product},'
                f'{row_ref("channel")})')
    chan = f'IF({chan_raw}="",DefaultChannel,{chan_raw})'
    rate = channel_fee_rate(chan)
    fixed = channel_fixed_fee(chan)
    ship_pct = channel_lookup(chan, "shipping_fee_pct", "0")
    ship_flag = channel_lookup(chan, "fees_on_shipping", "No")
    fees_on_post = (f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({ship_flag}),"Yes"),'
                    f'N({row_ref("shipping_paid")})*{ship_pct},0)')
    gross = f'{qty}*{unit_price}*(1-{discount})'
    unit_cost = fetch("Products", "id", "total_cost", product, "0")
    minutes_used = fetch("Products", "id", "minutes_used", product, "0")

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixSale", trigger="product", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date", 13.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        calc_col("sku", "SKU",
                 f'IF({product}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "sku", product)})',
                 14.0, "text"),
        calc_col("craft", "Craft",
                 f'IF({product}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "craft", product)})',
                 12.0, "text"),
        calc_col("category", "category",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "category", product)})',
                 12.0, "text", hidden=True,
                 note="Hidden - the Reports tab groups the year by category "
                      "with a plain SUMIFS on this column."),
        list_col("channel", "Channel", "ChannelList", 15.0,
                 note="Blank takes the channel from the Products tab."),
        int_col("qty", "Qty", 8.0),
        money_col("unit_price", "Price paid", 12.0,
                  note="What the customer paid for one - after any deal."),
        calc_col("catalog_price", "Catalog price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{fetch("Products", "id", "retail_price", product, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("price_check", "Price check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{unit_price}=0),"",'
                 f'IF({unit_price}<N({row_ref("catalog_price")})*0.8,'
                 f'"WELL BELOW LIST",IF({unit_price}>N({row_ref("catalog_price")}),'
                 f'"ABOVE LIST","OK")))', 16.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "WELL BELOW", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ABOVE", "fmt": "good"}]),
        pct_col("discount_pct", "Discount", 10.0,
                note="Taken off this line, as a decimal: 0.15 for 15%."),
        Col(key="promo", header="Promo code", width=14.0, style="text",
            validate=list_from("PromoCodes"),
            note="The code the customer used, if any."),
        calc_col("promo_discount", "Promo discount",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("promo")}=""),0,'
                 f'{fetch("Promotions", "code", "discount", row_ref("promo"), "0")})',
                 12.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("promo_check", "Promo check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("promo")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(N({fetch("Promotions", "code", "start", row_ref("promo"), "0")})=0,'
                 f'"NO SUCH CODE",'
                 f'IF(N({date})<N({fetch("Promotions", "code", "start", row_ref("promo"), "0")}),'
                 f'"NOT STARTED",'
                 f'IF(N({date})>N({fetch("Promotions", "code", "end", row_ref("promo"), "0")}),'
                 f'"ENDED","IN DATE"))))', 15.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "NO SUCH", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ENDED", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "IN DATE", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("counts", "Counts?",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(OR(EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Refunded"),'
                 f'EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Cancelled")),"No","Yes"))', 9.0,
                 "flag",
                 note="Refunded and cancelled rows keep their cost but lose "
                      "their revenue.",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "No", "fmt": "bad"}]),
        calc_col("gross", "Gross",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({counts}="No",0,{gross}))', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fee_rate", "Fee rate", f'IF({has_id},"",{rate})', 10.0,
                 "percent"),
        calc_col("fees_on_postage", "Fees on postage",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({counts}="No",0,{fees_on_post}))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fees", "Fees",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({counts}="No",0,'
                 f'{rate}*N({row_ref("gross")})+{fixed}+{fees_on_post}))',
                 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fee_pct", "Fees % of gross",
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("gross")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("fees")})/N({row_ref("gross")}))', 11.0,
                 "percent"),
        money_col("shipping_paid", "Postage paid by customer", 13.0),
        money_col("shipping_cost", "Postage it cost you", 13.0),
        calc_col("shipping_gap", "Postage gap",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("shipping_paid")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("shipping_cost")}))', 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("cost", "Cost of goods",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{qty}*{unit_cost})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("net", "Net revenue",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({counts}="No",0,N({row_ref("gross")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("shipping_paid")})-N({row_ref("fees")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("shipping_cost")})))', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("profit", "Profit",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("net")})-N({row_ref("cost")}))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("margin", "Margin",
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("net")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("profit")})/N({row_ref("net")}))', 10.0,
                 "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("margin_flag", "Flag",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("net")})=0,"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("profit")})<=0,"LOSS",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("margin")})<MarginWarning,"THIN","OK"))))',
                 9.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LOSS", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "THIN", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("minutes_total", "Minutes of work",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{qty}*{minutes_used})', 12.0, "number1"),
        calc_col("effective_hourly", "Hourly earned",
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("minutes_total")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("profit")})/(N({row_ref("minutes_total")})/60))',
                 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        list_col("status", "Status", "SaleStatusList", 12.0),
        list_col("payment_method", "Paid by", "PaymentMethodList", 13.0),
        text_col("order_ref", "Order ref", 14.0),
        text_col("customer", "Customer", 20.0,
                 note="A name or a handle - optional, for wholesale and "
                      "repeat buyers."),
        calc_col("month", "Month",
                 f'IF({date}="","",TEXT(N({date}),"yyyy-mm"))', 10.0, "text"),
        calc_col("week_start", "Week beginning",
                 f'IF({date}="","",N({date})-WEEKDAY(N({date}),3))', 12.0,
                 "date", note="Mondays."),
        calc_col("rank_profit", "rank profit", rank_desc("profit"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    """Shade any order that lost money."""
    spec_obj = reg[NAME]
    flag = spec_obj.letter("margin_flag")
    first = spec_obj.first_data_row
    last = spec_obj.last_data_row
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(
        first - 1, 0, last - 1, spec_obj.last_col_index,
        {"type": "formula", "criteria": f'${flag}{first}="LOSS"',
         "format": fmts.cf("bad")})
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/scenarios.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/scenarios.py sha256:7b4e40257860fc4961d426b4f5b1f97a870c757c27f859a3828c63fc7406dc4b -->
````python
"""The Scenarios tab - the same product priced five ways.

One product, five target margins from the budget end of the market to luxury,
plus what it earns at the price you charge today. Same costs, same fees, same
hours - only the margin changes, so the difference between the columns is pure
pricing.

The point of the page is the two rows at the bottom. `Monthly revenue` and
`Monthly profit` multiply each price by the units a month on Settings, which
turns a percentage argument into money: a budget price that needs three times
the sales to earn the same is a different business, not just a different
number.

Every row below the price row reads the cells above it rather than repeating
the pricing model. That is how a spreadsheet should be built anyway, and it
also keeps each formula far inside Excel's 8,192 character limit - inlining
the model eight times over, once per row, runs past it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import PRICING_SCENARIOS, Config, Palette
from ..layout import col_letter, lookup
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from .common import (channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, other, price_from,
                     round_price)

P = Palette

NAME = "Scenarios"

SUBTITLE = ("One product at five margins, side by side, with what each would "
            "earn over a month.")

HELP = ("Pick a product. Every column below is the same item at a different "
        "target margin; the last column is the price you charge today.")

#: the rows of the comparison table, top to bottom
ROWS: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]] = (
    ("Target margin", "percent"),
    ("Price", "money"),
    ("Profit an item", "money"),
    ("Margin after fees", "percent"),
    ("Effective hourly", "money"),
    ("Wholesale price", "money"),
    ("Monthly revenue", "money"),
    ("Monthly profit", "money"),
    ("Sales needed for the same profit", "number1"),
)

MARGIN = "Target margin"
PRICE = "Price"
PROFIT = "Profit an item"
MARGIN_NET = "Margin after fees"
HOURLY = "Effective hourly"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=True)
    scenarios = list(PRICING_SCENARIOS.items()) + [("At today's price", None)]
    columns = len(scenarios)
    last_col = 2 + columns * 2
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col, badge="Pricing scenarios")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 2, 30.0)
    for i in range(columns):
        sheet.set_col(3 + i * 2, 4 + i * 2, 14.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    def f(row: int, label: str, *, formula: Optional[str] = None,
          value: Any = None, name: Optional[str] = None, style: str = "text",
          input_cell: bool = False, validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
          help_text: str = "") -> int:
        return sheet.field(row, label, value, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                           value_end=4, style=style,
                           mode="input" if input_cell else "calc",
                           name=name, validate=validate,
                           help_text=help_text, help_col=5, formula=formula)

    prod = lambda key: lookup("ScProduct", other("Products", "id"),
                              other("Products", key))
    channel_of = f'IFERROR({prod("channel")},DefaultChannel)'

    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=30)

    r = sheet.section(r, "1. The product", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Product", name="ScProduct", input_cell=True,
          validate=list_from("ProductIDs"))
    r = f(r, "Product name", formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("name")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Craft", formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("craft")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Cost of one item", name="ScCost", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("total_cost")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Minutes an item", name="ScMinutes", style="number1",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("minutes_used")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Fee rate", name="ScFeeRate", style="percent",
          formula=f"={channel_fee_rate(channel_of)}")
    r = f(r, "Fixed fees an order", name="ScFixedFees", style="money",
          formula=f"={channel_fixed_fee(channel_of)}")
    r = f(r, "Price today", name="ScPriceToday", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("retail_price")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Units a month", name="ScUnits", style="int",
          formula="=UnitsPerMonth",
          help_text="From Settings - change it there to test a different "
                    "volume.")
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------- the comparison
    r = sheet.section(r, "2. The same item at every margin", last_col)
    header_row = r
    sheet.row_height(header_row, 30)
    sheet.merge(header_row, 1, 2, "Scenario", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    for i, (label, _margin) in enumerate(scenarios):
        col = 3 + i * 2
        sheet.ws.merge_range(header_row, col, header_row, col + 1, label,
                             fmts.chrome("header"))
    r += 1

    first = r
    row_of = {label: first + i for i, (label, _style) in enumerate(ROWS)}
    verdict_row = first + len(ROWS)

    def cell(label: str, i: int) -> str:
        """Absolute reference to one scenario column on one table row."""
        return f"${col_letter(3 + i * 2)}${row_of[label] + 1}"

    def put(row: int, i: int, formula: str, style: str) -> None:
        col = 3 + i * 2
        fmt = fmts.cell(style, "plain")
        sheet.ws.merge_range(row, col, row, col + 1, "", fmt)
        sheet.formula(row, col, formula, fmt)

    def margin_formula(i: int) -> str:
        if scenarios[i][1] is None:
            return ('=IF(N(ScPriceToday)=0,0,(N(ScPriceToday)'
                    '-(N(ScFeeRate)*N(ScPriceToday)+N(ScFixedFees))'
                    '-N(ScCost))/N(ScPriceToday))')
        return "=" + str(scenarios[i][1])

    def price_formula(i: int) -> str:
        if scenarios[i][1] is None:
            return "=N(ScPriceToday)"
        return "=" + price_from("N(ScCost)", "N(ScFixedFees)",
                                f"N({cell(MARGIN, i)})", "N(ScFeeRate)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- table rows
    for i in range(columns):
        put(row_of[MARGIN], i, margin_formula(i), "percent")
        put(row_of[PRICE], i, price_formula(i), "money")

    for i in range(columns):
        price = cell(PRICE, i)
        profit = cell(PROFIT, i)
        hourly = cell(HOURLY, i)
        net = cell(MARGIN_NET, i)
        base_profit = cell(PROFIT, 0)
        put(row_of[PROFIT], i,
            f"=N({price})-(N(ScFeeRate)*N({price})+N(ScFixedFees))-N(ScCost)",
            "money")
        put(row_of[MARGIN_NET], i,
            f'=IF(N({price})=0,"",N({profit})/N({price}))', "percent")
        put(row_of[HOURLY], i,
            f'=IF(N(ScMinutes)=0,"",N({profit})/(N(ScMinutes)/60))', "money")
        put(row_of["Wholesale price"], i,
            f'=IF(N({price})=0,"",'
            f'{round_price(f"N({price})*(1-WholesaleDiscount)")})', "money")
        put(row_of["Monthly revenue"], i, f"=N({price})*N(ScUnits)", "money")
        put(row_of["Monthly profit"], i, f"=N({profit})*N(ScUnits)", "money")
        put(row_of["Sales needed for the same profit"], i,
            f'=IF(N({base_profit})<=0,"n/a",N({base_profit})'
            f'/IF(N({profit})<=0,0.0001,N({profit})))', "number1")
        put(verdict_row, i,
            f'=IF(N({price})=0,"NO PRICE",'
            f'IF(N({profit})<=0,"LOSES MONEY",'
            f'IF(N(ScMinutes)=0,"NO TIME RECORDED",'
            f'IF(N({hourly})<MinimumWage,"BELOW THE MINIMUM WAGE",'
            f'IF(N({net})<MarginWarning,"THIN MARGIN","WORKS")))))', "status")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- row furniture
    for label, _style in ROWS:
        row = row_of[label]
        sheet.row_height(row, 18)
        bold = label in (PRICE, PROFIT)
        sheet.merge(row, 1, 2, label,
                    fmts.chrome("label_bold" if bold else "label"))
    sheet.row_height(verdict_row, 30)
    sheet.merge(verdict_row, 1, 2, "Verdict", fmts.chrome("label_bold"))
    for i in range(columns):
        col = 3 + i * 2
        for word, kind in (("LOSES", "bold_bad"), ("BELOW", "warn"),
                           ("WORKS", "good")):
            sheet.ws.conditional_format(
                verdict_row, col, verdict_row, col + 1,
                {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": word,
                 "format": fmts.cf(kind)})
    r = verdict_row + 2

    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "'Sales needed for the same profit' compares each column with the "
        "Budget market column: a figure of 3 means the budget price has to "
        "sell three times as many to earn what that column earns. That is the "
        "real cost of being the cheap option.",
        last_col, height=44)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(header_row + 1, 3)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/settings.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/settings.py sha256:5f9030036080d29d3b9e71c132a1de1465602907a7d8e2deab43f6ea8495971c -->
````python
"""The Settings tab - every number the rest of the workbook reads.

This is the control room. Nothing else in the workbook carries a hard coded
rate, fee, margin or prefix: they all read a defined name that points at a cell
here. Change your hourly rate here and every craft calculator, every product
cost and every break-even figure moves with it.

A few cells are calculated rather than typed, and they matter:

* ``LaborCostHour`` is the rate you pay yourself plus the payroll burden - the
  honest cost of an hour of your own time;
* ``OverheadMonthly`` totals the allocated rows of the Overhead tab, and
  ``OverheadPerHour`` and ``OverheadPerUnit`` divide it the way the overhead
  method says;
* ``TodayDate`` is TODAY(), so the reminders, the aging and the monthly
  columns follow the calendar rather than the day the file was generated.

The cream cells are yours. The sheet is protected, so the calculated ones
cannot be typed over by accident.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List

from ..config import (ROUNDING_RULES, SALES_CHANNELS, Config, Palette)
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from .common import (FIRST_ROW, OVERHEAD_METHODS, block, other)

P = Palette

NAME = "Settings"

SUBTITLE = ("Your rates, fees, margins, targets and ID prefixes. Every other "
            "tab reads this one.")

HELP = ("Change a figure here and the whole workbook follows. The cream cells "
        "are yours to type in; the calculated ones are locked.")

#: label -> (name, default, style, validate, help)
BUSINESS: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

PREFIXES: List[tuple] = [
    ("PrefixProduct", "Products", "P-"),
    ("PrefixMaterial", "Materials", "M-"),
    ("PrefixUsage", "Material Usage", "MU-"),
    ("PrefixLabor", "Labor", "L-"),
    ("PrefixPackaging", "Packaging", "PK-"),
    ("PrefixShipping", "Shipping", "SH-"),
    ("PrefixOverhead", "Overhead", "OH-"),
    ("PrefixBundle", "Bundles", "BN-"),
    ("PrefixBundleLine", "Bundle Lines", "BL-"),
    ("PrefixVariation", "Variations", "VR-"),
    ("PrefixBatch", "Batches", "BT-"),
    ("PrefixSale", "Sales", "SL-"),
    ("PrefixPromo", "Promotions", "PM-"),
    ("PrefixHistory", "Price History", "PH-"),
    ("PrefixCompetitor", "Competitors", "CP-"),
    ("PrefixWaste", "Waste Log", "WL-"),
    ("PrefixDevelopment", "Development", "DV-"),
    ("PrefixEvent", "Events", "EV-"),
    ("PrefixCustomer", "Wholesale Customers", "WC-"),
    ("PrefixOrder", "Wholesale Orders", "WO-"),
    ("PrefixCrochet", "Crochet", "CRO-"),
    ("PrefixJewelry", "Jewelry", "JWL-"),
    ("PrefixCandle", "Candles", "CND-"),
    ("PrefixClothing", "Clothing", "CLO-"),
    ("PrefixWood", "Woodworking", "WDW-"),
    ("PrefixDigital", "Digital", "DIG-"),
]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=False)
    last_col = 9
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col)
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 2, 30.0)
    sheet.set_col(3, 4, 17.0)
    sheet.set_col(5, last_col, 15.0)
    sheet.hide_gridlines(2) if hasattr(sheet, "hide_gridlines") else None
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=30)

    def field(row, label, value=None, *, name=None, style="text",
              formula=None, validate=None, help_text=""):
        return sheet.field(row, label, value, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                           style=style, name=name, formula=formula,
                           validate=validate, help_text=help_text,
                           help_col=5)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- the shop
    r = sheet.section(r, "1. Your shop", last_col)
    shop = cfg.shop
    r = field(r, "Shop name", shop.name, name="ShopName",
              help_text="Printed on the printables and the quote.")
    r = field(r, "Maker / owner", shop.owner, name="ShopOwner")
    r = field(r, "Brand", shop.brand, name="ShopBrand")
    r = field(r, "Email", shop.email, name="ShopEmail")
    r = field(r, "Phone", shop.phone, name="ShopPhone")
    r = field(r, "Address", shop.address, name="ShopAddress")
    r = field(r, "Website", shop.website, name="ShopWebsite")
    r = field(r, "Etsy shop", shop.etsy_shop, name="EtsyShop")
    r = field(r, "Instagram", shop.instagram, name="Instagram")
    r = field(r, "Tagline", shop.tagline, name="Tagline")
    r = field(r, "Tax / registration ID", shop.tax_id, name="TaxID",
              help_text="Goes on the wholesale order form.")
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- the dates
    r = sheet.section(r, "2. Dates", last_col)
    r = field(r, "Today", formula="=TODAY()", name="TodayDate", style="date",
              help_text="Calculated - every reminder and aging column reads "
                        "this.")
    r = field(r, "Report year", formula="=YEAR(TodayDate)", name="ReportYear",
              style="int")
    r = field(r, "This month starts",
              formula="=DATE(YEAR(TodayDate),MONTH(TodayDate),1)",
              name="MonthStart", style="date")
    r = field(r, "This month ends", formula="=EOMONTH(MonthStart,0)",
              name="MonthEnd", style="date")
    r = field(r, "This year starts", formula="=DATE(ReportYear,1,1)",
              name="YearStart", style="date")
    r = field(r, "This year ends", formula="=DATE(ReportYear,12,31)",
              name="YearEnd", style="date")
    r = field(r, "Fee schedule last checked", cfg.today, name="FeesReviewed",
              style="date",
              help_text="Marketplace fees move - put the date you last "
                        "checked them.")
    r = field(r, "Check the fees every (days)", cfg.fee_review_days,
              name="FeeReviewDays", style="int")
    r = field(r, "Fee schedule out of date?",
              formula=('=IF(FeesReviewed="","",'
                       'IF(TodayDate-FeesReviewed>FeeReviewDays,"Yes","No"))'),
              name="FeeStale", style="flag",
              help_text="The Dashboard shows a warning when this says Yes.")
    r += 1

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- labour
    r = sheet.section(r, "3. Your labour", last_col)
    r = field(r, "What you pay yourself an hour", cfg.hourly_rate,
              name="HourlyRate", style="money",
              help_text="The rate the whole workbook costs your time at.")
    r = field(r, "Minimum wage where you are", cfg.minimum_wage,
              name="MinimumWage", style="money",
              help_text="Anything earning less than this gets flagged.")
    r = field(r, "An employee's rate an hour", cfg.employee_rate,
              name="EmployeeRate", style="money")
    r = field(r, "A contractor's rate an hour", cfg.contractor_rate,
              name="ContractorRate", style="money")
    r = field(r, "Payroll burden", cfg.payroll_burden, name="PayrollBurden",
              style="percent",
              help_text="Tax, insurance, holiday pay - as a decimal, 0.12 "
                        "for 12%.")
    r = field(r, "True cost of your hour",
              formula="=HourlyRate*(1+PayrollBurden)", name="LaborCostHour",
              style="money",
              help_text="Calculated - this is what every labour cost uses.")
    r = field(r, "Productive hours a month", cfg.productive_hours,
              name="ProductiveHours", style="number",
              help_text="Hours actually spent making, not admin.")
    r = field(r, "Units made a month", cfg.units_per_month,
              name="UnitsPerMonth", style="int")
    r = field(r, "Default batch size", cfg.default_batch_size,
              name="DefaultBatchSize", style="int",
              help_text="Used when a craft row leaves the batch blank.")
    r = field(r, "Supplies an hour", cfg.supplies_per_hour,
              name="SuppliesPerHour", style="money",
              help_text="Thread, blades, sandpaper, gloves - consumables.")
    r = field(r, "Hourly wage you are aiming at",
              formula="=MAX(HourlyRate,LaborCostHour)", name="TargetHourly",
              style="money")
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------- waste and costs
    r = sheet.section(r, "4. Defaults for materials and packaging", last_col)
    r = field(r, "Default waste", cfg.default_waste, name="DefaultWaste",
              style="percent",
              help_text="Used when a material's own waste is blank.")
    r = field(r, "Default defect rate", cfg.default_defect_rate,
              name="DefaultDefect", style="percent",
              help_text="What a batch loses to seconds, as a decimal.")
    r = field(r, "Default packaging cost", cfg.default_packaging,
              name="DefaultPackaging", style="money",
              help_text="Used when the Packaging tab has nothing for a product.")
    r = field(r, "Default postage absorbed", cfg.default_shipping,
              name="DefaultShipping", style="money",
              help_text="What you pay towards postage when the Shipping tab "
                        "says nothing.")
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- overhead
    r = sheet.section(r, "5. Overhead", last_col)
    overhead_total = reg["Overhead"]
    allocated = other("Overhead", "allocated_month")
    r = field(r, "How overhead is spread", "Per unit", name="OverheadMethod",
              validate=list_from("OverheadMethodList"),
              help_text="Per unit, per hour, or per month divided by the "
                        "units you make.")
    r = field(r, "Overhead a month",
              formula=f"=IFERROR(SUM({allocated}),0)", name="OverheadMonthly",
              style="money",
              help_text="Calculated - the total of the allocated rows on the "
                        "Overhead tab.")
    r = field(r, "Overhead an hour",
              formula="=IF(ProductiveHours<=0,0,OverheadMonthly/"
                      "ProductiveHours)", name="OverheadPerHour",
              style="money4")
    r = field(r, "Overhead a unit",
              formula="=IF(UnitsPerMonth<=0,0,OverheadMonthly/UnitsPerMonth)",
              name="OverheadPerUnit", style="money4")
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- fees
    r = sheet.section(r, "6. Marketplace fees", last_col)
    r = field(r, "Default channel", SALES_CHANNELS[0], name="DefaultChannel",
              validate=list_from("ChannelList"),
              help_text="Used when a product or a craft row leaves the "
                        "channel blank.")
    r = field(r, "Listing fee", cfg.listing_fee, name="ListingFee",
              style="money")
    r = field(r, "Transaction fee", cfg.transaction_fee,
              name="TransactionFee", style="percent",
              help_text="As a decimal: 0.065 for 6.5%.")
    r = field(r, "Processing percentage", cfg.processing_percent,
              name="ProcessingPercent", style="percent")
    r = field(r, "Processing fixed", cfg.processing_fixed,
              name="ProcessingFixed", style="money")
    r = field(r, "Offsite ad fee", cfg.offsite_ads_fee, name="OffsiteAdsFee",
              style="percent")
    r = field(r, "Share of orders ads bring", cfg.offsite_ads_share,
              name="OffsiteAdsShare", style="percent",
              help_text="The ad fee only applies to those orders.")
    r = field(r, "Regulatory fee", cfg.regulatory_fee, name="RegulatoryFee",
              style="percent")
````
