````python
    r = field(r, "Currency conversion fee", cfg.currency_fee,
              name="CurrencyFee", style="percent")
    r = field(r, "Fees charged on postage too?", cfg.fees_include_shipping,
              name="FeesOnShipping", validate=list_from("YesNoList"))
    r = field(r, "Fees charged on tax?", cfg.fees_include_tax,
              name="FeesIncludeTax", validate=list_from("YesNoList"))
    r = field(r, "Total default fee rate",
              formula="=TransactionFee+ProcessingPercent+RegulatoryFee"
                      "+CurrencyFee+OffsiteAdsFee*OffsiteAdsShare",
              name="DefaultFeeRate", style="percent",
              help_text="Calculated - the Channels tab carries the real "
                        "figures per channel.")
    r += 1

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- pricing
    r = sheet.section(r, "7. Pricing rules", last_col)
    r = field(r, "Target retail margin", cfg.target_retail_margin,
              name="TargetRetailMargin", style="percent",
              help_text="What you want left after cost and fees, as a "
                        "decimal: 0.30 for 30%.")
    r = field(r, "Target wholesale margin", cfg.target_wholesale_margin,
              name="TargetWholesaleMargin", style="percent")
    r = field(r, "Default markup", cfg.default_markup, name="DefaultMarkup",
              style="number",
              help_text="Cost times this, when a markup is used instead of a "
                        "margin.")
    r = field(r, "Wholesale discount", cfg.wholesale_discount,
              name="WholesaleDiscount", style="percent",
              help_text="Off retail: 0.40 means trade buys at 60%.")
    r = field(r, "Margin warning below", cfg.margin_warning,
              name="MarginWarning", style="percent",
              help_text="Anything under this is flagged THIN.")
    r = field(r, "How prices are rounded", cfg.rounding_rule,
              name="RoundingRule", validate=list_from("RoundingList"),
              help_text="Applied to every calculated price in the workbook.")
    r = field(r, "Default discount", cfg.default_discount,
              name="DefaultDiscount", style="percent")
    r = field(r, "Sales tax / VAT rate", cfg.tax_rate, name="TaxRate",
              style="percent",
              help_text="Added on the printables, not to your margin.")
    r = field(r, "Minimum wholesale quantity", cfg.minimum_order_qty,
              name="MinOrderQty", style="int")
    r = field(r, "Minimum wholesale order", cfg.minimum_order_value,
              name="MinOrderValue", style="money")
    r = field(r, "Review a price every (days)", cfg.price_review_days,
              name="PriceReviewDays", style="int")
    r = field(r, "Low stock warning (days)", cfg.low_stock_days,
              name="LowStockDays", style="int")
    r += 1

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- targets
    r = sheet.section(r, "8. Targets the Dashboard measures against", last_col)
    r = field(r, "Revenue a month", cfg.revenue_target_month,
              name="MonthlyRevenueTarget", style="money")
    r = field(r, "Revenue a year", cfg.revenue_target_year,
              name="AnnualRevenueTarget", style="money")
    r = field(r, "Profit a month", cfg.profit_target_month,
              name="MonthlyProfitTarget", style="money")
    r = field(r, "Revenue needed a productive hour",
              formula="=IF(ProductiveHours<=0,0,MonthlyRevenueTarget/"
                      "ProductiveHours)", name="RevenuePerHourTarget",
              style="money")
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- prefixes
    r = sheet.section(r, "9. ID prefixes", last_col)
    r = sheet.note(r, "Every register numbers itself with the prefix below, "
                      "so an ID tells you which tab it came from.", last_col,
                   height=26)
    for name, tab, prefix in PREFIXES:
        r = field(r, f"{tab} prefix", prefix, name=name,
                  help_text=f"Used by the {tab} tab.")
    r += 1

    r = sheet.section(r, "How the price is worked out", last_col)
    for line in [
        "Total unit cost = materials + labour + packaging + postage you "
        "absorb + a share of overhead.",
        "Labour = minutes / 60 x the true cost of your hour (your rate plus "
        "the payroll burden).",
        "Suggested price = (total cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - "
        "channel fee rate), then rounded the way you chose above.",
        "Wholesale price = retail price less the trade discount, rounded the "
        "same way.",
        "Profit = price - fees - total cost. Margin = profit / price.",
    ]:
        r = sheet.note(r, line, last_col, height=17, boxed=False)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(4, 0)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/shipping.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/shipping.py sha256:ca46b4c2b16578653034e4747d674e6ddb09a42001b58540b6aa30cbb11c4381 -->
````python
"""The Shipping tab - postage bands and who really pays for them.

One row per posting option: a weight band, a carrier and a service, what it
costs you and what you charge the customer. The difference is `absorbed`, and
that is the figure the Products tab folds into a unit cost - postage you pay
out of the margin is a cost, not a fee.

`band_check` catches the two mistakes that lose money quietly: a band where the
top weight is below the bottom weight, and a band where the charge to the
customer is less than the postage costs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, id_col, int_col, list_col, money_col, num_col,
                     pct_col, row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, text_col,
                     wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Shipping"

SUBTITLE = ("Postage bands: what it costs to send, what the customer pays, "
            "and what you absorb.")

HELP = ("List the posting options you actually use. 'Postage absorbed' is the "
        "part you pay - Products adds it to the unit cost. Match products by "
        "typing their IDs in 'Applies to', separated by commas.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    sid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{sid}=""'
    base = f"N({row_ref('base_cost')})"
    per_oz = f"N({row_ref('per_oz')})"
    handling = f"N({row_ref('handling')})"
    top = f"N({row_ref('weight_to')})"
    bottom = f"N({row_ref('weight_from')})"
    charge = f"N({row_ref('retail_charge')})"
    absorbed = f"N({row_ref('absorbed')})"
    cost_at_max = f"{base}+{per_oz}*{top}+{handling}"

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixShipping", trigger="label", width=11.0),
        text_col("label", "Option", 30.0,
                 note="The name the rest of the workbook uses for this band."),
        list_col("carrier", "Carrier", "CarrierList", 14.0),
        list_col("service", "Service", "ServiceList", 15.0),
        list_col("zone", "Zone", "ZoneList", 13.0),
        num_col("weight_from", "Weight from (oz)", 11.0),
        num_col("weight_to", "Weight to (oz)", 11.0),
        calc_col("band_check", "Band check",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(AND({top}>0,{bottom}>{top}),'
                 f'"BAND REVERSED",IF({absorbed}>0.005,'
                 f'"YOU PAY THE POST","OK")))', 16.0, "status",
                 note="Bands run bottom weight to top weight; absorbed "
                      "postage is money out of the margin.",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "REVERSED", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "YOU PAY", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        money_col("base_cost", "Base postage", 12.0,
                  note="What the carrier charges for the band."),
        money_col("per_oz", "Cost an oz", 11.0, style="money4"),
        money_col("handling", "Handling cost", 12.0,
                  note="Your time and materials getting it out of the door."),
        calc_col("cost_at_max", "Cost at top weight",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{cost_at_max})', 13.0, "money"),
        money_col("retail_charge", "Customer pays", 12.0,
                  note="The postage you charge on the listing."),
        money_col("absorbed", "Postage absorbed", 12.0,
                  note="The part of the postage you pay. This is a cost."),
        calc_col("absorbed_pct", "Absorbed %",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({cost_at_max}=0,"",'
                 f'{absorbed}/{cost_at_max}))', 11.0, "percent"),
        yesno_col("tracking", "Tracked", 9.0),
        yesno_col("insurance", "Insured", 9.0),
        int_col("delivery_days", "Delivery days", 11.0),
        text_col("products", "Applies to", 26.0,
                 note="Product IDs separated by commas."),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary_mid))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/start_here.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/start_here.py sha256:32e73760993cfb76ff9f5a681ed88f615a842270b55b7a67252e085afec5ec58 -->
````python
"""The Start Here tab - the front door of the workbook.

What it is for, the three things to do first, how a price is actually worked
out, what the colours mean, and a guide to all forty tabs so nobody has to open
them one by one to find out. Every tab name on this page is a link.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List, Sequence, Tuple

from ..config import PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_SUBTITLE, Config, Palette
from ..layout import quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from .common import FIRST_ROW

P = Palette

NAME = "Start Here"

SUBTITLE = PRODUCT_SUBTITLE

#: tab, what it does, what you type in it
TAB_GUIDE: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = [
    ("Start Here", "This page: what the workbook does and how to start.",
     "Nothing - read it."),
    ("Settings", "Your rates, fees, margins, targets and ID prefixes. "
                 "Every other tab reads this one.",
     "Your hourly rate, fees, target margin, rounding rule."),
    ("Dashboard", "The whole shop on one screen: this month, this year, the "
                  "best sellers and everything that needs a decision.",
     "Nothing - it reads the registers."),
    ("Products", "The catalog, and what each product costs and earns.",
     "Product names, prices, the minutes they take."),
    ("Materials", "Everything you buy in, what a unit costs and what is on "
                  "the shelf.",
     "Materials, unit costs, stock, re-order points."),
    ("Material Usage", "Bills of materials: what each product is made of.",
     "Product, material, quantity, scrap."),
    ("Labor", "Every hour worked, and whether it was making or running the "
              "shop.",
     "Date, who, task, hours, rate."),
    ("Packaging", "What it costs to pack one order.",
     "Components, quantities, which products they go with."),
    ("Shipping", "Postage bands, what they cost and what you absorb.",
     "Bands, costs, what the customer pays."),
    ("Overhead", "Rent, power, insurance, subscriptions - the cost of having "
                 "a studio.",
     "Each cost and how often it is paid."),
    ("Channels", "What each place you sell charges you.",
     "The fee schedule per channel."),
    ("Retail Calculator", "Price one item from scratch and see what it earns.",
     "A product, or costs typed straight in."),
    ("Wholesale Calculator", "Work out a trade price and whether it still "
                             "pays you.",
     "A product, the quantity, the discount."),
    ("Profit & Break-Even", "How many you have to sell to cover the costs, "
                            "and what different volumes earn.",
     "A product and the volumes to test."),
    ("Crochet", "Yarn, notions and hours at the hook, costed per item.",
     "Yarn, skeins, minutes, price."),
    ("Jewelry", "Metal, stones, findings and bench time.",
     "Stones, findings, minutes, price."),
    ("Candles", "One pour costed down to a single jar.",
     "Wax, fragrance load, vessels, jars poured."),
    ("Clothing", "Fabric, notions and the time cutting, sewing, finishing.",
     "Fabric, yards, the three times, price."),
    ("Woodworking", "Lumber, hardware, finish and the four stages of time.",
     "Board feet, hardware, the four times, price."),
    ("Digital", "Downloads: the investment spread over the sales you expect.",
     "Hours to create, sales expected, price."),
    ("Bundles", "Kits and gift boxes, and whether the discount still pays.",
     "Bundle name, price, packaging, postage."),
    ("Bundle Lines", "What is inside each bundle.",
     "Bundle, product, quantity."),
    ("Variations", "Sizes, colours, scents - what each option adds.",
     "Option, value, price and cost adjustments."),
    ("Batches", "What a run of making really cost, defects included.",
     "Quantities, minutes, materials."),
    ("Sales", "Every order: price, fees, postage, cost and profit.",
     "Date, product, quantity, price paid."),
    ("Promotions", "Discounts, when they run and what they gave away.",
     "Code, discount, dates."),
    ("Price History", "Every price change and what happened next.",
     "Old price, new price, why, cost at the time."),
    ("Competitors", "What comparable listings charge.",
     "Their price and postage, which of yours it matches."),
    ("Waste Log", "What got broken or spoiled, and what it cost.",
     "Date, material, quantity, reason."),
    ("Development", "What it costs to bring something new to market.",
     "Project, hours, spend, target price."),
    ("Events", "Fairs and markets costed properly, including your hours.",
     "Fees, travel, hours, revenue."),
    ("Wholesale Customers", "The shops that buy from you.",
     "Contacts, terms, discount, credit limit."),
    ("Wholesale Orders", "Trade orders from quote to paid.",
     "Shop, retail value, status."),
    ("Scenarios", "The same product priced five ways, side by side.",
     "A product and the margins to compare."),
    ("Reports", "Twelve months of trading, by product, channel and craft.",
     "Nothing - it reads the registers."),
    ("Print Costing", "A one page cost sheet for a product, to print.",
     "The product ID at the top."),
    ("Print Quote", "A wholesale quote on your shop's letterhead.",
     "The customer and the lines."),
    ("Print Order", "A production docket for the workshop.",
     "The product, the quantity, the due date."),
    ("Lists", "Every drop down in the workbook lives here.",
     "Your own values for any list."),
    ("Help", "How the maths works, how to extend the workbook, and what to "
             "do when something looks wrong.",
     "Nothing - read it."),
]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=False)
    last_col = 8
    sheet.banner(NAME, f"{cfg.product_name} - {SUBTITLE}", last_col,
                 nav=False, badge=f"{cfg.author}  |  v{cfg.version}")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 1, 22.0)
    sheet.set_col(2, 3, 26.0)
    sheet.set_col(4, last_col, 17.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    r = 3
    r = sheet.section(r, f"Welcome to {cfg.product_name}", last_col)
    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "This workbook costs a handmade product properly - materials, your own "
        "time at a real rate, packaging, the postage you absorb, a share of "
        "the studio overhead and the fees the channel takes - and then works "
        "out the price your target margin asks for. It does the same for six "
        "crafts, for bundles, for sizes and scents, for wholesale, and for a "
        "day at a craft fair.",
        last_col, height=58)
    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        f"It opens with an example shop in it - {cfg.shop.name}, run by "
        f"{cfg.shop.owner} - so every tab has something to look at and every "
        f"number agrees with the ones next to it. To start clean, rebuild with "
        f"the --blank flag, or delete the example rows: the formulas run the "
        f"whole way down every register, so a cleared row is simply a row that "
        f"waits.",
        last_col, height=46)
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- first steps
    r = sheet.section(r, "Three things to do first", last_col)
    steps = [
        ("1", "Settings", "Put in what you pay yourself an hour, the fees "
                          "your marketplace charges, and the margin you want "
                          "to be left with. Everything else reads these."),
        ("2", "Materials", "List what you buy in and what one unit costs. "
                           "Then add each product on Products and its bill of "
                           "materials on Material Usage - or cost it on the "
                           "craft tab that matches."),
        ("3", "Retail Calculator", "Pick a product and read the price the "
                                   "model asks for next to the price you "
                                   "charge. The gap between the two is the "
                                   "whole point of the workbook."),
    ]
    for number, tab, text in steps:
        sheet.row_height(r, 34)
        sheet.write(r, 1, number, fmts.chrome("kpi_label"))
        _link(sheet, fmts, r, 2, tab)
        sheet.merge(r, 3, last_col, text, fmts.chrome("note_box"))
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------- the maths
    r = sheet.section(r, "How a price is worked out", last_col)
    for line in [
        "Total unit cost = materials + labour + packaging + the postage you "
        "absorb + a share of overhead.",
        "Labour = minutes / 60 x the true cost of your hour, which is your "
        "rate plus the payroll burden on Settings.",
        "Suggested price = (total cost + fixed fees) / (1 - target margin - "
        "channel fee rate), rounded the way Settings says.",
        "Wholesale price = retail price less the trade discount.",
        "Profit = price - fees - total cost.    Margin = profit / price.    "
        "Effective hourly = profit / hours spent.",
    ]:
        r = sheet.note(r, line, last_col, height=17, boxed=False)
    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "Why the margin is in the denominator: a 30% margin is not cost plus "
        "30%. If a piece costs 20 and the channel takes 10%, then 20 x 1.3 = "
        "26 leaves 6.60 after fees against a cost of 20 - a loss. The formula "
        "above asks for 33.99 and leaves the 30% you meant.",
        last_col, height=44)
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------- colour code
    r = sheet.section(r, "The colour code, and the password", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    sheet.write(r, 1, "Type here", fmts.chrome("legend_label"))
    sheet.write(r, 2, "", fmts.chrome("legend_input"))
    sheet.merge(r, 3, last_col, "Cream with a soft border - yours to fill in.",
                fmts.chrome("label"))
    r += 1
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    sheet.write(r, 1, "Calculated", fmts.chrome("legend_label"))
    sheet.write(r, 2, "", fmts.chrome("legend_calc"))
    sheet.merge(r, 3, last_col,
                "Warm grey - a formula. Locked, so it cannot be typed over.",
                fmts.chrome("label"))
    r += 1
    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        f"Every sheet is protected with the password '{cfg.password}'. "
        f"Protection is there to stop a formula being deleted by accident, "
        f"not to keep you out: unprotect a sheet from Review > Unprotect "
        f"Sheet whenever you want to change the layout, and the input cells "
        f"stay editable either way.",
        last_col, height=44)
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- tab guide
    r = sheet.section(r, "What is in this workbook", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 22)
    sheet.write(r, 1, "Tab", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    sheet.merge(r, 2, 4, "What it does", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    sheet.merge(r, 5, last_col, "What you type", fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    for i, (tab, does, types) in enumerate(TAB_GUIDE):
        sheet.row_height(r, 26)
        band = fmts.chrome("band") if i % 2 else None
        _link(sheet, fmts, r, 1, tab, band=band)
        sheet.merge(r, 2, 4, does, fmts.cell("wrap", "plain"))
        sheet.merge(r, 5, last_col, types, fmts.cell("wrap", "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the end
    r = sheet.section(r, "Compatibility, and who made it", last_col)
    for line in [
        "Formulas are written for Excel 2010 and later - no dynamic arrays, "
        "no XLOOKUP, no IFS, no LET - so the workbook also opens in Excel "
        "2010, LibreOffice and Google Sheets.",
        "It is a plain .xlsx with no macros, so nothing is blocked when you "
        "download or email it.",
        f"Created by {cfg.author}. Version {cfg.version}.",
    ]:
        r = sheet.note(r, line, last_col, height=30, boxed=False)

    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def _link(sheet, fmts, row: int, col: int, tab: str, band=None) -> None:
    """An internal link to another tab, in the house style."""
    fmt = band or fmts.chrome("nav")
    sheet.ws.write_url(row, col, f"internal:{quote_sheet(tab)}!A1", fmt,
                       f"> {tab}")
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/variations.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/variations.py sha256:7a64a7084f747b0e6e7da15f6ded1f30d4d889639f7f9b7ec09e1dc90605479e -->
````python
"""The Variations tab - the options under one listing.

A scent, a stone, a size, a length, a personalisation: each one is a row, with
what it adds to the price and what it adds to the cost. The base price and the
base cost come off the Products tab, so a variation is always costed against
the current catalog figures rather than a copy that has gone stale.

`extra minutes` is the time the variation adds - a size L takes longer than a
size M, a dark stain needs another coat and another day. It is costed at the
loaded rate on Settings and folded into the variation's cost, which is the part
most shops forget and then wonder why the bigger size earns less.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, countifs,
                     date_col, fetch, id_col, int_col, list_col, money_col,
                     other, product_col, rank_desc, raw_price_col, round_ref,
                     row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col,
                     yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Variations"

SUBTITLE = ("Sizes, colours, scents and stones: what each option adds to the "
            "price, the cost and the time.")

HELP = ("Pick the product, pick the option and type what it adds. The base "
        "price and cost arrive from Products; the variation price, its margin "
        "and the price your target margin asks for are calculated here.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    vid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{vid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    base_price = fetch("Products", "id", "retail_price", product, "0")
    base_cost = fetch("Products", "id", "total_cost", product, "0")
    channel_of_product = fetch("Products", "id", "channel", product)
    chan = f'IF({channel_of_product}="",DefaultChannel,{channel_of_product})'
    rate = channel_fee_rate(chan)
    fixed = channel_fixed_fee(chan)
    vprice = f"N({row_ref('variation_price')})"
    vcost = (f'N({row_ref("variation_cost")})'
             f'+N({row_ref("extra_time_cost")})')
    profit = f'{vprice}-({rate}*{vprice}+{fixed})-{vcost}'

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixVariation", trigger="value", width=11.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        list_col("option", "Option", "VariationOptionList", 15.0,
                 note="Size, colour, scent, stone, finish, length..."),
        text_col("value", "Value", 20.0,
                 note="The choice itself: L, Amethyst, Cedar & sage."),
        text_col("sku", "Variation SKU", 16.0),
        calc_col("size_factor", "Size factor",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IFERROR(INDEX(SizeFactors,'
                 f'MATCH({row_ref("value")},SizeNames,0)),1))', 11.0, "number",
                 note="From the size table on Lists, when the value is a size."),
        calc_col("base_price", "Base price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{base_price})', 12.0, "money"),
        money_col("price_adj", "Price adjustment", 13.0,
                  note="What this option adds to the price - negative for a "
                       "smaller size."),
        calc_col("variation_price", "Variation price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("base_price")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("price_adj")}))', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("base_cost", "Base cost", f'IF({has_id},"",{base_cost})',
                 12.0, "money"),
        money_col("cost_adj", "Cost adjustment", 13.0,
                  note="What this option adds to the materials."),
        calc_col("variation_cost", "Materials cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("base_cost")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("cost_adj")}))', 13.0, "money"),
        int_col("qty_delta", "Extra minutes", 12.0,
                note="Time this option adds - a bigger size, an extra coat, "
                     "personalisation."),
        calc_col("extra_time_cost", "Extra time cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("qty_delta")})/60*LaborCostHour)',
                 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("total_cost", "Total cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{vcost})', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fee_rate", "Fee rate", f'IF({has_id},"",{rate})', 11.0,
                 "percent"),
        calc_col("fees", "Fees",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{rate}*{vprice}+{fixed})', 12.0, "money"),
        calc_col("profit", "Profit",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({vprice}=0,"",{profit}))', 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("margin", "Margin",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({vprice}=0,"",{profit}/{vprice}))',
                 10.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("margin_flag", "Flag",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({vprice}=0,"",IF({profit}<=0,"LOSS",'
                 f'IF({profit}/{vprice}<MarginWarning,"THIN","OK"))))',
                 9.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LOSS", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "THIN", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        # the unrounded model price gets its own hidden cell: the rounding
        # rule repeats its argument eight times, and eight copies of this
        # cost expression pass Excel's 8,192 character formula limit
        raw_price_col(vcost, fixed, "TargetRetailMargin", rate, guard=has_id),
        calc_col("suggested_price", "Suggested price",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{round_ref(row_ref("price_raw"))})',
                 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("price_gap", "Gap to suggested",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{vprice}=0),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("suggested_price")})-{vprice})', 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"}]),
        int_col("stock", "Stock", 10.0,
                note="Blank or zero means made to order."),
        calc_col("stock_flag", "Stock",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("stock")})=0,"MADE TO ORDER",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("stock")})<=2,"LOW","IN STOCK")))', 15.0,
                 "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LOW", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "MADE TO ORDER", "fmt": "info"}]),
        yesno_col("active", "On sale?", 10.0),
        calc_col("in_bundles", "In bundles",
                 countifs([(other("Bundle Lines", "product"), product)]),
                 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("sku_check", "SKU check",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("sku")}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(COUNTIFS({{sku_first}}:{{sku_last}},{row_ref("sku")})>1,'
                 f'"DUPLICATE SKU",""))', 14.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DUPLICATE", "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        date_col("created", "Added", 13.0),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
        calc_col("rank_margin", "rank margin", rank_desc("margin"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/waste.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/waste.py sha256:7dd7c813d35af967bc41e13872f07128628004607558465979c971a3645dc901 -->
````python
"""The Waste Log - what got thrown away, and what it cost.

Every broken jar, every mis-cut length of linen, every board with a loose knot.
The Materials tab adds these rows up to give a real waste rate against the
guessed one, the Products tab can pick up the cost by product, and the Reports
tab totals it by month and by reason.

Waste is the cost nobody writes down, which is exactly why it never gets fixed.
`recoverable` and `recovered_value` are here for the seconds that still sell -
a warped board becomes a coaster, a chipped jar becomes a sample - so `net_loss`
is the money that actually went.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, date_col, fetch, id_col, list_col_inline,
                     material_col, money_col, num_col, product_col, rank_desc,
                     row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Waste Log"

SUBTITLE = ("What got broken, spoiled or mis-cut, what it cost and whether any "
            "of it was recovered.")

HELP = ("One row per loss. Pick the material and the cost per unit arrives "
        "from the Materials tab. Add a product when the loss happened while "
        "making something specific - the Products tab picks the cost up.")

STAGES = ["Making", "Finishing", "Packing", "Shipping", "Storage",
          "Supplier fault", "Sample", "Customer return"]


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    wid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{wid}=""'
    material = row_ref("material")
    product = row_ref("product")
    date = row_ref("date")
    qty = f"N({row_ref('qty')})"
    unit_cost = f"N({row_ref('unit_cost')})"

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixWaste", trigger="material", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date", 13.0),
        product_col(note="Blank when the loss was not part of one product."),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        material_col(),
        calc_col("material_name", "Material",
                 f'IF({material}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", material)})', 28.0,
                 "text"),
        calc_col("unit", "Unit",
                 f'IF({material}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "unit", material)})', 9.0,
                 "text"),
        calc_col("unit_cost", "Cost a unit",
                 f'IF({material}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", material, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4"),
        num_col("qty", "Qty lost", 11.0,
                note="In the unit the material is bought in."),
        calc_col("cost", "Cost of the loss",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{qty}*{unit_cost})', 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        list_col_inline("reason", "Reason", 
                        ["Breakage", "Spillage", "Cutting error", "Defect",
                         "Misprint", "Shedding", "Knots",
                         "Damaged in storage", "Expired", "Wrong colour",
                         "Sample", "Other"], 17.0,
                        note="Also on the Lists tab as WasteReasonList."),
        list_col_inline("stage", "Where it happened", STAGES, 15.0),
        yesno_col("recoverable", "Recovered?", 11.0,
                  note="Sold as a second, used as a sample, remade into "
                       "something smaller."),
        money_col("recovered_value", "Value recovered", 13.0),
        calc_col("net_loss", "Net loss",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("cost")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("recovered_value")}))', 12.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bad"}]),
        calc_col("month", "Month",
                 f'IF({date}="","",TEXT(N({date}),"yyyy-mm"))', 10.0, "text"),
        calc_col("rank_cost", "rank cost", rank_desc("cost"), 9.0, "int",
                 hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.accent))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/wholesale_calc.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/wholesale_calc.py sha256:76db856e9365f74563c863167a986b1b37b655f257c1fa7c122e8096793f17b3 -->
````python
"""The Wholesale Calculator - a trade order, costed before you quote it.

Trade is where a good retail price can still turn into a bad deal: the discount
is large, the parcel is heavy, the fees are different and the money arrives a
month later. Pick the shop and the product, type the quantity, and this page
shows the trade price their discount implies, what the order is worth, what you
keep after the fees and the cost of the goods, and whether the margin clears
the target for trade on Settings.

It also works backwards. `Retail price needed` answers the question that comes
up at every wholesale show: what does the retail price have to be for this
trade price to still work?
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import lookup
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from .common import (channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, other, price_from,
                     round_price)

P = Palette

NAME = "Wholesale Calculator"

SUBTITLE = ("A trade order priced properly: discount, fees, postage, terms and "
            "what is left for you.")

HELP = ("Pick the shop and the product, type the quantity. Their discount and "
        "terms arrive from the Wholesale Customers tab; the fees come from the "
        "Wholesale channel.")

WHOLESALE_CHANNEL = '"Wholesale"'

QTY_STEPS = [6, 12, 24, 48, 100]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME, tab_color=P.primary,
                        landscape=False)
    last_col = 10
    sheet.banner(NAME, SUBTITLE, last_col, badge="Wholesale pricing")
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 2.5)
    sheet.set_col(1, 2, 28.0)
    sheet.set_col(3, 4, 15.0)
    sheet.set_col(5, last_col, 14.0)
    sheet.ws.hide_gridlines(2)

    def f(row: int, label: str, *, formula: Optional[str] = None,
          value: Any = None, name: Optional[str] = None, style: str = "text",
          input_cell: bool = False, validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
          help_text: str = "") -> int:
        return sheet.field(row, label, value, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                           value_end=4, style=style,
                           mode="input" if input_cell else "calc",
                           name=name, validate=validate,
                           help_text=help_text, help_col=5, formula=formula)

    cust = lambda key: lookup("WcCustomer",
                              other("Wholesale Customers", "id"),
                              other("Wholesale Customers", key))
    prod = lambda key: lookup("WcProduct", other("Products", "id"),
                              other("Products", key))

    r = sheet.note(3, HELP, last_col, height=32)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the order
    r = sheet.section(r, "1. The order", last_col)
    r = f(r, "Shop", name="WcCustomer", input_cell=True,
          validate=list_from("CustomerIDs"),
          help_text="From the Wholesale Customers tab.")
    r = f(r, "Shop name", formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("name")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Their terms", formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("terms")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Their standing discount", style="percent",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("discount")},WholesaleDiscount)')
    r = f(r, "Their minimum order", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("min_order")},MinOrderValue)')
    r = f(r, "Their credit limit", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("credit_limit")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Product", name="WcProduct", input_cell=True,
          validate=list_from("ProductIDs"))
    r = f(r, "Product name", formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("name")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Retail price", name="WcRetail", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("retail_price")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Cost of one item", name="WcUnitCost", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("total_cost")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Minutes an item", name="WcMinutes", style="number1",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({prod("minutes_used")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Units in the order", name="WcQty", style="int",
          input_cell=True, value=cfg.minimum_order_qty,
          help_text="How many they want.")
    r = f(r, "Discount for this order", name="WcDiscount", style="percent",
          input_cell=True,
          help_text="Blank uses their standing discount.")
    r = f(r, "Discount used", name="WcDiscountUsed", style="percent",
          formula='=IF(WcDiscount="",WholesaleDiscount,N(WcDiscount))')
    r += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------- the trade price
    r = sheet.section(r, "2. The trade price", last_col)
    r = sheet.field(r, "Trade price an item", None, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                    value_end=4, style="money", name="WcTradePrice",
                    formula=f'={round_price("N(WcRetail)*(1-N(WcDiscountUsed))")}',
                    help_text="Retail less the discount, rounded the way "
                              "Settings says.")
    r = _rule(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    r = f(r, "Order value", name="WcOrderValue", style="money",
          formula="=N(WcTradePrice)*N(WcQty)")
    r = f(r, "Postage you charge", name="WcPostage", style="money",
          input_cell=True, value=0,
          help_text="A trade parcel is heavy - type what you will charge.")
    r = f(r, "Postage it costs you", name="WcPostageCost", style="money",
          input_cell=True, value=0)
    r = f(r, "Tax", name="WcTax", style="money", input_cell=True, value=0,
          help_text="Zero for a tax exempt shop with a resale certificate.")
    r = f(r, "Order total", name="WcOrderTotal", style="money",
          formula="=N(WcOrderValue)+N(WcPostage)+N(WcTax)")
    r += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------- what you keep
    r = sheet.section(r, "3. What you keep", last_col)
    rate = channel_fee_rate(WHOLESALE_CHANNEL)
    fixed = channel_fixed_fee(WHOLESALE_CHANNEL)
    r = f(r, "Wholesale fee rate", name="WcFeeRate", style="percent",
          formula=f"={rate}",
          help_text="From the Wholesale channel on the Channels tab.")
    r = f(r, "Fees on the order", name="WcFees", style="money",
          formula=f"=N(WcFeeRate)*N(WcOrderTotal)+{fixed}")
    r = f(r, "Cost of the goods", name="WcCogs", style="money",
          formula="=N(WcUnitCost)*N(WcQty)")
    r = sheet.field(r, "Profit on the order", None, label_col=1, value_col=3,
                    value_end=4, style="money", name="WcProfit",
                    formula="=N(WcOrderValue)+N(WcPostage)"
                            "-N(WcPostageCost)-N(WcFees)-N(WcCogs)",
                    help_text="After fees, postage and the cost of the goods.")
    r = _rule(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    r = f(r, "Margin", name="WcMargin", style="percent",
          formula='=IF(N(WcOrderValue)=0,"",N(WcProfit)/N(WcOrderValue))')
    r = f(r, "Margin check", style="text",
          formula='=IF(N(WcOrderValue)=0,"",IF(N(WcProfit)<=0,'
                  '"TRADE LOSES MONEY",IF(N(WcMargin)<TargetWholesaleMargin,'
                  '"BELOW THE TRADE TARGET","OK")))')
    r = f(r, "Profit an item", style="money",
          formula='=IF(N(WcQty)=0,"",N(WcProfit)/N(WcQty))')
    r = f(r, "Hours in the order", style="number",
          formula="=N(WcMinutes)*N(WcQty)/60")
    r = f(r, "Hourly earned", name="WcHourly", style="money",
          formula='=IF(N(WcMinutes)=0,"",N(WcProfit)/(N(WcMinutes)*N(WcQty)/60))')
    r = f(r, "Minimum order check", style="text",
          formula='=IF(N(WcOrderValue)=0,"",IF(N(WcOrderValue)'
                  '<MAX(N(MinOrderValue),0),"BELOW YOUR MINIMUM",'
                  'IF(N(WcQty)<MinOrderQty,"FEWER UNITS THAN YOUR MINIMUM",'
                  '"OK")))')
    r = f(r, "Credit check", style="text",
          formula='=IF(N(WcOrderTotal)=0,"",IF(N(WcOrderTotal)'
                  '+IFERROR(N(WcBalance),0)>N(IFERROR(WcCreditLimit,0))'
                  ',"WOULD GO OVER THEIR LIMIT","WITHIN THEIR LIMIT"))')
    r = f(r, "Money arrives", style="text",
          formula='=IF(WcCustomer="","",IF(EXACT(TRIM(WcTerms),"Prepaid"),'
                  '"ON ORDER","AFTER " & WcTerms))')
    r = f(r, "Their terms (name)", name="WcTerms",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("terms")},"")')
    r = f(r, "Outstanding balance", name="WcBalance", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("balance")},0)')
    r = f(r, "Credit limit (name)", name="WcCreditLimit", style="money",
          formula=f'=IFERROR({cust("credit_limit")},0)')
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- working back
    r = sheet.section(r, "4. Working backwards", last_col)
    r = sheet.field(r, "Trade price your target asks for", None, label_col=1,
                    value_col=3, value_end=4, style="money",
                    name="WcSuggestedTrade",
                    formula=f"={price_from('N(WcUnitCost)', fixed, 'TargetWholesaleMargin', 'N(WcFeeRate)')}",
                    help_text="(cost + fixed fees) / (1 - trade target margin "
                              "- fee rate).")
    r = _rule(sheet, fmts, r, 1, 4)
    retail_needed = round_price(
        "IF(N(WcDiscountUsed)>=1,0,"
        "N(WcSuggestedTrade)/(1-N(WcDiscountUsed)))")
    r = f(r, "Retail price needed", name="WcRetailNeeded", style="money",
          formula=f"={retail_needed}",
          help_text="What the retail price has to be for the trade price to "
                    "work at this discount.")
    r = f(r, "Gap to your retail price", style="money",
          formula='=IF(OR(N(WcRetailNeeded)=0,N(WcRetail)=0),"",'
                  'N(WcRetailNeeded)-N(WcRetail))',
          help_text="Positive means your retail price is too low to support "
                    "the trade discount.")
    r = f(r, "Biggest discount you can give", style="percent",
          formula='=IF(N(WcRetail)=0,"",MAX(0,1-N(WcSuggestedTrade)'
                  '/N(WcRetail)))',
          help_text="The discount that still leaves the trade target margin.")
    r += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- volume strip
    r = sheet.section(r, "5. The same product at five quantities", last_col)
    sheet.row_height(r, 20)
    for i, head in enumerate(["Units", "Order value", "Fees", "Cost of goods",
                              "Profit", "Margin"]):
        col = 1 + i * 2 if i < 3 else 1 + i * 2
        sheet.merge(r, col, col + 1, head, fmts.chrome("header_left"))
    r += 1
    for qty in QTY_STEPS:
        value = f"N(WcTradePrice)*{qty}"
        fees = f"N(WcFeeRate)*({value}+N(WcPostage)+N(WcTax))+{fixed}"
        cogs = f"N(WcUnitCost)*{qty}"
        profit = f"{value}+N(WcPostage)-N(WcPostageCost)-{fees}-{cogs}"
        sheet.row_height(r, 18)
        sheet.ws.merge_range(r, 1, r, 2, qty, fmts.cell("int", "plain"))
        for i, (formula, style) in enumerate([
                (value, "money"), (fees, "money"), (cogs, "money"),
                (profit, "money"),
                (f'IF({value}=0,"",{profit}/{value})', "percent")]):
            col = 3 + i * 2
            sheet.ws.merge_range(r, col, r, col + 1, "",
                                 fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
            sheet.formula(r, col, "=" + formula,
                                   fmts.cell(style, "plain"))
        r += 1
    r += 1
    r = sheet.note(
        r,
        "Trade prices are usually agreed for a season, so the discount on this "
        "page is the one to write on the line sheet. If the retail price "
        "needed is above the one you charge, the answer is not a smaller "
        "discount - it is a higher retail price.",
        last_col, height=44)

    sheet.ws.freeze_panes(4, 0)
    sheet.ws.print_area(0, 0, r, last_col)
    sheet.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def _rule(sheet, fmts, row: int, first_col: int, last_col: int) -> int:
    """Rule under a total, drawn on the blank row below it. Returns the next
    free row so the total above is never overwritten."""
    sheet.row_height(row, 7)
    for col in range(first_col, last_col + 1):
        sheet.ws.write_blank(row, col, None, fmts.chrome("rule"))
    return row + 1
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/wholesale_customers.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/wholesale_customers.py sha256:345826b474ede17788e9d895435c601a88866150ac3dff3090eb5efc5f63ab3c -->
````python
"""The Wholesale Customers tab - the shops that buy from you.

One row per retailer: the contact, the trade terms, the discount they get, the
minimum order and the credit limit. Everything else is counted off the Wholesale
Orders tab - how many orders, what they are worth, what is still outstanding,
how long since the last one, and whether the invoices get paid inside the terms.

Two flags matter. `credit_flag` says when the outstanding balance is close to
or over the limit, and `late_flag` says when a shop pays late often enough that
the terms should change. The example shop has one of each: a boutique sitting
at its limit, and a bookshop on hold after two late payments.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec, max_if, min_if
from ..writer import list_from
from ..layout import Col
from .common import (calc_col, countifs, date_col, id_col, list_col, money_col,
                     other, pct_col, rank_desc, row_ref, samples,
                     spec_defaults, sumifs, text_col, wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Wholesale Customers"

#: what min_if returns when nothing matched - 31 December 9999
NO_DATE = 2958465

SUBTITLE = ("Retailers who buy at trade prices: terms, limits, what they owe "
            "and how they pay.")

HELP = ("One row per shop. The order counts, the lifetime value, the "
        "outstanding balance and the payment record are all counted from the "
        "Wholesale Orders tab.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    cid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{cid}=""'
    key = other("Wholesale Orders", "customer")
    totals = other("Wholesale Orders", "order_total")
    dates = other("Wholesale Orders", "date")
    statuses = other("Wholesale Orders", "status")

    orders = countifs([(key, cid)])
    lifetime = sumifs(totals, [(key, cid)])
    paid_total = sumifs(totals, [(key, cid), (statuses, '"Paid"')])
    paid_orders = countifs([(key, cid), (statuses, '"Paid"')])
    first_raw = min_if(dates, f"{key}={cid}")
    last_raw = max_if(dates, f"{key}={cid}")

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixCustomer", trigger="name", width=11.0),
        text_col("name", "Shop", 30.0,
                 note="Who buys from you. Filling this in starts the row."),
        text_col("contact", "Contact", 20.0),
        text_col("email", "Email", 28.0),
        text_col("phone", "Phone", 16.0),
        wrap_col("address", "Address", 32.0),
        text_col("country", "Country", 14.0),
        list_col("terms", "Terms", "CustomerTermList", 12.0),
        pct_col("discount", "Trade discount", 12.0,
                note="Off your retail price: 0.5 is half price."),
        money_col("min_order", "Minimum order", 13.0),
        money_col("credit_limit", "Credit limit", 13.0),
        yesno_col("tax_exempt", "Tax exempt?", 11.0),
        list_col("status", "Status", "CustomerStatusList", 13.0),
        calc_col("orders_count", "Orders", orders, 9.0, "int"),
        calc_col("lifetime_value", "Lifetime value", lifetime, 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("avg_order", "Average order",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("orders_count")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("lifetime_value")})'
                 f'/N({row_ref("orders_count")})))', 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("balance", "Outstanding",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("lifetime_value")})'
                 f'-{paid_total})', 13.0, "money",
                 note="Everything ordered less everything marked Paid.",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("credit_used", "Limit used",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("credit_limit")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("balance")})/N({row_ref("credit_limit")})))',
                 11.0, "percent"),
        calc_col("credit_flag", "Credit check",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("credit_limit")})=0,"NO LIMIT",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("balance")})>N({row_ref("credit_limit")}),'
                 f'"OVER THE LIMIT",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("balance")})>'
                 f'N({row_ref("credit_limit")})*0.8,"NEAR THE LIMIT","OK"))))',
                 16.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OVER", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "NEAR", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("paid_on_time", "Paid share",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("orders_count")})=0,"",'
                 f'{paid_orders}/N({row_ref("orders_count")})))', 11.0,
                 "percent", note="Orders marked Paid, of all their orders."),
        calc_col("late_flag", "Payment record",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("orders_count")})<2,"",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("paid_on_time")})<0.8,"LATE PAYER",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("paid_on_time")})<1,"SOMETIMES LATE",'
                 f'"PAID UP"))))', 16.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LATE PAYER", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "SOMETIMES", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "PAID UP", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("first_raw", "first raw", first_raw, 12.0, "date",
                 hidden=True),
        calc_col("first_order", "First order",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("first_raw")})>={NO_DATE},"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("first_raw")})))', 13.0, "date"),
        calc_col("last_raw", "last raw", last_raw, 12.0, "date", hidden=True),
        calc_col("last_order", "Last order",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("last_raw")})=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("last_raw")})))', 13.0, "date"),
        calc_col("days_since_order", "Days since",
                 f'IF({row_ref("last_order")}="","",'
                 f'TodayDate-N({row_ref("last_order")}))', 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("lapsed_flag", "Relationship",
                 f'IF({row_ref("last_order")}="","",'
                 f'IF(TodayDate-N({row_ref("last_order")})>180,"LAPSED",'
                 f'IF(TodayDate-N({row_ref("last_order")})>90,"QUIET",'
                 f'"ACTIVE")))', 13.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "LAPSED", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "QUIET", "fmt": "info"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "ACTIVE", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("rank_value", "rank value", rank_desc("lifetime_value"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=2,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/wholesale_orders.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/wholesale_orders.py sha256:c3fc446b29ed79805cf837fad0fe75123e2a97643eba9bde37684547f8e7a2c7 -->
````python
"""The Wholesale Orders tab - trade orders, from quote to paid.

One row per order: the shop, the purchase order number, the retail value of
what they took, the trade discount, the postage and tax, and where the order is
in its life. `due` is worked out from the shop's terms on the Wholesale
Customers tab, so a Net 30 order knows when it falls due on its own, and
`aging_flag` says CURRENT, DUE SOON or OVERDUE against today.

Trade orders are where a pricing model gets tested hardest: the discount is
big, the postage is heavy and the money arrives a month later. `margin` here is
the margin after the discount and the fees, and `profit_an_order` is what is
left once the goods themselves are paid for.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import list_from
from .common import (calc_col, channel_fee_rate, channel_fixed_fee, date_col,
                     fetch, id_col, int_col, list_col, money_col, pct_col,
                     rank_desc, row_ref, samples, spec_defaults, text_col,
                     wrap_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Wholesale Orders"

SUBTITLE = ("Trade orders: the discount, the postage, the terms, what is owed "
            "and whether it is late.")

HELP = ("Pick the shop and type the retail value of the order. The trade "
        "discount arrives from their terms, the due date from the payment "
        "terms, and the fees from the Wholesale channel on the Channels tab.")

WHOLESALE_CHANNEL = '"Wholesale"'


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    oid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{oid}=""'
    customer = row_ref("customer")
    date = row_ref("date")
    status = row_ref("status")
    list_total = f"N({row_ref('list_total')})"
    eff = f"N({row_ref('effective_discount')})"
    wholesale = f"N({row_ref('wholesale_total')})"
    order_total = f"N({row_ref('order_total')})"

    rate = channel_fee_rate(WHOLESALE_CHANNEL)
    fixed = channel_fixed_fee(WHOLESALE_CHANNEL)
    terms = fetch("Wholesale Customers", "id", "terms", customer)
    terms_days = (f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({terms}),"Net 15"),15,'
                  f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({terms}),"Net 30"),30,'
                  f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({terms}),"Net 45"),45,'
                  f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({terms}),"Net 60"),60,'
                  f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({terms}),"Prepaid"),0,30)))))')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixOrder", trigger="customer", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Order date", 13.0),
        Col(key="customer", header="Customer ID", width=13.0, style="id",
            validate=list_from("CustomerIDs"),
            note="The shop, from the Wholesale Customers tab. Filling this in "
                 "starts the row."),
        calc_col("customer_name", "Shop",
                 f'IF({customer}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Wholesale Customers", "id", "name", customer)})',
                 28.0, "text"),
        text_col("po_number", "Their PO", 15.0),
        text_col("products", "What they took", 30.0,
                 note="Free text: P-0001 x24, P-0004 x12."),
        int_col("qty", "Units", 9.0),
        calc_col("terms", "Terms", f'IF({has_id},"",{terms})', 11.0, "text"),
        calc_col("customer_discount", "Their discount",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",'
                 f'{fetch("Wholesale Customers", "id", "discount", customer, "0")})',
                 12.0, "percent"),
        pct_col("discount_rate", "Discount (typed)", 13.0,
                note="Type one for this order and it beats their standing "
                     "discount."),
        calc_col("effective_discount", "Discount used",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({row_ref("discount_rate")}="",'
                 f'N({row_ref("customer_discount")}),{eff_raw()}))', 12.0,
                 "percent"),
        money_col("list_total", "Retail value", 13.0,
                  note="What the order would come to at your retail prices."),
        calc_col("wholesale_total", "Trade value",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{list_total}*(1-{eff}))', 13.0, "money"),
        money_col("shipping", "Postage charged", 13.0),
        money_col("shipping_cost", "Postage it cost you", 14.0),
        money_col("tax", "Tax", 11.0),
        calc_col("tax_check", "Tax check",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(AND(N({row_ref("tax")})>0,'
                 f'EXACT(TRIM({fetch("Wholesale Customers", "id", "tax_exempt", customer)}),'
                 f'"Yes")),"TAX CHARGED TO AN EXEMPT SHOP",""))', 24.0,
                 "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "EXEMPT", "fmt": "warn"}]),
        calc_col("order_total", "Order total",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{wholesale}+N({row_ref("shipping")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("tax")}))', 13.0, "money"),
        money_col("unit_cost", "Cost a unit", 12.0,
                  note="What one unit cost you - from the Products tab."),
        calc_col("cogs", "Cost of the goods",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("qty")})*N({row_ref("unit_cost")}))',
                 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("fees", "Fees",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{rate}*{order_total}+{fixed})', 12.0,
                 "money", note="From the Wholesale channel on Channels."),
        calc_col("profit", "Profit",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",{wholesale}+N({row_ref("shipping")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("shipping_cost")})-N({row_ref("cogs")})'
                 f'-N({row_ref("fees")}))', 13.0, "money",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("margin", "Margin",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({order_total}=0,"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("profit")})/{order_total}))', 10.0, "percent",
                 cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                      "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
        calc_col("min_order_check", "Minimum order",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF({wholesale}<'
                 f'N({fetch("Wholesale Customers", "id", "min_order", customer, "0")}),'
                 f'"BELOW THEIR MINIMUM","OK"))', 18.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "BELOW", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OK", "fmt": "good"}]),
        list_col("status", "Status", "OrderStatusList", 13.0),
        calc_col("due", "Due",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{date}=""),"",'
                 f'N({date})+{terms_days})', 13.0, "date",
                 note="Order date plus the payment terms."),
        date_col("paid", "Paid on", 13.0),
        calc_col("days_to_pay", "Days to pay",
                 f'IF(OR({has_id},{row_ref("paid")}="",{date}=""),"",'
                 f'IF(NOT(EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Paid")),"",'
                 f'N({row_ref("paid")})-N({date})))', 11.0, "int"),
        calc_col("aging_flag", "Aging",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Paid"),"PAID",'
                 f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Cancelled"),"CANCELLED",'
                 f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Quote"),"QUOTE ONLY",'
                 f'IF({row_ref("due")}="","NO DUE DATE",'
                 f'IF(TodayDate>N({row_ref("due")}),"OVERDUE",'
                 f'IF(N({row_ref("due")})-TodayDate<=7,"DUE SOON",'
                 f'"CURRENT")))))))', 14.0, "status",
                 cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "OVERDUE", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "DUE SOON", "fmt": "warn"},
                     {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                      "value": "PAID", "fmt": "good"}]),
        calc_col("balance_outstanding", "Still owed",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Paid"),0,'
                 f'IF(EXACT(TRIM({status}),"Cancelled"),0,{order_total})))',
                 13.0, "money"),
        calc_col("rank_total", "rank total", rank_desc("order_total"), 9.0,
                 "int", hidden=True),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 32.0),
    ]

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))


def eff_raw() -> str:
    """The typed discount, when there is one."""
    return f"N({row_ref('discount_rate')})"
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/woodworking.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/sheets/woodworking.py sha256:9b28edf8fc82e3e5d2f0ab55960e515662e069f284c05e91d96f1e65b817b9a3 -->
````python
"""The Woodworking calculator.

One row per piece: the lumber and how many board feet it took, hardware, the
finish and how much of it, glue, and the time in four parts - cutting, shaping,
sanding and finishing. Sanding and finishing are where a small piece quietly
becomes an expensive one, so they get their own columns rather than being
folded into "making".

Waste is already inside the lumber cost: the Materials tab carries a waste
percentage for the board (12% in the example shop, for knots and planing) and
`cost_with_waste` is what this tab picks up.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, List

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import SheetSpec
from .common import (calc_col, craft_tail, date_col, fetch, id_col, list_col,
                     material_col, money_col, num_col, product_col, row_ref,
                     samples, spec_defaults, text_col, wrap_col, yesno_col)

P = Palette

NAME = "Woodworking"

SUBTITLE = ("Woodwork: lumber, hardware, finish and the time in cutting, "
            "shaping, sanding and finishing.")

HELP = ("Pick the lumber and the finish from the materials list, type the "
        "board feet and the four times. The cost of one piece and the price "
        "your margin asks for are calculated to the right.")


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    data = samples(cfg, NAME)

    wid = row_ref("id")
    has_id = f'{wid}=""'
    product = row_ref("product")
    lumber = row_ref("lumber")
    finish = row_ref("finish")

    material_expr = (f'N({row_ref("lumber_cost")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("hardware")})'
                     f'+N({row_ref("finish_cost")})+N({row_ref("glue")})')

    cols: List[Any] = [
        id_col("PrefixWood", trigger="project", width=11.0),
        date_col("date", "Date made", 13.0),
        product_col(),
        calc_col("product_name", "Product",
                 f'IF({product}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Products", "id", "name", product)})', 26.0, "text"),
        text_col("project", "Project", 28.0,
                 note="What you made. Filling this in starts the row."),
        list_col("species", "Species", "WoodSpeciesList", 16.0),
        material_col("lumber", "Lumber ID", 12.0,
                     note="The board as it is listed on Materials, priced a "
                          "board foot."),
        calc_col("lumber_name", "Lumber",
                 f'IF({lumber}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", lumber)})', 28.0, "text"),
        calc_col("lumber_unit_cost", "Cost a board foot",
                 f'IF({lumber}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", lumber, "0")})',
                 13.0, "money4",
                 note="Waste for knots and planing is already in this figure."),
        num_col("board_feet", "Board feet", 11.0),
        calc_col("lumber_cost", "Lumber cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("board_feet")})'
                 f'*N({row_ref("lumber_unit_cost")}))', 12.0, "money"),
        money_col("hardware", "Hardware", 12.0,
                  note="Hinges, magnets, handles, fixings."),
        material_col("finish", "Finish ID", 12.0),
        calc_col("finish_name", "Finish",
                 f'IF({finish}="","",'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "name", finish)})', 26.0, "text"),
        calc_col("finish_unit_cost", "Finish cost a unit",
                 f'IF({finish}="",0,'
                 f'{fetch("Materials", "id", "cost_with_waste", finish, "0")})',
                 12.0, "money4"),
        num_col("finish_oz", "Finish used", 11.0,
                note="In the unit the finish is bought in - fl oz, ml."),
        calc_col("finish_cost", "Finish cost",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("finish_oz")})'
                 f'*N({row_ref("finish_unit_cost")}))', 12.0, "money"),
        money_col("glue", "Glue & consumables", 13.0,
                  note="Glue, sandpaper, rags, blades - what this piece wore out."),
        num_col("cut_minutes", "Cutting min", 11.0),
        num_col("shape_minutes", "Shaping min", 11.0,
                note="Routing, planing, joinery."),
        num_col("sand_minutes", "Sanding min", 11.0),
        num_col("finish_minutes", "Finishing min", 11.0,
                note="Oiling, waxing, polishing and the waiting in between."),
        num_col("total_minutes", "Minutes (typed)", 12.0,
                note="Type a total and it beats the four parts."),
        calc_col("minutes", "Minutes used",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",IF(N({row_ref("total_minutes")})>0,'
                 f'N({row_ref("total_minutes")}),'
                 f'N({row_ref("cut_minutes")})+N({row_ref("shape_minutes")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("sand_minutes")})'
                 f'+N({row_ref("finish_minutes")})))', 11.0, "number1"),
        calc_col("hours", "Hours",
                 f'IF({has_id},"",N({row_ref("minutes")})/60)', 9.0, "number"),
        list_col("difficulty", "Difficulty", "DifficultyList", 12.0),
        list_col("size", "Size", "SizeList", 11.0),
        yesno_col("food_safe", "Food safe", 10.0,
                  note="Food safe finish, for boards and bowls."),
        money_col("price", "Price today", 12.0),
        wrap_col("notes", "Notes", 30.0),
    ]
    cols += craft_tail(material_expr)

    return SheetSpec(columns=cols, samples=data, freeze_cols=3,
                     **spec_defaults(NAME, NAME, SUBTITLE, cfg, HELP,
                                     tab_color=P.primary))
````

### `24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/writer.py`

<!-- source-file: 24-handmade-pricing/handmade_pricing_spreadsheet/writer.py sha256:ccdc3b3d70096690194d22ee19753444c6340f3dc03e8d9ad1b5c15b20c213ef -->
````python
"""
Sheet writing helpers shared by every tab of the workbook.

:class:`SheetWriter` wraps an XlsxWriter worksheet and adds the house style:
title band, navigation strip, section headers, KPI tiles, label/value settings
rows and - most importantly - :meth:`SheetWriter.grid`, which turns a
:class:`~handmade_pricing_spreadsheet.layout.SheetSpec` into a finished register
with headers, drop downs, conditional formats, sample rows, frozen panes and
locked formula cells.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from .config import Config, Palette
from .formats import CALC, FormatBook, INPUT, PLAIN
from .layout import (NAV_ROW, SUBTITLE_ROW, TITLE_ROW, Registry,
                     SheetSpec, col_letter, quote_sheet)

P = Palette

#: Sheets linked from the navigation strip at the top of every tab.
NAV_LINKS: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("Start Here", "Start Here"),
    ("Dashboard", "Dashboard"),
    ("Products", "Products"),
    ("Materials", "Materials"),
    ("Labour", "Labor"),
    ("Retail Price", "Retail Calculator"),
    ("Wholesale", "Wholesale Calculator"),
    ("Sales", "Sales"),
    ("Help", "Help"),
]

#: Worksheet protection: formulas are locked, everything else stays usable.
PROTECT_OPTIONS: Dict[str, bool] = {
    "objects": False,
    "scenarios": False,
    "format_cells": True,
    "format_columns": True,
    "format_rows": True,
    "insert_columns": False,
    "insert_rows": True,
    "insert_hyperlinks": True,
    "delete_columns": False,
    "delete_rows": True,
    "select_locked_cells": True,
    "sort": False,          # stops rows being re-sorted out of sync with IDs
    "autofilter": True,     # filtering stays available
    "pivot_tables": False,
    "select_unlocked_cells": True,
}


class SheetWriter:
    """Convenience wrapper around a worksheet."""

    def __init__(self, book, fmts: FormatBook, cfg: Config, reg: Registry,
                 name: str, tab_color: Optional[str] = None,
                 landscape: bool = True) -> None:
        self.book = book
        self.f = fmts
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.reg = reg
        self.name = name
        self.ws = book.add_worksheet(name)
        self._protected = False
        if tab_color:
            self.ws.set_tab_color(tab_color)
        if landscape:
            self.ws.set_landscape()
        self.ws.set_paper(9)  # A4
        self.ws.set_margins(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 0.5)
        self.ws.set_header(
            f"&L&\"Calibri,Bold\"&12{''}"
            f"&C&\"Calibri,Bold\"&11{name}"
            f"&R&\"Calibri,Italic\"&9{cfg.product_name}")
        self.ws.set_footer(
            f"&L&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8{cfg.author} - v{cfg.version}"
            "&C&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8Page &P of &N"
            "&R&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8&D")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- plumbing
    def formula(self, row: int, col: int, formula: str, fmt=None):
        """Write a formula, rendering ``[[Sheet.key]]`` tokens first.

        Every formula in the workbook goes through here (or through
        :meth:`write` / :meth:`merge`, which call it). A token that reaches
        the file unrendered is not a formula Excel can resolve - there are no
        tables in this workbook, so ``[[Sales.gross]]`` would sit in the cell
        as a broken reference.
        """
        text = (formula or "").strip()
        if not text.startswith("="):
            text = "=" + text
        self.ws.write_formula(row, col, self.reg.render(text), fmt)

    def write(self, row: int, col: int, value: Any, fmt=None):
        """Type aware write (0 based row/col, like XlsxWriter)."""
        if value is None:
            if fmt is not None:
                self.ws.write_blank(row, col, None, fmt)
            return
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
            self.formula(row, col, value, fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, (_dt.datetime, _dt.date, _dt.time)):
            self.ws.write_datetime(row, col, value, fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            self.ws.write_string(row, col, "Yes" if value else "No", fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            self.ws.write_number(row, col, value, fmt)
        else:
            self.ws.write_string(row, col, str(value), fmt)

    def merge(self, row: int, first_col: int, last_col: int, value: Any,
              fmt=None, row2: Optional[int] = None):
        row2 = row if row2 is None else row2
        if first_col == last_col and row == row2:
            self.write(row, first_col, value, fmt)
            return
        text = "" if value is None else value
        if isinstance(text, (_dt.datetime, _dt.date, _dt.time)):
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_datetime(row, first_col, text, fmt)
        elif isinstance(text, str) and text.startswith("="):
            # merge first, then put the rendered formula in the anchor cell
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, "", fmt)
            self.formula(row, first_col, text, fmt)
        else:
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, text, fmt)

    def set_col(self, first: int, last: int, width: float, fmt=None,
                hidden: bool = False):
        options = {"hidden": 1} if hidden else {}
        self.ws.set_column(first, last, width, fmt, options)

    def row_height(self, row: int, height: float):
        self.ws.set_row(row, height)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- page chrome
    def banner(self, title: str, subtitle: str = "", last_col: int = 9,
               nav: bool = True, badge: str = "",
               tail_text: str = "") -> None:
        """Title row + strapline + navigation strip (Excel rows 1-3).

        `tail_text` is written in the empty space to the right of the
        navigation links - used for the register help line on sheets whose
        header row leaves no spare row for it.
        """
        r = TITLE_ROW - 1
        self.row_height(r, 34)
        split = max(last_col - 3, 1)
        self.merge(r, 0, split, title, self.f.chrome("title"))
        self.merge(r, split + 1, last_col,
                   badge or f"{self.cfg.author}  |  v{self.cfg.version}",
                   self.f.chrome("title_right"))

        r = SUBTITLE_ROW - 1
        self.row_height(r, 18)
        self.merge(r, 0, last_col, subtitle, self.f.chrome("subtitle"))

        if nav:
            self.nav_strip(NAV_ROW - 1, last_col, tail_text=tail_text)

    def nav_strip(self, row: int, last_col: int,
                  links: Optional[Sequence[Tuple[str, str]]] = None,
                  tail_text: str = "") -> int:
        """Row of internal links. Returns the first column left over."""
        links = list(links or NAV_LINKS)
        self.row_height(row, 16)
        col = 0
        fmt = self.f.chrome("nav")
        for label, sheet in links:
            if col + 1 > last_col:
                break
            self.ws.merge_range(row, col, row, min(col + 1, last_col), "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_url(row, col, f"internal:{quote_sheet(sheet)}!A1",
                              fmt, f"> {label}")
            col += 2
        if col <= last_col:
            room = last_col - col
            if tail_text and room >= 4:
                self.merge(row, col, last_col, tail_text,
                           self.f.chrome("note", bg_color=P.note_bg))
            else:
                self.merge(row, col, last_col, "",
                           self.f.chrome("nav_plain"))
        return col

    def section(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int, first_col: int = 0):
        self.row_height(row, 20)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text, self.f.chrome("section"))
        return row + 1

    def subsection(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int,
                   first_col: int = 0):
        self.row_height(row, 17)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text,
                   self.f.chrome("subsection"))
        return row + 1

    def note(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int, first_col: int = 0,
             height: float = 28, boxed: bool = True):
        self.row_height(row, height)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text,
                   self.f.chrome("note_box" if boxed else "note"))
        return row + 1

    def bullets(self, row: int, lines: Sequence[str], last_col: int,
                first_col: int = 0, height: float = 15):
        for line in lines:
            self.row_height(row, height)
            self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, line, self.f.chrome("label"))
            row += 1
        return row

    # -------------------------------------------------------- settings rows
    def field(self, row: int, label: str, value: Any = None, *,
              label_col: int = 1, value_col: int = 3,
              value_end: Optional[int] = None, style: str = "text",
              mode: Optional[str] = None, name: Optional[str] = None,
              validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
              help_text: str = "", help_col: Optional[int] = None,
              formula: Optional[str] = None):
        """A `Label | value | help` settings row, optionally named.

        `mode` defaults to CALC when a formula is supplied and to INPUT
````
