````python
        otherwise: a cell holding a formula must stay locked, or the first
        person to click it and start typing destroys the calculation.
        """
        if mode is None:
            mode = CALC if formula is not None else INPUT
        self.merge(row, label_col, value_col - 1, label,
                   self.f.chrome("label_bold"))
        fmt = self.f.cell(style, mode)
        end = value_end if value_end is not None else value_col
        if formula is not None:
            rendered = self.reg.render(formula)
            if end > value_col:
                self.ws.merge_range(row, value_col, row, end, "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_formula(row, value_col, rendered, fmt)
        else:
            if end > value_col:
                self.merge(row, value_col, end, None, fmt)
                self.write(row, value_col, value, fmt)
            else:
                self.write(row, value_col, value, fmt)
        if validate:
            self.ws.data_validation(row, value_col, row, value_col, validate)
        if help_text:
            hc = help_col if help_col is not None else end + 1
            self.merge(row, hc, hc + 3, help_text, self.f.chrome("note"))
        if name:
            self.book.define_name(
                name, f"={quote_sheet(self.name)}!"
                      f"${col_letter(value_col)}${row + 1}")
        return row + 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ KPI tiles
    def kpi(self, row: int, col: int, label: str, formula: str,
            style: str = "int", span: int = 2, note: str = ""):
        """Three row KPI tile: caption, big number, small note."""
        self.merge(row, col, col + span - 1, label, self.f.chrome("kpi_label"))
        self.row_height(row + 1, 26)
        fmt = self.f.chrome("kpi_value",
                            num_format=self._num_format(style))
        self.ws.merge_range(row + 1, col, row + 1, col + span - 1, "", fmt)
        self.ws.write_formula(row + 1, col, self.reg.render(formula), fmt)
        self.merge(row + 2, col, col + span - 1, note,
                   self.f.chrome("kpi_note"))
        return row + 3

    def num_format(self, style: str) -> str:
        """Number format string for a style key (public helper)."""
        return self._num_format(style)

    def _num_format(self, style: str) -> str:
        return {
            "money": self.cfg.money_format,
            "money0": self.cfg.money_format_0,
            "money4": self.cfg.money_format_4,
            "int": "#,##0",
            "number": "#,##0.00",
            "number1": "#,##0.0",
            "percent": "0.0%",
            "percent0": "0%",
            "date": self.cfg.date_format,
            "text": "General",
        }.get(style, "General")

    # ------------------------------------------------------- generic tables
    def table_head(self, row: int, col: int, headers: Sequence[str],
                   widths: Optional[Sequence[float]] = None,
                   align_left_first: bool = True):
        for i, head in enumerate(headers):
            fmt = self.f.chrome(
                "header_left" if (i == 0 and align_left_first) else "header")
            self.write(row, col + i, head, fmt)
            if widths:
                self.set_col(col + i, col + i, widths[i])
        self.row_height(row, 26)
        return row + 1

    def calc_row(self, row: int, col: int, values: Sequence[Any],
                 styles: Sequence[str], mode: str = CALC,
                 first_style: str = "text"):
        for i, value in enumerate(values):
            style = styles[i] if i < len(styles) else "text"
            fmt = self.f.cell(style, PLAIN if i == 0 and mode == PLAIN
                              else mode)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
                self.ws.write_formula(row, col + i, self.reg.render(value),
                                      fmt)
            else:
                self.write(row, col + i, value, fmt)
        return row + 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- the grid --
    def grid(self, spec: SheetSpec, extra_help: str = "") -> None:
        """Render a whole register sheet from its specification."""
        ws = self.ws
        last_col = spec.last_col_index
        header_row0 = spec.header_row - 1
        first = spec.first_data_row
        last = spec.last_data_row

        help_text = extra_help or spec.help_text
        spare_row = spec.header_row - 1 > NAV_ROW   # room above the headers?
        self.banner(spec.title, spec.subtitle, last_col,
                    tail_text="" if spare_row else help_text)

        if help_text and spare_row:
            self.note(header_row0 - 1, help_text, last_col, height=26)

        # Column widths, default formats (so blank cells keep the right lock
        # state) and the header row itself.
        for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            mode = CALC if col.is_formula else INPUT
            self.set_col(idx, idx, col.width, self.f.cell(col.style, mode),
                         hidden=col.hidden)
            self.write(header_row0, idx, col.header,
                       self.f.chrome("header_left" if idx <= 1 else "header"))
        self.row_height(header_row0, 30)

        # Data rows: formulas everywhere, sample values in the input columns.
        samples = spec.samples if self.cfg.include_sample_data else []
        for offset in range(spec.rows):
            excel_row = first + offset
            row0 = excel_row - 1
            sample = samples[offset] if offset < len(samples) else {}
            for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
                if col.is_formula:
                    fmt = self.f.cell(col.style, CALC)
                    ws.write_formula(
                        row0, idx,
                        self.reg.render(col.formula, excel_row, spec), fmt)
                elif col.key in sample and sample[col.key] is not None:
                    self.write(row0, idx, sample[col.key],
                               self.f.cell(col.style, INPUT))

        # Drop downs, help bubbles and conditional formats.
        for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            if col.validate:
                options = dict(col.validate)
                if "source" in options and isinstance(options["source"], str):
                    options["source"] = self.reg.render(options["source"])
                if col.note:
                    options.setdefault("input_title", col.header[:32])
                    options.setdefault("input_message", col.note[:255])
                ws.data_validation(first - 1, idx, last - 1, idx, options)
            if col.note:
                # Header comment: works in every Excel version and survives
                # the trip through Google Sheets.
                ws.write_comment(header_row0, idx, col.note, {
                    "author": self.cfg.author,
                    "width": 220,
                    "height": 100,
                    "x_scale": 1.1,
                })
            for rule in col.cf:
                options = dict(rule)
                fmt_key = options.pop("fmt", None)
                if fmt_key:
                    options["format"] = self.f.cf(fmt_key)
                for field_name in ("criteria", "value", "minimum", "maximum"):
                    val = options.get(field_name)
                    if isinstance(val, str) and ("[[" in val or "{" in val):
                        options[field_name] = self.reg.render(
                            val, first, spec)
                ws.conditional_format(first - 1, idx, last - 1, idx, options)

        ws.autofilter(header_row0, 0, last - 1, last_col)
        freeze_row = (spec.freeze_at if spec.freeze_at is not None
                      else spec.header_row)
        ws.freeze_panes(freeze_row, spec.freeze_cols)
        ws.print_area(0, 0, last - 1, last_col)
        ws.repeat_rows(0, header_row0 if spec.header_row <= 6 else 2)
        ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- finishing
    def finish(self, freeze_row: Optional[int] = None,
               freeze_col: int = 0, print_area: Optional[str] = None,
               fit_width: bool = True, gridlines: bool = True):
        if freeze_row is not None:
            self.ws.freeze_panes(freeze_row, freeze_col)
        if print_area:
            self.ws.print_area(print_area)
        if fit_width:
            self.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
        if not gridlines:
            self.ws.hide_gridlines(2)
        self.protect()

    def protect(self):
        if self.cfg.protect_sheets and not self._protected:
            self.ws.protect(self.cfg.password, dict(PROTECT_OPTIONS))
            self._protected = True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Small shared helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def yes_no(validate_note: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    opts: Dict[str, Any] = {"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]}
    if validate_note:
        opts["input_message"] = validate_note
    return opts


def list_from(name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Drop down fed by a defined name (see lists.py)."""
    return {"validate": "list", "source": f"={name}"}


def date_check() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "validate": "date",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": _dt.date(2000, 1, 1),
        "maximum": _dt.date(2100, 12, 31),
        "error_title": "Check the date",
        "error_message": "Enter a real date between 2000 and 2100.",
    }


def time_check() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Any time of day. Typing 9:00 AM or 14:30 both work."""
    return {
        "validate": "time",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": _dt.time(0, 0),
        "maximum": _dt.time(23, 59),
        "error_title": "Check the time",
        "error_message": "Enter a time of day, for example 9:00 AM "
                         "or 14:30.",
    }


def number_check(minimum: float = 0, maximum: float = 1000000,
                 decimal: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "validate": "decimal" if decimal else "integer",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": minimum,
        "maximum": maximum,
        "error_title": "Check the value",
        "error_message": f"Enter a number between {minimum} and {maximum}.",
    }


def cf_text(text: str, fmt: str, criteria: str = "containing") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "text", "criteria": criteria, "value": text, "fmt": fmt}


def cf_formula(formula: str, fmt: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "formula", "criteria": formula, "fmt": fmt}


def cf_bar(color: str = "#2E7D8F") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "data_bar", "bar_color": color}
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/build.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/build.py sha256:6284e9ba8a91fbe37bf9e5f33e29f6c773dbbdc6b47bf4f8893ee79b71dad5ed -->
````python
"""Workbook builder: puts every tab together in the right order.

Typical use::

    from fitness_tracker_spreadsheet import build_workbook
    build_workbook("Fitness & Weight Loss Tracker.xlsx")
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt
import inspect
import os
from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional

from xlsxwriter.workbook import Workbook

from .config import SHEET_TABS, Config
from .formats import FormatBook
from .layout import Registry, SheetSpec
from .names import define_cross_sheet_names
from .sheets import (cardio, dashboard, exercise_library, habits, meals,
                     measurements, planner, profile, records, reports,
                     review, settings_lists, start_here, water_sleep,
                     weight, workout_log)
from .writer import SheetWriter

#: register modules, in the order their specs are registered
REGISTER_MODULES = [
    workout_log, exercise_library, cardio, weight, measurements,
    meals, water_sleep, records,
]

#: tab order of the finished workbook
SHEET_ORDER: List[str] = list(SHEET_TABS)

#: sheets that are not registers - name -> builder(book, fmts, cfg, reg)
PAGE_BUILDERS: Dict[str, Callable] = {
    "1 Start Here": start_here.build,
    "2 Profile & Goals": profile.build,
    "3 Dashboard": dashboard.build,
    "4 Workout Planner": planner.build,
    "10 Habit Tracker": habits.build,
    "14 Weekly & Monthly Review": review.build,
    "15 Reports & Charts": reports.build,
    "16 Settings & Lists": settings_lists.build,
}

#: register modules by sheet name
REGISTER_BY_NAME = {module.NAME: module for module in REGISTER_MODULES}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_register(book, fmts: FormatBook, cfg: Config, reg: Registry,
                   module) -> SheetWriter:
    """Create one register sheet from its :class:`SheetSpec`."""
    spec: SheetSpec = reg[module.NAME]
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, spec.name,
                        tab_color=spec.tab_color)
    sheet.grid(spec)
    decorate = getattr(module, "decorate", None)
    if decorate is not None:
        wants_registry = len(inspect.signature(decorate).parameters) >= 4
        if wants_registry:
            decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg)
        else:
            decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def build_workbook(path: str = "Fitness Tracker.xlsx",
                   cfg: Optional[Config] = None) -> str:
    """Write the whole product to *path* and return the path."""
    cfg = cfg or Config()
    folder = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if folder and not os.path.isdir(folder):
        os.makedirs(folder)

    book = Workbook(path)
    _set_properties(book, cfg)

    fmts = FormatBook(book, cfg)
    reg = Registry()

    # 1. Register every spec first so cross sheet formulas resolve no
    #    matter which tab happens to be written first.
    for module in REGISTER_MODULES:
        reg.add(module.spec(cfg))

    # 2. Write the tabs in their final order.
    sheets: Dict[str, SheetWriter] = {}
    for name in SHEET_ORDER:
        if name in REGISTER_BY_NAME:
            sheets[name] = build_register(book, fmts, cfg, reg,
                                          REGISTER_BY_NAME[name])
        elif name in PAGE_BUILDERS:
            sheets[name] = PAGE_BUILDERS[name](book, fmts, cfg, reg)
        else:                                   # pragma: no cover
            raise KeyError(f"No builder for sheet '{name}'")

    # 3. Live lookup names (exercise names, food names, log dates).
    define_cross_sheet_names(book, reg)

    # 4. Final touches: open on the first page.
    first = sheets[SHEET_ORDER[0]].ws
    first.activate()
    first.set_first_sheet()

    book.close()
    return path


def _set_properties(book, cfg: Config) -> None:
    book.set_properties({
        "title": cfg.product_name,
        "subject": "Workout planner and log, weight and body measurement "
                   "tracker, habit and macro tracker",
        "author": cfg.author,
        "manager": cfg.author,
        "company": cfg.author,
        "category": "Personal fitness spreadsheet template",
        "keywords": ("fitness tracker spreadsheet, weight loss tracker, "
                     "workout log, workout planner, body measurement "
                     "tracker, habit tracker, macro tracker, Excel "
                     "Google Sheets template"),
        "comments": (f"{cfg.product_name}. Created by {cfg.author}. "
                     f"Version {cfg.version}. Formula cells are locked "
                     f"and every sheet is protected with the password "
                     f"'{cfg.password}'. For personal tracking only - "
                     f"not medical advice."),
        "status": "Final",
        "created": _dt.datetime(cfg.today.year, cfg.today.month,
                                cfg.today.day),
    })
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/cli.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/cli.py sha256:beddc1435ea54e0481c8d7b92ee23f3b281f73719b406b003e91e40b6c2be3f7 -->
````python
"""Command line front end.

    python -m fitness_tracker_spreadsheet
    python -m fitness_tracker_spreadsheet -o "output/Tracker.xlsx" --blank
    python -m fitness_tracker_spreadsheet --units Imperial --rows 200
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as _dt
import os
import sys
from typing import List, Optional

from .build import SHEET_ORDER, build_workbook
from .config import AUTHOR, PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE, PRODUCT_NAME, Config

DEFAULT_OUTPUT = os.path.join(
    "output", "Fitness & Weight Loss Tracker.xlsx")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="fitness_tracker_spreadsheet",
        description=f"Build the {PRODUCT_NAME} workbook.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT,
                        help="where to write the .xlsx file")
    parser.add_argument("--blank", action="store_true", default=True,
                        help="leave the registers empty (no example "
                             "training data)")
    parser.add_argument("--no-protect", action="store_true",
                        help="do not protect the sheets (for development)")
    parser.add_argument("--password", default=None,
                        help="sheet protection password")
    parser.add_argument("--author", default=AUTHOR,
                        help="document author / creator")
    parser.add_argument("--units", choices=["Metric", "Imperial"],
                        default=None,
                        help="the measurement system the workbook opens in")
    parser.add_argument("--rows", type=int, default=None,
                        help="scale every register (the default row "
                             "counts are multiplied to fit this many "
                             "workout log rows)")
    parser.add_argument("--today", default=None,
                        help="treat this ISO date as 'today' when "
                             "generating the example data")
    parser.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true",
                        help="only print the output path")
    return parser


def config_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> Config:
    kwargs = {}
    if args.blank:
        kwargs["include_sample_data"] = False
    if args.no_protect:
        kwargs["protect_sheets"] = False
    if args.password:
        kwargs["password"] = args.password
    if args.author:
        kwargs["author"] = args.author
    if args.units:
        kwargs["measure_system"] = args.units
    if args.today:
        kwargs["today"] = _dt.date.fromisoformat(args.today)
    cfg = Config(**kwargs)
    if args.rows:
        cfg.scale_rows(args.rows)
    return cfg


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        cfg = config_from_args(args)
    except ValueError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    path = build_workbook(args.output, cfg)
    size = os.path.getsize(path) / 1024.0

    if args.quiet:
        print(path)
        return 0

    print(f"{cfg.product_name}")
    print(f"  listing title : {PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE}")
    print(f"  author        : {cfg.author}")
    print(f"  sheets        : {len(SHEET_ORDER)}")
    print(f"  units         : {cfg.measure_system}")
    print(f"  example data  : "
          f"{'no' if not cfg.include_sample_data else 'yes'}")
    print(f"  protection    : "
          f"{'off' if not cfg.protect_sheets else 'on, password ' + cfg.password}")
    print(f"  written to    : {os.path.abspath(path)}  ({size:,.0f} KB)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":        # pragma: no cover
    raise SystemExit(main())
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/config.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/config.py sha256:b6f95e0e4c14830ccb996958df8cd79a7bf77630d84f6d96cdac9dc6e78434de -->
````python
"""
Configuration for the Fitness & Weight Loss Tracker.

Everything a buyer may want to re-brand lives here, so the workbook can
be regenerated for a different shop, unit system or capacity without
touching any of the sheet code.

Author of the generated workbooks: Novality Store.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import date


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Product / branding constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

AUTHOR = "Novality Store"
PRODUCT_NAME = "Fitness & Weight Loss Tracker"
PRODUCT_SUBTITLE = (
    "Workout Planner and Log, Weight and Body Measurement Tracker, "
    "Habit and Macro Tracker for Excel and Google Sheets"
)
PRODUCT_VERSION = "1.0.0"

#: Title suggested for the shop listing.
PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE = (
    "Fitness & Weight Loss Tracker Spreadsheet, Workout Planner and Log, "
    "Weight and Body Measurement Tracker, Habit and Macro Tracker for "
    "Excel and Google Sheets"
)

#: Password that protects every sheet so formula cells cannot be edited
#: by accident.  Input cells stay unlocked, formula cells are locked.
FORMULA_PASSWORD = "premium"

#: The health disclaimer that travels in the file and in the listing.
DISCLAIMER = (
    "This spreadsheet is a personal organisation and tracking tool. It is "
    "not medical advice, a diagnosis, a treatment plan or a substitute for "
    "professional care. Calorie, macro, body-fat and energy-expenditure "
    "figures are estimates produced from the numbers you type in, and all "
    "targets are yours to set and edit. Speak to a doctor or a registered "
    "professional before starting a new exercise or nutrition programme, "
    "particularly if you are pregnant, managing a health condition, or "
    "taking medication. No outcome of any kind is promised."
)
DISCLAIMER_SHORT = (
    "For personal tracking only - not medical advice. "
    "All targets are yours to set."
)

#: The sixteen tabs, in workbook order.  The numbers are part of the tab
#: names so the file opens in a sensible order.
SHEET_TABS = [
    "1 Start Here",
    "2 Profile & Goals",
    "3 Dashboard",
    "4 Workout Planner",
    "5 Workout Log",
    "6 Exercise Library",
    "7 Cardio & Activity",
    "8 Weight Tracker",
    "9 Body Measurements",
    "10 Habit Tracker",
    "11 Meals & Macros",
    "12 Water & Sleep",
    "13 Records & Milestones",
    "14 Weekly & Monthly Review",
    "15 Reports & Charts",
    "16 Settings & Lists",
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lists that feed the drop downs (all editable on 16 Settings & Lists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MUSCLE_GROUPS = [
    "Chest", "Back", "Shoulders", "Biceps", "Triceps", "Quadriceps",
    "Hamstrings", "Glutes", "Calves", "Core", "Full body",
]

EQUIPMENT = [
    "Barbell", "Dumbbell", "Kettlebell", "Cable", "Machine",
    "Pull-up bar", "Bands", "Bodyweight", "EZ bar", "Trap bar",
    "Ring", "Medicine ball", "Rowing machine", "Treadmill", "Bike",
    "Other",
]

MOVEMENT_PATTERNS = [
    "Squat", "Hinge", "Lunge", "Push", "Pull", "Carry", "Rotate",
    "Brace", "Jump", "Isolation", "Conditioning",
]

DIFFICULTY = ["Beginner", "Intermediate", "Advanced"]

TRAINING_SPLITS = [
    "Push / Pull / Legs", "Upper / Lower", "Full body",
    "Bro split", "Custom",
]

ACTIVITY_LEVELS = [
    ("Sedentary - desk day, little training", 1.2),
    ("Light - training 1-3 days a week", 1.375),
    ("Moderate - training 3-5 days a week", 1.55),
    ("Active - training 6-7 days a week", 1.725),
    ("Athlete - twice a day or physical job", 1.9),
]

#: Activity type -> MET value used for the optional calorie estimate.
#: MET x 3.5 x bodyweight(kg) / 200 = kcal per minute.
ACTIVITY_TYPES = [
    ("Walking", 3.5),
    ("Running", 9.8),
    ("Cycling", 7.5),
    ("Swimming", 6.0),
    ("Rowing", 7.0),
    ("Class", 6.5),
    ("Hiking", 6.0),
    ("Yoga", 3.0),
    ("Sports", 8.0),
    ("Other", 5.0),
]

MEAL_TYPES = ["Breakfast", "Lunch", "Dinner", "Snack", "Drink"]

GOAL_TYPES = ["Weight", "Strength", "Consistency", "Distance",
              "Habit", "Custom"]

SEX_OPTIONS = ["Female", "Male", "Other"]

#: Mifflin-St Jeor constant per sex option.
SEX_FACTORS = [("Female", -161), ("Male", 5), ("Other", -78)]

HABIT_DEFAULTS = [
    "Train as planned", "10k steps", "Protein at every meal",
    "2 L water", "Sleep 7+ hours", "No liquid calories",
    "Stretch or mobility", "Log meals", "Early night",
    "Morning walk", "Strength session", "Vegetables at dinner",
]

NSV_CATEGORIES = ["Clothes", "Energy", "Lifts", "Sleep", "Mood", "Other"]

WEEKDAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday",
            "Saturday", "Sunday"]

#: Plate denominations for the plate calculator, heaviest first.
PLATES_KG = [25.0, 20.0, 15.0, 10.0, 5.0, 2.5, 1.25]
PLATES_LB = [45.0, 35.0, 25.0, 10.0, 5.0, 2.5]
BAR_KG = 20.0
BAR_LB = 45.0

#: Conversion factors (also written on Settings & Lists).
KG_PER_LB = 0.45359237
CM_PER_IN = 2.54
KM_PER_MI = 1.609344

#: Milestone step for the weight tracker, per unit system.
MILESTONE_KG = 2.0
MILESTONE_LB = 5.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Colours - training palette: pine green, energy orange, chalk cream
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Palette:
    ink = "#20262B"           # near-black slate - titles
    primary = "#14655A"       # pine green headers
    primary_mid = "#3E897D"   # section bands
    primary_soft = "#DDEDE9"  # light band / alternating rows
    accent = "#E4572E"        # energy orange accent
    accent_soft = "#FBE3DA"
    input_bg = "#FFFDF5"      # editable cell background (cream)
    input_border = "#D9CDB4"
    calc_bg = "#ECEEEA"       # locked formula cell background (cool grey)
    calc_border = "#D4D8D2"
    white = "#FFFFFF"
    grey_text = "#5C6660"
    line = "#CBD3CC"
    good_bg = "#DCEBD8"
    good_text = "#2F5A2B"
    warn_bg = "#FDEDD2"
    warn_text = "#8A5A00"
    bad_bg = "#F8DAD9"
    bad_text = "#9C2A24"
    info_bg = "#E2E6F3"
    info_text = "#3A4578"
    note_bg = "#F7F6F1"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Row capacity of every register
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DEFAULT_ROWS = {
    "Workout Log": 400,
    "Exercise Library": 160,
    "Cardio & Activity": 300,
    "Weight Tracker": 200,
    "Body Measurements": 104,
    "Meals & Macros": 400,
    "Food Database": 220,
    "Water & Sleep": 200,
    "Non-Scale Victories": 60,
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The configuration object every sheet module reads
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Config:
    """Everything the generator needs to know to write one workbook."""

    author: str = AUTHOR
    product_name: str = PRODUCT_NAME
    product_subtitle: str = PRODUCT_SUBTITLE
    listing_title: str = PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE
    version: str = PRODUCT_VERSION
    password: str = FORMULA_PASSWORD
    protect_sheets: bool = True
    include_sample_data: bool = False

    # Formatting ------------------------------------------------------------
    currency_symbol: str = "$"
    currency_code: str = "USD"
    date_format: str = "dd-mmm-yyyy"
    time_format: str = "h:mm AM/PM"
    decimals: int = 2
    measure_system: str = "Metric"       # Metric | Imperial

    # Profile defaults ------------------------------------------------------
    height_cm: float = 172.0
    age_years: int = 34
    sex: str = "Female"
    start_weight_kg: float = 78.0
    goal_weight_kg: float = 70.0
    activity_level: str = ACTIVITY_LEVELS[2][0]

    # Nutrition targets -----------------------------------------------------
    calorie_target: float = 1900.0
    protein_target: float = 130.0
    carb_target: float = 170.0
    fat_target: float = 55.0
    fibre_target: float = 25.0
    water_target_ml: float = 2000.0
    glass_ml: float = 250.0

    # Training --------------------------------------------------------------
    sessions_per_week: int = 4
    weekly_minutes_target: float = 180.0
    training_split: str = TRAINING_SPLITS[0]
    week_start: str = "Monday"           # Monday | Sunday
    programme_weeks: int = 12

    # Behaviour -------------------------------------------------------------
    rows: dict = field(default_factory=lambda: dict(DEFAULT_ROWS))
    today: date = field(default_factory=date.today)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    def row_count(self, sheet: str) -> int:
        return int(self.rows.get(sheet, 100))

    @property
    def metric(self) -> bool:
        return self.measure_system.lower().startswith("met")

    @property
    def weight_unit(self) -> str:
        return "kg" if self.metric else "lb"

    @property
    def length_unit(self) -> str:
        return "cm" if self.metric else "in"

    @property
    def distance_unit(self) -> str:
        return "km" if self.metric else "mi"

    @property
    def milestone_step(self) -> float:
        return MILESTONE_KG if self.metric else MILESTONE_LB

    def scale_rows(self, log_rows: int) -> None:
        """Scale every register in place so Workout Log holds N rows."""
        base = DEFAULT_ROWS["Workout Log"]
        factor = max(0.02, float(log_rows) / float(base))
        self.rows = {k: (max(5, int(round(v * factor))) if v else v)
                     for k, v in self.rows.items()}

    def scaled(self, factor: float) -> "Config":
        rows = {k: max(5, int(round(v * factor))) if v else v
                for k, v in self.rows.items()}
        return replace(self, rows=rows)

    # Number format strings (money is kept for completeness: some buyers
    # track coaching or class costs in the notes of their own columns).
    @property
    def money_format(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'{s}#,##0.00;[Red]-{s}#,##0.00'

    @property
    def money_format_0(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'{s}#,##0;[Red]-{s}#,##0'

    @property
    def money_format_4(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'{s}#,##0.0000;[Red]-{s}#,##0.0000'
````

````python
"""The shipped exercise library: 154 movements.

Each row is ``(name, muscle, secondary, equipment, pattern, difficulty,
unilateral)``.  The "how to" line is written from the movement pattern
template below, and the two substitutions are picked from the same
muscle group at build time - both stay fully editable on the tab.

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List, Tuple

HOW_TO = {
    "Squat": "Brace, sit down between the hips, keep the torso tall, "
             "drive the floor away.",
    "Hinge": "Push the hips back, keep the load close, stand up with "
             "the glutes.",
    "Lunge": "Split the stance, lower the back knee, drive through the "
             "front foot.",
    "Push": "Set the shoulders, press in a straight line, lock out "
            "without shrugging.",
    "Pull": "Start tight or at a dead hang, pull the elbow to the rib "
            "cage, control the way down.",
    "Carry": "Grip and brace, stand tall, walk with short quick steps.",
    "Rotate": "Ribs down, rotate from the trunk, resist on the way back.",
    "Brace": "Ribs locked to the pelvis, breathe into the brace, hold "
             "the line.",
    "Jump": "Load soft, explode up, land quiet and absorb.",
    "Isolation": "Move only the target joint, full stretch, hard squeeze "
                 "at the top.",
    "Conditioning": "Hold the planned pace, breathe in rhythm, keep the "
                    "positions honest.",
}
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/formats.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/formats.py sha256:34058d15bcad67a1572f6bacaeaee7e4f6d62fc7237d0674d110f029b00b5ddc -->
````python
"""
Cell format factory.

Two things matter here:

* **Input cells** are unlocked (``locked: False``) and painted cream, so the
  user can type in them while the sheet is protected.
* **Formula cells** are locked (``locked: True``) and painted cool grey.  With
  the sheet protection password in place ("premium" by default) they cannot be
  overwritten by accident.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict

from .config import Config, Palette

P = Palette

INPUT = "input"
CALC = "calc"
PLAIN = "plain"


class FormatBook:
    """Creates (and caches) every :class:`xlsxwriter.format.Format` used."""

    def __init__(self, book, config: Config) -> None:
        self.book = book
        self.cfg = config
        self._cache: Dict[Any, Any] = {}

        money = config.money_format
        money0 = config.money_format_0
        money4 = config.money_format_4
        self._styles: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            "text": {"align": "left"},
            "id": {"align": "left", "bold": True, "font_color": P.primary},
            "wrap": {"align": "left", "valign": "top", "text_wrap": True},
            "date": {"num_format": config.date_format, "align": "center"},
            "time": {"num_format": config.time_format, "align": "center"},
            "money": {"num_format": money, "align": "right"},
            "money0": {"num_format": money0, "align": "right"},
            "money4": {"num_format": money4, "align": "right"},
            "number": {"num_format": "#,##0.00", "align": "right"},
            "number1": {"num_format": "#,##0.0", "align": "right"},
            "int": {"num_format": "#,##0", "align": "right"},
            "percent": {"num_format": "0.0%", "align": "center"},
            "percent0": {"num_format": "0%", "align": "center"},
            "rating": {"num_format": "0", "align": "center"},
            "flag": {"align": "center"},
            "status": {"align": "center", "bold": True},
            "link": {"align": "left", "font_color": P.info_text,
                     "underline": 1},
        }

        self._modes: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            INPUT: {"locked": False, "bg_color": P.input_bg,
                    "border": 1, "border_color": P.input_border},
            CALC: {"locked": True, "bg_color": P.calc_bg,
                   "border": 1, "border_color": P.calc_border,
                   "font_color": P.ink},
            PLAIN: {"locked": True},
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ core
    def _make(self, props: Dict[str, Any]):
        key = tuple(sorted((k, str(v)) for k, v in props.items()))
        if key not in self._cache:
            self._cache[key] = self.book.add_format(props)
        return self._cache[key]

    def cell(self, style: str = "text", mode: str = INPUT, **extra):
        """Data cell format: `style` = value type, `mode` = input/calc/plain."""
        props: Dict[str, Any] = {"font_name": "Calibri", "font_size": 10,
                                 "valign": "vcenter"}
        props.update(self._modes[mode])
        props.update(self._styles.get(style, {}))
        props.update(extra)
        return self._make(props)

    def input(self, style: str = "text", **extra):
        return self.cell(style, INPUT, **extra)

    def calc(self, style: str = "text", **extra):
        return self.cell(style, CALC, **extra)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- chrome
    def chrome(self, name: str, **extra):
        base: Dict[str, Any] = {"font_name": "Calibri", "font_size": 10,
                                "locked": True, "valign": "vcenter"}
        styles: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            "title": {"font_size": 18, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                      "bg_color": P.primary, "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "title_right": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "right", "indent": 1},
            "subtitle": {"font_size": 10, "italic": True,
                         "font_color": P.grey_text, "bg_color": P.note_bg,
                         "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "nav": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True, "font_color": P.info_text,
                    "bg_color": P.note_bg, "underline": 1, "align": "left",
                    "indent": 1},
            "nav_plain": {"font_size": 9, "font_color": P.grey_text,
                          "bg_color": P.note_bg, "align": "left"},
            "section": {"font_size": 11, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                        "bg_color": P.primary_mid, "align": "left",
                        "indent": 1},
            "subsection": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                           "font_color": P.primary, "bg_color": P.primary_soft,
                           "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "header": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                       "bg_color": P.primary, "align": "center",
                       "valign": "vcenter", "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                       "border_color": P.primary},
            "header_left": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "left", "valign": "vcenter",
                            "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                            "border_color": P.primary, "indent": 1},
            "label": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "indent": 1,
                      "font_color": P.ink},
            "label_bold": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True, "align": "left",
                           "indent": 1, "font_color": P.ink},
            "label_right": {"font_size": 10, "align": "right",
                            "font_color": P.ink},
            "note": {"font_size": 9, "italic": True,
                     "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "left",
                     "text_wrap": True, "valign": "top"},
            "note_box": {"font_size": 9, "font_color": P.ink,
                         "bg_color": P.accent_soft, "align": "left",
                         "valign": "top", "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.accent, "indent": 1},
            "kpi_label": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                          "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary_mid,
                          "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "kpi_value": {"font_size": 16, "bold": True,
                          "font_color": P.ink, "bg_color": P.white,
                          "align": "center", "valign": "vcenter",
                          "border": 1, "border_color": P.line},
            "kpi_note": {"font_size": 8, "italic": True,
                         "font_color": P.grey_text, "bg_color": P.white,
                         "align": "center", "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.line},
            "total_label": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "total_value": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "right"},
            "form_label": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True, "align": "left",
                           "font_color": P.primary, "bottom": 1,
                           "bottom_color": P.line, "indent": 1},
            "form_line": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "bottom": 1,
                          "bottom_color": P.ink, "locked": False},
            "form_box": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "valign": "top",
                         "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.ink, "locked": False},
            "print_title": {"font_size": 16, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.primary, "align": "left"},
            "print_sub": {"font_size": 10, "italic": True,
                          "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "left"},
            "legend_input": {"font_size": 9, "bg_color": P.input_bg,
                             "border": 1, "border_color": P.input_border,
                             "align": "center"},
            "legend_calc": {"font_size": 9, "bg_color": P.calc_bg,
                            "border": 1, "border_color": P.calc_border,
                            "align": "center"},
            "band": {"bg_color": P.primary_soft},
            "rule": {"bottom": 2, "bottom_color": P.primary},
            "legend_label": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                             "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "right"},
            "day_number": {"font_size": 11, "bold": True,
                           "font_color": P.primary,
                           "bg_color": P.primary_soft, "align": "left",
                           "indent": 1, "num_format": "d ddd",
                           "border": 1, "border_color": P.line},
            "day_item": {"font_size": 8, "font_color": P.ink,
                         "align": "left", "indent": 1, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.line, "bg_color": P.white},
        }
        props = dict(base)
        props.update(styles.get(name, {}))
        props.update(extra)
        return self._make(props)

    # -------------------------------------------------- conditional formats
    def cf(self, kind: str):
        """Formats used by conditional formatting rules."""
        palettes = {
            "good": {"bg_color": P.good_bg, "font_color": P.good_text},
            "warn": {"bg_color": P.warn_bg, "font_color": P.warn_text},
            "bad": {"bg_color": P.bad_bg, "font_color": P.bad_text},
            "info": {"bg_color": P.info_bg, "font_color": P.info_text},
            "muted": {"font_color": P.grey_text, "italic": True},
            "bold_bad": {"bg_color": P.bad_bg, "font_color": P.bad_text,
                         "bold": True},
            "bold_good": {"bg_color": P.good_bg, "font_color": P.good_text,
                          "bold": True},
        }
        return self._make(palettes[kind])
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/layout.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/layout.py sha256:3f85dc5068cb03c7bb7f378578ee4e2d7daa87c32d99d2df0fbee7871d0ed0fd -->
````python
"""
Layout engine.

The workbook is described declaratively: every register sheet (Clients,
Properties, Jobs, Invoices, ...) is a :class:`SheetSpec` of :class:`Col`
objects.  Formulas are written as templates that never contain hard coded
column letters, so columns can be reordered or inserted without breaking a
single formula:

    "=IF({client}{r}="","",SUMIFS([[Payments.amount]],[[Payments.invoice]],{id}{r}))"

    {r}            -> the current Excel row number (1 based)
    {key}          -> column letter of the column `key` on the *same* sheet
    [[Sheet.key]]  -> absolute range of that column's data rows, e.g.
                      'Job Costing'!$K$5:$K$504
    [[Sheet.key#r]]-> absolute single cell of that column on row r
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import string
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence

# Row 1 title, row 2 strapline, row 3 navigation, row 4 headers, row 5+ data.
TITLE_ROW = 1
SUBTITLE_ROW = 2
NAV_ROW = 3
HEADER_ROW = 4
DATA_ROW = 5


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A1 helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def col_letter(index: int) -> str:
    """0 based column index -> Excel column letter."""
    letters = ""
    index += 1
    while index:
        index, rem = divmod(index - 1, 26)
        letters = string.ascii_uppercase[rem] + letters
    return letters


def quote_sheet(name: str) -> str:
    """Quote a sheet name for use inside a formula when it needs it."""
    if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*$", name):
        return name
    return "'" + name.replace("'", "''") + "'"


def cell_ref(col: int, row: int, absolute: bool = True) -> str:
    dollar = "$" if absolute else ""
    return f"{dollar}{col_letter(col)}{dollar}{row}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Column / sheet specifications
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Col:
    """One column of a register sheet."""

    key: str
    header: str
    width: float = 14.0
    style: str = "text"              # key into the format book (see formats.py)
    formula: Optional[str] = None    # template -> locked, calculated column
    validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    note: Optional[str] = None       # help text shown when the cell is selected
    cf: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    hidden: bool = False
    group: str = ""                  # section label (documentation only)

    @property
    def is_formula(self) -> bool:
        return self.formula is not None


@dataclass
class SheetSpec:
    """A register sheet: title band, header row and N pre-built data rows."""

    name: str
    title: str
    subtitle: str = ""
    columns: List[Col] = field(default_factory=list)
    rows: int = 100
    header_row: int = HEADER_ROW        # 1 based Excel row of the header
    tab_color: Optional[str] = None
    freeze_cols: int = 2
    freeze_at: Optional[int] = None   # 1 based row to freeze below
    samples: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    help_text: str = ""
    extra_notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
    @property
    def first_data_row(self) -> int:
        return self.header_row + 1

    @property
    def last_data_row(self) -> int:
        return self.header_row + self.rows

    def index(self, key: str) -> int:
        for i, col in enumerate(self.columns):
            if col.key == key:
                return i
        raise KeyError(f"{self.name}: unknown column '{key}'")

    def letter(self, key: str) -> str:
        return col_letter(self.index(key))

    def col(self, key: str) -> Col:
        return self.columns[self.index(key)]

    @property
    def last_col_index(self) -> int:
        return len(self.columns) - 1


class Registry:
    """Lookup table of every registered :class:`SheetSpec`."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._specs: Dict[str, SheetSpec] = {}

    def add(self, spec: SheetSpec) -> SheetSpec:
        self._specs[spec.name] = spec
        return spec

    def __contains__(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return name in self._specs

    def __getitem__(self, name: str) -> SheetSpec:
        return self._specs[name]

    def names(self) -> Sequence[str]:
        return list(self._specs)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ references
    def rng(self, sheet: str, key: str, first: Optional[int] = None,
            last: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
        spec = self._specs[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        first = first or spec.first_data_row
        last = last or spec.last_data_row
        return f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first}:${letter}${last}"

    def cell(self, sheet: str, key: str, row: int) -> str:
        spec = self._specs[sheet]
        return f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${spec.letter(key)}${row}"

    def letter(self, sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        return self._specs[sheet].letter(key)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- renderer
    _REF = re.compile(r"\[\[([^\].#]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)(?:#(\d*))?\]\]")

    def render(self, template: str, row: Optional[int] = None,
               spec: Optional[SheetSpec] = None) -> str:
        """Expand [[Sheet.key]] and {key}/{r} tokens into a real formula."""

        def _ref(match: "re.Match[str]") -> str:
            sheet, key, single = match.group(1), match.group(2), match.group(3)
            if single:
                return self.cell(sheet, key, int(single))
            if single == "":
                # [[Sheet.key#]] -> same row as the formula being written
                if row is None:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"[[{sheet}.{key}#]] needs a row context")
                return self.cell(sheet, key, row)
            return self.rng(sheet, key)

        text = self._REF.sub(_ref, template)

        if spec is not None:
            mapping: Dict[str, Any] = {c.key: spec.letter(c.key)
                                       for c in spec.columns}
            # `{key_first}` / `{key_last}` give the absolute top and bottom
            # of a column on the same sheet, so an in-sheet COUNTIFS reads
            # `{key_first}:{key_last}` instead of a hand built $D$5:$D$104.
            for col in spec.columns:
                letter = spec.letter(col.key)
                mapping[f"{col.key}_first"] = (
                    f"${letter}${spec.first_data_row}")
                mapping[f"{col.key}_last"] = (
                    f"${letter}${spec.last_data_row}")
            if row is not None:
                mapping["r"] = row
                mapping["r_prev"] = row - 1
            mapping["first"] = spec.first_data_row
            mapping["last"] = spec.last_data_row
            text = text.format(**mapping)
        elif row is not None:
            text = text.format(r=row)
        return text


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reusable formula fragments
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def max_if(value_range: str, *conditions: str) -> str:
    """MAX of `value_range` where all conditions hold (no CSE required)."""
    cond = "*".join(f"({c})" for c in conditions)
    return f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX({cond}*{value_range}))"


def min_if(value_range: str, *conditions: str, sentinel: int = 2958465) -> str:
    """MIN of `value_range` where all conditions hold (no CSE required).

    Non matching rows are swapped for a sentinel (31-Dec-9999 as a serial) so
    that MIN ignores them.  Returns the sentinel when nothing matches, so the
    caller should wrap the result in an IF test.
    """
    cond = "*".join(f"({c})" for c in conditions)
    return (f"SUMPRODUCT(MIN({cond}*{value_range}"
            f"+(1-{cond})*{sentinel}))")


def blank_if(test: str, result: str) -> str:
    return f'IF({test},"",{result})'


def safe(expr: str, fallback: str = '""') -> str:
    return f"IFERROR({expr},{fallback})"


def lookup(value: str, table_range: str, index_range: str,
           fallback: str = '""') -> str:
    """INDEX/MATCH lookup (works left or right, unlike VLOOKUP)."""
    return f"IFERROR(INDEX({index_range},MATCH({value},{table_range},0)),{fallback})"


def dynamic_name(sheet: str, letter: str, first: int, last: int,
                 count_text: bool = True) -> str:
    """OFFSET based defined name that grows with the populated rows."""
    rng = f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first}:${letter}${last}"
    counter = f'COUNTIF({rng},"?*")' if count_text else f"COUNTA({rng})"
    return (f"=OFFSET({quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first},0,0,"
            f"MAX(1,{counter}),1)")


def join_nonblank(parts: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    """Build `a & b & c` style concatenation."""
    return "&".join(parts)
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/names.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/names.py sha256:380f0ef2abec6df833a076a29957155b10d96e2154f546eec5dd1022eb093d3e -->
````python
"""Workbook level defined names that point at the register sheets.

The static drop down lists on `16 Settings & Lists` define their own
names when that tab is built.  These are the ones that have to follow
live data - the exercise library and the food database - so they are
built from the registry once every register exists.  Each one is an
``OFFSET`` range that grows and shrinks with the number of filled rows,
which is why a new exercise appears in the log drop down the moment you
type it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Dict, Tuple

from .layout import Registry, dynamic_name

#: defined name -> (sheet, column key)
CROSS_SHEET_NAMES: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str]] = {
    "ExerciseNames": ("6 Exercise Library", "name"),
    "LogDates": ("5 Workout Log", "date"),
    "LogExercises": ("5 Workout Log", "exercise"),
    "WeightDates": ("8 Weight Tracker", "date"),
}


def define_cross_sheet_names(book, reg: Registry) -> None:
    """Create the live lookup names. Call after every register is built."""
    for name, (sheet, key) in CROSS_SHEET_NAMES.items():
        if sheet not in reg:
            continue
        spec = reg[sheet]
        book.define_name(
            name,
            dynamic_name(sheet, spec.letter(key), spec.first_data_row,
                         spec.last_data_row))
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/cardio.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/cardio.py sha256:de9007d1f395767f77fa61c88f070005444476445f5f859823cbb18c6f1e5fa0 -->
````python
"""7 Cardio & Activity - pace, splits, distance and MET calories.

Pace is shown both ways (min/km and min/mile) whichever unit system the
buyer chose.  The calorie column is optional: type a number from a
machine and it wins; leave it empty and the MET table on Settings
estimates from body weight at that date.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import SheetWriter, date_check, list_from, number_check
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "7 Cardio & Activity"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="7  Cardio & Activity",
        subtitle="Walks, runs, rides, swims, rows and classes - pace both "
                 "ways, steps, heart rate and an honest calorie estimate.",
        tab_color="#3E897D",
        rows=cfg.row_count("Cardio & Activity"),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text="Distance is typed in the stamped unit (or the workbook "
                  "unit). Pace, splits and the calorie estimate calculate; "
                  "type your own calorie number any time and it wins.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
                formula='="C-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
            Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("type", "Activity", 12, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListActivityType"),
                note="Feeds the MET estimate and the minutes-by-type "
                     "report."),
            Col("distance", "Distance", 10, "number1",
                validate=number_check(0, 500),
                note="In the stamped unit, or the workbook unit when the "
                     "stamp is empty."),
            Col("stamp", "Unit", 7, "flag",
                validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["km", "mi"],
                          "ignore_blank": True}),
            Col("km", "km (canonical)", 10, "number", hidden=True,
                formula="=" + C.km_from("{distance}{r}", "{stamp}{r}")),
            Col("dur", "Minutes", 10, "number1",
                validate=number_check(0, 900)),
            Col("pace", "min / km", 10, "number1", hidden=True,
                formula='IF(OR({km}{r}="",{km}{r}=0,{dur}{r}=""),"",'
                        '{dur}{r}/{km}{r})'),
            Col("pace_txt", "Pace / km", 11, "text",
                formula="=" + C.pace_text("{pace}{r}"),
                note="Minutes:seconds per kilometre."),
            Col("pace_mi_txt", "Pace / mile", 11, "text",
                formula='IF(OR({pace}{r}="",{pace}{r}<=0),"",'
                        'TEXT(INT({pace}{r}*KmPerMi),"0")&":"&TEXT(IF('
                        'ROUND(({pace}{r}*KmPerMi-INT({pace}{r}*KmPerMi))'
                        '*60,0)=60,0,ROUND(({pace}{r}*KmPerMi-INT('
                        '{pace}{r}*KmPerMi))*60,0)),"00"))',
                note="Minutes:seconds per mile, for the runners."),
            Col("steps", "Steps", 9, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000, False)),
            Col("hr", "Avg heart rate", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 250, False)),
            Col("rpe", "Effort 1-10", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 10, False)),
            Col("cal_in", "Calories (typed)", 12, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 5000, False),
                note="Optional. A machine or watch number wins over the "
                     "estimate."),
            Col("met", "MET", 7, "number", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({type}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(MetMET,MATCH('
                        '{type}{r},MetType,0)),""))'),
            Col("bw", "bodyweight kg", 10, "number", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({date}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX('
                        '[[8 Weight Tracker.kg]],MATCH({date}{r},'
                        '[[8 Weight Tracker.date]],1)),StartKg))',
                note="The weigh-in on or before this date; your starting "
                     "weight until the first weigh-in exists."),
            Col("kcal", "kcal used", 10, "int", hidden=True,
                formula='IF(OR({dur}="",{dur}{r}=0),0,IF({cal_in}{r}<>"",'
                        '{cal_in}{r},IF(OR({met}="",{bw}{r}=""),0,'
                        '{met}{r}*3.5*{bw}{r}/200*{dur}{r})))'),
            Col("kcal_disp", "Calories", 10, "int",
                formula='IF({kcal}{r}=0,"",{kcal}{r})',
                note="Typed value if you gave one, otherwise MET x 3.5 x "
                     "kg / 200 x minutes. An estimate, labelled as one."),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 26, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.cardio_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    sheet.note(spec_.last_data_row + 1,
               "Pace maths: pace = minutes / distance, shown per km and "
               "per mile both ways. The estimate uses the MET table on "
               "16 Settings & Lists and your body weight at the date - "
               "edit either and this tab follows.",
               spec_.last_col_index, height=26)
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/common.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/common.py sha256:39ce8bd18eca45c0b4fb7d04d2998a528d22b6abe16451c0e5bcf17d23e7886a -->
````python
"""Shared formula fragments and chrome helpers for every tab.

All fragments here are Excel 2010 safe: no IFS, no XLOOKUP, no MAXIFS,
no TEXTJOIN, no dynamic arrays.  Conditional aggregation is done with
COUNTIFS / SUMIFS / SUMPRODUCT(MAX(...)) and hidden helper columns.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import DISCLAIMER_SHORT

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Unit conversions.  Every register stores a canonical metric value in a
# hidden column; the unit stamp on the row wins, then the workbook unit.
# KgPerLb / CmPerIn / KmPerMi / Units are defined names on Settings.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def kg_from(typed: str, stamp: str) -> str:
    return (f'IF({typed}="","",IF({stamp}="lb",{typed}*KgPerLb,'
            f'IF({stamp}="kg",{typed},'
            f'IF(Units="Imperial",{typed}*KgPerLb,{typed}))))')


def cm_from(typed: str, stamp: str) -> str:
    return (f'IF({typed}="","",IF({stamp}="in",{typed}*CmPerIn,'
            f'IF({stamp}="cm",{typed},'
            f'IF(Units="Imperial",{typed}*CmPerIn,{typed}))))')


def km_from(typed: str, stamp: str) -> str:
    return (f'IF({typed}="","",IF({stamp}="mi",{typed}*KmPerMi,'
            f'IF({stamp}="km",{typed},'
            f'IF(Units="Imperial",{typed}*KmPerMi,{typed}))))')


def disp_weight(kg: str) -> str:
    """Canonical kg -> the unit the buyer chose, blank safe."""
    return f'IF({kg}="","",IF(Units="Imperial",{kg}/KgPerLb,{kg}))'


def disp_length(cm: str) -> str:
    return f'IF({cm}="","",IF(Units="Imperial",{cm}/CmPerIn,{cm}))'


def disp_distance(km: str) -> str:
    return f'IF({km}="","",IF(Units="Imperial",{km}/KmPerMi,{km}))'


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dates and weeks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def week_start_of(date_expr: str) -> str:
    """Monday of the week (or Sunday, per Settings) containing the date."""
    return (f'{date_expr}-WEEKDAY({date_expr},'
            f'IF(WeekStart="Sunday",1,2))+1')


def day_of_week(date_expr: str) -> str:
    """1..7 with day 1 = the week start chosen on Settings."""
    return f'WEEKDAY({date_expr},IF(WeekStart="Sunday",1,2))'


def mmss(minutes_expr: str) -> str:
    """92.5 minutes -> '92:30' (min:sec), blank safe, no array maths."""
    m = f'INT({minutes_expr})'
    s = f'ROUND(({minutes_expr}-{m})*60,0)'
    return (f'IF({minutes_expr}="","",IF({minutes_expr}=0,"0:00",'
            f'IF({s}=60,TEXT({m}+1,"0")&":00",'
            f'TEXT({m},"0")&":"&TEXT({s},"00"))))')


def pace_text(min_per: str) -> str:
    """A decimal min/km as mm:ss per unit, blank and zero safe."""
    return (f'IF(OR({min_per}="",{min_per}<=0),"",'
            f'TEXT(INT({min_per}),"0")&":"&'
            f'TEXT(IF(ROUND(({min_per}-INT({min_per}))*60,0)=60,0,'
            f'ROUND(({min_per}-INT({min_per}))*60,0)),"00"))')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chrome
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def footer(sheet, cfg, last_col: int, row: int, extra: str = "") -> int:
    """The two lines every tab carries: disclaimer then credit."""
    text = DISCLAIMER_SHORT
    if extra:
        text = f"{extra}  |  {text}"
    sheet.merge(row, 0, last_col, text, sheet.f.chrome("note"))
    sheet.merge(row + 1, 0, last_col,
                f"{cfg.author}  |  {cfg.product_name} v{cfg.version}",
                sheet.f.chrome("note"))
    return row + 2


def empty_state(test: str, message: str) -> str:
    """Honest empty state: a blank file never looks broken."""
    return f'IF({test},"{message}","")'
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/dashboard.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/dashboard.py sha256:d6b0f49f830bb50dfd9229ac8b45afa975cfd91d54f317d07507970b9407fd43 -->
````python
"""3 Dashboard - KPI tiles, goal bars, week over week, honest empties.

Every tile is a formula over the registers; before any data exists the
tiles show dashes and a single plain-English panel explains what to do
first, so a blank file never looks broken.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import quote_sheet
from ..layout import col_letter
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C
from . import habits as H

NAME = "3 Dashboard"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.accent, landscape=False)
    last_col = 11
    sheet.banner("3  Dashboard",
                 "The week at a glance - everything below reads the "
                 "registers, nothing is typed here.", last_col)
    log = reg["5 Workout Log"]
    wt = reg["8 Weight Tracker"]
    meals = reg["11 Meals & Macros"]
    ws_tab = reg["12 Water & Sleep"]
    ql, qw, qm, qs = (quote_sheet(x.name) for x in (log, wt, meals, ws_tab))
    qh = quote_sheet("10 Habit Tracker")
    HW = col_letter(H.SUM_COL0 + 3)   # habit "this week" column
    HB = col_letter(H.SUM_COL0 + 1)   # habit best streak column

    def lr(spec, key):
        return (f"{quote_sheet(spec.name)}!${spec.letter(key)}"
                f"${spec.first_data_row}:${spec.letter(key)}"
                f"${spec.last_data_row}")

    d_log, s_log, w_log, dur_log = (lr(log, k) for k in
                                    ("date", "sid", "wstart", "dur"))
    kg_w, disp_w, date_w, ma7_w = (lr(wt, k) for k in
                                   ("kg", "disp", "date", "ma7_disp"))
    d_m, cal_m = lr(meals, "date"), lr(meals, "cal_used")
    d_s, tot_s, hrs_s = lr(ws_tab, "date"), lr(ws_tab, "total"), \
        lr(ws_tab, "hours")
    mob_s = lr(ws_tab, "mobility")

    ws_this = C.week_start_of("TODAY()")
    ws_last = f"{ws_this}-7"

    def distinct_in(range_dates, cond_extra=""):
        return (f'SUMPRODUCT(({range_dates}<>"")*{cond_extra}/'
                f'COUNTIFS({range_dates},{range_dates}))')

    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "RIGHT NOW", last_col)
    tiles = [
        ("Current weight",
         f'=IFERROR(INDEX({disp_w},MATCH(MAX({date_w}),{date_w},0)),"-")',
         "number1", "latest weigh-in, 7-day line on tab 8"),
        ("Change from start",
         f'=IF(IFERROR(INDEX({kg_w},MATCH(MAX({date_w}),{date_w},0)),"")='
         f'"" ,"-",IF(Units="Imperial",(INDEX({kg_w},MATCH(MAX({date_w}),'
         f'{date_w},0))-StartKg)/KgPerLb,INDEX({kg_w},MATCH(MAX({date_w}),'
         f'{date_w},0))-StartKg))',
         "number1", "since your starting weight"),
        ("Workouts this week",
         f'=IF(SUMPRODUCT(({w_log}={ws_this})/((COUNTIFS({w_log},{w_log},'
         f'{s_log},{s_log})+({s_log}=""))))=0,"-",SUMPRODUCT(({w_log}='
         f'{ws_this})/((COUNTIFS({w_log},{w_log},{s_log},{s_log})+('
         f'{s_log}="")))))',
         "number1", f"target {cfg.sessions_per_week} a week"),
        ("Minutes this week",
         f'=IF(SUMIFS({dur_log},{w_log},{ws_this})=0,"-",SUMIFS({dur_log},'
         f'{w_log},{ws_this}))',
         "int", "strength sessions, tab 5"),
        ("Habit rate this week",
         f'=IF(COUNT({qh}!${HW}$8:${HW}$19)=0,"-",AVERAGE({qh}!${HW}$8:'
         f'${HW}$19)/7)',
         "percent0", "ticks over days, tab 10"),
        ("Best streak going",
         f'=IF(MAX({qh}!${HB}$8:${HB}$19)=0,"-",MAX({qh}!${HB}$8:'
         f'${HB}$19))',
         "int", "days, rest days protected"),
        ("Calories, 7-day average",
         f'=IF(SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&TODAY()-6,{d_m},"<="&TODAY())=0,'
         f'"-",SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&TODAY()-6,{d_m},"<="&TODAY())/'
         f'MAX(1,{distinct_in(d_m, f"({d_m}>=TODAY()-6)*({d_m}<=TODAY())")}))',
         "int", "logged days only"),
        ("Goal progress",
         '=IF(COUNT(GoalProgress)=0,"-",AVERAGE(GoalProgress))',
         "percent0", "mean of your six goals"),
    ]
    col = 0
    for i, (label, formula, style, note) in enumerate(tiles):
        sheet.kpi(row, col, label, formula, style=style, span=3, note=note)
        col += 3
        if i == 3:
            col = 0
            row += 3
    row += 4

    row = sheet.section(row, "GOAL PROGRESS", last_col)
    for g in range(6):
        gr = f"INDEX(GoalTypes,{g + 1})"
        sheet.formula(row, 0,
                      f'=IF({gr}="","",{gr}&": "&INDEX(GoalDescs,{g + 1}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, 3,
                      f'=IF(INDEX(GoalProgress,{g + 1})="","",REPT("|",'
                      f'MIN(20,INT(MAX(0,INDEX(GoalProgress,{g + 1}))*20)))'
                      f'&" "&TEXT(MAX(0,INDEX(GoalProgress,{g + 1})),"0%")'
                      f'&IF(INDEX(GoalToGo,{g + 1})="","","  ("&TEXT('
                      f'INDEX(GoalToGo,{g + 1}),"0.##")&" to go)"))',
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, 9, f'=INDEX(GoalStatus,{g + 1})',
                      sheet.f.calc("status"))
        row += 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "THIS WEEK VS LAST WEEK", last_col)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["", "This week", "Last week",
                                    "Difference"],
                           widths=[30, 12, 12, 12])
    compare = [
        ("Sessions logged",
         f'SUMPRODUCT(({w_log}={ws_this})/((COUNTIFS({w_log},{w_log},'
         f'{s_log},{s_log})+({s_log}=""))))',
         f'SUMPRODUCT(({w_log}={ws_last})/((COUNTIFS({w_log},{w_log},'
         f'{s_log},{s_log})+({s_log}=""))))', "number1"),
        ("Training minutes",
         f'SUMIFS({dur_log},{w_log},{ws_this})',
         f'SUMIFS({dur_log},{w_log},{ws_last})', "int"),
        ("Calories logged",
         f'SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&{ws_this},{d_m},"<="&{ws_this}+6)',
         f'SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&{ws_last},{d_m},"<="&{ws_last}+6)',
         "int"),
        ("Water (ml)",
         f'SUMIFS({tot_s},{d_s},">="&{ws_this},{d_s},"<="&{ws_this}+6)',
         f'SUMIFS({tot_s},{d_s},">="&{ws_last},{d_s},"<="&{ws_last}+6)',
         "int"),
        ("Sleep (hours, avg)",
         f'IFERROR(AVERAGEIFS({hrs_s},{d_s},">="&{ws_this},{d_s},"<="&'
         f'{ws_this}+6,{hrs_s},">0"),"")',
         f'IFERROR(AVERAGEIFS({hrs_s},{d_s},">="&{ws_last},{d_s},"<="&'
         f'{ws_last}+6,{hrs_s},">0"),"")', "number1"),
        ("Mobility minutes",
         f'SUMIFS({mob_s},{d_s},">="&{ws_this},{d_s},"<="&{ws_this}+6)',
         f'SUMIFS({mob_s},{d_s},">="&{ws_last},{d_s},"<="&{ws_last}+6)',
         "int"),
    ]
    for label, this_f, last_f, style in compare:
        sheet.write(row, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, 1, "=" + this_f, sheet.f.calc(style))
        sheet.formula(row, 2, "=" + last_f, sheet.f.calc(style))
        sheet.formula(row, 3,
                      f'=IF(OR(B{row + 1}="",C{row + 1}="","",0),'
                      f'"",B{row + 1}-C{row + 1})'.replace(",\"\",0)",
                                                          ")"),
                      sheet.f.calc(style))
        row += 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "WEIGHT TREND", last_col)
    # The sparkline must live in a cell of its own: a sparkline (or any
    # content) inside a merged range that it does not anchor makes Excel
    # strip the part's formula records on open.
    spark_cell = f"$D${row + 2}"
    sheet.set_col(3, 3, 36)
    sheet.merge(row, 0, 2, "7-day average, oldest to newest:",
                sheet.f.chrome("label_bold"))
    sheet.merge(row + 1, 0, 2, "", sheet.f.chrome("label"))
    sheet.write(row + 1, 3, None, sheet.f.cell("text", "calc"))
    sheet.ws.add_sparkline(spark_cell, {
        "range": f"{qw}!${wt.letter('ma7')}${wt.first_data_row}:"
                 f"${wt.letter('ma7')}${wt.last_data_row}",
        "type": "line", "plot_hidden": True,
        "empty_cells": "gaps", "markers": True,
        "series_color": "#14655A",
    })
    sheet.formula(row, 6,
                  f'=IF(COUNT({kg_w})=0,"No weigh-ins yet - the line '
                  f'appears with your second entry.",REPT("|",MIN(20,'
                  f'COUNT({kg_w})/10))&" "&COUNT({kg_w})&" weigh-ins '
                  f'logged")',
                  sheet.f.calc("text"))
    row += 3

    row = sheet.section(row, "WHAT TO DO NEXT", last_col)
    sheet.formula(row, 0,
                  f'=IF(COUNTA({d_log})=0,"Open 2 Profile & Goals and type '
                  f'your starting weight - everything else grows from '
                  f'that.",IF(MAX({date_w})<TODAY()-7,"You have not '
                  f'weighed in for a week - one number, same time of '
                  f'day.",IF(AND(SUMPRODUCT(({w_log}={ws_this})/((COUNTIFS('
                  f'{w_log},{w_log},{s_log},{s_log})+({s_log}=""))))<'
                  f'SessionsPerWeek,WEEKDAY(TODAY(),2)>=5),"Sessions '
                  f'left in this week - plan them on tab 4.",IF(SUMIFS('
                  f'{tot_s},{d_s},TODAY())=0,"Log today\'s water on tab '
                  f'12.","Everything is logged - write the week up on '
                  f'tab 14."))))',
                  sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
    sheet.row_height(row, 30)
    row += 2
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last_col, row)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=3, gridlines=False)
    return sheet
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/exercise_library.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/exercise_library.py sha256:246e09f4eb9140c48e8f3da98e5936db137a2a37ab17c899766cd926b963194f -->
````python
"""6 Exercise Library - 152 shipped movements, fully editable.

The library is product content, not demo data: it ships in both the
filled and the blank workbook, and it feeds every exercise drop down
through the ``ExerciseNames`` defined name.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..exercise_data import EXERCISES, HOW_TO
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from

NAME = "6 Exercise Library"


def _subs(index: int):
    """Two substitutions from the same muscle group, never the move itself."""
    muscle = EXERCISES[index][1]
    same = [i for i, ex in enumerate(EXERCISES)
            if ex[1] == muscle and i != index]
    picks = [same[index % len(same)], same[(index + 7) % len(same)]]
    return [EXERCISES[p]["name"] if isinstance(p, dict) else EXERCISES[p][0]
            for p in picks]


def library_rows():
    """The shipped rows as dictionaries for the grid (input columns)."""
    rows = []
    for i, (name, muscle, secondary, equip, pattern, diff, uni) in \
            enumerate(EXERCISES):
        sub1, sub2 = _subs(i)
        rows.append({
            "name": name, "muscle": muscle, "secondary": secondary,
            "equipment": equip, "pattern": pattern, "difficulty": diff,
            "unilateral": uni, "howto": HOW_TO[pattern],
            "sub1": sub1, "sub2": sub2,
        })
    return rows


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    rows = cfg.row_count("Exercise Library")
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="6  Exercise Library",
        subtitle="152 movements shipped - rename, edit or add your own; "
                 "every drop down in the workbook reads this list.",
        tab_color="#3E897D",
        rows=rows,
        freeze_cols=2,
        help_text="Cream cells are yours. The ID numbers itself; the two "
                  "substitutions are starting suggestions from the same "
                  "muscle group - change them to what you actually reach "
                  "for when a station is taken.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
                formula='="X-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
            Col("name", "Exercise", 30, "text",
                note="The name every other tab uses in its drop down."),
            Col("muscle", "Muscle group", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListMuscle")),
            Col("secondary", "Secondary muscles", 20, "text"),
            Col("equipment", "Equipment", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListEquipment")),
            Col("pattern", "Movement pattern", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListPattern")),
            Col("difficulty", "Difficulty", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListDifficulty")),
            Col("unilateral", "One side at a time?", 12, "flag",
                validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]}),
            Col("howto", "How to do it", 46, "wrap"),
            Col("sub1", "Substitution 1", 24, "text"),
            Col("sub2", "Substitution 2", 24, "text"),
            Col("notes", "Injury & modification notes", 34, "wrap",
                note="Travel with the exercise: 'swap for neutral grip, "
                     "shoulder friendly'."),
        ],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    """Write the shipped library into the input columns of both builds."""
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    first = spec_.first_data_row
    keys = ["name", "muscle", "secondary", "equipment", "pattern",
            "difficulty", "unilateral", "howto", "sub1", "sub2"]
    for offset, row in enumerate(library_rows()):
        if offset >= spec_.rows:
            break
        excel_row = first + offset
        for key in keys:
            sheet.write(excel_row - 1, spec_.index(key), row[key],
                        sheet.f.cell(spec_.col(key).style, "input"))
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/habits.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/habits.py sha256:7c1095d077b3c9f72b3c32412999e8591bda8df3268eb24d4179ac78e610d407 -->
````python
"""10 Habit Tracker - twelve habits, a month grid, honest streaks.

Streaks run left to right through hidden helper rows: a tick adds one,
a blank resets, and a rest day ("R") carries the streak through without
counting as a done day - the single most common complaint about habit
trackers, handled.  The grid is start-date agnostic: pick any month.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import col_letter
from ..writer import SheetWriter, date_check
from . import common as C

NAME = "10 Habit Tracker"

DAYS = 31
DAY_COL0 = 1                      # column B is day 1
SUM_COL0 = DAY_COL0 + DAYS + 1    # two columns of breathing room


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.primary_mid)
    last_col = SUM_COL0 + 5
    sheet.banner("10  Habit Tracker",
                 "Twelve habits you name yourself, a month at a time - "
                 "rest days protect the streak instead of breaking it.",
                 last_col)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.field(row, "Month on the grid",
                      _month_start(cfg) , style="date",
                      name="HabitMonth", validate=date_check(),
                      label_col=0, value_col=2,
                      help_text="The first day of any month. Ticks: x = "
                                "done, R = planned rest (keeps the "
                                "streak, does not add to it).")
    head_row = row + 1            # 0 based row of the ddd header
    date_row = row                # hidden row carrying real dates
    grid_first = head_row + 1
    grid_last = grid_first + 11
    help_row = grid_last + 1      # hidden streak helpers

    # hidden date row + weekday header
    for d in range(1, DAYS + 1):
        col = DAY_COL0 + d - 1
        sheet.formula(date_row, col,
                      f'=IF({d}>DAY(EOMONTH(HabitMonth,0)),"",'
                      f'HabitMonth+{d}-1)',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(head_row, col,
                      f'=IF({d}>DAY(EOMONTH(HabitMonth,0)),"",TEXT('
                      f'HabitMonth+{d}-1,"ddd"))',
                      sheet.f.calc("flag"))
        sheet.set_col(col, col, 4.2)
    sheet.ws.set_row(date_row, 6, None, {"hidden": True})
    sheet.write(head_row, 0, "Habit", sheet.f.chrome("header_left"))
    sheet.set_col(0, 0, 26)

    tick_validate = {"validate": "list", "source": ["x", "R"],
                     "ignore_blank": True}
    ticks = sample_ticks(cfg) if cfg.include_sample_data else {}
    for h in range(12):
        r = grid_first + h
        sheet.formula(r, 0, f'=INDEX(ListHabits,{h + 1})',
````
