````python
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        for d in range(1, DAYS + 1):
            col = DAY_COL0 + d - 1
            value = ticks.get((h, d))
            if value:
                sheet.write(r, col, value, sheet.f.input("flag"))
            else:
                sheet.write(r, col, None, sheet.f.input("flag"))
        sheet.ws.data_validation(r, DAY_COL0, r, DAY_COL0 + DAYS - 1,
                                 tick_validate)
        # hidden streak helper row
        for d in range(1, DAYS + 1):
            col = DAY_COL0 + d - 1
            tick = f"{col_letter(col)}{r + 1}"
            prev = (f"{col_letter(col - 1)}{help_row + 1}" if d > 1
                    else "0")
            sheet.formula(help_row + h, col,
                          f'=IF({col_letter(col)}{head_row + 1}="","",'
                          f'IF({tick}="R",{prev},IF({tick}<>"",IF({prev}='
                          f'"",1,{prev}+1),0)))',
                          sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.ws.set_row(help_row + h, 6, None, {"hidden": True})

    # summary columns
    heads = ["Current streak", "Best streak", "Done %", "This week",
             "Rest days"]
    for i, text in enumerate(heads):
        sheet.write(head_row, SUM_COL0 + i, text, sheet.f.chrome("header"))
        sheet.set_col(SUM_COL0 + i, SUM_COL0 + i, 11)
    anchor = ('IF(EOMONTH(HabitMonth,0)<TODAY(),DAY(EOMONTH(HabitMonth,0)),'
              'IF(HabitMonth>TODAY(),0,DAY(TODAY())))')
    for h in range(12):
        r = grid_first + h
        tick_rng = f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0)}{r + 1}:" \
                   f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0 + DAYS - 1)}{r + 1}"
        help_rng = f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0)}{help_row + h + 1}:" \
                   f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0 + DAYS - 1)}{help_row + h + 1}"
        date_rng = f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0)}{date_row + 1}:" \
                   f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0 + DAYS - 1)}{date_row + 1}"
        sheet.formula(r, SUM_COL0,
                      f'=IF({anchor}=0,0,INDEX({help_rng},{anchor}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, SUM_COL0 + 1, f'=MAX({help_rng})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, SUM_COL0 + 2,
                      f'=IF({anchor}=0,"",COUNTIF({tick_rng},"x")/MAX(1,'
                      f'{anchor}-COUNTIF({tick_rng},"R")))',
                      sheet.f.calc("percent0"))
        sheet.formula(r, SUM_COL0 + 3,
                      f'=COUNTIFS({date_rng},">="&{C.week_start_of("TODAY()")},'
                      f'{date_rng},"<="&{C.week_start_of("TODAY()")}+6,'
                      f'{tick_rng},"x")',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, SUM_COL0 + 4, f'=COUNTIF({tick_rng},"R")',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(grid_first, SUM_COL0 + 2, grid_last,
                                SUM_COL0 + 2,
                                {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                                 "value": 0.8,
                                 "format": sheet.f.cf("good")})

    # today marker across the grid
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(
        grid_first, DAY_COL0, grid_last, DAY_COL0 + DAYS - 1,
        {"type": "formula",
         "criteria": f"=AND({col_letter(DAY_COL0)}${date_row + 1}=TODAY(),"
                     f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0)}${date_row + 1}<>\"\")",
         "format": sheet.f.cf("info")})

    row = help_row + 12 + 1
    row = sheet.section(row, "WEEKLY CONSISTENCY SCORECARD", last_col)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Habit", "Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3",
                                    "Week 4", "Week 5"],
                           widths=[26, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9])
    for h in range(12):
        r = grid_first + h
        tick_rng = f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0)}{r + 1}:" \
                   f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0 + DAYS - 1)}{r + 1}"
        date_rng = f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0)}{date_row + 1}:" \
                   f"{col_letter(DAY_COL0 + DAYS - 1)}{date_row + 1}"
        sheet.formula(row, 0, f"=INDEX(ListHabits,{h + 1})",
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        for w in range(5):
            ws_expr = f"HabitMonth-WEEKDAY(HabitMonth,IF(WeekStart=" \
                      f'"Sunday",1,2))+1+{7 * w}'
            we_expr = f"{ws_expr}+6"
            days_in = f'COUNTIFS({date_rng},">="&{ws_expr},{date_rng},' \
                      f'"<="&{we_expr})'
            rests = f'COUNTIFS({date_rng},">="&{ws_expr},{date_rng},' \
                    f'"<="&{we_expr},{tick_rng},"R")'
            dones = f'COUNTIFS({date_rng},">="&{ws_expr},{date_rng},' \
                    f'"<="&{we_expr},{tick_rng},"x")'
            sheet.formula(row, 1 + w,
                          f'=IF({days_in}=0,"",{dones}/MAX(1,{days_in}-'
                          f'{rests}))',
                          sheet.f.calc("percent0"))
        row += 1
    row += 1
    row = sheet.section(row, "ROUTINE CHECKLIST (MORNING OR EVENING)",
                        last_col)
    checklist = ["Glass of water before coffee", "5 minutes of mobility",
                 "Protein at breakfast", "Walk after lunch",
                 "Screen off 30 min before bed"]
    for item in checklist:
        sheet.write(row, 0, item, sheet.f.input("text"))
        sheet.merge(row, 1, last_col,
                    "tick it in the grid as its own habit if you want "
                    "the streak maths", sheet.f.chrome("note"))
        row += 1
    row += 1
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last_col, row)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=grid_first, freeze_col=1, gridlines=False,
                 print_area=f"$A$1:${col_letter(last_col)}"
                            f"${grid_last + 27}")
    return sheet


def _month_start(cfg: Config):
    import datetime as _dt
    if cfg.include_sample_data:
        return _dt.date(cfg.today.year, cfg.today.month, 1)
    return None


def sample_ticks(cfg: Config):
    """A believable month of ticks and planned rests for the demo file."""
    import datetime as _dt
    ticks = {}
    today = cfg.today
    if today.month == 12:
        return ticks
    patterns = {
        0: lambda d: d % 2 == 0,              # train as planned
        1: lambda d: d % 3 != 0,              # steps
        2: lambda d: True,                    # protein
        3: lambda d: d % 4 != 1,              # water
        4: lambda d: d % 5 != 2,              # sleep
        5: lambda d: d % 7 not in (0, 6),     # no liquid calories
        6: lambda d: d % 2 == 1,              # mobility
        7: lambda d: True,                    # log meals
        8: lambda d: d % 6 != 3,              # early night
        9: lambda d: d % 2 == 0,              # morning walk
        10: lambda d: d % 7 in (1, 3, 5),     # strength
        11: lambda d: d % 3 == 0,             # veg at dinner
    }
    rests = {0: (6, 13, 20, 27), 10: (7, 14, 21, 28)}
    for h, fn in patterns.items():
        for d in range(1, DAYS + 1):
            day = _dt.date(today.year, today.month, d)
            if day > today:
                continue
            if d in rests.get(h, ()):
                ticks[(h, d)] = "R"
            elif fn(d):
                ticks[(h, d)] = "x"
    return ticks
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/meals.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/meals.py sha256:f81c73dfc354dcd177697556e59daf9a6bd3201abc8ffbaaa80e00be83f54e9a -->
````python
"""11 Meals & Macros - food log plus the shipped calorie database.

The buyer types calories and macros by row; when the food name matches
the reference database on the right of this tab, leaving a macro blank
pulls the reference value instead.  Nothing pretends to know your
portion: typed always wins, and incomplete rows say so instead of
silently counting as zero.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..food_data import FOODS
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec, col_letter, quote_sheet
from ..writer import (SheetWriter, cf_text, date_check, list_from,
                      number_check)
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "11 Meals & Macros"

#: database block starts two columns right of the register
DB_GAP = 2


def _ref(col_name: str) -> str:
    return f'IFERROR(INDEX({col_name},MATCH({{food}}{{r}},FoodNames,0)),"")'


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    cols = [
        Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
            formula='="F-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
        Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
        Col("meal", "Meal", 11, "text", validate=list_from("ListMeal")),
        Col("food", "Food", 28, "text",
            note="Type anything. If it matches the database on the "
                 "right, blank macro cells fill from it."),
        Col("cal_in", "kcal (typed)", 11, "int",
            validate=number_check(0, 5000, False)),
        Col("p_in", "Protein g", 10, "number1",
            validate=number_check(0, 300)),
        Col("c_in", "Carbs g", 10, "number1",
            validate=number_check(0, 500)),
        Col("f_in", "Fat g", 9, "number1",
            validate=number_check(0, 300)),
        Col("cal_ref", "kcal ref", 9, "int", hidden=True,
            formula="=" + _ref("FoodKcal")),
        Col("p_ref", "P ref", 8, "number1", hidden=True,
            formula="=" + _ref("FoodP")),
        Col("c_ref", "C ref", 8, "number1", hidden=True,
            formula="=" + _ref("FoodC")),
        Col("f_ref", "F ref", 8, "number1", hidden=True,
            formula="=" + _ref("FoodF")),
        Col("cal_used", "kcal used", 10, "int",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",IF({cal_in}{r}<>"",{cal_in}{r},'
                    '{cal_ref}{r}))'),
        Col("p_used", "Protein used", 11, "number1",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",IF({p_in}{r}<>"",{p_in}{r},'
                    '{p_ref}{r}))'),
        Col("c_used", "Carbs used", 10, "number1",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",IF({c_in}{r}<>"",{c_in}{r},'
                    '{c_ref}{r}))'),
        Col("f_used", "Fat used", 9, "number1",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",IF({f_in}{r}<>"",{f_in}{r},'
                    '{f_ref}{r}))'),
        Col("fibre", "Fibre g", 9, "number1",
            validate=number_check(0, 100)),
        Col("sugar", "Sugar g", 9, "number1",
            validate=number_check(0, 200)),
        Col("sodium", "Sodium mg", 10, "int",
            validate=number_check(0, 10000, False)),
        Col("x1", "Custom 1", 10, "number1"),
        Col("x2", "Custom 2", 10, "number1"),
        Col("complete", "Row status", 11, "status",
            formula='IF({date}{r}="","",IF(OR({cal_used}{r}="",{p_used}{r}'
                    '="",{c_used}{r}="",{f_used}{r}=""),"incomplete",'
                    '"logged"))',
            cf=[cf_text("incomplete", "warn"),
                cf_text("logged", "good")]),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "wrap"),
    ]
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="11  Meals & Macros",
        subtitle="Log by meal against your targets - the 200-item calorie "
                 "database on the right fills blanks, typed numbers win.",
        tab_color="#14655A",
        rows=cfg.row_count("Meals & Macros"),
        freeze_cols=4,
        help_text="Cream macro cells: type your number, or leave blank "
                  "and let the database fill it when the food name "
                  "matches. The day block under the register totals "
                  "everything against your targets.",
        columns=cols,
        samples=sample_data.meal_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    """The calorie database block + the day totals block."""
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    q = quote_sheet(NAME)
    db_col0 = spec_.last_col_index + 1 + DB_GAP
    head = spec_.header_row - 1
    heads = ["Food", "Category", "Serving", "kcal", "Protein g",
             "Carbs g", "Fat g"]
    widths = [30, 13, 14, 8, 10, 9, 8]
    for i, text in enumerate(heads):
        sheet.write(head, db_col0 + i, text, sheet.f.chrome("header"))
        sheet.set_col(db_col0 + i, db_col0 + i, widths[i])
    sheet.merge(head, db_col0 + 7, db_col0 + 12,
                "CALORIE DATABASE - edit freely, blanks fill from here",
                sheet.f.chrome("section"))
    first = spec_.first_data_row
    capacity = cfg.row_count("Food Database")
    for offset, row in enumerate(FOODS):
        if offset >= capacity:
            break
        excel = first + offset
        for i, value in enumerate(row):
            style = "text" if i < 3 else ("int" if i == 3 else "number1")
            sheet.write(excel - 1, db_col0 + i, value,
                        sheet.f.input(style))
    last_db = first + min(capacity, len(FOODS)) - 1
    letters = [col_letter(db_col0 + i) for i in range(7)]
    for name, letter in [("FoodNames", letters[0]),
                         ("FoodKcal", letters[3]),
                         ("FoodP", letters[4]),
                         ("FoodC", letters[5]),
                         ("FoodF", letters[6])]:
        sheet.book.define_name(
            name,
            f"=OFFSET({q}!${letter}${first},0,0,MAX(1,COUNTIF("
            f"{q}!${letter}${first}:${letter}${last_db},\"?*\")),1)")

    # ---- day totals block under the register
    d = f"{q}!${spec_.letter('date')}${first}:${spec_.letter('date')}" \
        f"${spec_.last_data_row}"
    used = {k: f"{q}!${spec_.letter(k)}${first}:${spec_.letter(k)}"
                 f"${spec_.last_data_row}"
            for k in ("cal_used", "p_used", "c_used", "f_used")}
    top = spec_.last_data_row + 3
    row = sheet.section(top, "A DAY AGAINST YOUR TARGETS", 8)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Pick a date", cfg.today, style="date",
                      label_col=0, value_col=2,
                      help_text="Every total below reads this date.")
    pick = f"$C${row}"
    rows = [
        ("Calories", "cal_used", "CalTarget", "int"),
        ("Protein (g)", "p_used", "ProteinTarget", "int"),
        ("Carbohydrate (g)", "c_used", "CarbTarget", "int"),
        ("Fat (g)", "f_used", "FatTarget", "int"),
    ]
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["", "Logged", "Target", "Gap"],
                           widths=[22, 10, 10, 10])
    for label, key, target in [(a, b, c) for a, b, c, _ in rows]:
        sheet.write(row, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, 1, f'=SUMIFS({used[key]},{d},"="&{pick})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 2, f"={target}", sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 3, f'=IF(B{row + 1}="","",B{row + 1}-C{row + 1})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        row += 1
    sheet.formula(row, 0,
                  f'=IF(SUMIFS({used["cal_used"]},{d},"="&{pick})=0,"No '
                  f'food logged for this date yet - the day block stays '
                  f'empty rather than pretending.","")',
                  sheet.f.chrome("note"))
    row += 2
    sheet.formula(row, 0,
                  f'=IF(OR(StartKg="",StartKg=0),"","Protein today per kg '
                  f'body weight: "&TEXT(IFERROR(SUMIFS({used["p_used"]},'
                  f'{d},"="&{pick})/StartKg,""),"0.00")&" g/kg")',
                  sheet.f.chrome("label"))
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=4, freeze_col=2,
                 print_area=f"$A$1:${col_letter(spec_.last_col_index)}$"
                            f"{spec_.last_data_row}")
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/measurements.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/measurements.py sha256:29047260c37ddc5bc6df77e111e0cfd23cbee76996d6344e6b9170b4e7b8482d -->
````python
"""9 Body Measurements - eleven sites, four custom, ratios and Navy.

The register stores what the tape said, in the stamped unit.  Ratios
are unit-free; the waist-to-height ratio and the optional Navy body-fat
estimate convert to centimetres inside the formula.  The per-site
summary block (first, latest, change, per cent change) is written by
``decorate`` so it never needs an array formula.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec, col_letter, quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter, date_check, number_check
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "9 Body Measurements"

SITES = [
    ("neck", "Neck"), ("shoulders", "Shoulders"), ("chest", "Chest"),
    ("arms", "Arm (R)"), ("forearms", "Forearm (R)"), ("waist", "Waist"),
    ("hips", "Hips"), ("thighs", "Thigh (R)"), ("calves", "Calf (R)"),
    ("c1", "Custom site 1"), ("c2", "Custom site 2"),
    ("c3", "Custom site 3"), ("c4", "Custom site 4"),
]


def _cm(key: str, row: str) -> str:
    return C.cm_from("{%s}%s" % (key, row), "{stamp}%s" % row)


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    cols = [
        Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
            formula='="M-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
        Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
    ]
    for key, label in SITES:
        cols.append(Col(key, label, 10, "number1",
                        validate=number_check(5, 250),
                        note="Tape measure, same time of day each time."))
    cols += [
        Col("stamp", "Unit", 7, "flag",
            validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["cm", "in"],
                      "ignore_blank": True}),
        Col("whr", "Waist : hip", 11, "number",
            formula='IF(OR({waist}{r}="",{hips}{r}="",{hips}{r}=0),"",'
                    '{waist}{r}/{hips}{r})',
            note="Unit-free ratio. Under 0.90 (men) / 0.85 (women) is the "
                 "usual WHO line - context, not a verdict."),
        Col("whtr", "Waist : height", 11, "number",
            formula='IF(OR({waist}{r}="",HeightCm=0),"",' +
                    _cm("waist", "{r}") + '/HeightCm)',
            note="Under about 0.5 is the common guide. An estimate from "
                 "your numbers, not medical advice."),
        Col("navy", "Navy body fat %", 13, "number1",
            formula='IF(OR(' + _cm("neck", "{r}") + '="",'
                    + _cm("waist", "{r}") + '="",' + _cm("hips", "{r}")
                    + '=""),"",'
                    'IF(Sex="Male",495/(1.0324*LOG10(' +
                    _cm("waist", "{r}") + '-' + _cm("neck", "{r}") +
                    ')-0.19077*LOG10(HeightCm))-450,'
                    '495/(1.29579*LOG10(' + _cm("waist", "{r}") + '+'
                    + _cm("hips", "{r}") + '-' + _cm("neck", "{r}") +
                    ')-0.35004*LOG10(HeightCm))-450))',
            note="US Navy tape method. Clearly an estimate - tape "
                 "measurements carry a couple of points of error."),
        Col("notes", "Notes", 22, "wrap"),
    ]
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="9  Body Measurements",
        subtitle="The tape tells you what the scales cannot - thirteen "
                 "sites, ratios and an optional Navy estimate.",
        tab_color="#3E897D",
        rows=cfg.row_count("Body Measurements"),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text="Measure in the stamped unit or the workbook unit. The "
                  "summary on the right compares your first and latest "
                  "entry per site. Custom sites are yours to name in the "
                  "header (unprotect first).",
        columns=cols,
        samples=sample_data.measurement_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    """Per-site summary block: first vs latest, change and per cent."""
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    q = quote_sheet(NAME)
    dates = f"{q}!${spec_.letter('date')}${spec_.first_data_row}:" \
            f"${spec_.letter('date')}${spec_.last_data_row}"
    top = spec_.last_data_row + 3
    row = sheet.section(top, "PER-SITE SUMMARY - FIRST VS LATEST", 8)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Site", "First", "Latest", "Change",
                                    "Change %"],
                           widths=[16, 10, 10, 10, 10])
    first_date = f"MIN({dates})"
    last_date = f"MAX({dates})"
    for key, label in SITES:
        letter = col_letter(spec_.index(key))
        rng = f"{q}!${letter}${spec_.first_data_row}:" \
              f"${letter}${spec_.last_data_row}"
        first_v = f"IF(COUNT({rng})=0,\"\",INDEX({rng},MATCH({first_date}," \
                  f"{dates},0)))"
        last_v = f"IF(COUNT({rng})=0,\"\",INDEX({rng},MATCH({last_date}," \
                 f"{dates},0)))"
        sheet.write(row, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, 1, "=" + first_v, sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 2, "=" + last_v, sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 3, f'=IF(OR(B{row + 1}="",C{row + 1}=""),"", '
                              f'C{row + 1}-B{row + 1})',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 4, f'=IF(OR(B{row + 1}="",B{row + 1}=0,'
                              f'C{row + 1}=""),"",(C{row + 1}-B{row + 1})/'
                              f'B{row + 1})',
                      sheet.f.calc("percent"))
        row += 1
    sheet.note(row + 1, "Change is in the unit you typed. Percent change "
                        "is unit-free, which is why it is the number to "
                        "compare across sites.", 8, height=24)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=4, freeze_col=2,
                 print_area=f"$A$1:${col_letter(spec_.last_col_index)}$"
                            f"{spec_.last_data_row}")
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/planner.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/planner.py sha256:cad8d182962b7e19ee05ab0641779962cfa9a8e8ca1cfca967b0b0b40b7c0e25 -->
````python
"""4 Workout Planner - a 12-week programme block and a weekly template.

The programme start date drives every week row; completed sessions and
minutes are pulled from the log with COUNTIFS / SUMIFS over the hidden
week-start column, and the distinct-session count uses the
SUMPRODUCT(1/COUNTIFS(...)) idiom so no array formula is needed.
Works whether the buyer starts in January or on a random Tuesday.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter, number_check, yes_no
from . import common as C

NAME = "4 Workout Planner"
LOG = "5 Workout Log"

PHASE_DEFAULT = ["Base", "Base", "Base", "Deload", "Build", "Build",
                 "Build", "Deload", "Peak", "Peak", "Peak", "Deload"]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.primary_mid, landscape=False)
    last_col = 9
    sheet.banner("4  Workout Planner",
                 "Twelve weeks of intent, one repeating week of detail - "
                 "planned versus completed, always.", last_col)
    log = reg[LOG]
    ql = quote_sheet(LOG)
    wstart = f"{ql}!${log.letter('wstart')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
             f"${log.letter('wstart')}${log.last_data_row}"
    sid = f"{ql}!${log.letter('sid')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
          f"${log.letter('sid')}${log.last_data_row}"
    dur = f"{ql}!${log.letter('dur')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
          f"${log.letter('dur')}${log.last_data_row}"
    dow = f"{ql}!${log.letter('dow')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
          f"${log.letter('dow')}${log.last_data_row}"

    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "THE PROGRAMME", last_col)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Programme start date",
                      cfg.today - _td(days=77) if cfg.include_sample_data
                      else None, style="date", name="ProgrammeStart",
                      help_text="Any date works - January 1st or a random "
                                "Tuesday. Every week row follows it.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Training split", None, formula="=TrainingSplit",
                      help_text="Changed on 16 Settings & Lists.")
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Week", "Starts", "Phase", "Deload",
                                    "Sessions planned", "Sessions done",
                                    "Minutes planned", "Minutes done",
                                    "Status"],
                           widths=[7, 12, 12, 9, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12])
    first = row
    for i in range(cfg.programme_weeks):
        ws = f"ProgrammeStart+{7 * i}"
        sheet.formula(row, 0, f"={i + 1}", sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 1, "=" + ws, sheet.f.calc("date"))
        sheet.write(row, 2, PHASE_DEFAULT[i] if cfg.include_sample_data
                    else None, sheet.f.input("text"))
        sheet.write(row, 3, "Yes" if (cfg.include_sample_data and
                                      PHASE_DEFAULT[i] == "Deload")
                    else None, sheet.f.input("flag"))
        sheet.ws.data_validation(row, 3, row, 3, yes_no())
        sheet.write(row, 4, 3 if PHASE_DEFAULT[i] == "Deload"
                    else cfg.sessions_per_week, sheet.f.input("int"))
        sheet.ws.data_validation(row, 4, row, 4, number_check(0, 14, False))
        sheet.formula(row, 5,
                      f'=IF($B{row + 1}="","",SUMPRODUCT(({wstart}='
                      f'$B{row + 1})/((COUNTIFS({wstart},{wstart},{sid},'
                      f'{sid})+({sid}="")))))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.write(row, 6, 45 if PHASE_DEFAULT[i] == "Deload" else 60,
                    sheet.f.input("int"))
        sheet.ws.data_validation(row, 6, row, 6, number_check(0, 900, False))
        sheet.formula(row, 7,
                      f'=SUMIFS({dur},{wstart},$B{row + 1})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 8,
                      f'=IF($E{row + 1}="","",IF($F{row + 1}>=$E{row + 1},'
                      f'"planned met",IF($F{row + 1}=0,"not started",'
                      f'"part way")))',
                      sheet.f.calc("status"))
        row += 1
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(first, 8, row - 1, 8,
                                {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                                 "value": "planned met",
                                 "format": sheet.f.cf("good")})
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "THE REPEATING WEEK", last_col)
    row = sheet.note(row, "One template week. The completed minutes read "
                          "the current week from the log, by weekday, so "
                          "the plan and the truth sit side by side.",
                     last_col, height=24)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Day", "Focus", "Planned exercises",
                                    "Sets", "Target reps",
                                    "Minutes planned",
                                    "Minutes done this week"],
                           widths=[12, 14, 40, 8, 11, 12, 14])
    focus_default = ["Push", "Pull", "Legs", "Rest or walk", "Upper",
                     "Lower", "Walk or mobility"]
    for i in range(7):
        sheet.formula(row, 0,
                      f'=INDEX(ListWeekday,MOD(IF(WeekStart="Sunday",6,0)'
                      f'+{i},7)+1)',
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.write(row, 1, focus_default[i] if cfg.include_sample_data
                    else None, sheet.f.input("text"))
        sheet.write(row, 2, None, sheet.f.input("wrap"))
        sheet.write(row, 3, None, sheet.f.input("int"))
        sheet.write(row, 4, None, sheet.f.input("text"))
        sheet.write(row, 5, 0 if focus_default[i].startswith(("Rest",
                                                              "Walk"))
                    else 50, sheet.f.input("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 6,
                      f'=SUMIFS({dur},{dow},{i + 1},{wstart},'
                      f'{C.week_start_of("TODAY()")})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        row += 1
    row += 1
    row = sheet.note(row, "Rest days are planned days. A walk in the "
                          "template is part of the programme, not a "
                          "failure to train.", last_col, height=24)
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last_col, row + 1)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=3, gridlines=False)
    return sheet


def _td(days: int):
    import datetime as _dt
    return _dt.timedelta(days=days)
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/profile.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/profile.py sha256:5f903136b629cdb8e6a8e213008b1b3307f6de320d5b8a28f37d59fb89f8b70d -->
````python
"""2 Profile & Goals - who is training, and six independent goals.

BMI, BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor) and TDEE are shipped as estimates the buyer
can overwrite - the workbook never tells anyone what to eat.  Each of
the six goals carries its own target, deadline and progress maths; a
weight goal reads the latest weigh-in by itself.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import col_letter, quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter, date_check, list_from, number_check
from . import common as C

NAME = "2 Profile & Goals"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.primary, landscape=False)
    last_col = 9
    sheet.banner("2  Profile & Goals",
                 "Your numbers, your targets - every estimate on this "
                 "page can be typed over.", last_col)
    q = quote_sheet(NAME)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "PROFILE", last_col)

    rows = {}

    def field(label, key, value=None, **kw):
        nonlocal row
        rows[key] = row          # 0 based row of the value cell
        row = sheet.field(row, label, value, **kw)

    field("Name", "name", "Maya" if cfg.include_sample_data else None,
          value_end=5, help_text="Optional. The print headers use it.")
    field("Sex", "sex", cfg.sex, validate=list_from("ListSex"),
          name="Sex",
          help_text="Used only by the BMR constant and the optional "
                    "Navy body-fat formula.")
    field("Age", "age", cfg.age_years if cfg.include_sample_data else None,
          style="int", name="AgeYears",
          validate=number_check(10, 100, False))
    field(f"Height ({cfg.length_unit})", "height",
          _len(cfg, cfg.height_cm) if cfg.include_sample_data else None,
          style="number1", validate=number_check(80, 250))
    field("Height unit stamp", "height_stamp",
          "cm" if cfg.metric else "in",
          validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["cm", "in"],
                    "ignore_blank": True},
          help_text="Stamp the unit you typed; switching the workbook "
                    "unit never misreads it.")
    field("Starting weight", "start_w",
          _wt(cfg, cfg.start_weight_kg) if cfg.include_sample_data
          else None, style="number1", validate=number_check(20, 400))
    field("Starting weight stamp", "start_stamp",
          "kg" if cfg.metric else "lb",
          validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["kg", "lb"],
                    "ignore_blank": True})
    field("Goal weight", "goal_w",
          _wt(cfg, cfg.goal_weight_kg) if cfg.include_sample_data
          else None, style="number1", validate=number_check(20, 400))
    field("Goal weight stamp", "goal_stamp",
          "kg" if cfg.metric else "lb",
          validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["kg", "lb"],
                    "ignore_blank": True})
    field("Target date", "goal_date",
          _plus_months(cfg.today, 4) if cfg.include_sample_data else None,
          style="date", name="GoalDate", validate=date_check())
    field("Activity level", "activity", cfg.activity_level,
          validate=list_from("ListActivityLevel"), name="ActivityLevel")
    row += 1

    book.define_name("HeightCm", "=" + C.cm_from(
        f"{q}!$D${rows['height'] + 1}", f"{q}!$D${rows['height_stamp'] + 1}"))
    book.define_name("StartKg", "=" + C.kg_from(
        f"{q}!$D${rows['start_w'] + 1}",
        f"{q}!$D${rows['start_stamp'] + 1}"))
    book.define_name("GoalKg", "=" + C.kg_from(
        f"{q}!$D${rows['goal_w'] + 1}",
        f"{q}!$D${rows['goal_stamp'] + 1}"))

    row = sheet.section(row, "ESTIMATES (YOURS TO OVERWRITE)", last_col)
    row = sheet.field(row, "BMI",
                      formula='IF(OR(HeightCm=0,StartKg="",StartKg=0),"",'
                              'StartKg/(HeightCm/100)^2)',
                      style="number1",
                      help_text="A population statistic, not a verdict "
                                "on an individual.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor)",
                      formula='IF(OR(HeightCm=0,AgeYears="",StartKg=""),'
                              '"",10*StartKg+6.25*HeightCm-5*AgeYears+IF('
                              'Sex="Male",5,IF(Sex="Female",-161,-78)))',
                      style="int", name="BMR",
                      help_text="Calories at complete rest. An estimate.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "TDEE (BMR x activity)",
                      formula='IF(BMR="","",BMR*INDEX(MultTable,MATCH('
                              'ActivityLevel,ListActivityLevel,0),2))',
                      style="int", name="TDEE",
                      help_text="The maintenance estimate paid apps "
                                "show. Type your own number over the "
                                "targets on Settings any time.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Target vs TDEE",
                      formula='IF(OR(TDEE="",CalTarget=""),"","Your '
                              'calorie target sits "&TEXT(ABS(TDEE-'
                              'CalTarget),"0")&" kcal "&IF(TDEE>CalTarget,'
                              '"below","above")&" the estimate - a "&'
                              'TEXT(IF(TDEE=0,0,ABS(TDEE-CalTarget)/TDEE),'
                              '"0%")&" "&IF(TDEE>CalTarget,"deficit",'
                              '"surplus")&", your call to make.")',
                      style="text", help_text="Arithmetic, not advice.")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "SIX GOALS, EACH WITH ITS OWN TARGET",
                        last_col)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Type", "What it means", "Start",
                                    "Target", "Deadline", "Current",
                                    "Auto / current", "Progress", "To go",
                                    "Status"],
                           widths=[13, 28, 9, 9, 12, 10, 11, 10, 9, 12])
    goals = _sample_goals(cfg) if cfg.include_sample_data else [{}] * 6
    first_goal = row
    for i in range(6):
        goal = goals[i] if i < len(goals) else {}
        sheet.write(row, 0, goal.get("type"), sheet.f.input("text"))
        sheet.ws.data_validation(row, 0, row, 0, list_from("ListGoalType"))
        sheet.write(row, 1, goal.get("desc"), sheet.f.input("wrap"))
        sheet.write(row, 2, goal.get("start"), sheet.f.input("number1"))
        sheet.write(row, 3, goal.get("target"), sheet.f.input("number1"))
        sheet.write(row, 4, goal.get("deadline"), sheet.f.input("date"))
        sheet.write(row, 5, goal.get("current"), sheet.f.input("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 6,
                      f'=IF($A{row + 1}="","",IF($A{row + 1}="Weight",'
                      f'{_latest_weight()},IF($F{row + 1}="","",'
                      f'$F{row + 1})))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 7,
                      f'=IF(OR($G{row + 1}="",$C{row + 1}="",$D{row + 1}='
                      f'"",$D{row + 1}=$C{row + 1}),"",($G{row + 1}-'
                      f'$C{row + 1})/($D{row + 1}-$C{row + 1}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("percent0"))
        sheet.formula(row, 8,
                      f'=IF(OR($G{row + 1}="",$D{row + 1}=""),"",'
                      f'$D{row + 1}-$G{row + 1})',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 9,
                      f'=IF($H{row + 1}="","",IF($H{row + 1}>=1,'
                      f'"achieved",IF($E{row + 1}="","in progress",IF('
                      f'TODAY()>$E{row + 1},"past due","in progress"))))',
                      sheet.f.calc("status"))
        row += 1
    for gname, gcol in [("GoalTypes", 0), ("GoalDescs", 1),
                        ("GoalProgress", 7), ("GoalToGo", 8),
                        ("GoalStatus", 9)]:
        letter = col_letter(gcol)
        book.define_name(gname, f"={q}!${letter}${first_goal + 1}:"
                                f"${letter}${first_goal + 6}")
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(first_goal, 9, row - 1, 9,
                                {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                                 "value": "achieved",
                                 "format": sheet.f.cf("bold_good")})
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(first_goal, 9, row - 1, 9,
                                {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                                 "value": "past due",
                                 "format": sheet.f.cf("warn")})
    row += 1
    row = sheet.note(row, "A weight goal reads your latest weigh-in by "
                          "itself; every other goal takes the current "
                          "value from the cream cell so you decide what "
                          "counts.", last_col, height=26)
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last_col, row + 1)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=3, gridlines=False)
    return sheet


def _len(cfg: Config, cm: float) -> float:
    return round(cm if cfg.metric else cm / 2.54, 1)


def _wt(cfg: Config, kg: float) -> float:
    return round(kg if cfg.metric else kg / 0.45359237, 1)


def _plus_months(day, months: int):
    month = day.month - 1 + months
    year = day.year + month // 12
    month = month % 12 + 1
    return day.replace(year=year, month=month, day=min(day.day, 28))


def _latest_weight() -> str:
    return ('IFERROR(INDEX([[8 Weight Tracker.ma7_disp]],MATCH(MAX('
            '[[8 Weight Tracker.date]]),[[8 Weight Tracker.date]],0)),"")')


def _sample_goals(cfg):
    t = cfg.today
    return [
        {"type": "Weight", "desc": "Reach the goal weight on the scale",
         "start": _wt(cfg, cfg.start_weight_kg),
         "target": _wt(cfg, cfg.goal_weight_kg),
         "deadline": _plus_months(t, 4), "current": None},
        {"type": "Strength", "desc": "Squat five reps at bodyweight",
         "start": 40.0, "target": _wt(cfg, cfg.start_weight_kg),
         "deadline": _plus_months(t, 6), "current": 55.0},
        {"type": "Consistency", "desc": "Sessions a week, 4-week average",
         "start": 1.0, "target": 4.0, "deadline": _plus_months(t, 3),
         "current": 3.0},
        {"type": "Distance", "desc": "Run 10 km without stopping",
         "start": 5.0, "target": 10.0, "deadline": _plus_months(t, 5),
         "current": 7.0},
        {"type": "Habit", "desc": "Protein at every meal, weekly rate",
         "start": 0.4, "target": 0.9, "deadline": _plus_months(t, 2),
         "current": 0.7},
        {"type": "Custom", "desc": "Morning mobility, minutes a week",
         "start": 0.0, "target": 60.0, "deadline": _plus_months(t, 2),
         "current": 25.0},
    ]
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/records.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/records.py sha256:38ffb40c8d06637ab56210fe23cb33c30b9b4098a5f888b01204cd357d091469 -->
````python
"""13 Records & Milestones - automatic PRs, cardio records, plate maths.

The register on the left is the non-scale-victories log (input).  The
block on the right mirrors the exercise library and pulls each
movement's heaviest lift, best estimated 1RM, the date it happened and
the PR count straight out of the log with SUMPRODUCT(MAX(...)) and
COUNTIFS - no array formulas, no macros.  Below it: the plate
calculator lifters screenshot, cardio records and consistency marks.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import BAR_KG, BAR_LB, PLATES_KG, PLATES_LB, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec, col_letter, quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter, date_check, list_from
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "13 Records & Milestones"
LIB = "6 Exercise Library"
LOG = "5 Workout Log"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="13  Records & Milestones",
        subtitle="Personal records detect themselves; the wins that never "
                 "show on a scale get written down here.",
        tab_color="#E4572E",
        rows=cfg.row_count("Non-Scale Victories"),
        freeze_cols=2,
        help_text="Left: your non-scale victories - clothes, energy, "
                  "lifts, sleep, mood - with a reward note. Right: the "
                  "automatic record book and the plate calculator.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
                formula='="N-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
            Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("category", "Category", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListNSV")),
            Col("victory", "The win", 40, "wrap",
                note="The trouser size, the stairwell, the rep that "
                     "moved, the night you slept."),
            Col("reward", "Reward note", 26, "wrap",
                note="What you promised yourself for getting here."),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.nsv_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    lib = reg[LIB]
    log = reg[LOG]
    ql = quote_sheet(LOG)
    qe = quote_sheet(LIB)

    ex = f"{ql}!${log.letter('exercise')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
         f"${log.letter('exercise')}${log.last_data_row}"
    kg = f"{ql}!${log.letter('kg')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
         f"${log.letter('kg')}${log.last_data_row}"
    e1 = f"{ql}!${log.letter('e1rm')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
         f"${log.letter('e1rm')}${log.last_data_row}"
    vol = f"{ql}!${log.letter('vol')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
          f"${log.letter('vol')}${log.last_data_row}"
    dt = f"{ql}!${log.letter('date')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
         f"${log.letter('date')}${log.last_data_row}"
    pr = f"{ql}!${log.letter('pr')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
         f"${log.letter('pr')}${log.last_data_row}"
    rownum = f"ROW({ql}!${log.letter('exercise')}${log.first_data_row}:" \
             f"${log.letter('exercise')}${log.last_data_row})"

    col0 = 7  # H
    top = 3
    sheet.merge(top, col0, col0 + 5,
                "AUTOMATIC RECORD BOOK - reads the workout log",
                sheet.f.chrome("section"))
    heads = ["Exercise", "Heaviest", "Best e1RM", "Date of best",
             "Best set volume", "PRs"]
    for i, text in enumerate(heads):
        sheet.write(top + 1, col0 + i, text, sheet.f.chrome("header"))
    for i, width in enumerate([28, 10, 11, 13, 13, 7]):
        sheet.set_col(col0 + i, col0 + i, width)
    row = top + 2
    n_lib = lib.rows
    for offset in range(n_lib):
        lib_row = lib.first_data_row + offset
        name_ref = f"{qe}!${lib.letter('name')}${lib_row}"
        cond = f"({ex}=$H{row + 1})"
        best_e1 = f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX({cond}*{e1}))"
        best_kg = f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX({cond}*{kg}))"
        best_vol = f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX({cond}*{vol}))"
        best_row = f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX({cond}*({e1}={best_e1})*{rownum}))"
        sheet.formula(row, col0, f'=IF({name_ref}="","",{name_ref})',
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 1,
                      f'=IF($H{row + 1}="","",IF({best_kg}=0,"",IF('
                      f'Units="Imperial",{best_kg}/KgPerLb,{best_kg})))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 2,
                      f'=IF($H{row + 1}="","",IF({best_e1}=0,"",IF('
                      f'Units="Imperial",{best_e1}/KgPerLb,{best_e1})))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 3,
                      f'=IF(OR($H{row + 1}="",{best_e1}=0),"",INDEX({dt},'
                      f'{best_row}-{log.first_data_row}+1))',
                      sheet.f.calc("date"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 4,
                      f'=IF(OR($H{row + 1}="",{best_vol}=0),"",IF('
                      f'Units="Imperial",{best_vol}/KgPerLb,{best_vol}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 5,
                      f'=IF($H{row + 1}="","",COUNTIFS({ex},$H{row + 1},'
                      f'{pr},"PR"))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        row += 1

    # ---- plate calculator -------------------------------------------------
    row += 2
    row = sheet.section(row, "PLATE CALCULATOR", col0 + 5, first_col=col0)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Bar load (your unit)", 100.0, style="number1",
                      label_col=col0, value_col=col0 + 1,
                      help_text="Total bar weight including the bar. The "
                                "calculator splits it per side.")
    target = f"${col_letter(col0 + 1)}${row}"
    row = sheet.field(row, "Bar alone",
                      formula='IF(Units="Imperial",%s,%s)'
                              % (BAR_LB, BAR_KG),
                      style="number1", label_col=col0,
                      value_col=col0 + 1,
                      help_text="20 kg / 45 lb, edit if your bar differs.")
    bar = f"${col_letter(col0 + 1)}${row}"
    row += 1
    # per-side remainder chain over the plate denominations
    row = sheet.table_head(row, col0,
                           ["Plate", "Per side", "Running remainder"],
                           widths=None)
    rem = f"MAX(0,({target}-{bar})/2)"
    plate_rows = []
    for plate in (PLATES_LB if not cfg.metric else PLATES_KG):
        sheet.write(row, col0, plate, sheet.f.input("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 1,
                      f'=IF({target}="","",INT(({rem})/{plate}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 2,
                      f'=IF({target}="","",({rem})-INT(({rem})/{plate})*'
                      f'{plate})',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        plate_rows.append((plate, row))
        rem = f"${col_letter(col0 + 2)}${row + 1}"
        row += 1
    sheet.merge(row, col0, col0 + 5,
                "Load per side:", sheet.f.chrome("label_bold"))
    row += 1
    sheet.merge(row, col0, col0 + 5,
                "=" + " & ".join(
                    [f'IF(${col_letter(col0 + 1)}${r}=0,"",IF('
                     f'${col_letter(col0 + 1)}${r}=0,""," ")&TEXT('
                     f'${col_letter(col0 + 1)}${r},"0")&" x "&TEXT('
                     f'{p},"0.##")&"  ")' for p, r in plate_rows]),
                sheet.f.chrome("label"))
    row += 2

    # ---- cardio records and consistency -----------------------------------
    ca = reg["7 Cardio & Activity"]
    qc = quote_sheet(ca.name)
    c_km = f"{qc}!${ca.letter('km')}${ca.first_data_row}:" \
           f"${ca.letter('km')}${ca.last_data_row}"
    c_pace = f"{qc}!${ca.letter('pace')}${ca.first_data_row}:" \
             f"${ca.letter('pace')}${ca.last_data_row}"
    c_dur = f"{qc}!${ca.letter('dur')}${ca.first_data_row}:" \
            f"${ca.letter('dur')}${ca.last_data_row}"
    row = sheet.section(row, "CARDIO RECORDS & CONSISTENCY", col0 + 5,
                        first_col=col0)
    lines = [
        ("Longest distance",
         f'=IF(SUMPRODUCT(MAX({c_km}))=0,"",IF(Units="Imperial",'
         f'SUMPRODUCT(MAX({c_km}))/KmPerMi,SUMPRODUCT(MAX({c_km}))))',
         "number1"),
        ("Fastest pace (min/km)",
         f'=IF(SUMPRODUCT(MAX(({c_pace}>0)*{c_pace}))=0,"",'
         f'SUMPRODUCT(MIN(({c_pace}>0)*{c_pace}+(1-({c_pace}>0))*9999)))',
         "number1"),
        ("Longest single session (min)",
         f'=IF(SUMPRODUCT(MAX({c_dur}))=0,"",SUMPRODUCT(MAX({c_dur})))',
         "number1"),
        ("Sessions in the last 30 days",
         f'=COUNTIFS({dt},">="&TODAY()-29,{dt},"<="&TODAY())', "int"),
        ("Training minutes, last 7 days",
         f'=SUMIFS({ql}!${log.letter("dur")}${log.first_data_row}:'
         f'${log.letter("dur")}${log.last_data_row},{dt},">="&TODAY()-6,'
         f'{dt},"<="&TODAY())', "int"),
        ("Weeks with at least one logged session",
         f'=SUMPRODUCT(({ql}!${log.letter("wstart")}${log.first_data_row}:'
         f'${log.letter("wstart")}${log.last_data_row}<>"")/COUNTIFS('
         f'{ql}!${log.letter("wstart")}${log.first_data_row}:'
         f'${log.letter("wstart")}${log.last_data_row},'
         f'{ql}!${log.letter("wstart")}${log.first_data_row}:'
         f'${log.letter("wstart")}${log.last_data_row}))',
         "int"),
    ]
    for label, formula, style in lines:
        sheet.merge(row, col0, col0 + 3, label,
                    sheet.f.chrome("label_bold"))
        sheet.formula(row, col0 + 4, formula, sheet.f.calc(style))
        row += 1
    sheet.note(row + 1, "Records recalculate the moment a better row "
                        "exists in the log. Nothing on this tab is typed "
                        "except the victories and the bar load.",
               col0 + 5, first_col=col0, height=26)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=4, freeze_col=2,
                 print_area=f"$A$1:${col_letter(col0 + 5)}$"
                            f"{spec_.last_data_row}")
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/reports.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/reports.py sha256:f987a1900d21a9090bd15428412bcc6c71df5036aef84ddfaa065b2bfcc71618 -->
````python
"""15 Reports & Charts - the printable year.

A month-by-month table plus five native charts: weight and its 7-day
line, sessions per month, minutes by activity type, habit consistency
and the performance of any one exercise picked from a drop down.  The
exercise series lives in a hidden helper column so the chart needs no
array formula.  Print area is one landscape page wide.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from
from . import common as C

NAME = "15 Reports & Charts"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.accent)
    last_col = 12
    sheet.banner("15  Reports & Charts",
                 "The year on pages you can print - weight, volume, "
                 "minutes, habits and one exercise of your choice.",
                 last_col)
    log = reg["5 Workout Log"]
    wt = reg["8 Weight Tracker"]
    ca = reg["7 Cardio & Activity"]
    meals = reg["11 Meals & Macros"]
    ql, qw, qc, qm = (quote_sheet(x.name) for x in (log, wt, ca, meals))

    def lr(spec, key):
        return (f"{quote_sheet(spec.name)}!${spec.letter(key)}"
                f"${spec.first_data_row}:${spec.letter(key)}"
                f"${spec.last_data_row}")

    d_log, w_log, dur_log = (lr(log, k) for k in ("date", "wstart", "dur"))
    d_w, kg_w, ma7_w, disp_w = (lr(wt, k) for k in
                                ("date", "kg", "ma7", "ma7_disp"))
    c_type, c_dur, c_km = (lr(ca, k) for k in ("type", "dur", "km"))
    d_m, cal_m, p_m = (lr(meals, k) for k in ("date", "cal_used", "p_used"))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ month table
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "MONTH BY MONTH", last_col)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Month", "Sessions", "Minutes",
                                    "Distance", "kcal / day",
                                    "Protein g / day", "Weight (7-day)"],
                           widths=[13, 10, 10, 10, 11, 13, 13])
    first_month = row
    for i in range(12):
        ms = (f'EDATE(DATE(YEAR(ProgrammeStart),MONTH(ProgrammeStart),1),'
              f'{i})')
        me = (f'EDATE(DATE(YEAR(ProgrammeStart),MONTH(ProgrammeStart),1),'
              f'{i + 1})-1')
        sheet.formula(row, 0, f'=IF({ms}>TODAY()+365,"",TEXT({ms},'
                              f'"mmm yyyy"))', sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, 1,
                      f'=IF($A{row + 1}="","",SUMPRODUCT(({d_log}>={ms})*'
                      f'({d_log}<={me})/((COUNTIFS({d_log},{d_log})+('
                      f'{d_log}="")))))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 2,
                      f'=IF($A{row + 1}="","",SUMIFS({dur_log},{d_log},'
                      f'">="&{ms},{d_log},"<="&{me}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 3,
                      f'=IF($A{row + 1}="","",IF(SUMIFS({c_km},{lr(ca, "date")},'
                      f'">="&{ms},{lr(ca, "date")},"<="&{me})=0,"",IF('
                      f'Units="Imperial",SUMIFS({c_km},{lr(ca, "date")},'
                      f'">="&{ms},{lr(ca, "date")},"<="&{me})/KmPerMi,'
                      f'SUMIFS({c_km},{lr(ca, "date")},">="&{ms},'
                      f'{lr(ca, "date")},"<="&{me}))))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 4,
                      f'=IF($A{row + 1}="","",IF(SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},'
                      f'">="&{ms},{d_m},"<="&{me})=0,"",SUMIFS({cal_m},'
                      f'{d_m},">="&{ms},{d_m},"<="&{me})/30))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 5,
                      f'=IF($A{row + 1}="","",IF(SUMIFS({p_m},{d_m},">="&'
                      f'{ms},{d_m},"<="&{me})=0,"",SUMIFS({p_m},{d_m},'
                      f'">="&{ms},{d_m},"<="&{me})/30))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 6,
                      f'=IF($A{row + 1}="","",IFERROR(INDEX({ma7_w},'
                      f'MATCH({me},{d_w},1)),""))',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        row += 1
    last_month = row - 1
    row += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------- minutes by type block
    row = sheet.section(row, "MINUTES BY ACTIVITY TYPE", 4)
    type_first = row
    from ..config import ACTIVITY_TYPES
    for label, _met in ACTIVITY_TYPES:
        sheet.write(row, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(row, 1, f'=SUMIFS({c_dur},{c_type},$A{row + 1})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        row += 1
    type_last = row - 1
    row += 1

    # ------------------------------------------- exercise performance picker
    row = sheet.section(row, "ONE EXERCISE OVER TIME", last_col)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Pick an exercise", None, label_col=0,
                      value_col=2, validate=list_from("ExerciseNames"),
                      help_text="The hidden column to the right builds "
                                "the series; the chart below follows it.")
    pick = f"$C${row}"
    helper_col = last_col + 2
    sheet.set_col(helper_col, helper_col, 9, hidden=True)
    sheet.write(3, helper_col, "series", sheet.f.chrome("header"))
    for offset in range(log.rows):
        lr_ = log.first_data_row + offset
        sheet.formula(4 + offset, helper_col,
                      f'=IF({ql}!${log.letter("exercise")}${lr_}={pick},'
                      f'{ql}!${log.letter("e1rm_disp")}${lr_},"")',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
    row += 1
    row = sheet.note(row, "Estimated 1RM per logged row of that "
                          "exercise, blanks between - the chart connects "
                          "the dots.", last_col, height=24)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- charts
    ch = book.add_chart({"type": "line"})
    ch.add_series({
        "name": "7-day average weight",
        "categories": [qw, wt.first_data_row - 1, wt.letter_index("date"),
                       wt.last_data_row - 1, wt.letter_index("date")]
        if hasattr(wt, "letter_index") else
        f"{qw}!${wt.letter('date')}${wt.first_data_row}:"
        f"${wt.letter('date')}${wt.last_data_row}",
        "values": f"{qw}!${wt.letter('ma7_disp')}${wt.first_data_row}:"
                  f"${wt.letter('ma7_disp')}${wt.last_data_row}",
        "line": {"color": "#14655A", "width": 2},
    })
    ch.set_title({"name": "Weight - 7-day average"})
    ch.set_size({"width": 620, "height": 300})
    sheet.ws.insert_chart("H5", ch)

    ch2 = book.add_chart({"type": "column"})
    ch2.add_series({
        "name": "Sessions",
        "categories": f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$A${first_month}:"
                      f"$A${last_month}",
        "values": f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B${first_month}:"
                  f"$B${last_month}",
    })
    ch2.set_title({"name": "Sessions per month"})
    ch2.set_size({"width": 620, "height": 300})
    sheet.ws.insert_chart("H22", ch2)

    ch3 = book.add_chart({"type": "bar"})
    ch3.add_series({
        "name": "Minutes",
        "categories": f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$A${type_first}:"
                      f"$A${type_last}",
        "values": f"={quote_sheet(NAME)}!$B${type_first}:"
                  f"$B${type_last}",
    })
    ch3.set_title({"name": "Minutes by activity type"})
    ch3.set_size({"width": 620, "height": 300})
    sheet.ws.insert_chart("H39", ch3)

    ch4 = book.add_chart({"type": "line"})
    ch4.add_series({
        "name": "Estimated 1RM",
        "categories": f"{ql}!${log.letter('date')}${log.first_data_row}:"
                      f"${log.letter('date')}${log.last_data_row}",
        "values": f"{quote_sheet(NAME)}!$"
                  f"{_letter(helper_col)}${log.first_data_row}:"
                  f"${_letter(helper_col)}${log.last_data_row}",
        "line": {"color": "#E4572E", "width": 2},
    })
    ch4.set_title({"name": "Chosen exercise - estimated 1RM"})
    ch4.set_size({"width": 620, "height": 300})
    sheet.ws.insert_chart("H56", ch4)

    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last_col, row + 2)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=4, freeze_col=1,
                 print_area=f"$A$1:$G${last_month + 3}")
    return sheet


def _letter(index: int) -> str:
    from ..layout import col_letter
    return col_letter(index)
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/review.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/review.py sha256:353930a9a9d53978028335659e7cecb5b2a9cda0d266bcbe506fdaa7d7956520 -->
````python
"""14 Weekly & Monthly Review - adherence first, reflections after.

Twelve weekly blocks and twelve monthly ones.  The numbers (sessions,
minutes, calories against target, weight change) are pulled in
automatically with SUMIFS / COUNTIFS / INDEX-MATCH; the wins, barriers,
lessons and next three goals are the buyer's own words.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import quote_sheet
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "14 Weekly & Monthly Review"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.primary_mid, landscape=False)
    last_col = 7
    sheet.banner("14  Weekly & Monthly Review",
                 "The numbers arrive first, then your words - twelve "
                 "weeks and twelve months of them.", last_col)
    log = reg["5 Workout Log"]
    wt = reg["8 Weight Tracker"]
    meals = reg["11 Meals & Macros"]
    ql, qw, qm = (quote_sheet(x.name) for x in (log, wt, meals))
    d_log, w_log, dur_log, s_log = (
        f"{ql}!${log.letter(k)}${log.first_data_row}:"
        f"${log.letter(k)}${log.last_data_row}"
        for k in ("date", "wstart", "dur", "sid"))
    d_w, ma7_w = (f"{qw}!${wt.letter(k)}${wt.first_data_row}:"
                  f"${wt.letter(k)}${wt.last_data_row}"
                  for k in ("date", "ma7"))
    d_m, cal_m = (f"{qm}!${meals.letter(k)}${meals.first_data_row}:"
                  f"${meals.letter(k)}${meals.last_data_row}"
                  for k in ("date", "cal_used"))

    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "TWELVE WEEKLY REVIEWS", last_col)
    for i in range(12):
        ws = f"ProgrammeStart+{7 * i}"
        we = f"{ws}+6"
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last_col,
                    f"WEEK {i + 1}", sheet.f.chrome("subsection"))
        row += 1
        rows = [
            ("Week", "=" + ws, "date"),
            ("Sessions logged",
             f'=SUMPRODUCT(({w_log}>={ws})*({w_log}<={we})/((COUNTIFS('
             f'{w_log},{w_log},{s_log},{s_log})+({s_log}=""))))', "number1"),
            ("Training minutes",
             f'=SUMIFS({dur_log},{w_log},">="&{ws},{w_log},"<="&{we})',
             "int"),
            ("Calories a day (logged)",
             f'=IF(SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&{ws},{d_m},"<="&{we})=0,"",'
             f'SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&{ws},{d_m},"<="&{we})/7)', "int"),
            ("Weight change, 7-day line",
             f'=IF(IFERROR(INDEX({ma7_w},MATCH({we},{d_w},1)),"")="","",'
             f'IF(IFERROR(INDEX({ma7_w},MATCH({ws},{d_w},1)),"")="","",'
             f'INDEX({ma7_w},MATCH({we},{d_w},1))-INDEX({ma7_w},MATCH('
             f'{ws},{d_w},1))))', "number1"),
        ]
        for label, formula, style in rows:
            sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, label, sheet.f.chrome("label"))
            sheet.formula(row, 2, formula, sheet.f.calc(style))
            row += 1
        for label in ("Wins", "Barriers", "Lessons",
                      "Next week's three goals"):
            sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, label, sheet.f.chrome("label"))
            sheet.merge(row, 2, last_col, None, sheet.f.input("wrap"))
            row += 1
        row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "TWELVE MONTHLY REVIEWS", last_col)
    for i in range(12):
        ms = f'EDATE(DATE(YEAR(ProgrammeStart),MONTH(ProgrammeStart),1),' \
             f'{i})'
        me = f'EDATE(DATE(YEAR(ProgrammeStart),MONTH(ProgrammeStart),1),' \
             f'{i + 1})-1'
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last_col, f"MONTH {i + 1}",
                    sheet.f.chrome("subsection"))
        row += 1
        rows = [
            ("Month", "=" + ms, "date"),
            ("Sessions logged",
             f'=SUMPRODUCT(({d_log}>={ms})*({d_log}<={me})/((COUNTIFS('
             f'{d_log},{d_log})+({d_log}=""))))', "number1"),
            ("Training minutes",
             f'=SUMIFS({dur_log},{d_log},">="&{ms},{d_log},"<="&{me})',
             "int"),
            ("Calories a day (logged)",
             f'=IF(SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&{ms},{d_m},"<="&{me})=0,"",'
             f'SUMIFS({cal_m},{d_m},">="&{ms},{d_m},"<="&{me})/30)', "int"),
        ]
        for label, formula, style in rows:
            sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, label, sheet.f.chrome("label"))
            sheet.formula(row, 2, formula, sheet.f.calc(style))
            row += 1
        for label in ("Wins", "Barriers", "Lessons",
                      "Next month's three goals"):
            sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, label, sheet.f.chrome("label"))
            sheet.merge(row, 2, last_col, None, sheet.f.input("wrap"))
            row += 1
        row += 1
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last_col, row)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=3, gridlines=False)
    return sheet
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/settings_lists.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/settings_lists.py sha256:0f3545300649721ee8cce33d44b035ba9da0f973797e9dc15cdc97c629673677 -->
````python
"""16 Settings & Lists - every drop down, target and conversion factor.

This tab owns the workbook level defined names (Units, KgPerLb, the
list ranges, the MET table) so it is the reference point for every
other tab.  All list blocks are plain input cells: the buyer edits a
list here and every drop down follows.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import (ACTIVITY_LEVELS, ACTIVITY_TYPES, DIFFICULTY,
                      EQUIPMENT, GOAL_TYPES, HABIT_DEFAULTS, MEAL_TYPES,
                      MOVEMENT_PATTERNS, MUSCLE_GROUPS, NSV_CATEGORIES,
                      Palette, SEX_OPTIONS, TRAINING_SPLITS, WEEKDAYS,
                      Config)
from ..writer import SheetWriter, list_from

NAME = "16 Settings & Lists"

#: block column layout: label A, values B, help D..
_LIST_DEFS = [
    ("ListMuscle", "Muscle groups", MUSCLE_GROUPS),
    ("ListEquipment", "Equipment", EQUIPMENT),
    ("ListPattern", "Movement patterns", MOVEMENT_PATTERNS),
    ("ListDifficulty", "Difficulty", DIFFICULTY),
    ("ListSplit", "Training splits", TRAINING_SPLITS),
    ("ListMeal", "Meal types", MEAL_TYPES),
    ("ListGoalType", "Goal types", GOAL_TYPES),
    ("ListSex", "Sex (for BMR and Navy body fat)", SEX_OPTIONS),
    ("ListNSV", "Non-scale victory categories", NSV_CATEGORIES),
    ("ListWeekday", "Weekday names, Monday first", WEEKDAYS),
]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.primary, landscape=False)
    last_col = 9
    sheet.banner("16  Settings & Lists",
                 "Every drop down, target, conversion and habit name in "
                 "one place - edit here, the whole workbook follows.",
                 last_col)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "UNITS, CALENDAR AND CONVERSIONS", last_col)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Unit system", cfg.measure_system,
                      validate={"validate": "list",
                                "source": ["Metric", "Imperial"]},
                      name="Units",
                      help_text="Switches every display, chart and target. "
                                "Rows keep their own unit stamp, so nothing "
                                "you logged is misread.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Week starts on", cfg.week_start,
                      validate={"validate": "list",
                                "source": ["Monday", "Sunday"]},
                      name="WeekStart",
                      help_text="Drives the planner, the weekly summaries "
                                "and the habit grid.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "One glass of water (ml)", cfg.glass_ml,
                      style="int", name="GlassML",
                      help_text="The water tab counts glasses in ml.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Milestone step",
                      formula='IF(Units="Imperial",5,2)', style="number1",
                      name="MilestoneStep",
                      help_text="A milestone is flagged every 5 lb or 2 kg "
                                "of change from your starting weight.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Kg per lb", 0.45359237, style="number",
                      name="KgPerLb", help_text="Conversion factor.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Cm per inch", 2.54, style="number",
                      name="CmPerIn", help_text="Conversion factor.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Km per mile", 1.609344, style="number",
                      name="KmPerMi", help_text="Conversion factor.")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "NUTRITION TARGETS (YOURS TO SET)", last_col)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Daily calories", cfg.calorie_target,
                      style="int", name="CalTarget",
                      help_text="An estimate is on Profile & Goals (TDEE); "
                                "type over it with your own number.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Daily protein (g)", cfg.protein_target,
                      style="int", name="ProteinTarget")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Daily carbohydrate (g)", cfg.carb_target,
                      style="int", name="CarbTarget")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Daily fat (g)", cfg.fat_target,
                      style="int", name="FatTarget")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Daily fibre (g)", cfg.fibre_target,
                      style="int", name="FibreTarget")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Daily water (ml)", cfg.water_target_ml,
                      style="int", name="WaterTarget")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "TRAINING TARGETS", last_col)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Sessions a week", cfg.sessions_per_week,
                      style="int", name="SessionsPerWeek")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Weekly minutes target",
                      cfg.weekly_minutes_target, style="int",
                      name="MinutesTarget")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Training split", cfg.training_split,
                      validate=list_from("ListSplit"), name="TrainingSplit")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "ACTIVITY MULTIPLIERS (TDEE)", last_col)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 1, ["Activity level", "Multiplier"],
                           widths=[44, 12])
    mult_first = row + 1
    for label, mult in ACTIVITY_LEVELS:
        sheet.write(row, 1, label, sheet.f.input("text"))
        sheet.write(row, 2, mult, sheet.f.input("number"))
        row += 1
    book.define_name("ListActivityLevel",
                     f"={_q(sheet)}!$B${mult_first}:$B${row - 1}")
    book.define_name("MultTable",
                     f"={_q(sheet)}!$B${mult_first}:$C${row - 1}")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "MET VALUES (OPTIONAL CALORIE ESTIMATE)",
                        last_col)
    row = sheet.note(row, "MET x 3.5 x bodyweight in kg / 200 = kcal a "
                          "minute. Edit any row; the cardio tab reads this "
                          "table. It is an estimate, never a measurement.",
                     last_col, height=26)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 1, ["Activity type", "MET"],
                           widths=[44, 12])
    met_first = row + 1
    for label, met in ACTIVITY_TYPES:
        sheet.write(row, 1, label, sheet.f.input("text"))
        sheet.write(row, 2, met, sheet.f.input("number"))
        row += 1
    book.define_name("ListActivityType",
                     f"={_q(sheet)}!$B${met_first}:$B${row - 1}")
    book.define_name("MetType",
                     f"={_q(sheet)}!$B${met_first}:$B${row - 1}")
    book.define_name("MetMET",
                     f"={_q(sheet)}!$C${met_first}:$C${row - 1}")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "DROP DOWN LISTS (EDIT FREELY)", last_col)
    for name, title, values in _LIST_DEFS:
        row = sheet.subsection(row, title, last_col)
        first = row + 1
        for value in values:
            sheet.write(row, 1, value, sheet.f.input("text"))
            row += 1
        book.define_name(name, f"={_q(sheet)}!$B${first}:$B${row - 1}")
        row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "HABIT NAMES (12 SLOTS)", last_col)
    first = row + 1
    for habit in HABIT_DEFAULTS:
        sheet.write(row, 1, habit, sheet.f.input("text"))
        row += 1
    book.define_name("ListHabits", f"={_q(sheet)}!$B${first}:$B${row - 1}")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "RPE SCALE (REFERENCE)", last_col)
    rpe = [("1-2", "Walking pace, could hold a long conversation"),
           ("3-4", "Easy work, breathing slightly up"),
           ("5-6", "Steady, talking in short sentences"),
           ("7", "Hard, one or two words at a time"),
           ("8", "Very hard, counting reps in your head"),
           ("9", "One rep left in the tank"),
           ("10", "Nothing left, race finish")]
    for score, meaning in rpe:
        sheet.write(row, 1, score, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.merge(row, 2, last_col, meaning, sheet.f.chrome("label"))
        row += 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "HOUSEKEEPING", last_col)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Sheet protection password", cfg.password,
                      mode="plain", style="text",
                      help_text="Review > Unprotect Sheet, then this word. "
                                "Protection is a guard rail, not encryption.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Version", cfg.version, mode="plain")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Author", cfg.author, mode="plain")
    row = sheet.note(row, "Colour key: cream cells are yours to type in, "
                          "grey cells calculate. Every list on this tab is "
                          "a cream cell - add your own exercises, foods, "
                          "habits and goals here and the drop downs grow.",
                     last_col, height=30)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=3, freeze_col=0, gridlines=False)
    return sheet


def _q(sheet: SheetWriter) -> str:
    from ..layout import quote_sheet
    return quote_sheet(sheet.name)
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/start_here.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/start_here.py sha256:0a40ec5bc10c8ecac2832f2b971396945af68df701946919bd7b6e449aecadd3 -->
````python
"""1 Start Here - welcome, quick start, colour key, demo data, licence.

Carries the full health disclaimer, the privacy note, the licence and
the documented one-pass way to remove the example data.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import DISCLAIMER, Config, Palette
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "1 Start Here"

QUICK_START = [
    "1.  Skim 16 Settings & Lists - units, week start, targets and the "
    "lists are all there, and all editable.",
    "2.  Fill in 2 Profile & Goals: sex, age, height, starting weight, "
    "goal weight, and up to six goals of any kind.",
    "3.  Plan the week on 4 Workout Planner - pick a start date, the "
    "phases arrive pre-filled, change anything.",
    "4.  Log as you go: 5 Workout Log, 7 Cardio & Activity, 8 Weight "
    "Tracker, 10 Habit Tracker, 11 Meals & Macros, 12 Water & Sleep.",
    "5.  Read 3 Dashboard daily and 14 Weekly & Monthly Review once a "
    "week. Print 15 Reports & Charts when the month closes.",
]

FAQ = [
    ("Will it work in my Excel?",
     "Excel 2010 or later on Windows or Mac, Excel on the web, Google "
     "Sheets, LibreOffice Calc and Apple Numbers all open it. No macros, "
     "no add-ins, no subscription."),
    ("Does it work in Google Sheets?",
     "Yes. Make your own copy (File > Make a copy), then use it as "
     "normal. Charts and drop downs survive; sparklines show in Excel "
     "and are ignored politely elsewhere."),
    ("What is the password for?",
     "Sheets are protected so formula cells cannot be overwritten by "
     "accident. The password is 'premium', printed on 16 Settings & "
     "Lists. Unprotect via Review > Unprotect Sheet."),
    ("How do I delete the example data?",
     "One pass: on each register (tabs 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13) select "
     "the cream cells from row 5 to the last example row and press "
     "Delete. The blank copy in your download is already empty."),
    ("Can I add my own exercises and foods?",
     "Yes - type them on 6 Exercise Library and in the calorie database "
     "on 11 Meals & Macros. Drop downs grow the moment you do."),
    ("Will switching kg to lb break my history?",
     "No. Every row carries a unit stamp; leave it blank and the row "
     "uses the workbook unit. Switch units and every display, chart and "
     "target converts; stamped rows keep their meaning."),
    ("Are the calorie and body-fat numbers reliable?",
     "They are estimates computed from what you type, clearly labelled "
     "as estimates, and every target is yours to overwrite. Nothing "
     "here is medical advice."),
    ("Where does my data live?",
     "In your file, on your machine or your own Drive. Nothing is sent "
     "anywhere; there is no account and no connection."),
    ("What if a drop down looks empty?",
     "The list it reads is on 16 Settings & Lists - check the block is "
     "not filtered or cleared. Unprotect, retype, re-protect."),
    ("Can I use it with clients?",
     "One file per client is fine under the personal-use licence. "
     "Reselling or redistributing the template itself is not."),
]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.primary, landscape=False)
    last_col = 9
    sheet.banner("1  Start Here",
                 f"{cfg.product_name} - v{cfg.version} by {cfg.author}",
                 last_col, nav=False)
    sheet.nav_strip(2, last_col)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "WELCOME", last_col)
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "This is a complete tracking system that does the "
                     "arithmetic for you: sixteen tabs, one colour code, "
                     "every total live. It plans, logs, calculates and "
                     "prints - and it never phones home.", last_col,
                     height=40)
    row = sheet.section(row, "FIVE-STEP QUICK START", last_col)
    row = sheet.bullets(row, QUICK_START, last_col, height=26)
    row += 1
    row = sheet.section(row, "THE COLOUR CODE", last_col)
    sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, "cream", sheet.f.chrome("legend_input"))
    sheet.merge(row, 2, last_col, "type here - every input cell in "
                                       "the workbook",
                sheet.f.chrome("label"))
    row += 1
    sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, "grey", sheet.f.chrome("legend_calc"))
    sheet.merge(row, 2, last_col, "calculated - locked so it stays "
                                       "true",
                sheet.f.chrome("label"))
    row += 2
    row = sheet.section(row, "WHERE YOUR DATA LIVES", last_col)
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "This file is yours. It lives on your machine or in "
                     "your own cloud folder; nothing is sent anywhere, "
                     "there is no account, no login and no connection. "
                     "In Google Sheets: File > Make a copy, then work in "
                     "your copy.", last_col, height=40)
    row = sheet.section(row, "DEMO DATA - AND HOW TO REMOVE IT", last_col)
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "The filled copy ships with eleven weeks of example "
                     "training so you can see every formula working: "
                     "workout log, cardio, weigh-ins, measurements, "
                     "meals, water, sleep, habits and a month of ticks. "
                     "Remove it in one pass - on tabs 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12 "
                     "and 13 select the cream cells from row 5 down to "
                     "the last example row and press Delete - or open "
                     "the completely blank workbook that ships beside "
                     "this one.", last_col, height=56)
    row = sheet.section(row, "HEALTH & FITNESS DISCLAIMER", last_col)
    row = sheet.note(row, DISCLAIMER, last_col, height=88)
    row = sheet.section(row, "LICENCE", last_col)
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "Personal-use licence: one buyer, unlimited personal "
                     "use, including tracking clients you coach one file "
                     "at a time. Not for resale, redistribution, or "
                     "inclusion in another product. Keep the credit row "
                     "on printed pages or do not - your prints, your "
                     "fridge.", last_col, height=40)
    row = sheet.section(row, "QUESTIONS BUYERS ACTUALLY ASK", last_col)
    for question, answer in FAQ:
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last_col, question,
                    sheet.f.chrome("label_bold"))
        row += 1
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last_col, answer, sheet.f.chrome("note"))
        sheet.row_height(row, 26)
        row += 1
    row += 1
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last_col, row)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=3, gridlines=False)
    return sheet
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/water_sleep.py`
