<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/water_sleep.py sha256:dd72a68998a5f44017bdf2880304ae7a194aebf72367c4bc8fc808ee55939346 -->
````python
"""12 Water & Sleep - hydration, sleep maths and recovery signals.

Sleep hours use MOD(wake - bed, 1) so a bedtime before midnight and a
wake time after it compute correctly.  The weekly summary block reads
the register with SUMIFS / AVERAGEIFS over date windows.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec, col_letter, quote_sheet
from ..writer import (SheetWriter, cf_formula, date_check, number_check,
                      time_check)
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "12 Water & Sleep"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="12  Water & Sleep",
        subtitle="Glasses or millilitres, bedtime and wake time - hours "
                 "slept cross midnight correctly.",
        tab_color="#3E897D",
        rows=cfg.row_count("Water & Sleep"),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text="Log glasses, ml, or both - they add up. Sleep quality, "
                  "mood and energy are 1-5, your scale, your rules. The "
                  "weekly summary below the register rolls everything up.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
                formula='="S-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
            Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("glasses", "Glasses", 9, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 30, False)),
            Col("ml", "Extra ml", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 6000, False),
                note="Bottles, flasks, anything not counted in glasses."),
            Col("total", "Total ml", 10, "int",
                formula='IF(AND({glasses}{r}="",{ml}{r}=""),"",IF('
                        '{glasses}{r}="",0,{glasses}{r}*GlassML)+IF('
                        '{ml}{r}="",0,{ml}{r}))'),
            Col("target", "Target ml", 10, "int",
                formula='IF({date}{r}="","",WaterTarget)'),
            Col("gap", "Gap to target", 12, "int",
                formula='IF({total}{r}="","",IF(Units="Imperial","", '
                        '{total}{r}-WaterTarget))',
                cf=[cf_formula("=AND($G5<>\"\",$G5<0)", "warn")],
                note="Negative means short of your target."),
            Col("bed", "Bedtime", 10, "time", validate=time_check()),
            Col("wake", "Wake time", 10, "time", validate=time_check()),
            Col("hours", "Hours slept", 11, "number1",
                formula='IF(OR({bed}{r}="",{wake}{r}=""),"",MOD({wake}{r}-'
                        '{bed}{r},1)*24)',
                note="Crosses midnight correctly."),
            Col("quality", "Quality 1-5", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(1, 5, False)),
            Col("mood", "Mood 1-5", 9, "int",
                validate=number_check(1, 5, False)),
            Col("energy", "Energy 1-5", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(1, 5, False)),
            Col("mobility", "Mobility min", 11, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 240, False),
                note="Stretching, mobility, foam rolling - the minutes "
                     "that keep the next session possible."),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 24, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.water_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    q = quote_sheet(NAME)
    first, last = spec_.first_data_row, spec_.last_data_row
    d = f"{q}!${spec_.letter('date')}${first}:${spec_.letter('date')}${last}"
    tot = f"{q}!${spec_.letter('total')}${first}:" \
          f"${spec_.letter('total')}${last}"
    hrs = f"{q}!${spec_.letter('hours')}${first}:" \
          f"${spec_.letter('hours')}${last}"
    qual = f"{q}!${spec_.letter('quality')}${first}:" \
           f"${spec_.letter('quality')}${last}"
    mob = f"{q}!${spec_.letter('mobility')}${first}:" \
          f"${spec_.letter('mobility')}${last}"
    top = last + 2
    row = sheet.section(top, "LAST EIGHT WEEKS", 8)
    row = sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Week starting", "Water (ml)",
                                    "Avg sleep (h)", "Avg quality",
                                    "Mobility (min)"],
                           widths=[16, 12, 13, 12, 13])
    for week in range(7, -1, -1):
        ws_expr = f"{C.week_start_of('TODAY()')}-{7 * week}"
        sheet.formula(row, 0, "=" + ws_expr, sheet.f.calc("date"))
        sheet.formula(row, 1, f'=SUMIFS({tot},{d},">="&$A{row + 1},{d},'
                              f'"<="&$A{row + 1}+6)',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(row, 2, f'=IFERROR(AVERAGEIFS({hrs},{d},">="&'
                              f'$A{row + 1},{d},"<="&$A{row + 1}+6,{hrs},'
                              f'">0"),"")',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 3, f'=IFERROR(AVERAGEIFS({qual},{d},">="&'
                              f'$A{row + 1},{d},"<="&$A{row + 1}+6,{qual},'
                              f'">0"),"")',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(row, 4, f'=SUMIFS({mob},{d},">="&$A{row + 1},{d},'
                              f'"<="&$A{row + 1}+6)',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        row += 1
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=4, freeze_col=2,
                 print_area=f"$A$1:${col_letter(spec_.last_col_index)}$"
                            f"{last}")
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/weight.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/weight.py sha256:25c62f95da4a0eda6e11ad21f15d5a329eca2184acf83c78a4cfe7d7fc3d5936 -->
````python
"""8 Weight Tracker - weigh-ins, moving averages, rate and projection.

No fixed schedule: log daily, weekly or whenever.  The 7-day and 28-day
moving averages use AVERAGEIFS over an expanding window (Excel 2007+),
the projection states itself as an estimate, and milestones fire every
5 lb / 2 kg of change from the starting weight.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import (SheetWriter, cf_text, date_check, number_check)
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "8 Weight Tracker"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="8  Weight Tracker",
        subtitle="Weigh in when you like - the moving averages make one "
                 "bad morning mean nothing.",
        tab_color="#14655A",
        rows=cfg.row_count("Weight Tracker"),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text="Type the date and the weight on the scales, in the "
                  "stamped unit or the workbook unit. Everything else on "
                  "the row calculates, including the date you would reach "
                  "your goal at the current 7-day rate.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
                formula='="W-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
            Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check(),
                note="Keep dates in order - the moving averages and the "
                     "projection read upwards."),
            Col("weight", "Weight", 10, "number1",
                validate=number_check(20, 400),
                note="As the scales showed it."),
            Col("stamp", "Unit", 7, "flag",
                validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["kg", "lb"],
                          "ignore_blank": True}),
            Col("kg", "kg (canonical)", 10, "number", hidden=True,
                formula="=" + C.kg_from("{weight}{r}", "{stamp}{r}")),
            Col("disp", "In your unit", 11, "number1",
                formula="=" + C.disp_weight("{kg}{r}")),
            Col("chg_start", "Since start", 11, "number1",
                formula='IF({kg}{r}="","",IF(Units="Imperial",'
                        '({kg}{r}-StartKg)/KgPerLb,{kg}{r}-StartKg))',
                cf=[cf_text("-", "muted")]),
            Col("chg_last", "Since last", 10, "number1",
                formula='IF(OR({kg}{r}="",{kg}{r_prev}=""),"",'
                        'IF(Units="Imperial",({kg}{r}-{kg}{r_prev})/KgPerLb,'
                        '{kg}{r}-{kg}{r_prev}))'),
            Col("ma7", "7-day average", 12, "number1",
                formula='IF({kg}{r}="","",AVERAGEIFS({kg_first}:{kg}{r},'
                        '{date_first}:{date}{r},">="&{date}{r}-6,'
                        '{date_first}:{date}{r},"<="&{date}{r}))',
                note="The number worth watching."),
            Col("ma28", "28-day average", 12, "number1",
                formula='IF({kg}{r}="","",AVERAGEIFS({kg_first}:{kg}{r},'
                        '{date_first}:{date}{r},">="&{date}{r}-27,'
                        '{date_first}:{date}{r},"<="&{date}{r}))'),
            Col("ma7_disp", "7-day, your unit", 12, "number1",
                formula="=" + C.disp_weight("{ma7}{r}")),
            Col("rate", "Rate / week", 11, "number1",
                formula='IF(OR({ma7}{r}="",{date}{r}=""),"",IFERROR(IF('
                        'INDEX({ma7_first}:{ma7}{r},MATCH({date}{r}-7,'
                        '{date_first}:{date}{r},1))="","",{ma7}{r}-INDEX('
                        '{ma7_first}:{ma7}{r},MATCH({date}{r}-7,'
                        '{date_first}:{date}{r},1))),""))',
                note="Change in the 7-day average over the last week, in "
                     "kg (or lb when you switch units on Settings)."),
            Col("proj", "Goal at this rate", 14, "date",
                formula='IF(OR({rate}{r}="",{rate}{r}=0,{kg}{r}=""),"",IF('
                        '(GoalKg-{kg}{r})/({rate}{r}/7)<0,"off track",IF('
                        '(GoalKg-{kg}{r})/({rate}{r}/7)>3650,"",{date}{r}+'
                        '(GoalKg-{kg}{r})/({rate}{r}/7))))',
                cf=[cf_text("off track", "warn")],
                note="An estimate from the current rate, not a promise. "
                     "'off track' means the rate is pointing away from "
                     "the goal."),
            Col("milestone", "Milestone", 11, "status",
                formula='IF({kg}{r}="","",IF(INT(ABS(StartKg-{kg}{r})/'
                        'MilestoneStep)>INT(ABS(StartKg-IF({kg}{r_prev}='
                        '"",{kg}{r},{kg}{r_prev}))/MilestoneStep),'
                        '"milestone",""))',
                cf=[cf_text("milestone", "bold_good")],
                note="Fires every 5 lb or 2 kg of change from your "
                     "starting weight."),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 24, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.weight_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    sheet.note(spec_.last_data_row + 1,
               "Weigh-ins do not need a schedule. The 7-day average is "
               "the honest line; the projection reads 'off track' rather "
               "than guessing a date when the rate points the wrong way.",
               spec_.last_col_index, height=26)
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/workout_log.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/sheets/workout_log.py sha256:cba55f74c640fb9a7ccb9740de6091abbb4e92970af9a3e6f8f7f29c24a97a4b -->
````python
"""5 Workout Log - one row per exercise per session.

Volume, estimated 1RM (Epley), personal-record detection and the
"last time" progressive-overload prompt are all calculated with
COUNTIFS / SUMPRODUCT(MAX(...)) and hidden helper columns, so nothing
here needs an array formula or a function newer than Excel 2007.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import (SheetWriter, cf_text, date_check, list_from,
                      number_check, yes_no)
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "5 Workout Log"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="5  Workout Log",
        subtitle="One row per exercise per session - volume, estimated "
                 "1RM and personal records calculate as you type.",
        tab_color="#14655A",
        rows=cfg.row_count("Workout Log"),
        freeze_cols=4,
        help_text="Type the date, the session name and the exercise "
                  "(drop down), then sets, reps and weight. Warm-up sets "
                  "are excluded from volume by the flag. The 'last time' "
                  "column is your progressive-overload prompt.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "ID", 8, "id",
                formula='="L-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
            Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("session", "Session", 14, "text",
                note="Any name you like: Push A, Lower 1, Club night."),
            Col("exercise", "Exercise", 26, "text",
                validate=list_from("ExerciseNames"),
                note="Drop down reads the Exercise Library - add moves "
                     "there and they appear here."),
            Col("muscle", "Muscle group", 13, "text",
                formula='IF({exercise}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX('
                        '[[6 Exercise Library.muscle]],MATCH({exercise}{r},'
                        '[[6 Exercise Library.name]],0)),""))'),
            Col("sets", "Sets", 7, "int", validate=number_check(0, 20, False)),
            Col("reps", "Reps / set", 9, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 100, False)),
            Col("weight", "Weight", 10, "number1",
                validate=number_check(0, 600),
                note="In the unit shown in the stamp column, or the "
                     "workbook unit when the stamp is empty."),
            Col("stamp", "Unit", 7, "flag",
                validate={"validate": "list", "source": ["kg", "lb"],
                          "ignore_blank": True},
                note="Leave empty to use the workbook unit. Stamp rows "
                     "logged in the other unit and switching units never "
                     "misreads them."),
            Col("kg", "kg (canonical)", 10, "number", hidden=True,
                formula="=" + C.kg_from("{weight}{r}", "{stamp}{r}")),
            Col("rpe", "RPE", 7, "int", validate=number_check(0, 10, False)),
            Col("rest", "Rest (sec)", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 900, False)),
            Col("dur", "Minutes", 9, "number1",
                validate=number_check(0, 600)),
            Col("warmup", "Warm-up?", 10, "flag", validate=yes_no(),
                note="Yes excludes the row from every volume number."),
            Col("done", "Done?", 8, "flag", validate=yes_no()),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 30, "wrap",
                note="Form, tempo, pain, band colour - anything future "
                     "you will want to know."),
            Col("vol", "Volume kg", 10, "number", hidden=True,
                formula='IF(OR({done}{r}<>"Yes",{warmup}{r}="Yes",'
                        '{sets}{r}="",{reps}{r}="",{kg}{r}=""),0,'
                        '{sets}{r}*{reps}{r}*{kg}{r})'),
            Col("e1rm", "e1RM kg", 10, "number", hidden=True,
                formula='IF(OR({kg}{r}="",{reps}{r}="",{reps}{r}<1),0,'
                        '{kg}{r}*(1+{reps}{r}/30))',
                note="Epley: weight x (1 + reps / 30). Edit the formula "
                     "if you prefer another estimator."),
            Col("e1rm_disp", "Est. 1RM", 11, "number1",
                formula='IF({e1rm}{r}=0,"",IF(Units="Imperial",'
                        '{e1rm}{r}/KgPerLb,{e1rm}{r}))'),
            Col("pr", "PR", 7, "status",
                formula='IF(OR({e1rm}{r}=0,{done}{r}<>"Yes"),"",IF('
                        'COUNTIFS({exercise_first}:{exercise}{r_prev},'
                        '{exercise}{r},{e1rm_first}:{e1rm}{r_prev},">"&'
                        '{e1rm}{r})=0,"PR",""))',
                cf=[cf_text("PR", "bold_good")],
                note="Flags the moment a row beats every earlier set of "
                     "the same exercise on estimated 1RM."),
            Col("prev_row", "prev row", 9, "int", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({exercise}{r}="","",SUMPRODUCT(MAX(('
                        '{exercise_first}:{exercise}{r_prev}={exercise}{r})'
                        '*ROW({exercise_first}:{exercise}{r_prev}))))'),
            Col("last_prompt", "Last time", 26, "text",
                formula='IF(OR({prev_row}{r}="",{prev_row}{r}=0),"",'
                        '"Last: "&INDEX({sets_first}:{sets_last},'
                        '{prev_row}{r}-{first}+1)&"x"&INDEX('
                        '{reps_first}:{reps_last},{prev_row}{r}-{first}+1)'
                        '&" @ "&TEXT(IF(Units="Imperial",INDEX('
                        '{kg_first}:{kg_last},{prev_row}{r}-{first}+1)'
                        '/KgPerLb,INDEX({kg_first}:{kg_last},'
                        '{prev_row}{r}-{first}+1)),"0.##")&" "&IF('
                        'Units="Imperial","lb","kg"))',
                note="Progressive overload without scrolling: the last "
                     "logged set of this exercise."),
            Col("dow", "day of week", 8, "int", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({date}{r}="","",' + C.day_of_week("{date}{r}")
                        + ")"),
            Col("wstart", "week start", 11, "date", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        + C.week_start_of("{date}{r}") + ")"),
            Col("sid", "session id", 14, "text", hidden=True,
                formula='IF(OR({date}{r}="",{session}{r}=""),"",'
                        'TEXT({date}{r},"yyyymmdd")&"|"&{session}{r})'),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.log_rows(cfg) if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet: SheetWriter, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> None:
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    last = spec_.last_data_row
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(
        spec_.first_data_row - 1, spec_.index("last_prompt"),
        last - 1, spec_.index("last_prompt"),
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "Last:",
         "format": sheet.f.cf("info")})
````

### `25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/writer.py`

<!-- source-file: 25-fitness-tracker/fitness_tracker_spreadsheet/writer.py sha256:91e0a76765797cf672305a85297809c211c3ad42985f8132865058bc08f77606 -->
````python
"""
Sheet writing helpers shared by every tab of the workbook.

:class:`SheetWriter` wraps an XlsxWriter worksheet and adds the house style:
title band, navigation strip, section headers, KPI tiles, label/value settings
rows and - most importantly - :meth:`SheetWriter.grid`, which turns a
:class:`~handmade_pricing_spreadsheet.layout.SheetSpec` into a finished register
with headers, drop downs, conditional formats, sample rows, frozen panes and
locked formula cells.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from .config import Config, Palette
from .formats import CALC, FormatBook, INPUT, PLAIN
from .layout import (NAV_ROW, SUBTITLE_ROW, TITLE_ROW, Registry,
                     SheetSpec, col_letter, quote_sheet)

P = Palette

#: Sheets linked from the navigation strip at the top of every tab.
NAV_LINKS: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("Start", "1 Start Here"),
    ("Profile", "2 Profile & Goals"),
    ("Dashboard", "3 Dashboard"),
    ("Plan", "4 Workout Planner"),
    ("Log", "5 Workout Log"),
    ("Library", "6 Exercise Library"),
    ("Cardio", "7 Cardio & Activity"),
    ("Weight", "8 Weight Tracker"),
    ("Measure", "9 Body Measurements"),
    ("Habits", "10 Habit Tracker"),
    ("Meals", "11 Meals & Macros"),
    ("Water", "12 Water & Sleep"),
    ("Records", "13 Records & Milestones"),
    ("Review", "14 Weekly & Monthly Review"),
    ("Reports", "15 Reports & Charts"),
    ("Settings", "16 Settings & Lists"),
]

#: Columns consumed per navigation link (one cell each on this product,
#: so all sixteen tabs fit on a single strip).
NAV_SPAN = 1

#: The navigation strip always gets at least this many columns, so every
#: tab is linked even from narrow registers.
NAV_MIN_COLS = 16

#: Worksheet protection: formulas are locked, everything else stays usable.
PROTECT_OPTIONS: Dict[str, bool] = {
    "objects": False,
    "scenarios": False,
    "format_cells": True,
    "format_columns": True,
    "format_rows": True,
    "insert_columns": False,
    "insert_rows": True,
    "insert_hyperlinks": True,
    "delete_columns": False,
    "delete_rows": True,
    "select_locked_cells": True,
    "sort": False,          # stops rows being re-sorted out of sync with IDs
    "autofilter": True,     # filtering stays available
    "pivot_tables": False,
    "select_unlocked_cells": True,
}


class SheetWriter:
    """Convenience wrapper around a worksheet."""

    def __init__(self, book, fmts: FormatBook, cfg: Config, reg: Registry,
                 name: str, tab_color: Optional[str] = None,
                 landscape: bool = True) -> None:
        self.book = book
        self.f = fmts
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.reg = reg
        self.name = name
        self.ws = book.add_worksheet(name)
        self._protected = False
        if tab_color:
            self.ws.set_tab_color(tab_color)
        if landscape:
            self.ws.set_landscape()
        self.ws.set_paper(9)  # A4
        self.ws.set_margins(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 0.5)
        self.ws.set_header(
            f"&L&\"Calibri,Bold\"&12{''}"
            f"&C&\"Calibri,Bold\"&11{name}"
            f"&R&\"Calibri,Italic\"&9{cfg.product_name}")
        self.ws.set_footer(
            f"&L&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8{cfg.author} - v{cfg.version}"
            "&C&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8Page &P of &N"
            "&R&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8&D")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- plumbing
    def formula(self, row: int, col: int, formula: str, fmt=None):
        """Write a formula, rendering ``[[Sheet.key]]`` tokens first.

        Every formula in the workbook goes through here (or through
        :meth:`write` / :meth:`merge`, which call it). A token that reaches
        the file unrendered is not a formula Excel can resolve - there are no
        tables in this workbook, so ``[[Sales.gross]]`` would sit in the cell
        as a broken reference.
        """
        text = (formula or "").strip()
        if not text.startswith("="):
            text = "=" + text
        self.ws.write_formula(row, col, self.reg.render(text), fmt)

    def write(self, row: int, col: int, value: Any, fmt=None):
        """Type aware write (0 based row/col, like XlsxWriter)."""
        if value is None:
            if fmt is not None:
                self.ws.write_blank(row, col, None, fmt)
            return
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
            self.formula(row, col, value, fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, (_dt.datetime, _dt.date, _dt.time)):
            self.ws.write_datetime(row, col, value, fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            self.ws.write_string(row, col, "Yes" if value else "No", fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            self.ws.write_number(row, col, value, fmt)
        else:
            self.ws.write_string(row, col, str(value), fmt)

    def merge(self, row: int, first_col: int, last_col: int, value: Any,
              fmt=None, row2: Optional[int] = None):
        row2 = row if row2 is None else row2
        if first_col == last_col and row == row2:
            self.write(row, first_col, value, fmt)
            return
        text = "" if value is None else value
        if isinstance(text, (_dt.datetime, _dt.date, _dt.time)):
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_datetime(row, first_col, text, fmt)
        elif isinstance(text, str) and text.startswith("="):
            # merge first, then put the rendered formula in the anchor cell
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, "", fmt)
            self.formula(row, first_col, text, fmt)
        else:
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, text, fmt)

    def set_col(self, first: int, last: int, width: float, fmt=None,
                hidden: bool = False):
        options = {"hidden": 1} if hidden else {}
        self.ws.set_column(first, last, width, fmt, options)

    def row_height(self, row: int, height: float):
        self.ws.set_row(row, height)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- page chrome
    def banner(self, title: str, subtitle: str = "", last_col: int = 9,
               nav: bool = True, badge: str = "",
               tail_text: str = "") -> None:
        """Title row + strapline + navigation strip (Excel rows 1-3).

        `tail_text` is written in the empty space to the right of the
        navigation links - used for the register help line on sheets whose
        header row leaves no spare row for it.
        """
        r = TITLE_ROW - 1
        self.row_height(r, 34)
        split = max(last_col - 3, 1)
        self.merge(r, 0, split, title, self.f.chrome("title"))
        self.merge(r, split + 1, last_col,
                   badge or f"{self.cfg.author}  |  v{self.cfg.version}",
                   self.f.chrome("title_right"))

        r = SUBTITLE_ROW - 1
        self.row_height(r, 18)
        self.merge(r, 0, last_col, subtitle, self.f.chrome("subtitle"))

        if nav:
            self.nav_strip(NAV_ROW - 1, max(last_col, NAV_MIN_COLS - 1),
                           tail_text=tail_text)

    def nav_strip(self, row: int, last_col: int,
                  links: Optional[Sequence[Tuple[str, str]]] = None,
                  tail_text: str = "") -> int:
        """Row of internal links. Returns the first column left over."""
        links = list(links or NAV_LINKS)
        self.row_height(row, 16)
        col = 0
        fmt = self.f.chrome("nav")
        for label, sheet in links:
            if col + NAV_SPAN - 1 > last_col:
                break
            if NAV_SPAN > 1:
                self.ws.merge_range(row, col, row,
                                    min(col + NAV_SPAN - 1, last_col),
                                    "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_url(row, col, f"internal:{quote_sheet(sheet)}!A1",
                              fmt, f"> {label}")
            col += NAV_SPAN
        if col <= last_col:
            room = last_col - col
            if tail_text and room >= 4:
                self.merge(row, col, last_col, tail_text,
                           self.f.chrome("note", bg_color=P.note_bg))
            else:
                self.merge(row, col, last_col, "",
                           self.f.chrome("nav_plain"))
        return col

    def section(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int, first_col: int = 0):
        self.row_height(row, 20)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text, self.f.chrome("section"))
        return row + 1

    def subsection(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int,
                   first_col: int = 0):
        self.row_height(row, 17)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text,
                   self.f.chrome("subsection"))
        return row + 1

    def note(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int, first_col: int = 0,
             height: float = 28, boxed: bool = True):
        self.row_height(row, height)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text,
                   self.f.chrome("note_box" if boxed else "note"))
        return row + 1

    def bullets(self, row: int, lines: Sequence[str], last_col: int,
                first_col: int = 0, height: float = 15):
        for line in lines:
            self.row_height(row, height)
            self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, line, self.f.chrome("label"))
            row += 1
        return row

    # -------------------------------------------------------- settings rows
    def field(self, row: int, label: str, value: Any = None, *,
              label_col: int = 1, value_col: int = 3,
              value_end: Optional[int] = None, style: str = "text",
              mode: Optional[str] = None, name: Optional[str] = None,
              validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
              help_text: str = "", help_col: Optional[int] = None,
              formula: Optional[str] = None):
        """A `Label | value | help` settings row, optionally named.

        `mode` defaults to CALC when a formula is supplied and to INPUT
        otherwise: a cell holding a formula must stay locked, or the first
        person to click it and start typing destroys the calculation.
        """
        if mode is None:
            mode = CALC if formula is not None else INPUT
        self.merge(row, label_col, value_col - 1, label,
                   self.f.chrome("label_bold"))
        fmt = self.f.cell(style, mode)
        end = value_end if value_end is not None else value_col
        if formula is not None:
            rendered = self.reg.render(formula)
            if end > value_col:
                self.ws.merge_range(row, value_col, row, end, "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_formula(row, value_col, rendered, fmt)
        else:
            if end > value_col:
                self.merge(row, value_col, end, None, fmt)
                self.write(row, value_col, value, fmt)
            else:
                self.write(row, value_col, value, fmt)
        if validate:
            self.ws.data_validation(row, value_col, row, value_col, validate)
        if help_text:
            hc = help_col if help_col is not None else end + 1
            self.merge(row, hc, hc + 3, help_text, self.f.chrome("note"))
        if name:
            self.book.define_name(
                name, f"={quote_sheet(self.name)}!"
                      f"${col_letter(value_col)}${row + 1}")
        return row + 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ KPI tiles
    def kpi(self, row: int, col: int, label: str, formula: str,
            style: str = "int", span: int = 2, note: str = ""):
        """Three row KPI tile: caption, big number, small note."""
        self.merge(row, col, col + span - 1, label, self.f.chrome("kpi_label"))
        self.row_height(row + 1, 26)
        fmt = self.f.chrome("kpi_value",
                            num_format=self._num_format(style))
        self.ws.merge_range(row + 1, col, row + 1, col + span - 1, "", fmt)
        self.ws.write_formula(row + 1, col, self.reg.render(formula), fmt)
        self.merge(row + 2, col, col + span - 1, note,
                   self.f.chrome("kpi_note"))
        return row + 3

    def num_format(self, style: str) -> str:
        """Number format string for a style key (public helper)."""
        return self._num_format(style)

    def _num_format(self, style: str) -> str:
        return {
            "money": self.cfg.money_format,
            "money0": self.cfg.money_format_0,
            "money4": self.cfg.money_format_4,
            "int": "#,##0",
            "number": "#,##0.00",
            "number1": "#,##0.0",
            "percent": "0.0%",
            "percent0": "0%",
            "date": self.cfg.date_format,
            "text": "General",
        }.get(style, "General")

    # ------------------------------------------------------- generic tables
    def table_head(self, row: int, col: int, headers: Sequence[str],
                   widths: Optional[Sequence[float]] = None,
                   align_left_first: bool = True):
        for i, head in enumerate(headers):
            fmt = self.f.chrome(
                "header_left" if (i == 0 and align_left_first) else "header")
            self.write(row, col + i, head, fmt)
            if widths:
                self.set_col(col + i, col + i, widths[i])
        self.row_height(row, 26)
        return row + 1

    def calc_row(self, row: int, col: int, values: Sequence[Any],
                 styles: Sequence[str], mode: str = CALC,
                 first_style: str = "text"):
        for i, value in enumerate(values):
            style = styles[i] if i < len(styles) else "text"
            fmt = self.f.cell(style, PLAIN if i == 0 and mode == PLAIN
                              else mode)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
                self.ws.write_formula(row, col + i, self.reg.render(value),
                                      fmt)
            else:
                self.write(row, col + i, value, fmt)
        return row + 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- the grid --
    def grid(self, spec: SheetSpec, extra_help: str = "") -> None:
        """Render a whole register sheet from its specification."""
        ws = self.ws
        last_col = spec.last_col_index
        header_row0 = spec.header_row - 1
        first = spec.first_data_row
        last = spec.last_data_row

        help_text = extra_help or spec.help_text
        spare_row = spec.header_row - 1 > NAV_ROW   # room above the headers?
        self.banner(spec.title, spec.subtitle, last_col,
                    tail_text="" if spare_row else help_text)

        if help_text and spare_row:
            self.note(header_row0 - 1, help_text, last_col, height=26)

        # Column widths, default formats (so blank cells keep the right lock
        # state) and the header row itself.
        for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            mode = CALC if col.is_formula else INPUT
            self.set_col(idx, idx, col.width, self.f.cell(col.style, mode),
                         hidden=col.hidden)
            self.write(header_row0, idx, col.header,
                       self.f.chrome("header_left" if idx <= 1 else "header"))
        self.row_height(header_row0, 30)

        # Data rows: formulas everywhere, sample values in the input columns.
        samples = spec.samples if self.cfg.include_sample_data else []
        for offset in range(spec.rows):
            excel_row = first + offset
            row0 = excel_row - 1
            sample = samples[offset] if offset < len(samples) else {}
            for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
                if col.is_formula:
                    fmt = self.f.cell(col.style, CALC)
                    ws.write_formula(
                        row0, idx,
                        self.reg.render(col.formula, excel_row, spec), fmt)
                elif col.key in sample and sample[col.key] is not None:
                    self.write(row0, idx, sample[col.key],
                               self.f.cell(col.style, INPUT))

        # Drop downs, help bubbles and conditional formats.
        for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            if col.validate:
                options = dict(col.validate)
                if "source" in options and isinstance(options["source"], str):
                    options["source"] = self.reg.render(options["source"])
                if col.note:
                    options.setdefault("input_title", col.header[:32])
                    options.setdefault("input_message", col.note[:255])
                ws.data_validation(first - 1, idx, last - 1, idx, options)
            if col.note:
                # Header comment: works in every Excel version and survives
                # the trip through Google Sheets.
                ws.write_comment(header_row0, idx, col.note, {
                    "author": self.cfg.author,
                    "width": 220,
                    "height": 100,
                    "x_scale": 1.1,
                })
            for rule in col.cf:
                options = dict(rule)
                fmt_key = options.pop("fmt", None)
                if fmt_key:
                    options["format"] = self.f.cf(fmt_key)
                for field_name in ("criteria", "value", "minimum", "maximum"):
                    val = options.get(field_name)
                    if isinstance(val, str) and ("[[" in val or "{" in val):
                        options[field_name] = self.reg.render(
                            val, first, spec)
                ws.conditional_format(first - 1, idx, last - 1, idx, options)

        ws.autofilter(header_row0, 0, last - 1, last_col)
        freeze_row = (spec.freeze_at if spec.freeze_at is not None
                      else spec.header_row)
        ws.freeze_panes(freeze_row, spec.freeze_cols)
        ws.print_area(0, 0, last - 1, last_col)
        ws.repeat_rows(0, header_row0 if spec.header_row <= 6 else 2)
        ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- finishing
    def finish(self, freeze_row: Optional[int] = None,
               freeze_col: int = 0, print_area: Optional[str] = None,
               fit_width: bool = True, gridlines: bool = True):
        if freeze_row is not None:
            self.ws.freeze_panes(freeze_row, freeze_col)
        if print_area:
            self.ws.print_area(print_area)
        if fit_width:
            self.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
        if not gridlines:
            self.ws.hide_gridlines(2)
        self.protect()

    def protect(self):
        if self.cfg.protect_sheets and not self._protected:
            self.ws.protect(self.cfg.password, dict(PROTECT_OPTIONS))
            self._protected = True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Small shared helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def yes_no(validate_note: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    opts: Dict[str, Any] = {"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]}
    if validate_note:
        opts["input_message"] = validate_note
    return opts


def list_from(name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Drop down fed by a defined name (see lists.py)."""
    return {"validate": "list", "source": f"={name}"}


def date_check() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "validate": "date",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": _dt.date(2000, 1, 1),
        "maximum": _dt.date(2100, 12, 31),
        "error_title": "Check the date",
        "error_message": "Enter a real date between 2000 and 2100.",
    }


def time_check() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Any time of day. Typing 9:00 AM or 14:30 both work."""
    return {
        "validate": "time",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": _dt.time(0, 0),
        "maximum": _dt.time(23, 59),
        "error_title": "Check the time",
        "error_message": "Enter a time of day, for example 9:00 AM "
                         "or 14:30.",
    }


def number_check(minimum: float = 0, maximum: float = 1000000,
                 decimal: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "validate": "decimal" if decimal else "integer",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": minimum,
        "maximum": maximum,
        "error_title": "Check the value",
        "error_message": f"Enter a number between {minimum} and {maximum}.",
    }


def cf_text(text: str, fmt: str, criteria: str = "containing") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "text", "criteria": criteria, "value": text, "fmt": fmt}


def cf_formula(formula: str, fmt: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "formula", "criteria": formula, "fmt": fmt}


def cf_bar(color: str = "#2E7D8F") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "data_bar", "bar_color": color}
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/build.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/build.py sha256:d7ca50080c5384254db44c374e377cb6428fd8837a6be83d128a8ced359db8ff -->
````python
"""Assembly order for the Salon Business Management System."""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt
import inspect
import os
from typing import Dict, Optional

from xlsxwriter import Workbook

from .config import Config, SHEET_TABS
from .formats import FormatBook
from .layout import Registry, SheetSpec
from .names import define_cross_sheet_names
from .writer import SheetWriter

from .sheets import (analytics, appointments, clients, commissions,
                     dashboard, expenses, goals, inventory, loyalty,
                     marketing, payments, payroll, pnl, purchases,
                     reports, sales, services, settings, staff,
                     start_here)

REGISTER_MODULES = [
    appointments, clients, services, sales, payments, staff, payroll,
    expenses, inventory, purchases, marketing, loyalty, goals,
]
REGISTER_BY_NAME = {m.NAME: m for m in REGISTER_MODULES}

PAGE_BUILDERS = {
    start_here.NAME: start_here.build,
    dashboard.NAME: dashboard.build,
    commissions.NAME: commissions.build,
    pnl.NAME: pnl.build,
    analytics.NAME: analytics.build,
    reports.NAME: reports.build,
    settings.NAME: settings.build,
}

SHEET_ORDER = list(SHEET_TABS)


def build_register(book, fmts: FormatBook, cfg: Config, reg: Registry,
                   module) -> SheetWriter:
    """Create one register sheet from its :class:`SheetSpec`."""
    spec: SheetSpec = reg[module.NAME]
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, spec.name,
                        tab_color=spec.tab_color)
    sheet.grid(spec)
    decorate = getattr(module, "decorate", None)
    if decorate is not None:
        wants_registry = len(inspect.signature(decorate).parameters) >= 4
        if wants_registry:
            decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg)
        else:
            decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg)
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def build_workbook(path: str = "Salon Business Management System.xlsx",
                   cfg: Optional[Config] = None) -> str:
    """Write the whole product to *path* and return the path."""
    cfg = cfg or Config()
    folder = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if folder and not os.path.isdir(folder):
        os.makedirs(folder)

    book = Workbook(path)
    _set_properties(book, cfg)

    fmts = FormatBook(book, cfg)
    reg = Registry()

    for module in REGISTER_MODULES:
        reg.add(module.spec(cfg))

    sheets: Dict[str, SheetWriter] = {}
    for name in SHEET_ORDER:
        if name in REGISTER_BY_NAME:
            sheets[name] = build_register(book, fmts, cfg, reg,
                                          REGISTER_BY_NAME[name])
        elif name in PAGE_BUILDERS:
            sheets[name] = PAGE_BUILDERS[name](book, fmts, cfg, reg)
        else:                                   # pragma: no cover
            raise KeyError(f"No builder for sheet '{name}'")

    define_cross_sheet_names(book, reg)

    first = sheets[SHEET_ORDER[0]].ws
    first.activate()
    first.set_first_sheet()

    book.close()
    return path


def _set_properties(book, cfg: Config) -> None:
    book.set_properties({
        "title": cfg.product_name,
        "subject": "Salon business management: appointments, client CRM, "
                   "services, sales, commissions, payroll, inventory, "
                   "profit and loss and reports",
        "author": cfg.author,
        "manager": cfg.author,
        "company": cfg.author,
        "category": "Business spreadsheet template",
        "keywords": ("salon spreadsheet, appointment book, client CRM, "
                     "commission calculator, inventory tracker, profit "
                     "and loss, Excel Google Sheets template"),
        "comments": (f"{cfg.product_name}. Created by {cfg.author}. "
                     f"Version {cfg.version}. Formula cells are locked "
                     f"and every sheet is protected with the password "
                     f"'{cfg.password}'. A business-organising tool - "
                     f"not accounting, payroll or tax advice."),
        "status": "Final",
        "created": _dt.datetime(cfg.today.year, cfg.today.month,
                                cfg.today.day),
    })
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/cli.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/cli.py sha256:b268566ff30b1c80d343e6733b87bd5166e7d5d5a3bdee74d2064cda9cb09dfc -->
````python
"""Command line entry point."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as _dt

from .build import build_workbook
from .config import Config


def main(argv=None) -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="build_salon_workbook",
        description="Build the Salon Business Management System workbook.")
    ap.add_argument("-o", "--output",
                    default="output/Salon Business Management System.xlsx")
    ap.add_argument("--blank", action="store_true", default=True,
                    help="no sample data - empty registers")
    ap.add_argument("--no-protect", action="store_true",
                    help="leave sheets unprotected (development only)")
    ap.add_argument("--password", default="premium")
    ap.add_argument("--author", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--currency", default="$")
    ap.add_argument("--rows", type=int, default=None,
                    help="scale registers so Sales holds N rows")
    ap.add_argument("--today", default=None,
                    help="ISO date used as 'today' for sample data")
    ap.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    cfg = Config()
    if a.blank:
        cfg.include_sample_data = False
    if a.no_protect:
        cfg.protect_sheets = False
    cfg.password = a.password
    if a.author:
        cfg.author = a.author
    cfg.currency_symbol = a.currency
    if a.rows:
        cfg.scale_rows(a.rows)
    if a.today:
        y, m, d = (int(x) for x in a.today.split("-"))
        cfg.today = _dt.date(y, m, d)

    path = build_workbook(a.output, cfg)
    if not a.quiet:
        print(path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````
