````python
"""
Configuration for the Salon Business Management System.

Everything a buyer may want to re-brand lives here, so the workbook can
be regenerated for a different shop, currency or capacity without
touching any of the sheet code.

Author of the generated workbooks: Novality Store.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import date


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Product / branding constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

AUTHOR = "Novality Store"
PRODUCT_NAME = "Salon Business Management System"
PRODUCT_SUBTITLE = (
    "Appointments, Client CRM, Services, Sales, Commissions, Payroll, "
    "Inventory, Profit & Loss and Reports for Excel and Google Sheets"
)
PRODUCT_VERSION = "1.0.0"

PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE = (
    "Salon Business Management Spreadsheet, Appointment Book & Client CRM, "
    "Commission & Payroll Calculator, Inventory & Profit Loss Tracker for "
    "Excel and Google Sheets"
)

#: Password that protects every sheet so formula cells cannot be edited
#: by accident.  Input cells stay unlocked, formula cells are locked.
FORMULA_PASSWORD = "premium"

DISCLAIMER = (
    "This spreadsheet is a business organisation and reporting tool. It is "
    "not accounting, payroll, legal or tax advice, and it does not replace "
    "your accountant or your local regulations. Tax, commission, tip and "
    "budget figures are estimates produced from the numbers you type in; "
    "rates and rules are yours to set and edit on the Settings tab. A "
    "spreadsheet organises bookings but does not send confirmations, text "
    "reminders or synchronise with salon booking platforms. No outcome of "
    "any kind is promised."
)
DISCLAIMER_SHORT = (
    "A business-organising tool - not accounting, payroll or tax advice."
)

#: The twenty tabs, in workbook order.
SHEET_TABS = [
    "1 Start Here",
    "2 Dashboard",
    "3 Appointment Planner",
    "4 Client CRM",
    "5 Services & Pricing",
    "6 Sales & Transactions",
    "7 Payments & Deposits",
    "8 Staff Management",
    "9 Staff Commissions",
    "10 Payroll & Tips",
    "11 Expenses",
    "12 Profit & Loss",
    "13 Product Inventory",
    "14 Suppliers & Purchases",
    "15 Marketing & Promotions",
    "16 Client Loyalty",
    "17 Goals & Budget",
    "18 Business Analytics",
    "19 Weekly & Monthly Reports",
    "20 Settings & Lists",
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lists that feed the drop downs (all editable on 20 Settings & Lists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

APPOINTMENT_STATUSES = ["Booked", "Confirmed", "Completed", "Cancelled",
                        "No-show"]
PAYMENT_METHODS = ["Cash", "Card", "Bank Transfer", "Gift Certificate",
                   "Other"]
PAYMENT_KINDS = ["Payment", "Deposit", "Refund"]
BOOKING_CHANNELS = ["Instagram", "Facebook", "Google", "Walk-in",
                    "Referral", "Website", "Phone", "Other"]
SERVICE_CATEGORIES = ["Hair", "Nails", "Lashes", "Brows", "Skincare",
                      "Waxing", "Other"]
EXPENSE_CATEGORIES = ["Rent", "Utilities", "Supplies", "Product Cost",
                      "Marketing", "Software", "Equipment", "Insurance",
                      "Training", "Other"]
STAFF_STATUSES = ["Active", "On Leave", "Left"]
STAFF_TYPES = ["Employee", "Contractor"]
COMMISSION_METHODS = ["Percentage", "Category", "Flat"]
TX_TYPES = ["Service", "Retail"]
PURCHASE_STATUSES = ["Ordered", "Received", "Cancelled"]
CONSENT = ["Yes", "No"]
PREF_CONTACT = ["Phone", "Text", "Email", "Any"]
RECURRING = ["Monthly", "Quarterly", "Annual", "One-time"]
PRODUCT_CATEGORIES = ["Retail", "Backbar"]
CLIENT_TIERS = ["Bronze", "Silver", "Gold"]

#: Service categories that carry their own commission rate when a staff
#: member is paid on the "Category" method (rate table on Settings).
CATEGORY_COMMISSION_DEFAULT = {
    "Hair": 0.45,
    "Nails": 0.50,
    "Lashes": 0.50,
    "Brows": 0.45,
    "Skincare": 0.40,
    "Waxing": 0.45,
    "Other": 0.40,
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Colours - salon palette: deep plum, brushed gold, warm porcelain
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Palette:
    ink = "#241F26"           # near-black plum - titles
    primary = "#6D2E4F"       # deep plum headers
    primary_mid = "#96587A"   # section bands
    primary_soft = "#F2E4EC"  # light band / alternating rows
    accent = "#B98A2F"        # brushed gold accent
    accent_soft = "#F6EBD6"
    input_bg = "#FFFCF7"      # editable cell background (porcelain)
    input_border = "#E0D3C0"
    calc_bg = "#EFEAEE"       # locked formula cell background
    calc_border = "#DCD3DA"
    white = "#FFFFFF"
    grey_text = "#5F5760"
    line = "#D8CFD6"
    good_bg = "#DCEBD8"
    good_text = "#2F5A2B"
    warn_bg = "#FDEDD2"
    warn_text = "#8A5A00"
    bad_bg = "#F8DAD9"
    bad_text = "#9C2A24"
    info_bg = "#E2E6F3"
    info_text = "#3A4578"
    note_bg = "#F8F6F4"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Row capacity of every register
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DEFAULT_ROWS = {
    "3 Appointment Planner": 400,
    "4 Client CRM": 250,
    "5 Services & Pricing": 80,
    "6 Sales & Transactions": 600,
    "7 Payments & Deposits": 600,
    "8 Staff Management": 30,
    "10 Payroll & Tips": 300,
    "11 Expenses": 400,
    "13 Product Inventory": 150,
    "14 Suppliers & Purchases": 150,
    "15 Marketing & Promotions": 80,
    "16 Client Loyalty": 250,
    "17 Goals & Budget": 24,
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The configuration object every sheet module reads
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Config:
    """Everything the generator needs to know to write one workbook."""

    author: str = AUTHOR
    product_name: str = PRODUCT_NAME
    product_subtitle: str = PRODUCT_SUBTITLE
    listing_title: str = PRODUCT_LISTING_TITLE
    version: str = PRODUCT_VERSION
    password: str = FORMULA_PASSWORD
    protect_sheets: bool = True
    include_sample_data: bool = False

    # Formatting ------------------------------------------------------------
    currency_symbol: str = "$"
    currency_code: str = "USD"
    date_format: str = "dd-mmm-yyyy"
    time_format: str = "h:mm AM/PM"
    decimals: int = 2

    # Business defaults (written to Settings, all editable) -----------------
    salon_name: str = ""
    owner_name: str = ""
    tax_rate: float = 0.00            # configurable, region dependent
    tax_reserve_rate: float = 0.25    # share of profit set aside
    payroll_tax_rate: float = 0.10    # employer-side reserve
    card_fee_rate: float = 0.022
    cash_fee_rate: float = 0.00
    bank_fee_rate: float = 0.005
    other_fee_rate: float = 0.01
    points_per_visit: float = 10.0
    reward_threshold: float = 100.0
    referral_reward: float = 10.0
    rebook_days: int = 42
    flat_commission: float = 18.0     # per completed service, Flat method

    # Behaviour -------------------------------------------------------------
    rows: dict = field(default_factory=lambda: dict(DEFAULT_ROWS))
    today: date = field(default_factory=date.today)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    def row_count(self, sheet: str) -> int:
        return int(self.rows.get(sheet, 100))

    def scale_rows(self, sales_rows: int) -> None:
        """Scale every register in place so Sales holds N rows."""
        base = DEFAULT_ROWS["6 Sales & Transactions"]
        factor = max(0.02, float(sales_rows) / float(base))
        self.rows = {k: (max(5, int(round(v * factor))) if v else v)
                     for k, v in self.rows.items()}

    def scaled(self, factor: float) -> "Config":
        rows = {k: max(5, int(round(v * factor))) if v else v
                for k, v in self.rows.items()}
        return replace(self, rows=rows)

    # Number format strings --------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def money_format(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'{s}#,##0.00;[Red]-{s}#,##0.00'

    @property
    def money_format_0(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'{s}#,##0;[Red]-{s}#,##0'

    @property
    def money_format_4(self) -> str:
        s = self.currency_symbol
        return f'{s}#,##0.0000;[Red]-{s}#,##0.0000'
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/formats.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/formats.py sha256:34058d15bcad67a1572f6bacaeaee7e4f6d62fc7237d0674d110f029b00b5ddc -->
````python
"""
Cell format factory.

Two things matter here:

* **Input cells** are unlocked (``locked: False``) and painted cream, so the
  user can type in them while the sheet is protected.
* **Formula cells** are locked (``locked: True``) and painted cool grey.  With
  the sheet protection password in place ("premium" by default) they cannot be
  overwritten by accident.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict

from .config import Config, Palette

P = Palette

INPUT = "input"
CALC = "calc"
PLAIN = "plain"


class FormatBook:
    """Creates (and caches) every :class:`xlsxwriter.format.Format` used."""

    def __init__(self, book, config: Config) -> None:
        self.book = book
        self.cfg = config
        self._cache: Dict[Any, Any] = {}

        money = config.money_format
        money0 = config.money_format_0
        money4 = config.money_format_4
        self._styles: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            "text": {"align": "left"},
            "id": {"align": "left", "bold": True, "font_color": P.primary},
            "wrap": {"align": "left", "valign": "top", "text_wrap": True},
            "date": {"num_format": config.date_format, "align": "center"},
            "time": {"num_format": config.time_format, "align": "center"},
            "money": {"num_format": money, "align": "right"},
            "money0": {"num_format": money0, "align": "right"},
            "money4": {"num_format": money4, "align": "right"},
            "number": {"num_format": "#,##0.00", "align": "right"},
            "number1": {"num_format": "#,##0.0", "align": "right"},
            "int": {"num_format": "#,##0", "align": "right"},
            "percent": {"num_format": "0.0%", "align": "center"},
            "percent0": {"num_format": "0%", "align": "center"},
            "rating": {"num_format": "0", "align": "center"},
            "flag": {"align": "center"},
            "status": {"align": "center", "bold": True},
            "link": {"align": "left", "font_color": P.info_text,
                     "underline": 1},
        }

        self._modes: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            INPUT: {"locked": False, "bg_color": P.input_bg,
                    "border": 1, "border_color": P.input_border},
            CALC: {"locked": True, "bg_color": P.calc_bg,
                   "border": 1, "border_color": P.calc_border,
                   "font_color": P.ink},
            PLAIN: {"locked": True},
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ core
    def _make(self, props: Dict[str, Any]):
        key = tuple(sorted((k, str(v)) for k, v in props.items()))
        if key not in self._cache:
            self._cache[key] = self.book.add_format(props)
        return self._cache[key]

    def cell(self, style: str = "text", mode: str = INPUT, **extra):
        """Data cell format: `style` = value type, `mode` = input/calc/plain."""
        props: Dict[str, Any] = {"font_name": "Calibri", "font_size": 10,
                                 "valign": "vcenter"}
        props.update(self._modes[mode])
        props.update(self._styles.get(style, {}))
        props.update(extra)
        return self._make(props)

    def input(self, style: str = "text", **extra):
        return self.cell(style, INPUT, **extra)

    def calc(self, style: str = "text", **extra):
        return self.cell(style, CALC, **extra)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- chrome
    def chrome(self, name: str, **extra):
        base: Dict[str, Any] = {"font_name": "Calibri", "font_size": 10,
                                "locked": True, "valign": "vcenter"}
        styles: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
            "title": {"font_size": 18, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                      "bg_color": P.primary, "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "title_right": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "right", "indent": 1},
            "subtitle": {"font_size": 10, "italic": True,
                         "font_color": P.grey_text, "bg_color": P.note_bg,
                         "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "nav": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True, "font_color": P.info_text,
                    "bg_color": P.note_bg, "underline": 1, "align": "left",
                    "indent": 1},
            "nav_plain": {"font_size": 9, "font_color": P.grey_text,
                          "bg_color": P.note_bg, "align": "left"},
            "section": {"font_size": 11, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                        "bg_color": P.primary_mid, "align": "left",
                        "indent": 1},
            "subsection": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                           "font_color": P.primary, "bg_color": P.primary_soft,
                           "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "header": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True, "font_color": P.white,
                       "bg_color": P.primary, "align": "center",
                       "valign": "vcenter", "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                       "border_color": P.primary},
            "header_left": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "left", "valign": "vcenter",
                            "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                            "border_color": P.primary, "indent": 1},
            "label": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "indent": 1,
                      "font_color": P.ink},
            "label_bold": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True, "align": "left",
                           "indent": 1, "font_color": P.ink},
            "label_right": {"font_size": 10, "align": "right",
                            "font_color": P.ink},
            "note": {"font_size": 9, "italic": True,
                     "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "left",
                     "text_wrap": True, "valign": "top"},
            "note_box": {"font_size": 9, "font_color": P.ink,
                         "bg_color": P.accent_soft, "align": "left",
                         "valign": "top", "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.accent, "indent": 1},
            "kpi_label": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                          "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary_mid,
                          "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "kpi_value": {"font_size": 16, "bold": True,
                          "font_color": P.ink, "bg_color": P.white,
                          "align": "center", "valign": "vcenter",
                          "border": 1, "border_color": P.line},
            "kpi_note": {"font_size": 8, "italic": True,
                         "font_color": P.grey_text, "bg_color": P.white,
                         "align": "center", "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.line},
            "total_label": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "left", "indent": 1},
            "total_value": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.white, "bg_color": P.primary,
                            "align": "right"},
            "form_label": {"font_size": 10, "bold": True, "align": "left",
                           "font_color": P.primary, "bottom": 1,
                           "bottom_color": P.line, "indent": 1},
            "form_line": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "bottom": 1,
                          "bottom_color": P.ink, "locked": False},
            "form_box": {"font_size": 10, "align": "left", "valign": "top",
                         "text_wrap": True, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.ink, "locked": False},
            "print_title": {"font_size": 16, "bold": True,
                            "font_color": P.primary, "align": "left"},
            "print_sub": {"font_size": 10, "italic": True,
                          "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "left"},
            "legend_input": {"font_size": 9, "bg_color": P.input_bg,
                             "border": 1, "border_color": P.input_border,
                             "align": "center"},
            "legend_calc": {"font_size": 9, "bg_color": P.calc_bg,
                            "border": 1, "border_color": P.calc_border,
                            "align": "center"},
            "band": {"bg_color": P.primary_soft},
            "rule": {"bottom": 2, "bottom_color": P.primary},
            "legend_label": {"font_size": 9, "bold": True,
                             "font_color": P.grey_text, "align": "right"},
            "day_number": {"font_size": 11, "bold": True,
                           "font_color": P.primary,
                           "bg_color": P.primary_soft, "align": "left",
                           "indent": 1, "num_format": "d ddd",
                           "border": 1, "border_color": P.line},
            "day_item": {"font_size": 8, "font_color": P.ink,
                         "align": "left", "indent": 1, "border": 1,
                         "border_color": P.line, "bg_color": P.white},
        }
        props = dict(base)
        props.update(styles.get(name, {}))
        props.update(extra)
        return self._make(props)

    # -------------------------------------------------- conditional formats
    def cf(self, kind: str):
        """Formats used by conditional formatting rules."""
        palettes = {
            "good": {"bg_color": P.good_bg, "font_color": P.good_text},
            "warn": {"bg_color": P.warn_bg, "font_color": P.warn_text},
            "bad": {"bg_color": P.bad_bg, "font_color": P.bad_text},
            "info": {"bg_color": P.info_bg, "font_color": P.info_text},
            "muted": {"font_color": P.grey_text, "italic": True},
            "bold_bad": {"bg_color": P.bad_bg, "font_color": P.bad_text,
                         "bold": True},
            "bold_good": {"bg_color": P.good_bg, "font_color": P.good_text,
                          "bold": True},
        }
        return self._make(palettes[kind])
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/layout.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/layout.py sha256:3f85dc5068cb03c7bb7f378578ee4e2d7daa87c32d99d2df0fbee7871d0ed0fd -->
````python
"""
Layout engine.

The workbook is described declaratively: every register sheet (Clients,
Properties, Jobs, Invoices, ...) is a :class:`SheetSpec` of :class:`Col`
objects.  Formulas are written as templates that never contain hard coded
column letters, so columns can be reordered or inserted without breaking a
single formula:

    "=IF({client}{r}="","",SUMIFS([[Payments.amount]],[[Payments.invoice]],{id}{r}))"

    {r}            -> the current Excel row number (1 based)
    {key}          -> column letter of the column `key` on the *same* sheet
    [[Sheet.key]]  -> absolute range of that column's data rows, e.g.
                      'Job Costing'!$K$5:$K$504
    [[Sheet.key#r]]-> absolute single cell of that column on row r
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import string
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence

# Row 1 title, row 2 strapline, row 3 navigation, row 4 headers, row 5+ data.
TITLE_ROW = 1
SUBTITLE_ROW = 2
NAV_ROW = 3
HEADER_ROW = 4
DATA_ROW = 5


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A1 helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def col_letter(index: int) -> str:
    """0 based column index -> Excel column letter."""
    letters = ""
    index += 1
    while index:
        index, rem = divmod(index - 1, 26)
        letters = string.ascii_uppercase[rem] + letters
    return letters


def quote_sheet(name: str) -> str:
    """Quote a sheet name for use inside a formula when it needs it."""
    if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*$", name):
        return name
    return "'" + name.replace("'", "''") + "'"


def cell_ref(col: int, row: int, absolute: bool = True) -> str:
    dollar = "$" if absolute else ""
    return f"{dollar}{col_letter(col)}{dollar}{row}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Column / sheet specifications
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Col:
    """One column of a register sheet."""

    key: str
    header: str
    width: float = 14.0
    style: str = "text"              # key into the format book (see formats.py)
    formula: Optional[str] = None    # template -> locked, calculated column
    validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    note: Optional[str] = None       # help text shown when the cell is selected
    cf: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    hidden: bool = False
    group: str = ""                  # section label (documentation only)

    @property
    def is_formula(self) -> bool:
        return self.formula is not None


@dataclass
class SheetSpec:
    """A register sheet: title band, header row and N pre-built data rows."""

    name: str
    title: str
    subtitle: str = ""
    columns: List[Col] = field(default_factory=list)
    rows: int = 100
    header_row: int = HEADER_ROW        # 1 based Excel row of the header
    tab_color: Optional[str] = None
    freeze_cols: int = 2
    freeze_at: Optional[int] = None   # 1 based row to freeze below
    samples: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    help_text: str = ""
    extra_notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
    @property
    def first_data_row(self) -> int:
        return self.header_row + 1

    @property
    def last_data_row(self) -> int:
        return self.header_row + self.rows

    def index(self, key: str) -> int:
        for i, col in enumerate(self.columns):
            if col.key == key:
                return i
        raise KeyError(f"{self.name}: unknown column '{key}'")

    def letter(self, key: str) -> str:
        return col_letter(self.index(key))

    def col(self, key: str) -> Col:
        return self.columns[self.index(key)]

    @property
    def last_col_index(self) -> int:
        return len(self.columns) - 1


class Registry:
    """Lookup table of every registered :class:`SheetSpec`."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._specs: Dict[str, SheetSpec] = {}

    def add(self, spec: SheetSpec) -> SheetSpec:
        self._specs[spec.name] = spec
        return spec

    def __contains__(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return name in self._specs

    def __getitem__(self, name: str) -> SheetSpec:
        return self._specs[name]

    def names(self) -> Sequence[str]:
        return list(self._specs)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ references
    def rng(self, sheet: str, key: str, first: Optional[int] = None,
            last: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
        spec = self._specs[sheet]
        letter = spec.letter(key)
        first = first or spec.first_data_row
        last = last or spec.last_data_row
        return f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first}:${letter}${last}"

    def cell(self, sheet: str, key: str, row: int) -> str:
        spec = self._specs[sheet]
        return f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${spec.letter(key)}${row}"

    def letter(self, sheet: str, key: str) -> str:
        return self._specs[sheet].letter(key)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- renderer
    _REF = re.compile(r"\[\[([^\].#]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)(?:#(\d*))?\]\]")

    def render(self, template: str, row: Optional[int] = None,
               spec: Optional[SheetSpec] = None) -> str:
        """Expand [[Sheet.key]] and {key}/{r} tokens into a real formula."""

        def _ref(match: "re.Match[str]") -> str:
            sheet, key, single = match.group(1), match.group(2), match.group(3)
            if single:
                return self.cell(sheet, key, int(single))
            if single == "":
                # [[Sheet.key#]] -> same row as the formula being written
                if row is None:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"[[{sheet}.{key}#]] needs a row context")
                return self.cell(sheet, key, row)
            return self.rng(sheet, key)

        text = self._REF.sub(_ref, template)

        if spec is not None:
            mapping: Dict[str, Any] = {c.key: spec.letter(c.key)
                                       for c in spec.columns}
            # `{key_first}` / `{key_last}` give the absolute top and bottom
            # of a column on the same sheet, so an in-sheet COUNTIFS reads
            # `{key_first}:{key_last}` instead of a hand built $D$5:$D$104.
            for col in spec.columns:
                letter = spec.letter(col.key)
                mapping[f"{col.key}_first"] = (
                    f"${letter}${spec.first_data_row}")
                mapping[f"{col.key}_last"] = (
                    f"${letter}${spec.last_data_row}")
            if row is not None:
                mapping["r"] = row
                mapping["r_prev"] = row - 1
            mapping["first"] = spec.first_data_row
            mapping["last"] = spec.last_data_row
            text = text.format(**mapping)
        elif row is not None:
            text = text.format(r=row)
        return text


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reusable formula fragments
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def max_if(value_range: str, *conditions: str) -> str:
    """MAX of `value_range` where all conditions hold (no CSE required)."""
    cond = "*".join(f"({c})" for c in conditions)
    return f"SUMPRODUCT(MAX({cond}*{value_range}))"


def min_if(value_range: str, *conditions: str, sentinel: int = 2958465) -> str:
    """MIN of `value_range` where all conditions hold (no CSE required).

    Non matching rows are swapped for a sentinel (31-Dec-9999 as a serial) so
    that MIN ignores them.  Returns the sentinel when nothing matches, so the
    caller should wrap the result in an IF test.
    """
    cond = "*".join(f"({c})" for c in conditions)
    return (f"SUMPRODUCT(MIN({cond}*{value_range}"
            f"+(1-{cond})*{sentinel}))")


def blank_if(test: str, result: str) -> str:
    return f'IF({test},"",{result})'


def safe(expr: str, fallback: str = '""') -> str:
    return f"IFERROR({expr},{fallback})"


def lookup(value: str, table_range: str, index_range: str,
           fallback: str = '""') -> str:
    """INDEX/MATCH lookup (works left or right, unlike VLOOKUP)."""
    return f"IFERROR(INDEX({index_range},MATCH({value},{table_range},0)),{fallback})"


def dynamic_name(sheet: str, letter: str, first: int, last: int,
                 count_text: bool = True) -> str:
    """OFFSET based defined name that grows with the populated rows."""
    rng = f"{quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first}:${letter}${last}"
    counter = f'COUNTIF({rng},"?*")' if count_text else f"COUNTA({rng})"
    return (f"=OFFSET({quote_sheet(sheet)}!${letter}${first},0,0,"
            f"MAX(1,{counter}),1)")


def join_nonblank(parts: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    """Build `a & b & c` style concatenation."""
    return "&".join(parts)
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/names.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/names.py sha256:16737195a34b0568175b873ddd3cd1315fa5923e0c6279bf51643e741b16a373 -->
````python
"""Workbook level defined names.

Two families:

* **Dynamic** (OFFSET + COUNTIF) names back the drop downs, so a new
  client, service, product or supplier appears in every list the moment
  it is typed.
* **Static** full-column names back the aggregations (SUMIFS, COUNTIFS,
  SUMPRODUCT masks).  Whole-column ranges always agree in size, which is
  what keeps SUMIFS from ever returning #VALUE.

The static lists on `20 Settings & Lists` define their own names when
that tab is built.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Dict, Tuple

from .layout import Registry, dynamic_name

#: defined name -> (sheet, column key, dynamic?)
CROSS_SHEET_NAMES: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str, bool]] = {
    # drop down sources (dynamic)
    "ServiceNames": ("5 Services & Pricing", "name", True),
    "ProductNames": ("13 Product Inventory", "name", True),
    "StaffNames": ("8 Staff Management", "name", True),
    "ClientNames": ("4 Client CRM", "name", True),
    "SupplierNames": ("14 Suppliers & Purchases", "sup_name", True),

    # services
    "ServiceCat": ("5 Services & Pricing", "category", False),
    "ServicePrice": ("5 Services & Pricing", "price", False),
    "ServiceDur": ("5 Services & Pricing", "duration", False),
    "ServiceTaxable": ("5 Services & Pricing", "taxable", False),
    "RevenueAll": ("5 Services & Pricing", "revenue", False),
    "ServiceRank": ("5 Services & Pricing", "rank", False),
    "ServiceSold": ("5 Services & Pricing", "sold", False),

    # products
    "ProductRetail": ("13 Product Inventory", "retail", False),
    "ProductTaxable": ("13 Product Inventory", "taxable", False),
    "InvOnHand": ("13 Product Inventory", "on_hand", False),
    "InvLow": ("13 Product Inventory", "low", False),
    "InvValue": ("13 Product Inventory", "value", False),

    # staff
    "StaffMethod": ("8 Staff Management", "method", False),
    "StaffSvcRate": ("8 Staff Management", "svc_rate", False),
    "StaffRetRate": ("8 Staff Management", "retail_rate", False),
    "StaffHourly": ("8 Staff Management", "hourly", False),
    "StaffRevenue": ("8 Staff Management", "revenue", False),

    # clients
    "ClientVisits": ("4 Client CRM", "visits", False),
    "ClientReferrals": ("4 Client CRM", "referrals", False),
    "ClientSource": ("4 Client CRM", "source", False),
    "ClientStatus": ("4 Client CRM", "status", False),
    "ClientLast": ("4 Client CRM", "last", False),
    "ClientFirst": ("4 Client CRM", "first", False),

    # appointments
    "ApptIds": ("3 Appointment Planner", "id", False),
    "ApptDates": ("3 Appointment Planner", "date", False),
    "ApptClients": ("3 Appointment Planner", "client", False),
    "ApptStaff": ("3 Appointment Planner", "staff", False),
    "ApptService": ("3 Appointment Planner", "service", False),
    "ApptStatus": ("3 Appointment Planner", "status", False),
    "ApptDone": ("3 Appointment Planner", "done", False),
    "ApptKeys": ("3 Appointment Planner", "key", False),
    "ApptDeposit": ("3 Appointment Planner", "deposit", False),
    "ApptFollow": ("3 Appointment Planner", "followup", False),

    # sales
    "SalesDates": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "date", False),
    "SalesClients": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "client", False),
    "SalesStaff": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "staff", False),
    "SalesType": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "type", False),
    "SalesItem": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "item", False),
    "SalesQty": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "qty", False),
    "SalesNet": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "net", False),
    "SalesDisc": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "discount", False),
    "SalesRefund": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "refund", False),
    "SalesTax": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "tax", False),
    "SalesBalance": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "balance", False),
    "SalesFee": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "fee", False),
    "SalesCat": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "cat", False),
    "SalesRate": ("6 Sales & Transactions", "rate", False),

    # payments
    "PayDates": ("7 Payments & Deposits", "date", False),
    "PayKind": ("7 Payments & Deposits", "kind", False),
    "PayAmount": ("7 Payments & Deposits", "amount", False),
    "PayLinkStatus": ("7 Payments & Deposits", "link_status", False),

    # purchases / inventory flow
    "PurchDates": ("14 Suppliers & Purchases", "date", False),
    "PurchProduct": ("14 Suppliers & Purchases", "product", False),
    "PurchQty": ("14 Suppliers & Purchases", "qty", False),
    "PurchStatus": ("14 Suppliers & Purchases", "status", False),
    "PurchTotal": ("14 Suppliers & Purchases", "total", False),

    # expenses
    "ExpDates": ("11 Expenses", "date", False),
    "ExpCat": ("11 Expenses", "category", False),
    "ExpAmount": ("11 Expenses", "amount", False),

    # payroll
    "PayrollDates": ("10 Payroll & Tips", "date", False),
    "PayrollStaff": ("10 Payroll & Tips", "staff", False),
    "PayrollHours": ("10 Payroll & Tips", "hours", False),
    "PayrollCost": ("10 Payroll & Tips", "total_cost", False),
    "PayrollTipsIn": ("10 Payroll & Tips", "tips_in", False),
}


def define_cross_sheet_names(book, reg: Registry) -> None:
    """Create every lookup name. Call after all registers are built."""
    for name, (sheet, key, dynamic) in CROSS_SHEET_NAMES.items():
        if sheet not in reg:
            continue
        spec = reg[sheet]
        if key not in [c.key for c in spec.columns]:
            continue
        if dynamic:
            book.define_name(
                name,
                dynamic_name(sheet, spec.letter(key), spec.first_data_row,
                             spec.last_data_row))
        else:
            book.define_name(name, reg.rng(sheet, key))
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/analytics.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/analytics.py sha256:18711a02bd969903fd2d8cd71546d3206db8f0fb1974b1455ec1393973c4fb78 -->
````python
"""18 Business Analytics - retention, popularity and trends."""

from __future__ import annotations

from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from ..config import Config, BOOKING_CHANNELS
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "18 Business Analytics"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color="#96587A", landscape=False)
    last = 9
    sheet.banner("18  Business Analytics",
                 "Who comes back, what sells, who earns it - the patterns "
                 "behind the month.", last)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "RETENTION", last)
    tiles = [
        ("Repeat-client rate",
         '=IF(COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,">=1")=0,"-",COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,'
         '">1")/COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,">=1"))', "percent0",
         "clients with 2+ visits"),
        ("Active clients", '=COUNTIFS(ClientStatus,"Active")', "int",
         "inside rebooking window"),
        ("Lapsed clients", '=COUNTIFS(ClientStatus,"Lapsed")', "int",
         "your win-back list"),
        ("New clients (30d)",
         f'=SUMPRODUCT(({C.ym_mask("ClientFirst", C.cur_ym())}))',
         "int", "first visits this month"),
        ("Avg visits per client",
         '=IF(COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,">=1")=0,"-",ROUND(SUM(ClientVisits)/'
         'COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,">=1"),1))', "number1", "recorded visits"),
        ("Retail attach rate",
         '=IF(SUM(ApptDone)=0,"-",COUNTIFS(SalesType,"Retail")/'
         'SUM(ApptDone))', "percent0", "retail lines per completed visit"),
    ]
    col = 0
    for i, (label, formula, style, note) in enumerate(tiles):
        sheet.kpi(row, col, label, formula, style=style, span=3, note=note)
        col += 5
        if i % 2 == 1:
            col = 0
            row += 3
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "NEW CLIENTS BY SOURCE", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Channel", "New clients", "Share"])
    for i, ch in enumerate(BOOKING_CHANNELS):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, ch, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=COUNTIFS(ClientSource,$A{r})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=IF(SUM($B${row + 1}:$B${row + len(BOOKING_CHANNELS)})=0,"",$B{r}/SUM($B${row + 1}:$B${row + len(BOOKING_CHANNELS)}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("percent0"))
    row += len(BOOKING_CHANNELS) + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "SERVICE POPULARITY - TOP TEN", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Rank", "Service", "Times sold", "Revenue",
                              "Share of revenue"])
    for i in range(10):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, i + 1, sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceNames,MATCH({i + 1},'
                            f'ServiceRank,0)),"-")', sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=IF($B{r}="-","",IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceSold,'
                            f'MATCH($B{r},ServiceNames,0)),""))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=IF($B{r}="-","",IFERROR(INDEX(RevenueAll,'
                            f'MATCH($B{r},ServiceNames,0)),""))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 4, f'=IF(OR($B{r}="-",SUM(RevenueAll)=0),"",'
                            f'$D{r}/SUM(RevenueAll))',
                      sheet.f.calc("percent0"))
    row += 12

    row = sheet.section(row, "BOOKING OUTCOMES", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Status", "Count", "Share of finalised"])
    statuses = ["Completed", "Cancelled", "No-show", "Booked", "Confirmed"]
    for i, st in enumerate(statuses):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, st, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,$A{r})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2,
                      f'=IF($A{r}="Booked",IF(SUM(ApptDone)+COUNTIFS('
                      f'ApptStatus,"Cancelled")+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,'
                      f'"No-show")=0,"","open"),IF(SUM(ApptDone)+'
                      f'COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Cancelled")+COUNTIFS('
                      f'ApptStatus,"No-show")=0,"",$B{r}/(SUM(ApptDone)+'
                      f'COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Cancelled")+COUNTIFS('
                      f'ApptStatus,"No-show"))))',
                      sheet.f.calc("percent0"))
    row += len(statuses) + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "TWELVE-MONTH CLIENT & REVENUE TREND", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Month", "New clients", "Revenue",
                              "Appointments"])
    for k in range(12):
        r = row + 1 + k
        ym = f'TEXT(EDATE(TODAY(),-{11 - k}),"yyyy-mm")'
        sheet.formula(r, 0, f'={ym}', sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=SUMPRODUCT('
                            f'{C.ym_mask("ClientFirst", f"$A{r}")})',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                            f'{C.ym_mask("SalesDates", f"$A{r}")}'
                            f'*SalesNet),2)', sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=SUMPRODUCT('
                            f'{C.ym_mask("ApptDates", f"$A{r}")}*ApptDone)',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
    row += 14
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last, row)
    sheet.finish(print_area=f"A1:{xl_col_to_name(last)}{row + 2}")
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

"""3 Appointment Planner - the booking register."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import cf_text, date_check, list_from, number_check, \
    time_check
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "3 Appointment Planner"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="3  Appointment Planner",
        subtitle="One row per booking - category, duration and price fill "
                 "themselves from the service menu.",
        tab_color="#6D2E4F",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=4,
        help_text="Type the date, time, client, staff and service (drop "
                  "downs), then the status as the booking moves. Deposit "
                  "is money taken before the visit; balance due is what "
                  "is left to collect.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "Appt ID", 10, "id",
                formula='="A-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"0000")'),
            Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("time", "Time", 9, "time", validate=time_check()),
            Col("client", "Client", 20, "text",
                validate=list_from("ClientNames"),
                note="Pick from the client list - new clients are added "
                     "on tab 4 and appear here at once."),
            Col("staff", "Staff", 16, "text",
                validate=list_from("StaffNames")),
            Col("service", "Service", 26, "text",
                validate=list_from("ServiceNames")),
            Col("category", "Category", 11, "text",
                formula='IF({service}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceCat,'
                        'MATCH({service}{r},ServiceNames,0)),""))'),
            Col("duration", "Mins", 7, "int",
                formula='IF({service}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceDur,'
                        'MATCH({service}{r},ServiceNames,0)),""))'),
            Col("price", "Price", 10, "money",
                formula='IF({service}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX('
                        'ServicePrice,MATCH({service}{r},ServiceNames,0)),'
                        '""))'),
            Col("status", "Status", 11, "status",
                validate=list_from("ListStatus"),
                cf=[cf_text("No-show", "bad"), cf_text("Cancelled", "warn"),
                    cf_text("Completed", "good")],
                note="Booked / Confirmed are open. Completed, Cancelled "
                     "and No-show are final and feed every KPI."),
            Col("deposit", "Deposit", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000)),
            Col("balance", "Balance due", 11, "money",
                formula='IF({price}{r}="","",ROUND(N({price}{r})'
                        '-N({deposit}{r}),2))'),
            Col("source", "Booked via", 12, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListChannels")),
            Col("walkin", "Walk-in", 9, "flag",
                validate=list_from("ListConsent")),
            Col("cancel_reason", "Cancellation reason", 24, "wrap"),
            Col("rescheduled", "Rescheduled from", 16, "text",
                note="Original date/time when you move a booking."),
            Col("followup", "Rebook reminder", 14, "date",
                formula='IF(OR({date}{r}="",{status}{r}<>"Completed"),"",'
                        '{date}{r}+RebookDays)',
                note="Visit date + the rebooking interval from Settings."),
            Col("final", "final", 6, "flag", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({status}{r}="","",IF(OR({status}{r}='
                        '"Completed",{status}{r}="Cancelled",{status}{r}='
                        '"No-show"),1,0))'),
            Col("done", "done", 6, "flag", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({status}{r}="Completed",1,0)'),
            Col("key", "key", 14, "text", hidden=True,
                formula='IF(OR({client}{r}="",{date}{r}=""),"",'
                        '{client}{r}&"|"&TEXT({date}{r},"yyyymmdd"))'),
            Col("notes", "Notes & preferences", 34, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.appointment_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
        extra_notes=[
            "A deposit is not revenue until the visit is completed and "
            "invoiced on tab 6 - the dashboard keeps unearned deposits "
            "separate.",
            "Double-booking check: filter by staff and date, sorted by "
            "time; the duration column shows the slot each booking holds.",
        ],
    )

"""4 Client CRM - profiles, history and rebooking prompts."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec, max_if, min_if
from ..writer import cf_text, date_check, list_from, number_check
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "4 Client CRM"
SENT = 2958465


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="4  Client CRM",
        subtitle="Every client's history, value and next-visit prompt - "
                 "calculated from the appointment and sales registers.",
        tab_color="#96587A",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text="Type the contact details once. First visit, last "
                  "visit, visits, lifetime spend and the most recent "
                  "service all come from tabs 3 and 6.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "Client ID", 10, "id",
                formula='="C-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"0000")'),
            Col("name", "Client name", 22, "text",
                note="Use the same spelling everywhere - the drop downs "
                     "and lookups match on this text."),
            Col("phone", "Phone", 15, "text"),
            Col("email", "Email", 26, "text"),
            Col("pref", "Prefers", 9, "flag",
                validate=list_from("ListPrefContact")),
            Col("source", "Found you via", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListChannels")),
            Col("birthday", "Birthday", 12, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("first", "First visit", 12, "date",
                formula='IF({name}{r}="","",IF(' +
                        min_if("ApptDates", 'ApptClients={name}{r}',
                               'ApptDates>0', sentinel=SENT) +
                        f'>={SENT},"",' +
                        min_if("ApptDates", 'ApptClients={name}{r}',
                               'ApptDates>0', sentinel=SENT) + '))'),
            Col("last", "Last visit", 12, "date",
                formula='IF({name}{r}="","",IF(' +
                        max_if("ApptDates", 'ApptClients={name}{r}',
                               'ApptDone=1') + '="","",' +
                        max_if("ApptDates", 'ApptClients={name}{r}',
                               'ApptDone=1') + '))'),
            Col("visits", "Visits", 7, "int",
                formula='IF({name}{r}="","",COUNTIFS(ApptClients,'
                        '{name}{r},ApptStatus,"Completed"))'),
            Col("spend", "Lifetime spend", 13, "money",
                formula='IF({name}{r}="","",ROUND(SUMIFS(SalesNet,'
                        'SalesClients,{name}{r}),2))'),
            Col("last_service", "Last service", 24, "text",
                formula='IF(OR({name}{r}="",{last}{r}=""),"",'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX(ApptService,MATCH({name}{r}&"|"&'
                        'TEXT({last}{r},"yyyymmdd"),ApptKeys,0)),""))'),
            Col("days_since", "Days since", 9, "int",
                formula='IF({last}{r}="","",TODAY()-{last}{r})'),
            Col("next_due", "Next booking due", 14, "date",
                formula='IF({last}{r}="","",{last}{r}+RebookDays)'),
            Col("status", "Status", 9, "status",
                formula='IF({last}{r}="","",IF({days_since}{r}<='
                        'RebookDays,IF({visits}{r}<=1,"New","Active"),'
                        '"Lapsed"))',
                cf=[cf_text("Lapsed", "warn"), cf_text("New", "info"),
                    cf_text("Active", "good")]),
            Col("referrals", "Referrals sent", 9, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 999, False)),
            Col("feedback", "Feedback & satisfaction", 30, "wrap"),
            Col("consent_comm", "Marketing consent", 11, "flag",
                validate=list_from("ListConsent"),
                cf=[cf_text("No", "warn")]),
            Col("consent_photos", "Photo consent", 10, "flag",
                validate=list_from("ListConsent"),
                cf=[cf_text("No", "warn")]),
            Col("notes", "Preferences & allergies", 34, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.client_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
        extra_notes=[
            "Status: New = one visit, Active = inside the rebooking "
            "window, Lapsed = overdue. Filter on Lapsed for your win-back "
            "list.",
            "Consent columns are your record for messages and photos - "
            "check them before every campaign.",
        ],
    )

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/commissions.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/commissions.py sha256:ab624eeec8b6f46463725ec86e398d225205140b61b274835fc4dba0e70378ba -->
````python
"""9 Staff Commissions - statements per person, method aware."""

from __future__ import annotations

from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from ..config import Config
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "9 Staff Commissions"
STAFF_ROWS = 12


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color="#96587A", landscape=False)
    last = 10
    sheet.banner("9  Staff Commissions",
                 "One statement per person - service commission at the "
                 "applicable rate, retail commission, tips and "
                 "adjustments.", last)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "HOW EACH METHOD PAYS", last)
    for line in [
        "Percentage - the staff member's own service % and retail % from "
        "tab 8.",
        "Category - the category rate table on tab 20 applies per sale, "
        "so hair and lashes can pay differently.",
        "Flat - a fixed amount per completed appointment (Settings), "
        "plus their retail %.",
        "Tips are reported from tab 10; adjustments are yours to type "
        "with an approval note.",
    ]:
        row = sheet.note(row, line, last) + 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "COMMISSION STATEMENTS", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Staff", "Method", "Service revenue",
                              "Retail revenue", "Service commission",
                              "Retail commission", "Flat element",
                              "Tips paid out", "Adjustment", "Total due",
                              "Approved by / notes"])
    first = row + 1
    for i in range(STAFF_ROWS):
        r = first + i
        sheet.formula(r, 0, f'=IFERROR(INDEX(StaffNames,{i + 1}),"")',
                      sheet.f.calc("text", bold=True))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=IF($A{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(StaffMethod,'
                            f'MATCH($A{r},StaffNames,0)),""))',
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=IF($A{r}="","",ROUND(SUMIFS(SalesNet,'
                            f'SalesStaff,$A{r},SalesType,"Service"),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=IF($A{r}="","",ROUND(SUMIFS(SalesNet,'
                            f'SalesStaff,$A{r},SalesType,"Retail"),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 4, f'=IF($A{r}="","",ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                            f'(SalesStaff=$A{r})*(SalesType="Service")'
                            f'*SalesNet*SalesRate),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 5, f'=IF($A{r}="","",ROUND(IFERROR(INDEX('
                            f'StaffRetRate,MATCH($A{r},StaffNames,0)),0)'
                            f'*SUMPRODUCT((SalesStaff=$A{r})*'
                            f'(SalesType="Retail")*SalesNet),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 6, f'=IF($A{r}="","",IF($B{r}="Flat",'
                            f'FlatCommission*COUNTIFS(ApptStaff,$A{r},'
                            f'ApptStatus,"Completed"),0))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 7, f'=IF($A{r}="","",ROUND(SUMIFS(PayrollTipsOut,'
                            f'PayrollStaff,$A{r}),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.write(r, 8, None, sheet.f.input("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 9, f'=IF($A{r}="","",ROUND(N($E{r})+N($F{r})'
                            f'+N($G{r})+N($I{r}),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money", bold=True))
        sheet.write(r, 10, None, sheet.f.input("wrap"))
    tot = first + STAFF_ROWS
    sheet.write(tot, 0, "TOTAL", sheet.f.chrome("total_label"))
    for c in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9):
        letter = xl_col_to_name(c)
        sheet.formula(tot, c,
                      f'=ROUND(SUM({letter}${first}:{letter}'
                      f'${first + STAFF_ROWS - 1}),2)',
                      sheet.f.chrome("total_value",
                                     num_format=sheet.num_format("money")))
    row = tot + 2
    row = sheet.section(row, "PAYOUT SUMMARY", last)
    sheet.formula(row, 0,
                  f'=IF(SUM($J${first}:$J${first + STAFF_ROWS - 1})=0,'
                  f'"No commissions yet - log completed sales on tab 6.",'
                  f'"Total commission due this period: "&TEXT(SUM($J$'
                  f'{first}:$J${first + STAFF_ROWS - 1}),"#,##0.00")&'
                  f'" across "&COUNTIF($A${first}:$A${first + STAFF_ROWS - 1}'
                  f',"?*")&" staff.")',
                  sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
    sheet.merge(row, 1, last, "", sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
    row += 2
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last, row)
    sheet.finish(print_area=f"A1:{xl_col_to_name(last)}{row + 2}")
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/common.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/common.py sha256:3fd8f65ca4b0de5aa07fb084c755c036bffd46dbbf441e4b92c0bc1a56b1b54f -->
````python
"""Shared formula fragments and chrome helpers for every tab.

All fragments here are Excel 2010 safe: no IFS, no XLOOKUP, no MAXIFS,
no TEXTJOIN, no dynamic arrays.  Conditional aggregation is done with
COUNTIFS / SUMIFS / SUMPRODUCT and defined names that point at whole
register columns, so range sizes always agree.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import DISCLAIMER_SHORT


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Money helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def fee_rate(method_expr: str) -> str:
    """Processing fee rate for a payment method (Settings names)."""
    return (f'IF({method_expr}="Card",CardFeeRate,'
            f'IF({method_expr}="Cash",CashFeeRate,'
            f'IF({method_expr}="Bank Transfer",BankFeeRate,OtherFeeRate)))')


def money(expr: str) -> str:
    """Round to 2 dp, blank safe."""
    return f'IF({expr}="","",ROUND({expr},2))'


def n(expr: str) -> str:
    """Numeric coercion that treats blanks and text as zero."""
    return f'N({expr})'


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lookups against the defined names
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def svc_lookup(item: str, names: str) -> str:
    return f'IFERROR(INDEX({names},MATCH({item},ServiceNames,0)),"")'


def prod_lookup(item: str, names: str) -> str:
    return f'IFERROR(INDEX({names},MATCH({item},ProductNames,0)),"")'


def either_lookup(item: str, svc_names: str, prod_names: str) -> str:
    """Service table first, product table second, blank if neither."""
    return (f'IF({item}="","",IFERROR('
            f'INDEX({svc_names},MATCH({item},ServiceNames,0)),'
            f'IFERROR(INDEX({prod_names},MATCH({item},ProductNames,0)),"")))')


def taxable_flag(item: str) -> str:
    return (f'IF({either_lookup(item, "ServiceTaxable", "ProductTaxable")}'
            f'="Yes",1,0)')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Months (TEXT based, so a P&L column is just a "yyyy-mm" string)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def month_of(date_expr: str) -> str:
    return f'TEXT({date_expr},"yyyy-mm")'


def ym_mask(date_range: str, ym_expr: str) -> str:
    """1/0 mask: rows of *date_range* that fall inside month *ym_expr*."""
    return (f'(YEAR({date_range})=VALUE(LEFT({ym_expr},4)))'
            f'*(MONTH({date_range})=VALUE(MID({ym_expr},6,2)))')


def cur_ym() -> str:
    return 'TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm")'


def prev_ym() -> str:
    return 'TEXT(EDATE(TODAY(),-1),"yyyy-mm")'


def week_start_of(date_expr: str) -> str:
    """Monday of the week containing the date."""
    return f'{date_expr}-WEEKDAY({date_expr},2)+1'


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chrome
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def footer(sheet, cfg, last_col: int, row: int, extra: str = "") -> int:
    """The two lines every tab carries: disclaimer then credit."""
    text = DISCLAIMER_SHORT
    if extra:
        text = f"{extra}  |  {text}"
    sheet.merge(row, 0, last_col, text, sheet.f.chrome("note"))
    sheet.merge(row + 1, 0, last_col,
                f"{cfg.author}  |  {cfg.product_name} v{cfg.version}",
                sheet.f.chrome("note"))
    return row + 2


def empty_state(test: str, message: str) -> str:
    """Honest empty state: a blank file never looks broken."""
    return f'IF({test},"{message}","")'
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/dashboard.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/dashboard.py sha256:895f9fe4f57b8c6c22121f0df828e3fb2c84e0e7892512eb8b112ea7e13da032 -->
````python
"""2 Dashboard - the salon's morning page."""

from __future__ import annotations

from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "2 Dashboard"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=Palette.accent, landscape=False)
    last = 11
    sheet.banner("2  Dashboard",
                 "Revenue, profit, bookings, balances and stock - every "
                 "tile reads the registers live.", last)
    cur, prv = C.cur_ym(), C.prev_ym()
    m_sales = f'SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("SalesDates", cur)}*SalesNet)'
    m_sales_p = f'SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("SalesDates", prv)}*SalesNet)'
    m_exp = f'SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("ExpDates", cur)}*ExpAmount)'
    m_appt = f'SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("ApptDates", cur)}*ApptDone)'

    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "THIS MONTH", last)
    tiles = [
        ("Revenue", f'=ROUND({m_sales},2)', "money", "net of discounts, "
         "refunds and tax"),
        ("Operating expenses", f'=ROUND({m_exp},2)', "money",
         "tab 11, this month"),
        ("Operating profit", f'=ROUND({m_sales}-{m_exp},2)', "money",
         "before payroll - see P&L"),
        ("Appointments done", f'={m_appt}', "int", "completed visits"),
        ("Average ticket", f'=IF({m_appt}=0,"-",ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
         f'{C.ym_mask("SalesDates", cur)}*(SalesType="Service")'
         f'*SalesNet)/{m_appt},2))', "money", "service revenue per visit"),
        ("Outstanding balances", '=ROUND(SUM(SalesBalance),2)', "money",
         "owed by clients right now"),
        ("Unearned deposits", '=ROUND(SUMIFS(PayAmount,PayKind,'
         '"Deposit",PayLinkStatus,"<>Completed"),2)', "money",
         "held, not yet revenue"),
        ("No-show rate", '=IF(COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Completed")'
         '+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Cancelled")+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,'
         '"No-show")=0,"-",COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"No-show")/'
         '(COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Completed")+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,'
         '"Cancelled")+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"No-show")))', "percent0",
         "of finalised bookings"),
        ("Cancellation rate", '=IF(COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Completed")'
         '+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Cancelled")+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,'
         '"No-show")=0,"-",COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Cancelled")/'
         '(COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"Completed")+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,'
         '"Cancelled")+COUNTIFS(ApptStatus,"No-show")))', "percent0",
         "of finalised bookings"),
        ("Repeat-client rate", '=IF(COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,">=1")=0,"-",'
         'COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,">1")/COUNTIFS(ClientVisits,">=1"))',
         "percent0", "clients with more than one visit"),
        ("Active clients", '=COUNTIFS(ClientStatus,"Active")', "int",
         "inside the rebooking window"),
        ("Reorder alerts", '=COUNTIF(InvLow,"REORDER")', "int",
         "products at or below minimum"),
    ]
    col = 0
    for i, (label, formula, style, note) in enumerate(tiles):
        sheet.kpi(row, col, label, formula, style=style, span=3, note=note)
        col += 3
        if i % 4 == 3:
            col = 0
            row += 3
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "MONTH VERSUS MONTH", last)
    heads = ["", "This month", "Last month", "Change"]
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, heads)
    pairs = [
        ("Revenue", m_sales, m_sales_p),
        ("Completed appointments", m_appt,
         f'SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("ApptDates", prv)}*ApptDone)'),
        ("Expenses", m_exp,
         f'SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("ExpDates", prv)}*ExpAmount)'),
    ]
    for i, (label, a, b) in enumerate(pairs):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=ROUND({a},2)', sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=ROUND({b},2)', sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=IF($C{r}="","",ROUND($B{r}-$C{r},2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
    row += len(pairs) + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "TWELVE-MONTH TREND", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Month", "Revenue", "Expenses", "Profit",
                              "Appts done"])
    trend_first = row + 1
    for k in range(12):
        r = trend_first + k
        ym = f'TEXT(EDATE(TODAY(),-{11 - k}),"yyyy-mm")'
        sheet.formula(r, 0, f'={ym}', sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                            f'{C.ym_mask("SalesDates", f"$A{r}")}'
                            '*SalesNet),2)', sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                            f'{C.ym_mask("ExpDates", f"$A{r}")}'
                            '*ExpAmount),2)', sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=IF($B{r}="","",ROUND($B{r}-$C{r},2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 4, f'=SUMPRODUCT('
                            f'{C.ym_mask("ApptDates", f"$A{r}")}*ApptDone)',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
    trend_last = trend_first + 11
    row = trend_last + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "TOP SERVICES BY REVENUE", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["#", "Service", "Times sold", "Revenue"])
    for i in range(5):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, i + 1, sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceNames,MATCH({i + 1},'
                            'ServiceRank,0)),"-")', sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=IF($B{r}="-","",IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceSold,'
                            f'MATCH($B{r},ServiceNames,0)),""))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=IF($B{r}="-","",IFERROR(INDEX(RevenueAll,'
                            f'MATCH($B{r},ServiceNames,0)),""))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
    top_last = row + 5
    row = top_last + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "REVENUE BY CATEGORY & BY STAFF", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Category", "Revenue", "", "Staff",
                              "Revenue"])
    from ..config import SERVICE_CATEGORIES
    for i, cat in enumerate(SERVICE_CATEGORIES):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, cat, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=ROUND(SUMPRODUCT((SalesCat=$A{r})'
                            '*SalesNet),2)', sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=IFERROR(INDEX(StaffNames,{i + 1}),"")',
                      sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 4, f'=IF($D{r}="","",ROUND(SUMIFS(SalesNet,'
                            f'SalesStaff,$D{r}),2))', sheet.f.calc("money"))
    cat_last = row + len(SERVICE_CATEGORIES)
    row = cat_last + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "WHAT TO DO NEXT", last)
    sheet.formula(row, 0,
                  '=IF(COUNTIFS(ClientStatus,"?*")=0,"Open tab 20 and set '
                  'your rates, then add staff, services and clients.",'
                  'IF(COUNTIF(InvLow,"REORDER")>0,"REORDER: "&'
                  'COUNTIF(InvLow,"REORDER")&" product(s) at or below '
                  'minimum - tab 13.",IF(SUM(SalesBalance)>0,"Chase "&'
                  'TEXT(SUM(SalesBalance),"0.00")&" of outstanding '
                  f'balances - tab 6.",IF({m_appt}=0,"No completed '
                  'appointments this month yet - plan the week on tab 3."'
                  ',"Everything is logged - write the month up on tab '
                  '19."))))',
                  sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
    sheet.merge(row, 1, last, "", sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
    sheet.row_height(row, 30)
    row += 2
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last, row)

    # native charts ---------------------------------------------------------
    chart = book.add_chart({"type": "column"})
    chart.add_series({
        "name": "Revenue",
        "categories": f"={_q(NAME)}!$A${trend_first}:$A${trend_last}",
        "values": f"={_q(NAME)}!$B${trend_first}:$B${trend_last}",
        "fill": {"color": "#6D2E4F"},
    })
    chart.add_series({
        "name": "Expenses",
        "categories": f"={_q(NAME)}!$A${trend_first}:$A${trend_last}",
        "values": f"={_q(NAME)}!$C${trend_first}:$C${trend_last}",
        "fill": {"color": "#B98A2F"},
    })
    chart.set_title({"name": "Revenue vs expenses by month"})
    chart.set_size({"width": 560, "height": 300})
    chart.set_legend({"position": "bottom"})
    sheet.ws.insert_chart(trend_first - 1, 6, chart)

    sheet.finish(print_area=f"A1:{xl_col_to_name(last)}{row + 2}")
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet


def _q(name: str) -> str:
    from ..layout import quote_sheet
    return quote_sheet(name)
````

"""11 Expenses - every cost, categorised and month-stamped."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import date_check, list_from, number_check
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "11 Expenses"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:

        name=NAME,

            "purchase order register on tab 14 tracks what arrived.",

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/goals.py sha256:f9936ed920a94ca7aa712c2ec3856894f9046980bf523643e91b29f8af029cce -->
````python
"""17 Goals & Budget - monthly targets versus actuals."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import number_check
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "17 Goals & Budget"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    ym = "{month}{r}"
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="17  Goals & Budget",
        subtitle="Revenue targets and expense budgets per month, with "
                 "actuals read straight from the sales and expense "
                 "registers.",
        tab_color="#6D2E4F",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=2,
        help_text="Month is a yyyy-mm stamp (2026-10). Actual columns sum "
                  "every sales and expense row in that month, so the "
                  "variance is always current.",
        columns=[
            Col("month", "Month", 10, "id",
                note="yyyy-mm, e.g. 2026-10."),
            Col("rev_target", "Revenue target", 13, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 10000000)),
            Col("rev_actual", "Revenue actual", 13, "money",
                formula='IF({month}{r}="","",ROUND(SUMPRODUCT(' +
                        C.ym_mask("SalesDates", ym) +
                        '*SalesNet),2))'),
            Col("rev_var", "Variance", 12, "money",
                formula='IF(OR({month}{r}="",{rev_target}{r}=""),"",'
                        'ROUND(N({rev_actual}{r})-N({rev_target}{r}),2))'),
            Col("rev_att", "Attained", 9, "percent",
                formula='IF(OR({month}{r}="",N({rev_target}{r})=0),"",'
                        '{rev_actual}{r}/{rev_target}{r})'),
            Col("exp_budget", "Expense budget", 13, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 10000000)),
            Col("exp_actual", "Expense actual", 13, "money",
                formula='IF({month}{r}="","",ROUND(SUMPRODUCT(' +
                        C.ym_mask("ExpDates", ym) + '*ExpAmount),2))'),
            Col("exp_var", "Budget left", 12, "money",
                formula='IF(OR({month}{r}="",{exp_budget}{r}=""),"",'
                        'ROUND(N({exp_budget}{r})-N({exp_actual}{r}),2))'),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.goal_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg) -> None:
    row = reg[NAME].last_data_row + 3
    last = 5
    sheet.section(row, "MONTHLY BUDGET BY CATEGORY", last)
    row += 1
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Category", "Monthly budget",
                              "Actual this month", "Variance",
                              "Share of spend"])
    from ..layout import quote_sheet
    exp = quote_sheet("11 Expenses")
    for i, cat in enumerate(__import__(
            "salon_business_spreadsheet.config",
            fromlist=["EXPENSE_CATEGORIES"]).EXPENSE_CATEGORIES):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, cat, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.write(r, 1, None, sheet.f.input("money"))
        tmpl = (
            f'=ROUND(SUMIFS({exp}!$K${{first}}:$K${{last}},'
            f'{exp}!$D${{first}}:$D${{last}},$A{r},'
            f'{exp}!$C${{first}}:$C${{last}},' + C.cur_ym() + '),2)'
        ).replace("{first}", str(reg["11 Expenses"].first_data_row)) \
         .replace("{last}", str(reg["11 Expenses"].last_data_row))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, tmpl, sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=IF($B{r}="","",ROUND(N($B{r})-$C{r},2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(
            r, 4,
            f'=IF(SUM($C${row + 1}:$C${row + 10})=0,"",'
            f'$C{r}/SUM($C${row + 1}:$C${row + 10}))',
            sheet.f.calc("percent"))
    sheet.note(row + 12,
               "Budgets are yours: type a monthly figure per category and "
               "the variance tracks itself.", last)
````

"""13 Product Inventory - stock on hand, value and reorder alerts."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import cf_text, date_check, list_from, number_check
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "13 Product Inventory"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="13  Product Inventory",
        subtitle="Retail and backbar stock: receipts from purchases, "
                 "units sold from sales, on-hand and reorder alerts.",
        tab_color="#B98A2F",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=4,
        help_text="On hand = opening + received - used in services - sold "
                  "- wasted + adjustments. Received comes from tab 14 and "
                  "sold from tab 6, so day-to-day you only type the "
                  "occasional adjustment.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "Prod ID", 9, "id",
                formula='="P-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),
            Col("sku", "SKU / barcode", 14, "text"),
            Col("name", "Product", 30, "text",
                note="The exact name retail sales rows use on tab 6."),
            Col("category", "Type", 10, "flag",
                validate=list_from("ListProdCats")),
            Col("supplier", "Supplier", 20, "text",
                validate=list_from("SupplierNames")),
            Col("unit_cost", "Unit cost", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000)),
            Col("retail", "Retail price", 11, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000)),
            Col("taxable", "Taxable", 8, "flag",
                validate=list_from("ListConsent")),
            Col("opening", "Opening", 8, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 9999, False)),
            Col("received", "Received", 9, "int",
                formula='IF({name}{r}="","",SUMIFS(PurchQty,PurchProduct,'
                        '{name}{r},PurchStatus,"Received"))'),
            Col("used", "Used in services", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 9999, False),
                note="Backbar units consumed at the chair."),
            Col("sold", "Retail sold", 9, "int",
                formula='IF({name}{r}="","",SUMIFS(SalesQty,SalesItem,'
                        '{name}{r},SalesType,"Retail"))'),
            Col("wasted", "Damaged / wasted", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 9999, False)),
            Col("adjusted", "Adjustments", 10, "int",
                validate=number_check(-9999, 9999, False),
                note="Stocktake corrections, plus or minus."),
            Col("on_hand", "On hand", 9, "int",
                formula='IF({name}{r}="","",N({opening}{r})'
                        '+N({received}{r})-N({used}{r})-N({sold}{r})'
                        '-N({wasted}{r})+N({adjusted}{r}))'),
            Col("min_level", "Min level", 9, "int",
                validate=number_check(0, 9999, False)),
            Col("low", "Reorder", 10, "status",
                formula='IF(OR({name}{r}="",{on_hand}{r}=""),"",IF('
                        '{on_hand}{r}<=N({min_level}{r}),"REORDER",""))',
                cf=[cf_text("REORDER", "bad")]),
            Col("value", "Stock value", 11, "money",
                formula='IF({on_hand}{r}="","",ROUND(N({on_hand}{r})'
                        '*N({unit_cost}{r}),2))'),
            Col("expiry", "Expiry", 11, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("batch", "Batch", 12, "text"),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 26, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.inventory_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
        extra_notes=[
            "REORDER appears the moment on-hand touches the minimum - "
            "filter the column for your shopping list.",
            "Stock value is at cost; the dashboard carries it as money "
            "sitting on the shelves.",
        ],
    )

"""16 Client Loyalty - points, tiers and referral rewards."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import cf_text, list_from
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "16 Client Loyalty"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="16  Client Loyalty",
        subtitle="Visit-based points, tiers, reward eligibility and "
                 "referral rewards - all read from the CRM.",
        tab_color="#B98A2F",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=2,
        help_text="Pick a client and everything else fills in: visits and "
                  "referrals from the CRM, points from the rate on "
                  "Settings, tier and reward from the thresholds.",
        columns=[
            Col("client", "Client", 22, "text",
                validate=list_from("ClientNames")),
            Col("visits", "Visits", 8, "int",
                formula='IF({client}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(ClientVisits,'
                        'MATCH({client}{r},ClientNames,0)),""))'),
            Col("points", "Points", 8, "int",
                formula='IF({visits}{r}="","",{visits}{r}*PointsPerVisit)'),
            Col("tier", "Tier", 9, "status",
                formula='IF({points}{r}="","",IF({points}{r}>='
                        'RewardThreshold*2,"Gold",IF({points}{r}>='
                        'RewardThreshold,"Silver","Bronze")))',
                cf=[cf_text("Gold", "good"), cf_text("Silver", "info")]),
            Col("reward_due", "Reward due", 10, "flag",
                formula='IF({points}{r}="","",IF({points}{r}>='
                        'RewardThreshold,"Yes","No"))',
                cf=[cf_text("Yes", "good")]),
            Col("referrals", "Referrals", 9, "int",
                formula='IF({client}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX('
                        'ClientReferrals,MATCH({client}{r},ClientNames,0)),'
                        '""))'),
            Col("ref_reward", "Referral credit", 11, "money",
                formula='IF({referrals}{r}="","",ROUND(N({referrals}{r})*'
                        'ReferralReward,2))'),
            Col("notes", "Rewards given & notes", 30, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.loyalty_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
        extra_notes=[
            "Points per visit, the reward threshold and the referral "
