````python
"""15 Marketing & Promotions - campaigns, gift certs and packages."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import date_check, list_from, number_check
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "15 Marketing & Promotions"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="15  Marketing & Promotions",
        subtitle="Campaign log with spend versus attributed revenue, new "
                 "clients per channel, gift certificates and prepaid "
                 "packages.",
        tab_color="#96587A",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text="Log each campaign with its channel and dates. New "
                  "clients counts CRM rows whose source matches the "
                  "channel, so attribution stays honest.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "Camp ID", 9, "id",
                formula='="M-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"00")'),
            Col("campaign", "Campaign", 28, "text"),
            Col("channel", "Channel", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListChannels")),
            Col("start", "Start", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("end", "End", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("spend", "Spend", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000)),
            Col("revenue", "Attributed revenue", 13, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 1000000),
                note="Revenue you can honestly tie to the campaign."),
            Col("new_clients", "New clients", 10, "int",
                formula='IF({channel}{r}="","",COUNTIFS(ClientSource,'
                        '{channel}{r}))'),
            Col("roi", "ROI", 9, "percent",
                formula='IF(OR({spend}{r}="",N({spend}{r})=0),"",'
                        '({revenue}{r}-{spend}{r})/{spend}{r})'),
            Col("notes", "Offer & learning", 34, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.marketing_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg) -> None:
    row = reg[NAME].last_data_row + 3
    last = 8
    sheet.section(row, "GIFT CERTIFICATE REGISTER", last)
    row += 1
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Code", "Client", "Value", "Issued",
                              "Expires", "Redeemed", "Balance", "Notes"])
    for i in range(12):
        r = row + 1 + i
        for c in range(8):
            style = {0: "text", 1: "text", 2: "money", 3: "date",
                     4: "date", 5: "money", 7: "wrap"}[c] if c in (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7) else "text"
            sheet.write(r, c, None, sheet.f.input(style))
        sheet.formula(r, 6, f'=IF($C${r}="","",ROUND(N($C${r})-N($F${r}),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
    row += 15
    sheet.section(row, "PACKAGE & PREPAID SERVICE REGISTER", last)
    row += 1
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Package", "Client", "Sessions included",
                              "Sessions used", "Paid", "Per session",
                              "Sessions left", "Notes"])
    for i in range(12):
        r = row + 1 + i
        for c in (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7):
            style = {0: "text", 1: "text", 2: "int", 3: "int",
                     4: "money", 7: "wrap"}[c]
            sheet.write(r, c, None, sheet.f.input(style))
        sheet.formula(r, 5, f'=IF(OR($C${r}="",N($C${r})=0),"",'
                            f'ROUND(N($E${r})/$C${r},2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(r, 6, f'=IF($C${r}="","",N($C${r})-N($D${r}))',
                      sheet.f.calc("int"))
    sheet.note(row + 14,
               "Gift certificates are a liability until redeemed - the "
               "balance column shows what you still owe in services.",
               last)
````

````python
"""10 Payroll & Tips - hours, tips, employer cost and period summaries."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import date_check, list_from, number_check
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "10 Payroll & Tips"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="10  Payroll & Tips",
        subtitle="Hours, tips in and out, employer-side reserve and the "
                 "true cost of each pay line.",
        tab_color="#6D2E4F",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=4,
        help_text="One row per pay line. Period is your own label, e.g. "
                  "2026-10 H1 - the summary block below totals by period.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "Pay ID", 10, "id",
                formula='="R-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"0000")'),
            Col("period", "Period", 12, "text",
                note="Any label: 2026-10 H1, Week 42, October."),
            Col("date", "Pay date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("staff", "Staff", 20, "text",
                validate=list_from("StaffNames")),
            Col("hours", "Hours", 8, "number1",
                validate=number_check(0, 200, False)),
            Col("rate", "Rate", 9, "money",
                formula='IF({staff}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(StaffHourly,'
                        'MATCH({staff}{r},StaffNames,0)),""))'),
            Col("gross", "Gross pay", 11, "money",
                formula='IF({hours}{r}="","",ROUND(N({hours}{r})'
                        '*N({rate}{r}),2))'),
            Col("tips_in", "Tips in", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000),
                note="Tips received by the team for this period."),
            Col("tips_out", "Tips paid out", 11, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000),
                note="What you passed on. The difference stays in the "
                     "business and shows in the cost column."),
            Col("employer_tax", "Employer reserve", 12, "money",
                formula='IF({gross}{r}="","",ROUND(N({gross}{r})*'
                        'PayrollTaxRate,2))',
                note="Gross x the employer-side rate from Settings."),
            Col("total_cost", "Total cost", 11, "money",
                formula='IF({gross}{r}="","",ROUND(N({gross}{r})'
                        '+N({employer_tax}{r})+N({tips_in}{r})'
                        '-N({tips_out}{r}),2))'),
            Col("notes", "Adjustments & approvals", 30, "wrap",
                note="Manual adjustments: who approved them and why."),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.payroll_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
        extra_notes=[
            "Tips are tracked in and out so the P&L only carries what the "
            "business actually keeps.",
            "This tab records payroll; it is not payroll software or tax "
            "advice - confirm rates with your accountant.",
        ],
    )


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg) -> None:
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    row = spec_.last_data_row + 2
    last = spec_.last_col_index
    sheet.section(row, "PAYROLL PERIOD SUMMARY", last)
    row += 1
    heads = ["Period", "Hours", "Gross pay", "Tips in", "Tips paid out",
             "Employer reserve", "Total cost"]
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, heads)
    periods = sorted({s["period"] for s in spec_.samples
                      if s.get("period")}) or ["2026-10 H1"]
    for i, p in enumerate(periods[:12]):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, p, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        for c, key in enumerate(["hours", "gross", "tips_in", "tips_out",
                                 "employer_tax", "total_cost"], start=1):
            letter = spec_.letter(key)
            rng = f"${letter}${spec_.first_data_row}:${letter}${spec_.last_data_row}"
            sheet.formula(
                r, c,
                f'=IF(SUMIF($A${spec_.first_data_row}:'
                f'$A${spec_.last_data_row},"{p}",{rng})=0,"",'
                f'ROUND(SUMIF($A${spec_.first_data_row}:'
                f'$A${spec_.last_data_row},"{p}",{rng}),2))',
                sheet.f.calc("number1" if key == "hours" else "money"))
    sheet.note(row + len(periods[:12]) + 2,
               "Add a row per period label you use - copy the formulas "
               "down and the summary follows.", last)
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/pnl.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/pnl.py sha256:9519fd8faf01610218ae05d1c931ccb090dc39f67a761ef523c2265874c6714e -->
````python
"""12 Profit & Loss - rolling twelve months plus YTD."""

from __future__ import annotations

from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from ..config import Config, EXPENSE_CATEGORIES
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "12 Profit & Loss"
MONTHS = 12


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color="#6D2E4F", landscape=True)
    last = MONTHS + 1          # label column + 12 months + YTD
    sheet.banner("12  Profit & Loss",
                 "Net sales, costs and operating profit per month - "
                 "every cell reads tabs 6, 7, 10, 11 and 14.", last)
    row = 4
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Line"] + ["" for _ in range(MONTHS + 1)])
    hdr = row
    for k in range(MONTHS):
        sheet.formula(hdr, 1 + k,
                      f'=TEXT(EDATE(TODAY(),-{MONTHS - 1 - k}),"yyyy-mm")',
                      sheet.f.chrome("header"))
    sheet.write(hdr, 1 + MONTHS, "12-month total", sheet.f.chrome("header"))

    rows: list = []

    def line(label: str, builder, style="money", bold=False):
        rows.append((label, builder, style, bold))

    def ym(col_idx: int) -> str:
        return f"${xl_col_to_name(col_idx)}${hdr}"

    line("Service revenue (net)",
         lambda c: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("SalesDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*(SalesType="Service")*SalesNet),2)')
    line("Retail revenue (net)",
         lambda c: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("SalesDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*(SalesType="Retail")*SalesNet),2)')
    line("Total net sales", None, "money", True)
    line("of which tax collected",
         lambda c: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("SalesDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*SalesTax),2)')
    line("Processing fees",
         lambda c: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("SalesDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*SalesFee),2)')
    for cat in EXPENSE_CATEGORIES:
        line(f"{cat}",
             lambda c, cat=cat: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                                f'{C.ym_mask("ExpDates", ym(c))}'
                                f'*(ExpCat="{cat}")*ExpAmount),2)')
    line("Payroll & tips cost",
         lambda c: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("PayrollDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*PayrollCost),2)')
    line("Total operating costs", None, "money", True)
    line("OPERATING PROFIT", None, "money", True)
    line("Break-even revenue", None, "money")
    line("Tax reserve suggestion", None, "money")
    line("Cash in (sales + deposits)",
         lambda c: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("SalesDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*SalesNet)+SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("PayDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*(PayKind="Deposit")*PayAmount),2)')
    line("Cash out (costs + stock)",
         lambda c: f'ROUND(SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("ExpDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*ExpAmount)+SUMPRODUCT('
                   f'{C.ym_mask("PayrollDates", ym(c))}*PayrollCost)'
                   f'+SUMPRODUCT({C.ym_mask("PurchDates", ym(c))}'
                   f'*PurchTotal),2)')

    r = hdr + 1
    idx = {}
    for label, builder, style, bold in rows:
        idx[label] = r
        fmt = (sheet.f.calc(style, bold=True) if bold
               else sheet.f.calc(style))
        sheet.write(r, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text", bold=bold))
        for k in range(MONTHS):
            c = 1 + k
            if builder is not None:
                sheet.formula(r, c, "=" + builder(c), fmt)
        r += 1

    # derived rows, month by month
    for k in range(MONTHS):
        c = 1 + k
        cl = xl_col_to_name(c)
        sheet.formula(idx["Total net sales"], c,
                      f'=ROUND(${cl}${idx["Service revenue (net)"]}+'
                      f'${cl}${idx["Retail revenue (net)"]},2)',
                      sheet.f.calc("money", bold=True))
        cost_first = idx["Rent"]
        cost_last = idx["Payroll & tips cost"]
        sheet.formula(idx["Total operating costs"], c,
                      f'=ROUND(SUM(${cl}${cost_first}:${cl}${cost_last}),2)',
                      sheet.f.calc("money", bold=True))
        sheet.formula(idx["OPERATING PROFIT"], c,
                      f'=ROUND(${cl}${idx["Total net sales"]}-'
                      f'${cl}${idx["Total operating costs"]},2)',
                      sheet.f.calc("money", bold=True))
        fixed = (f'${cl}${idx["Rent"]}+${cl}${idx["Utilities"]}+'
                 f'${cl}${idx["Insurance"]}+${cl}${idx["Software"]}+'
                 f'${cl}${idx["Payroll & tips cost"]}')
        sheet.formula(idx["Break-even revenue"], c,
                      f'=IF(OR(${cl}${idx["Total net sales"]}=0,'
                      f'${cl}${idx["Total net sales"]}-'
                      f'(${cl}${idx["Total operating costs"]}-({fixed}))'
                      f'<=0),"",ROUND(({fixed})/(1-('
                      f'${cl}${idx["Total operating costs"]}-({fixed}))/'
                      f'${cl}${idx["Total net sales"]}),2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
        sheet.formula(idx["Tax reserve suggestion"], c,
                      f'=IF(${cl}${idx["OPERATING PROFIT"]}<=0,0,ROUND('
                      f'${cl}${idx["OPERATING PROFIT"]}*TaxReserveRate,2))',
                      sheet.f.calc("money"))
    # YTD column = sum of the twelve months
    for label, builder, style, bold in rows:
        r_ = idx[label]
        first_c = xl_col_to_name(1)
        last_c = xl_col_to_name(MONTHS)
        sheet.formula(r_, 1 + MONTHS,
                      f'=ROUND(SUM(${first_c}${r_}:${last_c}${r_}),2)',
                      sheet.f.calc(style, bold=bold))
    r = idx["Cash out (costs + stock)"] + 2
    row = sheet.section(r, "READING IT", last)
    for t in [
        "Net sales are gross minus discounts, refunds and plus tax - the "
        "same number as tab 6, never double counted with deposits.",
        "Break-even uses rent, utilities, insurance, software and payroll "
        "as fixed; everything else as variable.",
        "The tax reserve is a suggestion at your Settings rate - set it "
        "to 0 if you prefer.",
    ]:
        row = sheet.note(row, t, last) + 1
    row += 1
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last, row)
    sheet.finish(freeze_row=hdr + 1, freeze_col=1,
                 print_area=f"A1:{xl_col_to_name(last)}{row + 2}")
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

````python
"""14 Suppliers & Purchases - directory plus the purchase order register."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config

from .. import sample_data

#: supplier directory block geometry (used by names.py)

                formula='="PO-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"000")'),

            Col("po", "PO number", 13, "text"),
            Col("supplier", "Supplier", 22, "text",
                validate=list_from("SupplierNames")),
            Col("product", "Product", 28, "text",
                validate=list_from("ProductNames")),
            Col("qty", "Qty", 7, "int", validate=number_check(0, 9999, False)),
            Col("unit_cost", "Unit cost", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000)),
            Col("total", "Total", 11, "money",
                formula='IF({qty}{r}="","",ROUND(N({qty}{r})'
                        '*N({unit_cost}{r}),2))'),
            Col("status", "Status", 11, "status",
                validate=list_from("ListPurchStatus"),
                note="Received is what inventory counts."),
            Col("received_date", "Received", 12, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 26, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.purchase_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
    )


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg) -> None:
    global SUP_FIRST_ROW
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    row = spec_.last_data_row + 3
    sheet.section(row, "SUPPLIER DIRECTORY", 7)
    row += 1
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Supplier", "Contact", "Phone", "Email",
                              "Terms", "Lead time", "Notes"])
    SUP_FIRST_ROW = row + 2          # 1-based Excel row of first supplier
    for i, sup in enumerate(sample_data.SUPPLIERS):
        r = row + 1 + i
        for c, val in enumerate(sup):
            sheet.write(r, c, val, sheet.f.input("text"))
    sheet.note(row + len(sample_data.SUPPLIERS) + 2,
               "Add suppliers here - the drop down on the register above "
               "and on tab 13 reads this list.", 7)
````

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/reports.py sha256:775e91bad44b63f8b270d1fc017970dd4579eab06a3cb9e71396f7ad400ac568 -->

````python
"""19 Weekly & Monthly Reports - the owner's review page."""

from __future__ import annotations

from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from ..config import Config
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "19 Weekly & Monthly Reports"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color="#B98A2F", landscape=False)
    last = 7
    sheet.banner("19  Weekly & Monthly Reports",
                 "Sunday, ten minutes: what happened, what it means, "
                 "what you will do about it.", last)
    ws = C.week_start_of("TODAY()")
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "THIS WEEK VS LAST WEEK", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Measure", "This week", "Last week",
                              "Change"])
    wk = [
        ("Revenue",
         f'SUMIFS(SalesNet,SalesDates,">="&{ws},SalesDates,"<="&TODAY())',
         f'SUMIFS(SalesNet,SalesDates,">="&{ws}-7,SalesDates,"<"&{ws})'),
        ("Appointments completed",
         f'SUMIFS(ApptDone,ApptDates,">="&{ws},ApptDates,"<="&TODAY())',
         f'SUMIFS(ApptDone,ApptDates,">="&{ws}-7,ApptDates,"<"&{ws})'),
        ("No-shows",
         f'SUMPRODUCT((ApptDates>={ws})*(ApptDates<=TODAY())*'
         '(ApptStatus="No-show"))',
         f'SUMPRODUCT((ApptDates>={ws}-7)*(ApptDates<{ws})*'
         '(ApptStatus="No-show"))'),
        ("Retail lines",
         f'SUMPRODUCT((SalesDates>={ws})*(SalesDates<=TODAY())*'
         '(SalesType="Retail"))',
         f'SUMPRODUCT((SalesDates>={ws}-7)*(SalesDates<{ws})*'
         '(SalesType="Retail"))'),
    ]
    for i, (label, a, b) in enumerate(wk):
        r = row + 1 + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, f'=ROUND({a},2)', sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(r, 2, f'=ROUND({b},2)', sheet.f.calc("number1"))
        sheet.formula(r, 3, f'=ROUND($B{r}-$C{r},2)',
                      sheet.f.calc("number1"))
    row += len(wk) + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "THIS MONTH IN ONE BREATH", last)
    cur = C.cur_ym()
    lines = [
        ("Revenue", f'=ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                    f'{C.ym_mask("SalesDates", cur)}*SalesNet),2)',
         "money"),
        ("Operating expenses", f'=ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                               f'{C.ym_mask("ExpDates", cur)}*ExpAmount),2)',
         "money"),
        ("Payroll cost", f'=ROUND(SUMPRODUCT('
                         f'{C.ym_mask("PayrollDates", cur)}*PayrollCost),2)',
         "money"),
        ("Best service", '=IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceNames,MATCH(1,'
                         'ServiceRank,0)),"-")', "text"),
        ("Top earner", '=IFERROR(INDEX(StaffNames,MATCH(MAX(StaffRevenue),'
                       'StaffRevenue,0)),"-")', "text"),
        ("Rebook reminders due", '=SUMPRODUCT((ApptFollow<>"")*'
         '(ApptFollow<=TODAY()))', "int"),
    ]
    for i, (label, formula, style) in enumerate(lines):
        r = row + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, label, sheet.f.calc("text", bold=True))
        sheet.formula(r, 1, formula, sheet.f.calc(style))
    row += len(lines) + 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "OWNER ACTION PLAN - TYPE HERE", last)
    prompts = [
        "What worked this month and deserves more of your calendar?",
        "Which service or slot under-earned - reprice, retime or retire?",
        "Who is lapsed or overdue a rebooking - call list for Monday?",
        "What will you reorder, repair or renegotiate?",
        "Which number will you move next month, and by how much?",
        "One thing to stop doing completely:",
    ]
    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last, p, sheet.f.chrome("subsection"))
        row += 1
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last, None, sheet.f.input("wrap"))
        sheet.row_height(row, 34)
        row += 1
    row += 1
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "Print this page for the monthly review - the print "
                     "area is set. Numbers above update themselves; the "
                     "plan is yours.", last) + 2
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last, row)
    sheet.finish(print_area=f"A1:{xl_col_to_name(last)}{row + 2}")
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

````python
"""6 Sales & Transactions - the money register."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..writer import cf_text, date_check, list_from, number_check
from . import common as C
from .. import sample_data

NAME = "6 Sales & Transactions"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    taxflag = C.taxable_flag("{item}{r}")
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="6  Sales & Transactions",
        subtitle="One row per invoice line - unit price, tax, net, fees "
                 "and the outstanding balance calculate as you type.",
        tab_color="#6D2E4F",
        rows=cfg.row_count(NAME),
        freeze_cols=4,
        help_text="Log every sale: services completed and retail products. "
                  "Unit price looks itself up from the service menu or the "
                  "product list; tax follows the taxable flag and the rate "
                  "on Settings.",
        columns=[
            Col("id", "Tx ID", 10, "id",
                formula='="T-"&TEXT(ROW()-{first}+1,"0000")'),
            Col("date", "Date", 12, "date", validate=date_check()),
            Col("client", "Client", 20, "text",
                validate=list_from("ClientNames")),
            Col("staff", "Staff", 16, "text",
                validate=list_from("StaffNames")),
            Col("type", "Type", 9, "flag", validate=list_from("ListTxType"),
                note="Service or Retail - drives which price list and "
                     "which commission rule applies."),
            Col("item", "Service / product", 28, "text",
                note="Pick the exact menu or product name."),
            Col("qty", "Qty", 6, "int", validate=number_check(0, 99, False)),
            Col("unit", "Unit price", 10, "money",
                formula='IF({item}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(ServicePrice,'
                        'MATCH({item}{r},ServiceNames,0)),IFERROR(INDEX('
                        'ProductRetail,MATCH({item}{r},ProductNames,0)),'
                        '"")))'),
            Col("gross", "Gross", 10, "money",
                formula='IF({unit}{r}="","",ROUND(N({qty}{r})'
                        '*N({unit}{r}),2))'),
            Col("discount", "Discount", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000)),
            Col("refund", "Refund", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000)),
            Col("tax", "Tax", 9, "money",
                formula='IF({gross}{r}="","",ROUND((N({gross}{r})'
                        '-N({discount}{r})-N({refund}{r}))*TaxRate*'
                        + taxflag + ',2))'),
            Col("net", "Net", 10, "money",
                formula='IF({gross}{r}="","",ROUND(N({gross}{r})'
                        '-N({discount}{r})-N({refund}{r})+N({tax}{r}),2))',
                note="Net sales = gross - discounts - refunds + tax. "
                     "This is the number every report uses."),
            Col("method", "Method", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("ListMethods")),
            Col("paid", "Paid", 10, "money",
                validate=number_check(0, 100000),
                note="What the client actually paid on this line. Split "
                     "payments: log the rest on tab 7 against this Tx ID."),
            Col("balance", "Owing", 10, "money",
                formula='IF({net}{r}="","",ROUND(N({net}{r})'
                        '-N({paid}{r}),2))',
                cf=[cf_text("-", "bad")]),
            Col("fee", "Processing fee", 11, "money",
                formula='IF({net}{r}="","",ROUND(N({net}{r})*'
                        + C.fee_rate("{method}{r}") + ',2))'),
            Col("cat", "Category", 11, "text",
                formula='IF({item}{r}="","",IFERROR(INDEX(ServiceCat,'
                        'MATCH({item}{r},ServiceNames,0)),"Retail"))'),
            Col("rate", "Comm rate", 9, "percent", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({type}{r}<>"Service","",IF(IFERROR(INDEX('
                        'StaffMethod,MATCH({staff}{r},StaffNames,0)),'
                        '"Percentage")="Category",IFERROR(INDEX('
                        'CatCommRate,MATCH({cat}{r},CatNames,0)),0),'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX(StaffSvcRate,MATCH({staff}{r},'
                        'StaffNames,0)),0)))'),
            Col("dup", "dup", 7, "flag", hidden=True,
                formula='IF({id}{r}="","",IF(COUNTIFS({id_first}:{id_last},'
                        '{id}{r})>1,"DUP",""))'),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 30, "wrap"),
        ],
        samples=sample_data.sales_rows(cfg)
        if cfg.include_sample_data else [],
        extra_notes=[
            "Deposits are recorded on tab 7, never as a second sale - so "
            "revenue is never counted twice.",
            "The hidden DUP column flags a repeated Tx ID; the Owing "
            "column turns red while a balance remains.",
        ],
    )


def decorate(sheet, fmts, cfg, reg) -> None:
    spec_ = reg[NAME]
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(
        spec_.first_data_row - 1, spec_.index("balance"),
        spec_.last_data_row - 1, spec_.index("balance"),
        {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0.001,
         "format": sheet.f.cf("bad")})
    sheet.ws.conditional_format(
        spec_.first_data_row - 1, spec_.index("dup"),
        spec_.last_data_row - 1, spec_.index("dup"),
        {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing", "value": "DUP",
         "format": sheet.f.cf("bad")})
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/settings.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/sheets/settings.py sha256:a9b3b036948e7287195268042000e09f4cc3dc58e84cc2fb5766743b43e8d883 -->
````python
"""20 Settings & Lists - every rate, rule and drop-down source."""

from __future__ import annotations

from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from ..config import (APPOINTMENT_STATUSES, BOOKING_CHANNELS,
                      COMMISSION_METHODS, CONSENT, Config,
                      CATEGORY_COMMISSION_DEFAULT, EXPENSE_CATEGORIES,
                      PAYMENT_KINDS, PAYMENT_METHODS, PREF_CONTACT,
                      PRODUCT_CATEGORIES, PURCHASE_STATUSES, RECURRING,
                      SERVICE_CATEGORIES, STAFF_STATUSES, STAFF_TYPES,
                      TX_TYPES)
from ..layout import col_letter, dynamic_name
from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "20 Settings & Lists"

LISTS = [
    ("list_status", "Booking statuses", APPOINTMENT_STATUSES),
    ("list_methods", "Payment methods", PAYMENT_METHODS),
    ("list_kinds", "Payment kinds", PAYMENT_KINDS),
    ("list_channels", "Channels & sources", BOOKING_CHANNELS),
    ("list_cats", "Service categories", SERVICE_CATEGORIES),
    ("list_expcats", "Expense categories", EXPENSE_CATEGORIES),
    ("list_staffstatus", "Staff statuses", STAFF_STATUSES),
    ("list_stafftypes", "Staff types", STAFF_TYPES),
    ("list_commmethods", "Commission methods", COMMISSION_METHODS),
    ("list_txtypes", "Sale types", TX_TYPES),
    ("list_purchstatus", "Purchase statuses", PURCHASE_STATUSES),
    ("list_consent", "Yes / No", CONSENT),
    ("list_prefcontact", "Preferred contact", PREF_CONTACT),
    ("list_recurring", "Recurring", RECURRING),
    ("list_prodcats", "Product types", PRODUCT_CATEGORIES),
]
LIST_SLOTS = 40          # editable rows per list
PER_BAND = 5             # lists side by side


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color="#241F26", landscape=False)
    last = 9
    sheet.banner("20  Settings & Lists",
                 "Every rate, rule and drop-down list in one place - "
                 "change a value here and the whole workbook follows.",
                 last)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "BUSINESS", last)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Salon name", cfg.salon_name, name="SalonName")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Owner name", cfg.owner_name, name="OwnerName")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "TAX & FEES (CONFIGURABLE - NOT ADVICE)", last)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Sales tax / VAT rate", cfg.tax_rate,
                      style="percent", name="TaxRate",
                      help_text="Applied to taxable services and products "
                                "on tab 6. Set 0 if your region has none.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Tax reserve rate", cfg.tax_reserve_rate,
                      style="percent", name="TaxReserveRate",
                      help_text="Share of operating profit the P&L "
                                "suggests setting aside.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Employer payroll reserve",
                      cfg.payroll_tax_rate, style="percent",
                      name="PayrollTaxRate")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Card processing fee", cfg.card_fee_rate,
                      style="percent", name="CardFeeRate")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Cash handling fee", cfg.cash_fee_rate,
                      style="percent", name="CashFeeRate")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Bank transfer fee", cfg.bank_fee_rate,
                      style="percent", name="BankFeeRate")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Other method fee", cfg.other_fee_rate,
                      style="percent", name="OtherFeeRate")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "LOYALTY & REBOOKING", last)
    row = sheet.field(row, "Points per visit", cfg.points_per_visit,
                      style="number1", name="PointsPerVisit")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Reward threshold (points)",
                      cfg.reward_threshold, style="number1",
                      name="RewardThreshold")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Referral credit", cfg.referral_reward,
                      style="money", name="ReferralReward")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Rebooking interval (days)", cfg.rebook_days,
                      style="int", name="RebookDays",
                      help_text="Drives CRM status and the rebook "
                                "reminder on tab 3.")
    row = sheet.field(row, "Flat commission per service",
                      cfg.flat_commission, style="money",
                      name="FlatCommission")
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "CATEGORY COMMISSION RATES", last)
    sheet.table_head(row, 0, ["Category", "Commission rate"])
    cat_first = row + 1
    for i, cat in enumerate(SERVICE_CATEGORIES):
        r = cat_first + i
        sheet.write(r, 0, cat, sheet.f.calc("text"))
        sheet.write(r, 1, CATEGORY_COMMISSION_DEFAULT[cat],
                    sheet.f.input("percent"))
    book.define_name("CatNames", dynamic_name(
        NAME, "A", cat_first, cat_first + len(SERVICE_CATEGORIES) - 1))
    book.define_name("CatCommRate", dynamic_name(
        NAME, "B", cat_first, cat_first + len(SERVICE_CATEGORIES) - 1,
        count_text=False))
    row = cat_first + len(SERVICE_CATEGORIES) + 1
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "Used for staff paid on the Category method: each "
                     "sale earns its own category's rate.", last) + 2

    row = sheet.section(row, "DROP-DOWN LISTS (ADD YOUR OWN VALUES)", last)
    geometry = []
    band = 0
    for i, (key, title, values) in enumerate(LISTS):
        slot = i % PER_BAND
        if slot == 0 and i:
            row += LIST_SLOTS + 3
            band += 1
        col = slot * 2
        sheet.merge(row, col, col, title, sheet.f.chrome("subsection"))
        first = row + 1
        for v in range(LIST_SLOTS):
            value = values[v] if v < len(values) else None
            sheet.write(first + v, col, value, sheet.f.input("text"))
        geometry.append((key, col, first))
    for key, col, first in geometry:
        book.define_name(key[0].upper() + key[1:], dynamic_name(
            NAME, col_letter(col), first, first + LIST_SLOTS - 1))
    row += LIST_SLOTS + 2
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "Type new values under any list - every drop-down in "
                     "the workbook reads these columns live.", last) + 1
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "Backup and privacy: keep this file on your own "
                     "machine or cloud folder and back it up like any "
                     "business record. It contains no macros and sends "
                     "nothing anywhere.", last) + 1
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last, row)
    sheet.finish(print_area=f"A1:{xl_col_to_name(last)}{row + 2}")
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

````python
                        '(SalesStaff={name}{r})*(SalesType="Retail")'

                        '{name}{r},StaffNames,0)),"")="Flat",FlatCommission'
                        '*COUNTIFS(ApptStaff,{name}{r},ApptStatus,'
                        '"Completed"),0),2))',
                note="Service revenue at the applicable rate + retail at "

        extra_notes=[
            "Commission eligibility is yours to set: change a rate to 0 "
````

````python
"""1 Start Here - welcome, setup checklist, legend, FAQ, disclaimer."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, DISCLAIMER
from xlsxwriter.utility import xl_col_to_name

from ..writer import SheetWriter
from . import common as C

NAME = "1 Start Here"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg) -> SheetWriter:
    sheet = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                        tab_color=cfg and "#6D2E4F", landscape=False)
    last = 9
    sheet.banner("1  Start Here",
                 "Your salon, one organised workbook - read this page "
                 "once, then never again.", last)
    row = 4
    row = sheet.section(row, "WELCOME", last)
    for line in [
        f"{cfg.salon_name} runs on twenty tabs: bookings, clients, the "
        "service menu, sales, payments, staff, commissions, payroll, "
        "expenses, stock, marketing, loyalty, goals, analytics and "
        "reports.",
        "White cells are yours. Pale grey cells are locked formulas - "
        "they do the maths so you do not have to.",
        "Everything recalculates the moment you type: the dashboard, the "
        "commission statements, the P&L and the reports all read the "
        "registers live.",
    ]:
        row = sheet.note(row, line, last) + 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "SETUP CHECKLIST - TEN MINUTES, ONCE", last)
    steps = [
        ("1", "Tab 20 Settings & Lists", "salon name, tax rate, payment "
         "fees, commission rates per category, loyalty rules, and every "
         "drop-down list"),
        ("2", "Tab 8 Staff Management", "one row per person: role, hourly "
         "rate, commission method and rates"),
        ("3", "Tab 5 Services & Pricing", "your menu with durations, "
         "prices, product and labour costs"),
        ("4", "Tab 13 Product Inventory", "retail and backbar stock with "
         "opening quantities and minimum levels"),
        ("5", "Tab 4 Client CRM", "your existing clients - contacts, "
         "consents and preferences"),
        ("6", "Tab 17 Goals & Budget", "a revenue target and an expense "
         "budget per month, plus category budgets"),
        ("7", "Tabs 3, 6, 7, 10, 11", "log bookings, sales, payments, "
         "payroll and expenses as they happen"),
        ("8", "Tab 2 every morning", "the dashboard tells you revenue, "
         "who is overdue a booking, what is owing and what to reorder"),
    ]
    for num, where, what in steps:
        sheet.merge(row, 0, 0, num, sheet.f.chrome("day_number"))
        sheet.merge(row, 1, 3, where, sheet.f.calc("text", bold=True))
        sheet.merge(row, 4, last, what, sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
        sheet.row_height(row, 30)
        row += 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "COLOUR LEGEND", last)
    legend = [
        ("input", "White / porcelain - unlocked, type here"),
        ("calc", "Pale grey - locked formula, do not type here"),
        ("good", "Green - healthy: completed, active, on target"),
        ("warn", "Amber - watch: cancelled, lapsed, over budget"),
        ("bad", "Red - act: no-show, refund, reorder, balance owing"),
    ]
    for style, text in legend:
        sheet.merge(row, 0, 1, text.split(" - ")[0],
                    sheet.f.chrome("legend_input") if style == "input"
                    else sheet.f.chrome("legend_calc") if style == "calc"
                    else sheet.f.chrome(style))
        sheet.merge(row, 2, last, text, sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
        row += 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "SAMPLE DATA", last)
    row = sheet.note(row,
                     "This file ships with a realistic example salon so "
                     "you can see every formula working. Your download "
                     "also includes a BLANK workbook with empty registers "
                     "- open that one to start clean. To clear this file "
                     "instead, select each register's rows and delete "
                     "them; formulas stay for the next entry.", last) + 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "FAQ", last)
    faq = [
        ("Will it work in my Excel?",
         "Excel 2010 and every version since, Windows and Mac, plus "
         "Google Sheets, LibreOffice and Numbers. No 365 subscription: "
         "nothing uses XLOOKUP, IFS, LET or dynamic arrays."),
        ("Can I break a formula?",
         "Practically no. Formula cells are locked behind the password "
         "'premium'; only input cells accept typing."),
        ("Does it send reminders or sync with booking apps?",
         "No. A spreadsheet organises bookings; confirmations, texts and "
         "platform sync need separate tools. The rebook-reminder column "
         "tells you who to call."),
        ("Is the tax right for my country?",
         "The rate is yours to set on Settings, including 0. Tax here is "
         "a configured percentage, not advice."),
        ("How do commissions work?",
         "Per staff member you choose Percentage (their own rates), "
         "Category (the category rate table on Settings) or Flat (a fixed "
         "amount per completed service). Retail keeps its own rate."),
        ("Where are my deposits?",
         "Tab 7. A deposit is not revenue until the visit completes and "
         "the sale is invoiced on tab 6 - unearned deposits are reported "
         "separately."),
        ("Can I add rows?",
         "Yes - insert above the last register row and copy the pale "
         "cells down, or simply use the next empty row; every formula "
         "already covers the full register."),
        ("Is my data private?",
         "The file lives on your machine or your own cloud folder. No "
         "macros, no links out, no telemetry. Keep backups like any "
         "business record."),
    ]
    for q, a in faq:
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last, "Q.  " + q, sheet.f.chrome("subsection"))
        row += 1
        sheet.merge(row, 0, last, "A.  " + a, sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
        sheet.row_height(row, 28)
        row += 1
    row += 1

    row = sheet.section(row, "DISCLAIMER", last)
    sheet.merge(row, 0, last, DISCLAIMER, sheet.f.chrome("note_box"))
    sheet.row_height(row, 60)
    row += 2
    C.footer(sheet, cfg, last, row)
    sheet.finish(print_area=f"A1:{xl_col_to_name(last)}{row + 2}")
    sheet.protect()
    return sheet
````

### `26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/writer.py`

<!-- source-file: 26-salon-business/salon_business_spreadsheet/writer.py sha256:1b711fe2e927ea1ff45c88eaef70c113380bb09a33dc375c56cd1e6a3eb12c7f -->
````python
"""
Sheet writing helpers shared by every tab of the workbook.

:class:`SheetWriter` wraps an XlsxWriter worksheet and adds the house style:
title band, navigation strip, section headers, KPI tiles, label/value settings
rows and - most importantly - :meth:`SheetWriter.grid`, which turns a
:class:`~handmade_pricing_spreadsheet.layout.SheetSpec` into a finished register
with headers, drop downs, conditional formats, sample rows, frozen panes and
locked formula cells.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from .config import Config, Palette
from .formats import CALC, FormatBook, INPUT, PLAIN
from .layout import (NAV_ROW, SUBTITLE_ROW, TITLE_ROW, Registry,
                     SheetSpec, col_letter, quote_sheet)

P = Palette

#: Sheets linked from the navigation strip at the top of every tab.
NAV_LINKS: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("Start", "1 Start Here"),
    ("Dash", "2 Dashboard"),
    ("Appts", "3 Appointment Planner"),
    ("Clients", "4 Client CRM"),
    ("Services", "5 Services & Pricing"),
    ("Sales", "6 Sales & Transactions"),
    ("Pay", "7 Payments & Deposits"),
    ("Staff", "8 Staff Management"),
    ("Comm", "9 Staff Commissions"),
    ("Payroll", "10 Payroll & Tips"),
    ("Exp", "11 Expenses"),
    ("P&L", "12 Profit & Loss"),
    ("Stock", "13 Product Inventory"),
    ("Supp", "14 Suppliers & Purchases"),
    ("Mktg", "15 Marketing & Promotions"),
    ("Loyal", "16 Client Loyalty"),
    ("Goals", "17 Goals & Budget"),
    ("Stats", "18 Business Analytics"),
    ("Reports", "19 Weekly & Monthly Reports"),
    ("Settings", "20 Settings & Lists"),
]

#: Columns consumed per navigation link (one cell each on this product,
#: so all sixteen tabs fit on a single strip).
NAV_SPAN = 1

#: The navigation strip always gets at least this many columns, so every
#: tab is linked even from narrow registers.
NAV_MIN_COLS = 20

#: Worksheet protection: formulas are locked, everything else stays usable.
PROTECT_OPTIONS: Dict[str, bool] = {
    "objects": False,
    "scenarios": False,
    "format_cells": True,
    "format_columns": True,
    "format_rows": True,
    "insert_columns": False,
    "insert_rows": True,
    "insert_hyperlinks": True,
    "delete_columns": False,
    "delete_rows": True,
    "select_locked_cells": True,
    "sort": False,          # stops rows being re-sorted out of sync with IDs
    "autofilter": True,     # filtering stays available
    "pivot_tables": False,
    "select_unlocked_cells": True,
}


class SheetWriter:
    """Convenience wrapper around a worksheet."""

    def __init__(self, book, fmts: FormatBook, cfg: Config, reg: Registry,
                 name: str, tab_color: Optional[str] = None,
                 landscape: bool = True) -> None:
        self.book = book
        self.f = fmts
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.reg = reg
        self.name = name
        self.ws = book.add_worksheet(name)
        self._protected = False
        if tab_color:
            self.ws.set_tab_color(tab_color)
        if landscape:
            self.ws.set_landscape()
        self.ws.set_paper(9)  # A4
        self.ws.set_margins(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 0.5)
        self.ws.set_header(
            f"&L&\"Calibri,Bold\"&12{''}"
            f"&C&\"Calibri,Bold\"&11{name}"
            f"&R&\"Calibri,Italic\"&9{cfg.product_name}")
        self.ws.set_footer(
            f"&L&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8{cfg.author} - v{cfg.version}"
            "&C&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8Page &P of &N"
            "&R&\"Calibri,Italic\"&8&D")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- plumbing
    def formula(self, row: int, col: int, formula: str, fmt=None):
        """Write a formula, rendering ``[[Sheet.key]]`` tokens first.

        Every formula in the workbook goes through here (or through
        :meth:`write` / :meth:`merge`, which call it). A token that reaches
        the file unrendered is not a formula Excel can resolve - there are no
        tables in this workbook, so ``[[Sales.gross]]`` would sit in the cell
        as a broken reference.
        """
        text = (formula or "").strip()
        if not text.startswith("="):
            text = "=" + text
        self.ws.write_formula(row, col, self.reg.render(text), fmt)

    def write(self, row: int, col: int, value: Any, fmt=None):
        """Type aware write (0 based row/col, like XlsxWriter)."""
        if value is None:
            if fmt is not None:
                self.ws.write_blank(row, col, None, fmt)
            return
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
            self.formula(row, col, value, fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, (_dt.datetime, _dt.date, _dt.time)):
            self.ws.write_datetime(row, col, value, fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            self.ws.write_string(row, col, "Yes" if value else "No", fmt)
        elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            self.ws.write_number(row, col, value, fmt)
        else:
            self.ws.write_string(row, col, str(value), fmt)

    def merge(self, row: int, first_col: int, last_col: int, value: Any,
              fmt=None, row2: Optional[int] = None):
        row2 = row if row2 is None else row2
        if first_col == last_col and row == row2:
            self.write(row, first_col, value, fmt)
            return
        text = "" if value is None else value
        if isinstance(text, (_dt.datetime, _dt.date, _dt.time)):
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_datetime(row, first_col, text, fmt)
        elif isinstance(text, str) and text.startswith("="):
            # merge first, then put the rendered formula in the anchor cell
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, "", fmt)
            self.formula(row, first_col, text, fmt)
        else:
            self.ws.merge_range(row, first_col, row2, last_col, text, fmt)

    def set_col(self, first: int, last: int, width: float, fmt=None,
                hidden: bool = False):
        options = {"hidden": 1} if hidden else {}
        self.ws.set_column(first, last, width, fmt, options)

    def row_height(self, row: int, height: float):
        self.ws.set_row(row, height)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- page chrome
    def banner(self, title: str, subtitle: str = "", last_col: int = 9,
               nav: bool = True, badge: str = "",
               tail_text: str = "") -> None:
        """Title row + strapline + navigation strip (Excel rows 1-3).

        `tail_text` is written in the empty space to the right of the
        navigation links - used for the register help line on sheets whose
        header row leaves no spare row for it.
        """
        r = TITLE_ROW - 1
        self.row_height(r, 34)
        split = max(last_col - 3, 1)
        self.merge(r, 0, split, title, self.f.chrome("title"))
        self.merge(r, split + 1, last_col,
                   badge or f"{self.cfg.author}  |  v{self.cfg.version}",
                   self.f.chrome("title_right"))

        r = SUBTITLE_ROW - 1
        self.row_height(r, 18)
        self.merge(r, 0, last_col, subtitle, self.f.chrome("subtitle"))

        if nav:
            self.nav_strip(NAV_ROW - 1, max(last_col, NAV_MIN_COLS - 1),
                           tail_text=tail_text)

    def nav_strip(self, row: int, last_col: int,
                  links: Optional[Sequence[Tuple[str, str]]] = None,
                  tail_text: str = "") -> int:
        """Row of internal links. Returns the first column left over."""
        links = list(links or NAV_LINKS)
        self.row_height(row, 16)
        col = 0
        fmt = self.f.chrome("nav")
        for label, sheet in links:
            if col + NAV_SPAN - 1 > last_col:
                break
            if NAV_SPAN > 1:
                self.ws.merge_range(row, col, row,
                                    min(col + NAV_SPAN - 1, last_col),
                                    "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_url(row, col, f"internal:{quote_sheet(sheet)}!A1",
                              fmt, f"> {label}")
            col += NAV_SPAN
        if col <= last_col:
            room = last_col - col
            if tail_text and room >= 4:
                self.merge(row, col, last_col, tail_text,
                           self.f.chrome("note", bg_color=P.note_bg))
            else:
                self.merge(row, col, last_col, "",
                           self.f.chrome("nav_plain"))
        return col

    def section(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int, first_col: int = 0):
        self.row_height(row, 20)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text, self.f.chrome("section"))
        return row + 1

    def subsection(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int,
                   first_col: int = 0):
        self.row_height(row, 17)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text,
                   self.f.chrome("subsection"))
        return row + 1

    def note(self, row: int, text: str, last_col: int, first_col: int = 0,
             height: float = 28, boxed: bool = True):
        self.row_height(row, height)
        self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, text,
                   self.f.chrome("note_box" if boxed else "note"))
        return row + 1

    def bullets(self, row: int, lines: Sequence[str], last_col: int,
                first_col: int = 0, height: float = 15):
        for line in lines:
            self.row_height(row, height)
            self.merge(row, first_col, last_col, line, self.f.chrome("label"))
            row += 1
        return row

    # -------------------------------------------------------- settings rows
    def field(self, row: int, label: str, value: Any = None, *,
              label_col: int = 1, value_col: int = 3,
              value_end: Optional[int] = None, style: str = "text",
              mode: Optional[str] = None, name: Optional[str] = None,
              validate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
              help_text: str = "", help_col: Optional[int] = None,
              formula: Optional[str] = None):
        """A `Label | value | help` settings row, optionally named.

        `mode` defaults to CALC when a formula is supplied and to INPUT
        otherwise: a cell holding a formula must stay locked, or the first
        person to click it and start typing destroys the calculation.
        """
        if mode is None:
            mode = CALC if formula is not None else INPUT
        self.merge(row, label_col, value_col - 1, label,
                   self.f.chrome("label_bold"))
        fmt = self.f.cell(style, mode)
        end = value_end if value_end is not None else value_col
        if formula is not None:
            rendered = self.reg.render(formula)
            if end > value_col:
                self.ws.merge_range(row, value_col, row, end, "", fmt)
            self.ws.write_formula(row, value_col, rendered, fmt)
        else:
            if end > value_col:
                self.merge(row, value_col, end, None, fmt)
                self.write(row, value_col, value, fmt)
            else:
                self.write(row, value_col, value, fmt)
        if validate:
            self.ws.data_validation(row, value_col, row, value_col, validate)
        if help_text:
            hc = help_col if help_col is not None else end + 1
            self.merge(row, hc, hc + 3, help_text, self.f.chrome("note"))
        if name:
            self.book.define_name(
                name, f"={quote_sheet(self.name)}!"
                      f"${col_letter(value_col)}${row + 1}")
        return row + 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ KPI tiles
    def kpi(self, row: int, col: int, label: str, formula: str,
            style: str = "int", span: int = 2, note: str = ""):
        """Three row KPI tile: caption, big number, small note."""
        self.merge(row, col, col + span - 1, label, self.f.chrome("kpi_label"))
        self.row_height(row + 1, 26)
        fmt = self.f.chrome("kpi_value",
                            num_format=self._num_format(style))
        self.ws.merge_range(row + 1, col, row + 1, col + span - 1, "", fmt)
        self.ws.write_formula(row + 1, col, self.reg.render(formula), fmt)
        self.merge(row + 2, col, col + span - 1, note,
                   self.f.chrome("kpi_note"))
        return row + 3

    def num_format(self, style: str) -> str:
        """Number format string for a style key (public helper)."""
        return self._num_format(style)

    def _num_format(self, style: str) -> str:
        return {
            "money": self.cfg.money_format,
            "money0": self.cfg.money_format_0,
            "money4": self.cfg.money_format_4,
            "int": "#,##0",
            "number": "#,##0.00",
            "number1": "#,##0.0",
            "percent": "0.0%",
            "percent0": "0%",
            "date": self.cfg.date_format,
            "text": "General",
        }.get(style, "General")

    # ------------------------------------------------------- generic tables
    def table_head(self, row: int, col: int, headers: Sequence[str],
                   widths: Optional[Sequence[float]] = None,
                   align_left_first: bool = True):
        for i, head in enumerate(headers):
            fmt = self.f.chrome(
                "header_left" if (i == 0 and align_left_first) else "header")
            self.write(row, col + i, head, fmt)
            if widths:
                self.set_col(col + i, col + i, widths[i])
        self.row_height(row, 26)
        return row + 1

    def calc_row(self, row: int, col: int, values: Sequence[Any],
                 styles: Sequence[str], mode: str = CALC,
                 first_style: str = "text"):
        for i, value in enumerate(values):
            style = styles[i] if i < len(styles) else "text"
            fmt = self.f.cell(style, PLAIN if i == 0 and mode == PLAIN
                              else mode)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
                self.ws.write_formula(row, col + i, self.reg.render(value),
                                      fmt)
            else:
                self.write(row, col + i, value, fmt)
        return row + 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- the grid --
    def grid(self, spec: SheetSpec, extra_help: str = "") -> None:
        """Render a whole register sheet from its specification."""
        ws = self.ws
        last_col = spec.last_col_index
        header_row0 = spec.header_row - 1
        first = spec.first_data_row
        last = spec.last_data_row

        help_text = extra_help or spec.help_text
        spare_row = spec.header_row - 1 > NAV_ROW   # room above the headers?
        self.banner(spec.title, spec.subtitle, last_col,
                    tail_text="" if spare_row else help_text)

        if help_text and spare_row:
            self.note(header_row0 - 1, help_text, last_col, height=26)

        # Column widths, default formats (so blank cells keep the right lock
        # state) and the header row itself.
        for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            mode = CALC if col.is_formula else INPUT
            self.set_col(idx, idx, col.width, self.f.cell(col.style, mode),
                         hidden=col.hidden)
            self.write(header_row0, idx, col.header,
                       self.f.chrome("header_left" if idx <= 1 else "header"))
        self.row_height(header_row0, 30)

        # Data rows: formulas everywhere, sample values in the input columns.
        samples = spec.samples if self.cfg.include_sample_data else []
        for offset in range(spec.rows):
            excel_row = first + offset
            row0 = excel_row - 1
            sample = samples[offset] if offset < len(samples) else {}
            for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
                if col.is_formula:
                    fmt = self.f.cell(col.style, CALC)
                    ws.write_formula(
                        row0, idx,
                        self.reg.render(col.formula, excel_row, spec), fmt)
                elif col.key in sample and sample[col.key] is not None:
                    self.write(row0, idx, sample[col.key],
                               self.f.cell(col.style, INPUT))

        # Drop downs, help bubbles and conditional formats.
        for idx, col in enumerate(spec.columns):
            if col.validate:
                options = dict(col.validate)
                if "source" in options and isinstance(options["source"], str):
                    options["source"] = self.reg.render(options["source"])
                if col.note:
                    options.setdefault("input_title", col.header[:32])
                    options.setdefault("input_message", col.note[:255])
                ws.data_validation(first - 1, idx, last - 1, idx, options)
            if col.note:
                # Header comment: works in every Excel version and survives
                # the trip through Google Sheets.
                ws.write_comment(header_row0, idx, col.note, {
                    "author": self.cfg.author,
                    "width": 220,
                    "height": 100,
                    "x_scale": 1.1,
                })
            for rule in col.cf:
                options = dict(rule)
                fmt_key = options.pop("fmt", None)
                if fmt_key:
                    options["format"] = self.f.cf(fmt_key)
                for field_name in ("criteria", "value", "minimum", "maximum"):
                    val = options.get(field_name)
                    if isinstance(val, str) and ("[[" in val or "{" in val):
                        options[field_name] = self.reg.render(
                            val, first, spec)
                ws.conditional_format(first - 1, idx, last - 1, idx, options)

        ws.autofilter(header_row0, 0, last - 1, last_col)
        freeze_row = (spec.freeze_at if spec.freeze_at is not None
                      else spec.header_row)
        ws.freeze_panes(freeze_row, spec.freeze_cols)
        ws.print_area(0, 0, last - 1, last_col)
        ws.repeat_rows(0, header_row0 if spec.header_row <= 6 else 2)
        ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- finishing
    def finish(self, freeze_row: Optional[int] = None,
               freeze_col: int = 0, print_area: Optional[str] = None,
               fit_width: bool = True, gridlines: bool = True):
        if freeze_row is not None:
            self.ws.freeze_panes(freeze_row, freeze_col)
        if print_area:
            self.ws.print_area(print_area)
        if fit_width:
            self.ws.fit_to_pages(1, 0)
        if not gridlines:
            self.ws.hide_gridlines(2)
        self.protect()

    def protect(self):
        if self.cfg.protect_sheets and not self._protected:
            self.ws.protect(self.cfg.password, dict(PROTECT_OPTIONS))
            self._protected = True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Small shared helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def yes_no(validate_note: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    opts: Dict[str, Any] = {"validate": "list", "source": ["Yes", "No"]}
    if validate_note:
        opts["input_message"] = validate_note
    return opts


def list_from(name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Drop down fed by a defined name (see lists.py)."""
    return {"validate": "list", "source": f"={name}"}


def date_check() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "validate": "date",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": _dt.date(2000, 1, 1),
        "maximum": _dt.date(2100, 12, 31),
        "error_title": "Check the date",
        "error_message": "Enter a real date between 2000 and 2100.",
    }


def time_check() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Any time of day. Typing 9:00 AM or 14:30 both work."""
    return {
        "validate": "time",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": _dt.time(0, 0),
        "maximum": _dt.time(23, 59),
        "error_title": "Check the time",
        "error_message": "Enter a time of day, for example 9:00 AM "
                         "or 14:30.",
    }


def number_check(minimum: float = 0, maximum: float = 1000000,
                 decimal: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "validate": "decimal" if decimal else "integer",
        "criteria": "between",
        "minimum": minimum,
        "maximum": maximum,
        "error_title": "Check the value",
        "error_message": f"Enter a number between {minimum} and {maximum}.",
    }


def cf_text(text: str, fmt: str, criteria: str = "containing") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "text", "criteria": criteria, "value": text, "fmt": fmt}


def cf_formula(formula: str, fmt: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "formula", "criteria": formula, "fmt": fmt}


def cf_bar(color: str = "#2E7D8F") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "data_bar", "bar_color": color}
````
