<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/equipment.py sha256:9834c8f6a59a7dc3940201e6cb00fe063f233af868df7b10c08b2e4f16b708f1 -->
````python
"""14. Equipment Inventory - the machines, and when they are due.

Mowers measure their lives in engine hours, not calendar months, so
this tab tracks both: hours since the last service against the
interval you set, and days since the last service against the months
you set. Whichever comes first wins, which is how the manual says it
and how the dashboard alert works.

A machine that fails in July costs a week of the season. The warning
columns here exist so that it fails in the workshop in February
instead.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, count_by, id_col,
                     is_usable_equipment, rank_desc, scale_cf,
                     status_cf, sum_by, yesno, zero)

NAME = "Equipment Inventory"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Equipment Inventory",
        subtitle="Every machine you own: what it cost, what it is "
                 "worth, when it was last serviced and what it owes "
                 "you.",
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
        rows=cfg.row_count("equipment"),
        samples=sample("equipment", cfg),
        help_text=(
            "List every machine worth more than a few days' hire. "
            "Record the engine hours when you service it and the "
            "workbook works out when the next one is due, by hours "
            "and by date, and warns you before either arrives."),
        extra_notes=[
            "Service intervals are set per machine because a "
            "commercial mower and a hedge trimmer do not live the "
            "same life. The defaults on Settings are used when a row "
            "leaves them blank.",
            "Cost per hour is the number that tells you whether to "
            "repair or replace. Once a machine's running cost per "
            "hour passes what hiring one would cost, the decision "
            "has already been made for you.",
            "Depreciation here is straight line and is for your own "
            "planning only. Your accountant will use a different "
            "method for tax, and theirs is the one that counts.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("name", "EquipmentPrefix",
                   digits=cfg.digits("equipment"), header="Equipment ID",
                   note="Generated. Useful on a sticker on the "
                        "machine itself."),
            Col("name", "Equipment", 26, "text",
                note="Start here. 'Exmark Lazer Z 60\"' beats 'big "
                     "mower' when there are three of them."),
            Col("category", "Category", 20, "text",
                validate=list_from("EquipmentCategoryList")),
            Col("make", "Make", 15, "text"),
            Col("model", "Model", 16, "text"),
            Col("serial", "Serial number", 18, "text",
                note="The one the insurer and the police ask for. "
                     "Photograph the plate as well."),
            Col("purchase_date", "Bought", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("purchase_price", "Cost", 11, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000)),
            Col("life_years", "Life (years)", 11, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 50, decimal=False),
                note="How long you expect to keep it working. Drives "
                     "the depreciation estimate."),
            Col("warranty_end", "Warranty to", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="Worth checking before paying for a repair."),
            Col("status", "Status", 15, "text",
                validate=list_from("EquipmentStatusList"),
                cf=status_cf()),
            Col("condition", "Condition", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("EquipmentConditionList"),
                cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "Poor", "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "Needs replacing", "fmt": "bold_bad"}]),
            Col("assigned", "Assigned to", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("CrewNameList"),
                note="Which crew has it on the trailer."),
            Col("location", "Kept at", 16, "text",
                note="Yard, trailer two, Danny's garage."),

            # ---- servicing -------------------------------------------
            Col("hours_now", "Engine hours", 12, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 100000,
                                "The reading on the hour meter today."),
                note="Update it when you service the machine. It is "
                     "the only honest measure of a mower's life."),
            Col("last_service", "Last service", 12, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("last_service_hours", "Hours at service", 14, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 100000),
                note="The hour meter reading at the last service."),
            Col("service_hours", "Service every (hrs)", 15, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 10000, decimal=False),
                note="Blank uses the default interval on Settings."),
            Col("service_months", "Service every (months)", 16, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 120, decimal=False),
                note="Some machines are due by the calendar even if "
                     "they have barely run."),
            Col("hours_used", "Hours since", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'MAX(0,{hours_now}{r}-'
                             '{last_service_hours}{r})'),
                note="Engine hours since the last service."),
            Col("hours_interval", "Interval used", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF({service_hours}{r}>0,'
                             '{service_hours}{r},ServiceHours)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("hours_left", "Hours to service", 14, "number1",
                formula='=IF({name}{r}="","",'
                        'ROUND({hours_interval}{r}-'
                        '{hours_used}{r},1))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<=", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<=", "value": 10,
                     "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="Negative means the service is overdue by that "
                     "many engine hours."),
            Col("days_since_service", "Days since", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF({last_service}{r}="",0,'
                             'TodayDate-{last_service}{r})'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("months_interval", "Months used", 10, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF({service_months}{r}>0,'
                             '{service_months}{r},ServiceMonths)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("next_service_date", "Service due", 12, "date",
                formula='=IF({name}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({last_service}{r}="","",'
                        'EDATE({last_service}{r},'
                        '{months_interval}{r})))',
                cf=[{"type": "formula",
                     "criteria": '=AND(ISNUMBER({next_service_date}{r}),'
                                 '{next_service_date}{r}<TodayDate)',
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"}],
                note="By the calendar. The hours column may get there "
                     "first - whichever does, wins."),
            Col("days_to_service", "Days to service", 13, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF({last_service}{r}="",0,'
                             'EDATE({last_service}{r},'
                             '{months_interval}{r})-TodayDate)'),
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<=",
                     "value": "=ServiceWarnDays", "fmt": "warn"}]),
            Col("service_due", "Due now", 8, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF(({hours_left}{r}<=0)+'
                             '(AND({last_service}{r}<>"",'
                             '{days_to_service}{r}<=0))>0,1,0)'),
                hidden=True,
                note="Either measure being past due makes this 1. The "
                     "dashboard counts it."),
            Col("service_soon", "Due soon", 8, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF(AND({service_due}{r}=0,'
                             '({hours_left}{r}<=ServiceWarnHours)+'
                             '(AND({last_service}{r}<>"",'
                             '{days_to_service}{r}<='
                             'ServiceWarnDays))>0),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),

            # ---- what it costs ---------------------------------------
            Col("maintenance_cost", "Maintenance spend", 15, "money",
                formula=zero("name", sum_by("Expense Tracker", "amount",
                                            "equipment", '{id}{r}')),
                note="Everything booked to this machine on the expense "
                     "tracker."),
            Col("maintenance_count", "Repairs", 9, "int",
                formula=zero("name", count_by("Expense Tracker",
                                              "equipment", '{id}{r}'))),
            Col("age_years", "Age (years)", 10, "number1",
                formula='=IF({purchase_date}{r}="","",'
                        'ROUND((TodayDate-'
                        '{purchase_date}{r})/365.25,1))'),
            Col("depreciated", "Written down to", 13, "money",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF({life_years}{r}<=0,0,'
                             'ROUND(MAX(0,{purchase_price}{r}*'
                             '(1-MIN(1,(TodayDate-'
                             '{purchase_date}{r})/365.25/'
                             '{life_years}{r}))),2))'),
                note="Straight line, for planning. Your accountant "
                     "will do it differently for tax."),
            Col("total_cost", "Owned cost", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'ROUND({purchase_price}{r}+'
                             '{maintenance_cost}{r},2)')),
            Col("cost_per_hour", "Cost per hour", 12, "money",
                formula='=IF({name}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({hours_now}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({total_cost}{r}/'
                        '{hours_now}{r},2)))',
                cf=scale_cf(),
                note="Purchase plus repairs, divided by the hours it "
                     "has run. Compare it with the hire rate."),
            Col("replace_flag", "Replace?", 10, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Are you planning to replace this in "
                               "the next twelve months?"),
                note="Planning it beats discovering it in June."),
            Col("insured", "Insured", 9, "flag",
                validate=yesno()),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 28, "wrap"),

            Col("is_usable", "Usable", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             f'IF({is_usable_equipment("{status}{r}")},'
                             '1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            rank_desc("maintenance_cost", guard='{name}{r}=""'),

            Col("alert", "What needs doing", 46, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("name", [
                    ('{status}{r}="Out of service"',
                     "Urgent - out of service, jobs needing it will "
                     "slip"),
                    ('AND({is_usable}{r}=1,{service_due}{r}=1)',
                     "Service - overdue, book it in now"),
                    ('{condition}{r}="Needs replacing"',
                     "Action - condition says it needs replacing"),
                    ('AND({is_usable}{r}=1,{service_soon}{r}=1)',
                     "Due - service coming up shortly"),
                    ('AND({purchase_price}{r}>0,'
                     '{maintenance_cost}{r}>{purchase_price}{r}*0.5)',
                     "Check - repairs have passed half what it cost"),
                    ('AND({hours_now}{r}>0,{last_service}{r}="")',
                     "Add - no service history recorded"),
                    ('AND({is_usable}{r}=1,{hours_now}{r}=0)',
                     "Add - no engine hours, so servicing cannot be "
                     "tracked"),
                    ('{insured}{r}="No"',
                     "Check - not marked as insured"),
                    ('{replace_flag}{r}="Yes"',
                     "Plan - flagged for replacement this year"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/expenses.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/expenses.py sha256:5fe500180c02a62d88bda75c31f94c4c462694be48c037e81a4a52534cec541d -->
````python
"""18. Expense Tracker - everything that goes out, and what it belongs to.

Two kinds of line live here and the difference matters. A line with a
Job ID is a cost of doing that job, and it lands on that job's actual
cost and its profit. A line without one is a cost of being in
business - insurance, the accountant, the yard rent - and it belongs
to the month, not to any visit.

Material purchases and material usage are both recorded here, which
is how the materials tab knows what is in the yard without anybody
counting it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, date_num_col, id_col,
                     is_job_cost, money_cf, month_col, pick,
                     yesno, zero)

NAME = "Expense Tracker"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Expense Tracker",
        subtitle="Every cost: the ones that belong to a job, and the "
                 "ones that belong to the business.",
        tab_color=Palette.deep,
        rows=cfg.row_count("expenses"),
        samples=sample("expenses", cfg),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text=(
            "One line per receipt. Put a Job ID on it only if the "
            "cost belongs to that visit - mulch delivered for it, "
            "the tip fee for its waste. Leave it blank for insurance, "
            "rent, advertising and everything else that is the cost "
            "of being open."),
        extra_notes=[
            "Booking a material purchase here with a Material ID and "
            "a quantity is what fills the Materials Inventory. Mark "
            "it as a purchase when it comes into the yard and as "
            "usage when it goes out to a job - the same tab, the "
            "'Purchase or usage' column apart.",
            "For material movements enter purchase amount on Purchase "
            "and the cost of stock consumed on Usage or Wastage. "
            "Monthly costs count purchases, not stock usage; job costs "
            "count usage linked to the job, not inventory purchases.",
            "Do not re-enter fuel from the Vehicle & Fuel Tracker. "
            "It is already counted there, and the monthly reports "
            "add the two together.",
            "The tax category column is there to make your "
            "accountant's year-end quicker. It is a label for your "
            "own records, not tax advice, and what is deductible "
            "depends on where you trade.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("date", '"EXP-"', digits=5, header="Line"),
            Col("date", "Date", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="Start here."),
            Col("supplier", "Paid to", 22, "text",
                note="Who got the money."),
            Col("description", "What for", 30, "wrap"),
            Col("category", "Category", 22, "text",
                validate=list_from("ExpenseCategoryList"),
                note="Four of these - materials, fuel, subcontract "
                     "and disposal - count as job costs when a Job ID "
                     "is attached."),
            Col("amount", "Amount", 11, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="What you paid, including tax if you cannot "
                     "reclaim it."),
            Col("tax_amount", "Tax paid", 10, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000),
                note="The tax portion, if you are registered and can "
                     "reclaim it."),
            Col("job", "Job ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("JobIDList",
                              "Pick the visit this cost belongs to."),
                note="Only when the cost belongs to one visit. This is "
                     "what makes job profit real rather than "
                     "theoretical."),
            Col("job_address", "Where", 24, "text",
                formula='=IF({job}{r}="","",'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX('
                        '[[Job & Work Orders.address]],'
                        'MATCH({job}{r},'
                        '[[Job & Work Orders.id]],0))&"",'
                        '"Check - Job ID not found"))',
                cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "Check -", "fmt": "bad"}]),
            Col("material", "Material ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("MaterialIDList",
                              "Only for material purchases and usage. "
                              "Pick from the Materials Inventory."),
                note="Fills the stock figures on the Materials tab."),
            Col("movement", "Purchase or usage", 15, "text",
                validate=pick("StockMoveList",
                              "Is this material coming into the yard "
                              "or going out to a job?"),
                note="'Purchase' adds to stock; 'Usage' and "
                     "'Wastage' both take it away. Leave blank for "
                     "anything that is not a material."),
            Col("quantity", "Quantity", 10, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "How many units, in the material's own "
                                "unit."),
                note="In the unit set on the Materials tab - bags, "
                     "yards, gallons."),
            Col("equipment", "Equipment ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("EquipmentIDList",
                              "For repairs, servicing and parts - "
                              "which machine was it for?"),
                note="Builds each machine's running cost and tells you "
                     "when repairing stops being worth it."),
            Col("vehicle", "Vehicle", 14, "text",
                validate=pick("VehicleList",
                              "For vehicle costs not already on the "
                              "fuel tracker."),
                note="Use the Vehicle & Fuel Tracker for fuel. This is "
                     "for anything else."),
            Col("payment_method", "Paid by", 15, "text",
                validate=list_from("PaymentMethodList")),
            Col("reference", "Receipt no.", 13, "text",
                note="Where to find the paperwork in six months."),
            Col("tax_category", "Tax category", 18, "text",
                validate=list_from("TaxCategoryList"),
                note="A label for your accountant. Not tax advice."),
            Col("recurring", "Recurring", 10, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Does this come round every month?"),
                note="Insurance, rent, software. Worth knowing what "
                     "your fixed monthly floor is."),
            Col("billable", "Rebill?", 9, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Will you charge this on to the "
                               "customer?"),
                note="Rebilled costs should appear as extras on the "
                     "job, otherwise you have paid for them twice."),
            Col("receipt_link", "Receipt link", 18, "link",
                note="A link to the photo of the receipt in your cloud "
                     "drive."),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 24, "wrap"),

            # Purchase-basis management costs and job-level allocation.
            Col("period_cost", "Period cost", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date", 'IF(OR({movement}{r}="Usage",'
                             '{movement}{r}="Wastage"),0,{amount}{r})'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("allocated_cost", "Job allocated cost", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date", 'IF(AND({material}{r}<>"",'
                             '{movement}{r}="Purchase"),0,{amount}{r})'),
                hidden=True),
            # ---- the flags other tabs count on -----------------------
            Col("is_job_cost", "Job cost", 8, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({job}{r}<>"",'
                             f'{is_job_cost("{category}{r}")}),1,0)'),
                hidden=True,
                note="A job cost is one with a Job ID AND a category "
                     "that belongs to a job."),
            Col("is_overhead", "Overhead", 8, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({is_job_cost}{r}=1,0,1)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_purchase", "Purchase", 8, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({material}{r}<>"",'
                             '{movement}{r}="Purchase",'
                             '{quantity}{r}>0),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_usage", "Usage", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({material}{r}<>"",'
                             '({movement}{r}="Usage")+'
                             '({movement}{r}="Wastage")>0,'
                             '{quantity}{r}>0),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("unit_cost", "Cost per unit", 11, "money",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({quantity}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'IF({is_purchase}{r}=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({amount}{r}/'
                        '{quantity}{r},2))))',
                note="What this delivery actually cost per unit. "
                     "Compare it with the Materials tab - prices "
                     "move."),
            date_num_col("date", "date_num"),
            month_col("date"),

            Col("alert", "What needs doing", 44, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("date", [
                    ('{job_address}{r}="Check - Job ID not found"',
                     "Check - the Job ID on this line does not exist"),
                    ('{amount}{r}=0',
                     "Add - no amount on this line"),
                    ('AND({material}{r}<>"",{movement}{r}="")',
                     "Add - material with no purchase or usage set, so "
                     "stock is not moving"),
                    ('AND({material}{r}<>"",{quantity}{r}=0)',
                     "Add - material with no quantity"),
                    ('AND({category}{r}="Materials",{job}{r}="",'
                     '{material}{r}="")',
                     "Check - materials cost tied to neither a job nor "
                     "a material"),
                    ('{category}{r}=""',
                     "Add - no category, so it will not reach the "
                     "right report"),
                    ('AND({billable}{r}="Yes",{job}{r}="")',
                     "Check - marked to rebill but no job to rebill "
                     "it on"),
                    ('{reference}{r}=""',
                     "Add - no receipt reference"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/feedback.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/feedback.py sha256:cf6fe3b990d3ced42fa2c0ec885ff7da654436286ac4df9e63645757b66586a5 -->
````python
"""19. Customer Feedback - what they said, and what you did about it.

Complaints are not the enemy; unrecorded complaints are. A row here
with a date, a cause and a resolution is a business learning
something. The same complaint arriving three times from three
customers, with nobody noticing, is a business about to lose them.

Scores feed back to the customer record and to the crew scorecard, so
one piece of feedback lands everywhere it is relevant.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, customer_col,
                     date_num_col, id_col, lookup_customer, month_col,
                     pick, rating_cf, score_validation,
                     status_cf, yesno, zero)

NAME = "Customer Feedback"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Customer Feedback",
        subtitle="Compliments, complaints and scores - with the cause, "
                 "the fix and how long it took.",
        tab_color=Palette.primary_mid,
        rows=cfg.row_count("feedback"),
        samples=sample("feedback", cfg),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text=(
            "Log everything, good and bad. Put the Job ID on it when "
            "it is about a particular visit, and the score feeds both "
            "the customer's record and the crew scorecard. Then fill "
            "in what you did about it - that column is the one that "
            "turns a complaint into a repeat customer."),
        extra_notes=[
            "A score of 1 to 5. Anything at or below 3 counts as a "
            "problem and is chased on the dashboard until it is "
            "resolved.",
            "Recording the cause honestly - rushed, wrong day, "
            "machine broke, price surprise - is how three "
            "complaints turn into one fix.",
            "Ask for a review only after a resolved complaint or a "
            "compliment. The 'Review asked' column stops you asking "
            "the same person twice.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("date", '"FBK-"', digits=4, header="Line"),
            Col("date", "Date", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="Start here - the day they told you."),
            customer_col(),
            Col("customer_name", "Customer", 20, "text",
                formula=lookup_customer("name")),
            Col("job", "Job ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("JobIDList",
                              "Pick the visit this is about."),
                note="If it is about one visit. Blank if it is general."),
            Col("property", "Property ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("PropertyList",
                              "Where it happened."),
                note="Where it happened, if it matters."),
            Col("crew", "Crew", 12, "text",
                validate=list_from("CrewNameList"),
                note="Which crew the feedback is about. Feeds their "
                     "quality score."),
            Col("source", "How it came in", 16, "text",
                validate=list_from("FeedbackSourceList")),
            Col("type", "Type", 16, "text",
                validate=list_from("FeedbackTypeList"),
                cf=status_cf()),
            Col("score", "Score", 8, "rating",
                validate=score_validation(5),
                cf=rating_cf(),
                note="1 to 5. Three or below is treated as a problem."),
            Col("comment", "What they said", 38, "wrap",
                note="Their words, not your summary of them. They are "
                     "more useful later."),
            Col("cause", "Cause", 20, "text",
                validate=pick("FeedbackCauseList",
                              "Why did it happen? Be honest - this is "
                              "for you, not for them."),
                note="The pattern in this column is worth more than "
                     "any individual complaint."),
            Col("action", "What you did", 34, "wrap",
                note="The fix. 'Recut the front, apologised, no "
                     "charge' is a complete answer."),
            Col("cost", "Cost to fix", 11, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "What putting it right cost you - a "
                                "free visit, a refund, replacement "
                                "plants."),
                note="Worth knowing. Poor work is rarely free."),
            Col("status", "Status", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("FeedbackStatusList"),
                cf=status_cf()),
            Col("resolved_date", "Resolved on", 12, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("owner", "Handled by", 16, "text"),
            Col("review_asked", "Review asked", 11, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Have you asked this customer for a "
                               "public review?"),
                note="Ask after a compliment or a resolved complaint, "
                     "never after an unresolved one."),
            Col("review_left", "Review left", 10, "flag",
                validate=yesno()),
            Col("follow_up", "Follow up on", 12, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="Put a date here and it will be chased."),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 24, "wrap"),

            # ---- the worked out bits ---------------------------------
            Col("is_problem", "Problem", 8, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(({type}{r}="Complaint")+'
                             '({type}{r}="Quality issue")+'
                             '({type}{r}="Damage claim")+'
                             '(AND({score}{r}>0,{score}{r}<=3))>0,'
                             '1,0)'),
                hidden=True,
                note="A complaint, a quality issue, a damage claim or "
                     "a score of three or less."),
            Col("is_open", "Open", 6, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(({status}{r}="Resolved")+'
                             '({status}{r}="Closed")>0,0,1)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("days_open", "Days open", 10, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({is_open}{r}=0,'
                             'IF({resolved_date}{r}="",0,'
                             '{resolved_date}{r}-{date}{r}),'
                             'TodayDate-{date}{r})'),
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 14,
                     "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 7,
                     "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="How long it took, or how long it has been "
                     "sitting there."),
            Col("is_promoter", "Promoter", 8, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({score}{r}>=4,1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            date_num_col("date", "date_num"),
            month_col("date"),

            Col("alert", "What needs doing", 44, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("date", [
                    ('AND({is_problem}{r}=1,{is_open}{r}=1,'
                     '{days_open}{r}>=7)',
                     "Urgent - an unresolved complaint over a week old"),
                    ('AND({is_problem}{r}=1,{is_open}{r}=1)',
                     "Action - complaint open, deal with it today"),
                    ('AND({is_open}{r}=1,{follow_up}{r}<>"",'
                     '{follow_up}{r}<=TodayDate)',
                     "Follow up - the follow-up date has arrived"),
                    ('AND({is_problem}{r}=1,{cause}{r}="")',
                     "Add - no cause recorded, so nothing can be "
                     "learned from it"),
                    ('AND({is_problem}{r}=1,{action}{r}="")',
                     "Add - nothing recorded about what you did"),
                    ('AND({is_promoter}{r}=1,'
                     '{review_asked}{r}<>"Yes")',
                     "Action - a happy customer who has not been "
                     "asked for a review"),
                    ('AND({review_asked}{r}="Yes",'
                     '{review_left}{r}<>"Yes",'
                     'TodayDate-{date}{r}>=FeedbackChaseDays)',
                     "Follow up - review asked for but never left"),
                    ('{is_open}{r}=1', "Due - still open"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/getting_started.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/getting_started.py sha256:5cc805a047aa30d1a001f2f82b0357b29164079e45715351204eb70beb61e164 -->
````python
"""`Getting Started` - the hour that makes the other twenty-two tabs work.

Written in the order somebody actually does it, with the honest bits
included: what this workbook does, what it does not do, and the four
IDs that hold the whole thing together.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import (DISCLAIMER, HONESTY_NOTE, PAYROLL_NOTE,
                      PHOTO_NOTE, PRIVACY_NOTE, ROUTE_NOTE,
                      WEATHER_NOTE, Config, Palette)
from ..layout import Registry
from ..writer import SheetWriter

NAME = "Getting Started"
LAST_COL = 9

STEPS = [
    ("1. Settings & Lists - half an hour, once",
     "Your business details, your crew cost per hour, your "
     "charge-out rate, your overhead per hour, your margins and "
     "your warning windows. Everything else in the workbook is "
     "calculated from these. The crew cost rate and the overhead "
     "rate are the two that decide whether your profit figures are "
     "true - set them properly before anything else."),
    ("2. Service Catalog - your price list",
     "Add your services, rates, units and times; the demo has "
     "illustrative examples, not recommendations. Set every rate "
     "to yours, and change the "
     "minutes to what the work actually takes you. The margin "
     "column will tell you straight away which of your prices do "
     "not work."),
    ("3. Customer CRM - who pays you",
     "One row per customer, and the Customer ID appears on its own. "
     "A household with two addresses is one customer with two "
     "properties, not two customers."),
    ("4. Property Database - where the work happens",
     "One row per address, pointing at a customer. Measure the lawn "
     "once and measure it properly - the area drives every price, "
     "every time estimate and every material quantity in the "
     "workbook. Record the access, the slope, the obstacles and the "
     "dog while you are there."),
    ("5. Crew Database - who does the work",
     "Each person, with their loaded cost per hour: wages plus "
     "payroll tax plus insurance, not take-home pay. Put the "
     "take-home figure in and every job will look more profitable "
     "than it really is."),
    ("6. Quote Calculator - price the first job",
     "Pick a customer, a property and a service and watch the price "
     "build itself from the lawn size, the labour, the materials, "
     "the travel and the margin you asked for. Override anything "
     "in the white input cells; the margin column shows what the "
     "override cost you."),
    ("7. Job & Work Orders - book the work",
     "A row per visit. Mark it Completed when it is done, and put "
     "the real hours on it. That one habit is what turns this from "
     "a list into a costing system."),
    ("8. Recurring Contracts - the income you can count on",
     "Set up the standing agreements. The workbook tells you when "
     "the next visit is due and what each agreement is worth over a "
     "year - and it will remind you to renew before the season "
     "starts."),
    ("9. Invoice & Payments - get paid",
     "Raise the invoice, put the Job ID on it, record payments as "
     "they arrive. The overdue column is the one that pays for this "
     "workbook."),
    ("10. Timesheets, Expenses, Equipment - the truth",
     "Hours against job numbers, receipts against job numbers, "
     "engine hours against machines. This is the unglamorous part, "
     "and it is the part that makes the Profit Analysis tab worth "
     "reading."),
]

WHAT_IT_DOES = [
    "Prices a job from lawn size, labour hours, materials, "
    "equipment, travel and the profit margin you want.",
    "Keeps customers and properties as separate, linked records, so "
    "one customer can own six addresses.",
    "Works out when every recurring visit is next due, from the "
    "frequency and the last completed visit.",
    "Costs every job twice - what you estimated and what it "
    "actually took - and shows you the gap.",
    "Tracks crew hours, overtime and the share of the day that was "
    "actually billable.",
    "Warns you when a machine is due a service, by engine hours or "
    "by date, whichever comes first.",
    "Flags overdue invoices, aged into buckets, worst first.",
    "Prints a quote, an invoice and a daily crew work order.",
    "Shows profit by job, by customer, by property, by service and "
    "by month.",
]

WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT = [
    "It does not navigate. The Route Planner organises the stops "
    "you choose onto a printable sheet; it is not GPS and it does "
    "not work out the shortest route.",
    "It does not sync with QuickBooks, Xero, Jobber, Yardbook or "
    "any other software. Nothing in it connects to the internet.",
    "It does not take card payments or send invoices. It records "
    "what you billed and what arrived.",
    "It does not run payroll or calculate tax withholding. It "
    "records hours and costs so your job figures are honest.",
    "It does not book jobs by itself. The contract scheduler tells "
    "you what is due; you decide what actually gets booked, because "
    "weather and breakdowns get a vote.",
    "It does not know about work nobody wrote down. Every figure in "
    "here is built from the rows you enter.",
]


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg: Registry) -> SheetWriter:
    s = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                    tab_color=Palette.primary_light)

    s.banner("Getting Started",
             "An hour here and the other twenty-two tabs do the rest "
             "of the year for you.",
             LAST_COL)
    s.set_col(0, 0, 4)
    s.set_col(1, 1, 40)
    s.set_col(2, LAST_COL, 14)

    row = 4
    row = s.note(
        row,
        "Work down this list in order. Each step depends on the one "
        "before it - there is no point pricing a job before the "
        "property it happens at exists, and no point costing it "
        "before the crew rate is right. The whole thing takes an "
        "hour or two, once.",
        LAST_COL, height=38)
    row += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------- the four IDs --
    row = s.section(row, "The four IDs that hold this together",
                    LAST_COL)
    row = s.note(
        row,
        "This is a connected workbook, not twenty-three separate "
        "lists, and four automatic IDs are what connect it. Every "
        "one of them is generated for you, and every cell that "
        "refers to one is a drop-down rather than free text. Pick "
        "from the list - a typed ID is a row that quietly stops "
        "being part of your business.",
        LAST_COL, height=44)
    row += 1
    for label, body in [
        ("Customer ID",
         "Created on the Customer CRM tab. Owns properties, "
         "contracts and invoices. Carries lifetime revenue and "
         "everything they owe you."),
        ("Property ID",
         "Created on the Property Database tab, and points at a "
         "Customer ID. Carries the lawn size, the access, the gate "
         "code and the distance - which is why a quote for an "
         "address you have visited before takes four seconds."),
        ("Job ID",
         "Created on the Job & Work Orders tab, and points at a "
         "property. Timesheets and expenses point at it, which is "
         "how the workbook knows what each visit really cost."),
        ("Invoice ID",
         "Created on the Invoice & Payments tab. Points at a "
         "customer and usually at a job. Carries what is owed and "
         "how late it is."),
    ]:
        s.write(row, 1, label, fmts.chrome("label_bold"))
        s.merge(row, 2, LAST_COL, body, fmts.chrome("label"))
        s.row_height(row, 30)
        row += 1
    row += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------ the steps --
    row = s.section(row, "Set it up, in this order", LAST_COL)
    for title, body in STEPS:
        s.merge(row, 1, LAST_COL, title, fmts.chrome("subsection"))
        row += 1
        s.merge(row, 1, LAST_COL, body, fmts.chrome("label"))
        s.row_height(row, 42)
        row += 1
    row += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------- the daily habit --
    row = s.section(row, "Then, the daily habit", LAST_COL)
    row = s.bullets(row, [
        "Morning: open the Route Planner, pick the date and the "
        "crew, print one sheet per truck.",
        "Evening: mark the jobs Completed, put the real hours on "
        "them, and type in the day's receipts.",
        "Friday: raise the invoices for the week's completed work. "
        "The dashboard's 'Completed, unbilled' tile is your list.",
        "Monthly: pick the month on the Profit Analysis tab and "
        "read one row. Fifteen minutes, and you will know more "
        "about your business than most people in this trade know "
        "about theirs.",
    ], LAST_COL, height=24)
    row += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------ honesty --
    row = s.section(row, "What this workbook does", LAST_COL)
    row = s.bullets(row, WHAT_IT_DOES, LAST_COL, height=24)
    row += 1
    row = s.section(row, "What it does not do", LAST_COL)
    row = s.note(
        row,
        "Said plainly, so you can decide before you rely on it.",
        LAST_COL, height=20)
    row += 1
    row = s.bullets(row, WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT, LAST_COL, height=30)
    row += 1

    # -------------------------------------------------- practical bits --
    row = s.section(row, "Practical things worth knowing", LAST_COL)
    row = s.bullets(row, [
        "Every sheet is protected with the password "
        f"'{cfg.password}' so that formulas cannot be typed over by "
        "accident. White cells are yours; shaded ones calculate "
        "themselves.",
        "Add rows by typing in the next empty row - the formulas are "
        "already there, waiting. Do not insert rows in the middle of "
        "a register.",
        "Filter a register rather than re-sorting it. The automatic "
        "IDs come from the row number, so re-sorting changes them.",
        "Nothing here needs macros, add-ins or a subscription. It "
        "is designed for desktop Excel 2010 and later.",
        "Keep a backup. It is one file, and one file is one thing to "
        "lose.",
    ], LAST_COL, height=28)
    row += 1

    for note, height in [(ROUTE_NOTE, 56), (HONESTY_NOTE, 62),
                         (PAYROLL_NOTE, 52), (WEATHER_NOTE, 44),
                         (PHOTO_NOTE, 44), (PRIVACY_NOTE, 52),
                         (DISCLAIMER, 72)]:
        row = s.note(row, note, LAST_COL, height=height)
        row += 1

    s.finish(freeze_row=4, gridlines=False, fit_width=True)
    s.protect()
    return s
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/invoices.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/invoices.py sha256:339842f5783f528fd885a3c7917ef5d4d51311434330e70b31a905f1f2941670 -->
````python
"""17. Invoice & Payments - what you billed and what actually arrived.

Outstanding is the whole point: total minus paid, aged against the
due date that comes from the customer's own payment terms. The
overdue column feeds the dashboard, the customer record and the
chase list, so there is exactly one place where a debt lives.

An invoice can cover one job or a month of them. Put the Job ID on it
when it is one job - that is what closes the loop from quote to job
to money in the bank.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, customer_col,
                     date_num_col, id_col, is_owed_invoice,
                     is_paid_invoice, lookup_customer, money_cf,
                     month_col, owing_cf, pick, service_tax,
                     status_cf, term_days, yesno, zero)

NAME = "Invoice & Payments"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Invoice & Payments",
        subtitle="Every invoice, what has been paid against it, and "
                 "exactly how late the rest of it is.",
        tab_color=Palette.deep,
        rows=cfg.row_count("invoices"),
        samples=sample("invoices", cfg),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text=(
            "One row per invoice. The due date comes from the "
            "customer's payment terms, the outstanding amount from "
            "what you have recorded as paid, and the overdue flag "
            "from the two together. Record part payments in the paid "
            "column as they arrive."),
        extra_notes=[
            "This tab records invoices; it does not send them and it "
            "does not take card payments. Use the printable invoice on Route Planner "
            "page to produce the document, then record what happens "
            "here.",
            "Age is counted from the due date, not the invoice date, "
            "so an invoice on 30-day terms is not 'thirty days late' "
            "the moment it is sent.",
            "Writing one off is a decision, not a deletion. Set the "
            "status to 'Written off' and the amount stops being "
            "chased but stays in the record, where it belongs.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("date", "InvoicePrefix", digits=cfg.digits("invoice"),
                   header="Invoice ID",
                   note="Generated, sequential and unique. Put it on "
                        "the job it bills."),
            Col("invoice_number", "Your number", 13, "text",
                note="If your accountant needs a particular numbering "
                     "format, put it here. The ID above is what the "
                     "workbook joins on."),
            Col("date", "Invoice date", 12, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="Start here."),
            customer_col(),
            Col("customer_name", "Customer", 22, "text",
                formula=lookup_customer("name")),
            Col("job", "Job ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("JobIDList",
                              "Pick the job this invoice bills."),
                note="For a single-job invoice. Leave blank for a "
                     "monthly or multi-job bill and list the work in "
                     "the description."),
            Col("contract", "Contract ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("ContractIDList",
                              "Pick the agreement being billed."),
                note="If this is the regular bill for a standing "
                     "agreement."),
            Col("description", "What for", 34, "wrap",
                note="What the customer sees. 'Grass cutting, April - "
                     "4 visits' saves a phone call."),
            Col("period", "Period covered", 14, "text",
                note="For monthly bills: 'April 2026'."),
            Col("po_number", "PO number", 13, "text",
                note="Commercial customers who need one will not pay "
                     "without it."),

            # ---- the money -------------------------------------------
            Col("subtotal", "Subtotal", 12, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "The amount before tax. Leave blank "
                                "to use the job's charge."),
                note="Blank pulls the charge from the Job ID, if "
                     "there is one."),
            Col("job_charge", "From job", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({job}{r}="",0,'
                             'IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.charge]],'
                             'MATCH({job}{r},'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.id]],0))*1,0)+'
                             'IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.extras]],'
                             'MATCH({job}{r},'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.id]],0))*1,0))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("net", "Net", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND(IF({subtotal}{r}>0,{subtotal}{r},'
                             '{job_charge}{r}),2)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("discount", "Discount", 10, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000)),
            Col("tax", "Tax", 10, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             service_tax('{net}{r}-{discount}{r}')),
                note="Only if tax is switched on for your business on "
                     "the Settings tab."),
            Col("total", "Total", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND({net}{r}-{discount}{r}+'
                             '{tax}{r},2)'),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="What you are asking for."),
            Col("paid", "Paid", 11, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "How much has arrived. Part payments "
                                "are fine - put the running total."),
                note="Update as money comes in. The rest follows."),
            Col("paid_date", "Paid on", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="The day the last payment landed."),
            Col("method", "Paid by", 15, "text",
                validate=list_from("PaymentMethodList")),
            Col("outstanding", "Outstanding", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND({total}{r}-{paid}{r},2)'),
                cf=owing_cf(),
                note="Total minus paid. This is the number the "
                     "dashboard and the customer record both read."),

            # ---- when it is due --------------------------------------
            Col("terms", "Terms", 16, "text",
                validate=pick("PaymentTermsList",
                              "Blank uses the terms on the customer's "
                              "record."),
                note="Blank falls back to the customer's own terms."),
            Col("terms_used", "Terms used", 16, "text",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({terms}{r}<>"",{terms}{r},'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX([[Customer CRM.terms]],'
                        'MATCH({customer}{r},'
                        '[[Customer CRM.id]],0))&"","Due on receipt")))',
                hidden=True),
            Col("term_days", "Days allowed", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("date", term_days('{terms_used}{r}')),
                hidden=True),
            Col("due_date", "Due", 11, "date",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        '{date}{r}+MAX(0,{term_days}{r}))',
                cf=[{"type": "formula",
                     "criteria": '=AND(ISNUMBER({due_date}{r}),'
                                 '{due_date}{r}<TodayDate,'
                                 '{outstanding}{r}>0)',
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"}],
                note="Invoice date plus the days your terms allow."),
            Col("days_late", "Days late", 10, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({outstanding}{r}<=0.004,0,'
                             'MAX(0,TodayDate-'
                             '({date}{r}+MAX(0,{term_days}{r}))))'),
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 60,
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 30,
                     "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="Counted from the due date. Zero once it is paid."),
            Col("age_band", "Age", 13, "text",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({outstanding}{r}<=0.004,"Paid",'
                        'IF({days_late}{r}<=0,"Not due yet",'
                        'IF({days_late}{r}<=30,"1-30 days",'
                        'IF({days_late}{r}<=60,"31-60 days",'
                        'IF({days_late}{r}<=90,"61-90 days",'
                        '"Over 90 days"))))))',
                cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "Over 90", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "61-90", "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "31-60", "fmt": "warn"},
                    {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "Paid", "fmt": "good"}],
                note="The ageing bucket the monthly report groups on."),
            Col("status", "Status", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("InvoiceStatusList"),
                cf=status_cf(),
                note="Set it as things happen. The jobs tab reads it "
                     "back, so there is only ever one version of the "
                     "truth."),
            Col("sent", "Sent", 8, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Has it actually gone to the customer?"),
                cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "No", "fmt": "warn"}]),
            Col("reminders", "Reminders sent", 12, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 50, decimal=False),
                note="How many times you have chased. Three and still "
                     "nothing is a different conversation."),
            Col("last_chase", "Last chased", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 26, "wrap"),

            # ---- flags other tabs read -------------------------------
            Col("is_owed", "Owed", 6, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             f'IF(AND({is_owed_invoice("{status}{r}")},'
                             '{outstanding}{r}>0.004),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_paid", "Paid flag", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             f'IF({is_paid_invoice("{status}{r}")},'
                             '1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_overdue", "Overdue", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({is_owed}{r}=1,'
                             '{days_late}{r}>0),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("late_rank", "Late rank", 9, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({is_overdue}{r}=0,0,'
                             'COUNTIFS({days_late_first}:'
                             '{days_late_last},">"&{days_late}{r},'
                             '{is_overdue_first}:{is_overdue_last},1)+'
                             'COUNTIFS({days_late_first}:'
                             '{days_late}{r},{days_late}{r},'
                             '{is_overdue_first}:{is_overdue}{r},1))'),
                hidden=True,
                note="1 = the latest invoice you have. The dashboard "
                     "chase list reads this."),
            Col("print_rank", "Print line", 9, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({id}{r}=PrintInvoice,1,0)'),
                hidden=True,
                note="Marks the one invoice the printable page is "
                     "showing."),
            date_num_col("date", "date_num"),
            date_num_col("paid_date", "paid_num", header="Paid #"),
            month_col("date"),

            Col("alert", "What needs doing", 46, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("date", [
                    ('{days_late}{r}>=60',
                     "Urgent - more than sixty days late, decide what "
                     "to do about it"),
                    ('AND({is_overdue}{r}=1,{reminders}{r}=0)',
                     "Chase - overdue and never chased"),
                    ('{is_overdue}{r}=1',
                     "Overdue - past its due date and unpaid"),
                    ('AND({total}{r}>0,{sent}{r}<>"Yes")',
                     "Send - raised but never sent to the customer"),
                    ('{status}{r}="Disputed"',
                     "Urgent - disputed, sort it out before it ages"),
                    ('{total}{r}=0',
                     "Add - no amount on this invoice"),
                    ('AND({outstanding}{r}<-0.004)',
                     "Check - paid more than the invoice, refund or "
                     "credit due"),
                    ('AND({is_owed}{r}=1,{days_late}{r}=0)',
                     "Due - sent and waiting, not yet late"),
                    ('AND({paid}{r}>0,{paid_date}{r}="")',
                     "Add - payment recorded with no date"),
                    ('AND({outstanding}{r}<=0.004,'
                     '{status}{r}<>"Paid",{total}{r}>0)',
                     "Check - fully paid but the status says "
                     "otherwise"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/jobs.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/jobs.py sha256:e87925271c43607f5e34e542be0e8e39430a240ac37f82a2cca84a29fa2c2bd0 -->
````python
"""8. Job & Work Orders - one row per visit, and the hub of the workbook.

Everything meets here. The customer and property say where; the
service says what; the timesheets say what the labour really cost;
the expenses say what was spent on site; the invoice says whether you
were paid for any of it.

The estimated-versus-actual pair of columns is the whole argument for
keeping records at all. Estimated cost is what the quote assumed.
Actual cost is what the crew and the receipts say happened. The gap
between them is where a landscaping business quietly loses money.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from, time_check
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, customer_col,
                     date_num_col, id_col, is_catchup_job, is_done_job,
                     is_open_job, lookup_customer, lookup_property,
                     lookup_property_num, lookup_service,
                     lookup_service_num, loss_cf, margin, money_cf,
                     month_col, owing_cf, pick, property_col, scale_cf,
                     service_col, service_tax, status_cf, sum_by,
                     week_start_col, weekday_col, yesno, zero)

NAME = "Job & Work Orders"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Job & Work Orders",
        subtitle="Every visit, booked or done: who, where, what, how "
                 "long it took and what it was really worth.",
        tab_color=Palette.deep,
        rows=cfg.row_count("jobs"),
        samples=sample("jobs", cfg),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text=(
            "One row per visit. Book it with a date, a property and a "
            "service; mark it Completed when it is done and fill in "
            "the actual hours. Everything else - the estimate, the "
            "costs, the profit, the invoice status - comes from the "
            "other tabs automatically."),
        extra_notes=[
            "Estimated cost comes from the catalogue time and the "
            "property's difficulty. Actual cost comes from the "
            "timesheets and the expense tracker. Watch the variance "
            "column: a service that is always 20% over is a service "
            "that is underpriced, not a crew that is slow.",
            "'Rained off' and 'Needs revisit' are not failures, they "
            "are work you still owe. They stay on the catch-up list on "
            "the dashboard until they are rescheduled.",
            "Leave the Invoice ID blank until you raise the invoice. "
            "The 'Unbilled' alert finds completed work nobody has "
            "charged for - on most jobs that is the single most "
            "profitable column in this workbook.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("date", "JobPrefix", digits=cfg.digits("job"),
                   header="Job ID",
                   note="Generated. This is what the timesheets, the "
                        "expenses and the invoice all point at."),
            Col("date", "Date", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="The day of the visit. Start here."),
            Col("weekday", "Day", 8, "text",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'TEXT({date}{r},"ddd"))',
                hidden=True),
            customer_col(),
            Col("customer_name", "Customer", 20, "text",
                formula=lookup_customer("name")),
            property_col(),
            Col("address", "Address", 28, "text",
                formula=lookup_property("address")),
            Col("town", "Town", 14, "text",
                formula=lookup_property("town", missing=""),
                note="Used by the route planner to group a day's stops "
                     "sensibly."),
            service_col(),
            Col("crew", "Crew", 12, "text",
                validate=pick("CrewNameList",
                              "Which crew is doing it? Set the crews up "
                              "on the Settings tab."),
                cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "Unassigned", "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="The route planner prints one sheet per crew per "
                     "day from this column."),
            Col("status", "Status", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("JobStatusList"),
                cf=status_cf(),
                note="Completed is what makes a job count as revenue. "
                     "Nothing is earned until it is done."),
            Col("priority", "Priority", 15, "text",
                validate=list_from("PriorityList"),
                cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "1 - Urgent", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "2 - High", "fmt": "bad"}]),
            Col("contract", "Contract ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("ContractIDList",
                              "Pick the agreement this visit belongs "
                              "to."),
                note="If this visit came from a recurring agreement, "
                     "its Contract ID. Blank for one-off work."),
            Col("quote", "Quote ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("QuoteIDList",
                              "Pick the quote this work was priced "
                              "from."),
                note="If it came from an accepted quote, its Quote ID. "
                     "That is the audit trail from price to paid."),

            # ---- the plan --------------------------------------------
            Col("start_time", "Start", 9, "time",
                validate=time_check(),
                note="Planned arrival. The route planner sorts the day "
                     "by this."),
            Col("area", "Lawn area", 10, "int",
                formula=lookup_property_num("lawn_area"),
                hidden=True),
            Col("difficulty", "Difficulty", 9, "number1",
                formula='=IF({property}{r}="",1,'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX([[Property Database.difficulty]],'
                        'MATCH({property}{r},'
                        '[[Property Database.id]],0))*1,1))',
                hidden=True),
            Col("cat_minutes", "Catalogue mins", 11, "int",
                formula=lookup_service_num("minutes"),
                hidden=True),
            Col("cat_unit", "Unit", 12, "text",
                formula=lookup_service("unit", missing=""),
                hidden=True),
            Col("units", "Units", 8, "number1",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'IF({cat_unit}{r}="Per 1,000 sq ft",'
                             'MAX(1,{area}{r})/1000,'
                             'IF({cat_unit}{r}="Per 100 sq ft",'
                             'MAX(1,{area}{r})/100,'
                             'IF({cat_unit}{r}="Per sq ft",'
                             'MAX(1,{area}{r}),1)))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("crew_size", "Crew size", 9, "int",
                validate=amount(1, 20, "How many people are going?",
                                decimal=False),
                note="Blank uses the default crew size on Settings."),
            Col("crew_used", "Crew used", 9, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({crew_size}{r}>0,{crew_size}{r},'
                             'CrewSize)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("hours_est", "Hours (est)", 10, "number1",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({cat_minutes}{r}*{units}{r}*'
                             'MAX(1,{difficulty}{r})/60,2)'),
                note="Crew hours the catalogue expects, adjusted for "
                     "this site."),

            # ---- what happened ---------------------------------------
            Col("hours_logged", "Hours (timesheet)", 13, "number1",
                formula=zero("date", sum_by("Timesheets & Payroll",
                                            "hours", "job", '{id}{r}')),
                hidden=True),
            Col("hours_typed", "Hours (actual)", 12, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 200,
                                "Total crew hours on site. Leave blank "
                                "if you are using the timesheets."),
                note="Type it here, or let the timesheets fill it in. "
                     "The timesheets win if both are present."),
            Col("hours_actual", "Hours used", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({hours_logged}{r}>0,{hours_logged}{r},'
                             '{hours_typed}{r})'),
                cf=scale_cf(),
                note="Timesheet hours if there are any, otherwise what "
                     "you typed."),
            Col("hours_var", "Hours vs est", 11, "number1",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({hours_actual}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({hours_actual}{r}-'
                        '{hours_est}{r},2)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0.5,
                     "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": -0.25,
                     "fmt": "good"}],
                note="Positive means it took longer than the catalogue "
                     "said. A pattern here is a pricing problem."),
            Col("weather", "Weather", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("WeatherList"),
                note="Why the day went the way it did. Rain is the "
                     "reason most schedules slip."),
            Col("completed_by", "Done by", 14, "text",
                note="Who actually did it, if it was not the crew you "
                     "booked."),
            Col("checklist_done", "Checklist done", 12, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Has the crew worked through the job "
                               "completion checklist?"),
                cf=[{"type": "text", "criteria": "containing",
                     "value": "No", "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="Gates shut, clippings cleared, tools counted. The "
                     "checklist itself is on the Seasonal Planner tab."),
            Col("photo_before", "Photo - before", 18, "link"),
            Col("photo_after", "Photo - after", 18, "link",
                note="Links to your cloud drive, not pictures in the "
                     "file. Keeps the workbook fast and the evidence "
                     "safe."),
            Col("issues", "Problems on site", 30, "wrap",
                note="Broken sprinkler, locked gate, a dog out. Write "
                     "it down the same day or it is gone."),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 30, "wrap"),

            # ---- money in --------------------------------------------
            Col("price_quoted", "Agreed price", 12, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "What the customer agreed to pay. Blank "
                                "uses the contract or catalogue price."),
                note="Blank falls back to the contract price, then the "
                     "catalogue."),
            Col("contract_price", "Contract price", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({contract}{r}="",0,'
                             'IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Recurring Contracts.visit_price]],'
                             'MATCH({contract}{r},'
                             '[[Recurring Contracts.id]],0))*1,0))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("cat_price", "Catalogue price", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND(IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Service Catalog.rate]],'
                             'MATCH({service}{r},'
                             '[[Service Catalog.name]],0))*1,0)*'
                             '{units}{r},2)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("charge", "Charge", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND(IF({price_quoted}{r}>0,'
                             '{price_quoted}{r},'
                             'IF({contract_price}{r}>0,'
                             '{contract_price}{r},{cat_price}{r})),2)'),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="What this visit earns, before tax. Completed "
                     "visits with a charge are your revenue."),
            Col("extras", "Extras charged", 11, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "Anything beyond the agreed price - an "
                                "extra bag of mulch, a hedge they asked "
                                "for on the day."),
                note="The work your crew does for nothing unless "
                     "somebody writes it down."),
            Col("tax", "Tax", 10, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             service_tax('{charge}{r}+{extras}{r}')),
                hidden=True),
            Col("total_charge", "Total", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND({charge}{r}+{extras}{r}+'
                             '{tax}{r},2)'),
                cf=money_cf()),

            # ---- money out: estimated, then actual -------------------
            Col("cost_est", "Cost (est)", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({hours_est}{r}*(LabourRate+'
                             'OverheadRate)+'
                             'IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Service Catalog.materials_cost]],'
                             'MATCH({service}{r},'
                             '[[Service Catalog.name]],0))*1,0)*'
                             '{units}{r}+'
                             '2*IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Property Database.miles]],'
                             'MATCH({property}{r},'
                             '[[Property Database.id]],0))*1,0)*'
                             'TravelRate,2)'),
                note="What the quote assumed: catalogue time at your "
                     "rates, plus materials, plus the drive."),
            Col("labour_cost", "Labour (actual)", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("date", sum_by("Timesheets & Payroll",
                                            "cost", "job", '{id}{r}')),
                note="From the timesheets, at each person's own rate."),
            Col("labour_fallback", "Labour fallback", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({hours_logged}{r}>0,0,'
                             'ROUND({hours_actual}{r}*LabourRate,2))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("expense_cost", "Site costs", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date", sum_by("Expense Tracker", "allocated_cost",
                                            "job", '{id}{r}')),
                note="Usage or wastage and non-inventory costs booked to this "
                     "Job ID. Inventory purchases are allocated on usage."),
            Col("overhead_cost", "Overhead", 10, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND({hours_actual}{r}*OverheadRate,2)'),
                note="Charged on the hours actually worked, not the "
                     "hours hoped for."),
            Col("travel_cost", "Travel", 10, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND(2*IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Property Database.miles]],'
                             'MATCH({property}{r},'
                             '[[Property Database.id]],0))*1,0)*'
                             'TravelRate,2)')),
            Col("cost", "Cost (actual)", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND({labour_cost}{r}+'
                             '{labour_fallback}{r}+{expense_cost}{r}+'
                             '{overhead_cost}{r}+{travel_cost}{r},2)'),
                note="Everything this visit really cost you."),
            Col("cost_var", "Cost vs est", 11, "money",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({is_done}{r}=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({cost}{r}-{cost_est}{r},2)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "good"}],
                note="Red means it cost more than you estimated. This "
                     "column, averaged over a season, is the most "
                     "valuable thing in the workbook."),
            Col("profit", "Profit", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({is_done}{r}=0,0,'
                             'ROUND({charge}{r}+{extras}{r}-'
                             '{cost}{r},2))'),
                cf=loss_cf(),
                note="Completed visits only, and excluding tax - tax is "
                     "never yours."),
            Col("margin_pct", "Margin", 9, "percent",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({is_done}{r}=0,"",'
                        f'{margin("{profit}{r}", "({charge}{r}+{extras}{r})")}))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=TargetMargin", "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=MinMargin", "fmt": "bad"}]),
            Col("per_hour", "Earned per hour", 12, "money",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({hours_actual}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND(({charge}{r}+{extras}{r})/'
                        '{hours_actual}{r},2)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "warn"}]),

            # ---- getting paid ----------------------------------------
            Col("invoice", "Invoice ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("InvoiceIDList",
                              "Pick the invoice that bills this "
                              "visit."),
                note="Fill in when you raise the invoice. Blank on a "
                     "completed job means unbilled work."),
            Col("invoiced", "Invoiced", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date", sum_by("Invoice & Payments", "total",
                                            "job", '{id}{r}')),
                hidden=True),
            Col("paid_state", "Payment", 14, "text",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({invoice}{r}="",'
                        'IF({is_done}{r}=1,"Not invoiced",""),'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX('
                        '[[Invoice & Payments.status]],'
                        'MATCH({invoice}{r},'
                        '[[Invoice & Payments.id]],0))&"",'
                        '"Check - invoice not found")))',
                cf=status_cf(),
                note="Read straight off the invoice register, so it can "
                     "never disagree with it."),
            Col("outstanding", "Still owed", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({invoice}{r}="",0,'
                             'IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Invoice & Payments.outstanding]],'
                             'MATCH({invoice}{r},'
                             '[[Invoice & Payments.id]],0))*1,0))'),
                cf=owing_cf(),
                hidden=True),

            # ---- the hidden machinery --------------------------------
            Col("is_done", "Done", 6, "int",
````
