````python
                formula=zero("date", f'IF({is_done_job("{status}{r}")},'
                                     '1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_open", "Open", 6, "int",
                formula=zero("date", f'IF({is_open_job("{status}{r}")},'
                                     '1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_catchup", "Catch up", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             f'IF({is_catchup_job("{status}{r}")},1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_today", "Today", 6, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({date}{r}=TodayDate,'
                             '{is_open}{r}=1),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_week", "This week", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({is_open}{r}=1,'
                             '{date}{r}>=TodayDate,'
                             '{date}{r}<=TodayDate+UpcomingDays),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("is_unbilled", "Unbilled", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({is_done}{r}=1,{invoice}{r}="",'
                             '{charge}{r}>0),1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("today_rank", "Today rank", 9, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({is_today}{r}=0,0,'
                             'COUNTIFS({is_today_first}:{is_today}{r},'
                             '1))'),
                hidden=True,
                note="1, 2, 3 ... down today's jobs, so the dashboard "
                     "can list them without an array formula."),
            Col("route_key", "Route key", 14, "text",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        'TEXT({date}{r},"yyyy-mm-dd")&"|"&'
                        '{crew}{r})',
                hidden=True,
                note="Date and crew together - how the route planner "
                     "finds one crew's day in one lookup."),
            Col("route_time", "Route time", 9, "number",
                formula=zero("date", 'IF({start_time}{r}="",2,{start_time}{r})'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("route_seq", "Stop", 6, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'COUNTIFS({route_key_first}:{route_key_last},'
                             '{route_key}{r},{route_time_first}:{route_time_last},'
                             '"<"&{route_time}{r})+'
                             'COUNTIFS({route_key_first}:{route_key}{r},'
                             '{route_key}{r},{route_time_first}:{route_time}{r},'
                             '{route_time}{r})'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("route_match", "Route match", 12, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF(AND({date}{r}=RouteDate,'
                             '{crew}{r}=RouteCrew),{route_seq}{r},0)'),
                hidden=True,
                note="Which line of the printable work order this job "
                     "is, if it is on the chosen day at all."),
            date_num_col("date", "date_num"),
            weekday_col("date", "dow", header="DOW"),
            week_start_col("date"),
            month_col("date"),

            Col("alert", "What needs doing", 46, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("date", [
                    ('AND({is_open}{r}=1,{date}{r}<TodayDate)',
                     "Overdue - booked in the past and never closed off"),
                    ('AND({is_done}{r}=1,{charge}{r}=0)',
                     "Urgent - completed with no charge, is it free?"),
                    ('{is_catchup}{r}=1',
                     "Reschedule - rained off or needs a revisit"),
                    ('AND({is_unbilled}{r}=1,'
                     '{date}{r}<TodayDate-OverdueDays)',
                     "Unbilled - done and never invoiced"),
                    ('AND({is_done}{r}=1,{profit}{r}<0)',
                     "Loss - this visit cost more than it charged"),
                    ('{is_today}{r}=1', "Today - on the list for today"),
                    ('AND({is_open}{r}=1,{crew}{r}="Unassigned")',
                     "Action - booked with nobody assigned to it"),
                    ('AND({is_done}{r}=1,{hours_actual}{r}=0)',
                     "Add - completed with no hours, so profit is "
                     "guesswork"),
                    ('AND({is_done}{r}=1,{checklist_done}{r}="No")',
                     "Check - completion checklist not signed off"),
                    ('AND({is_done}{r}=1,{margin_pct}{r}<>"",'
                     '{margin_pct}{r}<MinMargin)',
                     "Thin margin - under your floor on this visit"),
                    ('{is_week}{r}=1', "This week - coming up"),
                    ('{is_open}{r}=1', "Upcoming - booked"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/materials.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/materials.py sha256:4b651507b53a4e48ce9d80d269a233b43aaaae1e03c70528f4b52f4fb4f90c1c -->
````python
"""16. Materials Inventory - mulch, seed, fertiliser and fuel cans.

Stock on hand is derived, never typed: opening stock, plus what the
expense tracker says you bought, minus what the jobs say you used.
Typing a stock figure over the top of a calculation is how a stock
sheet stops being believed, so this one will not let you.

The low-stock alert uses your own reorder point, and the three
columns next to it tell you how long what you have will last at the
rate you are getting through it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, count_by, id_col,
                     money_cf, rank_desc, scale_cf, status_cf, sum_by,
                     yesno, zero)

NAME = "Materials Inventory"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Materials Inventory",
        subtitle="What is in the yard, what it cost, and what you are "
                 "about to run out of.",
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
        rows=cfg.row_count("materials"),
        samples=sample("materials", cfg),
        help_text=(
            "Add each material once with its unit, its cost and the "
            "level at which you want to be warned. Record purchases "
            "on the Expense Tracker against the Material ID and usage "
            "on the same tab - stock on hand follows automatically."),
        extra_notes=[
            "Stock on hand is opening stock plus purchases minus "
            "usage. If it is wrong, one of those three is wrong - "
            "fix the entry, not the number, or you lose the ability "
            "to trust any of it.",
            "Weeks of cover is based on what you have actually used "
            "in the last ninety days. In March it will look alarming "
            "and in November reassuring; read it with the season in "
            "mind.",
            "Charge-out price is what the customer pays per unit. It "
            "should be above cost - handling, collecting and "
            "carrying are real work and the markup on Settings is "
            "there to cover them.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("name", "MaterialPrefix",
                   digits=cfg.digits("material"), header="Material ID",
                   note="Generated. Book purchases and usage against "
                        "it on the Expense Tracker."),
            Col("name", "Material", 26, "text",
                note="Start here. 'Hardwood mulch, bulk' is more use "
                     "than 'mulch'."),
            Col("category", "Category", 20, "text",
                validate=list_from("MaterialCategoryList")),
            Col("unit", "Unit", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("MaterialUnitList"),
                note="Bag, yard, gallon, roll. Be consistent - half "
                     "the value of this tab is in the unit."),
            Col("supplier", "Supplier", 20, "text"),
            Col("supplier_code", "Their code", 14, "text",
                note="The code to quote when you ring up to order."),
            Col("cost_unit", "Cost per unit", 12, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000),
                note="What you pay. Drives job costs and the "
                     "suggested charge-out price."),
            Col("charge_unit", "Charge per unit", 13, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "What the customer pays per unit. "
                                "Blank uses cost times the markup on "
                                "Settings."),
                note="Blank falls back to cost times the markup."),
            Col("charge_used", "Charged", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF({charge_unit}{r}>0,{charge_unit}{r},'
                             'ROUND({cost_unit}{r}*MaterialMarkup,2))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("markup_pct", "Markup", 9, "percent",
                formula='=IF({name}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({cost_unit}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({charge_used}{r}/'
                        '{cost_unit}{r}-1,4)))',
                cf=scale_cf()),
            Col("opening", "Opening stock", 12, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "How much you had when you started "
                                "using this workbook."),
                note="Set once, when you start. After that the "
                     "purchases and usage do the work."),
            Col("reorder_at", "Reorder at", 11, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000),
                note="The level at which you want a warning. Set it "
                     "to a week's use plus whatever your supplier's "
                     "lead time is."),
            Col("reorder_qty", "Order quantity", 12, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000),
                note="How much you usually buy at once."),
            Col("location", "Kept at", 16, "text"),
            Col("status", "Status", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("MaterialStatusList"),
                cf=status_cf()),
            Col("hazardous", "Hazardous", 10, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Does this need a safety data sheet or "
                               "a licence to apply?"),
                note="Fertiliser, herbicide and fuel all have rules. "
                     "Know which ones apply to you."),
            Col("expiry", "Use by", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="Seed and chemicals do go off."),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 26, "wrap"),

            # ---- stock, derived --------------------------------------
            Col("purchased", "Bought", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("name", sum_by("Expense Tracker", "quantity",
                                            "material", '{id}{r}',
                                            "is_purchase", "1")),
                note="From the Expense Tracker, automatically."),
            Col("used", "Used", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("name", sum_by("Expense Tracker", "quantity",
                                            "material", '{id}{r}',
                                            "is_usage", "1")),
                note="Booked out to jobs on the Expense Tracker."),
            Col("on_hand", "On hand", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'ROUND({opening}{r}+{purchased}{r}-'
                             '{used}{r},2)'),
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "formula",
                     "criteria": '=AND({name}{r}<>"",'
                                 '{on_hand}{r}<={reorder_at}{r})',
                     "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="Opening plus bought minus used. Calculated - you "
                     "cannot type over it, and that is deliberate."),
            Col("stock_value", "Stock value", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'ROUND(MAX(0,{on_hand}{r})*'
                             '{cost_unit}{r},2)'),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="What is sitting in the yard, at cost."),
            Col("used_90", "Used (90 days)", 12, "number1",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'SUMIFS([[Expense Tracker.quantity]],'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.material]],{id}{r},'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.is_usage]],1,'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.date_num]],'
                             '">="&TodayDate-90)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("weekly_use", "Used per week", 12, "number1",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'ROUND({used_90}{r}/13,2)'),
                note="Averaged over the last ninety days."),
            Col("weeks_cover", "Weeks of cover", 13, "number1",
                formula='=IF({name}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({weekly_use}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND(MAX(0,{on_hand}{r})/'
                        '{weekly_use}{r},1)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<=", "value": 1,
                     "fmt": "bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<=", "value": 3,
                     "fmt": "warn"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 20,
                     "fmt": "info"}],
                note="At the current rate. Blank means you have not "
                     "used any lately, so there is nothing to project."),
            Col("spend_total", "Spent to date", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("name", sum_by("Expense Tracker", "amount",
                                            "material", '{id}{r}',
                                            "is_purchase", "1")),
                cf=money_cf()),
            Col("times_bought", "Orders", 9, "int",
                formula=zero("name", count_by("Expense Tracker",
                                              "material", '{id}{r}',
                                              "is_purchase", "1"))),
            Col("last_buy_num", "Last bought #", 11, "number",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'SUMPRODUCT(MAX('
                             '([[Expense Tracker.material]]={id}{r})*'
                             '([[Expense Tracker.is_purchase]]=1)*'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.date_num]]))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("last_bought", "Last bought", 11, "date",
                formula='=IF({name}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({last_buy_num}{r}<=0,"",'
                        '{last_buy_num}{r}))'),
            Col("is_low", "Low", 6, "int",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF(AND({status}{r}="Active",'
                             '{on_hand}{r}<={reorder_at}{r}),1,0)'),
                hidden=True,
                note="What the dashboard's low-material count reads."),
            Col("order_value", "Cost to restock", 13, "money",
                formula=zero("name",
                             'IF({is_low}{r}=0,0,'
                             'ROUND(MAX({reorder_qty}{r},'
                             '{reorder_at}{r}-{on_hand}{r})*'
                             '{cost_unit}{r},2))'),
                note="What it would cost to bring the low ones back "
                     "up. The shopping list, in money."),
            rank_desc("spend_total", guard='{name}{r}=""'),

            Col("alert", "What needs doing", 44, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("name", [
                    ('{on_hand}{r}<0',
                     "Urgent - stock has gone negative, a purchase is "
                     "missing"),
                    ('AND({status}{r}="Active",{on_hand}{r}<=0)',
                     "Out of stock - none left in the yard"),
                    ('AND({expiry}{r}<>"",{expiry}{r}<TodayDate,'
                     '{on_hand}{r}>0)',
                     "Expired - past its use-by date"),
                    ('{is_low}{r}=1',
                     "Reorder - at or below your reorder point"),
                    ('AND({weeks_cover}{r}<>"",{weeks_cover}{r}<=1)',
                     "Order - less than a week of cover left"),
                    ('{cost_unit}{r}=0',
                     "Add - no cost per unit, so job costs are "
                     "understated"),
                    ('AND({expiry}{r}<>"",'
                     '{expiry}{r}<TodayDate+60,{on_hand}{r}>0)',
                     "Due - use-by date within two months"),
                    ('{reorder_at}{r}=0',
                     "Add - no reorder point, so you will not be "
                     "warned"),
                    ('AND({hazardous}{r}="Yes",{notes}{r}="")',
                     "Check - hazardous with no handling note"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/monthly.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/monthly.py sha256:81535b506483a248ce800d097737c879450747f54e4469c15bdea37f2d45761c -->
````python
"""`Monthly Reports` - one month, read properly.

Pick a month at the top and everything below it changes: the money,
the work, the crew, the customers who grew and the ones who went
quiet. It is the fifteen minutes at the end of a month that tells you
whether the last four weeks were worth doing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Config, Palette
from ..layout import Registry
from ..writer import SheetWriter

NAME = "Monthly Reports"
LAST_COL = 11
LIST_ROWS = 8


def _month_sum(name_range: str, month_range: str) -> str:
    return f"SUMIFS({name_range},{month_range},ReportMonth)"


def build(book, fmts, cfg: Config, reg: Registry) -> SheetWriter:
    s = SheetWriter(book, fmts, cfg, reg, NAME,
                    tab_color=Palette.primary_mid)

    s.banner("Monthly Reports",
             "Pick a month. The whole page follows - money, work, "
             "crew, customers and what to do about them.",
             LAST_COL)
    s.set_col(0, 0, 26)
    for column in range(1, LAST_COL + 1):
        s.set_col(column, column, 14)

    row = 4
    row = s.field(row, "Month to report on", cfg.today.strftime("%Y-%m"), style="text",
                  name="ReportMonth", mode="input", help_col=5,
                  help_text="Select the month to report on; change this "
                            "when you want another month.")
    s.ws.data_validation(row - 1, 3, row - 1, 3,
                         {"validate": "list", "source": "=MonthKeys",
                          "input_message": "Pick a month in yyyy-mm "
                                           "form, for example "
                                           "2026-07."})
    row += 1
    row = s.note(
        row,
        "The month cell above is the only thing you change on this "
        "page. Everything else is calculated from the registers, so "
        "a report for March is never out of date - it is rebuilt "
        "the moment you ask for it.",
        LAST_COL, height=30)
    row += 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- money --
    row = s.section(row, "The money", LAST_COL)
    s.kpi(row, 0, "Revenue",
          '=SUMIFS(JobCharge,JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1)+'
          'SUMIFS(JobExtras,JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1)',
          "money", note="Completed visits, excluding tax")
    s.kpi(row, 2, "Invoiced", f'={_month_sum("InvTotal", "InvMonth")}',
          "money", note="What you billed in the month")
    s.kpi(row, 4, "Collected", '=SUMIFS(InvPaid,InvPaidDate,">="&DATE(VALUE(LEFT(ReportMonth,4)),VALUE(RIGHT(ReportMonth,2)),1),InvPaidDate,"<"&DATE(VALUE(LEFT(ReportMonth,4)),VALUE(RIGHT(ReportMonth,2))+1,1))',
          "money", note="Cumulative amounts grouped by last paid date")
    s.kpi(row, 6, "Labour cost",
          f'={_month_sum("TimeCost", "TimeMonth")}+{_month_sum("JobLabourFallback", "JobMonth")}', "money",
          note="Every hour, billable or not")
    s.kpi(row, 8, "Other costs",
          f'={_month_sum("ExpPeriodCost", "ExpMonth")}+'
          f'{_month_sum("VehAmount", "VehMonth")}', "money",
          note="Expenses and vehicles")
    row = s.kpi(row, 10, "Profit",
                '=SUMIFS(JobCharge,JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1)+'
                'SUMIFS(JobExtras,JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1)-'
                f'{_month_sum("TimeCost", "TimeMonth")}-'
                f'{_month_sum("JobLabourFallback", "JobMonth")}-'
                f'{_month_sum("ExpPeriodCost", "ExpMonth")}-'
                f'{_month_sum("VehAmount", "VehMonth")}',
                "money", note="What was left")
    row += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ work --
    row = s.section(row, "The work", LAST_COL)
    s.kpi(row, 0, "Visits completed",
          '=COUNTIFS(JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1)', "int")
    s.kpi(row, 2, "Visits cancelled",
          '=COUNTIFS(JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobStatus,"Cancelled")',
          "int", note="Worth watching the reason")
    s.kpi(row, 4, "Rained off",
          '=COUNTIFS(JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobStatus,"Rained off")',
          "int")
    s.kpi(row, 6, "Crew hours",
          f'={_month_sum("TimeHours", "TimeMonth")}', "number1")
    s.kpi(row, 8, "Billable hours",
          '=SUMIFS(TimeHours,TimeMonth,ReportMonth,TimeIsBillable,1)',
          "number1")
    row = s.kpi(row, 10, "Billable share",
                '=IFERROR(SUMIFS(TimeHours,TimeMonth,ReportMonth,'
                'TimeIsBillable,1)/'
                f'{_month_sum("TimeHours", "TimeMonth")},"")',
                "percent0", note="Share of paid time that was sold")
    row += 1

    # ---------------------------------------------------- per hour --
    row = s.section(row, "What an hour was worth", LAST_COL)
    s.kpi(row, 0, "Revenue per crew hour",
          '=IFERROR((SUMIFS(JobCharge,JobMonth,ReportMonth,'
          'JobIsDone,1)+SUMIFS(JobExtras,JobMonth,ReportMonth,'
          f'JobIsDone,1))/{_month_sum("TimeHours", "TimeMonth")},"")',
          "money", note="Against your charge-out rate")
    s.kpi(row, 2, "Average visit",
          '=IFERROR(SUMIFS(JobCharge,JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1)'
          '/COUNTIFS(JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1),"")', "money")
    s.kpi(row, 4, "Quotes sent",
          '=COUNTIFS(QuoteMonth,ReportMonth)', "int")
    s.kpi(row, 6, "Quotes won",
          '=COUNTIFS(QuoteMonth,ReportMonth,QuoteIsWon,1)', "int")
    s.kpi(row, 8, "Win rate",
          '=IFERROR(COUNTIFS(QuoteMonth,ReportMonth,QuoteIsWon,1)/'
          'COUNTIFS(QuoteMonth,ReportMonth),"")', "percent0")
    row = s.kpi(row, 10, "New customers",
                '=COUNTIFS(CustFirstJob,">="&DATE(VALUE(LEFT('
                'ReportMonth,4)),VALUE(RIGHT(ReportMonth,2)),1),'
                'CustFirstJob,"<="&DATE(VALUE(LEFT(ReportMonth,4)),'
                'VALUE(RIGHT(ReportMonth,2))+1,1)-1)', "int")
    row += 1

    # ----------------------------------------------------- money owed --
    row = s.section(row, "Money still out there", LAST_COL)
    row = s.note(
        row,
        "Aged from the due date, not the invoice date, so an "
        "invoice on thirty day terms is not counted late the "
        "moment it is sent. These four buckets cover every unpaid "
        "invoice in the workbook, not only this month's.",
        LAST_COL, height=32)
    row += 1
    s.kpi(row, 0, "Not due yet",
          '=SUMIFS(InvOutstanding,InvAgeBand,"Not due yet")', "money")
    s.kpi(row, 2, "1-30 days",
          '=SUMIFS(InvOutstanding,InvAgeBand,"1-30 days")', "money")
    s.kpi(row, 4, "31-60 days",
          '=SUMIFS(InvOutstanding,InvAgeBand,"31-60 days")', "money")
    s.kpi(row, 6, "61-90 days",
          '=SUMIFS(InvOutstanding,InvAgeBand,"61-90 days")', "money")
    s.kpi(row, 8, "Over 90 days",
          '=SUMIFS(InvOutstanding,InvAgeBand,"Over 90 days")',
          "money", note="Decide: chase, settle or write off")
    row = s.kpi(row, 10, "Total owed", "=SUM(InvOutstanding)",
                "money")
    row += 2

    # ------------------------------------------------ top services --
    row = s.section(row, "What sold this month", LAST_COL)
    s.table_head(row, 0,
                 ["Service", "Visits", "Revenue", "Avg price",
                  "Share of month"],
                 widths=[30, 11, 13, 13, 14])
    head = row
    for n in range(1, LIST_ROWS + 1):
        line = head + n
        pick = ('IFERROR(INDEX([[Service Catalog.name]],'
                f'MATCH(ROW()-{head + 1},'
                '[[Service Catalog.revenue_rank]],0)),"")')
        s.formula(line, 0, "=" + pick, fmts.calc("text"))
        s.formula(line, 1,
                  f'=IF($A{line + 1}="","",'
                  f'COUNTIFS(JobService,$A{line + 1},JobMonth,'
                  'ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1))', fmts.calc("int"))
        s.formula(line, 2,
                  f'=IF($A{line + 1}="","",'
                  f'SUMIFS(JobCharge,JobService,$A{line + 1},'
                  'JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1))',
                  fmts.calc("money"))
        s.formula(line, 3,
                  f'=IF($B{line + 1}="","",IF($B{line + 1}=0,"",'
                  f'ROUND($C{line + 1}/$B{line + 1},2)))',
                  fmts.calc("money"))
        s.formula(line, 4,
                  f'=IFERROR($C{line + 1}/'
                  'SUMIFS(JobCharge,JobMonth,ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1)'
                  ',"")', fmts.calc("percent"))
    row = head + LIST_ROWS + 2

    # ------------------------------------------------- top customers --
    row = s.section(row, "Who spent the most this month", LAST_COL)
    s.table_head(row, 0,
                 ["Customer", "Visits", "Revenue", "Owing",
                  "Last visit"],
                 widths=[28, 11, 13, 13, 13])
    head = row
    for n in range(1, LIST_ROWS + 1):
        line = head + n
        rank = f"ROW()-{head + 1}"
        s.formula(line, 0,
                  '=IFERROR(INDEX([[Customer CRM.name]],'
                  f'MATCH({rank},[[Customer CRM.lifetime_rank]],0)),'
                  '"")', fmts.calc("text"))
        s.formula(line, 1,
                  '=IFERROR(COUNTIFS(JobCustomer,'
                  f'INDEX([[Customer CRM.id]],MATCH({rank},'
                  '[[Customer CRM.lifetime_rank]],0)),JobMonth,'
                  'ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1),"")', fmts.calc("int"))
        s.formula(line, 2,
                  '=IFERROR(SUMIFS(JobCharge,JobCustomer,'
                  f'INDEX([[Customer CRM.id]],MATCH({rank},'
                  '[[Customer CRM.lifetime_rank]],0)),JobMonth,'
                  'ReportMonth,JobIsDone,1),"")', fmts.calc("money"))
        s.formula(line, 3,
                  '=IFERROR(INDEX([[Customer CRM.owing]],'
                  f'MATCH({rank},[[Customer CRM.lifetime_rank]],0))*1,'
                  '"")', fmts.calc("money"))
        s.formula(line, 4,
                  '=IFERROR(IF(INDEX([[Customer CRM.last_job]],'
                  f'MATCH({rank},[[Customer CRM.lifetime_rank]],0))='
                  '"","",INDEX([[Customer CRM.last_job]],'
                  f'MATCH({rank},[[Customer CRM.lifetime_rank]],0))),'
                  '"")', fmts.calc("date"))
    row = head + LIST_ROWS + 2

    # --------------------------------------------------- the crew --
    row = s.section(row, "The crew this month", LAST_COL)
    s.table_head(row, 0,
                 ["Name", "Hours", "Billable", "Billable %", "Cost",
                  "Overtime"],
                 widths=[24, 11, 11, 12, 12, 11])
    head = row
    for n in range(1, LIST_ROWS + 1):
        line = head + n
        rank = f"ROW()-{head + 1}"
        who = (f'INDEX([[Crew Database.id]],MATCH({rank},'
               '[[Crew Database.revenue_rank]],0))')
        s.formula(line, 0,
                  '=IFERROR(INDEX([[Crew Database.name]],'
                  f'MATCH({rank},[[Crew Database.revenue_rank]],0)),'
                  '"")', fmts.calc("text"))
        s.formula(line, 1,
                  f'=IFERROR(SUMIFS(TimeHours,TimeEmployee,{who},'
                  'TimeMonth,ReportMonth),"")', fmts.calc("number1"))
        s.formula(line, 2,
                  f'=IFERROR(SUMIFS(TimeHours,TimeEmployee,{who},'
                  'TimeMonth,ReportMonth,TimeIsBillable,1),"")',
                  fmts.calc("number1"))
        s.formula(line, 3,
                  f'=IF($B{line + 1}="","",IF($B{line + 1}=0,"",'
                  f'ROUND($C{line + 1}/$B{line + 1},4)))',
                  fmts.calc("percent"))
        s.formula(line, 4,
                  f'=IFERROR(SUMIFS(TimeCost,TimeEmployee,{who},'
                  'TimeMonth,ReportMonth),"")', fmts.calc("money"))
        s.formula(line, 5,
                  '=IFERROR(SUMIFS(TimeOvertimeHours,TimeEmployee,'
                  f'{who},TimeMonth,ReportMonth),"")',
                  fmts.calc("number1"))
    row = head + LIST_ROWS + 2

    # ------------------------------------------------ what to do next --
    row = s.section(row, "What this month is telling you", LAST_COL)
    row = s.bullets(row, [
        "Collected well below invoiced means the problem is "
        "getting paid, not getting work. Start at the top of the "
        "ageing table.",
        "Billable share under 60% means the day is being eaten by "
        "driving, loading and yard time. Look at the round order "
        "before you look at the crew.",
        "Revenue per crew hour below your charge-out rate means "
        "your prices and your times disagree. The Service Catalog "
        "tab shows which service is the culprit.",
        "A win rate over 90% is not good news - it means you are "
        "the cheapest quote in town. Test a higher price on the "
        "next five.",
        "Cancelled and rained-off visits are lost capacity. If they "
        "are not rescheduled within a fortnight they are simply "
        "gone.",
    ], LAST_COL, height=30)
    row += 1

    row = s.note(
        row,
        "Every figure on this page comes from the rows you have "
        "entered. A month with visits done but no timesheets will "
        "look wonderfully profitable and tell you nothing at all.",
        LAST_COL, height=30)

    s.finish(freeze_row=4, gridlines=False, fit_width=True)
    s.protect()
    return s
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/profit.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/profit.py sha256:de2f1b9e4b408c927d0321e0f7191f9cb5d704d1f29d92f3a80e35dc80f8219f -->
````python
"""21. Profit Analysis - the month-by-month truth.

Fourteen rows, one per month, every figure calculated. Revenue from
completed jobs, labour from the timesheets, materials and overheads
from the expenses, fuel from the vehicle tracker - and what is left.

The useful column is the one on the right: profit per crew hour.
Revenue can grow while that number shrinks, and when it does you are
working harder for less. No other single figure in this trade is
worth as much attention.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, loss_cf, money_cf, scale_cf,
                     zero)

NAME = "Profit Analysis"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Profit Analysis",
        subtitle="Month by month: what came in, what went out, what "
                 "was left, and what each crew hour earned.",
        tab_color=Palette.deep,
        rows=cfg.row_count("profit"),
        samples=sample("profit", cfg),
        freeze_cols=2,
        help_text=(
            "Choose a month in the first column and every figure on "
            "the row fills itself in from the registers. Nothing "
            "here is typed except the month and your own target. "
            "Fourteen rows gives you a full year plus the two months "
            "either side for comparison."),
        extra_notes=[
            "Revenue counts completed jobs only, excluding tax. Tax "
            "collected is never yours and does not belong in a "
            "profit figure.",
            "Period costs count material purchases, not usage; job "
            "costing counts usage. Collected uses the last paid date "
            "for the cumulative amount, not a payment ledger.",
            "Labour is what the timesheets cost, including the hours "
            "that were not billable. Driving and yard time are real "
            "wages and leaving them out is the most common way a "
            "landscaping business flatters itself.",
            "Profit per crew hour is the number to watch across the "
            "season. If it falls while revenue rises, the extra work "
            "is not paying for itself.",
        ],
        columns=[
            Col("month", "Month", 11, "text",
                validate={"validate": "list", "source": "=MonthKeys",
                          "input_message": "Pick a month in yyyy-mm "
                                           "form."},
                note="Pick the month. Everything else follows."),
            Col("label", "Period", 14, "text",
                formula='=IF({month}{r}="","",'
                        'TEXT(DATE(VALUE(LEFT({month}{r},4)),'
                        'VALUE(RIGHT({month}{r},2)),1),'
                        '"mmmm yyyy"))'),
            Col("start_num", "From", 10, "number",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'DATE(VALUE(LEFT({month}{r},4)),'
                             'VALUE(RIGHT({month}{r},2)),1)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("end_num", "To", 10, "number",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'DATE(VALUE(LEFT({month}{r},4)),'
                             'VALUE(RIGHT({month}{r},2))+1,1)-1'),
                hidden=True),

            # ---- money in --------------------------------------------
            Col("jobs_done", "Visits done", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'COUNTIFS([[Job & Work Orders.month]],'
                             '{month}{r},'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.is_done]],1)'),
                cf=scale_cf()),
            Col("revenue", "Revenue", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'ROUND(SUMIFS('
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.charge]],'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.month]],{month}{r},'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.is_done]],1)+'
                             'SUMIFS([[Job & Work Orders.extras]],'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.month]],{month}{r},'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.is_done]],1),2)'),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="Completed visits, excluding tax."),
            Col("invoiced", "Invoiced", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'SUMIFS([[Invoice & Payments.total]],'
                             '[[Invoice & Payments.month]],'
                             '{month}{r})'),
                note="What you billed in the month, which is not the "
                     "same thing as what you earned in it."),
            Col("collected", "Collected", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'SUMIFS([[Invoice & Payments.paid]],'
                             '[[Invoice & Payments.paid_num]],">="&{start_num}{r},'
                             '[[Invoice & Payments.paid_num]],"<="&{end_num}{r})'),
                note="Cumulative paid amount grouped by last paid date; "
                     "partial payments in different months are not tracked separately."),

            # ---- money out -------------------------------------------
            Col("labour", "Labour", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'SUMIFS([[Timesheets & Payroll.cost]],'
                             '[[Timesheets & Payroll.month]],'
                             '{month}{r})+'
                             'SUMIFS([[Job & Work Orders.labour_fallback]],'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.month]],{month}{r})'),
                note="Timesheets plus job-hour fallback where no job "
                     "timesheet hours exist."),
            Col("materials", "Materials", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'SUMIFS([[Expense Tracker.period_cost]],'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.month]],{month}{r},'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.category]],'
                             '"Materials")'),
                note="Bought in the month, from the expense tracker."),
            Col("fuel", "Fuel & vehicles", 13, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'SUMIFS('
                             '[[Vehicle & Fuel Tracker.amount]],'
                             '[[Vehicle & Fuel Tracker.month]],'
                             '{month}{r})'),
                note="Everything on the vehicle tracker - fuel, "
                     "repairs, tax and insurance."),
            Col("other_costs", "Other costs", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'ROUND(SUMIFS('
                             '[[Expense Tracker.period_cost]],'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.month]],{month}{r})-'
                             'SUMIFS([[Expense Tracker.period_cost]],'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.month]],{month}{r},'
                             '[[Expense Tracker.category]],'
                             '"Materials"),2)'),
                note="Everything else on the expense tracker - "
                     "insurance, rent, advertising, the accountant."),
            Col("total_costs", "Total costs", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'ROUND({labour}{r}+{materials}{r}+'
                             '{fuel}{r}+{other_costs}{r},2)')),

            # ---- what is left ----------------------------------------
            Col("profit", "Profit", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'ROUND({revenue}{r}-{total_costs}{r},2)'),
                cf=loss_cf(),
                note="Revenue less everything. The number that pays "
                     "you."),
            Col("margin_pct", "Margin", 9, "percent",
                formula='=IF({month}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({revenue}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({profit}{r}/'
                        '{revenue}{r},4)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=TargetMargin", "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=MinMargin", "fmt": "bad"}]),
            Col("hours", "Crew hours", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'SUMIFS([[Timesheets & Payroll.hours]],'
                             '[[Timesheets & Payroll.month]],'
                             '{month}{r})')),
            Col("billable_hours", "Billable hrs", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'SUMIFS([[Timesheets & Payroll.hours]],'
                             '[[Timesheets & Payroll.month]],'
                             '{month}{r},'
                             '[[Timesheets & Payroll.is_billable]],'
                             '1)')),
            Col("billable_pct", "Billable %", 10, "percent",
                formula='=IF({month}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({hours}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({billable_hours}{r}/'
                        '{hours}{r},4)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 0.75,
                     "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0.55,
                     "fmt": "bad"}],
                note="How much of the paid day was sold. The quiet "
                     "killer in this trade."),
            Col("revenue_hour", "Revenue / hour", 12, "money",
                formula='=IF({month}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({hours}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({revenue}{r}/'
                        '{hours}{r},2)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "warn"}]),
            Col("profit_hour", "Profit / hour", 12, "money",
                formula='=IF({month}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({hours}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({profit}{r}/'
                        '{hours}{r},2)))',
                cf=loss_cf(),
                note="The single most useful number on the tab. Watch "
                     "it across a season."),
            Col("avg_job", "Average visit", 12, "money",
                formula='=IF({month}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({jobs_done}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({revenue}{r}/'
                        '{jobs_done}{r},2)))'),
            Col("new_customers", "New customers", 12, "int",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'COUNTIFS([[Customer CRM.first_job]],'
                             '">="&{start_num}{r},'
                             '[[Customer CRM.first_job]],'
                             '"<="&{end_num}{r})')),
            Col("target", "Your target", 11, "money",
                validate={"validate": "decimal", "criteria": "between",
                          "minimum": 0, "maximum": 10000000,
                          "error_title": "Monthly target",
                          "error_message": "What you want this month "
                                           "to bring in. Blank uses "
                                           "the yearly target divided "
                                           "by twelve."},
                note="Your number for this month. Blank falls back to "
                     "a twelfth of the annual target on Settings."),
            Col("target_used", "Target used", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'IF({target}{r}>0,{target}{r},'
                             'ROUND(RevenueTarget/12,2))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("vs_target", "vs target", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("month",
                             'ROUND({revenue}{r}-'
                             '{target_used}{r},2)'),
                cf=loss_cf()),
            Col("target_pct", "% of target", 10, "percent",
                formula='=IF({month}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({target_used}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({revenue}{r}/'
                        '{target_used}{r},4)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 1,
                     "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0.8,
                     "fmt": "bad"}]),
            Col("notes", "Notes", 30, "wrap",
                note="Why the month went the way it did. 'Three weeks "
                     "of rain' explains a lot, a year later."),

            Col("alert", "What it is telling you", 44, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("month", [
                    ('{profit}{r}<0',
                     "Loss - this month cost more than it earned"),
                    ('AND({revenue}{r}>0,{margin_pct}{r}<>"",'
                     '{margin_pct}{r}<MinMargin)',
                     "Urgent - margin below your floor"),
                    ('AND({hours}{r}>0,{billable_pct}{r}<>"",'
                     '{billable_pct}{r}<0.55)',
                     "Check - too much of the paid day was not sold"),
                    ('AND({revenue}{r}>0,{target_pct}{r}<>"",'
                     '{target_pct}{r}<0.8)',
                     "Action - well under target for the month"),
                    ('AND({revenue}{r}>0,{collected}{r}<'
                     '{invoiced}{r}*0.7)',
                     "Chase - a lot of what you invoiced is still "
                     "out"),
                    ('AND({revenue}{r}>0,{margin_pct}{r}<>"",'
                     '{margin_pct}{r}<TargetMargin)',
                     "Thin margin - under target, above the floor"),
                    ('AND({revenue}{r}=0,{month}{r}<>"")',
                     "Add - no completed work recorded this month"),
                    ('AND({target_pct}{r}<>"",{target_pct}{r}>=1)',
                     "OK - target met"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/properties.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/properties.py sha256:6ea460c8770e5e46d80a9d6be1a6af2d02c6bff701f342bd995e041544b5720f -->
````python
"""5. Property Database - the ground you actually work on.

A customer is a person who pays; a property is a place with a gate
code, a slope, a dog and a lawn of a particular size. The two are
separate because one customer can own six of them, and because every
price in this workbook is driven by what is written here: lawn area,
terrain, access and how far it is from the yard.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, count_by, customer_col,
                     id_col,
                     lookup_customer, money_cf,
                     rank_desc, scale_cf, status_cf, sum_by, yesno, zero)

NAME = "Property Database"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Property Database",
        subtitle="Every address you maintain: the size of the lawn, how "
                 "to get in, what is in the way, and how far it is.",
        tab_color=Palette.primary,
        rows=cfg.row_count("properties"),
        samples=sample("properties", cfg),
        help_text=(
            "Pick the customer first, then describe the site. Lawn area "
            "is the single most useful number in the workbook - the "
            "quote calculator, the time estimate and the material "
            "quantities all come off it. Pace it out once and you never "
            "have to guess at that address again."),
        extra_notes=[
            "Measure the area you actually cut, not the plot size. A "
            "quarter acre plot with a house, a drive and a patio on it "
            "is rarely more than 6,000 sq ft of grass.",
            "Gate codes and alarm codes are sensitive. If this file is "
            "shared or stored in the cloud, leave those boxes empty and "
            "keep them somewhere your crew can reach and nobody else "
            "can.",
            "Difficulty multiplier is how this sheet earns its keep: a "
            "steep, tight, dog-occupied garden takes longer than a flat "
            "open one and should be priced accordingly.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("address", "PropertyPrefix",
                   digits=cfg.digits("property"), header="Property ID",
                   note="Generated. Jobs, quotes and contracts point at "
                        "this ID, not at the address text."),
            customer_col(note="Who pays for work at this address. Add "
                              "them on the Customer CRM tab first."),
            Col("customer_name", "Customer name", 22, "text",
                formula=lookup_customer("name"),
                note="Automatic. 'Not in Customer CRM' means the ID is "
                     "wrong."),
            Col("nickname", "Site name", 18, "text",
                note="What the crew calls it: 'the big one on Mill "
                     "Lane', 'Harper rear'. Optional but they will "
                     "thank you."),
            Col("address", "Address", 30, "wrap",
                note="Start typing here. The Property ID appears as "
                     "soon as you do."),
            Col("town", "Town / city", 16, "text"),
            Col("postcode", "Zip / postcode", 12, "text"),
            Col("type", "Property type", 18, "text",
                validate=list_from("PropertyTypeList")),
            Col("lawn_area", "Lawn area (sq ft)", 14, "int",
                validate=amount(
                    0, 2000000,
                    "Roughly how much grass do you cut here, in square "
                    "feet? An average suburban back lawn is 2,000 to "
                    "6,000."),
                note="The number everything is priced from. Measure once, "
                     "properly, and the quote calculator does the rest."),
            Col("beds_area", "Beds / borders (sq ft)", 15, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 2000000),
                note="Planted area. Drives mulch and weeding quantities."),
            Col("hedge_length", "Hedge (linear ft)", 13, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 100000)),
            Col("terrain", "Terrain", 16, "text",
                validate=list_from("TerrainList"),
                note="Flat and open cuts faster than steep and awkward. "
                     "This feeds the difficulty multiplier."),
            Col("access", "Access", 20, "text",
                validate=list_from("AccessList"),
                note="How the mower gets in. A narrow side gate means "
                     "the ride-on stays on the trailer."),
            Col("gate_code", "Gate / alarm code", 14, "text",
                note="Leave empty if this file is shared. Recording a "
                     "code here is a choice, not a requirement."),
            Col("dog", "Dog on site", 10, "flag",
                validate=yesno("Is there a dog that may be loose in the "
                               "garden?"),
                note="The crew needs to know before they open the gate."),
            Col("pets_note", "Site hazards", 26, "wrap",
                note="Ponds, septic lids, irrigation heads, a bad step, "
                     "the neighbour's cat. Anything that costs money if "
                     "it gets hit."),
            Col("parking", "Parking", 18, "text",
                note="Where the truck and trailer actually fit."),
            Col("water", "Water on site", 10, "flag",
                validate=yesno()),
            Col("power", "Power on site", 10, "flag",
                validate=yesno()),
            Col("disposal", "Clippings", 16, "text",
                note="Leave on site, bag them, or take them away. Taking "
                     "them away is a cost - price it."),
            Col("miles", "Miles from yard", 12, "number1",
                validate=amount(0, 2000,
                                      "One way distance from your yard "
                                      "or depot."),
                note="One way. The quote calculator charges the round "
                     "trip at the rate on Settings."),
            Col("drive_minutes", "Drive (mins)", 11, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 600),
                note="One way, in normal traffic. Blank uses the default "
                     "on Settings."),
            Col("difficulty", "Difficulty", 10, "number1",
                formula=zero("address",
                             'ROUND(1'
                             '+IF({terrain}{r}="Steep slope",0.25,'
                             'IF({terrain}{r}="Gentle slope",0.1,'
                             'IF({terrain}{r}="Terraced",0.2,'
                             'IF({terrain}{r}="Rough / uneven",0.15,'
                             'IF({terrain}{r}="Wet / boggy",0.15,0)))))'
                             '+IF({access}{r}="Narrow side gate",0.15,'
                             'IF({access}{r}="Rear access only",0.1,'
                             'IF({access}{r}="Locked gate - code needed",'
                             '0.05,IF({access}{r}="Steps only",0.2,0))))'
                             '+IF({obstacles}{r}>=8,0.15,'
                             'IF({obstacles}{r}>=4,0.08,0))'
                             '+IF({dog}{r}="Yes",0.05,0),2)'),
                cf=scale_cf(),
                note="Worked out from terrain, access, obstacles and the "
                     "dog. 1.00 is an easy flat lawn; 1.50 takes half as "
                     "long again. The quote calculator multiplies by it."),
            Col("obstacles", "Trees / obstacles", 12, "int",
                validate=amount(0, 500,
                                      "Roughly how many things do you "
                                      "have to mow around?"),
                note="Trees, beds, play equipment, washing poles. Every "
                     "one of them is a turn."),
            Col("mowing_minutes", "Mow time (mins)", 12, "int",
                formula=zero("address",
                             'ROUND(MAX(10,{lawn_area}{r}/1000*'
                             'MowMinutesPer1000)*{difficulty}{r},0)'),
                note="An estimate from area and difficulty, for planning. "
                     "Actual times come from the timesheets."),
            Col("status", "Status", 13, "text",
                validate=list_from("PropertyStatusList"),
                cf=status_cf()),
            Col("start_date", "Maintained since", 14, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("photo_before", "Photo - before", 22, "link",
                note="Paste a link to the photo in your cloud drive. The "
                     "workbook stores the link, not the picture."),
            Col("photo_after", "Photo - after", 22, "link",
                note="The pair of them is the best sales tool you own."),
            Col("map_link", "Map link", 22, "link",
                note="A link to this address in your map app, for the "
                     "crew. The workbook does not navigate."),
            Col("notes", "Site notes", 34, "wrap",
                note="'Cut the verge too', 'nobody home on Fridays', "
                     "'bins out Tuesday so park on the road'."),

            # ---- what happens here -----------------------------------
            Col("jobs_done", "Visits done", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("address", count_by("Job & Work Orders",
                                                 "property", '{id}{r}',
                                                 "is_done", "1")),
                cf=scale_cf()),
            Col("jobs_open", "Visits booked", 12, "int",
                formula=zero("address", count_by("Job & Work Orders",
                                                 "property", '{id}{r}',
                                                 "is_open", "1"))),
            Col("revenue", "Revenue", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("address", sum_by("Job & Work Orders",
                                               "charge", "property",
                                               '{id}{r}', "is_done", "1")),
                cf=money_cf()),
            Col("cost", "Cost", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("address", sum_by("Job & Work Orders", "cost",
                                               "property", '{id}{r}',
                                               "is_done", "1"))),
            Col("profit", "Profit", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("address",
                             'ROUND({revenue}{r}-{cost}{r},2)'),
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": "<", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": ">", "value": 0,
                     "fmt": "good"}]),
            Col("hours_actual", "Hours booked", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("address", sum_by("Job & Work Orders",
                                               "hours_actual", "property",
                                               '{id}{r}', "is_done", "1")),
                note="From the timesheets, via the jobs. Compare with "
                     "the mow time estimate - if they disagree, the "
                     "estimate is wrong."),
            Col("per_hour", "Earned per hour", 13, "money",
                formula='=IF({address}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({hours_actual}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({revenue}{r}/'
                        '{hours_actual}{r},2)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="The honest test of a price. Below your charge-out "
                     "rate means this address is subsidised by the rest."),
            Col("contracts", "On contract", 10, "int",
                formula=zero("address", count_by("Recurring Contracts",
                                                 "property", '{id}{r}',
                                                 "is_live", "1"))),
            Col("last_num", "Last visit #", 11, "number",
                formula=zero("address",
                             'SUMPRODUCT(MAX('
                             '([[Job & Work Orders.property]]={id}{r})*'
                             '([[Job & Work Orders.is_done]]=1)*'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.date_num]]))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("last_visit", "Last visit", 12, "date",
                formula='=IF({address}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({last_num}{r}<=0,"",{last_num}{r}))'),
            Col("next_num", "Next visit #", 11, "number",
                formula=zero("address",
                             'IF(COUNTIFS('
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.property]],{id}{r},'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.is_open]],1)=0,0,'
                             'SUMPRODUCT(MIN(IF('
                             '([[Job & Work Orders.property]]={id}{r})*'
                             '([[Job & Work Orders.is_open]]=1)=1,'
                             '[[Job & Work Orders.date_num]],99999))))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("next_visit", "Next visit", 12, "date",
                formula='=IF({address}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({next_num}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'IF({next_num}{r}>=99999,"",'
                        '{next_num}{r})))',
                note="The earliest booked visit still outstanding."),
            Col("days_since", "Days since", 10, "int",
                formula=zero("address",
                             'IF({last_num}{r}<=0,0,'
                             'TodayDate-{last_num}{r})'),
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=DormantDays", "fmt": "bad"}]),
            Col("is_active", "Active", 7, "int",
                formula=zero("address",
                             'IF({status}{r}="Active",1,0)'),
                hidden=True),
            rank_desc("revenue", guard='{address}{r}=""'),

            Col("alert", "What needs doing", 46, "wrap",
                formula=alert_chain("address", [
                    ('{customer_name}{r}="Not in Customer CRM"',
                     "Check - the Customer ID does not exist"),
                    ('{lawn_area}{r}=0',
                     "Add - no lawn area, so nothing here can be priced"),
                    ('AND({is_active}{r}=1,{jobs_open}{r}=0,'
                     '{contracts}{r}=0)',
                     "Schedule - active site with nothing booked and no "
                     "contract"),
                    ('AND({is_active}{r}=1,{days_since}{r}>=DormantDays,'
                     '{jobs_done}{r}>0)',
                     "Dormant - a long time since the last visit here"),
                    ('AND({revenue}{r}>0,{profit}{r}<0)',
                     "Loss - this address costs more than it brings in"),
                    ('AND({hours_actual}{r}>0,{per_hour}{r}<>"",'
                     '{per_hour}{r}<ChargeRate)',
                     "Thin margin - earning under your hourly rate here"),
                    ('{miles}{r}=0',
                     "Add - no distance set, so travel is not being "
                     "charged"),
                    ('AND({jobs_done}{r}=0,{jobs_open}{r}=0)',
                     "Action - no work recorded at this property yet"),
                ]),
                cf=alert_cf()),
        ],
    )
````

### `31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/quotes.py`

<!-- source-file: 31-landscaping/landscaping_spreadsheet/sheets/quotes.py sha256:63ee7a77dab777c4a885378e3738e191f000527c5ced53c1afb0a0c62e3ddf75 -->
````python
"""7. Quote Calculator - the tab people buy this workbook for.

Pick a property and a service and the price builds itself: lawn size
off the property, labour off the catalogue time, materials, equipment,
the round trip to site, overhead by the hour, then the margin you
asked for. Every line of that build is visible, because a quote you
cannot explain is a quote you cannot defend.

Mark a quote Accepted and the work order columns light up - that is
the hand-off into the Job & Work Orders tab.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..config import Palette, Config
from ..layout import Col, SheetSpec
from ..sample_data import get as sample
from ..writer import date_check, list_from
from .common import (alert_cf, alert_chain, amount, customer_col,
                     date_num_col, id_col, is_live_quote, is_won_quote,
                     lookup_customer, lookup_property, lookup_property_num,
                     lookup_service, lookup_service_num, loss_cf, margin,
                     money_cf, month_col, pick, property_col,
                     service_col, service_tax, status_cf, zero)

NAME = "Quote Calculator"


def spec(cfg: Config) -> SheetSpec:
    return SheetSpec(
        name=NAME,
        title="Quote Calculator",
        subtitle="Lawn size, labour, materials, equipment, travel and "
                 "the margin you want - priced in one row.",
        tab_color=Palette.accent,
        rows=cfg.row_count("quotes"),
        samples=sample("quotes", cfg),
        freeze_cols=3,
        help_text=(
            "Pick the customer, the property and the service. The lawn "
            "area and the drive come from the Property Database, the "
            "time and the materials from the Service Catalog, and the "
            "rates from Settings. Then look at the margin column and "
            "decide whether you are happy. Override any white cell - "
            "the shaded ones work themselves out."),
        extra_notes=[
            "The quote is built cost-up, not price-down: your cost is "
            "worked out first and the margin is added to it. That is "
            "why it can tell you when a price you had in mind is one "
            "you cannot afford.",
            "Travel is charged on the round trip, both ways, because "
            "that is how long the truck is away from anything else.",
            "Accepted quotes are the ones the job register expects to "
            "see. Set the status, write the Job ID you create against "
            "it, and the two tabs stay tied together.",
            "A quote expires on its own after the number of days set "
            "on Settings. An expired quote is a reason to call, not a "
            "reason to delete the row.",
        ],
        columns=[
            id_col("date", "QuotePrefix", digits=cfg.digits("quote"),
                   header="Quote ID",
                   note="Generated. Put this number on the paperwork "
                        "you send out."),
            Col("date", "Quote date", 12, "date",
                validate=date_check(),
                note="Start here. Everything else on the row unlocks "
                     "once there is a date."),
            customer_col(),
            Col("customer_name", "Customer name", 22, "text",
                formula=lookup_customer("name")),
            property_col(),
            Col("address", "Address", 28, "text",
                formula=lookup_property("address")),
            service_col(),
            Col("description", "What is included", 34, "wrap",
                formula='=IF({service}{r}="","",'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX([[Service Catalog.description]],'
                        'MATCH({service}{r},'
                        '[[Service Catalog.name]],0))&"",""))',
                note="Pulled from the catalogue so the quote says the "
                     "same thing every time. Overwrite it on the "
                     "printable if one job is different."),
            Col("frequency", "Frequency", 15, "text",
                validate=pick("FrequencyList",
                              "One-off, or how often it repeats if this "
                              "is a maintenance quote."),
                note="A recurring quote is worth its annual value, not "
                     "its visit value. The column on the right shows "
                     "both."),

            # ---- what the site tells us ------------------------------
            Col("area", "Lawn area", 11, "int",
                formula=lookup_property_num("lawn_area"),
                note="From the Property Database. Measure it there, "
                     "once."),
            Col("difficulty", "Difficulty", 10, "number1",
                formula='=IF({property}{r}="","",'
                        'IFERROR(INDEX([[Property Database.difficulty]],'
                        'MATCH({property}{r},'
                        '[[Property Database.id]],0))*1,1))',
                note="Slope, access, obstacles and the dog, from the "
                     "property record."),
            Col("miles", "Miles each way", 12, "number1",
                formula=lookup_property_num("miles")),

            # ---- the build -------------------------------------------
            Col("cat_minutes", "Catalogue mins", 12, "int",
                formula=lookup_service_num("minutes"),
                hidden=True),
            Col("cat_unit", "Unit", 14, "text",
                formula=lookup_service("unit", missing=""),
                hidden=True),
            Col("cat_crew", "Catalogue crew", 11, "int",
                formula=lookup_service_num("crew_size"),
                hidden=True),
            Col("units", "Units", 10, "number1",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'IF({cat_unit}{r}="Per 1,000 sq ft",'
                             'MAX(1,{area}{r})/1000,'
                             'IF({cat_unit}{r}="Per 100 sq ft",'
                             'MAX(1,{area}{r})/100,'
                             'IF({cat_unit}{r}="Per sq ft",'
                             'MAX(1,{area}{r}),1)))'),
                note="How many units of the catalogue price this site "
                     "needs. For a per-visit service it is simply 1."),
            Col("est_minutes", "Est. minutes", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({cat_minutes}{r}*{units}{r}*'
                             'MAX(1,{difficulty}{r}),0)'),
                note="Catalogue time, scaled for the size of this lawn "
                     "and how awkward it is."),
            Col("crew_size", "Crew", 8, "int",
                validate=amount(1, 20, "How many people are going?",
                                decimal=False),
                note="Override the catalogue if you are sending a "
                     "different number of people."),
            Col("crew_used", "Crew used", 9, "int",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'IF({crew_size}{r}>0,{crew_size}{r},'
                             'MAX(1,{cat_crew}{r}))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("site_hours", "Hours on site", 11, "number1",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({est_minutes}{r}/60/'
                             'MAX(1,{crew_used}{r}),2)'),
                note="How long the visit takes with that many people on "
                     "it. Two people halve the clock, not the cost."),
            Col("drive_hours", "Drive hours", 10, "number1",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND(2*IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Property Database.drive_minutes]],'
                             'MATCH({property}{r},'
                             '[[Property Database.id]],0))*1,'
                             'DriveMinutes)/60*{crew_used}{r},2)'),
                note="Round trip, times the crew, because they are all "
                     "in the truck and all being paid."),
            Col("labour_hours", "Crew hours", 10, "number1",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({site_hours}{r}*{crew_used}{r}+'
                             '{drive_hours}{r},2)'),
                note="Total paid hours this quote has to cover."),
            Col("labour_cost", "Labour cost", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({labour_hours}{r}*LabourRate,2)'),
                note="At your loaded crew rate from Settings - wages "
                     "plus tax plus insurance, not the take-home."),
            Col("materials_cost", "Materials", 11, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "Leave blank to use the catalogue "
                                "figure for this service."),
                note="Your cost, not the customer's price. The markup "
                     "is added below."),
            Col("materials_used", "Materials used", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'IF({materials_cost}{r}>0,'
                             '{materials_cost}{r},'
                             'ROUND(IFERROR(INDEX('
                             '[[Service Catalog.materials_cost]],'
                             'MATCH({service}{r},'
                             '[[Service Catalog.name]],0))*1,0)*'
                             '{units}{r},2))'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("materials_charge", "Materials charged", 13, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({materials_used}{r}*'
                             'MaterialMarkup,2)'),
                note="Cost times the markup on Settings. Handling, "
                     "collecting and carrying are real work."),
            Col("equipment_cost", "Equipment", 10, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "Hire, blades, fuel for the day, or a "
                                "share of what the machine costs to "
                                "own."),
                note="Anything this job needs that the hourly rate does "
                     "not already cover."),
            Col("travel_cost", "Travel", 10, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND(2*{miles}{r}*TravelRate,2)'),
                note="Round trip at the mileage rate on Settings. Fuel, "
                     "tyres and the share of the truck."),
            Col("disposal_cost", "Disposal", 10, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "Tip fees, green waste, skip hire."),
                note="Taking it away is never free. Charge it."),
            Col("overhead_cost", "Overhead", 10, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({labour_hours}{r}*OverheadRate,2)'),
                note="The yard, the van insurance, the phone and the "
                     "evenings doing paperwork, per crew hour."),
            Col("total_cost", "Cost to you", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({labour_cost}{r}+'
                             '{materials_used}{r}+{equipment_cost}{r}+'
                             '{travel_cost}{r}+{disposal_cost}{r}+'
                             '{overhead_cost}{r},2)'),
                note="What this visit actually costs you, before a "
                     "penny of profit."),

            # ---- the price -------------------------------------------
            Col("target_margin", "Margin wanted", 11, "percent0",
                validate=amount(0, 0.95,
                                "The profit margin you want on this "
                                "job. Blank uses the target on "
                                "Settings."),
                note="Your number, job by job. A difficult customer or "
                     "a tight season is a reason to change it."),
            Col("margin_used", "Margin used", 10, "percent0",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'IF({target_margin}{r}>0,'
                             '{target_margin}{r},TargetMargin)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("calc_price", "Calculated price", 13, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND(MAX(MinimumVisit,'
                             '({total_cost}{r}-{materials_used}{r}+'
                             '{materials_charge}{r})/'
                             'MAX(0.05,1-{margin_used}{r})),2)'),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="Cost plus the margin you asked for, with the "
                     "minimum visit charge as a floor. This is the "
                     "suggestion."),
            Col("discount", "Discount", 10, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "Any reduction you are offering - a "
                                "neighbour deal, a first-visit offer."),
                note="Record it rather than quietly lowering the price, "
                     "so you can see what discounting costs you."),
            Col("quoted_price", "Your price", 12, "money",
                validate=amount(0, 1000000,
                                "What you are actually quoting. Blank "
                                "uses the calculated price."),
                note="Override whenever you like. The margin column "
                     "tells you immediately what the override did."),
            Col("price_used", "Price", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND(IF({quoted_price}{r}>0,'
                             '{quoted_price}{r},{calc_price}{r})-'
                             '{discount}{r},2)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("tax", "Tax", 10, "money",
                formula=zero("service", service_tax('{price_used}{r}')),
                note="Only if you have switched tax on, on Settings. "
                     "Whether mowing is taxable where you trade is a "
                     "question for your accountant."),
            Col("total", "Total quoted", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'ROUND({price_used}{r}+{tax}{r},2)'),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="What goes on the paperwork."),
            Col("profit", "Profit", 11, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({price_used}{r}-{total_cost}{r},2)'),
                cf=loss_cf()),
            Col("margin_pct", "Margin", 9, "percent",
                formula='=IF({service}{r}="","",'
                        f'{margin("{profit}{r}", "{price_used}{r}")})',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=TargetMargin", "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=MinMargin", "fmt": "bold_bad"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=TargetMargin", "fmt": "warn"}],
                note="The number to look at before you press send."),
            Col("per_hour", "Earns per hour", 12, "money",
                formula='=IF({service}{r}="","",'
                        'IF({labour_hours}{r}<=0,"",'
                        'ROUND({price_used}{r}/'
                        '{labour_hours}{r},2)))',
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "good"},
                    {"type": "cell", "criteria": "<",
                     "value": "=ChargeRate", "fmt": "warn"}]),
            Col("visits_year", "Visits / year", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'IFERROR(INDEX(VisitsPerYear,'
                             'MATCH({frequency}{r},FrequencyList,0))*1,'
                             '0)'),
                hidden=True),
            Col("annual_value", "Annual value", 12, "money",
                formula=zero("service",
                             'ROUND({total}{r}*{visits_year}{r},2)'),
                cf=money_cf(),
                note="What a recurring quote is really worth over a "
                     "year. A one-off shows zero - that is the point."),

            # ---- where it went ---------------------------------------
            Col("status", "Status", 14, "text",
                validate=list_from("QuoteStatusList"),
                cf=status_cf(),
                note="Accepted is the one that matters - it is the "
                     "signal to raise a work order."),
            Col("sent_date", "Sent", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("decision_date", "Answered", 11, "date",
                validate=date_check()),
            Col("valid_until", "Valid until", 11, "date",
                formula='=IF({date}{r}="","",'
                        '{date}{r}+QuoteValidDays)',
                note="Automatic, from the date and the validity period "
                     "on Settings."),
            Col("days_out", "Days waiting", 11, "int",
                formula=zero("date",
                             'IF({sent_date}{r}="",0,'
                             'IF({decision_date}{r}<>"",'
                             '{decision_date}{r}-{sent_date}{r},'
                             'TodayDate-{sent_date}{r}))'),
                cf=[{"type": "cell", "criteria": ">=", "value": 14,
                     "fmt": "warn"}]),
            Col("job", "Job ID", 11, "id",
                validate=pick("JobIDList",
                              "Pick the work order this quote turned "
                              "into."),
                note="Once you have raised the work order, write its "
                     "Job ID here. That is the thread from quote to "
                     "job to invoice."),
````
